papers.title: Discovery, Characterization, and Potential Origins of a Stream in the Stellar Halo of Nearby LMC-Mass Galaxy NGC 55
authors: Clara E. Martínez-Vásquez Clecio R. Bom
papers.abstract: We present a previously undetected stellar stream in the halo of the LMC-mass dwarf galaxy NGC 55 (2 Mpc), as part of an ongoing effort to characterize the stellar halos of LMC/SMC-mass dwarfs in the DEEP component of the DECam Local Volume Exploration (DELVE) survey. This structure is aligned with an outflow traced by H$α$ emission, a spur and cloud of neutral hydrogen, and the ultra-diffuse and possibly disrupting satellite galaxy NGC 55-dw1. We investigate possible ex-situ progenitor scenarios for this stream through the local luminosity-metallicity relation and a set of toy dynamical models that include gaseous, stellar, and dark matter components. If the stream is a product of a previous merger, the progenitor galaxy had an absolute magnitude $M_V \leq -7.2$ and a stellar mass $M_* \geq 10^5 M_{\odot}$ based on extrapolations of the detected stellar populations. If it is disrupted material from the ultra-diffuse satellite, their shared progenitor had an absolute magnitude $M_V \leq -8.3$ and a stellar mass $M_* \geq 10^{5.2} M_{\odot}$. We compare our stream and progenitor scenarios to those for NGC 300, a galaxy with a stellar mass similar to that of NGC~55 and known to host multiple structures in its halo. Our results demonstrate that even relatively isolated LMC-mass galaxies can have complex accretion histories, providing new tests of hierarchical galaxy formation at low masses.

analysis.title_zh: 附近大麦哲伦云质量星系 NGC 55 恒星晕中一条星流的发现、表征及潜在起源
analysis.summary_zh: 作者利用 DELVE 巡天在附近的大麦哲伦云质量星系 NGC 55 的恒星晕中发现一条此前未知的恒星流，并结合局域光度—金属丰度关系及含气体、恒星和暗物质的玩具动力学模型研究其可能前身。摘要报告，该结构可能来自早期并合或 NGC 55-dw1 的潮汐瓦解，相关估算支持 NGC 55 即使较为孤立也可能具有复杂吸积史。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作并非直接研究 CMB，但它检验了低质量尺度上的层级星系形成、卫星吸积与暗物质晕中的潮汐演化。此类近场观测可补充 CMB 对早期宇宙和总体宇宙学参数的约束，用于检验由 CMB 标定的 ΛCDM 框架在小尺度结构形成方面的预言。
key_points: 在距约 2 Mpc 的大麦哲伦云质量星系 NGC 55 的恒星晕中发现此前未探测到的恒星流。
该结构与 Hα 外流、中性氢结构及可能正受扰动的超弥散卫星星系 NGC 55-dw1 方向一致。
不同前身情景均指向 NGC 55 具有复杂的低质量星系吸积历史。
methods: DECam Local Volume Exploration（DELVE）巡天 DEEP 部分的恒星晕观测
局域光度—金属丰度关系
包含气体、恒星和暗物质组分的玩具动力学模型
与质量相近且具有已知晕结构的 NGC 300 进行比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对恒星流的探测稳健性与成员星选择方法，并检查其与 Hα、中性氢及 NGC 55-dw1 的空间对齐是否足以区分共同起源、卫星剥离和独立并合等情景；摘要中的前身质量与光度约束依赖恒星族外推和玩具模型，其系统误差及模型退化尤其关键。

papers.title: Resurrecting Electroweak Dark Matter via Type-II Seesaw in light of recent LZ Event
papers.abstract: The recent observation of the high-energy nuclear recoil event LZ230616 with a recoil energy around 248 keV provides an interesting possibility to probe inelastic doublet dark matter (iDM). However, the electroweak doublet DM scenarios face strong constraints from solar DM capture for DM masses around the TeV scale which give rise to correct thermal relic density. In this work, we revive the inelastic doublet DM (iDM) scenario via type-II seesaw. In particular, we consider an inert lepton doublet (ILD) DM. While the minimal ILD scenario gives the correct relic abundance around the TeV scale, it is strongly constrained by direct detection and solar DM capture. In the type-II seesaw, the presence of the scalar triplet generates the required mass splitting and provides additional annihilation channels, allowing the correct relic abundance for much larger DM masses. The larger DM mass also helps evade the solar capture and indirect detection constraints. Additionally, the scalar triplet gives sub-eV neutrino masses required by the oscillation data.

analysis.title_zh: 近期 LZ 事件背景下通过 Type-II seesaw 复兴电弱暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对近期 LZ230616 高能核反冲事件可能指向的非弹性双重态暗物质，研究以 Type-II seesaw 扩展惰性轻子双重态模型。摘要称，标量三重态既能生成所需质量劈裂和额外湮灭道，使更高质量处仍可获得正确热遗迹丰度，也可产生振荡数据所需的亚电子伏中微子质量；更高暗物质质量则有助于避开太阳俘获和间接探测限制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作连接了热暗物质、中微子质量与地下直接探测异常，是粒子宇宙学中的模型构建研究。它与 CMB 的关系主要是间接的：热遗迹丰度决定宇宙暗物质密度，而暗物质湮灭所受的间接限制原则上也可能涉及早期宇宙能量注入；但摘要没有明确使用 CMB 数据或报告 CMB 约束，因此对 CMB 专门研究者更适合作为相关模型背景阅读。
key_points: Type-II seesaw 标量三重态可为惰性轻子双重态暗物质产生所需的质量劈裂。
新增湮灭道使正确热遗迹丰度可对应更高的暗物质质量。
较高质量有助于规避太阳俘获和间接探测约束，同时模型可产生亚电子伏中微子质量。
methods: 惰性轻子双重态非弹性暗物质模型
Type-II seesaw 标量三重态机制
热遗迹丰度分析
直接探测、太阳暗物质俘获与间接探测约束
中微子振荡数据所要求的质量条件
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：LZ230616 单一高能核反冲事件对应的非弹性散射参数区间如何确定；标量三重态产生的质量劈裂和新增湮灭道是否能在同一参数区间内同时满足遗迹丰度、直接探测、太阳俘获、间接探测及中微子质量约束。摘要未给出拟合优度、显著性或允许参数范围，不宜据此判断该事件得到暗物质解释。

papers.title: Non-linear halo bias for accurate modelling of cosmic infrared background anisotropies
papers.abstract: Halo models provide the standard framework for interpreting cosmic infrared background (CIB) anisotropies and inferring the connection between dusty star-forming galaxies and their host dark matter halos. Recent studies have shown that inaccuracies in the modelling of halo clustering may bias the inferred parameters governing star formation in dark matter halos. In this work, we investigate whether a more detailed description of halo clustering can alleviate these shortcomings. We incorporate a scale-dependent, non-linear correction to the halo bias within a halo-model framework based on a simple SFR-halo mass parametrisation. We consider both a full mass-dependent implementation and a computationally efficient approximation. We also investigate the impact of updated (sub)halo mass functions. We validate the revised framework using mock observations derived from a dedicated simplified version of the SIDES-Uchuu simulation, combining the SIDES empirical galaxy model with the Uchuu N-body simulation, specifically designed to match the SFR prescriptions adopted in our halo-model. The corrections modify the predicted CIB clustering by up to 30% on intermediate scales, while the effective implementation reproduces the full treatment at the sub-percent level. The updated model removes the scale-dependent discrepancies previously identified and accurately reproduces the measured power spectra over the full multipole range. In MCMC analyses, the input SFR parameters are recovered with substantially reduced biases, with all input parameters recovered within their $1σ$ confidence intervals. Our results demonstrate that accurately modelling non-linear halo clustering is essential not only to reproduce CIB anisotropies, but also to reliably recover the underlying galaxy-halo connection. The framework presented here provides a validated foundation for future analyses of observational data.

analysis.title_zh: 用于精确建模宇宙红外背景各向异性的非线性晕偏置
analysis.summary_zh: 论文在采用简单恒星形成率（SFR）—晕质量参数化的晕模型中，引入尺度依赖的非线性晕偏置修正，并利用专门构建的简化版 SIDES-Uchuu 模拟观测进行验证。摘要报告该修正可使中间尺度的 CIB 聚类预测改变最多约 30%，高效实现与完整处理达到亚百分比一致性，同时消除原有尺度依赖偏差，并在 MCMC 中将全部输入 SFR 参数回收到各自的 1σ 区间内。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CIB 是 CMB 温度、透镜重建及相关交叉关联分析中的重要毫米波/亚毫米波天体信号与前景，其角功率谱建模误差可能传播到宇宙学推断。该工作表明，中间尺度上的非线性晕聚类不能简单忽略，并提供了一个经模拟验证且计算上较高效的修正方案，有助于更可靠地刻画 CIB 及其背后的星系—暗物质晕关系；但摘要中的验证依赖与模型处方相匹配的专用模拟，向真实 CMB/CIB 数据推广仍需进一步核验。
key_points: 在晕模型中加入尺度依赖的非线性晕偏置修正。
修正使中间尺度的 CIB 聚类预测最多改变约 30%。
高效近似达到亚百分比精度，并明显减小 SFR 参数回收偏差。
methods: 基于简单 SFR–晕质量参数化的晕模型
尺度依赖、非线性的晕偏置修正，包括完整质量依赖实现与高效近似
更新的晕及子晕质量函数
由 SIDES 经验星系模型与 Uchuu N 体模拟构建的专用简化版 SIDES-Uchuu 模拟观测
角功率谱比较与 MCMC 参数推断
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对非线性偏置修正的具体形式、适用尺度与校准方式，以及简化版 SIDES-Uchuu 模拟和推断模型共享 SFR 处方是否使验证偏于理想化；还需检查“全多极范围”内的拟合质量、协方差处理，以及面对真实数据中的仪器噪声、频率相关系统误差和其他前景时结论能否保持。

papers.title: Stochastic black hole growth tracks stellar mass in ultramassive galaxies
papers.abstract: Over the past three decades, it has been established that galaxy spheroids contain supermassive black holes (BHs) whose masses correlate tightly with the properties of their host galaxies. The most predictive of these correlations is between BH mass and stellar velocity dispersion (the $M_{\rm BH}-σ$ relation), alongside a relation with bulge luminosity or stellar mass (the $M_{\rm BH}-M_\star$ relation). Theoretical models of galaxy evolution predict that for the most massive galaxies, whose late-time growth proceeds mainly via gas-poor `dry' mergers, $M_\star$ should become a better predictor of BH mass than $σ$. However, genuine deviations from the $M_{\rm BH}-σ$ relation have remained difficult to observe due to the extreme rarity and low central surface brightness of such galaxies. Here we report James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) measurements of central BHs in a sample of eight ultramassive galaxies. We find the largest deviations from the $M_{\rm BH}-σ$ relation ever reported, with most BH masses exceeding $10^{10}$ solar masses. In this extreme mass regime, the galaxies tightly follow the $M_{\rm BH}-M_\star$ relation with minimal scatter, successfully confirming theoretical predictions. Furthermore, we observe significant stochasticity: For one ultramassive galaxy, the central dispersion drops rather than peaks, revealing no evidence for a central mass; while we can formally only place an upper limit, the data are entirely consistent with no BH at all. Crucially, this physical dichotomy is already evident directly in the raw kinematic maps prior to any fitting, and is robustly confirmed by our dynamical modelling. This unexpected diversity suggests that extreme multi-body dynamical processes, such as gravitational recoil or three-body ejections, significantly disrupt BH growth in the Universe's most massive galaxies.

analysis.title_zh: 超大质量星系中的随机黑洞增长追随恒星质量
analysis.summary_zh: 论文利用JWST观测8个超大质量星系的中心运动学并进行动力学建模，检验极端质量区间中的黑洞—宿主星系标度关系。摘要报告这些星系显著偏离黑洞质量—速度弥散关系，却紧密遵循黑洞质量—恒星质量关系；其中一个目标仅能给出中心黑洞质量上限，数据也允许其不存在黑洞。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作不直接研究CMB，但涉及最 massive 星系的晚期并合史、超大质量黑洞增长及引力反冲或三体弹射等过程，可为宇宙结构形成与星系演化模型提供低红移约束。对CMB宇宙学而言，它主要属于连接初始条件与晚期非线性重子结构的间接研究，并可能影响星系—黑洞联合建模及相关引力波源群体的理解。
key_points: JWST观测了8个超大质量星系的中心黑洞。
在极端质量区间，黑洞质量与恒星质量的关系比与速度弥散的关系更符合理论预期。
一个星系仅得到黑洞质量上限，摘要认为其甚至可能没有中心黑洞。
methods: 詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）观测
原始运动学图
动力学建模
对8个超大质量星系的样本分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对黑洞质量及上限对动力学模型、恒星质量分布和各向异性假设的敏感性，并检查仅含8个目标的样本如何选择、所谓“极小散布”如何估计，以及无中心黑洞的解释能否排除分辨率或建模退化。

papers.title: Modified Gravity from growth data: goodness-of-fit and gravitational coupling
papers.abstract: While background expansion data alone cannot discriminate among cosmological models, the growth of large-scale structures directly probes the underlying theory of gravity, offering a path to distinguish General Relativity from its modifications. In this work, we constrain three representative $F(R)$ modified gravity models (Starobinsky, Hu-Sawicki, and $R^2$-corrected Appleby-Battye) using measurements of the growth rate $f(z)$ and the matter fluctuation amplitude $σ_8(z)$. Our analyses combine MCMC parameter estimation, Gaussian Process reconstructions, and goodness-of-fit statistics including Akaike information criterion (AIC) and Bayesian information criterion (BIC). All investigated models provide statistically comparable fits to the current growth data, with information criteria differences too small to establish a preference for any particular scenario. To overcome this degeneracy, we reconstruct the effective gravitational coupling $μ(z)$ from the MCMC posterior samples, providing a physically motivated diagnostic that complements standard goodness-of-fit criteria. The Starobinsky and Hu-Sawicki models predict moderate departures from General Relativity, remaining compatible with constraints on both $μ(z)$ and $S_8$. In contrast, the $R^2$-AB model predicts $μ_0 \sim 3.5$ and $S_8 = 0.638$, a $3.2σ$ tension with Planck 2018, rendering it physically disfavored despite its competitive statistical performance.

analysis.title_zh: 利用结构增长数据检验修正引力：拟合优度与引力耦合
analysis.summary_zh: 论文利用 f(z) 和 σ₈(z) 增长数据，结合 MCMC、高斯过程及 AIC/BIC，比较 Starobinsky、Hu-Sawicki 和含 R² 修正的 Appleby-Battye 三种 F(R) 引力模型。摘要称三者拟合表现相近，但由后验重建的 μ(z) 显示 R²-AB 模型给出 μ₀约为 3.5、S₈=0.638，并与 Planck 2018 存在其所报的 3.2σ 张力，因而在物理上不受偏好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作并不直接分析 CMB 或 B 模偏振，但以 Planck 2018 推断的 S₈ 作为跨探针参照，检验晚期结构增长与早期宇宙约束的一致性。其核心意义在于说明：即使修正引力模型对现有增长数据具有相近的统计拟合，结合有效引力耦合及 CMB 锚定的参数约束仍可能排除物理行为异常的模型。
key_points: 当前增长数据无法借拟合优度明确区分三个 F(R) 模型。
有效引力耦合 μ(z) 被用作信息准则之外的物理判别量。
摘要报告 R²-AB 模型的 S₈ 与 Planck 2018 存在 3.2σ 张力。
methods: 使用增长率 f(z) 与物质涨落振幅 σ₈(z) 的测量数据
MCMC 参数估计
高斯过程重建
AIC 与 BIC 拟合优度比较
由 MCMC 后验样本重建有效引力耦合 μ(z)
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对增长数据集的组成、尺度与红移适用范围，以及 μ(z) 从后验样本重建时采用的扰动方程和先验；还需检查所引 3.2σ 张力如何定义、是否计入 Planck 与增长数据之间的模型依赖和参数协方差。

papers.title: A two-component profile of baryonic feedback: hydrostatic and diffuse gas
papers.abstract: Baryonic feedback processes redistribute gas within and beyond dark matter halos, however, the resulting gas distribution remains highly uncertain, limiting predictions of the matter distribution for precision cosmology. We introduce a physically motivated approach to modelling the gas distribution that decomposes it into an approximately hydrostatic inner component and a diffuse outer component. This approach takes advantage of the growing observational landscape: X-ray measurements primarily probe the dense inner halo, while the kinetic Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (kSZ) effect is sensitive to diffuse ionized gas extending to larger radii. We implement this two-component profile within the baryonification framework, though we note that it is applicable to any model of the large-scale gas distribution. We jointly fit X-ray gas-fraction measurements from the HSC-XXL and eROSITA samples with stacked kSZ effect measurements of BOSS CMASS galaxies from the Atacama Cosmology Telescope, demonstrating that the proposed profile retains sufficient flexibility. This proof-of-concept shows that a decomposition between hydrostatic and diffuse gas provides a simple, physically interpretable framework for connecting complementary observations of the gas distribution, and a foundation for future models of baryonic feedback.

analysis.title_zh: 重子反馈的双成分剖面：流体静力学气体与弥散气体
analysis.summary_zh: 论文将重子反馈后的气体分布建模为近似流体静力学的内区成分与弥散的外区成分，并把该剖面嵌入 baryonification 框架。作者联合拟合 HSC-XXL 和 eROSITA 的 X 射线气体分数，以及 ACT 对 BOSS CMASS 星系的堆叠 kSZ 测量；摘要报告该剖面具有容纳这些互补观测所需的灵活性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: kSZ 是 CMB 次级各向异性的重要来源，可探测暗物质晕外围、X 射线较难覆盖的弥散电离气体。把 kSZ 与晕内 X 射线观测联合起来，有助于约束重子反馈导致的气体再分布，并改善对总物质分布及弱引力透镜、星系聚类等精密宇宙学预言中的重子系统误差建模。
key_points: 将晕内气体分解为近似流体静力学内区成分和弥散外区成分。
联合利用 X 射线气体分数与堆叠 kSZ 测量约束气体分布。
该概念验证旨在为重子反馈建模提供物理可解释的框架。
methods: 在 baryonification 框架中实现双成分气体剖面
HSC-XXL 与 eROSITA 样本的 X 射线气体分数测量
ACT 对 BOSS CMASS 星系的堆叠动力学 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 效应测量
对 X 射线与 kSZ 数据进行联合拟合
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对双成分剖面的参数化、内外成分之间的过渡与质量守恒条件，以及 X 射线和 kSZ 数据分别约束哪些参数、二者的系统误差与选择函数如何处理。还需检查摘要所称“足够灵活”采用了何种拟合优度或模型比较标准，以及该模型对物质功率谱等精密宇宙学观测量的影响是否在正文中得到量化。

papers.title: Intrinsic Tidal Shear at the Largest Scales: Galaxy Multiplet Alignment in DESI DR2
papers.abstract: We measure the intrinsic alignment (IA) of galaxy multiplets with the large-scale tidal field traced by galaxy positions in DESI Data Release 2. Using the BGS, LRG, and ELG samples spanning $0.01 < z < 1.6$, we optimize the scales which define multiplets in each sample to minimize measurement noise. We measure multiplet tidal alignment $\mathcal{E}_+$ on scales beyond 100 $h^{-1}$Mpc in all samples, and detect alignment over 200 $h^{-1}$Mpc, up to 4.5$σ$ in the highest LRG redshift bin. We additionally present the multiplet shape-shape autocorrelation, $\mathcal{E}_{++}$, which is independent of galaxy bias and provides a consistency check of our NLA (nonlinear alignment) model. We do not detect a baryon acoustic feature in the projected estimator. We also find the alignment strength of multiplets is correlated with redshift and galaxy morphology. Multiplet alignment offers direct access to the tidal shear field in all galaxy samples, even where individual galaxy alignment cannot, and extends IA detection to the largest scales yet probed.
papers.comment: Submitted to the Open Journal of Astrophysics. For an accessible summary of this paper, see https://cmlamman.github.io/doc/MIA-DR2-annotation.pdf

analysis.title_zh: 最大尺度上的本征潮汐剪切：DESI DR2 中的星系多重系统对齐
analysis.summary_zh: 本文使用 DESI DR2 中跨越 0.01 < z < 1.6 的 BGS、LRG 和 ELG 样本，研究星系多重系统形状与星系位置所示踪的大尺度潮汐场之间的本征对齐，并以形状自相关检验 NLA 模型。摘要报告所有样本在超过 100 h⁻¹ Mpc 的尺度上均测得对齐，最高红移 LRG 区间延伸至超过 200 h⁻¹ Mpc，但投影估计量中未探测到重子声学特征。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 本征对齐是弱引力透镜宇宙学的重要系统误差，也可作为大尺度潮汐场的独立探针；因而该结果与 CMB 透镜、星系巡天及其交叉相关的联合分析有关。它并非直接分析 CMB 数据，但在 CMB 透镜与低红移结构联合约束中，大尺度本征对齐模型及其红移、形态依赖可能影响对物质分布和宇宙学参数的解释。
key_points: 利用 DESI DR2 的 BGS、LRG 和 ELG 样本测量星系多重系统与大尺度潮汐场的本征对齐。
摘要报告在超过 100 h⁻¹ Mpc 的尺度上测得多重系统潮汐对齐，并在最高红移 LRG 区间将探测延伸至超过 200 h⁻¹ Mpc。
形状自相关量可检验非线性对齐模型；投影估计量中未探测到重子声学特征。
methods: DESI Data Release 2 的 BGS、LRG 和 ELG 星系样本，覆盖 0.01 < z < 1.6
按样本优化定义星系多重系统的尺度，以降低测量噪声
多重系统潮汐对齐统计量 𝓔₊
多重系统形状—形状自相关统计量 𝓔₊₊
非线性对齐（NLA）模型与投影估计量
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对多重系统的构造与尺度优化是否会引入选择效应或事后优化偏差，潮汐场重建及协方差估计如何处理巡天窗口和系统误差，以及 𝓔₊₊ 对星系偏置“不敏感”的成立条件。还应检查红移、星系形态与样本选择之间的退化，以及未见声学特征究竟受统计精度、投影平滑还是模型假设限制。

papers.title: FLUMEN: Neural Emulator of an Advanced Stochastic Weak Lensing Model
papers.abstract: Weak gravitational lensing by intervening structure magnifies distant sources and induces scatter in their luminosity distances. We develop an improved stochastic model for the distribution of weak lensing magnifications, $\textrm{d} P/\textrm{d}μ$, that resolves individual lenses down to $10^7\,M_\odot$ and, besides field halos and filaments, includes subhalos and large-scale clustering of the lens population. Both extensions broaden the distribution, and the resulting scatter in the luminosity distances agrees with the halo-model prediction from the nonlinear matter power spectrum and exceeds that obtained from $N$-body ray tracing, which we attribute to the finite mass resolution and box size of the simulations. Building on this model, we develop \texttt{FLUMEN}, a conditional normalizing-flow emulator that predicts $\textrm{d} P/\textrm{d}μ$ as a function of the source redshift up to $z_s=12$ and six cosmological parameters $\{h,Ω_M,Ω_B,σ_8,n_s,z_{\rm eq}\}$. The emulator enforces the empty-beam cutoff and the fold-caustic power-law tail analytically, and reproduces the Monte Carlo distributions on held-out cosmologies with a median Kullback--Leibler divergence of $0.0048$ at negligible cost. Our results provide a fast and flexible framework for incorporating the full magnification distribution into cosmological analyses of standard sirens, supernovae, and other point sources.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 12 figures + Appendix. Git link: https://github.com/baltabaygal/flumen

analysis.title_zh: FLUMEN：先进随机弱引力透镜模型的神经网络模拟器
analysis.summary_zh: 本文构建了一个包含场晕、丝状结构、子晕及透镜大尺度聚类的随机弱透镜模型，并训练条件归一化流 FLUMEN，以源红移和六个宇宙学参数为条件预测完整放大率分布。摘要报告称，新增结构会拓宽分布，所得光度距离散布与非线性物质功率谱的晕模型预测一致但大于 $N$ 体射线追踪结果；模拟器在留出宇宙学上的 Kullback--Leibler 散度中位数为 0.0048。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作并非直接研究 CMB，但弱透镜放大率分布受非线性物质结构及 $h、Ω_M、Ω_B、σ_8、n_s$ 等参数控制，与 CMB 给出的早期宇宙参数约束具有互补关系。它可用于标准警报器和超新星等晚期宇宙学探针的完整似然建模，从而影响这些探针与 CMB 联合约束或张力检验中对透镜散布及非高斯尾部的处理。
key_points: 随机弱透镜模型加入子晕与透镜群体的大尺度聚类，两者都会拓宽放大率分布。
FLUMEN以源红移和六个宇宙学参数为条件，快速预测完整的弱透镜放大率分布。
模拟器以解析方式施加空束截断和折叠焦散幂律尾部，并在留出宇宙学模型上复现蒙特卡洛分布。
methods: 解析至质量下限为 $10^7\,M_\odot$ 的随机弱引力透镜模型，包含场晕、丝状结构、子晕及透镜群体的大尺度聚类
基于非线性物质功率谱的晕模型预测与 $N$ 体射线追踪结果对比
条件归一化流模拟器
蒙特卡洛生成的放大率分布及留出宇宙学模型验证
以 Kullback--Leibler 散度评估模拟器复现效果
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对随机透镜模型中子晕、丝状结构和大尺度聚类的具体建模假设，以及它与非线性物质功率谱晕模型和 $N$ 体射线追踪之间的比较是否控制了质量分辨率、有限盒尺度及其他系统差异；还需检查训练参数域、留出宇宙学的选取方式，以及解析尾部约束在极端红移和参数边界处是否保持准确。

papers.title: High Resolution Grid-based Simulations of the Warm-Hot Intergalactic Medium
papers.abstract: We present high-resolution cosmological hydrodynamic simulations of the Warm-Hot Intergalactic Medium (WHIM) using the GPU-optimized grid-based hydrodynamic code Kratos. Employing a uniform 4096^3 grid in a (100 h^-1 Mpc)^3 comoving volume, we achieve a spatial resolution of ~24.5 h^-1 kpc, sufficient to resolve the Jeans scale of gas at T ~ 10^4 K and n_H ~ 10^-3 to 10^-2 cm^-3. This calculation ranks among the largest grid-based cosmological hydrodynamic simulations performed to date. We find that ~23.4% of cosmic baryons reside in the WHIM phase (T = 10^5 - 10^7 K) at z = 0, significantly below the 40-50% found in earlier, lower-resolution simulations. Through a suite of lower-resolution simulations, we demonstrate that spatial resolution plays a pivotal role in determining the WHIM fraction: resolving gas near its Jeans scale allows it to reach higher densities, where enhanced radiative cooling transfers a substantial fraction of baryons out of the WHIM temperature range. The remaining WHIM resides predominantly in filaments and accretion-shock structures in the vicinity of halos, where hierarchical structure formation and ongoing hydrodynamic accretion provide continued shock heating. Synthetic observations of Lyman-alpha, O VI, O VII, and O VIII emission reveal distinct morphological and kinematic signatures, with O VI tracing filament-halo interfaces and the X-ray lines probing hotter gas associated with massive halos. These predictions underscore the importance of current and future missions such as XRISM, ATHENA, and HUBS for mapping WHIM thermodynamics and kinematics.

analysis.title_zh: 温热星系际介质的高分辨率网格模拟
analysis.summary_zh: 论文使用 4096^3 均匀网格的高分辨率宇宙学流体模拟研究温热星系际介质，并以低分辨率模拟和多种离子谱线的合成观测进行比较。摘要报告红移 z=0 时约 23.4% 的宇宙重子处于 WHIM，相比早期低分辨率结果更低，其原因被解释为解析 Jeans 尺度后气体增密、辐射冷却增强，使部分重子离开 WHIM 温区。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: WHIM 是低红移宇宙重子预算和大尺度结构气体热历史的重要组成部分，也会影响与 CMB 研究相关的热/运动学 Sunyaev–Zel'dovich 信号及其与星系、晕和丝状体的交叉相关建模。该摘要强调数值分辨率可显著改变预测的热气体比例，因此对利用 CMB 次级各向异性约束缺失重子和反馈物理具有间接但实际的方法学意义。
key_points: 高分辨率网格模拟在红移 z=0 得到约 23.4% 的宇宙重子处于 WHIM 相。
摘要将较低的 WHIM 比例归因于分辨率提升后气体达到更高密度并增强辐射冷却。
不同离子谱线分别追踪丝状体—晕界面及大质量晕附近的高温气体。
methods: 采用 GPU 优化的网格流体力学代码 Kratos 进行宇宙学流体模拟
在边长 100 h^-1 Mpc 的共动体积中使用 4096^3 均匀网格
通过一组较低分辨率模拟检验 WHIM 比例对空间分辨率的依赖
生成 Lyman-alpha、O VI、O VII 和 O VIII 发射的合成观测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对不同分辨率模拟是否采用完全一致的初始条件、冷却与反馈模型，以及摘要所述 WHIM 比例变化能否被明确归因于 Jeans 尺度的解析，而非次网格物理或数值扩散；还应检查合成谱线预测是否包含仪器响应、背景和可探测性假设。

papers.title: Leptogenesis and Planck-scale black hole remnants in a Pati-Salam cosmology
papers.abstract: We study leptogenesis and Planck-scale remnant dark matter from primordial black hole (PBH) evaporation in a minimal Pati-Salam cosmology, with the gauge symmetry broken before inflation so that magnetic monopoles are diluted away. A singlet inflaton with a near-inflection potential enhances the curvature power spectrum on small scales, producing a narrow black hole population that briefly dominates the energy density. The Pati-Salam embedding ties the right-handed neutrino masses to the SU(2)_R breaking scale, and cosmological consistency forces both the scalar-sector Yukawa coupling and the heavy neutrino mass well below that scale. Two regimes emerge, depending on whether the black holes are hot enough to emit the lightest right-handed neutrino. Lighter PBHs drive non-thermal leptogenesis, while heavier ones require a thermal asymmetry and also affect it through entropy dilution. If quantum gravitational backreaction halts evaporation at the Planck scale, each PBH leaves a stable remnant whose present abundance scales as the inverse five-halves power of the initial mass. Suppressing remnants requires heavier black holes, but the lighter PBHs needed for non-thermal leptogenesis overproduce remnant dark matter. Thus, remnant dark matter and non-thermal leptogenesis are mutually exclusive. When the thermal contribution is included, a single initial PBH mass near 10^6 g accommodates the observed dark matter abundance, the heavy neutrino mass required by the baryon asymmetry, and the Pati-Salam breaking scale. The scenario predicts a stochastic gravitational wave background from Poisson fluctuations of the black hole distribution, within reach of future experiments, alongside high-frequency graviton emission constrained by future measurements of the effective number of relativistic species.

analysis.title_zh: Pati-Salam 宇宙学中的轻子生成与普朗克尺度黑洞遗迹
analysis.summary_zh: 论文在最小 Pati-Salam 宇宙学中研究由近拐点暴胀产生的原初黑洞蒸发如何同时影响轻子生成与普朗克尺度遗迹暗物质，并区分黑洞能否辐射最轻右手中微子的两种机制区间。摘要报告非热轻子生成与遗迹暗物质彼此不相容，而加入热贡献后，初始质量约为 10^6 g 的原初黑洞可协调暗物质丰度、重中微子质量和 Pati-Salam 破缺尺度，并伴随潜在可探测的随机引力波及高频引力子信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把暴胀产生的小尺度曲率扰动、原初黑洞早期物质主导、重子不对称和暗物质统一到同一宇宙学历史中。它与 CMB 的直接联系主要在额外相对论辐射对有效相对论自由度的影响，以及熵注入和早期膨胀史对宇宙学参数约束的潜在作用；与更广义宇宙学的联系还包括小尺度原初功率谱和随机引力波背景。摘要没有报告具体的 CMB 数据分析，因此其观测可检验性仍需结合全文中的谱形、频段和参数约束判断。
key_points: 近拐点暴胀势增强小尺度曲率功率谱，产生窄质量分布的原初黑洞。
轻质量原初黑洞支持非热轻子生成，却会过量产生稳定的普朗克尺度遗迹。
计入热轻子生成后，摘要报告特定初始黑洞质量附近可同时满足暗物质、重中微子与对称性破缺尺度要求。
methods: 最小 Pati-Salam 宇宙学模型
单态暴胀子与近拐点势
原初黑洞蒸发及其短暂物质主导阶段的宇宙学演化
热与非热轻子生成分析
普朗克尺度稳定黑洞遗迹丰度估算

高频引力子辐射及有效相对论自由度约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：近拐点势产生所需原初黑洞质量函数时是否满足现有小尺度功率谱与原初黑洞约束；蒸发终止并形成稳定普朗克遗迹这一量子引力假设如何进入丰度计算；热/非热轻子生成、熵稀释和黑洞主导时期是否采用一致的玻尔兹曼演化；以及摘要所称单一质量解对初始丰度、重中微子谱和 CP 不对称参数的敏感性。还应检查随机引力波及高频引力子对未来实验和有效相对论自由度的预测是否落在相应仪器与宇宙学探针的实际频段和灵敏度内。

papers.title: Lens Modeling and Cosmological Inference from an Impure Sample of Galaxy-Galaxy Strong Lenses
authors: the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
papers.abstract: The start of the Legacy Survey of Space and Time marks a new era for strong lensing science, where the number of strong lenses identified is expected to increase to $\mathcal{O}(10^5)$. In this paper we use a neural network to determine the precision with which lens parameters can be determined, using realistic simulated LSST lensed systems. We find that the Einstein radius can be measured with a mean precision of $3.7\%$ with calibrated uncertainties accurately reflecting the corresponding measurement error. Based on the performance of current strong lens classifiers, the $\sim 100,000$ detectable strong lenses are expected to be accompanied by a similar or larger number of false positives (non-lenses). In readiness for this we introduce a formalism, termed `COSMIC-BEAMS', to infer cosmological parameters while accounting for contamination by false positives. As a proof-of-concept, using simulated LSST measurements of the Einstein radii of a realistic and impure sample of photometric lens systems, i.e. those without spectroscopic confirmation, we find that the cosmological parameters $Ω_m$, $Ω_Λ$, and $w$ can be measured to a precision of $0.1$, $0.03$ and $0.15$ respectively for a $w$CDM cosmology. We demonstrate that unbiased cosmological parameters can be inferred even in strong lens samples contaminated by $50\%$ false positives, and that the photometric dataset of $100\,000$ strong lenses will provide equivalent $w$-precision to $2500-3500$ spectroscopic systems.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 15 figures. Submitted for publication in MNRAS

analysis.title_zh: 从非纯净星系—星系强透镜样本进行透镜建模与宇宙学推断
analysis.summary_zh: 作者利用真实化的 LSST 模拟数据训练神经网络测量星系-星系强透镜参数，并提出 COSMIC-BEAMS 框架，在宇宙学推断中显式处理非透镜假阳性。摘要报告爱因斯坦半径的平均测量精度为 3.7%，且在含 50% 假阳性的模拟样本中仍能无偏推断 wCDM 参数；对 10 万个光度候选体，Ω_m、Ω_Λ 和 w 的预期精度分别为 0.1、0.03 和 0.15。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作并非直接分析 CMB，但可通过低红移强透镜对宇宙几何和暗能量参数提供独立约束，并与 CMB 的早期宇宙约束形成互补。其核心价值在于面向 LSST 规模的候选样本，把分类污染直接纳入参数推断；若相关系统误差得到控制，这类结果可用于检验 CMB 与晚期宇宙数据在 wCDM 等模型下的一致性。
key_points: 神经网络在模拟 LSST 强透镜系统上估计透镜参数及其不确定度。
COSMIC-BEAMS 将强透镜候选体中的假阳性污染纳入宇宙学推断。
摘要报告，即使样本含 50% 假阳性，模拟分析仍可得到无偏的宇宙学参数。
methods: 真实化模拟的 LSST 星系-星系强透镜系统
用于透镜参数测量及不确定度校准的神经网络
处理假阳性污染的 COSMIC-BEAMS 宇宙学推断框架
包含光度透镜候选体与非透镜体的模拟混合样本
wCDM 宇宙学模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 COSMIC-BEAMS 对真透镜与假阳性总体分布、污染率及选择函数作了哪些假设，以及所谓“无偏”结论对模拟真实性、分类器校准、红移误差和质量模型失配是否稳健；还需确认把 10 万个光度系统与 2500–3500 个光谱系统比较时采用了哪些观测信息和成本口径。

papers.title: LenNet: Direct Detection and Localization of Strong Gravitational Lenses in Wide-Field Sky Survey Images
papers.abstract: Strong gravitational lenses are invaluable tools for addressing fundamental questions in astrophysics, from the nature of dark matter to the expansion of the universe. While current sky surveys have successfully identified thousands of lens candidates, the search methods employed face a critical challenge. The conventional approach relies on a "crop-and-classify" strategy, where small images are first cut out around billions of potential host galaxies before being individually classified. This process creates a significant computational and storage bottleneck that is unsustainable for future large-scale surveys. To overcome this limitation, we propose LenNet, an object detection model that identifies lenses directly within large, original survey images. Our method completely bypasses the inefficient cropping step by framing the problem as a direct detection and localization task. We initially train LenNet on simulated data to learn the complex features of gravitational lenses and then use transfer learning to fine-tune the model on a limited set of real, labeled examples from the Kilo-Degree Survey (KiDS). Our experiments show that LenNet performs remarkably well on real survey data, validating its potential as a highly efficient and scalable solution for lens discovery in massive astronomical surveys.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 8 figures. Published in Frontiers in Astronomy and Space Sciences

analysis.title_zh: LenNet：在宽场巡天天图中直接探测与定位强引力透镜
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 LenNet，将强引力透镜搜寻从围绕候选宿主星系逐一裁剪并分类，改写为在大型原始巡天图像中直接检测和定位目标。模型先用模拟数据训练，再以 KiDS 的有限真实标注样本进行迁移学习；摘要报告其在真实巡天数据上表现良好，但未给出具体定量结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 强引力透镜能够约束暗物质分布和宇宙膨胀，因此可为 CMB 推断之外的晚期宇宙学提供独立信息，并参与检验不同宇宙学探针之间的一致性。该工作的直接贡献主要是提升未来大规模巡天中的透镜发现效率，与 CMB 数据分析本身并无直接方法联系。
key_points: 将强引力透镜搜索改写为大幅巡天图像中的目标检测与定位任务。
以模拟数据进行初始训练，再利用 KiDS 的少量真实标注样本迁移学习。
摘要称模型在真实巡天数据上表现良好，但未提供定量指标。
methods: 面向原始大幅巡天图像的目标检测与定位模型 LenNet
模拟强引力透镜数据训练
迁移学习
Kilo-Degree Survey（KiDS）真实标注数据微调与实验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对训练集与测试集的构造和隔离方式、模拟透镜与真实巡天数据之间的域差异、目标检测评价指标及其具体数值，以及在固定完备率或纯度下相较“裁剪后分类”流程的计算、存储和误报成本。还需确认其所谓直接处理“大幅原始图像”时的分块、分辨率与小目标检测策略。

papers.title: Combining astrometry with pulsar timing: the first joint analysis of very low frequency gravitational waves
papers.abstract: The pHz to sub-nHz GW regime remains largely unexplored but is crucial for mapping the early inspiral stage of SMBHBs and probing early-Universe physics. Astrometry and pulsar timing offer orthogonal and deeply complementary secular observables to investigate this frequency band. We aim to present the first joint data analysis combining real astrometric proper motions with binary pulsar timing, to search for and constrain continuous gravitational waves (CWs) sourced by SMBHBs in the ultra-low-frequency regime ($10^{-12} \le f_{GW} \le10^{-9} Hz$). We employ a Bayesian model selection and upper limit estimation framework to combine apparent proper motion displacements of $\sim 1.5 \times 10^6$ quasars from the Gaia CRF3 catalog with the line-of-sight orbital period derivatives ($\dot{P}_b$) of 11 high-precision binary pulsars. To prevent spurious detections, we heavily model instrumental and astrophysical systematics: we propagate the Galactic potential uncertainty for pulsars via Monte Carlo simulations and perform a Vector Spherical Harmonics (VSH) decomposition up to the octupole order (l=3) for quasars. We find no statistically significant evidence for a CWs signal in the joint analysis ($\ln B_{joint} = -0.42 \pm 0.03$). In the absence of detection, we set the tightest constraints to date on CW strain in the pHz band, yielding a 95% upper limit of $h_0\le6.4x10^{-11}$ at a reference frequency of $f_{ref} = 4 \times 10^{-10}$ Hz. The combined dataset achieves full sky coverage and improves single-dataset upper limits by 20%-30%. Combining orthogonal observables successfully breaks spatial degeneracies intrinsic to isolated searches. Furthermore, forecasts from inj.-rec. indicate that with the extended temporal baseline and reduced uncertainties of the upcoming Gaia DR4, this joint framework is poised to break the $h_0 < 10^{-11}$ upper limit barrier for sub-nHz CWs.

analysis.title_zh: 结合天体测量与脉冲星计时：极低频引力波的首次联合分析
analysis.summary_zh: 论文首次联合 Gaia CRF3 中约 150 万个类星体的视自行与 11 颗双星脉冲星的轨道周期导数，通过贝叶斯模型选择搜索由超大质量黑洞双星产生的 10^-12–10^-9 Hz 连续引力波。摘要报告未发现统计显著信号，并在 4×10^-10 Hz 处给出 95% 应变上限 h₀≤6.4×10^-11，联合数据相对单一数据集将上限改善约 20%–30%。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这一频段可探测超大质量黑洞双星早期旋近，也可能约束早期宇宙引力波来源，因此与宇宙学背景信号搜索相关。它并非直接的 CMB 分析，但其多探针联合、全天球矢量场分解和系统误差控制思路，对 CMB 大尺度模式及原初引力波研究具有方法学参考价值。
key_points: 首次联合真实天体测量自行与双星脉冲星计时数据搜索超低频连续引力波。
联合分析未发现统计显著信号，并据此给出 pHz 频段连续引力波应变上限。
两类正交观测量提供全天覆盖，并有助于打破单一数据集固有的空间简并。
methods: 贝叶斯模型选择与上限估计
Gaia CRF3 约 150 万个类星体的视自行位移
11 颗高精度双星脉冲星的视向轨道周期导数
蒙特卡洛传播脉冲星银河系引力势不确定性
最高至八极阶（l=3）的矢量球谐分解
注入—恢复预报
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对联合似然中两类数据的系统误差、先验和协方差如何处理，以及“20%–30% 改进”和空间简并被打破的定义与稳健性；还需检查 Gaia DR4 预报所采用的时间基线、误差缩减和注入信号假设。

papers.title: A note on oscillons: non-negligible metric fluctuations during preheating
papers.abstract: The dominant lattice approach to post-inflationary preheating and oscillon formation evolves an inhomogeneous inflaton field on a spatially homogeneous Friedmann-Lemaître-Robertson-Walker background, whose expansion is sourced by a volume-averaged energy density, while metric perturbations are neglected. We examine the consistency of this approximation with General Relativity. Using the linearized Einstein constraints, we show that the suppression of the Bardeen potential, characteristic of slow-roll inflation, disappears during preheating: once the first slow-roll parameter becomes of order unity, the metric and inflaton fluctuations enter at the same perturbative order. We further show that the scalar-field equation evolved in the fixed-FLRW prescription omits leading-order contributions generated by metric fluctuations. We then derive the proper-volume average of the ADM Hamiltonian constraint and show that it does not reduce to the Friedmann equation used in lattice simulations: the exact averaged constraint contains additional contributions from the spatial curvature, the variance of the local expansion, the shear, and metric corrections to the local energy density. Finally, we illustrate numerically, for Starobinsky and $α$-attractor models, that the metric contribution becomes comparable to the scalar-field contribution during the amplification stage. These results directly affect the standard lattice description of oscillon formation and motivate numerical relativity as a consistent framework for the nonlinear preheating problem.

analysis.title_zh: 关于振荡子的说明：预热期间不可忽略的度规涨落
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检验在空间均匀 FLRW 背景上演化非均匀暴胀场、同时忽略度规扰动的标准预热格点近似是否符合广义相对论。摘要报告称，预热期间度规与暴胀场涨落进入同一微扰阶，固定背景方程遗漏领先阶项，而平均 ADM 约束还包含空间曲率、局域膨胀方差、剪切及能量密度的度规修正；在 Starobinsky 和 α-吸引子模型的数值示例中，涨落放大阶段的度规贡献可与标量场贡献相比。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作关注暴胀后预热与振荡子形成的引力处理是否自洽，这会影响从暴胀模型推导后续宇宙热史及相关引力波等宇宙学信号时所依赖的模拟框架。它不直接分析 CMB 各向异性，但若标准固定 FLRW 格点方法在预热阶段遗漏领先阶引力效应，则连接 CMB 约束下的暴胀势与暴胀后动力学时可能需要采用数值相对论重新评估。
key_points: 预热开始后，慢滚时期对 Bardeen 势的抑制不再成立。
固定 FLRW 背景上的标量场演化会遗漏度规涨落产生的领先阶贡献。
ADM 哈密顿约束的适当体积平均一般不等同于格点模拟采用的 Friedmann 方程。
methods: 线性化 Einstein 约束分析
ADM 哈密顿约束的适当体积平均
Starobinsky 模型与 α-吸引子模型的数值示例
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对线性化约束在涨落放大并进入非线性阶段前后的适用范围，以及“度规贡献可与标量场贡献相比”所采用的具体量、规范选择和比较标准；还需确认平均 ADM 约束中的各附加项在数值上何时不可忽略，摘要本身并未说明它们对振荡子形成率或最终丰度造成多大改变。

papers.title: 21-cm Constraints on S-wave Dark Matter Annihilation with Subhalo-enhanced Effects
papers.abstract: Observations of the 21-cm signal can probe energy injection into the intergalactic medium arising from dark matter annihilation during cosmic dawn and reionization. For s-wave annihilation, the annihilation rate depends on the squared dark matter density, making the 21-cm signal sensitive to dark matter halo substructure. In this work, we extend the numerical method of DM21cm to address spatially inhomogeneous s-wave annihilation including subhalo effects, using semi-analytical treatment of SASHIMI-C. Our numerical results show that the projected HERA limit for the $γγ$ annihilation channel is stronger than the Leo~T bound within the dark matter mass range of $m_χ\leq 3\,{\rm keV}$, whereas the projected HERA limit for the $e^+e^-$ annihilation channel is the strongest among the existing bounds for $m_χ\sim 0.1$--$1\,{\rm GeV}$.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 21 厘米信号约束具有亚晕增强效应的 S 波暗物质湮灭
analysis.summary_zh: 论文扩展 DM21cm，并以 SASHIMI-C 半解析描述亚晕，在宇宙黎明和再电离时期模拟含亚结构增强的空间非均匀 S 波暗物质湮灭。摘要报告，γγ 道的 HERA 预期限制在 mχ≤3 keV 时强于 Leo T 约束，而 e⁺e⁻ 道在 mχ约 0.1–1 GeV 时可成为所比较现有约束中最强者。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质湮灭会向星系际介质注入能量，改变气体温度、电离历史和 21-cm 信号；这些过程也与 CMB 对能量注入和再电离历史的约束密切相关。该工作强调低红移晕及其子结构造成的密度平方增强，可使 21-cm 观测在部分质量和湮灭道上提供相对于 CMB及其他天体物理探针互补的限制，但摘要没有给出与 CMB 约束的直接定量比较。
key_points: 将亚晕增强效应纳入空间非均匀的 S 波暗物质湮灭计算。
21-cm 信号因湮灭率正比于暗物质密度平方而对晕内子结构敏感。
摘要报告：HERA 预期限制在特定质量区间可强于所比较的现有约束。
methods: 扩展 DM21cm 数值方法，处理包含亚晕效应的空间非均匀 S 波湮灭
采用 SASHIMI-C 对亚晕效应进行半解析处理
利用预期 HERA 21-cm 灵敏度评估 γγ 与 e⁺e⁻ 湮灭道的限制，并与现有约束比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对亚晕质量函数、浓度关系及最小亚晕质量等假设如何进入增强因子，并检查空间非均匀能量沉积的建模方式；同时需要确认所谓 HERA“预期限制”采用的观测配置、前景处理和天体物理边缘化假设，以及与 Leo T 和其他约束比较时是否使用一致的暗物质模型。

papers.title: The high-velocity dark matter halo of the Milky Way in light of the LZ 248 keV event
papers.abstract: The interpretation of high-energy nuclear recoil events in direct-detection experiments can depend sensitively on the poorly understood high-speed tail of the Galactic dark matter velocity distribution. This fact has been brought into sharper focus recently by an anomalous nuclear-recoil event at $E_R\approx248~\mathrm{keV}$ observed by the LZ experiment. If interpreted as caused by a dark-matter-induced recoil, kinematic constraints on many models imply this particle would have to emerge from the high-speed tail. Here, we re-assess this astrophysical uncertainty using Milky Way analogues from the IllustrisTNG and FIRE simulations. We find that the maximum laboratory-frame DM speed on June 16, when the event was observed, is $792.7^{+82.9}_{-95.6}\, \mathrm{km/s}$ (median and 95\% containment across simulations), with a median very close to the fiducial SHM value. Modelling the tail of the velocity distribution in three dimensions is complicated by the fact that these simulated dark matter halos are anisotropic and are generically seen to spin in the same direction as the baryonic disk. However, we find that this does not reduce the maximum laboratory-frame DM speed because the approximately Gaussian azimuthal velocity distribution is negatively skewed by this co-rotation, rather than shifted by it. We illustrate these results in the context of an inelastic dark matter interpretation of the LZ event.

analysis.title_zh: 从 LZ 248 keV 事件审视银河系的高速暗物质晕
analysis.summary_zh: 论文利用 IllustrisTNG 和 FIRE 的银河系类似星系，重新评估暗物质速度分布高速尾部对 LZ 约 248 keV 异常核反冲事件解释的影响。摘要报告事件当天最大实验室系暗物质速度为中位数 792.7 km/s、模拟间 95% 包含范围对应 +82.9/-95.6 km/s，且各向异性和与重子盘共转并未降低这一最大速度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究不直接处理 CMB，但与粒子宇宙学中的暗物质性质推断有关：CMB 主要约束早期宇宙中的暗物质丰度及部分相互作用，而直接探测还依赖银河系局域速度分布。更可靠地刻画高速尾部，有助于判断特定暗物质模型能否同时与实验室事件、星系形成模拟及宇宙学约束相容。
key_points: LZ 的约 248 keV 异常核反冲若由暗物质引起，可能要求粒子来自银河系暗物质速度分布的高速尾部。
IllustrisTNG 与 FIRE 中银河系类似星系给出的最大实验室系暗物质速度中位数接近标准晕模型的基准值。
模拟暗物质晕具有各向异性并倾向与重子盘同向旋转，但摘要称这种共转不会降低最大实验室系速度。
methods: 分析 IllustrisTNG 和 FIRE 模拟中的银河系类似星系
在三维中建模暗物质速度分布的高速尾部
研究暗物质晕各向异性、与重子盘共转及方位速度分布偏度
以内禀非弹性暗物质模型说明对 LZ 事件解释的影响
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对银河系类似星系的筛选标准、太阳位置与实验室系变换的设定、最大速度及其 95% 区间的统计定义，以及有限模拟分辨率和晕际差异如何影响高速尾部；还需检查“共转不降低最大速度”的结论对三维尾部分布模型和方位速度负偏度的依赖。

papers.title: Anomalous Matter Potentials in Earth's Inner Core: A Phenomenological Probe of Dark Matter and Light Sterile Neutrinos
papers.abstract: Standard treatments of Earth matter effects in neutrino oscillation experiments assume that the coherent forward scattering potential experienced by propagating neutrinos is sourced entirely by the Standard Model electron density predicted by the Preliminary Reference Earth Model (PREM). We examine how an anomalous matter potential localized in Earth's inner core, motivated by gravitationally captured dark matter or resonant mixing of active neutrinos with a light (eV-scale or lighter) sterile state, would distort the vu survival and vutove appearance probabilities relative to the Standard Model PREM expectation. Using a full three-flavor matrix-exponentiation propagation code with a four-shell PREM density profile, we parametrize the new-physics contribution as a fractional enhancement ecore of the electron-sector potential confined to the inner core (r<1221 km) and compute oscillation probabilities for near-vertically upgoing atmospheric neutrinos (L=8000to12742km). Trajectories that do not cross the inner core (L<=12500km) are essentially insensitive to ecore, reproducing the Standard Model expectation to better than 0.1%. In contrast, near-antipodal trajectories crossing the inner core (L>=12505km, corresponding to nadir angles within roughly half a degree of the vertical) show significant effects. The muon-neutrino survival probability is displaced by tens of percent for ecore=0.05to0.15 and by more than 100% at particular energies for the νμ to νe appearance channel, with a pronounced neutrinoantineutrino asymmetry that mimics, but is physically distinct from, intrinsic CP violation. These results indicate that percent-level new-physics potentials confined to the inner core are within the discovery reach of high-statistics atmospheric neutrino telescopes such as IceCube Upgrade, KM3NeT/ORCA, and next-generation megaton-scale detectors.

analysis.title_zh: 地球内核中的反常物质势：暗物质与轻惰性中微子的唯象探针
analysis.summary_zh: 论文将地球内核中的暗物质俘获或轻惰性中微子混合所诱导的新物理，参数化为局限于内核的电子扇区物质势增强，并用四层 PREM 模型进行三味中微子传播计算。摘要报告，非内核穿越轨迹几乎不受影响，而近对跖、穿越内核的轨迹可出现显著的 μ 中微子生存与 μ→e 转化概率偏移，并呈现明显的中微子—反中微子不对称。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作不直接研究 CMB，而是通过大气中微子探测地球内部可能存在的暗物质或惰性中微子效应。它与宇宙学的联系主要在于暗物质粒子性质和轻惰性中微子自由度：后者也会影响早期宇宙辐射成分、结构形成及 CMB 推断，因此地面中微子振荡约束可与 CMB 和大尺度结构限制形成互补；但摘要没有建立具体的联合宇宙学约束。
key_points: 研究局限于地球内核的反常中微子物质势。
只有穿越内核的近对跖大气中微子轨迹表现出明显响应。
摘要称中微子望远镜和下一代大型探测器可能检验这类效应。
methods: 三味中微子矩阵指数传播计算
四层 PREM 地球密度剖面
以内核电子扇区势的分数增强参数化新物理
计算近乎垂直向上的大气中微子生存与味转化概率
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：把暗物质俘获或轻惰性中微子混合等不同微观机制统一等效为局域电子势增强的条件是否成立；极窄的内核穿越天顶角窗口在真实探测器的角分辨率、能量分辨率、事例率及系统误差下是否仍有灵敏度；摘要所称相对概率变化是否对应足够的绝对事例数，以及与质量排序、标准物质效应和 CP 相位等参数的简并如何处理。

papers.title: Self-Similar Mass Spectra of Hierarchical Black Hole Mergers
papers.abstract: Black holes that merge repeatedly carry a record of that history in their mass distribution. We treat hierarchical merging as a coagulation problem, in which a single kernel encodes how the merger rate depends on the masses involved and on cosmic time, and we derive the late-time spectra that such populations approach. The framework yields closed scaling laws, an exactly solvable benchmark, and a classification of merger environments by a single exponent measuring how strongly mergers favor or suppress massive participants. Applying it to primordial black holes requires care in translating published merger rates into kernel form; done correctly, three of the four standard binary-formation channels map onto superlinear kernels and are therefore candidates for runaway growth, in which the heaviest objects would dominate and no steady mass-conserving spectrum exists; establishing physical gelation, however, requires the full population-dependent kernel and its finite coagulation history, neither of which we settle here. Only the early three-body channel maps into the nongelling regime and admits slow self-similar growth. Numerical solutions across thirteen suppressive, nongelling kernels show that the shape of the spectrum is not fixed by the scaling exponent alone, and that accounting for the energy radiated at each merger measurably changes the high-mass cutoff and drains the population's total black-hole mass.

analysis.title_zh: 层级黑洞并合的自相似质量谱
analysis.summary_zh: 论文把层级黑洞并合视为凝聚问题，用依赖参与质量和宇宙时间的核函数推导晚时质量谱与标度规律，并据此分类并合环境。摘要报告称，四种标准原初黑洞双星形成通道中三种对应可能失控增长的超线性核，只有早期三体通道处于非凝胶化区；对13种非凝胶化核的数值计算还显示，谱形不能仅由尺度指数确定，辐射能损失会改变高质量截止并消耗黑洞总质量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与CMB的联系是间接的：原初黑洞可作为暗物质候选，其质量谱及随宇宙时间的并合演化会影响对原初黑洞丰度和宇宙学历史的建模，而这些参数可能与CMB约束形成互补。摘要没有直接使用CMB数据或计算CMB可观测量，因此其主要价值在于为原初黑洞种群演化和相关宇宙学约束提供理论框架。
key_points: 将重复黑洞并合建模为由质量与宇宙时间相关核函数控制的凝聚过程。
四种标准原初黑洞双星形成通道中，有三种被映射为可能发生失控增长的超线性核；摘要并未确认物理凝胶化确实发生。
数值结果表明，尺度指数不足以唯一决定质量谱形状，并合辐射能损失会改变高质量端截止并减少黑洞总质量。
methods: 凝聚方程与单核函数建模
晚时自相似标度分析及可精确求解的基准模型
将已发表的原初黑洞并合率转换为凝聚核
对13种抑制性、非凝胶化核进行数值求解
在并合演化中计入引力辐射导致的能量损失
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：已发表并合率到总体依赖核函数的转换是否保留了环境与种群演化依赖；“超线性核”与真实有限时长黑洞种群中发生物理凝胶化之间需要哪些额外条件；13种核的选取是否覆盖相关原初黑洞形成通道，以及辐射能损失如何进入质量守恒方程。

papers.title: Endothermic Z'-Portal Dark Matter: LZ-LHC Complementarity
papers.abstract: Motivated by the $2.6σ$ high-energy recoil event recently reported by the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) Collaboration, we consider an endothermic $Z^\prime$-portal Majorana dark matter framework and discuss the complementarity between the LZ event and LHC searches for a $Z^\prime$ resonance. As a concrete realization, we consider a gauged U(1) ${B-L}$ extension of the Standard Model. The phenomenology of the framework is essentially controlled by two free parameters: the U(1) ${B-L}$ gauge coupling $g_{BL}$ and the $Z^\prime$ boson mass $m_{Z^\prime}$. For a fixed $m_{Z^\prime}$, the observed dark matter abundance requires the dark matter mass to be near the $Z^\prime$ resonance, $m_{\rm DM} \sim m_{Z^\prime}/2$, and sets a lower bound on $g_{BL}$. Complementarily, LHC searches for a $Z^\prime$ resonance set an upper bound on $g_{BL}$. The parameter space allowed by the dark matter abundance and LHC constraints can account for the recent LZ event. The synergy between future $Z^\prime$ resonance searches at the High-Luminosity LHC and the LZ experiment may provide a test of this framework.

analysis.title_zh: 吸热型 Z' 门户暗物质：LZ 与 LHC 的互补性
analysis.summary_zh: 论文受 LZ 最近报告的 2.6σ 高能反冲事例启发，研究规范化 U(1) B-L 实现下的吸热型 Z'-门户 Majorana 暗物质，并联合暗物质丰度与 LHC 的 Z' 共振搜索进行约束。摘要称，暗物质质量需接近 m_DM≈m_Z'/2 的共振区，丰度与 LHC 分别限制 g_BL 的下界和上界，二者允许的参数空间可解释该 LZ 事例，并有望由高亮度 LHC 与 LZ 联合检验。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要属于暗物质直接探测与对撞机粒子宇宙学，对 CMB 的联系是间接的：模型必须产生摘要所称的观测暗物质丰度，而暗物质丰度是 CMB 宇宙学参数推断的核心结果之一。对于 CMB 研究者，其价值在于提供一个可由地面实验交叉检验的暗物质微观模型；但摘要未讨论 CMB 各向异性、能量注入、额外辐射或其他具体 CMB 可观测量。
key_points: 以 LZ 报告的 2.6σ 高能反冲事例为动机。
暗物质丰度要求质量接近 Z' 共振区，并对耦合给出下界。
LHC 的 Z' 共振搜索对同一耦合给出上界，未来实验可联合检验剩余参数空间。
methods: 吸热型 Z'-门户 Majorana 暗物质框架
规范化 U(1) B-L 标准模型扩展
暗物质丰度约束
LZ 高能反冲事例解释
LHC Z' 共振搜索约束
高亮度 LHC 与 LZ 的未来互补性分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：单个高能反冲事例如何映射到暗物质参数空间；暗物质丰度所给耦合下界与 LHC 所给上界分别依赖哪些假设；允许区域是否还受到其他直接探测、间接探测及宇宙学约束。摘要未提供这些约束的具体数值或稳健性检验。

papers.title: Comparing the Detectability of the Baryon Acoustic Oscillation through Gravitational-Wave Autocorrelation and Cross-Correlation with Galaxies
papers.abstract: The amplitude and waveform shape of gravitational wave radiation from compact binary mergers enable a direct measurement of the luminosity distance to these events, making them \textit{``standard sirens''}. Binary black hole (BBH) mergers form a significant fraction of these standard sirens. A substantial catalog of BBH merger events can be used to probe cosmology and large-scale structure properties, such as the baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO). In this work, we explore detecting the BAO scale using the cross-correlation between BBH mergers and a galaxy catalog, and compare it with the BBH autocorrelation for the third-generation detector observations. Over a $10$-year observation period, these observatories will localize approximately $1.5\times10^{5}$ events within $10$ square degrees, with \snr $\geq 50$ and luminosity distance uncertainty $\leq 50$ Mpc, and will allow recovery of the BAO scale. We find that the BAO scale is recovered with approximately two times the \snr and a significantly better precision through cross-correlation as compared to autocorrelation.
papers.comment: The manuscript contains 13 pages, 4 Figures. It has been prepared to be submitted to a journal, shortly. Comments are invited

analysis.title_zh: 通过引力波自相关及其与星系的交叉相关比较重子声学振荡的可探测性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究第三代引力波探测器时代能否利用双黑洞并合事件恢复重子声学振荡标度，并比较双黑洞自相关与其同星系目录互相关两种方法。摘要预计十年内约有 1.5×10^5 个满足给定定位、信噪比和距离误差条件的事件，并报告互相关恢复 BAO 的信噪比约为自相关的两倍、精度也明显更好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: BAO 是约束宇宙膨胀史和距离尺度的核心标准尺；以引力波标准警报器作为独立的大尺度结构示踪体，并与星系交叉相关，可为传统星系 BAO 和 CMB 给出的早期宇宙声学尺度提供低红移、不同系统误差来源的互补检验。该工作并非直接分析 CMB，但其 BAO 距离信息可与 CMB 联合用于限制背景宇宙学，并检验从复合时期声学尺度到晚期结构分布之间的一致性。
key_points: 将双黑洞并合事件视为标准警报器和大尺度结构示踪体。
比较双黑洞自相关与双黑洞—星系互相关恢复 BAO 标度的能力。
摘要报告互相关的 BAO 探测信噪比约为自相关的两倍，测量精度也明显更好。
methods: 第三代引力波探测器的十年期观测情景
双黑洞并合事件与星系目录的交叉相关
双黑洞并合事件的自相关
基于定位面积、事件信噪比和光度距离不确定度的事件选择
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：事件率、天空定位和距离误差的预设如何进入选择函数；星系目录的红移范围、完备性及偏置如何建模；自相关与互相关的协方差、系统误差和 BAO 显著性是否在一致条件下比较。还应确认摘要所称“约两倍信噪比”具体采用何种统计量，以及是否包含引力波距离误差、弱透镜、宿主星系不确定性和星系巡天系统学。

papers.title: Systematic Uncertainties and Their Impact on Gamma-Ray Searches for Dark Matter in Dwarf Galaxies
papers.abstract: Gamma-ray observations of Milky Way dwarf galaxies provide some of the strongest constraints on dark matter annihilation and are approaching the sensitivity required to test dark matter interpretations of the Galactic Center Gamma-Ray Excess. The results, however, depend critically on the inferred dark matter distributions in these systems, conventionally described by their $J$-factors and spatial profiles. We review several sources of systematic uncertainty in dwarf galaxy $J$-factor determinations, including stellar membership, unresolved binaries, departures from equilibrium and spherical symmetry, and assumptions regarding the stellar and dark matter density profiles. Most $J$-factor determinations reported in the literature neglect several of these uncertainties, and the resulting measurements are often more dispersed than their quoted uncertainties would suggest. This indicates uncertainties of order $Δ\log_{10}J\sim0.5$ or larger may be warranted for many of these systems. Using an ensemble of simulated Fermi-LAT observations of a stacked sample of 27 dwarf galaxies, we quantify how these unmodeled uncertainties affect the resulting constraints on the dark matter annihilation cross section. We find that adding an uncertainty of $Δ\log_{10}J\sim 0.5$ or 1.0 in quadrature weakens the median upper limits of a stacked analysis by factors of 1.4 or 3.2, respectively. Furthermore, underestimating these uncertainties can cause such analyses to exclude the true annihilation cross section more frequently than the nominal confidence level would imply. Such undercoverage is especially pronounced in stacked analyses and persists even when the adopted and true $J$-factor uncertainties agree. Mismodeling spatially extended halos as point sources, as is sometimes done, further strengthens the resulting limits and increases the probability that true signals will be incorrectly excluded.

analysis.title_zh: 系统不确定性及其对矮星系暗物质伽马射线搜寻的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文梳理恒星成员判定、未分辨双星、动力学非平衡、非球对称及密度轮廓假设等因素对矮星系 $J$ 因子推断的系统影响，并通过 27 个矮星系的模拟 Fermi-LAT 堆叠观测评估其对暗物质湮灭限制的作用。摘要报告称，额外加入 $0.5$ 或 $1.0$ dex 的 $J$ 因子不确定性会使湮灭截面中位上限分别减弱约 1.4 倍和 3.2 倍；误差低估及点源近似还会增加错误排除真实信号的概率。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作不直接研究 CMB，但与粒子宇宙学中的暗物质约束互补：CMB 对早期宇宙能量注入的限制与矮星系伽马射线对晚期暗物质湮灭的限制依赖不同的天体物理和粒子物理假设。论文强调的覆盖率和系统误差问题关系到能否可靠比较、联合或解释 CMB、伽马射线及银河中心过量给出的暗物质参数空间。
key_points: 矮星系暗物质湮灭限制高度依赖 $J$ 因子及暗物质晕空间轮廓。
摘要认为，许多文献可能低估了恒星成员、双星、非平衡和非球对称等系统误差。
低估 $J$ 因子误差或将扩展晕视为点源，会造成限制过强和置信区间覆盖不足。
methods: 综述矮星系 $J$ 因子测定中的系统不确定性来源
模拟 Fermi-LAT 观测
对 27 个矮星系进行堆叠分析
改变 $J$ 因子不确定性并评估暗物质湮灭截面上限及统计覆盖率
比较空间扩展晕与点源建模
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对模拟中“真实”与分析采用的 $J$ 因子及空间轮廓如何生成、各系统误差是否被独立地以平方和加入，以及覆盖率的定义与重复实验构造。尤其需要查明为何在采用与真实 $J$ 因子误差一致时，堆叠分析仍会出现覆盖不足，并检查点源近似的影响是否依赖具体矮星系、能段和仪器响应。

papers.title: Cosmic web Ly$α$ emission in a sample of overdense regions
papers.abstract: We present a complete and homogeneous analysis of the Ly$α$ emission properties of the cosmic web at $3 \lesssim z \lesssim 5$ as a function of the overdensity of Ly$α$ emitters (LAEs) in the MUSE Ultra Deep Field (MUDF) and the MUSE Extremely Deep Field (MXDF). We identify 41 overdensities, probing environments that are $δ\approx 2 - 10$ times denser than the field. We search for extended emission down to surface brightness (SB) levels of $3 - 5 \times 10^{-20}\ \mathrm{erg\ s^{-1}\ cm^{-2}\ arcsec^{-2}}$, revealing filamentary structures beyond the scale of the circumgalactic medium, confirming that LAEs act as signposts of the cosmic web. A trend with overdensity emerges: non-detections are mainly at $δ< 2$, a $\approx 1$ dex scatter in SB appears for $2 \lesssim δ\lesssim 3.5$, and detections reach a maximum intrinsic SB of $\approx 2 \times 10^{-19}\ \mathrm{erg\ s^{-1}\ cm^{-2}\ arcsec^{-2}}$ for $δ\gtrsim 3.5$. Emitting regions occupy a fraction of projected area $f_s \approx 0.20 - 0.25$ inside filaments, yielding a cosmological incidence for Ly$α$ emission in the cosmic web $\ell(\mathrm{Ly}α)$ of $\approx 1.22$, which is similar to the one of partially-neutral Lyman limit systems. This analysis indicates that the emitting gas is partially ionized at moderate densities ($n_{\mathrm{H}} \approx 10^{-3} - 10^{-1}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-3}$), likely tracing the denser spines of intergalactic filaments and embedded substructures. Finally, we forecast how oriented stacking in larger samples of overdensities from shallower observations could yield an expanded view of the cosmic web before the next-generation wide-field spectroscopic instruments become operational.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 12 Figures (+2 in appendix). Resubmitted to A&A following a referee report

analysis.title_zh: 过密区样本中的宇宙网 Lyα 辐射
analysis.summary_zh: 该研究利用 MUDF 和 MXDF 的 MUSE 深场数据，均一分析红移约 3–5、不同 Lyα 发射星系过密度环境中的延展 Lyα 辐射，并在星系周介质尺度之外发现丝状结构。摘要报告探测与表面亮度随过密度增强的趋势，并据此认为部分电离的中等密度气体可能描绘星系际丝状体较致密的脊部及其子结构。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作并非直接研究 CMB，但它观测低红移于复合时代的宇宙重子如何分布在大尺度丝状结构中，可为结构形成、星系际介质和缺失重子研究提供约束。对 CMB 宇宙学而言，此类宇宙网气体观测可作为大尺度结构与重子物理模型的外部检验，并与 CMB 引力透镜、热/运动学 Sunyaev–Zel'dovich 效应及其交叉相关研究形成互补；不过摘要没有实际开展这些 CMB 联合分析。
key_points: 在红移约 3–5 的 41 个过密区中搜寻低表面亮度的延展 Lyα 辐射。
延展辐射的探测情况和内禀表面亮度随 Lyα 发射星系过密度呈现变化趋势。
摘要将辐射气体解释为宇宙网丝状体致密脊部及其嵌入子结构中的部分电离气体。
methods: 对 MUSE Ultra Deep Field（MUDF）和 MUSE Extremely Deep Field（MXDF）进行完整且均一的分析
基于 Lyα 发射星系识别 41 个过密区
搜索低至约 3–5×10^-20 erg s^-1 cm^-2 arcsec^-2 的延展 Lyα 表面亮度信号
估算丝状体内发射区的投影面积占比与宇宙学发生率
讨论面向较大过密区样本的定向叠加预测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对过密度 δ 的具体定义与场样本基准、延展辐射的提取及背景和点扩散函数控制、丝状结构与星系周介质的尺度划分，以及从表面亮度推断气体密度和电离状态时采用的辐射机制与模型假设；还需确认面积占比和宇宙学发生率对探测阈值、完备性及样本选择的敏感性。

papers.title: Thermal gravitino and axino rate from AutoTherm
papers.abstract: If ultrarelativistic supersymmetric particles are thermally produced in the early universe they would influence big-bang nucleosynthesis, dark matter and reheating constraints. While the basic framework for thermal gravitino and axino production is well established, the calculation is not completely settled. In this work, we revisit the problem using AutoTherm, a new tool which automates the computation of thermal rates from first-principles Thermal Field Theory, with control over the inherent theory uncertainty in Hard Thermal Loop resummation schemes. We demonstrate that the strict leading-order (LO) scheme, while unambiguous for hard momenta, can yield unphysical negative rates when extrapolated to soft momenta. To address this, we introduce a tuned scheme that ensures positivity and agreement with strict LO at high momenta, while avoiding gauge-dependent pathologies. We compare our results with existing parametrizations in the literature, identifying discrepancies and providing new, reliable fits for the gauge and Yukawa contributions to the gravitino and axino production rates. The choice of resummation scheme gives a theory uncertainty by a factor of $\sim 1.5$...$3$ depending on the temperature, which has been underappreciated until now. This residual spread should be taken into account in precision cosmological analyses of gravitino/axino abundancies.
papers.comment: 19 pages + appendices, code available at https://autotherm.in2p3.fr

analysis.title_zh: 利用 AutoTherm 计算热引力微子与轴微子产生率
analysis.summary_zh: 本文使用 AutoTherm 从第一性原理热场论重新计算早期宇宙中热引力微子和轴微子的产生率，并比较不同硬热圈重求和方案。摘要报告称，严格领头阶结果在软动量区可能出现负产生率；作者据此提出保持正定且在高动量区匹配严格领头阶的调谐方案，给出规范与 Yukawa 贡献的新拟合，并估计方案选择导致约 1.5 至 3 倍的理论不确定性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 热引力微子和轴微子的产生率直接影响其遗留丰度，进而关系到暗物质、原初核合成和再加热温度约束。它并非直接研究 CMB 各向异性，但对利用 CMB 约束的早期宇宙热史、再加热情景及粒子宇宙学模型具有间接意义；摘要强调的理论不确定性也可能限制相关精密宇宙学推断。
key_points: 严格领头阶方案在硬动量区明确，但外推至软动量时可能产生非物理的负产生率。
作者引入调谐重求和方案，以保持产生率为正、在高动量区匹配严格领头阶，并规避依赖规范选择的病态行为。
重求和方案选择带来约 1.5 至 3 倍的理论不确定性，具体大小取决于温度。
methods: AutoTherm 自动化热产生率计算工具
第一性原理热场论计算

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对调谐方案的定义与调谐准则、正定性是否在全部相关动量和温度范围内成立，以及其规避规范依赖病态的论证。还需检查新拟合的适用温区、误差定义，以及约 1.5 至 3 倍的不确定性如何传播到最终的引力微子/轴微子丰度和再加热约束。

papers.title: AutoTherm: Automated Thermal Field Theory rates for cosmology
papers.abstract: AutoTherm is a modular code automating the determination of thermal production and interaction rates for cosmology from Thermal Field Theory. This first release computes fully automatically the leading-order contribution from ultrarelativistic $2\leftrightarrow 2$ processes to the production rate of an off-equilibrium $\vartheta$ particle coupled to a thermal bath. It takes as input a FeynRules model file describing the Lagrangian of the bath-$\vartheta$ system. The AutoTherm program consists of a Wolfram package, which utilises FeynArts/FormCalc, together with a few Python modules for symbolic and numerical routines. Their combined usage leads from the model file to the rate, but each component can also be used in a standalone manner. The main strength of this release is the automated, model-independent handling of Hard Thermal Loop resummation, which is necessary whenever a $2\leftrightarrow 2$ process is mediated by a $t$-channel massless mediator. Developments in Thermal Field Theory reduce the apparently large model dependence to the determination of the thermal mass of the mediator, which we automate successfully. They further allow us to provide three leading-order-equivalent implementations of HTL resummation. Their spread provides a first estimate of the theory uncertainty from higher-order thermal corrections. We showcase the strength of our AutoTherm framework by successfully reproducing or correcting a host of results in the literature, such as the thermal production rate of ultrarelativistic right-handed neutrinos, of gravitons and gravitinos, of axions and of dark photons.
papers.comment: 47 pages + appendices. Code and documentation available from https://autotherm.in2p3.fr

analysis.title_zh: AutoTherm：面向宇宙学的热场论反应率自动计算
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍模块化程序 AutoTherm：从 FeynRules 拉格朗日量模型出发，自动计算非平衡粒子在热浴中由超相对论性 2↔2 过程产生的领头阶速率，并自动处理 t 道无质量媒介引起的硬热圈重求和。摘要称，该框架提供三种领头阶等价的 HTL 实现，并复现或修正了多类粒子的已发表热产生率结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 早期宇宙中的热产生率决定右手中微子、轴子、暗光子及引力相关粒子的丰度与能量注入历史，因而可影响暗辐射、有效相对论自由度、物质组成和宇宙膨胀史等可由 CMB 间接约束的量。本文并非直接分析 CMB 数据，但其自动化速率计算与理论误差估计可为把粒子模型可靠映射到 CMB/宇宙学观测量提供基础。
key_points: 自动计算非平衡粒子与热浴耦合时的超相对论性热产生率。
自动处理无质量粒子在 t 道传递时所需的硬热圈重求和及媒介粒子热质量。
三种领头阶等价实现之间的差异被用作高阶热修正理论不确定性的初步估计。
methods: 以描述热浴—ϑ系统拉格朗日量的 FeynRules 模型文件为输入
基于 FeynArts/FormCalc 的 Wolfram 软件包
用于符号与数值计算的 Python 模块
