papers.title: Cosmological anatomy of interacting dark energy
papers.abstract: Interacting dark energy (IDE) models, featuring interactions between dark matter (DM) and dark energy (DE), have received significant renewed interest. However, little attention has been devoted to understanding their genuine cosmological signatures, with comparisons against $Λ$CDM often carried out at fixed cosmological parameters. Considering the widely studied model with energy exchange rate proportional to the DE density, we carry out a three-level sequence of comparisons, starting from the naïve fixed-parameter comparison, then compensating for shifts in $θ_s$ and $z_{\text{eq}}$, and then removing effects due to the modified background. We show that fixing $θ_s$ and $z_{\text{eq}}$ leads to pre-recombination evolutions of the Weyl potential, photon monopole, and baryon velocity which are nearly identical to their $Λ$CDM counterparts, and hence virtually indistinguishable Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) temperature power spectra. Comparing IDE to a non-interacting $w$CDM model with the same background, we find small scale-dependent signatures in CMB lensing. We find larger differences in the matter power spectrum, reflecting the different values of $Ω_m$ resulting from the different partition of the dark sector into DM and DE, with only percent-level differences remaining once we compare $Ω_m^2P_m(k)$, indicating the importance of high-fidelity determinations of $Ω_m$. Our controlled comparison strategy can be a powerful tool for a wide range of models beyond $Λ$CDM.
papers.comment: 32 pages, many sub-figures and sub-panels arranged in 11 figures, many references. CLASS_IDE publicly available at https://github.com/msabogal/CLASS_IDE

analysis.title_zh: 相互作用暗能量的宇宙学剖析
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究暗物质与暗能量相互作用模型相对于 ΛCDM 的真实宇宙学信号，重点考察能量交换率正比于暗能量密度的情形。通过依次固定参数、补偿声学尺度 θ_s 与物质辐射平衡红移 z_eq、再控制背景演化的三级比较，摘要报告称复合前动力学和 CMB 温度功率谱几乎与 ΛCDM 相同，但 CMB 透镜存在小的尺度依赖差异，物质功率谱的较大差异主要来自 Ω_m 不同。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作直接涉及 CMB 对暗物质与暗能量相互作用的约束及模型可辨识性。它指出，在匹配 θ_s、z_eq 和背景演化后，许多 IDE 与 ΛCDM 的 CMB 温度信号可能高度退化，因此仅比较固定参数下的功率谱容易夸大或误读模型差异；CMB 透镜和物质功率谱则可能提供额外区分信息，同时 Ω_m 的高精度测定对解释这些差异十分关键。
key_points: 固定 θ_s 和 z_eq 后，IDE 与 ΛCDM 的复合前演化及 CMB 温度功率谱几乎不可区分。
与具有相同背景的非相互作用 wCDM 比较时，CMB 透镜仍呈现小的尺度依赖特征。
物质功率谱差异主要与 Ω_m 的不同有关；比较 Ω_m^2P_m(k) 后，剩余差异降至百分比量级。
methods: 研究暗物质与暗能量之间能量交换率正比于暗能量密度的相互作用暗能量模型。
采用三级受控比较：固定宇宙学参数；补偿 θ_s 和 z_eq 的变化；进一步移除修正背景演化的影响。
比较 Weyl 势、光子单极矩、重子速度以及 CMB 温度功率谱。
将 IDE 与具有相同背景的非相互作用 wCDM 模型进行比较。
比较物质功率谱 P_m(k) 以及重标度后的 Ω_m^2P_m(k)。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对三级比较中参数如何重新匹配、所谓“移除修正背景”的具体定义，以及相互作用模型的耦合参数范围。还应确认 CMB 透镜的尺度依赖信号相对于观测误差和参数退化是否具有实际可探测性，并检查 Ω_m^2P_m(k) 重标度为何能显著削弱物质功率谱差异。

papers.title: Probing Lorentz-violating scalar forces and dark matter with precision matter and antimatter experiments
papers.abstract: We explore a class of Lorentz-violating scalar-field models where the effects of the scalar field on antimatter can be strongly enhanced compared to matter. Non-trivial differences in phenomenology arise for spectroscopy measurements depending on whether the scalar field changes slowly or rapidly on the atomic scale. We highlight opportunities for precision tests in the laboratory including dark matter searches, in particular with spectroscopy and interferometry measurements, as well as certain types of antimatter experiments.

analysis.title_zh: 利用精密物质与反物质实验探测破坏洛伦兹对称性的标量力与暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究一类破坏洛伦兹对称性的标量场模型，其中标量场对反物质的作用可能显著强于对物质的作用。摘要比较了标量场在原子尺度上缓慢或快速变化时的光谱学现象，并提出利用光谱学、干涉测量和特定反物质实验开展暗物质搜索与精密检验；摘要未给出具体数值结果或统计显著性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作将暗物质模型、引力与相对论中的洛伦兹对称性检验，与原子物理和反物质精密实验联系起来。对 CMB/宇宙学研究而言，它提供了宇宙学暗物质候选模型在实验室尺度上的补充检验思路，但摘要本身没有涉及 CMB 数据、宇宙学参数拟合或具体 CMB 观测预言。
key_points: 模型允许标量场对反物质的作用相较于物质显著增强。
原子尺度上标量场的缓慢或快速变化会导致不同的光谱学现象。
光谱学、干涉测量和部分反物质实验可用于实验室检验，并探索暗物质。
methods: 构建和研究一类破坏洛伦兹对称性的标量场模型
比较标量场在原子尺度缓慢变化与快速变化情形下的光谱学现象
提出基于光谱学、干涉测量和反物质实验的精密实验检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对洛伦兹对称性破缺模型的具体作用量与参数化方式，反物质效应增强的理论机制及其与已有约束的相容性；还需确认暗物质信号在光谱学和干涉测量中的具体可观测量、频率或空间尺度依赖，以及所提实验相较现有限制的灵敏度提升。

papers.title: Toward Autonomous Radio Follow-up of Multi-messenger Transients with RADAR: From Alert Parsing to Inference and Observation Scheduling
papers.abstract: Multi-messenger astronomy (MMA), the joint study of cosmic sources through gravitational waves (GWs), electromagnetic (EM) radiation, neutrinos, and cosmic rays, is rapidly reshaping time-domain astrophysics. Realizing the promise of MMA will require coordinating heterogeneous observing resources and automating the chain from alert to analysis to follow-up. RADAR (Radio Afterglow Detection and AI-driven Response) is a federated, privacy-enhancing framework for the radio follow-up of GW events, previously validated on GW170817. Here, we extend it along three axes. First, we benchmark three large language models (LLMs; GPT-5.5, Claude-Opus-4.7, and Gemini-3.5-Flash) against the GW170817 radio light curve dataset. GPT-5.5 attains the highest event-level $F_1$ score, the harmonic mean of precision and recall, at $0.893 \pm 0.010$, and the highest GCN-level recall, $0.794 \pm 0.013$, improving on previous GPT-4.1 results by 16\% and 10\%, respectively, while Claude-Opus-4.7 achieves the highest precision, $0.978 \pm 0.014$. Second, we introduce concurrent likelihood evaluation, which speeds up the MCMC computation by a factor of $40\times$ over our previous results. Third, we present an LLM-driven scheme that converts natural-language observing requests into submission-ready scheduling blocks for the Karl G. Jansky Very Large Array. Together, these developments advance RADAR toward a scalable, largely autonomous system for GW radio follow up.

papers.title: Void probability function in the Quijote simulations
papers.abstract: The void probability function (VPF) is the likelihood of finding no tracers (galaxies or dark-matter haloes) within a given volume and is sensitive to the large-scale matter distribution. We investigate the VPF of dark matter haloes and galaxies using the \textsc{Quijote} N-body simulations across a range of cosmological models, including $Λ$CDM and several extensions. We examine its dependence on cosmology, redshift, halo mass, morphology, and sample dilution, and compare the results with theoretical predictions from the geometric hierarchical (GH) and negative binomial (NB) models. We find that the halo VPF is sensitive to cosmology and halo mass and follows the GH model at $z=0$, with $Λ$CDM showing the smallest deviation and the massive-neutrino cosmology the largest. At higher redshift and stronger sample dilution, the VPF departs from the GH model and approaches the NB model. The dependence on halo mass varies with cosmology, with low-mass haloes showing the largest deviations in $Λ$CDM, while intermediate- and high-mass haloes show stronger deviations in the modified-gravity scenario. In redshift space, the VPF shifts toward the NB model, with primordial non-Gaussianity producing the largest deviations. For galaxies, the VPF depends on morphology and cosmology, with ellipticals following the GH model and spirals following the NB model. We also find that cosmic variance introduces non-negligible scatter in the VPF measurements. Overall, these results suggest that the VPF could be useful as a computationally efficient probe to distinguish extensions of the standard $Λ$CDM model in upcoming large-volume galaxy surveys.

analysis.title_zh: Quijote 模拟中的空洞概率函数
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 Quijote N-body 模拟研究暗物质晕和星系的空洞概率函数（VPF），系统考察其对宇宙学模型、红移、晕质量、星系形态、样本稀释及红移空间效应的依赖，并与 GH 和 NB 理论模型比较。摘要报告称，晕 VPF 在 z=0 总体接近 GH 模型，但在更高红移、更强样本稀释和红移空间中趋向 NB 模型；VPF 对宇宙学、质量和形态具有敏感性，可能用于大体积星系巡天区分 ΛCDM 的扩展。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: VPF 是一种高阶、非高斯的大尺度结构统计量，能够补充传统两点相关函数和功率谱对物质分布的描述。虽然论文不直接分析 CMB 数据，但它研究的中微子质量、修正引力、原初非高斯性及其他宇宙学扩展都与 CMB 对宇宙学参数的约束具有互补关系；若 VPF 能在星系巡天中有效区分这些模型，可帮助联合 CMB 与大尺度结构数据、检验标准 ΛCDM。
key_points: 暗物质晕的 VPF 对宇宙学模型和晕质量敏感，且其与 GH/NB 理论模型的偏离随红移、样本稀释和红移空间效应变化。
在 z=0，晕 VPF 总体遵循 GH 模型；ΛCDM 偏离最小，含较大中微子质量的宇宙学偏离最大。
星系 VPF 具有形态依赖：椭圆星系更接近 GH 模型，旋涡星系更接近 NB 模型；宇宙方差会引入不可忽略的测量散布。
methods: 使用 Quijote N-body 模拟。
测量暗物质晕和星系的空洞概率函数（VPF）。
比较 ΛCDM、含大质量中微子的宇宙学模型、修正引力和原初非高斯性等模型。
考察红移、晕质量、星系形态、样本稀释及实空间/红移空间对 VPF 的影响。
将模拟结果与几何层级（GH）模型和负二项式（NB）模型进行比较。
评估宇宙方差对 VPF 测量的影响。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 VPF 对不同宇宙学扩展的区分能力是否在包含观测选择效应、星系形成模型、有限体积和宇宙方差后仍然稳健；还应确认 GH 与 NB 模型的比较采用了哪些参数拟合或校准方式，以及所谓“偏离最大”是否对应可观测且具有统计区分度的差异。

papers.title: Constraints of Big Bang Nucleosynthesis and Cosmological Observations on varying Higgs VEV
papers.abstract: The Higgs vacuum expectation value (VEV) alters both the electroweak and strong interaction rates. We study both effects on Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN) and seek concordance between observed primordial abundances of light elements and cosmological constraints from cosmic microwave background (CMB) fluctuations and anisotropies. We find a strong negative correlation between primordial 4He abundance and the Higgs VEV. Consequently, using a 1.58% uplift of the Higgs VEV during BBN from the current value, an agreement can be achieved among the new primordial 4He abundance, observed by the EMPRESS group, Deuterium abundance determined from absorption lines in the Lyman-alpha forest along the line-of-sight of high-redshift quasars, and the lithium abundance on the Spite plateau. This agreement requires a baryon-to-photon ratio different from the CMB determination, indicating the need for non-standard cosmological evolution between BBN and recombination epochs.We also demonstrate that a 0.2% uplift in the Higgs VEV can partially alleviate the "cosmic Li problem", keeping consistency with the CMB with remaining discrepancy potentially accounted for by stellar depletion mechanisms.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, accepted by Phys. Rev. D

analysis.title_zh: 变化的希格斯真空期望值所受的大爆炸核合成与宇宙学观测约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究早期宇宙中希格斯真空期望值变化对电弱、强相互作用速率及大爆炸核合成的影响，并将预测的轻元素丰度与观测和CMB约束比较。摘要称，BBN期间VEV提高1.58%可使氦-4、氘和锂丰度相互协调，但需要BBN与CMB给出不同的重子—光子比；提高0.2%则可在维持CMB一致性的同时部分缓解锂问题。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把粒子物理参数在早期宇宙中的可能变化同时连接到BBN轻元素丰度和CMB确定的重子密度。其核心宇宙学意义在于检验BBN与复合时期的标准演化是否自洽，并评估能否在不破坏CMB一致性的前提下缓解原初锂丰度张力；摘要中的1.58%方案反而要求两时期之间存在非标准宇宙学演化。
key_points: 同时考虑希格斯真空期望值变化对电弱与强相互作用速率的影响。
摘要报告：BBN期间希格斯VEV提高1.58%可协调多种轻元素丰度，但要求不同于CMB推断的重子—光子比。
较小的0.2% VEV提高可在保持CMB一致性的同时部分缓解宇宙学锂问题。
methods: 改变希格斯真空期望值的BBN计算
原初氦-4、氘和锂丰度的一致性比较
与CMB涨落及各向异性给出的宇宙学约束比较
EMPRESS原初氦-4观测
高红移类星体视线方向莱曼α森林吸收线的氘丰度
Spite平台锂丰度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：希格斯VEV变化如何分别传递到电弱和强相互作用速率及核反应网络；1.58%与0.2%方案所采用的轻元素观测误差和统计判据；前一方案与CMB重子—光子比不一致的程度，以及作者设想的BBN至复合时期非标准演化是否有明确机制并满足其他宇宙学约束。

papers.title: Does galaxy-scale compactness regulate nebular electron density? A cross-scale test with DESI
papers.abstract: Nebular electron density, $n_e$, traces ionized gas in small-scale H\,{\sc ii} regions and diffuse ionized structures, whereas galaxy stellar surface density, $Σ_\star$, measures compactness on kpc scales. Whether these quantities are correlated is therefore a cross-scale question rather than a geometrical identity. We test whether nebular electron density varies systematically with galaxy-scale stellar compactness after controlling for the correlated effects of stellar mass and star-formation rate (SFR). We use DESI DR 1 spectra to test this cross-scale connection in AGN-clean star-forming galaxies at $0.10<z<0.44$. We divide each redshift interval into tertiles of $Σ_\star=M_\star/(2πR_e^2)$. We construct one controlled sample in which the $M_\star$ distributions are matched across the three compactness tertiles, and a second in which their joint $M_\star$--SFR distributions are matched, thereby minimizing the influence of these correlated galaxy properties. For each compactness tertile, we stack the galaxy spectra with equal weight and use the stacked spectrum to measure the average $n_e$ of the galaxies in that sample. The average $n_e$ increases systematically toward higher stellar surface density in all redshift intervals. This is the first controlled population-level evidence for a correlation between kpc-scale galaxy stellar surface density (compactness) and the average $n_e$ of ionized gas on subgalactic scales. Its persistence after matching both $M_\star$ and SFR suggests that a more compact stellar configuration may promote higher gas pressure and/or stronger confinement of ionized gas, linking galaxy-scale structure to nebular conditions.

papers.title: Infrared Universality of Scalar Induced Gravitational Waves Beyond Second Order
papers.abstract: Primordial black hole dark matter is formed from the collapse of enhanced primordial density fluctuations. The formation of primordial black holes is accompanied by scalar induced gravitational waves whose infrared scaling only depends on the equation of state, $w$, of the background at leading order. Establishing whether this characteristic scaling remains robust under corrections of arbitrary perturbative order, including in the presence of non-Gaussianities, requires a physical understanding of the infrared scaling. In this work, we provide such a physical interpretation. We find that the stress of sound waves with nearly equal frequencies produces a slow beat. Although the incoming waves oscillate rapidly, this slow beat continues to source the long wavelength tensor perturbation before its horizon entry, thus generating an infrared scaling that only depends on the expanding background. We show that higher order interactions generate freely propagating waves that finally lead to the same slow beat deep inside the horizon. Since non-Gaussianities would not change the speed of the freely propagating waves, they do not modify the infrared scaling. As the source with a slow beat has enough time to accumulate before the horizon entry of the infrared tensor mode, it records the background expansion and thus the infrared scaling could provide a robust probe of the cosmological equation of state.

analysis.title_zh: 二阶以上标量诱导引力波的红外普适性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究与原初黑洞形成相伴的标量诱导引力波，其红外标度在高阶修正和非高斯性下是否仍只依赖宇宙背景状态方程。摘要通过近等频声波产生慢拍并持续激发长波张量模的图像，论证高阶相互作用最终产生相同慢拍，而非高斯性不改变自由传播波速度，因而不修改该红外标度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把原初黑洞情景中的随机引力波背景与早期宇宙膨胀史联系起来：若所述红外标度确实对高阶效应和非高斯性稳健，它可用于约束产生这些引力波时期的宇宙学状态方程。它并非直接研究 CMB，但与 CMB 对原初扰动、非高斯性和早期宇宙背景的约束具有互补性，也有助于联合判断原初黑洞及增强小尺度扰动模型。
key_points: 标量诱导引力波的红外标度在领先阶仅由背景状态方程决定。
近等频声波产生的慢拍可在红外张量模进入视界前持续提供源项。
摘要认为高阶相互作用及非高斯性不会改变这一红外标度。
methods: 对近等频声波应力产生慢拍并激发长波张量扰动的物理机制进行分析
考察高阶相互作用产生的自由传播波及其深处视界后的慢拍行为
从自由传播波速度不受非高斯性改变这一点论证红外标度的稳健性
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对其“任意微扰阶”结论的适用条件与证明范围，包括背景状态方程、源谱形状、非高斯性的类型，以及是否存在会改变传播速度、色散关系或源项相干时间的例外。还应确认红外极限的定义、视界进入前累积的定量条件，以及该标度在可观测频段中的适用性。

papers.title: Resolving 3 Exotic Hyperbolic-Umbilic Lensing Configurations in the "Cosmic Mantis": An Exploration of RXJ0437.1+0043 with JWST
papers.abstract: We present an updated strong lensing model for the galaxy cluster RXJ0437.1+0043 (z=0.285) using new JWST NIRCam imaging in four pass-bands. The cluster field notably displays at least three separate gravitationally lensed galaxies in hyperbolic-umbilic (H-U) configurations, which in the JWST imaging show exquisitely resolved stellar clumps at scales as small as 0.04''. We identify 13 new systems of multiply-imaged lensed galaxies and determine the redshifts for two sources based on archival spectroscopic observations. We also identify over 50 individually resolved substructure clumps in the multiple images of eight galaxies and add them into the lens model, for a total of 275 positional lensing constraints between all 26 lensed sources used in the model. We investigate the impact of different modeling choices on our results. In the final lens model, we reproduce the observed multiple images with a precision of 0.23'' , and achieve 0.13'' specifically for the H-U systems. We estimate a total enclosed mass in the cluster's strong lensing regime of M(<110 kpc) ~ 8.2 x 10^13 Msun, reconstruct the source images of the most highly magnified galaxies, and measure time delays in the most magnified, morphologically detailed systems. The isotropic lensing effect from the H-U configurations enables future detailed studies of the properties of their source galaxies, and the number and spatial density of additional constraints improve the model's ability to detect dark matter substructures within the cluster core.
papers.comment: Submitted for review to The Astrophysical Journal on September 15, 2026

analysis.title_zh: 解析“宇宙螳螂”中的三种奇异双曲脐型透镜构型：利用JWST探索RXJ0437.1+0043
analysis.summary_zh: 作者利用JWST NIRCam四通带成像更新星系团RXJ0437.1+0043的强透镜模型，纳入26个背景源及其内部团块所提供的275个位置约束。摘要报告模型对全部多重像和双曲脐型系统分别达到0.23角秒和0.13角秒的位置重现精度，并给出强透镜区包络质量、源像重建和部分系统的时间延迟测量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究与CMB本身没有直接数据联系，但高分辨率星系团强透镜是研究暗物质分布、小尺度结构和高红移星系的重要互补探针。其质量模型及子结构约束可用于检验宇宙结构形成与暗物质模型，并与CMB所确定的早期宇宙参数和大尺度结构演化框架进行跨尺度比较。
key_points: JWST NIRCam 成像揭示至少三组双曲脐型强引力透镜构型及大量可分辨恒星团块。
模型使用26个背景源的275个位置约束，并比较不同建模选择的影响。
摘要报告了像位置重现精度、强透镜区包络质量、源像重建与时间延迟测量。
methods: JWST NIRCam四个通带成像
星系团强引力透镜建模
档案光谱观测给出的源红移
多重像与内部子结构团块的位置约束
源平面图像重建与时间延迟测量
不同透镜建模选择的比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：双曲脐型系统和内部团块的识别及匹配是否稳健；275个位置约束的误差与相关性如何处理；质量分布参数化、视线结构和源红移不确定性如何影响包络质量、时间延迟及暗物质子结构探测能力。摘要仅称新增约束可改善子结构探测，未报告实际探测到暗物质子结构。

papers.title: Optimising instrument concepts with Machine Learning: Application to CMB spectral distortion experiments
papers.abstract: Understanding how instrumental and mission parameters affect the ability to measure faint astrophysical signals is a key challenge in the design of future experiments. This is particularly relevant for CMB spectral distortions, whose weak signals are affected by both instrumental effects and astrophysical foregrounds. We develop a method to explore and optimise the multidimensional parameter space of an astronomical instrument, and apply it to CMB spectral distortion measurements using the FOSSIL mission concept. We combine a dedicated sky model with a realistic instrument model and use Fisher forecasts to assess measurement capabilities of the simulated instrument. Decision-tree-based regression models are then used to learn the non-linear mapping between instrumental parameters and the predicted signal-to-noise ratios of the sky observables. Random Forest and gradient boosting models accurately reproduce the forecasted measurement performance. SHAP values are used to interpret the impact of instrumental parameters on the measurement. The temperature of the warmest instrumental component is found to be the dominant parameter for all three observables, highlighting the importance of limiting internal emission and operating the instrument at cryogenic temperatures. Frequency coverage is also highly influential, revealing a trade-off between spectral coverage and instrumental sensitivity. The proposed optimisation method provides a fast and interpretable approach to explore high-dimensional instrumental parameter spaces and identify parameters that most strongly influence the scientific performance of an experiment. To the best of our knowledge, this work represents the first application of machine-learning methods to the global optimisation of an astronomical instrument and can readily be extended to other astronomical instruments and mission concepts.

analysis.title_zh: 利用机器学习优化仪器概念：在 CMB 谱畸变实验中的应用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究如何在未来 CMB 谱畸变实验设计中快速探索并优化高维仪器参数空间。作者以 FOSSIL 任务概念为例，将专用天空模型、现实仪器模型和 Fisher 预报结合起来，再用随机森林与梯度提升等决策树回归方法学习仪器参数到观测量信噪比的非线性映射；摘要报告这些模型能够准确复现预报性能，并发现最暖仪器部件温度和频率覆盖对测量能力尤其重要。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 谱畸变信号极其微弱，实验灵敏度不仅取决于探测器噪声，也受到仪器内部辐射、频率覆盖和天体物理前景的共同影响。该工作把机器学习作为实验设计和仪器优化工具，用可解释的特征重要性分析识别关键工程参数，可为未来 CMB 谱畸变任务的低温设计、频段规划和性能权衡提供方法学参考；其影响主要位于 CMB 实验设计与仪器建模层面，而非直接给出新的宇宙学约束。
key_points: 以 FOSSIL CMB 谱畸变任务概念为例，联合天空模型和现实仪器模型评估测量能力。
随机森林和梯度提升模型能够较准确地复现 Fisher 预报的信噪比。
SHAP 分析显示，最暖仪器部件的温度是三个天空观测量的主导参数，频率覆盖则体现了覆盖范围与灵敏度之间的权衡。
methods: 专用天空模型
现实仪器模型
Fisher 预报
基于决策树的回归模型
随机森林
梯度提升模型
SHAP 值解释
FOSSIL 任务概念
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对天空模型与仪器模型的具体假设、Fisher 预报是否包含参数退化和系统误差，以及机器学习训练集覆盖的仪器参数范围和模型外推可靠性。还需确认“最暖部件温度主导”在不同前景模型、频段配置和噪声假设下是否稳健，以及优化结果是否真正经过独立仪器配置或端到端模拟验证。

papers.title: On the cosmic previrialization
papers.abstract: Non-linear gravitational evolution affects the growth of density and velocity fluctuations, and leads to previrialization effects before virialized structures are formed. Therefore, understanding and quantifying the leading nonlinear corrections to the corresponding variances is crucial for describing the departure from linear structure formation. We calculate the first nonlinear correction to the variance of the cosmic density and velocity fields. We analyze the 1-loop contributions associated with the second and third order perturbative kernels of both the density and velocity-divergence fields. The relevant forms of the third-order kernels $F_3(\vec{k},\vec{q},-\vec{q})$ for density, and $G_3(\vec{k},\vec{q},-\vec{q})$ for velocity divergence, are clearly non-symmetric under exchange of $\vec{k}$ with $\vec{q}$. However, the calculation of the variance involves a symmetric double integral of these variables, so in this particular case the kernels can be additionally symmetrized. We therefore explicitly symmetrize these kernels $F_3$ and $G_3$, and express them as functions of the two scalar variables: the cosine of the angle between the two wavevectors and a symmetric function of their magnitudes. This representation enables us to identify and isolate the terms which are divergent before performing the angular integration, and to show their cancellation between the second- and third-order terms. The divergent contribution from $P_{δ22}\,$ to the one-loop power spectrum cancels exactly that arising from $P_{δ13}$ . Angularly averaged divergence-free part of $F_3$ turns out to be remarkably close to a constant. We found that the corresponding coefficient of the leading-order correction is confined to a remarkably narrow interval of 4007/2205 to 4063/2205 $(\simeq 1.817 \leq C \leq 1.843)$, for any form of the linear power spectrum.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, to be submitted to Astronomy & Astrophysics

analysis.title_zh: 论宇宙预维里化
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究非线性引力演化在结构维里化之前产生的预维里化效应：作者计算宇宙密度场与速度场方差的首个非线性修正。通过分析二阶与三阶微扰核的 1-loop 贡献并对三阶核做对称化，摘要报告二阶与三阶发散项相消，且领头修正系数被限制在 4007/2205 至 4063/2205（约 1.817–1.843）的窄区间内。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 预维里化属于非线性结构形成理论；对 CMB 研究而言，它关系到如何用物质功率谱和速度场连接原初扰动与晚期观测，并影响引力透镜、ISW、kSZ 等次级效应的理论建模。
key_points: 计算密度场和速度散度场方差的首个非线性修正，关注 1-loop 贡献。
对 F3 和 G3 做显式对称化，分离角积分前的发散项，并展示二阶与三阶项之间的抵消。
角平均无散部分的 F3 近似为常数；领头修正系数 C 在约 1.817 到 1.843 之间，摘要称对任意线性功率谱成立。
methods: 宇宙微扰论：二阶与三阶微扰核（密度 F3、速度散度 G3）的 1-loop 计算。
对 F3(k,q,-q) 与 G3(k,q,-q) 进行显式对称化，并表示为两标量变量的函数。
角积分及发散项分离，并比较 Pδ22 与 Pδ13 对一圈功率谱的发散贡献。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：发散项抵消是在方差计算还是一圈功率谱层面严格成立；对称化与角平均无散部分的近似常数如何影响最终系数区间；4007/2205–4063/2205 的推导是否确实不依赖线性功率谱形状，以及速度场结论与密度场是否同等成立。

papers.title: JADES: Dynamical Measurements of Dark Matter Halo Masses at $z \approx 7$ Using Galaxy Pairs
papers.abstract: We present dynamical measurements of dark matter halo masses at $z\approx7$ using galaxy pairs. Galaxy pairs in the early Universe are usually in their first infall, before substantial orbital evolution or phase mixing. Their relative velocities closely trace the halo mass, especially when the pair separation is near the halo virial radius. In the TNG100 simulation, we find that dynamical mass estimators can recover halo masses with an intrinsic scatter of $\sim$0.2 dex. We apply this method to 10 pair systems at z=6-8 with [O III] spectroscopy from the JWST Advanced Deep Extragalactic Survey (JADES). We infer the stellar-to-halo mass relation while marginalizing over projection effects, measurement uncertainties, and intrinsic scatter. We find a mean halo mass of $\log\,(M_{200}/M_\odot)=11.06\pm0.21$ at $\log\,(M_{*}/M_\odot)=9$. These galaxies do not appear to inhabit unusually massive halos. Our results instead indicate a high stellar-to-halo mass ratio, corresponding to an integrated star formation efficiency of $5^{+3}_{-2}\%$, about twice the TNG100 prediction, although the current statistical significance is limited. Future observations with larger samples will tighten these constraints and directly examine whether enhanced star formation efficiency drives the overabundance of luminous galaxies at cosmic dawn.

analysis.title_zh: JADES：利用星系对对z≈7暗物质晕质量进行动力学测量
analysis.summary_zh: 论文利用早期宇宙中首次下落星系对的相对速度估计暗物质晕质量，先以TNG100模拟检验方法，再应用于JADES中10个z=6–8的[O III]光谱星系对。摘要报告在恒星质量log(M*/M☉)=9处平均晕质量为log(M200/M☉)=11.06±0.21，并推得积分恒星形成效率为5%（+3%/−2%），约为TNG100预测的两倍，但统计显著性仍有限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究不直接分析CMB，但其对宇宙黎明时期恒星质量—暗物质晕质量关系和恒星形成效率的约束，有助于理解早期结构形成及高红移亮星系丰度。它也可为结合CMB所约束的背景宇宙学、再电离历史与高红移星系观测的模型提供关键天体物理输入，并检验标准宇宙学模拟中的星系形成处方。
key_points: 利用高红移星系对的相对速度和间距估计暗物质晕质量。
TNG100模拟显示该动力学估计量的内禀散布约为0.2 dex。
摘要报告这些星系具有较高的恒星质量与晕质量之比，但当前统计显著性有限。
methods: TNG100宇宙学流体动力学模拟校准与检验
JADES中10个红移z=6–8星系对的JWST [O III]光谱
基于星系对相对速度与分离尺度的动力学晕质量估计
在推断恒星质量—暗物质晕质量关系时边缘化投影效应、测量不确定性和内禀散布
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：TNG100对高红移首次下落星系对的模拟样本选择及其与JADES观测选择函数是否匹配；质量估计量对轨道构型、投影效应、晕定义和小样本的敏感性；“较高恒星形成效率”相对TNG100预测的统计证据，以及由10个系统推断总体关系时采用的先验和层次模型。

papers.title: A reanalysis of the megamaser Hubble constant: from spot catalogues to peculiar velocities
papers.abstract: The Hubble tension motivates careful scrutiny of the redshift-independent distances underpinning the local distance ladder. Water megamasers afford a purely geometric distance from orbital dynamics in an accretion disc. For five of the six Megamaser Cosmology Project (MCP) galaxies, we present a Bayesian forward model that infers the angular-diameter distance and warped Keplerian disc parameters jointly from the very long baseline interferometry quasi-observables: maser spot positions, velocities, and accelerations. We then constrain $H_0$ from these distances and the host redshifts, including a physical distance prior, modelling the galaxy sample selection and testing a linear and a non-linear peculiar-velocity reconstruction. Accounting for peculiar velocities with the non-linear Manticore reconstruction, we infer $H_0 = 71.6 \pm 3.7$ km/s/Mpc, where the uncertainty is statistical. Relative to ignoring peculiar velocities, the linear and non-linear reconstructions lower $H_0$ by $0.8$--$1.4$ and $1.6$--$2.1$ km/s/Mpc, respectively, whereas changing the selection variable alters it by less than $1$ km/s/Mpc. We analyse the sixth galaxy, NGC 4258, separately. Modelling its disc as eccentric and quadratically warped, we infer an angular-diameter distance of $7.558 \pm 0.073$ (stat.) Mpc, within $0.13σ$ of the published maser distance.

analysis.title_zh: 巨脉泽哈勃常数的再分析：从斑点目录到本动速度
analysis.summary_zh: 论文重新分析五个 MCP 巨脉泽星系，以贝叶斯前向模型联合拟合脉泽斑点的位置、速度、加速度以及翘曲开普勒盘参数和角直径距离，再结合宿主红移、样本选择与本动速度重建推断 H₀。摘要报告采用非线性 Manticore 重建时得到 H₀=71.6±3.7 km/s/Mpc（仅统计误差）；对单独分析的 NGC 4258，偏心且二次翘曲的盘模型给出 7.558±0.073 Mpc（统计误差），与已发表脉泽距离相差 0.13σ。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 巨脉泽提供独立于造父变星等传统距离梯级标定环节的几何距离，因此可作为检验局域 H₀ 推断及哈勃张力系统误差的重要途径。对 CMB 研究而言，这项低红移 H₀ 测量可与 CMB 在特定宇宙学模型下推断的 H₀ 比较；摘要尤其显示，本动速度建模会造成可见的 H₀ 位移，因而是评估局域测量与早期宇宙推断差异时不可忽略的因素。
key_points: 从甚长基线干涉测量的脉泽斑点目录直接联合推断距离与盘模型参数。
非线性 Manticore 本动速度重建使推断的 H₀ 比忽略本动速度时降低 1.6–2.1 km/s/Mpc。
NGC 4258 被单独建模，其距离结果与已发表的脉泽距离一致。
methods: 贝叶斯前向模型
甚长基线干涉测量的脉泽斑点位置、速度与加速度数据
翘曲开普勒吸积盘模型
物理距离先验与星系样本选择建模
线性及非线性本动速度重建
Manticore 非线性本动速度重建
NGC 4258 的偏心、二次翘曲盘模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：从斑点层级准观测量到距离后验的似然与系统误差处理；物理距离先验及样本选择函数是否会引入偏差；线性与 Manticore 非线性本动速度场的适用尺度、边界条件和不确定性如何传播到 H₀。还需注意摘要给出的 H₀ 误差明确仅为统计误差，不能据此判断总误差预算或其缓解哈勃张力的程度。

papers.title: The galaxy-electron cross-spectrum with ACT, SPT-3G and DESILS LRGs
papers.abstract: The galaxy--electron cross-power spectrum $P_{ge}(k)$ measures the small-scale distribution of gas around galaxies, the quantity reshaped by feedback. We measure $P_{ge}$ from the kinetic Sunyaev--Zel'dovich (kSZ) signal of the photometric DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys luminous red galaxies, cross-correlating a velocity-weighted galaxy momentum template with the CMB temperature from ACT DR6 and, for the first time, SPT-3G. The absolute normalization of the cross-spectrum is fixed by a surrogate-field Monte Carlo that propagates the survey mask, lightcone evolution, and photometric-redshift weights, converting the measured pseudo-spectrum into $P_{ge}(k)$ in physical units. We detect $P_{ge}$ at $11.7σ$ with ACT and $8.4σ$ with SPT-3G, and at $12.3σ$ combining SPT-3G with the ACT northern cap, which it does not overlap. The two surveys have independent optics, beams, filtering and noise and share about two thirds of the SPT-3G galaxies; their amplitudes agree channel by channel, the largest difference being $0.7σ$. All $26$ null tests on the adopted night maps are consistent with zero signal, among them the six ACT frequency differences, the three SPT-3G frequency differences, and the four ACT cap differences of the main selection. Turning the amplitude into a gas fraction requires the host halo masses of the sample, which the cross-spectrum does not itself measure; taking them from its measured number density and from a published CMB-lensing calibration of the same galaxies, the gas within the virial radius is $25$--$33\%$ of the cosmic baryon budget of the halo.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 ACT、SPT-3G 和 DESI Legacy 发光红星系测量星系—电子交叉谱
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys 的光度发光红星系样本，将速度加权星系动量模板与 ACT DR6 和 SPT-3G 的 CMB 温度进行 kSZ 交叉相关，测量星系—电子交叉功率谱 P_ge(k)。摘要报告 ACT、SPT-3G 以及联合分析均探测到显著信号，并在采用外部宿主晕质量信息后推得晕内气体约占宇宙重子预算的 25%--33%。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接利用 CMB 的次级各向异性 kSZ 信号研究星系周围的热电子和重子气体分布，连接了 CMB 观测、星系巡天和星系反馈物理。对宇宙学而言，星系—电子交叉谱可帮助约束重子分布、反馈导致的小尺度物质重塑，并为理解缺失重子问题提供观测信息；同时，结果对光度红移、速度重建和宿主晕质量校准的系统误差较为敏感。
key_points: 利用 DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys 发光红星系与 ACT DR6、SPT-3G CMB 温度的 kSZ 交叉相关测量星系周围气体分布。
通过代理场蒙特卡洛传播掩膜、光锥演化和光度红移权重，将伪谱归一化并转换为物理单位下的星系—电子交叉功率谱。
ACT 和 SPT-3G 分别以 11.7σ 和 8.4σ 探测到信号；结合非重叠的 ACT 北部天空区域后，总显著性为 12.3σ。
methods: 运动加权的星系动量模板与 CMB 温度图的交叉相关
动力学 Sunyaev–Zel'dovich（kSZ）信号分析
ACT DR6 和 SPT-3G CMB 数据
DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys 光度红星系样本
代理场蒙特卡洛，用于传播巡天掩膜、光锥演化和光度红移权重
伪谱到物理单位下 P_ge(k) 的转换
频率差分、天空区域差分等零检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对代理场蒙特卡洛对绝对归一化和光度红移系统误差的建模、kSZ 速度模板与电子分布之间的假设，以及 ACT 与 SPT-3G 共享约三分之二星系样本时联合显著性和协方差的处理。还应核对气体占比 25%--33% 对宿主晕质量校准的依赖，因为该交叉谱本身并不直接测量晕质量。

papers.title: Massively parallel transdimensional sampling with data assimilation: an application to LISA galactic binaries
papers.abstract: Transdimensional Bayesian inference is becoming a key ingredient in gravitational-wave astronomy. In many relevant applications, the number of components needed to describe the data is not known a priori and must be inferred jointly with their parameters. We present a transdimensional Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) framework designed to exploit massive parallelism. The method evolves a population of particles through a sequence of tempered distributions and uses the No-U-Turn Sampler for the exploration of fixed-dimensional parameter space while reversible-jump birth and death moves allow the number of components to vary. The same SMC construction also enables posterior samples obtained from a shorter data segment to be updated as additional data become available, enhancing the overall efficiency of the analysis. We validate the approach on two proof-of-concept problems: the recovery of a sequence of Gaussian pulses and a simplified LISA Galactic-binary inference problem. In both cases, the method recovers the injected number of components and produces consistent posterior estimates. These results indicate that the proposed method is a promising avenue toward scalable and parallel Bayesian transdimensional inference for current and future gravitational-wave astronomy.

analysis.title_zh: 结合数据同化的大规模并行跨维采样：在 LISA 银河系双星中的应用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对信号分量数未知的引力波分析，提出可大规模并行的跨维序贯蒙特卡洛框架，以 NUTS 探索固定维参数空间，并用可逆跳跃的出生/死亡操作改变分量数，同时支持随新增数据更新已有后验样本。摘要报告该方法在高斯脉冲序列和简化的 LISA 银河系双星问题中均恢复了注入分量数，并得到一致的后验估计。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接面向 LISA 引力波源分离，而非 CMB 数据分析，但它处理的“未知分量数、重叠信号与高维后验”问题也出现在 CMB 前景成分建模、点源或星系团数目不定的目录推断及其他层次贝叶斯分析中。其粒子并行和增量数据更新思路可能对未来大规模宇宙学数据流有方法学参考价值，但摘要尚未展示其在 CMB 场景中的适用性。
key_points: 以序贯蒙特卡洛在未知信号分量数与连续参数之间开展跨维贝叶斯推断。
固定维空间由无掉头采样器探索，分量数通过可逆跳跃的出生与死亡操作改变。
摘要报告其在两个概念验证问题中恢复了注入的分量数，并给出一致的后验估计。
methods: 跨维序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）
温度化分布序列与粒子群演化
无掉头采样器（NUTS）
可逆跳跃出生与死亡操作
利用新增数据更新较短数据段所得后验样本的数据同化方案
高斯脉冲序列恢复测试
简化的 LISA 银河系双星推断测试
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：跨维出生/死亡提议及权重更新是否保证正确的目标后验；数据同化过程中如何处理新增数据与既有后验样本；所谓“大规模并行”的实际扩展效率、计算成本与粒子退化情况；以及简化 LISA 测试与真实高密度、重叠双星信号分析之间仍有哪些差距。

papers.title: WIMPs with Enhanced Annihilation from a Feebly Interacting Unstable Partner
papers.abstract: Weakly interacting massive particles (WIMPs) constitute one of the best-motivated dark matter (DM) candidates. In this study, we consider a simple extension of the WIMP paradigm in which WIMPs are coupled to a heavier particle that interacts only with them and can decay into WIMPs. In the early Universe, when WIMPs are in thermal equilibrium with the Standard Model (SM) bath, they serve as a portal to populate the heavy partner through inverse decays. Depending on the lifetime of the partner particle, its eventual decay into WIMPs can significantly alter the WIMP abundance. If the partner decays into WIMPs before their freeze-out from equilibrium, the standard thermal history remains unchanged. When the decay occurs after WIMP freeze-out, however, the injected non-thermal population of WIMPs can result in an overproduction of DM, therefore requiring a larger WIMP annihilation cross section relative to the standard scenario without the partner. For a given partner lifetime and WIMP annihilation cross section, freeze-out may be delayed due to re-annihilation or followed by a freeze-in phase. By solving the Boltzmann equations both semi-analytically and numerically, we explore these thermal histories and study the required enhancement in the WIMP annihilation cross section compared to the canonical value. This enhancement, which can reach up to three orders of magnitude, leads to stronger annihilation signals in the late Universe. As a result, current and upcoming indirect detection experiments are able to probe the lifetime of the partner particle. We briefly explore possible connections between our scenario and the baryon asymmetry of the Universe. As an example, we show that the Next-to-Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model (NMSSM) can provide a realization of our scenario, with the possibility of accommodating light higgsino DM with the correct relic abundance.

analysis.title_zh: 具有增强湮灭效应的WIMP：来自一个弱相互作用不稳定伙伴
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究一种扩展的WIMP暗物质情景：WIMP通过逆衰变在早期宇宙中产生一个仅与WIMP相互作用的更重伙伴，伙伴随后衰变并改变WIMP丰度。作者通过半解析和数值求解玻尔兹曼方程，分析伙伴寿命导致的标准冻结出、再湮灭或冻结入热史；摘要报告称所需WIMP湮灭截面相对标准情形可增强至多约三个数量级，并由此增强晚期宇宙的间接探测信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接涉及暗物质遗迹丰度和晚期湮灭，是粒子宇宙学与宇宙学热史研究的交叉问题。虽然摘要重点是间接探测而非CMB数据分析，但增强的晚期WIMP湮灭可能向宇宙等离子体注入能量，从而影响复合时期的电离历史、CMB温度和偏振各向异性；因此该情景需要与CMB能量沉积约束进行比较。
key_points: 弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）与一个仅同其相互作用、且可衰变为WIMP的更重伙伴耦合。
伙伴粒子在WIMP冻结出之前衰变时，标准热史基本不变；在冻结出之后衰变时，注入的非热WIMP可能导致暗物质过量。
再湮灭或后续冻结入等热史可使所需WIMP湮灭截面相对标准情形增强，摘要称增强幅度最高可达三个数量级。
methods: 半解析求解玻尔兹曼方程
数值求解玻尔兹曼方程
研究伙伴粒子寿命与WIMP湮灭截面对热史和遗迹丰度的影响
讨论间接探测实验对伙伴粒子寿命的探测能力
以次最小超对称标准模型（NMSSM）作为该情景的实现例子
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对伙伴粒子的具体量子数、耦合与衰变道如何定义，以及半解析和数值结果的适用参数范围；还需确认“最高三个数量级”的增强对应哪些寿命、质量和湮灭截面条件，并检查间接探测约束是否纳入了宇宙学、天体物理和实验系统学不确定性。对于与CMB的联系，应重点核对晚期注入和增强湮灭是否会改变复合时期的能量沉积，以及论文是否给出相应的CMB约束。

papers.title: Proper Time Shifts in Pulsar Timing Arrays
papers.abstract: Pulsar timing arrays are a powerful tool for probing low-frequency gravitational phenomena and physics beyond the Standard Model. We establish a general, gauge-invariant framework for the timing residual by identifying the measurable quantity as the proper time interval between consecutive pulse arrivals at Earth. In linearized general relativity, we derive a general expression for this proper time shift and show that it decomposes into Doppler, Shapiro, and Einstein delay contributions whose sum is gauge invariant, similar to frameworks that have been developed for other gravitational-wave detectors such as laser and atom interferometers. We also provide a recipe for computing the resulting timing residual for any specified perturbation, and we illustrate the method with several physically well-motivated sources, recovering known results where they exist in the literature. This recipe can be directly applied to search for new physics from real pulsar timing data using existing numerical software.

analysis.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中的固有时偏移
analysis.summary_zh: 论文把地球上相邻脉冲到达之间的固有时区间确立为 PTA 的可测量量，并在线性化广义相对论中推导一般的固有时偏移表达式。摘要称该偏移可分解为多普勒、夏皮罗和爱因斯坦延迟，三者之和规范不变；作者还给出针对任意指定微扰计算计时残差的方案，并通过若干源恢复了文献中的已知结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: PTA 是探测纳赫兹频段引力现象及超越标准模型物理的重要手段，而规范选择若处理不清，可能混淆计时残差中不同物理效应的解释。该工作提供统一且规范不变的响应框架，有助于一致地建立随机引力波背景或其他新物理微扰的 PTA 信号模板；它与 CMB 的联系主要在于两者都利用宇宙学扰动约束引力与早期宇宙模型，而非直接研究 CMB 温度或偏振观测。
key_points: 以地球端相邻脉冲到达事件之间的固有时区间作为可观测量。
在线性化广义相对论中，将固有时偏移分解为多普勒、夏皮罗和爱因斯坦延迟，三者之和具有规范不变性。
给出适用于指定微扰源的计时残差计算流程，并以若干物理动机明确的源作示例。
methods: 线性化广义相对论
规范不变的脉冲星计时残差框架
多普勒、夏皮罗与爱因斯坦延迟分解
对若干物理动机明确的微扰源进行示例计算
面向现有数值软件和真实脉冲星计时数据的计算方案
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：固有时可观测量与常用 PTA 计时残差定义之间的严格对应关系；三个延迟分量各自的规范依赖如何精确抵消；计算方案对脉冲星端项、地球端项、边界条件及实际计时模型拟合的处理。还需区分哪些示例只是复现已有结果，哪些属于新物理信号的新增推导。

papers.title: The OpenGadget3 Code for Cosmological Simulations
papers.abstract: We present the public release of OpenGadget3 (OG3), a substantially extended and re-organised version of the widely used Gadget-2/3 family of cosmological simulation codes. Since G2 was made publicly available, the absence of continued official development led to the creation of numerous, mutually incompatible developer versions of G3 across the community. This made it effectively impossible to track bug fixes, reproduce published results, or consistently credit the many individual contributors. OG3 addresses this by consolidating these disparate developments into a single, documented, and continuously maintained code base, released under the GNU GPLv3 through a GitLab repository (with an accompanying wiki), regularly synchronised with the active developer branch, and supported by a dedicated continuous-integration (CI) pipeline. OG3 retains the core algorithmic backbone of its predecessors, a Barnes\&Hut oct-tree combined with a Particle-Mesh method for gravity, and a choice of Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics or Meshless-Finite-Mass solvers for gas dynamics, within a hybrid MPI/OpenMP parallelisation framework, extended with GPU offloading via OpenACC and OpenMP. The code integrates an extensive suite of sub-resolution and physical modules, including primordial chemistry, radiative cooling, star formation, stellar feedback and chemical enrichment, dust formation and evolution, black hole growth and AGN feedback, MHD, thermal conduction, physical viscosity, SIDM, and massive neutrinos. OG3 introduces new features improving robustness, reproducibility, and usability: a flexible mixed-precision framework spanning 16- to 128-bit representations; expert-level tagged parameters with restart-time change log; extensive consistency checks against invalid configurations; and FAIR-compliant reporting of all settings, parameters, and specific publications. (shortened and abridged)
papers.comment: 70 Pages, 26 pictures, submitted, OpenGadget3 available via https://gitlab.lrz.de/AstroCodes/OpenGadget3

analysis.title_zh: 用于宇宙学模拟的 OpenGadget3 代码
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍公开发布的 OpenGadget3（OG3），旨在把社区中分散且相互不兼容的 Gadget-3 开发版本整合为统一、文档化并持续维护的宇宙学模拟代码。摘要称该代码保留 Barnes–Hut/Particle-Mesh 引力、SPH 或 MFM 气体动力学及混合 MPI/OpenMP 并行框架，并扩展了 GPU 支持、丰富物理模块、混合精度和可复现性工具；摘要没有给出定量性能或科学结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 与宇宙学研究常依赖大规模数值模拟来生成非线性结构、重子物理、反馈过程和中微子效应的理论预言，并用于解释或校准观测信号。OG3 通过统一代码版本、记录参数与变更、持续集成和配置检查，可能提升宇宙学模拟结果的可复现性与跨研究组比较能力；不过摘要本身未具体展示其对 CMB 观测预测或参数约束的影响。
key_points: 将分散且彼此不兼容的 Gadget-3 开发版本整合为统一、持续维护并有文档支持的 OpenGadget3 代码库。
保留 Barnes–Hut 八叉树与 Particle-Mesh 引力算法，以及 SPH 或 Meshless-Finite-Mass 气体动力学求解器，并支持混合 MPI/OpenMP 与 GPU 卸载。
加入混合精度、重启时参数变更记录、一致性检查和 FAIR 兼容设置报告，以改善稳健性、可复现性和可用性。
methods: Barnes–Hut 八叉树与 Particle-Mesh 结合的引力计算方法
Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics（SPH）或 Meshless-Finite-Mass（MFM）气体动力学求解器
混合 MPI/OpenMP 并行化
通过 OpenACC 和 OpenMP 实现 GPU 卸载
持续集成（CI）流程
GitLab 代码库及配套 wiki
16 位至 128 位表示范围的混合精度框架
配置一致性检查、重启时参数变更日志和 FAIR 兼容参数报告
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 OG3 相对于不同 Gadget-3 分支的具体代码差异、各物理模块的验证测试和性能基准，尤其要确认 GPU 卸载、混合精度及新增可复现性功能在实际模拟中的适用范围与代价。摘要未提供定量性能提升、误差控制或科学应用结果。

papers.title: $B$-sure. Part II. Scattering transforms as robustness test for tensor-to-scalar ratio detection from CMB observations
papers.abstract: Galactic foregrounds represent a major contamination to the measurement of primordial $B$-modes from observations of the Cosmic Microwave Background polarisation. Even after the application of component separation algorithms, foreground residuals may potentially still bias the estimate of the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$, causing a false detection. In this work, we present the methodology of a robustness test for the validation of an eventual detection of primordial $B$-modes, as obtained by a future, LiteBIRD-like satellite experiment. The goal of the test is to identify the foreground residuals contamination by looking for non-Gaussian properties in the CMB $B$-modes map, recovered through blind component separation algorithms. We adopt scattering transforms (ST) as our summary statistics sensitive to the non-Gaussian features of foreground residuals and to their correlation with foregrounds tracer maps. We characterise and validate the methodology on realistic sky simulations with different levels of foregrounds complexity. The proposed test is able to identify a bias on the tensor-to-scalar ratio of $\gtrsim 10^{-3}$ in $\sim 90\%$ of our simulations, with this bias value being of the same order of the accuracy targeted by LiteBIRD. Additionally, for our particular experimental configuration, the test is passed when the bias is lower than the sensitivity on the $r$ parameter, and no warning is raised. These results provide an important step forward in the development of statistical tools for validating future measurement of cosmological parameters, against foregrounds contamination.
papers.comment: 16 pages plus 10 pages of appendices and references; 3 tables, 10 figures. Prepared for submission to JCAP. Comments are welcome

papers.title: Vanilla Scotogenic Model at the future Muon Collider
papers.abstract: The vanilla scotogenic model (VSM) featuring three right-handed neutrinos and an inert scalar doublet, offers a unified explanation of neutrino masses, dark matter (DM), and the baryon asymmetry of the Universe through leptogenesis. The typical mass scale of such a scenario lies in the vicinity of $\sim$ 10 TeV and above, whereas enhanced second-generation Yukawa couplings lower the leptogenesis scale to $\sim 1$ \TeV, allowing the model to be probed at the future muon colliders. Adhering to DM, neutrino mass, Leptogenesis, and flavour dependent constraints, the charged scalar is likely to be a long-lived particle (LLP). We analyse both the prompt and displaced vertex signatures of the model to find that, prompt mono-photon signals remain challenging, but LLP searches offer a promising avenue to probe such a framework, subject to the timing resolutions, and displaced-vertex reconstruction efficiency.

papers.title: The Equivalence Principle in the Dark Sector in light of DESI
papers.abstract: Recent measurements of the distribution of galaxies by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) are in mild tension with a standard $Λ$-Cold Dark Matter cosmological model inferred from the anisotropies of the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) when extrapolated to low redshifts. Several solutions to explain this discrepancy in terms of new physics have been put forward, notably from new dynamics in a complex Dark Sector. Here we report on a resolution to this discrepancy that postulates that the inertial and gravitational masses of dark matter particles are not the same. Our best fit to CMB data combined either with Baryon Acoustic Oscillation (BAO) and Full Shape (FS) data from DESI DR1 (Data Release 1), or with BAO DR2 data alone, suggests the presence of a new long-range force in the Dark Sector with strength of $β\sim 0.5\% $ relative to gravity, at the $\sim 2.5σ$ level. A preliminary analysis combining FS DR1 and BAO DR2 data confirms the statistical power of DR2 and raises the evidence for dark forces to $\sim 3σ$, albeit ignoring the not yet available cross-correlation between the two datasets.

analysis.title_zh: DESI 观测下暗扇区中的等效原理
analysis.summary_zh: 论文用暗物质惯性质量与引力质量不相等、从而产生暗扇区长程力的模型，解释 DESI 低红移星系分布与由 CMB 外推的标准 ΛCDM 模型之间的轻微张力。摘要称，CMB 联合 DESI DR1 BAO/全形状或 DR2 BAO 数据的最佳拟合支持强度约为引力 0.5% 的新力，证据约 2.5σ；一项忽略数据交叉相关的初步组合分析达到约 3σ。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接讨论由 CMB 锚定的早期宇宙模型与 DESI 测得的低红移结构之间的一致性，并把潜在偏差解释为暗物质违反等效原理。若这种解释经更完整的协方差处理和系统误差检验后仍成立，它将改变 CMB 与大尺度结构联合约束暗物质微观性质的方式；但摘要所述张力和证据均属中等水平，且部分结果仍是初步分析。
key_points: 检验暗物质惯性质量与引力质量不相等的暗扇区等效原理破缺模型。
CMB 联合 DESI DR1 BAO 与全形状数据或 DR2 BAO 数据时，最佳拟合指向相对引力约 0.5% 的暗扇区长程力。
摘要报告的证据约为 2.5σ；初步的 DR1 全形状与 DR2 BAO 联合分析提高至约 3σ，但未计入两套数据的交叉相关。
methods: CMB 数据联合分析
DESI DR1 重子声学振荡（BAO）数据
DESI DR1 全形状（FS）数据
DESI DR2 BAO 数据
暗物质惯性质量与引力质量不相等的现象学模型
初步联合 DR1 FS 与 DR2 BAO 的分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对暗物质惯性质量与引力质量不等如何映射为长程力参数 β，以及该参数与标准宇宙学参数、暗能量动力学和星系偏置等效应的退化；还需检查约 2.5σ 证据对数据组合、先验和非线性建模的敏感性。对于约 3σ 的初步结果，尤其要核对忽略 DR1 FS 与 DR2 BAO 交叉相关会如何影响协方差与显著性，不能将其直接视为稳健的独立证据。

papers.title: Cosmological Constrained Axion-Portal Inelastic Dark Matter for the LZ Event
papers.abstract: The recent high-recoil candidate event reported by LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) motivates dark-matter scenarios with nonstandard kinematics and momentum-dependent interactions. We study a two-state inelastic dark-matter model in which $χ_1$ and $χ_2$ couple off-diagonally to an axion-like particle (ALP) that also couples to gluons and photons. Unlike treatments that assume only one dark-matter state is present today, we track the cosmological evolution of both states. The excited state $χ_2$ is sufficiently long-lived to survive to the present, with its relic fraction determined by the dark-sector conversion process $χ_2χ_2\leftrightarrowχ_1χ_1$. We find that this fraction depends strongly on the Lorentz structure of the DM--ALP interaction: scalar transition couplings efficiently deplete $χ_2$, favoring endothermic $χ_1 N\toχ_2 N$ scattering, whereas pseudoscalar transition couplings preserve $f_2\simeq1/2$, yielding recoil spectra dominated by exothermic $χ_2 N\toχ_1 N$ down-scattering. Benchmark spectra in all four scenarios can peak near the observed recoil energy of $250\,\mathrm{keV}$. Our results demonstrate that the dominant direction of inelastic scattering in direct detection can be dynamically selected by the early-Universe evolution of the dark sector. With additional data, annual modulation measurements could distinguish these scenarios. We further show that the ALP portal can be directly probed at colliders.

analysis.title_zh: 用于解释 LZ 事件的宇宙学约束轴子门户非弹性暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究通过类轴子粒子连接标准模型的两态非弹性暗物质，并同时追踪两个暗物质态的宇宙学演化，以解释 LZ 报告的高反冲候选事件。摘要称，标量跃迁耦合会有效耗减激发态并偏向吸热上散射，赝标量耦合则可维持约各半的激发态比例并使放热下散射占优；四类基准情景的反冲谱均可在观测候选事件约 250 keV 附近达到峰值。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的联系主要在粒子宇宙学层面：当今两个暗物质态的相对丰度由早期宇宙中的暗扇区转化历史决定，因而需要与暗物质遗存量及其他宇宙学约束相容。摘要没有报告使用 CMB 数据或计算 CMB 各向异性效应，但所涉及的长寿命激发态、ALP 门户及可能的能量注入过程，在完整约束分析中可能需要核对其是否受 CMB 限制。
key_points: 同时追踪两个暗物质态的宇宙学演化及其当今丰度。
DM–ALP 跃迁耦合的洛伦兹结构决定激发态的耗减效率。
早期宇宙演化可动态选择直接探测中吸热或放热散射占主导。
methods: 两态非弹性暗物质模型
同时耦合胶子和光子的类轴子粒子门户
暗扇区转化过程 χ₂χ₂↔χ₁χ₁ 的宇宙学演化追踪

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 χ₂ 寿命与遗存比例的计算假设，包括转化过程的冻结条件、标量与赝标量耦合下的速度或动量依赖，以及所得参数区是否同时满足宇宙学、直接探测、ALP 和对撞机约束。还需检查单个 LZ 候选事件下基准谱的统计解释，避免将“可在约 250 keV 附近出现峰值”理解为模型获得了显著支持。

papers.title: Running Hubble Constant with the Redshift as a Marker of Evolutionary Dark Energy
papers.abstract: We discuss the interpretation of an observed running Hubble constant with the redshift, in terms of the possible underlying physical scenario. Assuming, like in the $Λ$CDM model, that the matter and dark energy components do not directly interact, we arrive at the conclusion that the physical content of the cosmological dynamics can always be represented with an evolutionary dark energy paradigm. We discuss both the case of the power-law running Hubble constant, and that of an optimized fitting model, both studied with the binned Pantheon Sample of the Type Ia Supernovae data. These two cases turn out to be associated with a phantom-like evolutionary dark energy.

analysis.title_zh: 随红移运行的哈勃常数：演化暗能量的标志
analysis.summary_zh: 论文讨论如何把观测上随红移变化的推断哈勃常数解释为潜在物理情景；在物质与暗能量不直接相互作用的假设下，作者用分箱 Pantheon Ia 型超新星数据研究幂律模型和优化拟合模型，并报告两者均可对应类幽灵型演化暗能量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 哈勃参数的红移演化直接关系到晚期宇宙膨胀史以及暗能量状态方程的重建。对 CMB 研究而言，这类低红移解释可与 CMB 给出的早期宇宙约束和 ΛCDM 外推结果比较，但摘要仅使用超新星数据，未报告与 CMB 数据的联合分析，也不能仅据摘要判断其能否缓解哈勃张力。
key_points: 将随红移变化的推断哈勃常数解释为演化暗能量的可能标志。
假设物质与暗能量之间没有直接相互作用。
摘要称两种拟合情形都对应类幽灵型演化暗能量。
methods: 使用分箱后的 Pantheon Ia 型超新星样本
考察哈勃常数的幂律红移变化模型
考察优化拟合模型
在物质与暗能量无直接相互作用的假设下进行宇宙学动力学解释
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“随红移运行的哈勃常数”在各红移分箱中的具体定义与统计稳健性、优化模型的参数化及模型选择依据，以及从该现象映射到类幽灵暗能量是否具有唯一性并依赖哪些先验；还需检查系统误差和超新星绝对星等标定如何处理。

papers.title: Caught by its own light: Wimpzillas, the LHAASO knee and the diffuse $γ$-ray sky
papers.abstract: We use the proton spectrum resolved by LHAASO across the knee to test superheavy dark matter in the nucleon channel at PeV energies. Both the hardening at $0.34$ PeV and the knee at $3.3$ PeV are reproduced by nucleons from a relic of mass $5\cdot 10^{7}$ GeV decaying in the Galactic halo, with the mass as the only shape parameter of the spectrum and the background index profiled under an independent prior on the proton slope below $0.1$ PeV. It works equally well in all three hadronic-interaction-model reconstructions. On the other hand, the photons of the same cascade rule out this interpretation by about two orders of magnitude against the photon fraction of the cosmic radiation, and by about one order of magnitude against the LHAASO diffuse Galactic emission.

analysis.title_zh: 被自身的光捕获：Wimpzilla、LHAASO 膝与弥散伽马射线天空
analysis.summary_zh: 论文利用 LHAASO 跨越宇宙射线膝区的质子能谱，检验银河系晕中超重暗物质遗迹经核子道衰变的解释。摘要报告称，质量为 5×10^7 GeV 的遗迹粒子可在三种强子相互作用模型重建下拟合谱变硬与膝结构，但同一衰变级联伴随的光子信号分别比宇宙射线光子占比约束和 LHAASO 银河系弥散辐射约束高约两个及一个数量级，因而排除了该解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把宇宙射线膝区结构、超重暗物质和弥散伽马射线背景放在同一多信使一致性检验中，说明仅能拟合带电宇宙射线谱并不足以支持暗物质解释。它不直接分析 CMB，但与粒子宇宙学中的暗物质候选及早期宇宙遗迹密切相关；其伽马射线约束可与 CMB 对暗物质衰变能量注入的限制形成互补。
key_points: 用 LHAASO 跨越膝区的质子能谱检验超重暗物质衰变情景。
质量为 5×10^7 GeV 的遗迹粒子衰变核子可同时拟合 0.34 PeV 处的变硬和 3.3 PeV 处的膝。
同一衰变级联产生的光子通量与光子占比及弥散伽马射线观测严重冲突。
methods: LHAASO 跨膝区质子能谱
银河系晕内超重暗物质衰变的核子道模型
对背景谱指数进行剖面处理，并采用 0.1 PeV 以下质子谱斜率的独立先验
比较三种强子相互作用模型下重建的能谱
利用宇宙射线光子占比和 LHAASO 银河系弥散伽马射线辐射进行约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对质子谱拟合与光子约束是否采用一致的衰变级联、银河系晕分布和传播假设，并检查所谓“质量是唯一形状参数”在背景建模及强子相互作用模型系统误差下是否仍然成立；还应确认摘要所述排除倍数对应的能区、数据集和统计定义。

papers.title: A fast radio burst from a non-targeted low-frequency survey
papers.abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are bright, millisecond-duration transient radio signals of extragalactic origin with unknown source and emission mechanisms. While several thousand FRBs have been discovered at frequencies above 400 MHz, detections at lower frequencies have been exceptionally rare. Contributing to their rarity are the magnified dispersive delay, in the tens of seconds, and signal scattering that make low-frequency searches with established techniques computationally prohibitive. In particular, the only confirmed detection below 300 MHz came from a Low-Frequency Array observing campaign targeted at FRB 20180916B, a source already known to emit at higher frequencies. Here we present the first non-targeted detection of an FRB below 300 MHz, achieved in a wide-field, imaging-based survey with the Murchison Widefield Array. The implied FRB rate is consistent with that observed at higher frequencies, demonstrating that non-targeted wide-field surveys can uncover an unbiased, large low-frequency FRB population. This result challenges models invoking severe scattering or absorption to explain previous non-detections, and strengthens the case of low-frequency observations as promising avenue to study the local environment of FRBs.

papers.title: The WEFT project: I. The emergence of turbulence in a cosmic filament
papers.abstract: Much of the ordinary matter in the present-day Universe still escapes direct detection. These missing baryons are thought to reside in a warm-hot intergalactic medium (WHIM) threading the filaments of the cosmic web, whose turbulent and thermal state remains poorly constrained yet underpins any attempt to observe it. Beyond its observational stakes, how this turbulence emerges, as gravitational collapse converts ordered inflow into a disordered cascade, is a question of structure formation in its own right. We characterise the emergence of turbulence in the diffuse gas of a cosmic filament, from its assembly to the present day, in the first simulation of the Web Evolution in Filament Targeted zoom simulations (WEFT) project. The cosmological zoom-in technique is applied to a single filament, evolved from z=63 to z=0 with the moving-mesh code AREPO, reaching a median gas cell size of ~8 kpc. We trace the filament assembly, the thermodynamic state of its diffuse gas, the generation of vorticity at its accretion shocks, and the growth of turbulent motions, then quantify the intermittency of the cascade through high-order velocity structure functions and their relative scaling exponents from extended self-similarity. The filament assembles by the hierarchical merging of several proto-filaments rather than by laminar accretion. Vorticity is seeded baroclinically where the rotating strands meet their accretion shocks obliquely. The flow evolves from a supersonic, shock-dominated state, statistically close to the bifractal Burgers limit, into a developed, mildly supersonic, intermittent cascade whose longitudinal exponents lie closest to the sheet-like She-Lévêque model at z=0. Turbulence is thus an intrinsic, quantifiable property of the diffuse gas of filaments. This pathfinder run provides the turbulent input for forecasts of WHIM observability.

analysis.title_zh: WEFT 项目 I：宇宙丝中湍流的涌现
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 WEFT 项目的首个单宇宙丝宇宙学高分辨率重模拟，研究从早期组装到当前时刻弥散气体中涡量和湍流级联的形成。摘要报告，宇宙丝经原初丝状体层级并合而形成，斜压作用在吸积激波处播种涡量，流动最终由接近 Burgers 极限的超声速激波主导状态演化为轻度超声速、具有间歇性且更接近片状 She-Lévêque 模型的成熟级联。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作不直接分析 CMB，但关系到晚期宇宙重子分布、温热星系际介质及宇宙大尺度结构的气体物理。宇宙丝中湍流和热状态会影响缺失重子的观测预报，并可能成为解释热/动理学 Sunyaev–Zel'dovich 效应、快速射电暴色散量或其他大尺度结构示踪量时需要建模的间接前景与重子反馈因素；不过摘要并未实际计算这些 CMB 次级效应。
key_points: 该宇宙丝由多个原初丝状体层级并合形成，而非通过层流吸积形成。
斜向吸积激波与旋转气体束的相互作用通过斜压机制产生涡量。
气体流动从超声速、激波主导状态演化为轻度超声速且具有间歇性的湍流级联。
methods: 针对单个宇宙丝的宇宙学高分辨率重模拟
使用移动网格代码 AREPO 从 z=63 演化至 z=0
追踪组装历史、弥散气体热力学状态、吸积激波涡量生成及湍流运动增长
高阶速度结构函数
扩展自相似性及相对标度指数分析
与双分形 Burgers 极限和片状 She-Lévêque 模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对单个宇宙丝的选取标准及其代表性、约 8 kpc 的中值气体单元尺度能否充分解析激波与湍流惯性区间，以及速度结构函数的测量区域、尺度范围和数值收敛性；还需区分摘要所称湍流演化中物理效应与数值耗散的贡献。

papers.title: Alpha-Core Breakup in the Strong Decay of \({}_{ΛΛ}^{6}\mathrm{He}\) to a Deeply Bound \(H\) Dibaryon
papers.abstract: We investigate the effect of $α$-core breakup on the strong conversion of \({}^{6}_{ΛΛ}\mathrm{He}\) into a deeply bound \(H\) dibaryon. In addition to the coherent \(H+{}^{4}\mathrm{He}\) channel, we evaluate the open final states \(H+p+{}^{3}\mathrm{H}\), \(H+n+{}^{3}\mathrm{He}\), and \(H+d+d\) using a translationally invariant Gaussian cluster description, including spin-isospin recoupling and full nonrelativistic three-body phase-space integrations. The breakup widths are normalized to Gal's intact-\(α\) result. At \(B_{ΛΛ}^{H}=176~\mathrm{MeV}\), corresponding to \(m_H\simeq2055~\mathrm{MeV}\), the summed breakup width exceeds the intact-\(α\) width by a factor \(R_{\mathrm{br}}=2.49\times10^{3}\). The resulting inclusive width and lifetime are \(Γ_{\mathrm{inc}}=3.87\times10^{-4}~\mathrm{eV}\) and \(τ_{\mathrm{inc}}=1.70\times10^{-12}~\mathrm{s}\), respectively, compared with \(τ_α=4.25\times10^{-9}~\mathrm{s}\) for the intact-\(α\) channel alone. The mass-dependent calculation shows that the inclusive lifetime crosses the characteristic hypernuclear weak-decay timescale near \(m_H\simeq2020~\mathrm{MeV}\) and increases rapidly as the \(H\) mass decreases. In the representative dark-matter-motivated interval \(1865\leq m_H\leq1885~\mathrm{MeV}\), we obtain \(6.59\times10^{-4}\lesssimτ_{\mathrm{inc}}\lesssim 6.80\times10^{-3}~\mathrm{s}\), far exceeding the weak-decay timescale. Thus, although core breakup can dominate the inclusive strong width near \(m_H\simeq2055~\mathrm{MeV}\), weakly decaying double-\(Λ\) hypernuclei remain compatible, within the present framework, with a deeply bound \(uuddss\) state in the mass range relevant to sexaquark dark matter.

analysis.title_zh: ⁶ΛΛHe 强衰变至深束缚 H 双重子过程中的 α 核破裂
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究 ⁶ΛΛHe 强转换为深束缚 H 双重子时 α 核破裂的影响，以高斯团簇模型、自旋—同位旋重耦合和三体相空间积分计算多个开放末态。摘要报告，在 m_H≈2055 MeV 时破裂通道使总宽度远超完整 α 核通道，而在 1865–1885 MeV 的暗物质相关质量区间，所得强衰变寿命仍远长于典型超核弱衰变时标。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作不直接研究 CMB，而是检验深束缚 uuddss 六夸克态作为暗物质候选时是否与双 Λ 超核现象相容。它对粒子宇宙学的意义在于约束六夸克暗物质的质量与核内转换行为；若该候选的允许参数空间发生变化，才可能间接影响暗物质丰度、早期宇宙演化及相关 CMB 推断，因此对以 CMB 为主的读者属于背景性而非直接相关文献。
key_points: 纳入 α 核破裂后，H 双重子产生的强衰变末态不再局限于相干的 H+⁴He 通道。
摘要报告：在 m_H≈2055 MeV 时，破裂通道显著增大总强衰变宽度并缩短寿命。
在与六夸克暗物质相关的 1865–1885 MeV 质量区间，模型所得强衰变寿命远长于典型超核弱衰变时标。
methods: 平移不变的高斯团簇描述
自旋—同位旋重耦合
完整的非相对论三体相空间积分
以 Gal 的完整 α 核结果归一化破裂宽度
计算 H+p+³H、H+n+³He、H+d+d 及 H+⁴He 末态

papers.title: The UV-to-FIR environments of nearby Type Ia supernovae with the DustPedia Galaxy Catalogue -- I. Local versus global host properties
papers.abstract: The ongoing use of Type Ia Supernovae (SNe Ia) as standardisable candles relies on an additional correction for the relationship between their standardised brightnesses and host galaxy properties. Currently, this correction is built on host stellar mass, typically derived from optical-only SED fitting, which recent analyses suggest may not fully capture the underlying environmental properties. This relationship is stronger when considering the regions closest to the SNe, rather than the galaxies as a whole. I use a sample of SNe Ia in DustPedia galaxies and \texttt{CIGALE} SED fitting to compare the local environments of 90 nearby SNe Ia against the global properties of their hosts. The UV-to-FIR coverage of DustPedia enables improved dust constraints, and helps break the age-dust degeneracy that limits optical-only studies; to my knowledge this coverage has not been previously applied to the sub-galactic regions around SNe Ia. Stellar mass and dust mass are lower locally simply because the aperture encloses less of the galaxy; however, for colour, sSFR, and dust attenuation, local values differ from the host average by more than measurement uncertainty alone allows, with attenuation showing the strongest discrepancy ($p=6.3\times10^{-5}$). Only mass-weighted age is consistent locally and globally. Galaxy-integrated properties therefore do not capture the true conditions at the SN location. SN siblings (sharing a host galaxy) only emphasise this effect. Siblings sampling the same galaxy structure, such as two SNe in spiral arms, have consistent environments, whilst others diverge. Standardising on global properties may therefore mask the differences that drive the brightness-environment relationship.

papers.title: Limits on the Inferred Hubble Constant Bias from a Local McVittie Gravitational Field
papers.abstract: We examine the exact propagation of light in a McVittie spacetime to quantify the observational bias introduced on the inferred Hubble constant $H_0$ by a localized central mass embedded in an expanding asymptotically de Sitter background. By integrating the Sachs optical equations for radial null geodesics, we derive linearized analytical expressions for the areal and luminosity distances to first order in the dimensionless Hawking-Hayward coupling parameter $μ= H_{\text{dS}} m_H$. We evaluate the magnitude of this local gravitational field effect across realistic astrophysical scales, ranging from supermassive black holes ($\text{Sgr A}^*$) to galaxy cluster halos. We show that while a McVittie central mass induces a coordinate-invariant path-focusing effect on incoming photons, the quantitative correction for local galactic parameters ($μ\sim 10^{-16}$) is negligible ($\sim 10^{-15}\%$), proving that a localized galactic mass alone cannot resolve the $\sim 8\%$ Hubble tension. We establish strict upper bounds on the extent to which local spacetime inhomogeneity can bias low-redshift distance ladder measurements.

analysis.title_zh: 局域 McVittie 引力场对推断哈勃常数偏差的限制
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在渐近 de Sitter 膨胀背景中的 McVittie 时空里，通过积分径向零测地线的 Sachs 光学方程，推导中心质量对面积距离和光度距离的一阶修正，并据此评估推断 H₀ 的偏差。摘要报告称，该聚焦效应虽具有坐标不变性，但对局域星系参数仅产生可忽略的修正，因此局域星系质量本身不能解决哈勃张力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 低红移距离阶梯给出的 H₀ 是哈勃张力的一端，而 CMB 在给定宇宙学模型下提供早期宇宙推断的 H₀；因此，检验局域引力场是否系统性偏置距离阶梯，是判断张力来自局域环境、观测系统误差还是新宇宙学物理的重要环节。该文摘要所述结果限制了一类由单个局域球对称质量造成的解释，但并不直接检验 CMB 数据，也不能仅凭摘要排除更复杂的局域非均匀性。
key_points: 在 McVittie 时空中计算局域中心质量对光传播和距离测量的影响。
中心质量会产生坐标不变的光路聚焦效应，但在局域星系参数下极其微弱。
摘要结论是：单个局域星系质量无法解释约 8% 的哈勃张力。
methods: McVittie 时空中的径向零测地线
Sachs 光学方程的积分
以 Hawking–Hayward 耦合参数 μ=H_dS m_H 为小参数的一阶线性化解析推导
从 Sgr A* 到星系团晕的天体物理尺度评估
低红移距离阶梯偏差的上限估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对一阶 μ 展开的适用范围、观测者与光源的定义及边界条件，以及从单个球对称中心质量推广到真实局域宇宙非球对称、多结构环境是否成立；还需检查其“严格上限”依赖哪些质量分布和距离阶梯假设。

papers.title: Cosmological information from field-level analysis in redshift space
papers.abstract: The field-level analysis of galaxy clustering with a forward model based on the Effective Field Theory of Large Scale structure provides cosmological measurements at optimal statistical precision which are simultaneously robust with respect to theoretical uncertainties regarding galaxy formation. Yet, the quantitative gains of field-level analysis in the perturbative regime over the current state-of-the-art, set by the combination of power- and bispectrum, are not obvious, and they depend on analysis choices, the cosmological model, and the observed galaxy population. We therefore quantify the precision improvement from field-level analysis over power- and bispectrum from redshift-space snapshots that closely resemble the DESI LRG sample. Our mock data are created with the LEFTfield forward model, which we also use for the subsequent field-level analysis and for a Fisher forecast of the power- and bispectrum precision. We find significant improvements from the field-level analysis over the power- and bispectrum for a $Λ$CDM cosmology; in particular the primordial fluctuation amplitude can be measured twice as precisely. Precision gains at the field-level are even more pronounced for extended cosmologies with a more flexible dependence between power spectrum shape and structure growth; they reach up to a factor of three in the primordial amplitude and a factor of two in parameters that capture deviations from $Λ$CDM. Our results highlight the potential of field-level analysis for future discoveries. Realizing this potential will require substantial developments on the modeling of observations and observational systematics as well as on the numerical inference techniques.

analysis.title_zh: 红移空间场级分析中的宇宙学信息
analysis.summary_zh: 本文使用 LEFTfield 构造近似 DESI 亮红星系样本的红移空间模拟快照，并比较基于大尺度结构有效场论的场级分析与功率谱加双谱 Fisher 预报。摘要报告，在 ΛCDM 中场级分析可将原初涨落振幅的测量精度提高约一倍，在扩展宇宙学中部分参数的精度增益可达摘要所述的二至三倍。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作关注如何从星系大尺度结构中更充分地提取宇宙学信息，可为 CMB 对原初涨落振幅、功率谱形状及 ΛCDM 扩展参数的约束提供低红移互补。场级推断若能可靠处理真实观测效应，还有助于联合 CMB 与 DESI 类巡天区分原初条件、结构增长和星系偏置之间的退化。
key_points: 比较红移空间场级分析与功率谱加双谱的参数约束精度。
模拟数据近似 DESI LRG 样本，并由 LEFTfield 前向模型生成和分析。
摘要报告：场级分析在 ΛCDM 及扩展宇宙学中均可明显提高参数测量精度。
methods: 基于大尺度结构有效场论的场级前向建模
LEFTfield 前向模型
近似 DESI LRG 样本的红移空间快照模拟数据
功率谱与双谱的 Fisher 预报
ΛCDM 与扩展宇宙学参数约束比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对比较是否采用一致的尺度截断、参数先验、偏置与随机项处理，以及用同一 LEFTfield 模型生成并拟合模拟数据是否使场级分析处于理想化的“模型匹配”条件；还需检查观测效应和系统误差尚未纳入时，所报精度增益能否外推至真实巡天。

papers.title: Probing multi-state dark matter via optical absorption lines in DESI spectra
papers.abstract: We search for dark matter through absorption lines imprinted on the spectra of background sources whose sightlines pass through foreground dark matter halos. Such a line is a generic feature of multi-state dark matter models that couple to photons through higher-order electromagnetic moments. We focus on the minimal case of a two-state system with a magnetic dipole transition, in which the ground state absorbs a photon and makes a transition to the excited state. For transition energy $ΔE \sim O \,(\text{eV})$, the line falls in the optical band, within reach of spectroscopic surveys such as DESI. Stacking 145,087 spectra of DESI Early Data Release objects paired with foreground GAMA galaxy groups, we find a stacked optical depth consistent with zero and place $2σ$ upper limits on the magnetic dipole transition cross-section. The limits are strongest at $ΔE \sim$ 3-5 eV for a few MeV dark matter mass in the parameter space that is inaccessible to both cosmological (BBN+CMB) and direct detection experiments. We forecast that the full DESI and the next-generation spectroscopic surveys will tighten these limits by more than an order of magnitude, establishing spectroscopic stacking as a competitive probe of electromagnetically interacting multi-state dark matter.

analysis.title_zh: 利用DESI光谱中的光学吸收线探测多态暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 论文在两态暗物质的磁偶极跃迁模型下，利用前景GAMA星系群与背景DESI光谱配对，叠加145,087条光谱以搜索eV量级跃迁产生的光学吸收线。摘要报告叠加光学深度与零一致，并给出磁偶极跃迁截面的2σ上限；最强限制位于约3–5 eV跃迁能量和数MeV暗物质质量附近。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作并非直接分析CMB，而是以低红移光谱吸收线补充BBN、CMB和直接探测对电磁相互作用暗物质的约束。摘要特别指出，其最强限制覆盖了一部分现有BBN+CMB约束和直接探测均难以触及的参数空间，因此有助于扩展暗物质微观性质的宇宙学检验范围；摘要没有报告与再电离或CMB前景去除有关的具体分析。
key_points: 在前景暗物质晕后的背景源光谱中搜寻暗物质吸收线。
叠加145,087条DESI早期数据发布光谱后，光学深度与零一致。
研究对磁偶极跃迁截面给出2σ上限，并预计未来巡天可将限制收紧一个数量级以上。
methods: 两态暗物质及磁偶极跃迁模型
DESI Early Data Release光谱
GAMA星系群目录
背景源与前景星系群视线配对
145,087条光谱的叠加分析
磁偶极跃迁截面的2σ上限估计
完整DESI及下一代光谱巡天的灵敏度预测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对叠加光学深度的构造与归一化、前景星系群暗物质柱密度及速度展宽的建模、连续谱与仪器系统误差的处理，以及试探不同跃迁能量时的多重检验问题。还需确认所谓BBN+CMB不可及参数区的边界依赖哪些宇宙学假设，以及未来灵敏度提升预测采用了怎样的样本量和系统误差缩放。

papers.title: Bridging Between Statistical Mechanics and Black Hole Evolution: Theoretical Formalism
papers.abstract: Black holes in the Universe span nearly ten orders of magnitude in mass over a large cosmic timescale, dating back to at least the Universe's early history, when it was only a few hundred million years old. The formation and evolution of these objects remain a mystery because no direct probe can trace each black hole across the full mass range and cosmic time. This work shows, for the first time, a statistical mechanical description of black hole evolution. I show that though each black hole and its evolution are governed by stochastic processes, one can make a macroscopic description of the distribution function of black holes in the Universe, and its evolution over the entire mass range and cosmic time can be expressed in terms of the Kramers-Moyal expansion. This bridging between statistical mechanics and black hole evolution in terms of the Kramers-Moyal expansion enables the discovery of the underlying physical processes that play a role in the evolution of black holes. In the future, the application of this technique to data accessible from different messengers, such as gravitational waves and electromagnetic waves, which probe black holes in the Universe, can lead to a data-driven understanding of the underlying physical processes by this statistical mechanics technique despite the ignorance of the underlying microscopic stochastic processes.

papers.title: Right Energy, Wrong Profile: Why the 43 GeV Cluster Line Is Unlikely to Be Dark Matter
papers.abstract: A narrow gamma-ray line would be a distinctive signature of dark matter, but its interpretation depends as much on its spatial distribution as on its energy. We reanalyze the reported 43 GeV feature in Fermi-LAT observations of Virgo, Fornax, and Ophiuchus. The excess is reproduced in the same public data and survives event-type partitions, a test using data withheld from the original selection, and detector-coordinate permutation tests. Realistic hadronic and inverse-Compton emission is too broad to explain it. A spatial--spectral likelihood analysis restricted to Good Time Intervals and including diffuse backgrounds and catalogued sources finds a broad line-like component. Uniform surface brightness and substructure-enhanced annihilation are preferred, whereas smooth NFW annihilation and a central point source are unlikely explanations. An independent annular analysis agrees: the events associated with the excess extend through much of the virial region. Calibration over 20--70 GeV and five morphologies gives a conditional global significance of approximately $2.7σ$, peaking at 44.5 GeV for uniform brightness. This result is conditional on the preselected three-cluster sample. The broad morphology is the main obstacle to a dark-matter interpretation. Such an interpretation would require photons to be a leading annihilation channel, annihilation to remain efficient in cold subhalos, and subhalos to supply nearly all the cluster luminosity. Yet a boost consistent with $Λ$CDM drives the required two-photon cross section into the range most tightly constrained by Galactic-halo line limits. The most likely explanation is a chance fluctuation amplified by analysis and target-selection effects, possibly compounded by residual Galactic diffuse or unresolved-source mismodeling; if celestial, its morphology makes a simple dark-matter interpretation unlikely.

analysis.title_zh: 能量对了，轮廓错了：为何星系团的 43 GeV 谱线不太可能来自暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 论文重新分析 Fermi-LAT 在三个星系团方向报告的约 43 GeV 伽马射线特征，结合稳健性检验、空间-能谱似然和环带分析评估其真实性与空间形态。摘要报告该特征在预选样本条件下仍有约 2.7σ 的全局显著性，但其辐射广泛延伸至维里区域，不符合平滑 NFW 湮灭或中心点源预期，因此作者认为统计涨落或背景失配比简单暗物质解释更可能。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作检验了间接暗物质搜寻中的候选伽马射线谱线，并把能谱异常与暗物质晕及子结构的空间分布联系起来。它与 CMB 的联系主要是互补性的：CMB 可约束暗物质湮灭造成的早期宇宙能量注入，而星系团和银河系伽马射线观测探测晚期宇宙中的湮灭信号；对湮灭截面、速度依赖和子晕增强的联合理解有助于判断粒子暗物质模型是否同时兼容这些观测。
key_points: 作者在公开的 Fermi-LAT 数据中复现了约 43 GeV 的线状超出，并进行了事件类型划分、留出数据和探测器坐标置换等检验。
空间分析显示相关事件广泛分布于星系团维里区域，均匀面亮度或子结构增强湮灭形态比平滑 NFW 形态和中心点源更受偏好。
摘要认为宽广的空间形态及其他伽马射线限制使简单暗物质解释难以成立，最可能的原因是受分析和目标选择效应放大的统计涨落，并可能叠加背景建模残差。
methods: Fermi-LAT 对室女座、天炉座和蛇夫座星系团的公开观测数据
事件类型划分、原始筛选未使用数据的留出检验、探测器坐标置换检验
限制于 Good Time Intervals，并纳入弥散背景和已编目源的空间-能谱似然分析
独立环带分析
在 20–70 GeV 能区及五种空间形态上的校准与条件全局显著性评估
强子辐射和逆康普顿辐射模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对条件全局显著性的试验因子如何定义，尤其是预先选定三个星系团所引入的目标选择效应是否被充分计入；还应检查五种空间模板、弥散背景与未分辨源模型的选择对形态偏好的稳健性，以及由子结构增强推导暗物质湮灭截面约束时采用的假设。

papers.title: Gravitational Wave Bias in IllustrisTNG300 from Machine-Learned Population-Synthesis Calibrated Merger Rates
papers.abstract: The large scale clustering of gravitational wave (GW) sources offers an independent probe of cosmology and compact-binary astrophysics. Interpreting future GW clustering measurements requires understanding how merger rates depend on host-galaxy properties and environment. We develop a simulation-based framework to model the clustering of binary black hole (BBH) mergers and estimate the corresponding GW bias. We populate IllustrisTNG300 with GW sources using a machine-learning emulator trained on the GALAXYRATE data set, which provides population-synthesis calibrated merger rates linked to galaxy formation histories. This enables physically motivated mock GW catalogs with galaxy-specific BBH merger rates that depend on stellar mass, star formation rate, metallicity, and redshift. We compare this framework to a simpler phenomenological model in which the merger rate depends only on stellar mass. In both approaches, GW sources are more strongly biased than the overall galaxy population, reflecting the preference for BBH mergers to occur in more massive, more strongly clustered halos. The machine-learned model also produces stronger scale dependence in the GW bias than stellar-mass weighting alone, indicating that additional host properties affect GW clustering. We further find that metallicity correlates positively with both GW and galaxy bias. These results highlight the importance of physically motivated merger rate models for GW large scale structure analyses and provide a framework for interpreting future clustering measurements from experiments such as the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer.

papers.title: Peering Beyond the Veil of Last Scattering: A View of the Universe with CMB Spectral Distortions
papers.abstract: The frequency spectrum of the cosmic microwave background is the most precise blackbody ever measured in nature, with deviations constrained at the level of almost one part per million from the COBE satellite. Nevertheless, departures away from a perfect blackbody are present in standard $Λ$CDM cosmology, lurking just beneath the surface of our current observational bounds. These spectral distortions provide invaluable information on our thermal history in both the post- and pre-recombination epochs, allowing us to peer beyond last scattering and into the primordial Universe. Here, we present an overview of the underlying physics responsible for generating CMB spectral distortions at all epochs. As an illustration of this rich physics, we review a comprehensive set of mechanisms capable of generating distortions both within and beyond the standard $Λ$CDM paradigm. We also discuss the information that can be gleaned by going beyond the monopole (sky-averaged) spectrum and exploiting the spatial information present in anisotropic spectral distortions. To supplement our discussion of the diverse science of spectral distortions, we provide an overview of the upcoming and proposed experimental landscape. We highlight that the combination of the TMS, COSMO, and BISOU experiments will provide the first discovery of a monopole $y$-type distortion within the coming decade. From space, the proposed FOSSIL experiment is forecasted to improve upon the original COBE/FIRAS measurement by roughly three orders of magnitude in sensitivity, bringing with it the detection of the $Λ$CDM $μ$-type distortion sourced by the dissipation of small scale acoustic modes in the pre-recombination plasma. With transformational measurements on the horizon, CMB spectral distortions offer a uniquely sensitive probe of the thermal history of the Universe at redshifts $z \lesssim 2 \times 10^6$.

analysis.title_zh: 窥探末次散射帷幕之外：以 CMB 频谱畸变观测宇宙
analysis.summary_zh: 本文综述从再组合前到晚期宇宙产生 CMB 频谱畸变的物理机制，并涵盖标准 ΛCDM 内外的来源、各向异性畸变以及未来实验。摘要指出，TMS、COSMO 与 BISOU 的组合有望首次发现单极 y 型畸变，而拟议中的 FOSSIL 预计将较 COBE/FIRAS 提升约三个数量级的灵敏度，从而探测由再组合前小尺度声学模耗散产生的 ΛCDM μ 型畸变。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 频谱畸变保留了仅靠温度和偏振各向异性难以获得的热历史信息，可把观测窗口延伸到末次散射之前，并检验小尺度原初扰动、能量注入及其他标准模型内外过程。本文同时连接频谱畸变理论、空间各向异性与实验路线，对评估下一代 CMB 频谱测量的科学目标和系统误差要求具有直接参考价值。
key_points: 系统梳理各宇宙时期产生 CMB 频谱畸变的物理机制。
讨论单极频谱及具有空间信息的各向异性频谱畸变。
摘要预计未来实验将探测标准宇宙学中的 y 型和 μ 型畸变。
methods: 综述 CMB 频谱畸变在不同宇宙时期的产生机制
汇总标准 ΛCDM 内外可产生频谱畸变的物理过程
讨论各向异性频谱畸变所含的空间信息
评述 TMS、COSMO、BISOU 和 FOSSIL 等实验及其预期灵敏度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对各实验灵敏度预测所采用的前景模型、系统误差与联合分析假设，并区分对 y 型、μ 型畸变的“发现”或“探测”预期究竟来自已批准实验还是仍处于提案阶段的任务；还需检查各向异性频谱畸变的可观测量与单极测量之间如何互补。

papers.title: FOSSIL: A future mission for CMB spectral distortion measurements
papers.abstract: We present FOSSIL, a proposed space mission which is designed to deliver unprecedented absolute spectroscopic measurements of the sky intensity over a broad frequency range (50GHz to 2THz) to accurately measure chemical-potential mu-type, Compton y-type, and Compton relativistic y-type CMB spectral distortions. FOSSIL will reach monopole sensitivities representing a gain of roughly three orders of magnitude over COBE/FIRAS. These capabilities will allow us to constrain primordial density fluctuations on scales k~(10 to 10^4)Mpc^-1, test inflationary models, probe dark matter annihilation/decay/interactions, constrain primordial black hole seed scenarios, and pin down feedback models in galaxy evolution and structure formation by measuring the cosmic thermal energy content. Furthermore, its 130 spectral channels will enable legacy astrophysics, including precise characterisation of the Cosmic Infrared Background, line intensity mapping during cosmic noon, and detailed Galactic dust mapping.

analysis.title_zh: FOSSIL：一项测量 CMB 光谱畸变的未来任务
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 FOSSIL，一项拟议中的空间任务，计划在 50 GHz 至 2 THz 范围内对天空强度进行绝对光谱测量，以测量 μ 型、Compton y 型和相对论性 Compton y 型 CMB 光谱畸变。摘要称其单极灵敏度相较 COBE/FIRAS 约提升三个数量级，从而可研究小尺度原初密度涨落、暴胀、暗物质、原初黑洞及星系演化反馈，并开展宇宙红外背景、宇宙正午线强度制图和银河系尘埃研究。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 光谱畸变提供了温度各向同性之外的宇宙热历史信息，可连接早期宇宙能量注入、原初密度涨落的小尺度性质、暗物质过程和结构形成反馈。FOSSIL 的宽频绝对光谱能力若能达到摘要所述灵敏度，将补充传统 CMB 温度与偏振观测，尤其探测 COBE/FIRAS 之后尚未充分测量的微弱单极光谱畸变；其多波段数据还具有前景天体物理和星系演化研究价值。
key_points: 提出覆盖 50 GHz 至 2 THz、包含 130 个光谱通道的 FOSSIL 空间任务。
目标是测量 μ 型、Compton y 型和相对论性 Compton y 型 CMB 光谱畸变，并将单极灵敏度较 COBE/FIRAS 提升约三个数量级。
科学应用涵盖小尺度原初密度涨落、暴胀、暗物质、原初黑洞以及星系演化中的热反馈。
methods: 空间任务方案设计
天空强度的绝对光谱测量
50 GHz 至 2 THz 的宽频观测
130 个光谱通道
对 μ 型、Compton y 型和相对论性 Compton y 型 CMB 光谱畸变进行测量
利用光谱畸变约束原初密度涨落、暗物质模型和原初黑洞种子情景
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对任务的仪器设计、绝对标定方案、前景分离与系统误差预算，以及“较 COBE/FIRAS 提升约三个数量级”的灵敏度定义和适用频段；还需确认这些灵敏度如何具体转化为对不同尺度原初功率谱、暗物质相互作用和原初黑洞情景的约束。摘要列出多项科学目标，但未说明各目标的定量预测或探测显著性。

papers.title: CMB-HD Foregrounds: Simulations, Source Detection, and Foreground Removal
papers.abstract: We present simulations of the microwave sky at 2.5 arcsecond resolution over 100 square degrees, generated from existing full-sky, lower-resolution simulations, and use them to demonstrate extragalactic foreground removal for a CMB-HD survey. Our cleaning method detects and removes the cosmic infrared background and radio galaxies, yielding source catalogs that are 95% complete down to flux limits of 0.008 and 0.04 mJy at 90 and 148 GHz, respectively. It also identifies and removes galaxy clusters via the thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect, producing a cluster sample that is nearly complete above $M_{500c} = 5 \times 10^{13} M_\odot$. After cleaning, the residual foreground-plus-noise power spectrum of the coadded 90 and 148 GHz temperature map is 50% higher than previous idealized estimates, increasing cosmological parameter uncertainties for an 11-parameter $Λ$CDM + $N_\mathrm{eff}$ + $\sum m_ν$ + $T_\mathrm{AGN}$ + $A_\mathrm{kSZ}$ + $n_\mathrm{kSZ}$ model by less than 7%. The small impact on cosmological parameters reflects the strong constraining power of CMB polarization, the temperature-polarization cross spectra, and CMB lensing spectra reconstructed from polarization-only estimators, all of which are minimally affected by extragalactic foregrounds. In particular, the survey remains a sensitive probe of light thermal relic particles, achieving $σ(N_\mathrm{eff}) = 0.0154$, which can exclude any new species ($ΔN_\mathrm{eff} \ge 0.027$) with at least 90% confidence. Our simulation and foreground-removal codes are publicly available and should aid the development of analysis pipelines for ultradeep, ultrahigh-resolution microwave surveys.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 19 figures, 8 tables. The simulations are available at https://lambda.gsfc.nasa.gov/simulation/ultrahigh_resolution_sims.html , the simulation code is available at https://github.com/CMB-HD/hdsims , and the foreground cleaning code is available at https://github.com/CMB-HD/hdfgclean

analysis.title_zh: CMB-HD 前景：模拟、源探测与前景去除
analysis.summary_zh: 论文面向 CMB-HD，构建覆盖 100 平方度、分辨率达 2.5 角秒的微波天空模拟，并通过源探测及热 SZ 识别清除宇宙红外背景源、射电星系和星系团。摘要报告清理后的温度图残余前景加噪声功率比既有理想化估计高 50%，但对所考虑的 11 参数模型的宇宙学参数不确定度增幅低于 7%，且对轻热遗迹粒子的灵敏度仍然较高。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB-HD 的超高分辨率和超深观测会使河外点源、宇宙红外背景及热 SZ 星系团成为小尺度温度各向异性分析的关键限制因素。该工作直接评估较现实的前景清理残余如何传递到 CMB 功率谱、透镜重建和参数约束，并强调偏振、温度-偏振交叉谱及仅偏振透镜估计量在抑制河外前景影响方面的重要性；其公开模拟与清理代码也可用于未来高分辨率 CMB 分析流程的开发和验证。
key_points: 构建了覆盖 100 平方度、角分辨率为 2.5 角秒的微波天空模拟。
通过源探测与热 SZ 星系团识别去除主要河外前景，并生成相应源表和星系团样本。
清理后残余功率高于理想化估计，但摘要报告其对多参数宇宙学约束的影响有限。
methods: 基于已有全天低分辨率模拟生成高分辨率微波天空模拟
宇宙红外背景源与射电星系的探测、编目和去除
利用热 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 效应识别并去除星系团
90 与 148 GHz 温度图联合及残余前景加噪声功率谱估计
对 11 参数宇宙学模型进行参数预报
使用偏振、温度-偏振交叉功率谱及仅偏振估计量重建的 CMB 透镜谱
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对高分辨率模拟由低分辨率全天模拟生成的具体方法及其是否保留了小尺度源的聚集性和频率相关性；同时检查源完备度、星系团选择函数和残余功率谱的定义，以及参数预报对前景模型、频率覆盖、偏振系统误差和透镜重建假设的敏感性。
