papers.title: Population III Host Candidates at $z\sim2$: Strong He II $\lambda1640$ and Absent UV Metal Lines in HETDEX Ly$α$ Emitters
papers.abstract: Population III (Pop III) stars are expected to produce extremely hard ionizing spectra, yet direct evidence for their signature--strong narrow He II $\lambda1640$ emission with weak or absent metal lines--remains elusive. Although Pop III formation peaks at $z\gtrsim10$, models predict that nearly pristine gas pockets can survive to later times, making intermediate-redshift searches a probe of metal mixing across cosmic time. We search 109,545 high-confidence Ly$α$-emitting galaxies at $1.9<z<2.3$ in the Hobby--Eberly Telescope Dark Energy Experiment's database for systems with strong He II $\lambda1640$ and no detected UV metal lines, recovering eight candidates and a first-order, tentative comoving number density of $\sim30$ Gpc$^{-3}$. The eight-object stack yields a rest-frame He II equivalent width of $28.7\pm6.7$ Angstrom, He II/Ly$α=0.354\pm0.094$, and a resolution-corrected He II FWHM of $449\pm105$ km s$^{-1}$. We find no significant N V, C IV, or O III] emission; using the He II width to set the scale, we derive $3σ$ upper limits of N V/He II $<0.167$, C IV/He II $<0.128$, and O III]/He II $<0.140$. This combination of strong He II, elevated He II/Ly$α$, moderate line width, and weak metal lines is difficult to reproduce with metal-enriched stellar populations, AGN narrow-line regions, shocks, or classical Wolf--Rayet features. We interpret the sample as candidates for very metal-poor or Pop III-like ionizing sources at $z\sim2$. Definitive confirmation requires deeper rest-UV spectroscopy to measure He II and metal-line limits in individual objects, followed by rest-optical spectroscopy of H$β$, [O III] $\lambda4959,\lambda5007$, [O II] $\lambda3727$, and H$α$ to constrain gas-phase metallicity, ionization conditions, and AGN activity.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal

analysis.title_zh: z∼2的星族III宿主候选体：HETDEX Lyα发射星系中的强He II λ1640与缺失的紫外金属线
analysis.summary_zh: 作者在HETDEX的109,545个z=1.9–2.3高置信度Lyα发射星系中搜索强窄He II λ1640且缺乏紫外金属线的系统，筛得8个候选体并分析其叠加光谱。摘要报告叠加谱具有较强He II、较高He II/Lyα和未显著探测到N V、C IV、O III]等特征，因而将这些天体解释为极贫金属或类星族III电离源候选体，而非已获确认的星族III宿主。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作与CMB观测没有直接的数据联系，但星族III恒星及早期金属富集关系到再电离史、紫外光子产生效率和高红移电离源建模，而这些因素会影响CMB对再电离光学深度及相关二次各向异性的解释。在z∼2寻找残存的近原初气体还可检验跨宇宙时间尺度的金属混合模型，为外推到CMB所探测的早期宇宙提供低红移约束。
key_points: 从109,545个高置信度Lyα发射星系中筛得8个强He II且未探测到紫外金属线的候选体。
叠加光谱显示较强的He II λ1640，并对N V、C IV和O III]相对He II的强度给出上限。
作者将其解释为极贫金属或类星族III电离源候选体，但明确指出仍需更深光谱确认。
methods: 检索HETDEX数据库中1.9<z<2.3的109,545个高置信度Lyα发射星系
按强He II λ1640发射且无紫外金属线探测的条件筛选候选体
对8个候选体进行叠加光谱分析
测量He II等效宽度、He II/Lyα比值及经分辨率校正的线宽
利用He II线宽设定尺度，估计N V、C IV和O III]发射的3σ上限
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对候选体筛选函数、假阳性与谱线误认率、叠加及上限计算方式，以及样本完备性如何影响暂定数密度；还应检查现有数据排除AGN、激波、沃尔夫-拉叶星和普通贫金属恒星族的力度，尤其是叠加结果能否代表每个单体。

papers.title: A Dark-matter Origin of Little Red Dots: Early Seeding and Super-Bondi Accretion
papers.abstract: The "Little red dots" (LRDs) are a population of accreting supermassive black holes (SMBHs) in the early Universe which often exhibit undermassive or even undetectable stellar hosts. Their early emergence, high space density, and extremely large black-hole-to-stellar mass ratios pose a serious challenge to conventional seeding scenarios that rely on baryon for both the formation and growth of black holes. Here we demonstrate that the above anomalies can be naturally resolved if dark matter is self-interacting. We apply a fully relativistic, non-equilibrium halo-evolution model, first developed in our earlier work, to trace the complete gravothermal evolution of self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) halos, from the initial collapse into BH seeds to the subsequent accretion of dark matter. We find that in highly concentrated halos assembled before reionization, gravothermal collapse efficiently produces stellar-mass black-hole seeds within a few hundred million years. Remarkably, and contrary to standard expectations for dark-matter accretion, heat conduction in SIDM then sustains a prolonged super-Bondi inflow that drives these seeds to supermassive scale by the LRD epoch, without baryonic assistance. The halo conditions required for completing these processes, together with the probability of avoiding major mergers that disrupt gravothermal evolution, result in an SMBH population consistent with the observed abundance and redshift distribution of LRDs. Our findings establish a pathway in which SMBHs are seeded and assembled primarily from dark matter, well before substantial galaxies form around them, thereby offering both a compelling physical explanation for LRDs and a new observational probe of dark-matter microphysics.

analysis.title_zh: 小红点的暗物质起源：早期播种与超邦迪吸积
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用全相对论、非平衡暗晕演化模型追踪自相互作用暗物质晕从引力热坍缩形成黑洞种子，到通过暗物质继续吸积的全过程。摘要报告，在再电离前形成的高浓度暗晕中，SIDM 热传导可维持长期超邦迪流入，使恒星质量黑洞种子无需重子协助便在 LRD 时期前增长至超大质量尺度，并产生与 LRD 丰度和红移分布相符的种群。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把早期超大质量黑洞的形成与自相互作用暗物质的微观性质直接联系起来，为利用高红移 LRD 检验暗物质模型提供了路径。它与 CMB 的联系主要是间接的：模型要求暗晕在再电离前较早形成，并可能改变早期黑洞辐射、宿主形成及再电离历史；这些过程原则上可影响 CMB 对再电离光学深度和次级各向异性的解释，但摘要并未计算任何 CMB 信号或给出相应约束。
key_points: 以自相互作用暗物质晕的引力热坍缩形成早期黑洞种子。
摘要称，SIDM 的热传导可维持超邦迪暗物质流入，使种子在无需重子协助的情况下增长至超大质量尺度。
模型结合所需暗晕条件与避免破坏性大并合的概率，得到与 LRD 观测丰度及红移分布相符的 SMBH 种群。
methods: 全相对论、非平衡暗晕演化模型
自相互作用暗物质晕的完整引力热演化追踪
黑洞形成后的暗物质吸积建模
对再电离前形成的高浓度暗晕进行分析
纳入避免大并合、维持引力热演化的概率
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对：所谓“超邦迪”流入在全相对论非平衡模型中的定义、能量输运机制与适用边界；结果对 SIDM 微观参数、初始晕浓度及形成红移的敏感性；大并合中断概率和 LRD 选择函数如何进入丰度比较；以及该情景是否同时满足现有暗物质、自相互作用、黑洞增长和再电离约束。摘要未给出这些检验的具体数值。

papers.title: Dark Radiation Sticks Together: Dark QCD and the Hubble Tension
papers.abstract: We introduce a model of dark matter charged under a new confining gauge group akin to the Standard Model's quantum chromodynamics (QCD). The fermionic sector contains both heavy and light quark-like fermions charged under the dark QCD. As the Universe cools, the gauge force confines and dark radiation transitions from free particles to low-mass dark pions. This form of dark radiation behaves as an imperfect fluid with nonzero viscosity. If the confinement occurs at the MeV scale, the model can alleviate the tension between early- and late-time measurements of the Hubble parameter, with a Bayesian posterior of $H_0 = 71.60\pm 0.63$ km/s/Mpc and a $3σ$ residual tension across Planck, ACT, BBN, Pantheon+, DESI DR2, and SH0ES. In the late Universe, the heavy dark matter can evade existing constraints on dark matter self-interactions while containing a rich phenomenology that may be accessible in future observations.

analysis.title_zh: 暗辐射凝聚成团：暗QCD与Hubble张力
analysis.summary_zh: 论文提出一种含重、轻类夸克的新暗QCD模型，研究宇宙冷却时暗辐射在规范禁闭后转化为低质量暗π子，并以具有非零黏性的非理想流体描述其效应。摘要报告，在禁闭发生于MeV尺度时，该模型可将联合数据下的H_0后验推至71.60±0.63 km/s/Mpc，并缓解但未完全消除早晚期Hubble参数测量之间的张力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接涉及CMB所探测的早期宇宙辐射成分、声学尺度和扰动演化，并尝试通过具有时间演化和流体黏性的暗辐射解释Hubble张力。它还把CMB、BBN、超新星、星系巡天和局域H_0测量放在同一联合分析中；若模型的微观暗QCD动力学与宇宙学有效描述一致，可能为暗物质自相互作用和暗辐射观测信号提供新的联系。
key_points: 提出含重、轻类夸克的暗QCD模型，使暗辐射在MeV尺度禁闭后转化为低质量暗π子。
禁闭后的暗辐射表现为具有非零黏性的非理想流体，从而改变早期宇宙中的辐射成分演化。
摘要报告该模型可缓解Hubble张力，但在联合数据下仍存在3σ残余张力。
methods: 构建带有新禁闭规范群的暗物质与暗辐射模型。
分析宇宙冷却过程中暗QCD禁闭及暗辐射由自由粒子向低质量暗π子的转变。
将暗辐射视为具有非零黏性的非理想流体。
使用Planck、ACT、BBN、Pantheon+、DESI DR2和SH0ES数据进行联合贝叶斯分析。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对暗QCD禁闭和暗π子流体的有效扰动方程如何实现、黏性参数是否由微观模型自洽决定，以及联合数据分析中的先验、参数退化和各数据集对H_0后验的具体贡献。还需确认MeV尺度禁闭是否满足BBN、CMB和暗物质自相互作用等约束，以及摘要所称3σ残余张力的定义。

papers.title: Less isn't more: Cosmological bounds on the neutrino masses are robust to changes in the neutrino abundance
papers.abstract: We investigate how neutrino-mass constraints from cosmology depend on the assumed thermal history of the universe. Photon injection after neutrino decoupling would decrease the neutrino abundance inferred from the temperature of the cosmic microwave background (CMB), potentially loosening the upper limit on their masses. We first evaluate how the cosmological neutrino-mass bound is altered by the decay of massive particles into photons and dark radiation after Big Bang nucleosynthesis. To test the robustness of this constraint more generally, we also assess the impact of varying the temperature of the cosmic neutrino background without assuming a specific physical mechanism. We perform MCMC analyses of both frameworks with primary CMB observations from Planck, CMB lensing measurements from Planck and ACT, and baryon acoustic oscillation data from DESI. For the degenerate mass ordering, the $95\%$ credible limit tightens from $\sum m_ν<0.0691$ eV in a standard thermal history to $\sum m_ν<0.0652$ eV if the massive particles decay only into photons, while the injection of dark radiation in addition to photons slightly relaxes this limit to $\sum m_ν<0.0710$ eV. The same pattern holds for the normal and inverted orderings, and the decay scenario shifts the bound on the sum of the neutrino masses by at most $0.004$ eV for fixed mass splittings. Allowing model-agnostic changes in the neutrino-to-photon ratio yields a $95\%$ credible limit of $\sum m_ν<0.0724$ eV for the degenerate ordering, indicating that the stringency of our neutrino-mass bounds is not driven by constraints on the decay scenario. We find that the neutrino temperature and the sum of the neutrino masses are positively correlated, which implies that reducing the pre-recombination radiation density will only worsen the emerging tension between cosmological bounds on the neutrino masses and the measured mass splittings.
papers.comment: 16 pages plus 8 pages of appendices and references; 15 figures; 9 tables

analysis.title_zh: 少并非多：宇宙学对中微子质量的限制对中微子丰度变化具有稳健性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究宇宙学中微子质量约束是否依赖标准热历史，分别分析大爆炸核合成后重粒子向光子和暗辐射衰变的模型，以及自由改变宇宙中微子背景温度的模型，并用 Planck、ACT 和 DESI 数据进行 MCMC。摘要报告这些扩展仅使中微子质量和的 95% 可信上限小幅变化：简并质量排序下由标准情景的 0.0691 eV 变为 0.0652–0.0724 eV，且中微子温度与质量和正相关。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对中微子质量的限制依赖早期辐射密度、复合前膨胀史及后期结构增长，因此非标准的中微子—光子温度比可能系统性改变质量上限。该摘要表明，加入 CMB 原初各向异性、CMB 透镜和 BAO 后，质量约束对所考察的中微子丰度变化仍较稳健；同时，降低复合前辐射密度并不能缓解、反而会加剧宇宙学质量上限与振荡实验质量劈裂之间正在显现的张力。
key_points: 检验宇宙学中微子质量上限对非标准热历史和中微子丰度变化的稳健性。
结合 Planck、ACT 的 CMB 与透镜数据，以及 DESI BAO 数据开展 MCMC 分析。
摘要报告各类模型中的质量上限变化较小，并发现中微子温度与质量和呈正相关。
methods: 对大爆炸核合成之后重粒子衰变为光子及暗辐射的情景进行建模
不指定物理机制地改变宇宙中微子背景温度
MCMC 参数分析
Planck 原初 CMB 观测
Planck 与 ACT 的 CMB 透镜测量
DESI 重子声学振荡数据
分别考察简并、正常和倒置质量排序
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：不同热历史参数与中微子质量、有效辐射密度及其他宇宙学参数之间的退化关系如何被 CMB 透镜和 DESI BAO 打破；所给上限对数据组合、先验、质量排序及固定质量劈裂假设是否敏感；重粒子衰变情景是否完整满足大爆炸核合成、谱畸变及其他早期宇宙约束。

papers.title: Constraining quantum-gravity predictions for evolving dark energy
papers.abstract: We confront a class of dark-energy equations of state emerging from group field theory (GFT) quantum gravity with DESI Data Release 2 baryon acoustic oscillations and Pantheon+ type-Ia supernovae. We introduce sampling parametrisations that replace microscopic initial-condition parameters by combinations more directly measured by background probes. The GFT solutions separate into logarithmic, power-law and oscillatory branches, determined by the microscopic interaction parameter $m$. The logarithmic branch is constrained to lie extremely close to a cosmological constant, while the power-law branch permits a small phantom deviation. Without perturbative-theory priors, oscillatory solutions can reproduce the mild preference of the distance data for a dip in $w(z)$ near $z\simeq0.5$--$1$. Profile-likelihood constraints favour $m\sim-2$ and $m\sim-5$ from BAO and supernovae, shifting towards $m\sim-3.5$ when CMB information is included. Conservative perturbative priors strongly suppress these deviations from $Λ$CDM. The quantum-gravity scale $z_q$, related to the average number of quantum gravity atoms, remains unconstrained, although its role in the time evolution makes higher-redshift observations a promising route to probing it. We further find that strong projection effects highlight the importance of performing likelihood profiling alongside our marginal posterior constraints. Our results provide a first direct test of GFT-motivated dynamical dark energy and demonstrate the potential for cosmological observations to inform quantum-gravity model building.

analysis.title_zh: 约束演化暗能量的量子引力预言
analysis.summary_zh: 论文将群场论（GFT）量子引力产生的一类演化暗能量状态方程，与 DESI DR2 BAO 和 Pantheon+ 超新星距离数据进行比较，并用更贴近背景观测量的组合替代微观初始条件进行采样。摘要报告称，对数分支被限制得极接近宇宙学常数，幂律分支允许小幅幽灵型偏离，振荡分支在不施加微扰理论先验时可再现距离数据对中等红移处 w(z) 下凹的轻微偏好，但保守先验会强烈抑制这些偏离，且量子引力尺度 z_q 仍未受约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把量子引力模型与晚期宇宙距离观测直接联系起来，并考察加入 CMB 信息后暗能量微观参数约束如何变化。对 CMB 研究而言，关键在于 CMB 提供高红移距离及早期宇宙锚点，可与 BAO、超新星共同打破背景演化参数的退化；同时，摘要称 z_q 仍未受约束，提示更高红移观测可能是检验该量子引力暗能量模型的重要方向。
key_points: 首次以 DESI DR2 BAO 与 Pantheon+ 超新星直接检验 GFT 启发的动力学暗能量。
对数、幂律和振荡分支呈现不同约束；保守微扰先验会显著压低相对 ΛCDM 的偏离。
边缘后验存在明显投影效应，摘要强调应同时采用剖面似然分析。
methods: DESI Data Release 2 重子声学振荡数据
Pantheon+ Ia 型超新星数据
加入 CMB 信息的联合约束
面向背景观测量的采样参数化
边缘后验约束与剖面似然分析
保守微扰理论先验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“加入 CMB 信息”的具体数据集、似然实现及其对参数 m 约束移动的来源，并区分振荡分支对距离数据特征的拟合改善、投影效应和模型复杂度影响；还需检查所谓保守微扰先验的物理依据及其对各分支参数空间的实际裁剪方式。

papers.title: A Standard Ultraviolet Continuum Can Hide Supercritical Accretion in GN-z11
papers.abstract: The ultraviolet continuum from a high-redshift accreting black hole is routinely used to infer its mass. GN-z11 offers a sharp test of whether that inference is secure. A thin-disk fit to its continuum gives an Eddington mass of $M_{\rm E}=1.12\times10^{7}\,\Msun$, an order of magnitude above the $\log(\Mbh/\Msun)=6.2\pm0.3$ inferred from broad N~\textsc{iv}. We show that this apparent tension is not imposed by the ultraviolet slope alone. We derive a closed-form criterion comparing the radius where observed photons are produced with the radius where a supercritical flow departs from efficient solution. For GN-z11, the criterion places the supercritical transition inside the ultraviolet-emitting region. Composite disks retaining the outer solution confirm this numerically, requiring $\Mdot_{\rm out}=3.1$--$4.4\,\Msun\,\mathrm{yr^{-1}}$ and placing $\Rsph=(1.2$--$1.8)\times10^{3}\,\rg$ inside $\Ruv=(2.6$--$2.9)\times10^{3}\,\rg$. Replacing the inner $\sim10^{3}\rg$ by a supercritical flow shifts the fitted slope by only $Δ\betaUV=+0.08$ to $+0.11$, comparable to uncertainties from standard spectral modelling. Reversing the radial ordering requires the effective transition to move outward by a factor $1.7$--$2.1$. Within our composite models, the measured slope constrains black-hole mass only to around $10^{6}\,\Msun$, an order of magnitude below the continuum Eddington mass. Continuum Eddington masses should therefore be treated as model-dependent bounds that assume global thin-disk efficiency. The same hierarchy appears in three additional JWST sources under the disk-dominated interpretation, where separation masses are only $4$--$6$\% of continuum Eddington masses. This distinction can substantially weaken the seed-mass and early-growth demands inferred from ultraviolet continua at cosmic dawn for the first massive black holes.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, Submitted to AAS journal. Comments are welcome

analysis.title_zh: 标准紫外连续谱可能掩盖 GN-z11 中的超临界吸积
analysis.summary_zh: 论文考察 GN-z11 的紫外连续谱是否足以可靠推断中心黑洞质量，并用一个比较紫外光子产生半径与超临界流转变半径的判据，以及保留外盘解的复合盘模型进行分析。摘要报告称，超临界转变位于紫外发射区以内时，内区结构只使紫外斜率发生较小变化，因此连续谱爱丁顿质量可能高估真实质量；类似的半径层级也出现在另外三个 JWST 源中。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 紫外连续谱常被用于估计高红移吸积黑洞质量，而这些质量估计会影响对宇宙黎明时期黑洞种子质量和早期增长历史的判断。本文指出，在超临界吸积和复合盘结构下，连续谱斜率未必能区分全局薄盘与内区超临界流，因此与 CMB 及早期宇宙研究相关的黑洞形成、反馈和星系演化推断，可能需要将连续谱爱丁顿质量视为依赖模型的界限，而不是稳健的直接质量测量。
key_points: GN-z11 的紫外连续谱并不能单独排除超临界吸积。
复合盘模型将超临界转变半径置于紫外发射区以内，同时保持外盘解。
连续谱爱丁顿质量可能只是依赖全局薄盘高效辐射假设的模型相关上界。
methods: 薄盘连续谱拟合
比较观测光子产生半径与超临界流偏离高效解的半径的闭式判据
保留外部盘解的复合盘数值模型
紫外连续谱斜率比较
GN-z11 及另外三个 JWST 源的盘主导解释
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对闭式判据的推导及其适用条件，尤其是超临界转变半径、紫外发射半径和盘结构假设如何定义；还需检查复合盘模型中的辐射转移、倾角、消光与宽线区质量估计是否会改变质量约束，以及“连续谱质量仅约为爱丁顿质量量级以下”的结论对模型参数有多强的依赖。

papers.title: Can Isotropic Thermal Conduction Heat One of the Hottest Cool Cores?
papers.abstract: Thermal conduction can act as a heating mechanism for cool-core clusters, yet the same transport must erode any temperature discontinuity it crosses. Ophiuchus permits both effects to be tested in the same atmosphere. Its temperature rises from about $1$ keV in the innermost core to $9$ keV at $r\sim30$ kpc, making conductive heating especially favorable, while two sharply resolved cold fronts independently constrain the same transport. \textcolor{black}{We construct a steady radial energy balance from deprojected \textit{Chandra} density and temperature profiles, with XRISM-based limits on turbulent heating and a subsonic inflow contribution.} Closing the balance with conduction requires only sub-Spitzer coefficients --- \Ftwentyfive\ at 25 kpc and \Finner\ and \Fouter\ at the inner and outer cold fronts --- so conduction can energetically supply the missing heat. Yet the same coefficients, applied normal to the cold-front surfaces, would broaden the fronts to their observed width limits within \Tinner\ and \Touter\ Myr, short compared to the characteristic sloshing timescales that generate and sustain such interfaces. For a representative 200 Myr residence time, the radial conductivity demanded by the energy balance exceeds the cross-front conductivity permitted by front survival by roughly a factor of three, with the required anisotropy exceeding unity in 99.9\% and 98.8\% of accepted models. The result leaves two broad regimes. Thermal conduction is either subdominant in Ophiuchus or contributes substantially but is strongly anisotropic, with heat transport suppressed across the cold fronts relative to the radial direction. Together they disfavor locally isotropic conduction as a dominant heating mechanism in cool cores generally.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, Submitted to AAS journal, Comments are welcome

analysis.title_zh: 各向同性热传导能加热最热的冷核之一吗？
analysis.summary_zh: 论文以蛇夫座星系团为对象，利用去投影的 Chandra 密度和温度剖面，结合 XRISM 对湍流加热及次声速流入的限制，构建稳态径向能量平衡，并将其与冷锋宽度约束进行比较。摘要报告称，热传导在能量上可以补足缺失热量，但若假定局部各向同性传导，同样的传输系数会过快抹平冷锋；在代表性的 200 Myr 驻留时间下，能量平衡所需的径向传导率约为冷锋存活所允许跨界传导率的三倍，因此结果倾向于热传导较弱或具有显著各向异性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团冷核的加热机制涉及热等离子体输运、反馈与气体演化，是理解星系团内部重子物理的重要问题，也会影响星系团作为宇宙学探针时对气体物理的建模。该工作并非直接分析 CMB 数据，但通过检验冷核中的热传导与冷锋存活条件，为 CMB 相关的星系团形成、质量标定及系统误差研究提供了有关非引力气体物理的约束。
key_points: 蛇夫座星系团的径向温度梯度使热传导在能量收支上具有较强潜力。
同一组传导系数若作用于冷锋法向，会在较短时间内展宽冷锋。
摘要据此不支持局部各向同性热传导作为冷核主导加热机制，除非传导具有显著各向异性。
methods: 使用去投影的 Chandra 密度和温度剖面。
构建稳态径向能量平衡。
采用 XRISM 对湍流加热和次声速流入贡献的限制。
用两个分辨出的冷锋及其观测宽度上限约束跨冷锋热传导。
比较能量平衡所需的径向传导率与冷锋存活所允许的跨界传导率，并进行模型接受率分析。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对稳态径向能量平衡的边界条件、去投影剖面的系统误差，以及 XRISM 对湍流加热和流入项的具体限制；还需确认冷锋宽度上限、驻留时间和假定的各向异性参数化如何共同决定“约三倍”及模型比例等结论。

papers.title: NERV: Neural-network Enhanced Reconstruction of the UniVerse with Application to Baryon Acoustic Oscillations in the BOSS DR12 Galaxy Sample
papers.abstract: We present the first application of neural-network-based baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) reconstruction to real galaxy survey data, restoring the acoustic signature damped by nonlinear structure growth. {\texttt{NERV}} ({\bf N}eural-network {\bf E}nhanced {\bf R}econstruction of the Uni{\bf V}erse) augments standard reconstruction with a convolutional neural network trained on cubic $N$-body simulations, and explicitly accounts for realistic observational effects including the curved-sky geometry, the redshift-dependent selection function, and finite survey boundaries, by tessellating the survey volume into local patches. We validate the method on the \textsc{MultiDark-Patchy} mock catalogs, recovering unbiased BAO dilation parameters. Applied to the BOSS DR12 galaxy sample, NERV improves the precision of the BAO distance measurements significantly. These results establish neural reconstruction as a practical component of BAO analyses for ongoing surveys such as DESI, with the potential to substantially tighten constraints on the cosmic expansion history and the nature of dark energy.

analysis.title_zh: NERV：神经网络增强的宇宙重建及其在 BOSS DR12 星系样本重子声学振荡中的应用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究如何利用神经网络进行重子声学振荡（BAO）重建，以恢复非线性结构增长所削弱的声学特征。作者将卷积神经网络与标准重建方法结合，在考虑曲率天空几何、随红移变化的选择函数和有限巡天边界的局部块方法中进行验证；摘要报告称，该方法在 MultiDark-Patchy 模拟星表中恢复了无偏的 BAO 膨胀参数，并在 BOSS DR12 星系样本中显著提高了 BAO 距离测量精度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: BAO 是测量宇宙距离—红移关系和宇宙膨胀历史的重要工具，与 CMB 给出的早期宇宙标尺及宇宙学参数约束具有互补性。若重建方法能更有效地恢复 BAO 信号并提高距离测量精度，就可能增强对暗能量和宇宙膨胀史的约束；摘要还将其应用前景指向 DESI 等正在进行的大型巡天。
key_points: 提出将卷积神经网络增强的重建用于真实星系巡天 BAO 分析。
通过局部块划分显式处理曲率天空、红移依赖选择函数和有限巡天边界。
在 MultiDark-Patchy 模拟中得到无偏 BAO 膨胀参数，并在 BOSS DR12 中提高 BAO 距离测量精度。
methods: 基于卷积神经网络的 BAO 重建。
将神经网络与标准 BAO 重建相结合。
使用立方体 N 体模拟训练神经网络。
通过将巡天体积划分为局部块来处理曲率天空几何、红移依赖的选择函数和有限巡天边界。
在 MultiDark-Patchy 模拟星表上进行验证，并应用于 BOSS DR12 星系样本。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对神经网络相对于标准重建在 BAO 距离参数误差和偏差上的定量改善、训练模拟与真实 BOSS 数据之间的分布差异，以及曲率天空、选择函数和边界处理是否引入额外系统误差；还需确认“显著提高精度”的统计定义和稳健性检验。

papers.title: Impact of uncertainties on the cosmic optical and infrared backgrounds on the propagation of astroparticles
papers.abstract: When propagating through the universe, gamma rays at very-high energy (VHE, E > 100 GeV) and ultra-high energy cosmic rays (UHECRs, E > 1 EeV) can interact with the optical, infrared and microwave photon fields that permeate the universe. These interactions result in a characteristic absorption imprint in the spectra of extragalactic gamma-ray sources at VHE, and in a change in the mass-composition of UHECRs. The study of both VHE gamma rays and UHECRs therefore requires precise knowledge of the intensity of the cosmic photon fields. In this work, we explore the impact of the current uncertainties on the optical and infrared photon fields on the propagation of astroparticles. We restrict the range of available models to those best matching the recent measurements, and compare the different reconstructions resulting from these models. We find that the knowledge on the cosmic background light is no longer the dominant source of uncertainties in understanding the phenomenology of astroparticle sources in the low redshift universe (z < 0.1), enabling robust spectral and composition inference with the next generation of both gamma-ray and UHECR measurements.

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙光学和红外背景不确定性对天体粒子传播的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究宇宙光学、红外和微波光子场的不确定性如何影响甚高能伽马射线与超高能宇宙线在宇宙中的传播及其观测特征。作者筛选出与近期测量最相符的背景光模型并比较其重建结果，摘要称对于低红移宇宙（z<0.1），宇宙背景光已不再是理解天体粒子源现象的主导不确定性来源。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙微波背景光子场是传播效应中的一部分，而光学和红外背景会影响高能伽马射线的吸收以及超高能宇宙线的质量组成推断，因此该工作与CMB相关的背景辐射建模、光子场演化和多信使宇宙学存在联系。不过，论文重点并非CMB各向异性或参数估计，而是宇宙背景光对高能天体粒子传播的系统影响。
key_points: 考察光学和红外宇宙背景模型不确定性对甚高能伽马射线和超高能宇宙线传播的影响。
比较与近期测量相符的不同背景光重建结果。
摘要报告称在低红移宇宙中，背景光不确定性不再是主要误差来源。
methods: 考虑甚高能伽马射线与超高能宇宙线同光学、红外和微波光子场的相互作用。
将可用模型限制为与近期测量最相符的模型。
比较不同模型给出的宇宙背景光重建结果及其对天体粒子传播的影响。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对所采用的具体背景光模型及其筛选标准、近期测量数据的范围、不同重建之间的不确定性如何定量传递到伽马射线谱和宇宙线质量组成，以及“低红移中不再占主导”相对于哪些其他误差来源而言。还应确认微波背景在分析中的具体作用，因为摘要的主要讨论集中在光学和红外背景。

papers.title: Cosmological Signatures of Curvature-Coupled Dark Energy
papers.abstract: We study a curvature-coupled dark energy model that can modify cosmological evolution both before recombination and during the late-time accelerated era. The model belongs to the class of scalar-tensor theories, in which a quintessence field is non-minimally coupled to the Ricci scalar. We specify the model through a shifted quartic coupling, $f(\varphi)=α(\varphi^2-\varphi_{\rm today}^2)^2$, and an inverse power-law potential, $V(\varphi)=Λ\varphi^{-σ}$, where $\varphi_{\rm today}$ is a constant fixed by requiring the effective Planck mass to recover its present-day normalization. We implement the model in a modified version of $\mathtt{hi\_class}$ and compute its background and linear cosmological predictions. This specific form of non-minimal coupling allows an effective crossing of the phantom divide at late times while naturally suppressing deviations from standard gravity today and satisfying local gravity constraints. At the same time, the scalar field can modify the expansion history before recombination, shifting the acoustic scale in the direction required to alleviate the $H_0$ tension, while remaining dynamically relevant as dark energy at low redshift. For the parameter choices studied here, we find tens-of-percent deviations from $Λ$CDM in the expansion history, matter clustering, and metric-potential spectra. The modified evolution of the gravitational potentials leaves characteristic signatures in relativistic observables, with weak-lensing power suppressed by $\mathcal{O}(20$-$40\%)$ at low multipoles and order-unity changes in the late Integrated Sachs-Wolfe signal. Together, these results reveal a broad, scale-dependent phenomenology that motivates both a full parameter-space analysis and an extension of the present linear treatment to a dedicated non-linear $N$-body implementation.
papers.comment: 50 pages, 13 figures. The code is available at https://github.com/abdolalibanihashemi/hi_class_CCDE

analysis.title_zh: 曲率耦合暗能量的宇宙学特征
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究一种将 quintessence 场与Ricci标量非最小耦合的标量-张量暗能量模型，采用移位四次耦合和反幂律势，并在修改版 hi_class 中计算背景与线性扰动预言。摘要称该模型可影响复合前后的宇宙膨胀，在晚期有效跨越幻影分界并可能缓解 H0 张力；所研究参数下，相对 ΛCDM 的膨胀、物质聚集和度规势谱可有数十个百分点偏离，低多极弱透镜功率约抑制20%–40%，晚期ISW信号则可发生数量级变化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该模型直接关联 CMB 声学尺度、复合前膨胀历史以及晚期引力势演化，因此同时涉及 H0 张力、CMB透镜、ISW效应和暗能量本性。它还提供了一个把早期宇宙修正与晚期加速膨胀统一起来的标量-张量框架，但摘要明确表明当前结果主要基于线性计算，完整参数空间约束和非线性结构形成仍待研究。
key_points: 非最小曲率耦合可同时影响复合前膨胀和晚期加速膨胀。
模型允许晚期有效跨越幻影分界，并在今天恢复标准引力归一化。
摘要报告弱透镜低多极功率抑制约20%–40%，晚期ISW信号可发生数量级变化。
methods: 采用移位四次耦合形式 f(φ)=α(φ²−φ_today²)²。
采用反幂律势 V(φ)=Λφ^−σ。
在修改版 hi_class 中实现模型。
计算背景演化和线性宇宙学预言。
考察膨胀历史、物质聚集、度规势谱以及弱引力透镜和晚期积分Sachs–Wolfe观测量。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对所选参数和初始条件如何确定，复合前膨胀改变对声学尺度和 H0 张力缓解的定量程度，以及局域引力约束、CMB观测量和其他数据联合后是否仍允许这些模型。还应重点检查线性计算对弱透镜和ISW大幅偏离的适用范围，以及作者如何界定“有效跨越”幻影分界。

papers.title: Toward Precision Kinetic Sunyaev-Zel'dovich Cosmology---1. The Matter - Momentum Bispectrum at One-Loop Order
papers.abstract: The kinetic Sunyaev-Zeldovich (kSZ) effect is a sensitive probe of the free-electron momentum field, tapping into spatial correlations relevant for both large-scale cosmology and smaller-scale astrophysics. Precision kSZ measurements will provide a robust channel for constraining inflationary physics and equivalence principle violation, while simultaneously characterizing the small-scale gas distribution and associated baryonic feedback. However, robust kSZ measurement for cosmological applications is challenging, as the primary source of large-scale information is convolved with unknown small-scale dynamics in a degenerate combination. In this paper we address this challenge using the Effective Field Theory (EFT) framework that provides a principled way of treating the effects of small-scale dynamics on large scale-structure. Extracting the kSZ signal can be reformulated as a measurement of the one-loop galaxy-galaxy-electron momentum bispectrum. We compute here a pure dark matter version of this bispectrum in EFT and compare it to simulations. We derive the EFT counterterms that capture small-scale backreaction and find that two of them acquire a transverse direction. One transverse counterterm gets generated entirely by the vorticity of the velocity field. Our computation of the bispectrum dipole agrees with simulation data to 5% up to k_max = 0.23 h/Mpc, which is significantly larger than the reach of tree level theory, which breaks down beyond k_max = 0.07 h/Mpc (at redshift z = 0.5). For the bispectrum computed with the projected momentum field, relevant to measuring the kSZ field, we find a similar k_max, and make the first detection of the transverse counterterms from simulations. Our results suggest that one-loop bispectrum computations can play an important role in advancing kSZ cosmology.

analysis.title_zh: 迈向精密动力学 Sunyaev–Zel'dovich 宇宙学（一）：一圈阶物质—动量双谱
analysis.summary_zh: 论文将用于提取 kSZ 信号的统计量表述为一圈阶星系—星系—电子动量双谱，并在大尺度结构 EFT 中计算其纯暗物质版本、推导小尺度反馈反项并与模拟比较。摘要报告双谱偶极在红移 z=0.5 时与模拟达到 5% 符合至 k_max=0.23 h/Mpc，优于树级理论的 k_max=0.07 h/Mpc；投影动量场结果具有相近适用范围，并在模拟中首次检出横向反项。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: kSZ 是 CMB 次级各向异性，直接联系自由电子的视向动量与大尺度结构，但其宇宙学信息会同未知的小尺度气体动力学和重子反馈纠缠。该工作尝试用 EFT 系统参数化小尺度反作用，并把理论预测推进到一圈阶，因此可能扩大 kSZ 交叉相关分析可使用的尺度范围，为约束暴胀物理、等效原理破缺及电子分布提供更可靠的理论模板；不过摘要中的验证仍基于纯暗物质版本，面向真实 kSZ 数据的重子物理适用性仍需核查。
key_points: 将 kSZ 信号提取重写为一圈阶星系—星系—电子动量双谱的测量问题。
EFT 反项用于吸收小尺度动力学对大尺度结构统计的反馈，其中两个反项具有横向分量。
摘要报告一圈阶双谱偶极与模拟在更大波数范围内符合，并从模拟中首次检出横向反项。
methods: 大尺度结构有效场论（EFT）
一圈阶物质—动量双谱计算
EFT 反项推导
暗物质模拟对比
双谱偶极与投影动量场分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：纯暗物质版本如何映射到真实的自由电子动量场；各 EFT 反项的算符基底、参数简并与拟合策略；所谓横向反项的统计检出标准及其对模拟分辨率和旋度建模的依赖；5% 符合度和有效波数上限的具体定义，以及这些结论能否在引入气体物理、星系偏置和观测投影后保持。

papers.title: Using the Circumgalactic Medium of Dwarf Galaxies as a Calorimetric Dark Matter Detector
papers.abstract: Many well-motivated dark matter (DM) scenarios, including dark photon DM, axion-like particles, sterile neutrinos, and primordial black holes, can deposit energy into ordinary matter and significantly raise the thermal energy of astrophysical gas. We present a simple, model-independent implementation of DM-induced heating in the RAMSES hydrodynamic simulation code, parameterized by an effective local heat-transfer rate $Γ_{\rm heat}$. Using simulations of an isolated gas-rich dwarf galaxy with properties similar to WLM, we find that DM heating substantially alters the thermal structure of the circumgalactic medium (CGM) while leaving the star formation rate and the dense ISM nearly unchanged. For $Γ_{\rm heat} = 10^{-27}$ to $10^{-25}\ {\rm s}^{-1}$, the neutral hydrogen column at 10 kpc is suppressed by 0.6 to 3.9 dex relative to the control simulation. Similarly, the C II and Si II column densities decrease by 4.1 and 5.5 dex, and by 2.2 and 3.0 dex for C IV and Si IV. These signatures are accessible to quasar absorption-line spectroscopy, so CGM observations of nearby field dwarf galaxies provide a promising avenue for constraining dark matter models that inject heat into ordinary matter.

analysis.title_zh: 利用矮星系的星系周介质作为量热型暗物质探测器
analysis.summary_zh: 该研究在RAMSES中以有效局域热传递率实现模型无关的暗物质加热，并模拟一个类似WLM的孤立富气矮星系。摘要报告，加热显著改变星系周介质的热结构并大幅降低中性氢及多种金属离子的柱密度，但对恒星形成率和致密星际介质影响很小。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作并不直接研究CMB，而是提出一种低红移、小尺度的暗物质能量注入探针，可与CMB对暗物质衰变、湮灭或其他能量沉积过程的早期宇宙约束形成互补。其价值在于利用矮星系CGM的热状态和吸收线柱密度检验多类可加热普通物质的暗物质情景，但能否与CMB约束直接联合取决于有效加热率和具体粒子模型之间的可靠对应关系。
key_points: 将暗物质向普通物质注入能量统一参数化为局域有效加热率。
模拟显示，矮星系CGM的热结构和多种离子柱密度对暗物质加热高度敏感。
恒星形成率与致密星际介质近乎不变，主要观测信号集中在星系周介质。
methods: 在RAMSES流体动力学模拟代码中实现模型无关的暗物质加热方案
以有效局域热传递率 $\Gamma_{\rm heat}$ 参数化能量注入
模拟性质类似WLM的孤立、富气矮星系
比较加热模拟与对照模拟中的热结构及H I、C II、Si II、C IV和Si IV柱密度
以类星体吸收线光谱作为潜在观测检验手段
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：$\Gamma_{\rm heat}$与具体暗物质模型及粒子参数之间如何映射；加热率是否随气体密度、暗物质密度和红移变化；CGM柱密度结果对分辨率、金属丰度、电离背景、反馈模型及初始条件是否稳健；摘要给出的不同离子压低幅度分别对应哪些加热率和视线选择。

papers.title: Hadrophilic inelastic freeze-in dark matter in $q_1-q_2$ gauge extension and the high energy LZ event
papers.abstract: The recent observation of a single event at nuclear recoil energy $248\pm23\pm23$ keV by the LZ collaboration has prompted dark matter (DM) model builders to explore new physics explanations. While most of the existing literature invokes an endothermic scattering by a TeV-scale DM to explain the event, the favored DM interaction strength is in tension with the indirect detection constraints for most of the models. To evade this, this work explores exothermic DM scattering in a hadrophilic $q_1-q_2$ gauge extension setup with a new $Z'$ boson as a mediator to the dark sector. This can naturally escape the indirect searches in the absence of tree-level coupling of the mediator to neutrinos, $W,τ$, and $b$ quark. We consider freeze-in production at a low reheating temperature to populate DM in the early universe, with a comparatively smaller coupling than the thermal freeze-out scenario. We identify the $Z'$ parameter space that can explain the observed relic density and LZ event simultaneously. We also discuss the relevant constraints coming from flavor mixing and FCNC.

analysis.title_zh: q₁−q₂ 规范扩展中的亲强子非弹性冻结产生暗物质与 LZ 高能事件
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在含新 Z′ 媒介子的亲强子 q₁−q₂ 规范扩展中，以放热型非弹性暗物质散射解释 LZ 报告的一个高能核反冲事件，并用低再加热温度下的冻结产生机制生成暗物质。摘要称作者找到了可同时符合观测遗迹丰度和该事件的 Z′ 参数空间，同时考察了味混合及味改变中性流约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是直接研究 CMB 的论文，但其低再加热温度、非热冻结产生和暗物质遗迹丰度计算属于粒子宇宙学问题，可能影响早期宇宙热史及相关宇宙学一致性检验。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键联系在于该情景是否改变辐射背景、能量注入或标准热史；摘要未报告具体的 CMB 数据分析或约束。
key_points: 用放热型非弹性暗物质散射解释 LZ 的高能核反冲候选事件。
在亲强子 q₁−q₂ 规范扩展中引入 Z′，并利用低再加热温度下的冻结产生机制获得暗物质。
摘要称存在可同时解释暗物质遗迹丰度与该 LZ 事件的 Z′ 参数空间，并讨论了味混合和味改变中性流约束。
methods: 亲强子 q₁−q₂ 规范扩展及其 Z′ 媒介粒子
放热型非弹性暗物质核散射
低再加热温度下的冻结产生机制
暗物质遗迹丰度与 LZ 高能核反冲事件的联合参数空间分析
味混合与味改变中性流约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：单个 LZ 候选事件对应的统计处理与核反冲谱是否足以约束模型；低再加热温度、冻结产生耦合和质量劈裂之间如何共同满足遗迹丰度；所谓避开间接探测约束是否仍受圈图诱导耦合、其他强子末态、味混合及 FCNC 限制。还需确认低再加热历史与 BBN 等早期宇宙约束是否相容。

papers.title: $Λ$CDM in a courtroom
papers.abstract: The cosmological constant $Λ$, and its generalization as Dark Energy, makes up roughly 70% of the present-epoch universe and has been part of the dominant $Λ$CDM cosmological paradigm for more than a quarter of a century. It has been put on trial by recent measurements of galaxy clustering, Type Ia supernovae, and the cosmic microwave background. In this Perspective we evaluate the strength of the evidence for a constant $Λ$, versus Dynamical Dark Energy (DDE) in the light of recent developments. We also assess what the future holds both for our Universe and our understanding of its most mysterious component.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 1 Table, 1 Figure; a Perspective article accepted for publication by Nature Astronomy and to appear in the October 2026 issue

analysis.title_zh: ΛCDM 出庭受审
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇 Perspective 讨论占当前宇宙约 70% 的宇宙学常数 Λ，以及其动态暗能量推广，并评估近期星系聚类、Ia 型超新星和 CMB 测量对 ΛCDM 的挑战。文章比较常数 Λ 与动态暗能量（DDE）的证据强度，同时展望未来观测对暗能量本质和宇宙命运的认识。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗能量是标准宇宙学模型的核心组成部分，而 CMB 通常与低红移星系聚类和 Ia 型超新星联合使用来约束宇宙膨胀史及能量组分。论文关注这些观测是否共同指向超越 ΛCDM 的动态暗能量，因此与 CMB 参数推断、数据集间张力以及宇宙学模型检验直接相关。
key_points: 论文评估近期观测是否对常数宇宙学常数 ΛCDM 构成挑战。
重点比较常数 Λ 与动态暗能量（DDE）两种解释。
讨论未来观测对暗能量性质和宇宙命运判断的影响。
methods: 评述星系聚类测量
评述 Ia 型超新星观测
评述宇宙微波背景（CMB）观测
比较常数暗能量与动态暗能量模型的证据
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者如何综合星系聚类、Ia 型超新星和 CMB 的结果，是否区分不同数据集、系统误差与模型先验；还需确认文中所谓对 ΛCDM 的“审判”究竟是统计张力、模型比较意义上的偏好，还是已达到足以排除常数 Λ 的证据。

papers.title: Anisotropic redshift distributions in photometric galaxy clustering and their cosmological impact
papers.abstract: Photometric galaxy clustering is a major probe of large-scale structure whose interpretation relies on accurate characterization of the galaxy redshift distribution, $n(z)$. Standard analyses assume the $n(z)$ of a selected lens sample to be isotropic, whereas observational systematics can imprint spatial variations. We quantify how this anisotropy biases angular galaxy clustering, internal consistency, and cosmological inference. We develop an analytical formalism for clustering under spatially varying $n(z)$ and forward-model realistic observational systematics, galaxy selection, and tomographic binning. For a fiducial magnitude-limited sample, modeling $w(θ)$ with a single global $\bar n(z)$ underestimates the clustering signal by up to $\sim10\%$ at small scales in the highest-redshift bin, decreasing towards lower redshift. In a $2\times2$pt analysis, cosmological parameter shifts remain below $1σ$ for KiDS-like and DES-like setups. For an LSST-like setup retaining KiDS-like selection and observing-condition variation, $σ_8$ is biased low by $1.7σ$ and $Ω_m$ high by $1.4σ$, while the high-redshift galaxy bias shifts by up to $\sim4σ$. The anisotropy also affects whether the probes are consistent enough to combine: a calibrated posterior-predictive internal-consistency test finds the contaminated angular clustering improbable given the joint cosmic-shear and galaxy--galaxy-lensing constraints (median calibrated $\tilde p\approx8\times10^{-4}$ under LSST-like noise). Anisotropic redshift distributions are therefore a potentially significant systematic for future photometric clustering analyses. Our forward model can be used to mitigate it given a realistic selection function and galaxy population model.

analysis.title_zh: 光度星系聚类中的各向异性红移分布及其宇宙学影响
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究光度星系样本的红移分布随天区变化时，采用单一全局红移分布会如何影响角聚类、探针间一致性和宇宙学推断，并以解析形式结合观测系统误差、星系选择及层析分箱进行前向建模。摘要报告小尺度高红移角聚类信号可被低估约 10%；KiDS 类和 DES 类设置下参数偏移低于 1σ，而特定 LSST 类设置下 σ₈、Ωₘ及高红移星系偏置出现更明显偏移，并表现出探针间不一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 光度星系聚类、宇宙剪切与星系—星系透镜是低红移大尺度结构联合分析的重要组成部分，也常与 CMB 温度、偏振及 CMB 透镜约束结合。若红移分布的空间变化未被建模，它既可能偏移增长幅度和物质密度等参数，也可能制造低红移探针彼此之间或其与 CMB 之间的表观张力，因此对未来联合宇宙学分析的系统误差控制具有直接意义。
key_points: 空间变化的红移分布会使采用单一全局红移分布的角聚类模型产生尺度与红移相关的偏差。
摘要报告：KiDS 类和 DES 类设置中的宇宙学参数偏移低于 1σ，但 LSST 类设置中的偏差可能不可忽略。
该系统误差还会破坏角聚类、宇宙剪切和星系—星系透镜之间的内部一致性。
methods: 为空间变化的星系红移分布建立角聚类解析形式
前向建模观测系统误差、星系选择和层析分箱
联合分析角星系聚类与星系—星系透镜的 2×2pt 方法
使用宇宙剪切和星系—星系透镜约束进行校准后的后验预测内部一致性检验
比较 KiDS 类、DES 类和 LSST 类观测设置
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对红移分布各向异性的生成模型及其与真实巡天选择函数、观测条件变化的对应关系，并检查 LSST 类预测为何沿用 KiDS 类选择与观测条件变化、尺度切除和系统误差边缘化是否充分，以及所报告参数偏移对这些假设的敏感性。

papers.title: Gravitational-Wave Image Multiplicity as a Topological Probe of Dark-Matter Core Collapse
papers.abstract: Dark-matter self-interactions can drive subhalos through gravothermal core collapse, but conventional lensing observables vary continuously with uncertain inner profiles. We show that gravitational-wave image multiplicity provides a discrete alternative. Near a macro-critical minimum, increasing subhalo central convergence opens two caustics in sequence, converting one detectable waveform into three and then five stationary images. Using weighted SASHIMI subhalos and an ET+CE selection model, we forecast almost 2 systems with at least three copies detectable in five years if dense remnants survive, compared with the prediction of 0.36 in 5yrs for standard CDM. The much more diagnostic second case is rare: the corresponding 5yrs yield with at least four detectable copies is 0.149, versus $1.55\times10^{-6}$ for CDM. According to the Poisson statistics, this gives only a 13.8\% probability of at least one event detected in 5 years. Thus this is a rare-event, exposure-limited test rather than a guaranteed detection: a resolved second pair would be difficult to reconcile with the fiducial single-halo CDM population, whereas a five-year null result would not by itself constrain remnant survival strongly.

analysis.title_zh: 引力波多重成像：暗物质核心坍缩的拓扑探针
analysis.summary_zh: 本文探讨用强引力透镜产生的引力波像数这一离散观测量，识别自相互作用暗物质导致的亚晕引力热核心坍缩；摘要称，在宏观临界极小像附近，随亚晕中心会聚度增大，两个焦散依次出现，可使一个可探测波形对应三个、继而五个驻相像。基于加权 SASHIMI 亚晕模型和 ET+CE 选择模型，作者预测致密遗迹存活时五年至少三份可探测拷贝的系统接近2个，而标准 CDM 为0.36个；更具诊断性的至少四份可探测拷贝事件期望数分别为0.149和1.55×10^-6，但前者五年至少出现一次的泊松概率也仅为13.8%。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作与 CMB 的联系是间接但重要的：CMB 主要约束早期宇宙及大尺度暗物质性质，而引力波强透镜的像数可能检验晚期小尺度亚结构、暗物质自相互作用及其引力热演化，从而提供与 CMB 互补的暗物质模型测试。摘要同时表明该检验受稀有事件和观测曝光量限制，因此不能简单把短期零探测解释为对暗物质模型的强约束。
key_points: 像的多重性被用作区别连续透镜剖面指标的离散拓扑观测量。
致密坍缩遗迹情景预测的多拷贝事件率高于摘要采用的标准 CDM 基准。
第二对像一旦被分辨将具有较强诊断力，但五年内出现此类事件的概率较低。
methods: 分析宏观临界极小像附近，亚晕中心会聚度变化导致焦散依次开启及驻相像数改变的过程。
采用加权 SASHIMI 亚晕模型进行亚晕总体建模。
结合 ET+CE 选择模型预测五年事件产额，并用泊松统计计算至少一次探测的概率。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对像数变化对亚晕内密度剖面、宏观透镜环境和源位置的依赖，以及“可探测拷贝”的信噪比、时延与波形可辨识标准；还需检查 SASHIMI 权重、致密遗迹存活率及单亚晕 CDM 基准如何影响事件率，并确认多亚晕或视线结构是否可能造成类似的多像信号。

papers.title: Influence of the large-scale structure velocity field on halo mass assembly within cosmic filaments
papers.abstract: The cosmic web governs the growth of dark matter halos through anisotropic matter flows, yet the role of local velocity-field dynamics in halo mass assembly remains poorly understood. The velocity field carries non-linear information about matter transport that is not fully captured by density alone, particularly within filaments. We investigate this connection through velocity divergence and vorticity using dark matter halos in the IllustrisTNG TNG50-1-Dark simulation at $z=0$. Cosmic filaments are extracted with the 1-DREAM framework, and we statistically study how halo mass relates to divergence, vorticity, and radial distance from filament spines across three overdensity regimes. The velocity field correlates strongly with the cosmic web, with converging flows tracing filaments and vorticity arising primarily in overdense, non-linear regions. Within filaments, both divergence and vorticity show enhanced kinematic activity at intermediate distances from the spine, with amplitudes increasing with overdensity. We confirm a clear mass segregation, with more massive halos preferentially located near filament centers. Most notably, halos with masses $M \geq 10^{12} M_\odot$ are found almost exclusively in regions of low absolute divergence and low vorticity, while highly dynamical environments are dominated by low-mass halos. We further find that halos residing in kinematically calm regions assembled later and maintain higher recent accretion rates than those in dynamically active environments, linking present-day velocity-field properties to halo growth histories. These results demonstrate that the local kinematic state of the cosmic flow encodes information about halo mass and assembly beyond that contained in density alone, providing a complementary dynamical description of halo growth within the cosmic web.

analysis.title_zh: 大尺度结构速度场对宇宙丝状体内暗物质晕质量组装的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 IllustrisTNG 的 TNG50-1-Dark 模拟，在 z=0 研究宇宙丝状体内暗物质晕的质量与速度场散度、涡量及其到丝状体骨架距离之间的关系，并按三种过密度区域进行统计分析。摘要报告称，速度场能够在密度之外提供关于晕质量和组装历史的信息：大质量晕更倾向于位于丝状体中心附近及低散度、低涡量区域，而运动学较平静区域中的晕具有较晚的组装时间和较高的近期吸积率。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙大尺度结构的速度场反映物质输运和非线性动力学，因而可补充仅依赖密度场对暗物质晕形成与演化的描述。对 CMB 研究而言，这类晕和丝状体中的动力学环境与 CMB 晕化、引力透镜以及大尺度结构—CMB 交叉分析所涉及的物质分布和速度信息有关，但摘要本身未直接讨论 CMB 可观测量或具体观测约束。
key_points: 丝状体中的速度汇聚与宇宙网结构相关，涡量主要出现在高过密度、非线性区域。
大质量晕更倾向于靠近丝状体中心，并几乎只出现在低绝对散度、低涡量环境。
运动学较平静区域中的晕组装较晚，且近期吸积率较高。
methods: 使用 IllustrisTNG 的 TNG50-1-Dark 暗物质数值模拟，在 z=0 研究暗物质晕。
采用 1-DREAM 框架提取宇宙丝状体。
通过速度散度和涡量分析速度场，并统计晕质量、速度场性质与到丝状体骨架径向距离的关系。
在三种过密度区域中进行统计比较。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“几乎只出现在”及组装时间、近期吸积率差异的定量定义与统计显著性，并确认结果对模拟选择、丝状体识别方法、过密度分区及红移范围的依赖；还需核对这些速度场关系如何具体投影到 CMB 透镜或其他 CMB 相关可观测量上。

papers.title: 2+1 is not 3: Angular bispectrum and Super-Sample Covariance on the light cone
papers.abstract: Observations of the Large Scale Structure sit on the light cone. Cosmological statistics must then be projected from 3D to angular space. For the bispectrum and higher orders, the polyspectra crucially depend on the angles between Fourier modes in addition to their moduli. This leads to delicate cancellations in the squeezed limit and make Limber's approximation fail. This is problematic for predicting the Super-Sample Covariance (SSC), with no known full-sky computation of the angle-dependent terms. Here we develop a new analytical approach to the angular bispectrum, writing Fourier vectors as derivatives that we project on the sphere and tackle with spin-weighted spherical harmonics. We find bispectrum equations free of cancellations and amenable to beyond-Limber numerical methods. Limber's approximation becomes well-behaved and works in the squeezed limit and any other configuration. We then derive the consequence for the covariance between 1-point (e.g. cluster or peak counts) and 2-point statistics (e.g. galaxy clustering, weak lensing or 21cm), which relates to the squeezed bispectrum. The results split into intra-survey covariance and SSC, where we find significant differences with past literature. Our results are in line with the 2+1 geometry of the light cone, having e.g. temporal derivatives in addition to spatial ones. We also find that the tidal term is degenerate with the simpler growth-only term. The total SSC contains a wealth of new terms including wide-angle effects and responses to the background velocity. However we show numerically that it is well approximated by a single term with a density-only response. This ultimately makes our results simpler than past literature. This full-sky result should be more representative than the past flat-sky limit for large survey areas, thus being the one relevant for coming observations with e.g. Euclid, LSST and Roman.
papers.comment: 40+34 pages, 6 figures, 2 summary tables for the bispectrum, 1 summary equation for the SSC

analysis.title_zh: 2+1 并不等于 3：光锥上的角向双谱与超样本协方差
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究光锥观测中将三维大尺度结构统计投影到角向空间后，角度依赖的双谱及其挤压极限对超样本协方差（SSC）预测造成的问题。作者提出基于球面投影和自旋加权球谐函数的解析方法，得到适用于超越 Limber 近似的角向双谱表达式，并据此讨论一点评统计量与二点评统计量之间的协方差；摘要报告称，SSC 虽包含宽角效应和背景速度响应等新项，但数值上可由仅含密度响应的单项较好近似。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接涉及大尺度结构和弱透镜等角向统计量的全天天空建模，而这些观测与 CMB 一样都需要在球面上处理投影效应、角向模式耦合和协方差。其对球谐方法、Limber 近似及光锥几何的处理，可为 CMB 与 CMB 透镜分析中理解全天天空投影、非平面效应及大尺度协方差提供方法上的参照；不过论文摘要明确聚焦于大尺度结构统计，而非 CMB 数据本身。
key_points: 提出利用导数投影与自旋加权球谐函数处理角向双谱的解析方法。
摘要称该表达式避免挤压极限中的抵消，并使 Limber 近似在不同构型下表现良好。
SSC 包含宽角效应和背景速度响应等多项，但数值上可由密度响应主导的单项近似。
methods: 将傅里叶向量表示为导数，并投影到球面上。
使用自旋加权球谐函数推导角向双谱。
采用超越 Limber 的数值方法，并检验 Limber 近似在挤压及其他构型中的表现。
推导一点评统计量与二点评统计量之间的协方差，区分巡天内部协方差与超样本协方差。
考虑潮汐项、增长项、宽角效应和背景速度响应等贡献，并进行数值近似比较。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：所谓“Limber 近似在任意构型下表现良好”所依赖的适用条件和误差范围；SSC 中潮汐响应与增长响应的退化是如何定义和证明的；密度-only 单项近似在不同红移、角尺度、观测量及实际 Euclid、LSST 或 Roman 选样下是否仍然成立；以及与既有平面天空和全天天空结果差异的具体来源。

papers.title: Assembly Bias in eRASS1 X-ray Galaxy Clusters: Accounting for Non-uniform Survey Exposure
papers.abstract: Halo assembly bias describes the dependence of halo clustering on properties beyond halo mass and provides a means of connecting halo assembly history to the large-scale matter distribution. We develop and test a relative clustering methodology for measuring differences in the large-scale bias of two halo populations using the ratio of their cluster--galaxy pair counts. In the linear regime, this ratio can be related to the difference in cluster bias, while the galaxy autocorrelation independently constrains the galaxy bias. We apply the method to a volume-limited X-ray selected galaxy clusters from the eROSITA eRASS1 catalogue, dividing them into high- and low-temperature subsamples with matched distributions in X-ray luminosity, redshift, and exposure. We first verify the validity of the linear approximation, finding $ξ(r)\ll1.0$ over $4$--$10\,h^{-1}\mathrm{Mpc}$. The joint clustering analysis yields $b_{\rm g}=1.610^{+0.018}_{-0.019}$ and a bias difference $Δb=0.8\pm1.1$. DES Y3 weak gravitational lensing measurements provide an independent test of the halo masses, yielding $\log(M_{200\mathrm{m}}/h^{-1}M_\odot)=14.33^{+0.07}_{-0.07}$ and $14.33^{+0.10}_{-0.09}$ for the high- and low-temperature samples, respectively, with a mass difference of $Δ\log M_{200\mathrm{m}}=-0.01\pm0.12$. We therefore find no statistically significant evidence for assembly bias at the $1σ$ level, but our measurement is consistent with the bias difference measured for analogous halo populations in the FLAMINGO simulation. The result therefore does not rule out assembly bias at the level expected from the simulation, while demonstrating that the relative clustering methodology provides a framework for future assembly-bias measurements with larger X-ray cluster and galaxy surveys.

analysis.title_zh: eRASS1 X射线星系团中的装配偏置：考虑非均匀巡天曝光
analysis.summary_zh: 论文针对eRASS1巡天曝光不均匀条件下的星系团装配偏置测量，利用两类星系团—星系对计数之比估计相对大尺度偏置，并以星系自相关约束星系偏置、以DES Y3弱透镜检验两组晕质量。摘要报告高、低温样本的质量相容，偏置差为Δb=0.8±1.1，因而没有达到1σ统计显著性的装配偏置证据，但结果仍与FLAMINGO模拟预期相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 装配偏置会改变固定质量下暗物质晕与大尺度结构之间的关系，因而可能影响星系团聚类的宇宙学建模以及由偏置推断物质分布的结果。它与CMB的联系主要是间接的：星系团聚类和弱透镜可与CMB透镜、原初涨落幅度及晚期结构增长约束联合分析，而未建模的装配偏置可能成为此类跨巡天宇宙学分析的系统误差。
key_points: 提出以两类星系团—星系对计数之比测量相对大尺度偏置的方法。
高温与低温子样本在X射线光度、红移和巡天曝光分布上经过匹配。
摘要报告未发现统计显著的装配偏置证据，但测量精度尚不足以排除模拟预期的效应。
methods: eROSITA eRASS1体积受限X射线星系团样本
星系团—星系对计数比与星系自相关的联合聚类分析
按温度划分并匹配X射线光度、红移和曝光分布
DES Y3弱引力透镜质量测量
与FLAMINGO模拟中的类似晕族群比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对非均匀曝光如何进入样本选择、匹配与协方差估计，并检查在4—10 h⁻¹ Mpc尺度采用线性近似是否足以控制非线性偏置；还需确认温度划分在固定光度和质量条件下能否可靠追踪装配历史，以及弱透镜质量不确定性对装配偏置约束的限制。

papers.title: Self-field of a moving string
papers.abstract: We discuss the effectiveness of the recently proposed quantity $J_{s}$ in suppressing the contribution of a string's self-field to its spectrum, which is used in field theory simulations to track the emission of axions by decaying cosmic strings. We compute the contribution of the self-field to the spectrum of this quantity and to the usually computed spectrum of $φ\partial_{t}α$ for an infinitely long straight string. Although we demonstrate that the $J_s$ approach is a substantial improvement, we also point out that this highly symmetric model doesn't capture the full contribution of the self-field to the spectrum emitted by strings of a more complex shape, which are typical in network simulations. We then illustrate this point numerically using a simulation of a sinusoidally perturbed straight string. For this simple configuration, we managed to separate the contribution from the self-field and the radiation to the spectrum of $J_{s}$, using the self-field subtraction method. This allows us to show that the spectrum of $J_{s}$ is still dominated by the $n=1$ mode of the string's oscillation, which can be attributed to the self-field and is largely suppressed when the self-field is removed. We also demonstrate that this mode is predominantly sourced by variations along the direction parallel to the string, which is missing in the unconnected segment model, used by arXiv:2512.13653 to claim the effectiveness of $J_{s}$ in suppressing the self-field's contribution to the spectrum.

analysis.title_zh: 运动弦的自场
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检验用于宇宙弦轴子辐射谱分析的量 Js 能否有效压低弦自场贡献，并通过解析计算无限长直弦以及数值模拟正弦扰动直弦，将自场与辐射成分分离。摘要报告称，Js 虽较传统的 φ∂tα 谱有显著改进，但在扰动弦中仍由可归因于自场的 n=1 模主导，该模在自场减除后大幅受抑。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作直接关系到宇宙弦网络产生轴子的谱及其丰度预测是否受到自场污染，因而影响轴子暗物质和早期宇宙缺陷演化的理论推断。它与 CMB 的联系较间接：宇宙弦可能在 CMB 温度、偏振及非高斯信号中留下印记，而可靠区分弦的近场与真实辐射，有助于建立一致的弦网络演化和多信使宇宙学约束。
key_points: 评估谱量 Js 抑制宇宙弦自场污染的实际效果。
无限长直弦模型显示 Js 有明显改进，但不能代表复杂弦形状。
正弦扰动直弦的 Js 谱仍受自场相关的 n=1 振荡模主导；扣除自场后该模大幅减弱。
methods: 无限长直宇宙弦的自场谱贡献计算
正弦扰动直弦的数值模拟
自场减除方法
比较 Js 与通常采用的 φ∂tα 的谱
分析平行于弦方向的变化对谱模的贡献
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对自场减除方法的定义、数值实现及其系统误差，并确认正弦扰动直弦所得结论能否推广到真实网络中的弯曲弦、闭合环和多尺度结构；还应检查 n=1 模被归因于自场的诊断依据，以及与非连通弦段模型比较时两类模型的初始条件和可观测量是否一致。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Data-Driven Models for GRB X-ray Light-Curve Gap Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Swift-XRT X-ray afterglows of gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) frequently contain temporal gaps that limit the precision with which the Willingale et al. 2007 (W07) plateau parameters measure plateau end time $T_a$, plateau flux $F_a$, and post-plateau decay index $α$. Because these parameters underpin the Dainotti relations (Dainotti et al. 2008, Dainotti et al. 2010, Dainotti et al. 2017), reducing their measurement uncertainty directly improves the cosmological statistical power of GRBs. As the fifth in a series of light-curve reconstruction studies (Dainotti et al. 2023, Manchanda et al. 2025, Kaushal et al. 2026, Gupta et al. 2026), this work benchmarks four models on 545 Swift-XRT GRBs: (i) a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) under seven afterglow priors (Zhang et al. 2006, Nousek et al. 2006); (ii) ReFANN (Wang et al. 2020); (iii) a Siamese dual-branch network (Bromley et al. 1993, Gal et al. 2016); and (iv) Polynomial Quantile Regression (PQR; Koenker et al. 2005). All four methods reduce the fractional uncertainties in $\log T_a$, $\log F_a$, and $α$ relative to the original observations. The PINN broken power-law prior achieves the largest reductions ($\sim41$--$49\%$) at a higher outlier rate ($\sim15$--$20\%$), while ReFANN, the Siamese network, and PQR deliver consistent reductions ($\sim19$--$27\%$) with outlier fractions ($\lesssim4\%$) across a wider morphological range. A reduced-$χ^2$ prior-selection scheme recovers a morphological classification consistent with independent labelling, though without matching the best single-prior reduction. These results provide a systematic benchmark of physics-informed and data-driven reconstruction strategies for irregularly sampled GRB afterglows.

analysis.title_zh: 用于 GRB X 射线光变曲线缺口重建的物理信息神经网络与数据驱动模型
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 Swift-XRT 伽马射线暴 X 射线余辉中的时间缺口，在 545 个 GRB 上比较采用七种余辉先验的 PINN、ReFANN、暹罗网络和多项式分位数回归，以重建光变曲线并改善 W07 平台参数测量。摘要报告四种方法均降低了 log T_a、log F_a 和 α 的相对不确定度，其中 PINN 的折断幂律先验降幅最大但离群率较高，其余方法改善较温和而离群率较低、适用形态更广。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: GRB 平台结束时间、平台流量和平台后衰减指数是构建 Dainotti 关系的基础；若缺口重建能在保持偏差与离群率受控的前提下缩小这些参数的不确定度，可能增强 GRB 作为高红移宇宙学探针的统计能力。它与 CMB 的联系是间接的：GRB 可在不同红移范围提供距离或演化信息，与 CMB 等早期宇宙约束形成互补，但摘要并未报告联合 CMB 分析或具体宇宙学参数约束。
key_points: 在 545 个 Swift-XRT GRB 上比较四类光变曲线缺口重建方法。
四种方法均降低了 W07 平台参数的相对不确定度，但物理先验带来的改善与离群率之间存在权衡。
基于约化 χ² 的先验选择可恢复与独立标注一致的形态分类，但未达到最佳单一先验的降不确定度效果。
methods: 545 个 Swift-XRT 伽马射线暴的 X 射线余辉光变曲线
采用七种余辉先验的物理信息神经网络（PINN）
ReFANN、暹罗双分支网络和多项式分位数回归（PQR）
Willingale et al. 2007（W07）平台参数拟合
基于约化 χ² 的先验选择方案
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对训练、验证与缺口模拟或真实缺失数据的划分方式，防止信息泄漏；还需检查不确定度缩减的定义与校准、离群点判据、七种物理先验的具体形式，以及重建后 Dainotti 关系的散布和宇宙学约束是否确有改善。摘要只报告参数测量层面的收益，尚不足以判断最终宇宙学推断的稳健性。

papers.title: FOSSIL: Thermo-mechanical architecture
papers.abstract: FOSSIL (FTS fOr CMB Spectral diStortIon expLoration) is a proposed ESA M8 mission tailored to measure the spectral distortions of the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) with a sensitivity three orders of magnitude beyond the COBE/FIRAS legacy measurement. Achieving this sensitivity demands an extraordinarily challenging cryogenic architecture: the scientific instrument must be maintained at the lowest achievable temperature (4.5 K), while the detector focal plane assembly operates at 50 mK. This paper presents the thermal architecture of the FOSSIL payload and instrument, from the spacecraft service module at 293 K down to the sub-kelvin detector stage. The thermal design draws on heritage from the Planck and ARIEL missions and relies on a staged passive cooling chain comprising a multi-layer insulation blanket, three V-groove radiators (operating at approximately 130 K, 90 K, and 50 K), and a 25 K actively cooled shield fed by an ESA-provided 4 K cryocooler chain. Sub-kelvin temperatures are achieved via a multi-stage adiabatic demagnetisation refrigerator (ADR) system developed for NewAthena/X-IFU, providing continuous cooling at 1.8 K and 350 mK, and 50 mK with an 80% duty cycle. The Focal Plane Assembly (FPA), which houses four Kinetic Inductance Detector (KID) arrays at 50 mK, is thermally isolated from the 4.5~K bench via a carbon-fibre reinforced polymer (CFRP) hexapod structure with staged heat interception. We present the steady-state thermal budget across all stages, demonstrating comfortable margins at every temperature level, and discuss key thermal design drivers on the Blackbody Internal Reference (BBIR).

analysis.title_zh: FOSSIL：热—机械架构
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍拟议中的 ESA M8 任务 FOSSIL 的载荷与仪器热架构，目标是以较 COBE/FIRAS 高三个数量级的灵敏度测量 CMB 频谱畸变，并将科学仪器和探测器焦平面分别维持在 4.5 K 和 50 mK。摘要称，该设计结合分级被动冷却、4 K 制冷机链和多级绝热去磁制冷系统，稳态热预算在各温区均留有充足裕量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 频谱畸变能够探测早期宇宙能量注入、热史及结构形成等信息，而达到目标灵敏度依赖于对仪器自身热辐射和探测器噪声的严格控制。本文聚焦支撑此类测量的低温工程基础，对评估 FOSSIL 概念的可实现性及其系统误差控制能力具有直接意义。
key_points: 提出从 293 K 服务舱到 50 mK 焦平面的完整分级热架构。
四组 KID 阵列位于 50 mK 焦平面，并通过带分级热截获的 CFRP 六足结构与 4.5 K 光学平台热隔离。
摘要报告各温区的稳态热预算均有充足裕量，并讨论了内部黑体参考源的关键热设计约束。
methods: 多层隔热毯与约工作于 130 K、90 K、50 K 的三级 V 形辐射器组成的被动冷却链
由 ESA 提供的 4 K 制冷机链供冷的 25 K 主动冷却屏
源自 NewAthena/X-IFU 的多级绝热去磁制冷机系统，可在 1.8 K 和 350 mK 连续制冷，并以 80% 占空比提供 50 mK 制冷
使用碳纤维增强聚合物六足支撑及分级热截获，对焦平面组件实施热隔离
各温级的稳态热预算分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对热预算所采用的耗散、寄生热漏和制冷能力假设，以及所谓“充足裕量”在任务全周期和非稳态工况下是否仍成立；还应检查 50 mK 的 80% 占空比如何影响观测效率、内部黑体参考源稳定性及频谱畸变系统误差。

papers.title: Did LZ see modified gravity?
papers.abstract: We investigate whether the recently reported high-energy nuclear recoil event by the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) collaboration can be interpreted as a signal of freeze-in dark matter (DM) in a non-standard cosmological history. We consider DM production from the Standard Model thermal bath during an era of modified expansion preceding Big Bang nucleosynthesis. Requiring consistency with the observed DM abundance, cosmological and collider constraints, we identify viable parameter regions that can accommodate the LZ event. Our results demonstrate the potential of direct detection experiments to probe non-standard cosmological histories and, more broadly, alternative theories of gravity.

analysis.title_zh: LZ 看到了修正引力吗？
analysis.summary_zh: 论文探讨 LUX-ZEPLIN（LZ）合作组近期报告的一个高能核反冲事件，能否解释为非标准宇宙学历史中冻结产生的暗物质信号。摘要称，在大爆炸核合成之前的修正膨胀阶段考虑标准模型热浴产生暗物质，并结合暗物质丰度、宇宙学及对撞机约束后，找到了可容纳该事件的参数区域。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项研究不直接分析 CMB 数据，但把暗物质直接探测与早期宇宙膨胀史联系起来；非标准的前核合成膨胀会改变暗物质生成与遗存丰度，并可能与 CMB 所约束的后期宇宙学参数及暗物质性质形成互补检验。
key_points: 尝试将 LZ 的单个高能核反冲事件解释为冻结产生暗物质。
暗物质生成发生在大爆炸核合成之前的修正膨胀阶段。
摘要报告存在同时满足暗物质丰度、宇宙学和对撞机约束的可行参数区域。
methods: 计算标准模型热浴中的冻结产生暗物质过程。
引入大爆炸核合成之前的非标准宇宙膨胀历史。
联合检验观测暗物质丰度、宇宙学约束和对撞机约束。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对修正膨胀史如何与具体引力理论对应、LZ 单事件的能谱与背景不确定性如何处理，以及所谓可行参数区域对核合成、暗物质丰度和对撞机约束的敏感程度；还应区分“可容纳该事件”与具有统计意义的信号解释。

papers.title: Inelastic Dark Matter at LZ from Radiative Dirac Neutrino Mass Paradigm
papers.abstract: The LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment has reported a high-energy nuclear recoil candidate, LZ230616, at $E_R = 248 \pm 23_{\rm stat} \pm 23_{\rm sys}\,$keV, which is difficult to reconcile with elastic scattering of halo dark matter (DM). Endothermic inelastic scattering offers a natural explanation, but it rests on a nucleon coupling that is off-diagonal rather than diagonal. We show that this feature arises automatically within a radiative Dirac neutrino mass framework. The Standard Model is extended by three right-handed neutrinos (RHNs), a pair of vector-like neutral fermions for each generations, and a scalar sector comprising an inert doublet and a real singlet, governed by a $\mathcal{Z}_2 \times \mathcal{Z}_4$ symmetry. The $\mathcal{Z}_2$ symmetry stabilizes the DM, while the $\mathcal{Z}_4$ symmetry forbids the tree-level Dirac Yukawa coupling together with all renormalizable Majorana mass terms, thereby allowing the generation of Dirac neutrino masses at the one-loop level through a softly broken scalar trilinear coupling `$κ$'. Since the neutral dark-sector fields can be expressed in terms of real scalar mass eigenstates, the $Z$ boson couples to them purely off-diagonally and elastic $Z$-mediated scattering is absent identically rather than simply suppressed. The singlet--doublet mixing induced by `$κ$' governs both the inelastic rate and the one-loop Dirac neutrino mass, which therefore vanish as $κ\to 0$. We find that DM masses in the few hundred GeV to TeV range, with splittings of $\mathcal{O}(340-360)\,$ keV, simultaneously reproduce the observed relic abundance, account for the LZ event and yield neutrino masses of the correct order, while respecting elastic direct-detection limits and all relevant theoretical and experimental constraints. A substantial part of the surviving parameter space lies within reach of DARWIN.

analysis.title_zh: 辐射狄拉克中微子质量框架下 LZ 实验中的非弹性暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 论文构建一个辐射狄拉克中微子质量模型，以吸热型非弹性暗物质散射解释 LZ230616 高能核反冲候选事件，其中对称性和暗扇区结构使 Z 玻色子仅产生非对角耦合。摘要报告，质量处于数百 GeV 至 TeV、劈裂约为 340–360 keV 的暗物质可同时给出观测到的遗迹丰度、该 LZ 事件及正确量级的中微子质量，并满足所考察的约束，部分参数空间可由 DARWIN 探测。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作主要属于粒子暗物质与中微子质量模型研究，并非直接研究 CMB。它与宇宙学的联系在于模型需再现暗物质遗迹丰度，而 CMB 对暗物质总丰度及潜在早期宇宙能量注入提供互补约束；不过摘要没有说明其进行了 CMB 数据分析或计算了具体的 CMB 限制。
key_points: 以吸热型非弹性暗物质散射解释 LZ230616 高能核反冲候选事件。
模型的对称性同时保障暗物质稳定性，并使狄拉克中微子质量在一圈层次产生。
暗物质与 Z 玻色子的耦合纯为非对角形式，因此 Z 介导的弹性散射恒等消失。
methods: 构建具有 Z2×Z4 对称性的辐射狄拉克中微子质量模型
引入三个右手中微子、逐代成对的矢量样中性费米子、惰性双重态和实单态标量
利用软破缺标量三线性耦合 κ 诱导单态—双重态混合及一圈狄拉克中微子质量
联合考察暗物质遗迹丰度、LZ 核反冲事件、弹性直接探测限制以及理论和实验约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：单个 LZ 高能候选事件对应的信号似然与背景处理；约 340–360 keV 质量劈裂及非弹性散射率对晕暗物质速度分布的敏感性；κ 同时控制散射和中微子质量后，满足遗迹丰度与各项约束的参数空间是否需要调节；以及 DARWIN 可检验范围所采用的曝光量、阈值和背景假设。

papers.title: Optical spectroscopy of the VHE flat-spectrum radio quasar PKS 0903-57
papers.abstract: We report new optical spectroscopic results for the gamma-ray blazar PKS~0903$-$57. The optical properties of this source have historically been complicated to establish, due to a bright foreground star separated from the blazar by only 0.67$^{\prime\prime}$. During its strong high-energy (HE) and very high-energy (VHE) gamma-ray flaring period between 2020 and 2022, the Southern African Large Telescope and Very Large Telescope (VLT) took spectra of its optical counterpart. Photometric monitoring with the Rapid Eye Mount (REM) telescope complemented the observations. The observational results were inconclusive. A major improvement was achieved with a repeat of the VLT observations in 2024 using a 0.5$^{\prime\prime}$ slit under excellent seeing conditions. This led to the detection of five narrow emission features in the spectra, yielding a robust redshift measurement of $z$ = 0.2621 $\pm$ 0.0006. We also detected a broad symmetric H$α$ emission component with a full width at half maximum of 4020 $\pm$ 30 km/s in the spectra. Non-thermal jet emission was found to dominate the continuum, supporting the classification of PKS~0903$-$57 as a flat-spectrum radio quasar. Another interesting observation was a significant velocity displacement of $\sim$1500~km/s between the broad H$α$ line and its corresponding narrow line. Such a displacement may be associated with unusual dynamics in the broad-line region or accretion flow, a system containing two supermassive black holes, or a recoiling black hole produced following a supermassive black-hole merger. Building on these results, we carried out additional VLT, REM, and \emph{Swift} observations towards the end of 2024 and during 2025. We present in this paper the preliminary results from the analysis of these new data.

analysis.title_zh: 甚高能平谱射电类星体 PKS 0903-57 的光学光谱研究
analysis.summary_zh: 作者利用 VLT 和南非大望远镜的光学光谱、REM 测光及 Swift 后续观测，研究受近邻明亮前景星严重污染的伽马射线耀变体 PKS 0903-57。2024 年的高质量 VLT 狭缝光谱探测到五条窄发射线并测得稳健红移 z = 0.2621 ± 0.0006，同时发现宽 Hα 成分、喷流主导的连续谱及宽窄线之间约 1500 km/s 的速度偏移，从而支持其平谱射电类星体分类。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要属于高能活动星系核与黑洞吸积研究，并非直接的 CMB 观测或宇宙学参数分析。其可靠红移有助于确定该甚高能伽马射线源的距离并研究伽马射线传播及河外背景光吸收；从 CMB 角度看，耀变体也是微波天空中的点源前景，因此对其喷流性质和多波段变化的认识可间接服务于点源建模与掩膜，但摘要没有开展微波或 CMB 数据分析。
key_points: 在克服近邻明亮前景星污染后，光谱给出红移 z = 0.2621 ± 0.0006。
探测到宽而对称的 Hα 成分，连续谱由非热喷流辐射主导，支持平谱射电类星体分类。
宽、窄 Hα 线之间约 1500 km/s 的速度偏移可能涉及宽线区或吸积流动力学，但其物理起源尚未确定。
methods: 南非大望远镜和甚大望远镜（VLT）光学光谱观测
2024 年在优良视宁度下使用 VLT 0.5 角秒狭缝进行重复观测
Rapid Eye Mount（REM）望远镜测光监测
VLT、REM 与 Swift 的后续多波段观测
窄发射线红移测量及 Hα 线型、线宽和速度偏移分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对前景星与耀变体仅相隔 0.67 角秒时的光谱分离、背景扣除和系统误差处理，以及五条窄发射线的识别是否唯一；还需检查宽、窄 Hα 速度偏移的参考系与拟合稳健性，并区分数据直接支持的结果和双超大质量黑洞、黑洞反冲等推测性解释。摘要称后续数据仅为初步分析，其结论成熟度也需在正文中核实。

papers.title: Forecasting Coupled Dark Energy Parameters with the One-Loop Galaxy Power Spectrum
papers.abstract: We forecast constraints on the parameters of the coupled dark energy model using DESI and Euclid data with the one-loop galaxy power spectrum. We investigate the distinguishability of our model from the zero-coupling scenario at the $1σ$ level and explore how the parameter constraints depend on the fiducial coupling $β_{\rm fid}$, the fixed potential slope parameter $ν$, the maximum wavenumber $k_{\max}$, and different prior choices. We find that the inclusion of mildly non-linear scales improves the constraints on the coupling by roughly a factor of five. Then, we address the question of which is the minimum value of $β$ that can be distinguished from zero at $1σ$. We find that for our reference case $k_{\rm max}=0.2 h/$Mpc, $β=0.15$ lies roughly $1σ$ above zero. In the most optimistic case with $k_{\rm max}=0.3 h/$Mpc and including a Planck prior on $Ω_{m0}$, this value can be reduced to $0.05$. These values are substantially larger than the current constraints on $β$, but the latter have been obtained assuming $β$ to be constant from at least the decoupling epoch to today, while we only employ late-time data. We conclude therefore that only models that allow for time-varying couplings can be detected with late-time datasets.

analysis.title_zh: 利用单圈星系功率谱预报耦合暗能量参数约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文使用 DESI 和 Euclid 的预期数据及单圈星系功率谱，预报耦合暗能量参数约束，并考察基准耦合、势斜率、最大波数和先验选择的影响。摘要报告，加入弱非线性尺度可将耦合约束改善约五倍；参考设置下 β=0.15 约能在 1σ 水平与零区分，最乐观设置下阈值可降至 0.05，并据此认为晚期数据更可能探测到允许耦合随时间变化的模型。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究聚焦暗能量与暗物质之间可能存在的非引力耦合，这类相互作用会改变晚期结构增长并影响由 CMB 确定的早期宇宙参数向低红移观测的外推。它也说明 Planck 参数先验与 DESI、Euclid 大尺度结构信息的互补性，但本文依据摘要主要使用晚期巡天预报，并非直接开展 CMB 数据分析。
key_points: 利用 DESI 与 Euclid 的预期数据约束耦合暗能量参数。
纳入弱非线性尺度后，耦合参数约束据摘要称可改善约五倍。
仅凭晚期数据，能够与零耦合区分的耦合强度仍高于恒定耦合模型的现有约束。
methods: 单圈星系功率谱
DESI 与 Euclid 数据预报
改变基准耦合 β_fid、固定势斜率参数 ν、最大波数 k_max 和先验的敏感性分析
在乐观情形中加入 Planck 对 Ω_m0 的先验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对单圈建模在 k_max=0.2 和 0.3 h/Mpc 处的适用性、理论误差与星系偏置等参数如何处理，以及所谓“1σ 可区分”采用的统计定义。还需确认将结果解释为偏好时变耦合时，是否充分考虑了恒定耦合现有约束与本文晚期数据预报在数据组合和模型假设上的差异。

papers.title: Field-Level Baryon Acoustic Oscillation Reconstruction of the DESI DR1 Luminous Red Galaxies with Linear Field Transformer (LiFT)
papers.abstract: We present the first application of neural field-level baryon-acoustic oscillation (BAO) reconstruction to real spectroscopic survey data. We develop Linear Field Transformer (LiFT), a 3D vision transformer that takes as input the observed galaxy field, its standard reconstruction, and a set of context channels encoding local line of sight, survey coverage, and redshift, and learns to correct standard reconstruction toward the linear density field. We construct a forward-modeling pipeline to produce mock lightcones similar to the DESI Data Release 1 (DR1) luminous red galaxy (LRG) sample, and train LiFT on these. We validate LiFT on held-out simulations, as well as on additional mocks which differ in gravity solver, halo finder, HOD, cosmology, and fiber-assignment history, as well as on mocks analyzed with a distorted distance-redshift relation; ultimately, we find unbiased dilation parameters with consistently tighter constraints than standard reconstruction. Applied to the DESI DR1 LRGs, LiFT improves errors on $α_{\rm iso}$ by 13%, 24%, and 30% and on $α_{\rm AP}$ by 5%, 22%, and 30% relative to the DESI DR1 standard reconstruction analysis in the LRG1, LRG2, and LRG3 bins respectively; meanwhile, our DR1 central values remain consistent with DR1 and DR2. This equates to a factor of 1.2, 1.7 and 2.0 increase in Figure of Merit (or effective survey volume) if one were to only use standard reconstruction. Ultimately, these results establish LiFT as a validated, survey-ready tool for current and upcoming galaxy surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 使用线性场 Transformer（LiFT）对 DESI DR1 亮红星系进行场级重子声学振荡重建
analysis.summary_zh: 论文提出三维视觉 Transformer LiFT，利用观测星系场、标准 BAO 重建结果和巡天几何等上下文信息，将重建场校正得更接近线性密度场，并在面向 DESI DR1 LRG 的模拟光锥及多种替代模拟上训练和验证。摘要报告 LiFT 给出无偏的膨胀参数，并在 DESI DR1 的 LRG1、LRG2、LRG3 区间中相对标准重建将 α_iso 误差分别改善 13%、24%、30%，将 α_AP 误差分别改善 5%、22%、30%，中心值与 DR1 和 DR2 一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: BAO 与 CMB 分别约束晚期和早期宇宙的标准尺：更精确的 BAO 距离测量可与 CMB 声学尺度联合，用于检验膨胀历史、暗能量模型及空间几何。该工作若能在严格系统误差控制下稳定提高 DESI 的 BAO 精度，将增强 CMB 与低红移大尺度结构数据的联合约束能力；同时，其对模拟训练依赖和域偏移的处理也关系到机器学习方法能否可靠进入精密宇宙学分析。
key_points: 首次将神经网络场级 BAO 重建应用于真实光谱巡天数据。
LiFT 在多类分布外模拟样本及畸变距离-红移关系下进行验证，摘要报告其膨胀参数无偏且约束更紧。
在 DESI DR1 三个 LRG 红移区间中，摘要报告其对 α_iso 和 α_AP 的误差均有不同程度改善。
methods: 三维视觉 Transformer（Linear Field Transformer，LiFT）
输入观测星系场、标准重建场及局部视线方向、巡天覆盖和红移等上下文通道
面向 DESI DR1 LRG 样本的前向建模模拟光锥训练流程
留出模拟及改变引力求解器、暗物质晕识别器、HOD、宇宙学和光纤分配历史的额外模拟验证
采用畸变距离-红移关系的模拟检验
DESI DR1 亮红星系光谱数据
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：训练模拟与真实 DESI 数据之间的域偏移如何控制；“无偏”检验覆盖了哪些宇宙学参数范围及系统误差；误差改善是否包含网络训练、模拟有限性与协方差估计的不确定性；与标准重建比较时两者的数据选择、拟合模型和尺度范围是否完全一致。还应检查在不同模拟体系上的稳健性是否足以支持其“survey-ready”结论，以及 DR1 数据分析是否采用了盲化或预先固定的分析流程。

papers.title: Boosted or Inelastic? Discriminating Interpretations of the LZ 248 keV Event
papers.abstract: The LUX-ZEPLIN experiment has reported a single nuclear recoil candidate at $E_R = 248 \pm 23(\mathrm{stat}) \pm 23(\mathrm{sys})$~keV, disfavouring the background-only hypothesis at a global significance of $2.6σ$. The difficulty such an event poses is not the recoil energy itself but the absence of any accompanying excess at low energy as elastic scattering of halo dark matter yields a monotonically falling spectrum, and supplying the required momentum transfer $q \simeq 246$~MeV already demands $m_χ\gtrsim 79$~GeV. We confront the event with the two kinematically distinct mechanisms that evade this limitation, endothermic inelastic dark matter, in which a mass splitting $δ\sim \mathcal{O}(100)$~keV forbids low-energy recoils and boosted dark matter, in which a light relativistic flux supplies the momentum, treating both with the same model-independent scalar--scalar, pseudoscalar--scalar and pseudoscalar--pseudoscalar effective operators. The two scenarios prove spectrally distinguishable. The inelastic spectra sit near the observed energy for every operator, placing only $6$--$17\%$ of events below 150~keV, whereas the boosted spectra depend critically on the operator: the scalar and pseudoscalar--scalar interactions place $99\%$ and $92\%$ of their events below 150~keV, while the pseudoscalar--pseudoscalar interaction places $75\%$ above it. Momentum dependence is thus essential to the boosted interpretation, but in the inelastic case it trades against the splitting, the preferred $δ$ decreasing monotonically from $\mathcal{O}_{ss}$ to $\mathcal{O}_{ps}$ to $\mathcal{O}_{pp}$. Because the scenarios differ across the whole high-energy window, a handful of additional events would separate them, placing the question within reach of the full LZ exposure.

analysis.title_zh: 加速还是非弹性？区分 LZ 248 keV 事件的不同解释
analysis.summary_zh: 论文针对 LZ 报告的单个约 248 keV 核反冲候选事件，在相同的三类有效算符框架下比较吸热型非弹性暗物质与加速暗物质解释。摘要报告称，非弹性情景的能谱普遍集中在观测能区，而加速暗物质的谱形高度依赖动量结构，因此后续高能区事件有望区分两种机制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作不直接研究 CMB，而是利用地下直接探测实验检验暗物质微观性质。它与 CMB/宇宙学的联系在于：非弹性质量劈裂、相互作用算符以及相对论性加速暗物质通量都可能对应不同的早期宇宙产生史、暗物质丰度与能量注入约束；若高能核反冲信号得到确认，可为仅凭 CMB 难以确定的暗物质粒子属性提供互补信息。不过，摘要没有实际联合 CMB 数据或计算宇宙学约束，因此对 CMB 读者主要属于间接相关。
key_points: 研究对象是 LZ 报告的单个 248 keV 核反冲候选事件。
吸热型非弹性暗物质在三类有效算符下均可抑制低能反冲；加速暗物质的谱形则强烈依赖算符的动量结构。
摘要认为，未来增加少量高能区事件即可从谱形上区分两种解释。
methods: 对吸热型非弹性暗物质与加速暗物质进行统一的运动学和反冲能谱比较
采用标量-标量、赝标量-标量和赝标量-赝标量三类模型无关有效算符
比较不同情景及算符在 150 keV 以下和以上的事件比例
使用 LUX-ZEPLIN（LZ）高能核反冲候选事件及其完整曝光前景
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：事件比例和“少量新增事件即可区分”的结论如何纳入 LZ 的能量依赖效率、核响应、能量分辨率与背景不确定性；有效算符处理是否满足所用动量转移范围内的有效场论适用条件；加速暗物质通量和非弹性暗物质速度分布采用了哪些假设，以及结论对这些假设是否稳健。

papers.title: Gravitating sources with zero energy density in cosmology
papers.abstract: A cosmological source can have identically zero comoving energy density and still gravitate through its pressure. This differs from an energy density passing through zero at an isolated time. Maintaining zero density with nonzero pressure requires energy exchange in a nonstatic FLRW universe. We construct proportional-pressure and constant-pressure backgrounds, including steady-state, bouncing, recollapsing, and $Λ$CDM expansion histories, and relate them to creation pressure, bulk viscosity, and time-dependent vacuum descriptions. Scalar fields can realize zero density along a trajectory; imposing it as an identity on a timelike $P(X,φ)$ domain selects $P=A(φ)\sqrt{X}$, locally a signed potential-free cuscuton for nonzero $A$. We formulate linear perturbations without dividing by the vanishing background density. For a nondegenerate $P(X,φ)$ scalar with a timelike field gradient, zero density and negative pressure cannot coexist with positive kinetic and gradient coefficients when the interaction leaves its principal kinetic structure unchanged. Two models couple the scalar to number-conserving dust through a field-dependent mass. The proportional-pressure trajectory is a homogeneous saddle and has no growing power-law dust mode on its accelerating branch in the matter-sourced quasistatic subhorizon approximation. A distinct constant-pressure model reproduces the $Λ$CDM expansion history, but in the same approximation the dust mode that initially grows during matter domination reaches a maximum at low redshift and then decays. These restrictions apply to the stated scalar class and models. Exact Bianchi I solutions demonstrate separately conserved zero-density sources supported by anisotropic stress. An inverse-pressure construction distinguishes the density of an interacting constituent from an inferred dark-energy density that may cross zero.

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙学中能量密度为零的引力源
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究共动能量密度恒为零但压力非零的宇宙学源，构造多类 FLRW 背景、标量场实现和线性扰动框架。摘要报告称，这类源可产生引力效应，但在所研究的 P(X,φ) 标量场及尘埃耦合模型中受到稳定性和结构增长限制；另有精确 Bianchi I 解表明，各向异性应力可支撑独立守恒的零密度源。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接涉及暗能量的微观建模、背景膨胀与物质扰动增长之间的一致性。对 CMB 研究而言，其相关性主要是间接的：若零密度压力源改变晚期膨胀、引力势演化或结构增长，就可能影响 CMB 距离尺度、晚期积分 Sachs–Wolfe 效应和 CMB 透镜；但摘要没有给出 CMB 功率谱计算或与观测数据的比较。
key_points: 共动能量密度恒为零的源仍可通过非零压力产生引力效应。
在非静态 FLRW 宇宙中维持零密度与非零压力，需要与其他组分交换能量。
特定标量场模型受到稳定性与结构增长约束；各向异性应力则可支撑独立守恒的零密度源。
methods: 构造比例压力与常压力的 FLRW 背景，包括稳态、反弹、再坍缩和 ΛCDM 膨胀史
分析具有类时梯度的 P(X,φ) 标量场及其零密度恒等条件
在不除以零背景密度的前提下建立线性扰动方程
在物质源准静态亚视界近似下分析尘埃密度扰动模式
研究通过场依赖质量与粒子数守恒尘埃耦合的两个模型
构造精确 Bianchi I 解与逆压力模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：零密度条件究竟是沿特定背景轨迹成立，还是在整个类时 P(X,φ) 定义域内作为恒等式成立；能量交换项如何满足总能动量守恒；关于鬼与梯度稳定性的排除结论依赖哪些“非退化”和“主部不变”假设；结构增长结果对准静态、亚视界及物质源近似有多敏感。还应区分相互作用组分的实际密度与由背景膨胀反演得到、可能过零的暗能量密度。

papers.title: Bayesian Inference of the Tip of the Red Giant Branch: I. One-Dimensional Analysis
papers.abstract: The tip of the red giant branch (TRGB) can be used as a relative distance measure as part of the cosmic distance ladder to infer the Hubble constant. We present a Bayesian framework for TRGB inference that incorporates selection effects and propagates per-star uncertainties, modelling the observed catalogue as a realisation of an inhomogeneous Poisson point process which includes the RGB and contamination from the asymptotic giant branch (AGB). We derive expressions for the predicted TRGB uncertainty in terms of the photometric noise, stellar density fainter than the tip, and the ratio of the AGB to AGB+RGB number densities, $r$. We validate these using synthetic data from a simplified luminosity function. Applying the full model to synthetic catalogues, we find that the dependence on $r$ is the strongest of the three, and that reliable inference requires $r \lesssim 0.5$; beyond this, the posterior is multimodal, and the TRGB cannot reliably be identified. We then fit data from 11 Hubble Space Telescope fields of the calibrator galaxy NGC 4258. We find intrinsic field-to-field scatter beyond measurement noise of $τ= 0.067^{+0.023}_{-0.017}$ mag, and a galaxy-level, extinction-corrected TRGB magnitude of $25.324 \pm 0.026$. Combining this with the maser distance to NGC 4258, we determine the absolute magnitude of the TRGB to be ${M}_{\rm{F814W}}^{\rm{TRGB}} = -4.073 \pm 0.026$ (tip) $ \pm$ $0.032$ (dist), consistent with, but brighter than, other recent analyses of the same data.

analysis.title_zh: 红巨星分支尖端的贝叶斯推断：I. 一维分析
analysis.summary_zh: 论文将含 RGB 与 AGB 污染的恒星目录建模为非齐次泊松点过程，以贝叶斯方法纳入选择效应并传播逐星不确定性；合成数据表明污染比例 r 的影响最强，且摘要报告 r≳0.5 时后验会呈多峰、TRGB 难以可靠识别。作者进一步拟合 NGC 4258 的 11 个 HST 视场，报告消光校正后的星系级 TRGB 视星等为 25.324±0.026，并结合脉泽距离得到 F814W 波段绝对星等 −4.073±0.026（尖端）±0.032（距离）。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: TRGB 是宇宙距离阶梯中独立于造父变星的重要距离指标，其标定会影响本地哈勃常数 H₀ 的推断，并进而关系到早期宇宙 CMB 推断与晚期距离阶梯测量之间的一致性检验。本文尤其强调污染、选择效应和视场间散布对 TRGB 标定的影响，因此对评估 H₀ 比较中的天体物理系统误差具有直接意义；但摘要没有进行 CMB 数据分析。
key_points: 建立了纳入选择效应、逐星测光不确定性及 AGB 污染的 TRGB 贝叶斯推断框架。
合成数据分析显示，AGB 与 AGB+RGB 数密度之比 r 是三项误差控制因素中影响最强的；摘要称可靠推断需要 r≲0.5。
对 NGC 4258 的 11 个 HST 视场进行联合分析，并结合脉泽距离给出 TRGB 绝对星等标定。
methods: 非齐次泊松点过程建模
贝叶斯推断与逐星不确定性传播
选择效应建模
简化光度函数生成的合成数据验证
11 个 NGC 4258 哈勃空间望远镜视场
NGC 4258 脉泽距离标定
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：选择函数和 RGB/AGB 光度函数的具体参数化是否足够灵活；r≲0.5 的可靠性界限对合成数据假设、先验和模型失配有多敏感；视场间内禀散布如何纳入星系级结果；以及测光零点、消光、拥挤和脉泽距离等系统误差是否被完整传播。还需注意，这篇“I”仅是一维分析，其适用范围不应自动外推到颜色—星等图的更高维建模。

papers.title: NICER neutron stars with dark energy and dark matter: effects on the inferred equation of state
papers.abstract: [Abridged] In this work, we compare neutron stars where dark energy or dark matter are present in the core, contrasting them against purely baryonic stars with the same central energy density. From this comparison, we find that the dark energy models are more constrained by neutron star observations than the dark matter models, suggesting that neutron stars can place strong constraints on dark energy parameters. We consider four configurations: purely baryonic neutron stars described by a piecewise polytropic (PP) equation of state (EoS), baryonic stars admixed with bosonic or fermionic asymmetric dark matter (ADM) cores, and stars with a dark energy core and baryonic shell, where the dark energy is described by the modified Chaplygin dark fluid (MCDF). Using the masses and radii of PSR J0740$+$6620, PSR J0437$-$4715, and PSR J0030$+$0451, we employ Bayesian inference to investigate how accounting for bosonic/fermionic ADM and MCDF cores affects the inferred neutron star properties. We find that MCDF cores, more than PP and ADM admixed models, substantially broaden neutron star mass-radius and pressure-energy density posterior distributions. Moreover, the MCDF EoS parameters can be tightly constrained. While bosonic and fermionic ADM cores decrease the inferred maximum mass, their posteriors strongly coincide with those of the PP model for ADM mass-fractions $F_χ\leq 5\%$. These results demonstrate that current mass-radius observations cannot rule out MCDF cores, but they can constrain the MCDF parameter space to narrow regions. ADM admixed neutron stars, however, remain observationally identical to purely baryonic stars for all explored mass-fractions, even with improved mass-radius uncertainties. This suggests that mass-radius measurements alone are insufficient to detect ADM core inside neutron stars and that independent astrophysical or particle physics probes will be required.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 7 figures. Constructive feedback/comments are welcome

analysis.title_zh: NICER 中子星中的暗能量与暗物质：对推断状态方程的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 论文利用三颗脉冲星的质量—半径观测进行贝叶斯推断，比较纯重子中子星、含玻色或费米非对称暗物质核的混合星，以及具有修正 Chaplygin 暗流体核的模型。摘要报告暗能量核模型明显拓宽恒星性质与状态方程的后验分布但其参数可被限制，而所探索的暗物质混合模型在质量—半径观测上仍与纯重子模型难以区分。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的联系主要是间接的：CMB 在宇宙学尺度约束暗物质和暗能量，而中子星提供强引力、高密度环境下的互补检验，可用于考察相关暗成分模型是否具有可观测的致密天体效应。论文也提示，至少对所研究的非对称暗物质核，仅凭中子星质量—半径数据可能难以打破退化，因此需要与粒子物理或其他天体物理探针联合；摘要并未讨论 CMB 数据或开展联合宇宙学分析。
key_points: 比较纯重子星、含玻色或费米非对称暗物质核的中子星，以及具有修正 Chaplygin 暗流体核的中子星。
摘要报告，暗能量核显著拓宽质量—半径及压强—能量密度的后验分布，同时其状态方程参数仍可受到较强约束。
在所探索的暗物质质量分数范围内，仅靠质量—半径测量难以区分暗物质混合星与纯重子星。
methods: 分段多方状态方程
玻色与费米非对称暗物质核模型
修正 Chaplygin 暗流体模型
基于 PSR J0740+6620、PSR J0437−4715 和 PSR J0030+0451 质量与半径数据的贝叶斯推断
质量—半径和压强—能量密度后验分布比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对贝叶斯分析中的先验选择、不同模型参数量带来的后验体积效应，以及“MCDF 参数受到紧约束”对状态方程参数化和中心能量密度假设的依赖；还需检查所谓改进质量—半径误差的具体设定，以及暗物质模型不可区分的结论是否仅适用于摘要所探索的质量分数和粒子参数范围。

papers.title: The Connection between Halo Assembly History and the Stellar Distribution I: The Central Stellar Mass - Richness Plane
papers.abstract: Recent observations suggest intrinsic links between the stellar components of massive halos and their assembly histories. Using massive halos with $\log[M_{\rm halo}/M_\odot] \geq 13.0$ from the IllustrisTNG-300 simulation, we explore differences in secondary halo properties between samples selected by central galaxy stellar mass and satellite richness. For group-like masses, we find that halos selected by the outskirts stellar mass of their central galaxies between 50 and 100 kpc ($M_{\star,[50,100]}$) have similar halo mass distributions to those selected by intrinsic satellite richness ($λ_{10, R_{200}}$), but differ significantly in assembly history: $M_{\star,[50,100]}$-selected halos are more concentrated and formed earlier. At higher masses ($\sim10^{14}~M_\odot$), intrinsic richness becomes the better halo-mass proxy, but only when projection effects are ignored. We find that the difference-set test selects comparable halo-mass samples most effectively when the two proxies have similar scatter. Projection effects and baryonic physics do not alter the main trends but remain important caveats for observational applications. Our findings show that the central stellar mass-richness plane is a powerful tool for selecting halos with particular accretion histories, offering new insights into the galaxy-halo connection in the era of deep imaging and precision lensing surveys such as Euclid and LSST.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 15 figures, 1 table, submitted to ApJ

analysis.title_zh: 暗物质晕组装历史与恒星分布的联系 I：中心星系恒星质量—丰富度平面
