papers.title: A Vector-Like Lepton Interpretation of the High-Energy Nuclear Recoil Candidate in LUX-ZEPLIN
papers.abstract: The LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment has recently reported a nuclear-recoil candidate at $E_R=248\pm23_{\rm stat}\pm23_{\rm sys}\,{\rm keV}$ in an exposure of $2.84\,{\rm tonne\,yr}$. At this unusually high recoil energy, the spin-independent (SI) xenon response is strongly suppressed, motivating dark matter interactions with a harder recoil spectrum. We show that elastic spin-dependent (SD) scattering through the nonrelativistic operator $\mathcal O_4=\mathbf S_{\rm DM}\cdot\mathbf S_N$ provides a simple realization of such a spectrum. We consider singlet-doublet Majorana dark matter, for which a diagonal $Z$ coupling generates the required SD interaction. The accompanying Higgs-mediated SI interaction would generically produce too many low-energy recoils, but can be suppressed along a Higgs blind spot while retaining a nonzero $Z$ coupling. We find a region of the Higgs blind spot that simultaneously predicts an $\mathcal O(1)$ event rate in the LZ high-recoil window and reproduces the observed thermal relic abundance. The same SD interaction leads to solar capture, allowing this region to be tested independently with solar-neutrino searches. Current IceCube limits already probe part of the LZ-compatible thermal parameter space, while a viable region remains. Additional xenon exposure and improved solar-neutrino searches can therefore provide complementary tests of this interpretation.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, lots of fun. Comments welcome!

analysis.title_zh: LUX-ZEPLIN 中高能核反冲候选事件的矢量样轻子解释
analysis.summary_zh: 本文尝试解释 LUX-ZEPLIN 实验报告的一个高能核反冲候选事件，动机是通常的自旋无关氙响应在该能区受抑而需要更硬的反冲谱。作者考察 singlet-doublet Majorana 暗物质，通过 Z 介导的自旋相关散射产生候选事件，并在 Higgs blind spot 中避免过多低能反冲；摘要称仍有与热遗迹丰度相容且可被 IceCube 和未来太阳中微子搜索检验的参数空间。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文属于粒子宇宙学和暗物质直接探测，对 CMB 读者的关联主要在于暗物质候选体的宇宙学丰度和互作用模型。CMB 本身没有在摘要中作为数据约束出现，但热遗迹丰度和暗物质性质是连接早期宇宙、结构形成与直接探测结果的共同问题。
key_points: 围绕 LZ 报告的高能核反冲候选事件，提出具有更硬反冲谱的暗物质解释。
模型为 singlet-doublet Majorana 暗物质，通过 Z 介导的自旋相关弹性散射产生高反冲事件。
摘要称 Higgs blind spot 可抑制低能自旋无关反冲，同时保留热遗迹丰度和可由太阳中微子搜索检验的参数区。
methods: LUX-ZEPLIN 高能核反冲候选事件解释
非相对论算符 O4 = S_DM · S_N
singlet-doublet Majorana dark matter 模型
Z 介导自旋相关散射
Higgs-mediated 自旋无关相互作用与 Higgs blind spot
热遗迹丰度约束
太阳俘获与 IceCube 太阳中微子限制
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 LZ 单个高能候选事件的统计解释是否稳健、背景建模和 look-elsewhere 问题如何处理，以及 Higgs blind spot 区域是否同时满足直接探测、太阳中微子、热遗迹和其他粒子物理约束；不要仅凭摘要把该事件视为暗物质证据。

papers.title: Optical Depths from the Thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich Effect with ACT DR6 and DESI DR1 Spectroscopic Galaxies and Optically-Selected Clusters
papers.abstract: We present stacked thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (tSZ) effect measurements for three samples of galaxy groups and clusters: those traced by the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Intstrument Data Release 1 (DESI DR1) luminous red galaxies (LRG) and the DESI DR1 Bright Galaxy Sample (BGS), and an eROMaPPer optically-selected sample from the DESI Legacy Imaging Survey. We use the latest Atacama Cosmology Telescope DR6 (ACT)+Planck component-separated internal linear combination (ILC) Compton-$y$ maps and ACT+Planck coadded 90, 150, and 220 GHz temperature maps to extract the tSZ signal within a $\sim2'$ disk aperture for sources binned by luminosity, richness, or mass. We measure the average tSZ signal with high statistical significance, with signal-to-noise ratios surpassing 38 for LRG, 27 for BGS, and 39 for the eROMaPPer sample using the 90 GHz ACT DR6+Planck map. We conduct a detailed study of systematics and foregrounds such as dust and cosmic infrared background (CIB) contamination, which remain a core challenge for tSZ analysis. For the LRG and BGS samples, we find that dust and radio source emission dominate the tSZ signal at scales near and below the disk aperture radius. Large-scale ($R>4'$) contamination from the CIB is less significant. We mitigate these contaminants to isolate the tSZ signal and use a combination of simulated and real measurements to develop Compton-$y-$optical depth ($\bar y-\bar τ$) scaling relations to infer optical depths, which are found to be in agreement with values measured using the pairwise kinematic SZ effect for the same tracer samples. The $\bar y-\bar τ$ scaling relation for the eROMaPPer sample is the first such relationship to be derived directly from SZ measurements.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 22 figures, submitted to Physical Review D

analysis.title_zh: 利用 ACT DR6 和 DESI DR1 光谱星系及光学选取星系团通过热 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 效应测量光学深度
analysis.summary_zh: 本文使用 ACT DR6+Planck 的 Compton-y 图和多频温度图，对 DESI DR1 LRG、BGS 以及 eROMaPPer 光学选取样本进行约 2 角分孔径内的堆叠 tSZ 测量，并研究尘埃、射电源和 CIB 等前景。摘要报告了高显著性的平均 tSZ 信号，经过污染缓解后建立了 y–光学深度标度关系，其结果与相同示踪样本的成对运动学 kSZ 光学深度一致，并为 eROMaPPer 样本给出了据称首个直接由 SZ 测量导出的此类关系。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: tSZ 和 kSZ 都是 CMB 的次级各向异性，前者追踪电子压强，后者可提供电子散射光学深度及气体分布信息。该工作把 ACT 的 CMB 观测与 DESI 的大规模星系、星系团样本结合起来，并系统处理小尺度前景，对从 CMB 研究低质量晕中的重子物理、星系团气体以及再电离和大尺度结构相关问题具有方法学价值。
key_points: 利用 ACT DR6+Planck 的 Compton-y 和多频温度图，测量三类 DESI 星系与光学星系团样本的堆叠 tSZ 信号。
尘埃和射电源排放在 LRG、BGS 样本的小尺度上主导污染；CIB 在大于约 4 角分尺度上的影响较弱。
建立 Compton-y–光学深度标度关系，所得光学深度与同类示踪样本的成对运动学 kSZ 测量一致；eROMaPPer 样本的关系据摘要称为首次直接由 SZ 测量得到。
methods: ACT DR6+Planck 分离分量内部线性组合（ILC）Compton-y 图
ACT DR6+Planck 合并的 90、150、220 GHz 温度图
约 2 角分圆盘孔径内的 tSZ 堆叠测量
按光度、丰富度或质量分箱
尘埃、射电源和 CIB 前景与系统误差分析
模拟与真实测量相结合建立 Compton-y–光学深度标度关系
DESI DR1 LRG、BGS、DESI Legacy Imaging Survey 的 eROMaPPer 光学星系团样本
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对前景建模与去除的具体假设、不同孔径和频段下的稳定性，以及由 y 转换为光学深度时模拟校准和气体物理模型的依赖；还需确认与 kSZ 光学深度的一致性是在何种协方差和样本匹配条件下得到的。

papers.title: Why Azimuthal Averaging Works in Halo Lensing: Symmetry and Power Counting for Nonlinear Shear and Magnification
papers.abstract: Cluster weak-lensing analyses often compress two-dimensional lensing fields into azimuthally averaged radial profiles and evaluate nonlinear observables from the averaged convergence and shear. However, the ring average of a nonlinear observable generally differs from the mean-field prediction formed from the averaged fields. This difference, divided by the mean-field prediction, defines the fractional residual. For a complete ring, the difference begins at second order in angular fluctuations. For centered elliptical halos, rotational symmetry makes the shape contribution even in signed ellipticity, while the leading miscentering dipole is orthogonal to the shape quadrupole. We test these predictions using projected triaxial NFW halos at six mass-redshift grid points spanning $3\leq M_{200\mathrm c}/(10^{14}\,h^{-1}M_\odot)\leq20$ and $0.2\leq z_l\leq0.5$, for $z_s=1$. For the reference offset model, centering offsets follow a Rayleigh distribution with scale $0.05r_{200\mathrm c}$. For $0.366\leq R/r_{200\mathrm c}\leq1$, where at least $95\%$ of each population satisfies a conservative subcriticality criterion, we calculate the median of the fractional residuals across the retained halos for each population and radius. The largest population-median magnitudes are $0.90\%$ for reduced shear, $0.0093\%$ for inverse magnification, $0.64\%$ for magnification, and $0.18\%$ across the two magnification-bias cases $μ^{α-1}$ ($α=0.3, 1.4$). In the paired calculation at $z_s=2$, the maximum magnitude increases for every observable, consistent with weak-lensing power counting. Across both source planes and the common radial domain, every population median remains below $2\%$ in magnitude. This accuracy follows from first-order cancellation, rotational symmetry, and harmonic orthogonality, with further weak-lensing suppression of the remaining nonlinear terms.
papers.comment: Submitted to ApJ; 30 pages (including appendices), 5 figures, 3 tables

analysis.title_zh: 暗晕透镜中方位平均为何有效：非线性剪切与放大率的对称性和幂次计数
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究将二维星系团弱透镜场压缩为方位平均径向剖面后，用平均会聚和剪切计算非线性观测量所产生的偏差，并通过对称性与弱透镜幂次计数说明完整环上的一阶角向涨落会抵消。摘要报告，投影三轴 NFW 暗晕检验中，在指定公共径向范围及两个源红移下，各总体分数残差的中位数幅度均低于 2%。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接关系到星系团弱透镜质量标定中常用的一维径向压缩是否会对约化剪切、放大率和放大偏置引入系统误差。它并非直接研究 CMB，但其对非线性平均偏差、暗晕非球对称性和定心误差的分析可服务于星系团宇宙学；对于依赖弱透镜质量标定的 CMB 星系团样本，以及需要比较星系弱透镜与 CMB 透镜质量估计的研究，也具有方法学参考价值。
key_points: 完整方位环平均使非线性观测量与平均场预测之差从角向涨落的二阶开始。
旋转对称性与不同角谐波的正交性进一步抑制椭率和偏心引起的修正。
摘要报告，在所考察的公共径向范围和两个源红移下，各总体的残差中位数幅度均低于 2%。
methods: 对完整方位环上的非线性弱透镜观测量进行对称性分析与弱透镜幂次计数
采用投影三轴 NFW 暗晕，在六个质量—红移网格点上进行检验
以尺度为 0.05 r_{200c} 的瑞利分布模拟定心偏移
比较约化剪切、逆放大率、放大率及两种放大偏置观测量
在源红移 z_s=1 和配对的 z_s=2 情形下，统计保留暗晕的分数残差中位数
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：分数残差的具体定义及分母接近零时的处理；“完整环”与实际掩膜、有限视场和非均匀权重之间的差异；亚临界筛选是否改变暗晕总体；三轴 NFW、椭率与偏心模型对结果的敏感性；以及总体中位数较小是否掩盖了单个暗晕残差分布的宽尾。

papers.title: Weak cool core, weak turbulence: XRISM, XMM-Newton and Chandra spectroscopy of the core of Abell 1413
papers.abstract: We present the first XRISM spectroscopy of the core of Abell 1413 (z = 0.143), combining 104.7 ks of Resolve with archival XMM-Newton and Chandra spectra of a matched sky region. A1413 is hot, massive and relaxed but lacks a strong cool core (t_cool = 6.4 Gyr), a regime in which the low turbulence reported to date has been tested only once, in A3571. The Resolve spectrum requires a single velocity-broadened component with kT = 7.06 (+0.33, -0.43) keV and a line-of-sight velocity dispersion sigma_v = 170 (+25, -24) km/s (M_3D = 0.217). The bulk velocity relative to the brightest cluster galaxy, v_bulk = -24 +/- 26 (z_ICM) +/- 71 (z_BCG) km/s, is limited by the optical redshift rather than by Resolve, and disfavours coherent line-of-sight sloshing. The non-thermal pressure fraction, 2.5 +/- 0.7 per cent, implies a hydrostatic mass bias b < 2.5 per cent, comparable to the strong cool-core cluster A2029 (2.6 +/- 0.3 per cent) and, at matched sampling scale, if anything below it. With A3571 (1.3 +/- 0.3 per cent), to which A1413 rescales within 0.2 sigma, two weak cool cores now show that this quiescence does not require central cooling. The resolved Fe-K He-alpha complex gives Fe = 0.38 +/- 0.03 (stat) +/- 0.04 (sys) solar; Ni/Fe, separated from Fe K-beta for the first time, is solar, as is the pattern as a whole. The Ne, Mg and Si lines that set Ne/Fe, Mg/Fe and Si/Fe lie below 2 keV, where our instruments disagree by 10-20 per cent; we therefore do not regard the SNIa fraction as constrained.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to MNRAS

analysis.title_zh: 弱冷核，弱湍流：XRISM、XMM-Newton 与 Chandra 对 Abell 1413 核心的光谱学研究
analysis.summary_zh: 本文结合 104.7 ks 的 XRISM Resolve 观测以及 XMM-Newton、Chandra 档案光谱，研究缺乏强冷核的星系团 Abell 1413 核心区的热力学、速度和元素丰度。摘要报告了较低的速度弥散、约 2.5% 的非热压分数和较小的静水平衡质量偏差，并指出两个弱冷核星系团的低湍流并不需要中心冷却；由于软 X 射线线的仪器不一致，SNIa 比例未被认为受到约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团是宇宙学质量标尺，气体湍流和非热压会影响由 X 射线静水平衡推断的星系团质量，进而影响物质密度和结构增长研究。虽然本文不直接分析 CMB，但其对星系团质量偏差、热气体物理和 X 射线交叉校准的结果，关系到 CMB 与星系团联合宇宙学约束的系统误差控制。
key_points: 首次报告 XRISM 对 Abell 1413 核心区域的 Resolve 光谱观测，并结合 XMM-Newton 与 Chandra 数据。
该缺乏强冷核的星系团显示低湍流和很低的非热压支持。
观测到的低湍流并不要求中心存在强冷却，且系统性不确定性限制了 SNIa 比例判断。
methods: 使用 104.7 ks 的 XRISM Resolve 光谱。
结合匹配天空区域的档案 XMM-Newton 和 Chandra 光谱。
对 Resolve 光谱进行单一速度展宽热成分建模。
利用 Fe-K He-alpha 复合体测量铁丰度，并分离 Ni/Fe 与 Fe K-beta。
通过速度色散估计三维马赫数和非热压分数，并评估静水平衡质量偏差。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对单一速度展宽成分是否足以描述视线方向的多温度、速度结构和仪器响应，并检查非热压分数到静水平衡质量偏差的推导假设。还需重点核对低于 2 keV 的 Ne、Mg、Si 线在不同仪器间 10%至20%不一致对元素丰度及 SNIa 比例结论的影响。

papers.title: Detection prospects for heavy WIMP dark matter around M31* in microwave band
papers.abstract: This work analyzes the detection prospects for weakly interacting massive particles (WIMPs) in dark matter (DM) density spike around the supermassive black hole (SMBH) in Andromeda galaxy M31 in microwave band. WIMP annihilation produces relativistic electrons and positrons, which generate the synchrotron emission in strong magnetic field of the accretion flow medium at microwave frequencies. Properties of this emission, as well as their dependence on DM and medium parameters, were modeled. Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA) sensitivity to this emission and underlying WIMP parameters was estimated. It was obtained that M31* in microwave band represents the unique target, where DM spike signal can be detected in case of realistic spike and halo density profiles. In such case ALMA may reach the thermal s-wave annihilating WIMPs with masses up to around 1 TeV with just 10--100 hours exposure. Optimistic parameter configurations may allow probing all possible WIMP masses up to 100 TeV. Related systematic uncertainties are discussed.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 87 references, submitted to JCAP, continues the work arXiv:2512.10923

analysis.title_zh: M31* 周围重 WIMP 暗物质在微波波段的探测前景
analysis.summary_zh: 本文建模了仙女座星系 M31 中心超大质量黑洞周围暗物质密度尖峰内 WIMP 湮灭产生的电子、正电子及其同步辐射，并评估 ALMA 在微波波段的探测能力。摘要报告称，在现实的尖峰和晕密度剖面下，M31* 可能是独特的暗物质目标，10--100 小时观测可探测质量约至 1 TeV 的热 s 波湮灭 WIMP，而乐观参数配置下探测范围可延伸至约 100 TeV。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把微波观测作为暗物质间接探测手段，利用暗物质湮灭产生的同步辐射信号，连接了粒子暗物质、星系中心黑洞和射电观测。它与 CMB 的关系主要体现在微波波段观测技术、前景与系统误差处理，以及对非标准微波源的物理解释；但摘要所述信号并非 CMB 各向异性本身。
key_points: 研究 M31 中心超大质量黑洞 M31* 周围暗物质密度尖峰产生的微波同步辐射。
暗物质 WIMP 湮灭产生相对论性电子和正电子，其在吸积流磁场中的同步辐射可成为微波信号。
摘要认为 M31* 是现实尖峰和晕密度剖面下具有独特探测潜力的目标，ALMA 可检验部分高质量 WIMP 参数空间。
methods: 暗物质密度尖峰与晕密度剖面建模
WIMP 湮灭产生的电子和正电子同步辐射建模
研究辐射对暗物质参数和吸积流介质参数的依赖
估计 ALMA 对微波辐射的灵敏度及其对 WIMP 参数的约束能力
相关系统误差分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对暗物质密度尖峰的形成与存活假设、吸积流磁场和介质参数的取值范围，以及现有 M31* 微波背景和其他射电源污染是否会削弱所称的探测能力；还需区分灵敏度估计与完整观测可行性之间的差别。

papers.title: Supermassive black hole binaries in the multi-messenger context of ground and spaceborne VLBI
papers.abstract: Evidence of a gravitational wave background suggests the existence of a population of sub-parsec supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs), with characteristic angular separations on the order of 1-10 $μ$as. Spaceborne extensions of Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) and the next generation ground arrays introduce the possibility of directly imaging these SMBHBs. In this work, a binary Spectral Energy Distribution (SED) model is used to predict the detectability of SMBHBs with ground and spaceborne VLBI. We consider the Black Hole Explorer (BHEX), a proposal for a spaceborne VLBI mission, as our primary case study. We explore the detectable SMBHB parameter space and identify distinguishable binary signatures that could exist in the visibility domain. We find that for a flux-density-limited sample, ground array observations are more effective at detecting a wider region of the binary parameter space, with $M_\mathrm{tot} \gtrsim 10^9$ solar mass systems detectable out to redshift, $z=0.075$ and beyond. Conversely, inclusion of a spaceborne element such as BHEX, offering finer angular resolution ($\sim6\,μ$as) and sampling of the (u,v) plane not limited by Earth rotation synthesis, will provide significant benefits in constraining binary properties, resulting in improvements in characterisation of the separation and position angle of SMBHBs by a factor of $\sim4$. Near-future ground and/or spaceborne VLBI may achieve the first direct observation of a SMBHB, contributing significantly to multi-messenger studies of such systems with pulsar timing arrays and observations across the electromagnetic spectrum.
papers.comment: Accepted by Publications of the Astronomical Society of the Pacific (PASP) for the BHEX focus issue. 22 pages, 10 figures

analysis.title_zh: 地面与空间 VLBI 多信使背景下的超大质量黑洞双星
analysis.summary_zh: 论文利用双黑洞谱能量分布模型，评估地面和空间 VLBI 对亚秒差距超大质量黑洞双星的直接成像和参数测量能力，并以 BHEX 为主要案例。摘要报告地面阵列在通量受限样本中可覆盖更宽参数空间，而空间 VLBI 的更高角分辨率和 uv 平面采样可将间距与位置角的表征改善约四倍。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 超大质量黑洞双星既可能是脉冲星计时阵列所探测引力波背景的天体来源，也可通过射电和其他电磁观测研究其环境与演化。该工作连接了 VLBI 仪器设计、黑洞双星人口和引力波宇宙学；对 CMB 研究的直接关系较弱，但属于理解高红移和大尺度宇宙中引力波源群体的观测基础。
key_points: 论文评估地面和空间 VLBI 直接成像亚秒差距超大质量黑洞双星的能力。
地面阵列在通量受限样本中可探测更宽的双星参数空间。
空间 VLBI 通过约 6 微角秒分辨率和更完整的 uv 平面采样，可将双星间距和位置角的表征改善约四倍。
methods: 建立双黑洞谱能量分布模型。
预测地面及空间 VLBI 对超大质量黑洞双星的可探测性。
以拟议的 Black Hole Explorer（BHEX）空间 VLBI 任务为主要案例。
探索可探测的超大质量黑洞双星参数空间。
在可见度域识别可区分的双星信号。
将 VLBI 结果与脉冲星计时阵列和全电磁波段观测置于多信使背景下讨论。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对双黑洞谱能量分布模型、源群体和通量选择函数的假设，确认地面与空间 VLBI 的探测率及参数表征改善是否包含仪器噪声、uv 覆盖、源变异和成像退化，并明确这些直接成像结果如何与脉冲星计时阵列的引力波背景联系起来。

papers.title: A Content-Addressed Workflow for Reproducible DANTE Gravitational-Wave Anomaly Analysis
papers.abstract: Unsupervised analysis of gravitational-wave detector data combines expensive scientific stages with data acquisition, provenance checks, statistical calibration, follow-up products, and reporting. Reproducing such an analysis requires more than preserving model weights or a final candidate table: the execution graph, scientific contracts, retry semantics, and verification boundary must also be explicit. We present a local workflow layer for the Domain-Adaptive Network for Transient Evaluation (DANTE) that represents a corrected O4a analysis as a content-addressed, 15-stage directed acyclic graph. The architecture separates immutable stage evidence from mutable operational progress, binds command-line and browser interfaces to the same run identity, and resumes only work compatible with the frozen contract. The tagged v1 release records all 15 stages as verified in a machine-readable receipt and passed a documented human usability gate. The release verifies adopted scientific artifacts rather than recomputing them, and therefore makes no new claim of global significance, astrophysical discovery, or public real-time operation. This paper describes the architecture, its fail-closed controls, and the bounded evidence supporting reproducible local use.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Reproducibility artifacts and tagged workflow release: https://github.com/lucacirfeta/dante-gravi-signal-ml/tree/dante-workflow-productization-v1

analysis.title_zh: 用于可复现 DANTE 引力波异常分析的内容寻址工作流
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论无监督引力波探测器数据异常分析的可复现性问题，提出 DANTE 的本地工作流层，把修正后的 O4a 分析组织成内容寻址的 15 阶段 DAG，并用机器可读 receipt 与人工可用性门控记录验证状态。摘要强调该工作验证的是已采纳科学产物而非重新计算结果，因此不声称新的全局显著性、天体物理发现或公开实时运行能力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接研究 CMB，但与宇宙学数据分析中的可复现性、溯源和异常候选验证密切相关。对 CMB 研究者的启发在于，大型数据管线若涉及候选事件、异常搜索或后续报告，仅保存模型权重和最终表格不足以支撑可复查的科学结论。
key_points: 提出面向 DANTE 引力波异常分析的本地可复现工作流层。
将一次修正后的 O4a 分析表示为内容寻址的 15 阶段有向无环图。
摘要明确说明该发布不提出新的全局显著性、天体物理发现或公开实时运行主张。
methods: 内容寻址工作流
15 阶段有向无环图
执行图与科学契约显式化
机器可读 receipt 验证
人工可用性门控
命令行与浏览器接口绑定同一 run identity
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对的是所谓“verified”的边界：15 个阶段验证的是已采纳科学产物还是完整重算结果，以及 fail-closed 控制、重试语义和冻结契约如何防止不可复现或不兼容的恢复执行。

papers.title: $\texttt{LensFactory.jl}$: A general-purpose strong lens modeling package
papers.abstract: We present LensFactory.jl, an efficient, open-source, general-purpose strong lens modeling package written in Julia. It supports single- and multi-plane lensing with a wide range of analytic lens profiles, and its modular design, built on Julia's multiple dispatch, makes it straightforward to add new profiles or inference methods, while native multi-threading parallelizes the computationally expensive steps, enabling full cluster-scale lens reconstructions within hours on a desktop-class machine. We validate the mass-reconstruction pipeline of LensFactory.jl on two simulated galaxy clusters (Ares and Hera), recovering the convergence and magnification maps well where the lensing constraints lie, and on the JWST-observed cluster SMACS J0723.3-7327, obtaining a strong lens model (image-plane RMS of 0.46'') consistent with previously published results. In addition, we introduce singularity maps as a complementary diagnostic for comparing lens models, probing differences in the higher-order derivatives of the lensing potential, which remain largely unconstrained by standard observables such as image positions, time delays, and flux ratios. LensFactory.jl is accompanied by a set of worked examples covering all core functionality.
papers.comment: 18 pages. 7 figures. Accepted in Journal of Astrophysics & Astronomy

analysis.summary_zh: AI 解读尚未启用。摘要首句：We present LensFactory.jl, an efficient, open-source, general-purpose strong lens modeling package written in Julia.
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作涉及大型巡天、宇宙学；建议结合原文确认结论、假设与统计显著性。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 当前仅展示 arXiv 元数据与规则评分。配置 GPT_API_KEY 后会自动补全中文解读。

papers.title: A Missing Tool for Calculating Auto/Cross-correlation Function under Nonuniform Sampling Observations
papers.abstract: Nonuniform sampling presents a long-standing challenge in astrophysical time-domain analysis, invalidating the standard autocorrelation and cross-correlation functions and forcing researchers to adopt ad-hoc methods like interpolation or binning, which introduce unquantified biases and lack rigorous error estimation. Here we introduce a new method for calculating the nonuniform autocorrelation function (NUACF) and nonuniform cross-correlation function (NUCCF) for irregularly sampled time series. Instead of relying on interpolation, it naturally evaluates the correlation function by incorporating time-interval weights and misalignment penalties. Monte Carlo simulations provide confidence bands for significance assessment and a complete error budget for the time delays that accounts for both flux uncertainties and sampling irregularity (essential but generally absent from existing methods). Through extensive simulations, we demonstrate our method outperforms traditional methods across various conditions, from strictly periodic to complex repeating variability patterns (e.g., intermittent but aperiodic). Its effectiveness is demonstrated via various real astrophysical data sets, revealing repetitive variability in stellar light curves, measuring time delays for multi-band disc reverberation in the AGN Fairall 9, and providing model-independent validation of time delays for the gravitationally lensed quasar HE 0435-1223. The method provides a rigorous and general solution to the ubiquitous problem of nonuniform sampling, positioning it as a useful tool for large-scale time-domain survey data analysis. The framework is also directly applicable to emerging time-domain phenomena such as fast radio bursts (FRBs), enabling, e.g., the study of correlations between persistent radio source luminosity and repeating FRB activity, or among the multi-parameter variability curves of FRB emission itself.

analysis.title_zh: 一种用于非均匀采样观测下计算自相关/互相关函数的缺失工具
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对天体时域数据的非均匀采样问题，提出非均匀自相关函数 NUACF 和非均匀互相关函数 NUCCF，通过时间间隔权重、错位惩罚和 Monte Carlo 模拟来估计相关性显著性与时延误差。摘要称该方法在多种模拟条件下优于传统方法，并在恒星光变、AGN Fairall 9 盘回响和透镜类星体 HE 0435-1223 时延验证中展示应用。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文不是直接的 CMB 论文，但时延估计和非均匀采样相关分析对时域宇宙学、强透镜 H0 测量和大规模巡天数据处理有意义；这些结果可与 CMB 推断的 H0 和宇宙学参数形成独立比较。其方法论也可能启发对不规则观测窗口函数下相关统计量的误差处理。
key_points: 提出用于非均匀采样时间序列的 NUACF 和 NUCCF。
方法避免插值，使用时间间隔权重和错位惩罚，并通过 Monte Carlo 给出置信带与时延误差预算。
在模拟和多类真实天体数据中展示用途，包括 AGN 盘回响、强透镜类星体时延和未来时域巡天/FRB 应用。
methods: 非均匀自相关函数（NUACF）
非均匀互相关函数（NUCCF）
时间间隔权重
misalignment penalties
Monte Carlo simulations
置信带与时延误差预算
恒星光变曲线
AGN Fairall 9 多波段盘回响
引力透镜类星体 HE 0435-1223
FRB 时域相关分析设想
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 NUACF/NUCCF 的统计定义、归一化和误差传播是否在红噪声、季节性窗口函数和非平稳变源下保持无偏；还要比较其与 ICCF、DCF/ZDCF 等常用方法在相同采样与噪声条件下的基准测试。

papers.title: Harnessing stellar kinematics to constrain dark energy with the double-source-plane gravitational lens SDSS J0946+1006
papers.abstract: SDSS J0946+1006 is an attractive target for measuring cosmological parameters through lens modelling. It is the best-studied galaxy-scale strong gravitational lens with multiple sources whose redshift separations are well-suited to constraining the dark energy equation of state. However, multi-plane lens models with free cosmological parameters risk a multi-plane mass-sheet degeneracy, although this can be lifted by a non-lensing deflector density profile tracer. We simultaneously reconstruct near-infrared and near-ultraviolet HST imaging whilst including a velocity dispersion measurement from VLT-MUSE to constrain the foreground deflector. Imaging is reconstructed faithfully regardless of whether the inferred kinematics are realistic, though we find the kinematic constraint essential for shifting the preferred cosmology into a region not in significant tension with other dark energy probes. Deflector density profile perturbations, via substructure and multipolar halo shape deformations, have only a modest effect on inferred cosmology. Combining our fiducial model with Planck CMB data yields $w=-1.01^{+0.08}_{-0.13}$; or, combined with Pantheon SNe Ia, $w=-0.99^{+0.13}_{-0.15}$. We further show that this system proves a remarkably valuable complementary probe in the $w_{0}$-$w_{a}$ plane of an evolving dark energy model, and that the DESI BAO tension with $Λ$CDM seen when combined with other datasets is not reproduced when combined with this lens, yielding $(w_{0}, w_{a})=(-0.87^{+0.10}_{-0.11}, -0.22^{+0.28}_{-0.25})$. The system's third source, visible with MUSE, only weakly constrains $w$CDM but may strengthen $w_{0}w_{a}$CDM constraints, though further mass-model complexity along its line of sight is required. Overall, kinematics-informed multi-plane lens modelling is a robust route to competitive dark energy constraints, even with a single system.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 16 figures, 3 appendices. Submitted to MNRAS. Comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 利用恒星运动学通过双源平面引力透镜 SDSS J0946+1006 约束暗能量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文对具有两个背景源的强引力透镜 SDSS J0946+1006 进行多平面透镜建模，将 HST 近红外和近紫外成像与 VLT-MUSE 的前景透镜星系速度弥散联合，以缓解多平面质量片简并并约束暗能量。摘要报告称，运动学约束对改变首选宇宙学区域至关重要；与 Planck CMB 联合得到 w=-1.01^{+0.08}_{-0.13}，与 Pantheon 联合得到 w=-0.99^{+0.13}_{-0.15}，并在 w0-wa 模型中提供了对演化暗能量的互补约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Planck CMB 通常提供早期宇宙和宇宙学参数的基准约束，而强引力透镜时间延迟或几何信息可从低红移、不同物理系统检验暗能量模型。本文展示如何用透镜星系的恒星运动学补充透镜成像信息、缓解质量简并，并将单个透镜系统与 Planck 等 CMB 数据联合，从而检验 wCDM、w0-waCDM 以及 DESI BAO 所涉及的暗能量张力。
key_points: 使用双源平面强引力透镜 SDSS J0946+1006 的多平面透镜建模约束暗能量参数。
将 HST 近红外、近紫外成像与 VLT-MUSE 速度弥散测量联合，用非透镜运动学信息缓解多平面质量片简并。
与 Planck CMB 数据联合得到 wCDM 下的暗能量状态方程约束；与 Pantheon 超新星联合及在 w0-wa 平面中的结果也被报告。
methods: 双源平面多平面强引力透镜建模
同时重建 HST 近红外和近紫外成像
纳入 VLT-MUSE 测得的前景透镜星系速度弥散
通过非透镜的透镜星系密度剖面示踪物缓解多平面质量片简并
考虑子结构和多极晕形变对透镜体密度剖面的扰动
与 Planck CMB 数据、Pantheon Ia 型超新星及 DESI BAO 相关结果联合比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对速度弥散测量如何进入质量模型、各向异性和恒星质量分布等假设，以及多平面质量片简并是否被充分打破；还应详细检查单个透镜系统与 Planck、Pantheon 和 DESI BAO 联合时的数据相关性、先验选择、视线结构和模型复杂度对 w 与 w0-wa 约束的影响。

papers.title: Vacuum Decay and Baryogenesis Associated with Primordial Black Holes at Finite Temperature
papers.abstract: Within finite-temperature effective potential framework, we study the effects of PBHs on vacuum decay, the associated gravitational wave spectrum, and the baryon asymmetry. For the PBHs considered, the Hawking temperatures are below the ambient temperature, and their dominant effect is taken to be the gravitational distortion of the Higgs field configuration. Relative to flat spacetime, the PBH background reduces the vacuum decay exponent, enhances the gravitational wave peak amplitude, and shifts the peak frequency downward. For PBH masses of roughly $10^{11}~{\rm g}-10^{13}~{\rm g}$, the sphaleron energy is reduced, while the small PBH abundance renders the associated washout negligible. Additionally, over roughly the same mass range, PBH-emitted BSM particle decays generate a baryon asymmetry too small to spoil the agreement between the baryon abundances inferred from BBN and CMB.

analysis.title_zh: 有限温度下与原初黑洞相关的真空衰变和重子生成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在有限温有效势框架下研究原初黑洞对真空衰变、相关引力波谱和重子不对称的影响。摘要报告称，在所考虑 PBH 的 Hawking 温度低于环境温度时，主要效应来自 PBH 对 Higgs 场构型的引力畸变，并导致真空衰变指数降低、引力波峰值增强且峰频降低，同时相关重子不对称不会破坏 BBN 与 CMB 推断丰度的一致性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 的联系主要在早期宇宙一致性检验：PBH、相变引力波和重子不对称都会影响宇宙学模型的可行性，而 BBN 与 CMB 对重子丰度的一致推断是约束此类粒子宇宙学情景的重要基准。
key_points: 研究有限温有效势框架下 PBH 对真空衰变、引力波谱和重子不对称的影响。
摘要称 PBH 背景会降低真空衰变指数、增强引力波峰值振幅并使峰频下移。
在约 10^11-10^13 g 的 PBH 质量范围内，相关重子不对称不足以破坏 BBN 与 CMB 推断的丰度一致性。
methods: 有限温有效势框架
PBH 背景中的 Higgs 场构型引力畸变
Hawking 辐射产生的 BSM 粒子衰变
与 BBN 和 CMB 推断的重子丰度比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 PBH 丰度、质量范围和有限温有效势参数如何设定，以及真空衰变、sphaleron 能量和重子不对称对这些假设的敏感性；摘要未给出模型细节和误差预算。

papers.title: Finding the distribution of matter using lenses - II: deconvolution-based reconstruction with 3x2pt measurements
papers.abstract: We present a deconvolution-based framework for testing scale-dependent departures of the late-time matter power spectrum from a fiducial cosmological model using $3\times2$pt measurements. We introduce a free-form scale-dependent modulation $A(k)$ of the fiducial nonlinear matter power spectrum and construct the linear response of binned galaxy-clustering, galaxy-galaxy-lensing, and cosmic-shear spectra to the discretized modulation $A(k)$. The response is evaluated with full-sky, beyond-Limber kernels including density, redshift-space-distortion, gravitational-shear, and intrinsic-alignment contributions. We reconstruct $A(k)$ using a regularized modified Richardson-Lucy algorithm, with weak diffusion in $\ln k$ and selection of the minimum-$χ^2$ solution along the iteration history. Using Rubin/LSST Year 10-like synthetic data, we find that oscillatory modulations with amplitudes $\gtrsim1\%$ can be recovered over $0.1\lesssim k\lesssim0.5\,{\rm Mpc}^{-1}$, provided the oscillation frequency $f\lesssim10$ on $\log_{10}[k/(0.2\,{\rm Mpc}^{-1})]$. We further introduce a posterior-weighted consistency statistic calibrated with posterior-predictive null mocks, thereby accounting for cosmological and nuisance-parameter uncertainties without relying on Wilks' theorem. The null case is consistent with $A(k)=1$, while a $1\%$ oscillatory modulation is detected at $\sim 2.6σ$. These results demonstrate the potential of regularized deconvolution as a model-independent consistency test of the matter power spectrum in future $3\times2$pt surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 利用透镜寻找物质分布 II：基于 3x2pt 测量的反卷积重建
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一个基于反卷积的框架，用 galaxy clustering、galaxy-galaxy lensing 和 cosmic shear 的 3x2pt 测量来检验晚期物质功率谱相对 fiducial 宇宙学模型的尺度依赖偏离。摘要报告，在 Rubin/LSST Year 10-like 合成数据中，正则化 Richardson-Lucy 重建可在给定 k 范围和振荡频率条件下恢复振幅约大于 1% 的振荡调制，并用后验加权一致性统计检验空模型与调制情形。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 物质功率谱连接 CMB 初始扰动、晚期结构增长、暗能量和可能的新物理；用弱透镜和星系聚类重建尺度依赖偏离，可作为检验 ΛCDM 外推和 CMB 预测的一种低红移一致性测试。该工作面向未来 LSST 类 3x2pt 数据，和 CMB lensing、星系弱透镜及 LSS 联合分析的系统误差建模密切相关。
key_points: 提出用 3x2pt 数据反卷积重建相对于 fiducial 模型的尺度依赖物质功率谱调制 A(k)。
响应核包含全天天区、超 Limber 的密度、RSD、引力剪切和内禀排列贡献。
LSST Year 10-like 合成数据中，摘要报告可恢复特定 k 范围和频率条件下的约 1% 振荡调制。
methods: 3x2pt measurements
free-form scale-dependent modulation A(k)
linear response construction
full-sky beyond-Limber kernels
density, redshift-space-distortion, gravitational-shear, and intrinsic-alignment contributions
regularized modified Richardson-Lucy algorithm
weak diffusion in ln k
minimum-χ² solution selection
Rubin/LSST Year 10-like synthetic data
posterior-weighted consistency statistic
posterior-predictive null mocks
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对反卷积正则化、迭代停止/最小 χ² 选择、A(k) 分箱与先验对重建的影响，以及 1% 振荡检出显著性如何在后验预测空模型、宇宙学参数和 nuisance 参数不确定性下校准。

papers.title: Finding the distribution of matter using lenses - I: deconvolution-based reconstruction with CMB lensing
papers.abstract: The matter power spectrum is one of the primary statistical descriptors of the large-scale distribution of matter in the Universe and provides a powerful probe of cosmic structure formation. Measurements of cosmic microwave background (CMB) lensing offer an integrated view of the matter distribution over a wide range of redshifts, enabling the reconstruction of the underlying matter power spectrum. In this work, we reconstruct the reference linear matter power spectrum $ P_\text{lin}(k,0)$ from the baseline joint CMB lensing measurements of Planck PR4, ACT DR6, and SPT-3G using a covariance-weighted modified Richardson-Lucy(MRL) deconvolution algorithm. The reconstructed spectrum is found to be consistent with the fiducial linear prediction on large scales, while exhibiting a systematic enhancement for $k \gtrsim 0.1\,{\rm Mpc}^{-1}$, where nonlinear gravitational evolution becomes important. To investigate this behavior, we introduce a scale-dependent correction factor, $A(k)$, defined through $P(k)=A(k)\,P_{\rm nl}(k),$ where $P_{\rm nl}(k)$ is the fiducial nonlinear matter power spectrum obtained from 2LPT simulations. The reconstructed correction factor remains consistent with unity within $2σ$ confidence over the reconstructed range, indicating that the observed enhancement is well explained by the standard nonlinear evolution of the matter power spectrum. In addition, the reconstruction shows agreement with the fiducial BAO template around the BAO feature at $k\sim(0.04-0.06)\ {\rm Mpc}^{-1}$, indicating that some BAO-scale information survives the lensing projection.

analysis.title_zh: 利用透镜寻找物质分布 I：基于反卷积的 CMB 透镜重建
analysis.summary_zh: 本文尝试从 Planck PR4、ACT DR6 和 SPT-3G 的联合 CMB 透镜测量中，用协方差加权的改进 Richardson-Lucy 反卷积算法重建当前线性物质功率谱。摘要称重建结果在大尺度与基准线性预言一致，在 k≳0.1 Mpc^-1 处出现增强；引入相对 2LPT 非线性谱的 A(k) 后，A(k) 在重建范围内与 1 在 2σ 内一致，并在 BAO 尺度附近与基准 BAO 模板相符。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 透镜直接探测从再组合到今天的积分物质分布，是连接早期宇宙初始扰动、晚期结构增长和物质功率谱的核心观测量。该工作若方法可靠，可为用多实验 CMB 透镜数据恢复 P(k)、检验非线性演化和提取 BAO 信息提供一条数据分析路径。
key_points: 使用 Planck PR4、ACT DR6 和 SPT-3G 的联合 CMB 透镜测量重建线性物质功率谱。
采用协方差加权的改进 Richardson-Lucy 反卷积算法。
摘要称小尺度增强可由标准非线性演化解释，BAO 尺度信息在透镜投影后仍有保留。
methods: Planck PR4 CMB 透镜测量
ACT DR6 CMB 透镜测量
SPT-3G CMB 透镜测量
协方差加权改进 Richardson-Lucy 反卷积算法
2LPT 模拟得到的基准非线性物质功率谱
尺度依赖修正因子 A(k)
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 CMB 透镜核到三维物质功率谱的反卷积是否稳定、协方差和数据集相关性如何处理、MRL 正则化或停止准则如何影响 k≳0.1 Mpc^-1 的增强，以及 BAO 特征的恢复是否对先验模板敏感。

papers.title: Cosmological extra dimensions can mimic dark energy
papers.abstract: We present a simple model of a higher dimensional spacetime in which the 4d submanifold is a FLRW metric, while the extra dimensions are compactified to a hypersphere. We calculate the Friedmann equations of this model finding that the extra dimensions interact in a non-trivial way with the 4d submanifold evolution. We prove that what is observed as Dark Energy could be explained only as an effect due to the Gaussian curvature and the expansion rate of the extra dimensions. We calculate the luminosity distance in this model and derive the acceleration parameter q. We find that Ωm and q are in some sense dressed by terms coming from the extra dimensions, thus a Universe filled only with matter (both luminous and dark) and with extra dimensions can explain the observational data. We find that the extra dimensions do not affect the CMB spectrum, but this is not a solution to the Hubble tension. We fit our model to SNe data and find evidence for the presence of 3-4 extra dimensions which are presently contracting.

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙学额外维可以模拟暗能量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一种高维宇宙学模型，其中四维子空间为 FLRW 度规，额外维紧致为超球面，并推导 Friedmann 方程、光度距离和加速度参数。摘要报告称额外维的高斯曲率和膨胀率可在仅含物质的宇宙中模拟暗能量，SNe 数据拟合给出当前正在收缩的 3-4 个额外维的证据，同时称该模型不影响 CMB 谱且不能解决 Hubble tension。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接触及暗能量解释、Hubble tension 和 CMB 一致性检验。若额外维确实能改变低红移距离-红移关系而不改变 CMB 谱，它会成为一种与标准 ΛCDM 在背景演化层面竞争的模型；但摘要也提示它不能解决 Hubble tension，因此需要结合 CMB、SNe 和其他距离探针检查其参数空间。
key_points: 构造四维 FLRW 子流形加紧致超球面额外维的高维时空模型。
推导该模型的 Friedmann 方程、光度距离和加速度参数 q。
摘要称额外维可模拟暗能量、拟合 SNe 数据支持当前收缩的 3-4 个额外维，但不解决 Hubble tension，且不影响 CMB 谱。
methods: 高维时空模型
四维 FLRW 度规
紧致为超球面的额外维
Friedmann 方程推导
光度距离计算
加速度参数 q 推导
SNe 数据拟合
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“额外维不影响 CMB 谱”的推导条件和适用范围，以及 SNe 拟合中额外维数、收缩率、Ωm 和 q 的参数退化是否与 CMB、BAO 或局域 H0 约束相容。

papers.title: Revisiting EBL Constraints from Gamma-Ray Observations: A Critical Assessment and Methodological Improvements
papers.abstract: The extragalactic background light (EBL), ranging from the infrared to the ultraviolet bands, is the second most intense photon field in the universe, surpassed only by the cosmic microwave background (CMB). It is primarily generated by starlight in galaxies, either directly or through absorption by dust and re-emission at longer wavelengths. Very high energy (VHE, $E$ > $100\,$GeV) photons can be absorbed via $γγ$ interactions with the EBL during their propagation across cosmological distances, providing an indirect method to probe the EBL by studying its impact on the energy spectra of distant VHE sources. This paper examines the robustness of EBL constraints derived from gamma-ray data, critically assessing the assumptions made in previous studies about the intrinsic source spectra, the uncertainties of the observations and the validity of the analysis tools. We find that earlier studies likely underestimated the uncertainties in the EBL intensity constraints, underscoring the need to account for systematic uncertainties comprehensively. By employing a Monte Carlo (MC) simulation and a plausible model for unknown systematic errors, we compute more realistic uncertainties. Additionally, we discuss possible alternatives to set EBL constraints, relaxing the assumptions on the intrinsic spectra of gamma-ray sources, with the goal of achieving more robust constraints.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for publication in MNRAS

analysis.title_zh: 重新审视来自伽马射线观测的河外背景光约束：批判性评估与方法改进
analysis.summary_zh: 本文重新评估利用甚高能伽马射线在宇宙学距离传播中受 EBL γγ 吸收来约束河外背景光强度的方法。摘要称既有研究可能低估了 EBL 强度约束的不确定性，作者用 Monte Carlo 模拟和未知系统误差模型给出更现实的不确定性，并讨论放宽伽马射线源本征谱假设的替代约束方案。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: EBL 是仅次于 CMB 的重要宇宙背景光场，刻画恒星形成和尘埃再辐射的累积历史。虽然本文不是 CMB 数据分析论文，但 EBL 与 CMB 共同构成高能光子传播的宇宙背景环境；更稳健的 EBL 约束也有助于区分天体物理吸收效应与可能的新物理或宇宙学信号。
key_points: 评估用 VHE 伽马射线观测约束 EBL 的稳健性。
指出既有研究可能低估 EBL 强度约束的不确定性。
使用 MC 模拟和未知系统误差模型估计更现实的不确定性，并讨论放宽源本征谱假设的替代方法。
methods: 甚高能伽马射线源能谱分析
γγ 吸收与 EBL 相互作用
Monte Carlo 模拟
未知系统误差的模型化
对本征源谱假设的稳健性评估
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其系统误差模型是否有观测依据、对本征伽马射线源谱的先验如何改变 EBL 约束，以及“既有研究低估不确定性”的结论是否依赖特定样本或分析工具。

papers.title: Probing Projection Effects in Optically-Selected Clusters with Velocity Dispersions Outliers
papers.abstract: The evolution of galaxy cluster abundance is a powerful probe of cosmology, but its efficacy depends on our ability to understand and control for systematics in the selection and mass estimation of clusters. We study redMaPPer-selected clusters in the Cardinal simulation, which simulates the DES Y3 observational conditions. Specifically, we investigate the line-of-sight velocity distributions of cluster member galaxies in 12,272 simulated clusters. We find that a significant fraction of clusters, 35%, have velocity dispersions that are high compared to their richness with an offset of $\sim 400$ km s$^{-1}$ between the outliers and the main population. A similar population of velocity dispersion outliers was found in the DES Y3 data. Nearly all of the outliers (98%) in a low-richness subsample have non-Gaussian velocity distributions, and they are more likely than the main population to have significant velocity substructure. These clusters also tend to have higher redshifts than clusters with typical velocity dispersions, and they show a larger scatter between halo mass and richness. Overall, our results point to a significant contamination of redMaPPer-selected samples from line of sight structure, particularly at high redshifts and low richness. Comparison to the Buzzard simulations shows similar results.

analysis.title_zh: 用速度弥散离群体探测光学选择星系团中的投影效应
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在模拟 DES Y3 观测条件的 Cardinal 模拟中，分析 redMaPPer 选团的成员星系视线速度分布，以研究速度弥散相对 richness 偏高的离群体是否受投影效应影响。摘要报告相当比例的模拟团簇存在高速度弥散离群现象，且低 richness 离群体几乎都呈非高斯速度分布并更常有速度子结构，指向视线方向结构污染。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 光学星系团丰度可用于约束物质密度、结构增长和暗能量，但需要可靠的选择函数和质量-richness 标定。该文聚焦投影效应对光学选团和速度弥散质量代理的污染，这会影响团簇宇宙学，并间接关系到与 CMB 约束、CMB 透镜或 SZ 观测的联合一致性分析。
key_points: 研究 redMaPPer 光学选团中相对 richness 速度弥散偏高的离群体。
Cardinal 模拟中 35% 团簇表现为高速度弥散离群，低 richness 子样本中 98% 离群体速度分布非高斯。
结果指向视线方向结构污染，尤其在高红移和低 richness 情况下更重要。
methods: Cardinal 模拟，模拟 DES Y3 观测条件
redMaPPer 选出的模拟团簇样本
12,272 个模拟团簇成员星系的视线速度分布分析
速度子结构与非高斯性检验
与 Buzzard 模拟比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对速度弥散离群体的判定阈值、成员星系分配和 richness 估计如何实现，以及 Cardinal 与 Buzzard 中视线结构污染是否能定量映射到真实 DES Y3 选团系统误差。

papers.title: CTree: Branch-wise compatible merger tree builder
papers.abstract: We introduce a merger tree builder, CTree. Its key feature is the identification of progenitors using the evolutionary information encoded in object branches, rather than relying solely on the instantaneous particle membership in a single snapshot. In this sense, CTree can be described as a branch-wise merger tree builder. Specifically, CTree extracts particles associated with objects over a defined timescale and uses this information to compute the merit functions employed in the progenitor search across multiple snapshots. During this process, CTree requires only the identifiers of particles and objects. This ensures high compatibility with different halo and galaxy catalogues and also with pre-existing merger trees. To identify `core' particles that remain bound to the host halo over extended physical timescales, CTree employs a simple and efficient algorithm that does not rely on explicit radial or binding-energy information. The timescale adopted for core particle extraction and the number of snapshots used in the progenitor search can be user-configured. Basic validation tests using suites of dark matter-only simulations demonstrate that CTree produces stable and physically consistent halo merger trees, particularly in high-density regions or in simulations with high output cadence. The code is written in C++ and employs a hybrid message passing interface and OpenMP parallelization, making it well-suited for high-resolution cosmological simulations. The code is publicly available and actively maintained to improve performance, reliability, and compatibility.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables, accepted for publication in Astronomy & Astrophysics

analysis.title_zh: CTree：按分支兼容的并合树构建器
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍了 merger tree 构建器 CTree，其核心是在对象分支中提取演化信息来识别前身，而不是只依赖单个快照的粒子成员关系。摘要称，基于暗物质-only 模拟的基础验证表明，CTree 可生成稳定且物理一致的 halo merger trees，尤其适用于高密度区域或高输出频率模拟。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 并合树是连接宇宙学 N 体模拟、halo 形成史、星系形成模型和大尺度结构统计的重要工具。虽然它不直接分析 CMB，但对理解暗物质结构增长和非线性结构形成很重要，而这些过程会影响 CMB 透镜、SZ 效应和晚期宇宙学交叉相关研究。
key_points: CTree 用分支演化信息而非单个快照的瞬时粒子成员关系来识别前身。
只需要粒子和对象标识符，强调与不同 halo/星系目录及已有 merger trees 的兼容性。
暗物质-only 模拟的基础验证显示其在高密度区域或高输出频率模拟中较稳定。
methods: 基于对象分支的前身识别
跨多个快照的 merit function 计算
core 粒子提取算法
暗物质-only 模拟套件验证
C++、MPI 与 OpenMP 混合并行
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其“branch-wise”merit function 的具体定义、core 粒子提取对时间尺度和快照数量的敏感性，以及与主流 merger tree 构建器在复杂环境中的定量比较。

papers.title: Interacting fluid cosmologies from the metric-affine framework
papers.abstract: Metric-affine gravity provides a natural geometric framework in which spacetime curvature, torsion, and non-metricity are treated as independent degrees of freedom, leading to novel cosmological dynamics beyond General Relativity. A generic consequence of such theories is the emergence of effective interactions among the cosmological fluids, even in the absence of explicit phenomenological couplings. Interestingly, the above happens while the Standard Model of Particle physics remains unmodified. In this work, we investigate interacting cosmological models that arise from metric-affine gravity and analyze their implications for the background evolution of the Universe. We derive the modified continuity equations governing the matter, radiation, and dark-energy components, highlighting the geometric origin of energy exchange in the dark sector. We discuss how these interactions modify the expansion history and can effectively mimic evolving dark-energy behavior. The resulting cosmological scenarios are confronted with the most recent observational data from Type Ia Supernovae (Pantheon+), Cosmic Chronometers, and Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (DESI DR2). Moreover, using model selection criteria, e.g., Akaike Information Criterion, Bayesian Information Criterion and the Bayesian Evidence, we compare the aforementioned models against the standard $Λ$CDM model. We find that the proposed framework performs slightly better than $ΛCDM$, in the light of the data sets considered here. Our analysis demonstrates that metric-affine-induced interactions constitute a viable and theoretically motivated alternative for the description of the Universe.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 4 figures. Comments welcome, data and code available upon reasonable request

analysis.title_zh: 来自度规-仿射框架的相互作用流体宇宙学
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究由度规-仿射引力自然产生的相互作用宇宙学流体模型，推导物质、辐射和暗能量的修正连续性方程，并分析其对背景膨胀史的影响。摘要报告称，与 Pantheon+、Cosmic Chronometers 和 DESI DR2 BAO 数据比较后，这类模型相对 ΛCDM 表现略好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作关注晚期宇宙背景演化和暗能量有效行为，直接关系到与 CMB 联合约束时常见的几何退化、Hubble 张力和暗能量模型选择问题。由于摘要未使用 CMB 数据，其对 CMB 研究的意义主要在于提供可与 CMB 距离尺度和早期宇宙约束交叉检验的修正引力背景模型。
key_points: 度规-仿射引力可在曲率、挠率和非度规性独立的框架下诱导宇宙流体间有效相互作用。

papers.title: Non-linear Pairwise Velocities as a Cosmological Probe
papers.abstract: Peculiar velocities trace gravitational dynamics directly, complementing density-based clustering as wide-field spectroscopic surveys (DESI, Euclid, PFS) and kinetic Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (kSZ) measurements enter the precision era. Observational analyses of pairwise velocities and the pairwise kSZ signal remain largely restricted to linear and quasi-linear scales ($\gtrsim20-30$ $h^{-1}Mpc$), despite substantial cosmological information available at smaller separations. We present a simulation-calibrated likelihood for $v_{12}(r,a)$, built on the exact pair conservation equation and PyCAMB HMcode-2020 non-linear clustering, and validate it against the QUIJOTE and TNG300-3 suites across resolution, particle sampling, box size, and redshift. Using QUIJOTE, we show that extending the fit to non-linear scales tightens the $1σ$ uncertainty on $Ω_\mathrm{m}$ and $σ_8$ by $74\%$ and $81\%$ at $z=0.5$ ($r_{\rm min}=4$ $h^{-1}Mpc$), and by $70\%$ and $74\%$ at $z=0$ ($r_{\rm min}=8$ $h^{-1}Mpc$), relative to the linear-regime baseline ($r_{\rm min}=50$ $h^{-1}Mpc$) (all at fixed $r_{max}=140$ $h^{-1}Mpc$); $σ(fσ_8)$ tightens by up to $86\%$, and the joint $Ω_\mathrm{m}$-$fσ_8$ Figure-of-Merit improves by up to $9.1\times$ relative to the same baseline. These constraints are conditional on $h$ fixed at its QUIJOTE fiducial value, due to a near-degenerate response with $σ_8$; jointly sampling $h$ shifts and widens them substantially. This framework provides a validated route to exploiting that information in upcoming direct peculiar-velocity, redshift-space, and kSZ analyses.
papers.comment: 11 pages plus references, 8 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to Physical Review D. Comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 作为宇宙学探针的非线性成对速度
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一个经模拟校准的非线性成对速度 v12(r,a) 似然框架，基于精确成对守恒方程和 HMcode-2020 非线性聚类，并用 QUIJOTE 与 TNG300-3 检验。摘要报告称，将拟合扩展到非线性尺度可相对于线性尺度基线显著收紧 Ωm、σ8 和 fσ8 约束，但这些结果依赖固定 h 的设定。

papers.title: Observation-driven simulations of strong lensing galaxy clusters
papers.abstract: Galaxy clusters are the most powerful strong lenses: they greatly magnify the flux of distant and faint sources. Strong lensing also allows for the reconstruction of their mass distribution with-1% level accuracy and enables investigating cosmological parameters. The number of known systems of this type is bound to increase in the next years thanks to wide imaging surveys. Using simulations in this context is crucial to validate the analysis methods before they are applied to real data, and to train machine learning algorithms that can handle large volumes of images. In this work, we present a simulated set of one hundred images of galaxy clusters that we have produced with a novel code for simulating cluster-scale strong lenses. One of the main novelties of our approach, distinguishing it from other existing codes, is the use of empirical relations, derived from state-of-the-art observations, for modelling the characteristics, such as morphology, color, and spatial distribution of the cluster member population. This allows us to reliably reproduce the complexity of real observations. The simulations are partly carried out with the latest version of SkyLens, a code that creates mock observations of strong lensing events in different systems and observational setups. The main improvements we introduce are the use of the message passage interface (MPI) paradigm, a standard for parallel programming that leverages the use of several processors to perform some given task, and the implementation of score-based diffusion models to augment the images of the background sources. Together, they lead to more efficient and realistic image simulations. We also present the validation of the code and simulations by comparing the properties of the mock clusters to those of real ones. [Abridged]
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Astronomy & Astrophysics (15 pages, 10 figures), comments are welcome

analysis.title_zh: 观测驱动的强透镜星系团模拟
analysis.summary_zh: 本文面向即将增长的星系团强透镜样本，介绍一种由观测驱动的星系团强透镜模拟框架，并生成一百幅模拟星系团图像。摘要称其通过观测经验关系建模团成员星系性质，结合 SkyLens、MPI 并行和基于得分的扩散模型，使模拟更高效且更接近真实观测，并通过与真实星系团性质比较进行验证。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团强透镜可用于高精度重建质量分布并辅助约束宇宙学参数，同时也是训练和验证大规模巡天图像分析方法的重要基准。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类质量分布与星系团样本模拟可与 CMB 透镜、SZ 星系团宇宙学和多探针质量校准形成互补。

引入 MPI 并用基于得分的扩散模型增强背景源图像，以提高效率和真实感。

基于观测的经验关系建模团成员星系性质

papers.title: The SRG/eROSITA All-Sky Survey: Early dark energy and Hubble constant from the cluster mass function
papers.abstract: The evolution of the mass function of massive galaxy clusters is a well-established probe of cosmology. Using the eROSITA X-ray instrument on board the Spectrum Roentgen Gamma (SRG) mission, the western Galactic hemisphere of eROSITA's first All-Sky Survey (eRASS1) delivers a uniformly selected and securely confirmed sample of 5259 galaxy clusters spanning $0.1 < z < 0.8$. When combined with overlapping weak lensing data from DES Year 3, KiDS, and HSC for mass calibration, this dataset enables precise tests of the standard $Λ$CDM framework and beyond. In this work, we use the $0.1 < z < 0.45$ subsample of the eRASS1 cluster catalog to place constraints on an axion-like Early Dark Energy (EDE) scenario. Such models have been proposed as a possible mechanism to alleviate the tension between early- and late-Universe measurements of the Hubble constant. In this framework, a scalar field temporarily enhances the cosmic expansion rate around the epoch of recombination before rapidly diluting at later times, leaving distinct imprints on structure growth. We leverage these signatures to present the first constraints on EDE derived from galaxy cluster number counts. Using eRASS1 number counts alone, we obtain an upper limit on the maximum EDE fraction of $f_{\rm EDE} < 0.3$, consistent with primary CMB analyses. Combining our cluster analysis with primary CMB measurements, baryon acoustic oscillations, and CMB lensing, while notably excluding distance-ladder calibration data, yields results consistent with a nonzero EDE contribution and $H_0$ values compatible with late-Universe measurements. The most significant detection, at $\sim 3.2σ$, arises from the joint analysis of the eRASS1 sample with the full set of external datasets, yielding $f_{\rm EDE} = 0.10^{+0.04}_{-0.03}$ and $H_0 = 71.4 \pm 1.4$ km/s/Mpc. [ABRIDGED]
papers.comment: 26 pages, 18 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication by A&A

analysis.title_zh: SRG/eROSITA 全天巡天：由星系团质量函数约束早期暗能量和哈勃常数
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 eROSITA eRASS1 星系团质量函数检验轴子型早期暗能量模型，并结合 DES Y3、KiDS、HSC 弱透镜数据进行质量定标。摘要报告，eRASS1 数目计数单独给出 f_EDE < 0.3 的上限；与主 CMB、BAO、CMB 透镜等联合后得到与非零 EDE 和较高 H0 相容的结果，最强组合给出约 3.2σ 检测。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 早期暗能量直接改变复合时期附近的膨胀史，因此与 CMB 推断的声学尺度、H0 和结构增长密切相关。星系团数目计数提供了与主 CMB 不同的低红移结构增长探针，可检验缓解 H0 张力的 EDE 模型是否同时符合大尺度结构观测。

星系团单独给出 f_EDE 上限，并与主 CMB 结果一致。
联合 CMB、BAO、CMB 透镜等数据时，摘要报告非零 EDE 与较高 H0 的结果。

papers.title: Neural Posterior Estimation for Tomographic Weak Lensing Mass Mapping
authors: the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
papers.abstract: Weak gravitational lensing shear and convergence trace the distribution of baryonic and dark matter across space, making them a powerful probe of cosmic structure. Inferring shear and convergence from images is a challenging inverse problem. The prevailing approach to this task estimates shear from weighted averages of galaxy ellipticities, calibrates these estimates to account for systematic biases, and transforms them to reconstruct convergence, a multistage procedure that requires substantial computational resources and meticulous handling of statistical uncertainties. As an alternative, we propose a probabilistic approach to field-level weak lensing inference in which we train a deep neural network to directly map a multiband image to a variational distribution over the underlying tomographic shear and convergence fields. This neural posterior estimation (NPE) procedure implicitly marginalizes over nuisance variables in the cosmological forward model and does not require evaluating the likelihood function. It is also amortized, so it enables rapid posterior inference for astronomical surveys once the neural network is trained. When evaluated on synthetic images from the LSST-DESC DC2 Simulated Sky Survey, NPE produces well-calibrated variational distributions for shear and convergence that are consistent with the ground truth. We describe how maps sampled from these variational distributions could be used in a subsequent simulation-based inference procedure to approximate the posterior distribution over cosmological parameters.

analysis.title_zh: 用于层析弱透镜质量成图的神经后验估计
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对弱引力透镜从图像反演剪切和收敛场这一多阶段且系统误差敏感的问题，提出用神经后验估计从多波段图像直接输出 tomographic 剪切与收敛场的变分后验。摘要报告，在 LSST-DESC DC2 模拟天空图像上，该方法给出的后验分布校准良好并与真值一致，且可作为后续基于模拟的宇宙学参数推断输入。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 弱透镜质量成图是约束大尺度结构、暗物质分布和宇宙学参数的核心手段，也是 CMB 透镜交叉相关、S8 张力检验和多探针联合分析的重要低红移对应物。该文若能可靠传播场级不确定性，将直接影响未来 LSST 等巡天与 CMB-S4/Simons Observatory 等数据的联合宇宙学推断。
key_points: 提出用神经后验估计直接从多波段图像推断分 tomographic 的剪切与收敛场后验。
方法避免显式似然评估，并在训练后可摊销用于快速后验推断。
在 LSST-DESC DC2 模拟图像上，摘要报告其变分分布校准良好且与真值一致。
methods: Neural Posterior Estimation, NPE
深度神经网络
多波段图像到 tomographic shear/convergence fields 的变分分布映射

papers.title: Inelastic Singlet-Doublet Fermion Dark Matter in light of the 248 keV LZ event
papers.abstract: Recently, the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) collaboration reported the observation of a single dark matter (DM)-nucleus scattering event at a nuclear recoil energy of $248\pm23_{\rm stat}\pm23_{\rm sys}$ keV, corresponding to an exposure of 2.84 tonne-year. The absence of events at lower nuclear recoil energies in the predicted spectrum is naturally explained if the underlying process is inelastic DM-nucleus scattering. Motivated by this, we investigate the singlet-doublet fermion DM model, in which the DM consists of two pseudo-Dirac states: the Majorana nature of the lighter state forbids tree level $Z$-mediated elastic scattering identically, while the same states enable inelastic DM-nucleus scattering via $Z$ exchange, with any residual elastic scattering proceeding only through a suppressed Higgs-mediated channel. We further extend the model with a $Z_2$-even scalar triplet, which is responsible both for generating the pseudo-Dirac splitting and for realizing Majorana neutrino masses via the Type-II seesaw mechanism.

analysis.title_zh: 248 keV LZ 事件背景下的非弹性单重态-双重态费米子暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文受 LUX-ZEPLIN 报告的一个 248 keV 暗物质候选核反冲事件启发，研究 singlet-doublet 费米子暗物质中通过 Z 交换发生非弹性散射的解释。摘要称模型中较轻 Majorana 态禁止树级 Z 介导弹性散射，残余弹性散射仅经受抑 Higgs 通道，并进一步加入标量三重态以产生赝 Dirac 劈裂和 II 型 seesaw 中微子质量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于粒子暗物质直接探测现象学，与 CMB 的联系较间接：若模型成立，其暗物质性质需与宇宙学丰度、结构形成和 CMB 对暗物质相互作用或能量注入的约束相容。对 CMB 读者而言，它更适合作为暗物质微观模型与宇宙学约束衔接的背景材料，而非直接的 CMB 分析论文。
key_points: 以 LZ 报告的单个 248 keV 核反冲事件为动机，讨论非弹性暗物质-原子核散射解释。
研究 singlet-doublet 费米子暗物质模型，其中较轻 Majorana 态禁止树级 Z 介导弹性散射。
扩展加入 Z2 偶标量三重态，用于产生赝 Dirac 劈裂并通过 II 型 seesaw 实现 Majorana 中微子质量。

非弹性 DM-原子核散射

papers.title: Filament-Arm Node Systems (FANS): A new probe of the winding and chirality of the cosmic web
papers.abstract: We define Filament-Arm Node Systems (FANS), a new class of cosmic-web objects consisting of multiple filament arms connected to a common node, and use their geometry to construct an object-based test of cosmic chirality. With the cosmic-web node providing a natural reference point, FANS span characteristic scales of ~60Mpc/h, allowing the coherent winding of their arms around the node to be measured directly. We define cosmic spirality as the amplitude of this winding and handedness as its signed clockwise (CW) or counter-clockwise (CCW) sense. We further introduce an axis-conditioned extrinsic estimator that searches for the projected signature of a coherent three-dimensional axial pattern of the handedness field, corresponding to a preferred axis of winding. Applying these measurements to two distinct SDSS filament reconstructions, and assessing their significance with sign-flip nulls and 27 controlled variations of the FANS construction parameters, we find no significant preference for CW or CCW winding, either globally or around a preferred axis. The data are therefore consistent with parity symmetry, as expected in standard LCDM cosmology. We additionally find that cosmic spirality decreases with cosmic time, a trend that may reflect the gravitational straightening of filament arms. These first constraints establish FANS as a new probe of cosmic-web symmetry and large-scale morphology and provide a baseline for future parity tests with the much larger filament samples expected from upcoming surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 丝状体-臂节点系统（FANS）：探测宇宙网缠绕与手征性的新工具
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出“丝状体-臂节点系统”（FANS）作为宇宙网新对象，用共同节点周围多条丝状体臂的几何缠绕来检验宇宙手征性。作者将方法应用于两套 SDSS 丝状体重构，并用符号翻转零假设和参数变化评估显著性；摘要报告未发现全局或优选轴方向上的顺/逆时针偏好，数据与标准 LCDM 的宇称对称相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙大尺度结构的宇称对称性是标准 LCDM 图像的重要预期，任何稳健的宇宙网手征性信号都可能指向早期宇宙或引力结构形成中的新物理。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类低红移大尺度结构宇称检验可与 CMB 中的宇称异常、各向异性或手征性搜索形成互补。
key_points: 定义由多个丝状体臂连接到共同节点的 FANS 天体类别。
用 SDSS 丝状体重构检验宇宙网缠绕的手征性和优选轴信号。
摘要报告未发现显著 CW/CCW 偏好，结果与 LCDM 中的宇称对称相符。

papers.title: Black Holes, Gravitational Waves and Space-Time Singularities Lemaitre Conference 2024
papers.abstract: This editorial introduces the topical collection arising from the Lemaitre Conference 2024 - the second in a series of meetings dedicated to the scientific legacy of Georges Lemaitre - held at the Vatican Observatory in Castel Gandolfo, 17-20 June 2024, fifty-seven years after Lemaitre's death and on the eve of the centenary of his foundational 1927 paper on the expanding universe. The nineteen contributions collected here address the most pressing open problems at the interface of cosmology, gravitation, and quantum theory: the Hubble tension and the future of $Λ$CDM in light of recent DESI data; inflationary cosmology and dark-energy model-building in string theory and supergravity, together with the Swampland constraints that bound them; the observer-dependence of the quantum-cosmological wave function; the removal, or consistent crossing, of spacetime singularities - from the canonical quantization of Lemaitre's own 1933 dust model to string-theoretic pre-Big-Bang bounces and many-body constructions of singularity-free black-hole cores; primordial black holes and their gravitational-wave signatures; the search for a background-independent formulation of quantum gravity and a first-principles account of horizon thermodynamics; and the foundational status of the quantum-to-classical transition in gravitational contexts. A proposal for lunar-based cosmological observations, and a historical reconstruction of the genesis of Lemaitre's primeval-atom hypothesis, complete the collection. A recurring unifying thread was the legacy of Lemaitre himself - who first distinguished coordinate from physical singularities and coined the term "horizon" - whose pioneering vision continues to guide research at the frontier of cosmology and fundamental physics.
papers.comment: 10 pages, proceedings editorial of the Lemaitre Conference 2024, accepted in General Relativity and Gravitation
