papers.title: LZ nuclear recoil event from inelastic singlet-doublet scalar dark matter
papers.abstract: We study the possibility of explaining the recently reported high-energy nuclear recoil event by the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) collaboration within the framework of singlet-doublet scalar dark matter (DM). Considering DM to be the CP even mass eigenstate formed out of a scalar doublet and a real scalar singlet, both being odd under an unbroken $Z_2$ symmetry, we find the parameter space of the model consistent with correct relic abundance and direct-detection limits on elastic scattering rates. A large part of the parameter space can also lead to inelastic up-scattering of DM with a rate and recoil energy consistent with the recent LZ event. Depending upon the singlet-doublet mixing, the model allows a much wider range of currently allowed parameter space compared to the pure scalar doublet DM limit. Presence of $Z_2$-odd right-handed neutrinos also leads to other interesting phenomenology related to the origin of light neutrino masses and leptogenesis.

analysis.title_zh: 来自非弹性单重态-双重态标量暗物质的 LZ 核反冲事件
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究单重态-双重态标量暗物质模型是否能解释 LUX-ZEPLIN 报告的高能核反冲事件。摘要称，在满足正确暗物质遗迹丰度和弹性散射直接探测限制的参数空间中，大量区域也可给出与该 LZ 事件相符的非弹性上散射率和反冲能量，并可因加入 Z2 奇的右手中微子联系轻中微子质量与轻子生成。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质的微观性质直接影响宇宙物质组分和结构形成，是 CMB 推断宇宙学参数时默认模型的一部分。虽然该文主要是粒子暗物质与直接探测现象学，但若此类事件解释成立，将影响暗物质质量、相互作用和热史假设，并与 CMB 对暗物质丰度及能量注入的约束形成互补。
key_points: 尝试用单重态-双重态标量暗物质解释 LZ 高能核反冲事件。
模型包含未破缺 Z2 对称性下的 CP 偶质量本征态暗物质。
摘要称部分参数空间可同时满足遗迹丰度、弹性直接探测限制和非弹性上散射事件特征。
methods: singlet-doublet scalar dark matter 模型
LUX-ZEPLIN 高能核反冲事件解释
遗迹丰度约束
直接探测弹性散射限制
非弹性 up-scattering 率与反冲能量比较
含 Z2-odd 右手中微子的扩展现象学讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对所谓 LZ 事件解释是否依赖事后拟合、局部背景假设或窄参数调节；还需检查遗迹丰度、弹性散射上限与非弹性散射所需质量劈裂和混合角之间是否真正兼容。

papers.title: Ultra-slow-roll Inflation with Non-perturbative Non-Gaussianity and Scalar Induced Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: An ultra-slow-roll phase during inflation could potentially produce the right abundance of primordial black holes (PBHs) for them to form all of dark matter (DM). We consider such a scenario, carefully treating the transitions from slow to ultra slow roll inflation and back, using a parametrisation of the inflaton potential that can describe inflation from the time when CMB scales crossed out of the horizon until its end. A $δN$ analysis shows that this model can possess $O(1)$ non-Gaussianity. When computing the primordial black hole abundance, we keep the full non-linear relation between curvature perturbations and the density contrast and consider the non-Gaussianity to all orders. We find that $O(1)$ non-Gaussianity is sufficient to enhance the PBH abundance by orders of magnitude, leading to reduced gravitational wave (GW) signals for fixed PBH abundance. The signal to noise ratio is computed for future gravitational wave observatories. We find that, in spite of the reduced strength, the GW signal is well above the sensitivity of LISA if PBHs form a significant component of DM.

analysis.title_zh: 具有非微扰非高斯性和标量诱导引力波的超慢滚暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究含超慢滚阶段的暴胀模型能否产生足够的原初黑洞作为暗物质，并从 CMB 尺度出视界到暴胀结束统一参数化暴胀势。摘要报告，δN 分析给出 O(1) 非高斯性；在计算 PBH 丰度时保留非线性关系和全阶非高斯性后，PBH 丰度可被大幅增强，而固定 PBH 丰度所需的诱导引力波信号降低但仍可高于 LISA 灵敏度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的联系在于暴胀模型必须同时解释 CMB 尺度扰动并在小尺度增强功率以产生 PBH。非高斯性和标量诱导引力波会影响小尺度暴胀物理的可观测检验，也关系到 PBH 作为暗物质候选的宇宙学一致性。
key_points: 研究超慢滚暴胀产生 PBH 暗物质的情景。
δN 分析显示模型可具有 O(1) 非高斯性。
摘要称非高斯性会显著增强 PBH 丰度，并在固定 PBH 丰度下降低诱导引力波信号。
methods: 超慢滚暴胀模型
从 CMB 尺度出视界到暴胀结束的暴胀势参数化
δN 分析
曲率扰动与密度反差的完整非线性关系
全阶非高斯性处理
未来引力波探测器信噪比计算
LISA 灵敏度比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对慢滚到超慢滚再返回慢滚的过渡处理是否物理且稳定，以及全阶非高斯性和密度阈值假设如何影响 PBH 丰度与标量诱导引力波预测。

papers.title: Recovering Large-Scale Clustering of Missing Galaxies for Galaxy--Gravitational-Wave Cross-correlations
papers.abstract: We present a framework for completing galaxy catalogs from flux-limited surveys which reconstructs the missing galaxy population while preserving its clustering properties. This is particularly important for cosmological analyses using gravitational-wave (GW) dark sirens without electromagnetic counterparts, such as binary black hole mergers, which constitute the majority of GW detections. As GW detectors probe increasingly larger distances, galaxy catalogs become progressively incomplete owing to survey flux limits. Current state-of-the-art statistical host identification methods typically account for this incompleteness by assuming that the missing galaxies are uniformly distributed in comoving volume. While this approximation can mitigate biases due to incompleteness, it neglects the clustering of galaxies within the cosmic web. Since galaxies and GW sources are both expected to trace the underlying large-scale structure, their spatial distributions are correlated, making a homogeneous reconstruction physically unrealistic, a shortcoming which our framework addresses. As a proof of concept, we apply the method to simulated galaxy catalogs with different flux limits and observational selection functions. Our approach provides a significantly more realistic completion of incomplete galaxy catalogs than the commonly adopted homogeneous-in-comoving-volume approximation, enabling more robust cosmological inference from gravitational-wave dark sirens.

analysis.title_zh: 为星系--引力波互相关恢复缺失星系的大尺度聚类
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对通量受限星系巡天在远距离处缺失星系、影响引力波暗 siren 宿主统计识别的问题，提出一种补全星系目录并保持聚类性质的框架。摘要称，在带有不同通量限制和观测选择函数的模拟目录中，该方法比常用的共动体积均匀补全近似更真实，从而有助于更稳健的引力波宇宙学推断。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作不直接分析 CMB，但与大尺度结构和引力波标准 siren 宇宙学密切相关。若暗 siren 推断中的星系目录不完备处理不当，会影响对哈勃常数、暗能量等宇宙学参数的约束；这些参数也正是 CMB 与低红移探针联合检验 ΛCDM 和张力问题时的核心对象。
key_points: 提出补全通量受限星系目录的框架，目标是恢复缺失星系的大尺度聚类。
针对无电磁对应体的引力波暗 siren 宇宙学分析，批评常用均匀共动体积分布假设忽略宇宙网聚类。
在模拟星系目录、不同通量限制和观测选择函数上做概念验证。
methods: 通量受限星系巡天的星系目录补全框架
模拟星系目录
不同通量限制
观测选择函数
与共动体积均匀补全近似比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该框架如何在不引入先验偏差的情况下恢复缺失星系的聚类，包括其对选择函数、红移误差、星系偏置和引力波定位体积的假设；还要检查“更真实补全”是否最终转化为暗 siren 宇宙学参数推断的可量化改进。

papers.title: Conformally Interacting Dark Energy with Early and Late-Time Measurements
papers.abstract: The conformal interacting dark energy (CIDE) model is investigated by introducing a scalar field representing dark energy (DE) coupled to dark matter (DM) via a conformal transformation, thereby yielding a class of scalar-tensor theories. The interaction term ${Q}$, that indicts the flow of energy between the dark sectors is proportional to the trace of the energy momentum tensor of the DM fluid, $T^{\mathrm{DM}}_{μν}$, as ${Q}=\frac{C'(φ)}{2C(φ)}g^{μν}T^{\mathrm{DM}}_{μν}$, where $C(φ)$ is the conformal function of a scalar potential (coupling) field. We assume the power-law parametrization $C(φ)\propto (1+φ)^m$, with $m$ a coupling parameter, and determine the direction and magnitude of the energy flow between the DM and DE components. The dynamical nature of DE is modeled by the two conformal interacting scenarios, CIDE and $w$CIDE, with $w$ the DE equation of state parameter. To test the viability of each model, we constrain them using a combination of early- and late-time cosmological data, namely: CMB measurements from the South Pole Telescope, Planck 2018, and the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (DR6) (\texttt{CMB SPA}); BAO data from the Dark Energy Survey (\texttt{DESI DR2 BAO}); and Supernova Type Ia distance compilations (\texttt{PantheonPlus, PantheonPlus + SH0ES, Union3}, and \texttt{DES Dovekie}). Parameter inference is performed with Monte Carlo Markov Chain (\texttt{MCMC}) simulations using \texttt{COBAYA} and a modified \texttt{CLASS}. Further statistical analysis using the Akaike information criterion (AIC) and the Bayesian information criterion (BIC) is summarized to assess the viability of the model in comparison with the standard cosmological model, investigating the model's potential to alleviate the $H_0$ and $S_8$ tensions.

analysis.title_zh: 结合早期与晚期测量的共形相互作用暗能量
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究通过共形变换耦合暗能量标量场与暗物质的 CIDE/wCIDE 模型，并采用幂律共形函数描述暗部门间的能量交换。作者联合 SPT、Planck 2018、ACT DR6、DESI DR2 BAO 及多套 Ia 型超新星数据进行 MCMC 推断，并计划用 AIC/BIC 评估其相对标准宇宙学模型的可行性及缓解 H₀、S₈ 张力的潜力；摘要未报告具体约束或比较结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗部门相互作用会改变背景膨胀和结构增长，并可能在 CMB 各向异性、BAO 距离尺度及超新星距离中留下相互关联的信号。该研究直接联合多项早期与晚期观测，可用于检验非标准暗能量是否在保持 CMB 拟合的同时改变 H₀ 和 S₈ 推断，但其实际效果需依据正文中的后验分布、数据组合依赖性及模型选择统计量判断。
key_points: 以共形变换构造暗能量与暗物质相互作用，能量交换项与暗物质能动张量的迹成正比。
采用幂律共形函数 C(φ)∝(1+φ)^m，并考察 CIDE 与 wCIDE 两种情景。
联合多组 CMB、BAO 和 Ia 型超新星数据约束模型，并以 AIC/BIC 与标准宇宙学模型比较。
methods: 南极望远镜、Planck 2018 和阿塔卡马宇宙学望远镜 DR6 的 CMB 测量
DESI DR2 BAO 数据
PantheonPlus、PantheonPlus + SH0ES、Union3 和 DES Dovekie Ia 型超新星距离数据
使用 COBAYA 与修改版 CLASS 进行马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛参数推断
Akaike 信息准则（AIC）与贝叶斯信息准则（BIC）模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应首先核对相互作用项 Q 的符号约定，以及幂律参数 m 如何决定暗物质与暗能量之间能量流动的方向和强度；还需检查不同 CMB 数据集及超新星样本组合是否分别给出一致约束，并确认 H₀、S₈ 张力的评价是否同时考虑拟合改善、额外参数惩罚和数据集间一致性。摘要未提供参数约束、张力缓解幅度或 AIC/BIC 数值，因此不能仅凭摘要判断模型是否优于标准宇宙学模型。

papers.title: Primordial Black Hole Abundances and Scalar Induced Gravitational Waves from Finite-Width Power Spectra in a Stiff Thermal History
papers.abstract: We study the formation of primordial black holes (PBHs) from large primordial perturbations that re-enter the horizon during an epoch with equation of state ${\rm w}\geq1/3$. We consider a log-normal curvature power spectrum of finite width $Δ$ and determine the collapse amplitude by numerical-relativity simulations of a self-gravitating perfect fluid. Threshold scans are performed for five values of $\rm w$ and five spectral widths, and the resulting numerical thresholds are used in the PBH abundance and scalar-induced gravitational-wave (SIGW) calculations. For comparison, we also evaluate the semi-analytical $q$-function prescription. It reproduces the numerical trend close to radiation domination and for nearly monochromatic profiles, but it is not a reliable threshold estimator for generic finite-width profiles in stiffer backgrounds. We show how collapse thresholds increase with both $Δ$ and $\rm w$, changing the curvature amplitude required for PBHs to constitute all of the dark matter and, consequently, the normalization of the accompanying SIGW signal.

analysis.title_zh: 刚性热历史中有限宽功率谱产生的原初黑洞丰度与标量诱导引力波
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究状态方程 w≥1/3 的早期刚性热历史中，大幅原初扰动再入视界后形成原初黑洞的问题。作者采用有限宽 log-normal 曲率功率谱，并用自引力完美流体的数值相对论模拟确定坍缩阈值，再用于 PBH 丰度和标量诱导引力波计算；摘要报告阈值随谱宽 Δ 和 w 增大而升高，并改变 PBH 构成全部暗物质所需的曲率扰动幅度及相伴 SIGW 信号归一化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: PBH 暗物质和标量诱导引力波都直接依赖小尺度原初曲率扰动，而这些尺度通常远小于 CMB 直接观测范围；因此它们为 CMB 所约束的大尺度原初谱提供互补的小尺度检验。非标准早期热历史还会影响辐射时代前后的扰动演化，对把 CMB 约束外推到早期宇宙模型时尤其相关。
key_points: 研究刚性热历史 w≥1/3 中有限宽曲率功率谱诱导的 PBH 形成。
用数值相对论模拟给出不同 w 和谱宽 Δ 下的坍缩阈值。
摘要指出阈值随 Δ 和 w 增大而升高，并影响 PBH 暗物质丰度与伴随 SIGW 信号归一化。
methods: 有限宽 log-normal 曲率功率谱
自引力完美流体的数值相对论模拟
五个状态方程参数 w 与五个谱宽 Δ 的阈值扫描
PBH 丰度计算
标量诱导引力波 SIGW 计算
半解析 q-function prescription 对比
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对数值相对论阈值的定义和初始剖面设定、有限谱宽如何映射到实空间坍缩剖面，以及 SIGW 计算是否与非标准热历史的转变过程和 PBH 丰度归一化保持一致。

papers.title: Recovering the characteristic halo mass of rare populations from clustering: a benchmark using the Millennium Simulation
papers.abstract: We measure how accurately the characteristic halo mass of a rare, massive population can be recovered from clustering alone, using dark matter haloes in the Millennium simulation, where the true masses are known. Massive samples of 25 to 10000 haloes are cross-correlated against field reference samples of 5000 to 50000 haloes at six redshifts over $0 \leq z \leq 5.29$. The bias is measured at $r = 8\,h^{-1}\,\mathrm{Mpc}$ and inverted to return a characteristic mass, which we compare with the mean logarithmic halo mass measured directly from the simulation. Across 192 configurations the characteristic mass is recovered with a median absolute offset of $0.103$ dex. We show that (i) accuracy depends only weakly on the number of rare objects while the uncertainty falls from $\pm 0.71$ dex at 25 objects to $\pm 0.08$ dex at 10000; (ii) enlarging the smallest samples gives the greatest return, with a doubling from 25 to 50 objects reducing the uncertainty by about a third, against a tenth from 5000 to 10000; and (iii) the reference population carries an error of its own, which propagates coherently into every cross-correlation measured against it and is not reduced by observing more rare objects. Working with haloes rather than galaxies isolates the clustering measurement from the galaxy--halo connection, providing a benchmark before population-specific complications are introduced. For the best configurations, the uncertainty contributed by the calibration of the bias--mass relation, at $\sim 0.07$ dex, already matches that of the measurement itself.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables; Submitted to MNRAS

analysis.title_zh: 从聚类恢复稀有族群的特征晕质量：使用 Millennium Simulation 的基准检验
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Millennium Simulation 中真实质量已知的暗物质晕，评估仅依靠聚类能多准确地恢复稀有大质量天体样本的特征晕质量。作者将 25 到 10000 个稀有晕与 5000 到 50000 个参考晕在 0≤z≤5.29 的六个红移上做互相关，在 r=8 h^-1 Mpc 测量偏置并反演质量；摘要报告 192 种配置的中位绝对偏差为 0.103 dex。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 晕质量与偏置关系是把星系、类星体或高红移稀有天体聚类转化为宇宙学信息的关键环节，也影响大尺度结构与 CMB lensing、SZ 和星系巡天互相关的解释。该工作提供了一个不受星系-晕连接复杂性影响的暗物质晕层面基准，可帮助判断聚类质量估计中的统计误差和 bias-mass 标定误差。
key_points: 用 Millennium Simulation 检验仅由聚类恢复稀有大质量样本特征晕质量的精度。
通过稀有晕样本与参考晕样本的互相关测量 r=8 h^-1 Mpc 处偏置，并反演特征质量。
摘要报告 192 种配置中质量恢复的中位绝对偏差为 0.103 dex，并强调参考样本误差会相干传播。
methods: Millennium Simulation 暗物质晕样本
稀有大质量晕样本与场参考样本的交叉相关
六个红移 0≤z≤5.29
在 r=8 h^-1 Mpc 测量偏置
由 bias-mass 关系反演特征晕质量
与模拟中直接测得的平均对数晕质量比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 bias-mass 反演所用标定、r=8 h^-1 Mpc 的尺度选择是否稳健，以及从暗物质晕基准推广到真实星系或高红移稀有天体时，星系-晕连接和选择函数会引入多大额外系统误差。

papers.title: NEXUS: Transient Searches and First Results from Year One Observations
papers.abstract: We describe ongoing efforts of high-redshift transient searches using multi-epoch NIRCam imaging (F200W+F444W) and NIRSpec MSA/PRISM spectroscopy from the NEXUS JWST multi-cycle Treasury program targeting the north ecliptic pole region. The transient search area covers $\sim 61.5\,{\rm arcmin^2}$ between the reference epoch and each subsequent NEXUS-Deep epoch at a cadence of $\sim2$~months. In the first year of observations from NEXUS, we detect 68 robust transients, with the host photometric redshift distribution declining rapidly at $z>2$ but extending to $z_{\rm phot}\approx 6$. In addition, we obtained secure spectroscopic redshifts for 37 transients ($\sim54\%$) from NIRSpec/PRISM and NIRCam/WFSS, with seventeen at $1 < z < 2$, eight at $2 < z < 3$, two at $3 < z < 4$, and one tentative host association at z = 6.151. Overall, the NEXUS program recovers observed supernova (SN) rates broadly consistent with other SN search programs with JWST. While NEXUS achieves the highest transient detection efficiency, 6.6 SNe per imaging hr ($2.6\times$ COSMOS-SN and $26\times$ JADES-SN), the limited filter coverage (F200W+F444W only) limits robust identification and classification of high-$z$ SNe for deep spectroscopic follow-up. We describe the details of the data reduction and transient detection pipeline, and report the Year-1 transient sample along with their light curves, available MSA spectroscopy, host association, and the raw detection rate. We also describe and release a new PSF photometry package that properly accounts for correlated pixel noise from combining drizzled images.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 19 figures, 5 tables. The jwst_psfmc package, designed to account for correlated noise in PSF photometry on drizzled images, is available at https://github.com/mingyangzhuang/jwst_psfmc

analysis.title_zh: NEXUS：暂现源搜索及第一年观测的初步结果
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 NEXUS JWST 项目第一年在北黄极区域开展的高红移暂现源搜索，使用多历元 NIRCam 近红外成像和 NIRSpec/PRISM 等光谱数据。摘要称共探测到 68 个稳健暂现源，其中 37 个有可靠光谱红移，观测超新星率与其他 JWST 搜索大体一致，但 F200W+F444W 的有限滤光片覆盖限制了高红移超新星的稳健分类。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要服务于高红移暂现源和超新星巡天，而非直接 CMB 分析；但高红移超新星率、恒星形成历史和暂现源样本会影响宇宙结构形成与再电离相关的天体物理背景理解。对 CMB 读者而言，它更像是 JWST 深场时域数据和高红移天体物理约束的补充资料。
key_points: 介绍 NEXUS JWST 多周期 Treasury 项目第一年高红移暂现源搜索。
使用多历元 NIRCam 成像和 NIRSpec/PRISM 等光谱数据，报告 68 个稳健暂现源。
有限滤光片覆盖提升了分类和深度光谱后续观测的不确定性。
methods: JWST NIRCam 多历元成像，滤光片 F200W+F444W
NIRSpec MSA/PRISM 光谱
NIRCam/WFSS 光谱红移
暂现源探测流水线
PSF 测光，并考虑 drizzled 图像合并导致的相关像素噪声
宿主光度红移与宿主关联
光变曲线分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对暂现源选择函数、探测效率定义、宿主关联和红移确认标准，尤其是有限滤光片覆盖如何影响高红移超新星分类和速率估计。

papers.title: Little Red Dot Cosmology: A Matter-Era Baryon Acoustic Oscillations Probe of $Λ$CDM
papers.abstract: The discovery of Little Red Dots (LRDs) with JWST provides a new source population for cosmology in a largely unmapped period of cosmic history. LRDs are most numerous at $4\lesssim z\lesssim9$, thereby bridging existing low-redshift large-scale-structure measurements and the cosmic microwave background. In this epoch, the Universe is deep in the matter-dominated era, where dark energy is dynamically negligible and the expansion history is tightly predicted in $Λ$CDM, making these redshifts a clean test of the standard cosmological model. Recent measurements indicate that LRDs have number densities of $\bar n\sim10^{-4}$ $h^3$ Mpc$^{-3}$, a bias rising from $b\sim 3$ to $\sim8$ over this interval, and distinctive spectrophotometric signatures -- a remarkably favorable combination for baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) measurements. Using a Fisher forecast with these fiducial inputs, we find that a wide-field spectroscopic survey of LRDs over a DESI-like (14,000 deg$^2$) footprint delivers a percent-level isotropic distance scale measurement of $D_V/r_d$ across four bins spanning $4\lesssim z\lesssim9$. LRDs are therefore a compelling target for future wide-field near- to mid-infrared spectroscopy aimed at mapping large-scale structure deep into the matter-dominated era.

analysis.title_zh: 小红点宇宙学：物质主导时代的重子声学振荡探针与 ΛCDM 模型检验
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 JWST 发现的小红点（Little Red Dots, LRDs）能否作为 4≲z≲9 物质主导时代的大尺度结构示踪体，用于 BAO 测量和检验 ΛCDM 的膨胀历史。作者采用基于观测动机设定的 LRD 数密度与偏置输入进行 Fisher 预报，摘要报告称，在 DESI 类 14,000 平方度覆盖的宽场光谱巡天中，四个红移 bin 的 D_V/r_d 可达到百分比级各向同性距离尺度测量精度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: BAO 测量能够提供几何距离尺度，而 CMB 给出早期宇宙声学尺度 r_d 及高红移初始条件。LRD 所处的 4≲z≲9 区间连接 CMB 与传统低红移大尺度结构观测，可在暗能量动力学影响很小的物质主导时代检验 ΛCDM 预言，并为未来高红移光谱巡天的设计提供依据。
key_points: JWST 小红点（LRD）可填补低红移大尺度结构观测与 CMB 之间的高红移区间。
在 4≲z≲9 的物质主导时期，LRD 的数密度、偏置和光谱特征有利于 BAO 测量。
基于 Fisher 预报，DESI 类覆盖范围的宽场近红外至中红外光谱巡天有望在四个红移 bin 中测量百分比精度的各向同性距离尺度。
methods: 使用 Fisher forecast（Fisher 预报）。
采用 LRD 的基准数密度、红移依赖偏置和 DESI 类 14,000 平方度巡天覆盖作为输入。
以 BAO 的各向同性距离尺度 D_V/r_d 为测量目标，并划分 4≲z≲9 的四个红移区间。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Fisher 预报所采用的 LRD 数密度、偏置和选择函数是否符合实际观测，以及光谱红移误差、非线性效应、系统误差和星系样本可获得性是否纳入；还需确认“百分比精度”具体对应哪些红移 bin 和误差假设。

papers.title: Inelastic Self-interacting Dark Matter and LUX-ZEPLIN 248 keV Event in a Dirac Modular Inverse Seesaw
papers.abstract: We propose a novel framework that simultaneously addresses the origin of Dirac neutrino masses and the nature of self-interacting dark matter (SIDM). The model is based on an $A_{4}$ modular symmetry to ensure the Diracness of neutrinos as well as the stability of the DM. The neutrino sector realizes a Dirac Inverse Seesaw mechanism where the smallness of the neutrino mass is governed by the vacuum expectation value (VEV) of a singlet scalar $φ$. This same scalar couples to a vector-like fermion DM candidate, inducing a tiny Majorana mass splitting that renders the DM pseudo-Dirac and inelastic. Crucially, the scalar also acts as a light mediator for DM self-interactions, potentially solving the small-scale structure problems of Cold DM. In light of the recent 248 keV nuclear-recoil event, LZ230616, observed by LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) DM direct detection experiment, we demonstrate that our inelastic SIDM parameter space naturally accommodates this signal via endothermic scattering kinematics. Furthermore, the spontaneous breaking of the dark parity required for this inelasticity produces a network of cosmological domain walls. We show that the explicit symmetry breaking needed to safely annihilate these walls generates a stochastic gravitational wave background. The non-holomorphic modular symmetry reduces the free parameters, correlating neutrino observables, addressing DM phenomenology, $ΔN_{\rm eff}$, and gravitational-wave signatures.

analysis.title_zh: Dirac 模逆跷跷板中的非弹性自相互作用暗物质与 LUX-ZEPLIN 248 keV 事件
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一个基于 A4 模对称的 Dirac 模逆跷跷板框架，用同一标量场同时解释 Dirac 中微子质量、暗物质赝 Dirac 非弹性分裂和暗物质自相互作用。摘要称该模型可容纳 LUX-ZEPLIN 248 keV 核反冲事件，并把畴壁湮灭产生的随机引力波背景、ΔN_eff 和中微子/暗物质观测量联系起来。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质自相互作用、额外辐射自由度 ΔN_eff 和早期宇宙相变遗迹都会影响宇宙学约束；其中 ΔN_eff 可由 CMB 精确限制，随机引力波背景也与早期宇宙物理互补。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键是该粒子模型是否给出可检验的额外辐射或早期宇宙能量组分信号。
key_points: 提出把 Dirac 中微子质量、赝 Dirac 非弹性自相互作用暗物质和轻媒介子联系起来的模型。
声称可用吸热非弹性散射运动学容纳 LUX-ZEPLIN 248 keV 核反冲事件。
暗宇称自发破缺产生畴壁，显式破缺使其湮灭并产生随机引力波背景。
methods: A4 模对称模型构建
Dirac 逆跷跷板机制
矢量样费米子暗物质候选体
非弹性自相互作用暗物质唯象分析
LUX-ZEPLIN 直接探测事件解释
宇宙学畴壁与随机引力波背景分析
ΔN_eff 约束关联
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：LZ 248 keV 事件是否足以支持模型参数区间；非弹性散射、SIDM 小尺度结构需求、ΔN_eff、畴壁湮灭和引力波信号之间的参数相关是否同时成立；以及暗宇称破缺是否破坏暗物质稳定性假设。

papers.title: ADF22-WEB: Massive galaxy formation shaped by cosmic web filaments in the z = 3.1 proto-cluster core
papers.abstract: We present a census of dust, molecular gas, and galaxy structure in 18 dusty star-forming galaxies (DSFGs) at $z=3.09$ embedded in Ly$α$-traced cosmic web filaments in the core of the SSA22 proto-cluster, using multi-band ALMA, JWST imaging, and JVLA CO(1--0). Using up to six ALMA bands and Herschel/SPIRE data, we construct rest-frame far-infrared spectral energy distributions. The DSFGs span two orders of magnitude in far-infrared luminosity ($L_{\rm FIR}\sim10^{11}$--$10^{13}L_\odot$), with median values of $\log(L_{\rm FIR}/L_\odot)=11.56^{+0.32}_{-0.37}$ and $T_{\rm dust}=25^{+6}_{-3}{\rm K}$. For eight DSFGs with high-resolution ($\sim1$ kpc) JWST and ALMA imaging, we measure stellar and dust surface densities and find a positive correlation, suggesting that structural compaction of the stellar component proceeds together with that of the interstellar medium. We report 12 detections of CO(1--0), 18 of CO(3--2), four each of CO(8--7) and CO(9--8), and one of CO(12--11). The median brightness temperature ratio between CO(3--2) and CO(1--0) is $r_{31}=0.66^{+0.05}_{-0.04}$, consistent with field galaxies at similar redshifts. The high-$J$ CO lines show relatively low excitation, and the CO(8--7)/CO(3--2) ratio correlates with star-formation rate surface density, suggesting that molecular gas excitation is primarily regulated by star formation. Lower-mass galaxies show excess molecular gas fractions and depletion times relative to field scaling relations. By combining quiescent galaxy samples in the same field, we identify a sequence from gas-rich systems with low stellar surface density to gas-poor, compact systems with high stellar surface density. These results suggest that massive galaxy evolution in dense environments is governed by a baryon cycle linking gas supply, star formation, and structural transformation within the cosmic web environment.

analysis.title_zh: ADF22-WEB：z = 3.1 原星系团核心中由宇宙网丝状结构塑造的大质量星系形成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 z=3.09 SSA22 原星系团核心、位于 Lyα 示踪宇宙网丝状结构中的 18 个尘埃恒星形成星系，结合 ALMA、JWST、JVLA 和 Herschel/SPIRE 数据普查其尘埃、分子气体和星系结构。摘要报告了远红外光度、尘埃温度、CO 多谱线探测和气体激发结果，并指出恒星与尘埃致密化相关，支持大质量星系在宇宙网环境中的气体供给、恒星形成和结构转化相互耦合。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要面向高红移星系形成而非 CMB 本身，但它讨论 z≈3 致密环境中的重子循环和大质量星系组装，可为连接 CMB 确定的初始条件、宇宙大尺度结构增长与星系形成模型提供观测约束。对 CMB 研究者而言，它更像是后期结构形成和重子物理的背景材料。
key_points: 给出 SSA22 原星系团核心中 18 个 z=3.09 尘埃恒星形成星系的尘埃、分子气体和结构普查。
结合 ALMA、JWST、JVLA CO(1--0) 与 Herschel/SPIRE 构建远红外 SED 并测量气体激发。
摘要认为致密环境中的大质量星系演化由气体供给、恒星形成和结构转化相连的重子循环调控。
methods: 多波段 ALMA 观测
JWST 成像
JVLA CO(1--0) 观测
Herschel/SPIRE 数据
远红外光谱能量分布构建
CO 多能级谱线探测与亮温比分析
恒星和尘埃面密度测量
与同场宁静星系样本联合比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对样本选择是否偏向明亮尘埃星系、远红外 SED 与尘埃温度拟合假设、CO 到分子气体质量转换因子，以及“宇宙网环境驱动”与一般质量/选择效应之间如何区分。

papers.title: Recovering Weak Signals with Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract: In many scientific disciplines, weak signals of interest are obscured by dominant nuisance signals that are several orders of magnitude stronger. Recovering these weak signals requires subtracting the dominant ones; however, this calibration process inherently distorts or partially suppresses the underlying signal of interest. To address this problem, we propose the use of normalizing flow models to reconstruct calibration-affected weak signals. By leveraging the statistical invariance of the target signals and assuming minimal initial suppression, our framework effectively recovers the lost signal components. We provide a comprehensive theoretical overview of this normalizing flow-based recovery method and demonstrate its efficacy using simulated data.

analysis.title_zh: 用归一化流恢复弱信号
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注弱目标信号被强得多的干扰/校准信号掩盖时，常规扣除会扭曲或压低目标信号的问题。作者提出用 normalizing flow 在目标信号统计不变且初始抑制较小的假设下恢复被校准影响的弱信号，并用模拟数据展示该方法的有效性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 分析长期面对强前景、仪器系统效应和校准过程对微弱宇宙学信号的影响，例如 B 模偏振或二级各向异性信号。该工作提供的是一种通用统计恢复思路，可能与前景清除、去投影和信号损失校正有关，但摘要没有说明已应用到具体 CMB 数据。
key_points: 针对强前景/系统信号压倒弱目标信号后的校准损失问题。
提出用 normalizing flow 在统计不变性假设下重建被抑制的弱信号成分。
摘要只报告了模拟数据上的有效性展示，未给出具体天文观测应用或性能数值。
methods: normalizing flow 模型
统计不变性假设
弱信号初始抑制较小的假设
理论框架推导
模拟数据演示
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“目标信号统计不变性”和“初始抑制较小”在具体 CMB 前景扣除、仪器校准或 21cm 类场景中是否成立，以及 normalizing flow 是否会把残余系统误差误认为可恢复信号。

papers.title: Distinguishing lensing and precessional modulation in binary black-hole inspiral waveforms
papers.abstract: Binary black holes (BBHs) emit gravitational waves (GWs) as they inspiral towards merger. These GWs can be gravitationally lensed by large-scale structure along the line of sight, potentially creating multiple images of the same source with fixed time delays determined by the lensing geometry. As the BBHs inspiral, the GW frequency increases, leading to successive constructive and destructive interference between the multiple images. BBHs also have spins $\mathbf{S}_i$ that may be misaligned with their orbital angular momentum $\mathbf{L}$. As the BBHs inspiral, these misaligned spins cause $\mathbf{L}$ to precess about the total angular momentum $\mathbf{J}$, modulating the GW emission similar to pulsar emission resulting from a misaligned jet rotating in and out of the line of sight. We investigate the ability of a single L-shaped GW detector to distinguish between these two sources of modulation. We find that precessional modulation can mimic the lensing modulation between two images with comparable magnifications when the time delay between the images is short enough that fewer than three interference fringes occur during the time the GW signal spends in the sensitivity band of the detector. As strong lensing is rare for GW sources at moderate redshift while misaligned spins are common for BBHs produced in certain formation channels, ruling out precessional modulation is essential to identifying genuinely lensed systems.

analysis.title_zh: 区分双黑洞旋近波形中的透镜调制与进动调制
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文比较双黑洞 inspiral 波形中两类可混淆的调制来源：沿视线大尺度结构造成的多像引力透镜干涉，以及自旋与轨道角动量失配导致的进动。摘要报告称，在两幅像放大率相近且时延短到信号在探测器灵敏频带内少于三条干涉条纹时，进动调制可以模拟透镜调制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文主要属于引力波宇宙学而非 CMB。其与宇宙学的联系在于强透镜引力波可探测大尺度结构和距离尺度；对 CMB 读者而言，它是另一种透镜与大尺度结构探针中的系统混淆问题，概念上类似 CMB 透镜信号识别中需排除非透镜调制或系统效应。
key_points: 研究单个 L 形引力波探测器区分强透镜调制与进动调制的能力。
当两幅像放大率相近且时延足够短、探测器频带内少于三条干涉条纹时，进动调制可模拟透镜调制。
摘要强调识别真正透镜化引力波事件前，必须排除黑洞自旋进动解释。
methods: 双黑洞 inspiral 引力波波形调制分析
单个 L 形引力波探测器情形
比较引力透镜多像干涉调制与自旋失配导致的进动调制
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“少于三条干涉条纹”的判据如何定义、对探测器噪声和源参数先验是否稳健，以及结论是否依赖单探测器设定而非探测器网络。

papers.title: Probing Dark matter-Baryon Interaction with S301--the Fastest Known Star in the Milky Way
papers.abstract: The recent discovery of S301 provides an unique opportunity to investigate dark matter-baryon interaction in the innermost region of the Milky Way. S301 follows a highly eccentric orbit around Sgr~A*, and its pericenter distance is only around 12 AU with velocity about $25000\,{\rm km/s}$. These extreme properties make S301 highly sensitive to dark matter-baryon scattering in the center of galaxy, where the dark matter density may be strongly enhanced. We have calculated the orbit-averaged energy deposited rate in S301 via dark matter-proton scattering, and show that over a broad dark matter parameter space, cross sections satisfying the existing bounds from terrestrial experiments and astronomical observations can inject sufficient energy to modify the luminosity and evolution of S301. Our results establish S301 as an exceptionally sensitive probe of dark matter-baryon interactions and open a new avenue for probing dark matter interactions in high-density and high-velocity astrophysical environments.

analysis.title_zh: 用银河系已知最快恒星 S301 探测暗物质-重子相互作用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出利用银河系已知最快恒星 S301 探测银河系中心的暗物质-重子相互作用。作者计算暗物质-质子散射在 S301 中的轨道平均能量沉积率，并在摘要中报告：在较宽参数空间内，仍满足现有地面实验和天文观测约束的散射截面可能向 S301 注入足够能量，从而改变其光度和演化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 的联系主要在暗物质-重子相互作用本身：同类散射会影响早期宇宙中重子与暗物质的热史和扰动演化，因此也是 CMB 各向异性和大尺度结构约束的重要对象。S301 提供的是一个低红移、高密度、高速度环境下的互补天体物理探针，可与 CMB 给出的早期宇宙约束进行参数空间对照。
key_points: S301 的近心距离和高速轨道被用作银河系中心暗物质-重子散射探针。
摘要称在较宽暗物质参数空间内，现有约束允许的截面可影响 S301 的光度和演化。
结论依赖银河系中心暗物质密度增强与恒星内部能量沉积建模。
methods: S301 围绕 Sgr A* 的高偏心轨道信息
暗物质-质子散射
轨道平均能量沉积率计算
与地面实验和天文观测现有约束比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对银河系中心暗物质密度分布、S301 轨道参数和恒星结构假设如何进入能量沉积率；还要确认“可改变光度和演化”的判据是否可观测且与恒星模型不确定性区分开。

papers.title: Inelastic dark matter and baryon flavor symmetry in light of LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment
papers.abstract: We present a novel model for inelastic dark matter in a simple extension of the Standard Model (SM) with a local $U(1)'$ baryon flavor symmetry, such as $U(1)_{B_i-B_j}$ with $i\neq j$. In this framework, we realize a realistic flavor structure for the mixing Yukawa couplings due to higher dimensional operators or renormalizable couplings between the SM quarks and extra vector-like quarks that are anomaly-free by themselves. We regard a Dirac singlet fermion as being dark matter and obtaining a small mass splitting for inelastic dark matter, only after the $U(1)'$ symmetry is broken spontaneously. We show that there is a consistent parameter space for explaining both the LZ nuclear recoil event and the correct relic density for dark matter and the existing collider and indirect detection bounds are satisfied at the same time. In this case, we predict a relatively light $Z'$ boson with $10-20\,{\rm GeV}$ mass and a weak gauge coupling, suggesting a dedicated search at colliders. The future data with higher recoil energies at direct detection experiments will play a decisive role of discriminating between the scenarios of light and heavy dark matter.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, v2: comments on sideband events added, relic density condition corrected, and references added

analysis.title_zh: LUX-ZEPLIN（LZ）实验背景下的非弹性暗物质与重子味对称性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在带有局域 U(1)' 重子味对称性的标准模型扩展中构建非弹性暗物质模型，通过高维算符或额外无反常矢量样夸克产生夸克混合的味结构，并在 U(1)' 自发破缺后为狄拉克单态暗物质生成小质量劈裂。摘要称存在一片参数空间，可同时解释 LZ 核反冲事例和暗物质遗存丰度，并满足现有对撞机及间接探测限制，同时预言质量约为 10–20 GeV、耦合较弱的 Z' 玻色子。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作并非直接研究 CMB，但暗物质遗存丰度及其粒子物理性质是连接早期宇宙与 CMB 宇宙学的重要环节；模型能否满足间接探测约束，也关系到暗物质湮灭或衰变对宇宙学观测的潜在限制。对 CMB 研究者而言，重点是其遗存丰度机制及参数空间是否还受到早期宇宙能量注入约束，而摘要未说明是否纳入了专门的 CMB 限制。
key_points: 以局域 U(1)_{B_i-B_j} 重子味对称性构建非弹性暗物质模型。
U(1)' 自发破缺后，狄拉克单态暗物质获得小质量劈裂。
摘要预言较轻且弱耦合的 Z'，并强调更高反冲能量的直接探测数据可区分轻、重暗物质情景。
methods: 通过高维算符或标准模型夸克与无反常矢量样夸克之间的可重整化耦合实现味混合结构。
利用 U(1)' 对称性的自发破缺生成非弹性暗物质所需的质量劈裂。
联合考察 LZ 核反冲事例、暗物质遗存丰度、对撞机限制和间接探测限制对应的参数空间。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对作者如何处理和统计解释所谓的“LZ 核反冲事例”，以及遗存丰度、直接探测散射率和各类排除界限所依赖的质量劈裂、速度分布及宇宙学假设；还应确认是否显式纳入 CMB 能量注入约束，而非仅使用其他间接探测结果。

papers.title: Stacking HI in the dark: Towards detecting the reionization-epoch 21 cm signal in Lyman-$α$ dark gaps
papers.abstract: The detection of the redshifted 21 cm signal from neutral hydrogen during the epoch of reionization remains one of the central challenges in contemporary cosmology. Although upcoming radio interferometers are expected to measure 21 cm fluctuations at a few percent precision, an independent confirmation is essential to ensure robustness against instrumental systematics and foreground contamination. In this work, we propose a novel real-space stacking technique to detect the 21 cm signal, guided by the presence of dark gaps in quasar absorption spectra during the late stages of reionization ($z \sim 5.0$-$6.1$). Using a semi-numerical reionization model, we show that stacking 21 cm images on long dark gaps (length, $L > 32~h^{-1}\mathrm{cMpc}$ and threshold flux, $F_{\mathrm{th}} < 0.005$) should reveal a strong emission signal with a peak mean-subtracted 21 cm brightness temperature of $δ\tilde{T}_b \sim 2-3~ mK$ for a volume-weighted average neutral fraction of $x_{\mathrm{HI}} \sim 0.1$ at $z = 5.9$. We further extend our analysis to realistic reionization lightcones, incorporating thermal noise and foreground avoidance effects, generated for two different reionization histories. In an optimistic foreground avoidance scenario (wedge field of view $θ< 20^\circ$), a sample of roughly 100 dark gaps is sufficient to achieve a combined root-sum-square signal-to-noise ratio exceeding 10 for both reionization models, while a more conservative wedge avoidance may require more dark gaps for a solid detection. Given the large number of quasars known at $z > 6$, a detection of this stacked signal may thus already be within reach of existing optical (i.e., VLT, Keck) and 21 cm observatories (i.e., HERA, SKA). This synergistic approach offers a promising pathway towards a direct and statistically robust detection of the cosmological 21 cm signal.
papers.comment: Prepared for submission to A&A, 12 pages, 15 figures, Comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 在黑暗中叠加 HI：迈向在 Lyman-α 暗隙中探测再电离时期 21 cm 信号
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对再电离时期红移 21 cm 信号难以直接确认的问题，提出以高红移类星体吸收谱中的 Lyα 暗隙为引导，对 21 cm 图像做实空间叠加。摘要报告，半数值模型和含噪声、前景规避的 lightcone 分析显示，在乐观前景规避假设下约 100 个暗隙样本可给出较高的合并信噪比。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作直接面向再电离 21 cm 宇宙学，是 CMB 之外约束早期宇宙电离历史的重要途径；若能用 Lyα 森林暗隙独立定位中性氢富集区域，将有助于检验低频射电 21 cm 测量中的仪器系统误差和前景污染。
key_points: 提出用类星体吸收谱中的 Lyα 暗隙定位并叠加 21 cm 图像。
半数值再电离模型预期长暗隙处可出现 mK 量级的平均扣除后 21 cm 发射信号。
探讨热噪声和前景楔规避后，HERA/SKA 与现有光学类星体样本联合探测的可行性。
methods: 类星体吸收谱 Lyα dark gaps
实空间 stacking 技术
半数值再电离模型
再电离 lightcones
热噪声建模
前景规避/foreground wedge avoidance
HERA、SKA、VLT、Keck 相关观测设定
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对暗隙长度和通量阈值选择是否对模型、谱噪声和类星体连续谱拟合稳健，以及 foreground wedge、热噪声和样本选择函数如何影响叠加信噪比估计。

papers.title: Do DESI-DR2 BAO data imply a coupling of dark matter and dark energy?
papers.abstract: We revisit an interacting dark matter (DM) -- dark energy (DE) model characterized by the interaction function $Q = Γρ_x$, where $Γ$ is a constant coupling parameter and $ρ_x$ is the energy density of DE. This type of interaction is independent of the Hubble rate or other external parameters, but depends only on the fundamental properties of DE, such as its equation of state (EoS), $w_x$. We pay special attention to $w_x$ and study three distinct interacting scenarios distinguished by the nature of $w_x$, i.e. $w_x =-1$ (when DE corresponds to the vacuum energy), $w_{x} < -1$ (when DE has a phantom behavior), and $w_x > -1$ (quintessential DE). We constrain all of them using the most recent cosmological datasets, including CMB from Planck 2018, BAO from DESI DR2, and three compilations of SNIa (PantheonPlus, Union3, and DESY5). Our analyses reveal that evidence of interaction is supported in scenarios with $w_x =-1$ and $w_x < -1$ when all three datasets are combined, but from the Bayesian evidence analysis, $Λ$CDM remains favored over these interacting scenarios. Regarding the $S_8$ parameter, when $w_x > -1$, this interacting scenario leads to mildly lower estimates across all datasets.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Physical Review D. DOI: 10.1103/6kdf-vzq4. 25 pages, 20 figures

analysis.title_zh: DESI-DR2 BAO 数据是否意味着暗物质与暗能量之间存在耦合？
analysis.summary_zh: 论文重新检验了相互作用函数 Q = Γρx 的暗物质—暗能量模型，并分别研究真空能、幻影暗能量和精质暗能量三种状态方程。基于 Planck 2018 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO 及三套 SNIa 数据，摘要称联合数据在 wx = -1 和 wx < -1 情形显示相互作用证据，但贝叶斯证据总体仍偏好 ΛCDM；wx > -1 时 S8 估计略低。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质—暗能量耦合会改变宇宙膨胀史、结构增长率和 CMB 各向异性演化，因此可能影响 BAO、超新星和 CMB 对宇宙学模型的联合检验。本文直接使用 Planck CMB 与 DESI DR2 BAO 等数据评估耦合信号，并比较参数拟合偏好与贝叶斯模型证据，有助于判断 DESI 所提示的暗能量偏离是否需要引入暗部门相互作用。
key_points: 重新研究 Q = Γρx 的暗物质—暗能量相互作用模型，并按暗能量状态方程 wx 分类。
使用 Planck 2018 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO 和三套超新星数据进行约束。
联合三类数据时，wx = -1 和 wx < -1 情形支持相互作用，但贝叶斯证据仍偏好 ΛCDM；wx > -1 时 S8 仅略有降低。

三种暗能量状态方程情形：wx = -1、wx < -1、wx > -1

papers.title: Macroscopic dark matter constraints for extended mass functions
papers.abstract: We compile and recompute a subset of the landscape of constraints for macroscopic dark matter (macros), explicitly including the dependence on the fraction of dark matter in macros $f_{\rm dm}$. This allows us to map these constraints to scenarios with extended mass functions for the macros, which is a generic outcome for many of the assembly processes relevant to macro formation. We compute a number of examples of constraints for extended mass functions, finding that in many cases, wider mass functions can be severely constrained by just the interactions of the tails of the distributions. Finally, we present the code and data required for computing these limits and generating these plots in a publicly accessible repository.

analysis.title_zh: 延展质量函数的宏观暗物质约束
analysis.summary_zh: 论文汇总并重新计算一部分宏观暗物质约束，显式保留宏观暗物质占暗物质比例 fdm 的依赖性，从而推广到更一般的延展质量函数。摘要报告，较宽的质量函数可能仅因其分布尾部的相互作用就受到强约束，同时作者公开了生成这些限制和图表所需的代码与数据。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宏观暗物质属于粒子宇宙学与暗物质宇宙学交叉问题，其允许的质量范围和丰度会影响早期宇宙模型及结构形成的参数空间。虽然摘要没有直接分析 CMB 数据，但 CMB 对暗物质总丰度、早期能量沉积和结构形成历史的限制，通常可与宏观暗物质的天体物理或实验约束互补；本文的延展质量函数处理也有助于避免只讨论单一质量时遗漏分布尾部效应。
key_points: 系统整理宏观暗物质约束，并显式纳入宏观暗物质占全部暗物质的比例 fdm。
将单一质量约束推广到宏观暗物质的延展质量函数。
示例表明，宽质量分布可能因分布尾部的相互作用而受到严格限制，并公开代码和数据。

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对每类约束所采用的实验、天体物理观测和宏观暗物质相互作用假设，以及对 fdm 和质量函数形状的定义；尤其要检查尾部约束是否依赖质量函数参数化、先验或独立约束的组合方式。

papers.title: High-sensitivity Ultralight Dark Matter detector: Parametrically Amplified Casimir Devices
papers.abstract: We propose the use of sphere-and-plate Casimir force measurement setups to detect ultralight vector dark matter. We demonstrate that sub-picometer signals can be parametrically amplified to be detectable. We present a novel improvement that allows the continuous tuning of the natural frequency of the system, opening new research opportunities at the submicron scale. We show that the improved setup can determine the dark matter mass with high accuracy, significantly expand the detectable mass range, and achieve the best sensitivity to date in the $8\times10^{-14}\sim1\times10^{-12}{\rm~ eV}$ mass range.

analysis.title_zh: 高灵敏度超轻暗物质探测器：参数放大的 Casimir 器件
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出用球-板 Casimir 力测量装置探测超轻矢量暗物质，并论证亚皮米尺度信号可经参数放大而被探测。摘要报告该改进装置可连续调谐本征频率，进而高精度测定暗物质质量、扩大可探测质量范围，并在 8×10^-14 到 1×10^-12 eV 质量区间达到其所称的当前最佳灵敏度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 超轻暗物质是粒子宇宙学和宇宙学暗物质模型的重要候选，其探测结果会影响对暗物质相空间的约束。该工作不直接研究 CMB，但若能改进特定质量区间的实验约束，可与 CMB、结构形成和其他宇宙学观测给出的暗物质限制形成互补。
key_points: 提出用球-板 Casimir 力测量装置探测超轻矢量暗物质。
摘要称亚皮米信号可通过参数放大达到可探测水平。
可连续调谐系统本征频率，从而扩展可覆盖的暗物质质量范围。
methods: 球-板 Casimir 力测量装置
参数放大
连续调谐系统自然频率的改进设计
超轻矢量暗物质信号建模/灵敏度估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对参数放大的噪声模型、系统频率调谐的可实现性，以及“best sensitivity to date”所比较的实验基准和系统误差假设。

papers.title: Halo mass, star formation, and morphology in galaxies: A morphology-dependent connection between halo environment and star formation activity
papers.abstract: Understanding the mechanisms responsible for quenching star formation in galaxies requires disentangling the roles of internal structure and large-scale environment. We investigate how galaxy morphology and specific star formation rate (sSFR) relate to the typical masses of host dark-matter halos (DMHs), and whether the halo--star formation connection depends on morphology. We analyse non-active galaxies in the VIPERS and Stripe 82 fields at $0.5 \leq z \leq 1.2$, combining DESI-based Sérsic classifications with stellar masses and SFRs from spectral energy distribution fitting. Galaxies are separated into disc- and bulge-dominated systems and divided into quantile-based sSFR bins designed to minimise stellar-mass differences between morphologies. Each bin is characterised by its median $Δ{\rm MS}=\log {\rm SFR}-\log {\rm SFR}_{\rm MS}$, and characteristic DMH masses are inferred from projected galaxy cross-correlations. The halo-mass relation with star formation activity depends strongly on morphology: disc-dominated galaxies show little variation in halo mass across the probed $Δ{\rm MS}$ range, whereas bulge-dominated galaxies occupy lower-mass halos at high $Δ{\rm MS}$ and higher, mutually consistent halo masses toward lower $Δ{\rm MS}$. These trends are unlikely to be driven mainly by stellar-mass differences. Typical halo mass alone therefore does not map cleanly onto quiescence; instead, the connection between halo environment and star formation activity is stronger in bulge-dominated than in disc-dominated galaxies.
papers.comment: A&A accepted, abstract has been abridged

analysis.title_zh: 星系中的晕质量、恒星形成与形态：晕环境和恒星形成活动之间依赖形态的联系
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 0.5≤z≤1.2 非活动星系中形态、比恒星形成率和宿主暗物质晕质量的联系，结合 Sérsic 形态分类、SED 拟合量和投影星系互相关推断晕质量。摘要报告该联系显著依赖形态：盘主导星系的晕质量随主序偏移变化不大，而核球主导星系在高 ΔMS 时位于较低质量晕、向低 ΔMS 时位于更高且相互一致的晕质量区间。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系形成和反馈过程会影响物质分布、星系偏置和大尺度结构解释，是宇宙学巡天建模的重要系统因素。它与 CMB 的联系较间接，但对把星系巡天、弱透镜和 CMB 透镜等观测联合用于宇宙学约束时的星系-晕关系建模有参考价值。

使用 VIPERS 和 Stripe 82 中 0.5≤z≤1.2 的非活动星系样本。
盘主导星系的晕质量随 ΔMS 变化较弱，核球主导星系中晕环境与恒星形成活动联系更强。

papers.title: How Cluster Pressure Profiles Scale: Mass, Redshift, and Intrinsic Scatter
papers.abstract: [shortened] The thermal pressure profile of the intracluster medium is critical for cluster cosmology and understanding galaxy-cluster astrophysics. We determine the population-averaged pressure profile of Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (SZ) selected clusters, characterize its intrinsic scatter, and measure its scaling with mass and redshift. We select 60 clusters from the South Pole Telescope (SPT) SZ catalog with $0.08<z<0.6$, requiring high signal-to-noise and 5 element resolution on Planck-SPT Compton-$y$ maps. We model spherical three-dimensional pressure profiles from the Compton-$y$ maps using a hierarchical Bayesian framework with restricted cubic splines. We adopt an updated weak-lensing-calibrated Compton-$Y$--mass scaling relation, effectively removing hydrostatic mass bias from the inferred masses. Our model accounts for cluster-to-cluster profile variations, line-of-sight foreground and background contributions, and outliers from intrinsically distinct clusters or projection effects. The code is publicly available. We derive the population-averaged pressure profile and find minimal intrinsic scatter at intermediate radii ($0.4 \le r/r_{500} \le 0.7$). Our pressure profile is approximately 40\% lower than previous estimates at all radii, due to the unbiased mass scaling. We find suggestive, though not conclusive, evidence that the adopted mass dependence may require revision by removing the additional $M^{0.12}$ scaling introduced by Arnaud et al. 2010. We constrain departures from self-similar evolution in the mean profile to less than 0.1--0.2 dex and evolution of the intrinsic scatter to less than 8\% per $Δz=0.1$.

analysis.title_zh: 星系团压强剖面如何标度：质量、红移与内禀散布
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 60 个 SPT SZ 选择星系团和 Planck-SPT Compton-y 图，在层级贝叶斯框架下重建球对称三维热压强剖面，并测量其内禀散布及质量、红移标度。摘要报告平均压强剖面在所有半径上约比既有估计低 40%，中等半径处内禀散布最小，并给出对自相似演化偏离和散布演化的限制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团热压强剖面直接决定热 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 信号，是 CMB 次级各向异性、星系团宇宙学和 tSZ 前景建模的核心输入。更可靠的压强剖面、散布和演化约束有助于改进 CMB 小尺度分析、tSZ 功率谱解释以及 CMB 与星系团样本的联合宇宙学约束。
key_points: 测量 SZ 选择星系团的平均热压强剖面、内禀散布及其质量和红移标度。
使用 60 个 SPT SZ 星系团和 Planck-SPT Compton-y 图。
摘要称采用弱透镜校准的 Y-M 关系后，平均压强剖面比以往估计约低 40%。

Planck-SPT Compton-y 图

papers.title: Fast Lensing And Sub-minute High-accuracy photometry (FLASH) with JWST: Pipeline and Primordial Black Hole Microlensing Constraints from M31
papers.abstract: Minute- and sub-minute microlensing provides a direct probe of compact dark matter at asteroid-mass scales, where primordial black holes with MPBH <~ 10^-10 Msol would produce short-duration, finite-source-suppressed amplifications of stars in extragalactic fields. To enable these measurements, we present FLASH: Fast Lensing And Sub-minute High-accuracy photometry with JWST, a pipeline designed to recover such events from JWST/NIRCam imaging by preserving detector-ramp time information and performing high-precision crowded-field photometry. FLASH begins from Level 1 NIRCam data products, applies microlensing-oriented detector calibration (including improved treatment of non-linearity and position-dependent detector calibration), and extracts forced multi-band light curves in crowded fields. We apply the pipeline to two public JWST/NIRCam datasets targeting the disk of M31 with 21.5 s cadence: GO-4735 and GO-2609. Although these observations are suboptimal as a microlensing survey, they provide a stringent test of JWST time-domain performance in a high-surface-brightness, crowded stellar field. Using these data with our own microlensing simulations, we derive the first JWST-based microlensing constraints toward M31, finding fPBH <~ 100 for MPBH~ 10^-9 Msol. Our results demonstrate that JWST is a competitive platform for high-cadence microlensing and that a dedicated, continuous NIRCam monitoring program could substantially improve constraints on compact dark matter below the current ground-based frontier.

analysis.title_zh: JWST 上的快速引力透镜与亚分钟高精度测光（FLASH）：管线及来自 M31 的原初黑洞微引力透镜约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 FLASH（Fast Lensing And Sub-minute High-accuracy photometry）管线，针对 JWST/NIRCam 数据中的分钟及亚分钟微引力透镜事件，处理探测器时间信息、标定和拥挤场高精度测光。作者将其应用于 M31 盘区的两个公开数据集，并结合微引力透镜模拟报告了基于 JWST 的 M31 微引力透镜约束；摘要同时指出这些观测并非为微引力透镜巡天优化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作把 JWST 的高时间分辨率成像能力与原初黑洞微引力透镜搜索联系起来，探测的是地面观测较难覆盖的短时标、低质量尺度紧致暗物质。它与 CMB 的关系主要是互补的：CMB 约束早期宇宙和暗物质相关物理，而该工作通过晚期宇宙中的微引力透镜事件检验小质量原初黑洞暗物质。摘要没有涉及 CMB 数据或 CMB 参数约束。
key_points: 提出 FLASH 管线，从 JWST/NIRCam Level 1 数据中保留探测器 ramp 时间信息并提取高精度多波段光变曲线。
将管线应用于 M31 盘区两个公开 JWST 数据集，观测节奏为 21.5 秒。
基于数据与微引力透镜模拟，报告了首个基于 JWST、面向 M31 的微引力透镜约束。
methods: JWST/NIRCam 成像数据分析
从 Level 1 数据产品开始的探测器标定

papers.title: Analytic bispectrum covariance for galaxy survey cosmology
papers.abstract: The bispectrum of galaxy distribution remains an underutilized statistic in cosmological data analysis. This can be attributed to mathematical and computational challenges associated with a proper modeling of the signal and its covariance. While recent theoretical advances have made it possible to analytically model the bispectrum signal and covariance using perturbation theory, a fully non-Gaussian analytical treatment of the covariance for a realistic survey with window remains elusive. The full bispectrum covariance of observed galaxies is a non-Gaussian six-point function with each of its legs convolved with a complex window function. Although it has so far proven intractable, the problem is well-posed. In this article, we present the derivation, implementation, and validation of a numerical routine for the analytic calculation of the bispectrum covariance for a spherical window, carried out by a large language model (LLM). The derivation uncovered terms that vanish in the windowless case but that dominate the covariance for triangles with survey scale modes. As a development benchmark for the implementation, we used the sample covariance of the halo bispectrum measured from 6000 fiducial Quijote halo catalogs in real space. Over several iterations of refinement, the LLM converged on a regime-specific numerical scheme for the covariance matrix calculation, mixing exact and approximate approaches, resulting in a highly optimized, tractable and accurate covariance across scales and shapes, using only tree-level models for the input polyspectra. Closing the loop still required human expertise, which illustrates what human-AI collaboration in research may look like in the near term.

analysis.title_zh: 星系巡天宇宙学的解析双谱协方差
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对真实星系巡天中带复杂窗口函数的非高斯双谱协方差难以解析计算的问题，推导、实现并验证了一个球形窗口下的数值解析计算程序。作者使用 6000 个 Quijote halo catalog 的双谱样本协方差作为开发基准，并报告通过混合精确和近似方法，在不同尺度与形状上获得了可处理且准确的协方差计算结果；摘要还指出，大语言模型参与了推导和实现，但最终仍需要人工专业判断。

papers.title: Exploring the dark sector through galaxy dynamics in clusters
papers.abstract: Galaxy clusters are among the most powerful laboratories to probe fundamental physics, from the formation of cosmic structures to the nature of dark matter, dark energy, and gravity. Realizing their full potential requires accurate and unbiased determinations of their mass profiles, a longstanding challenge in cluster cosmology. In this context, the kinematics of member galaxies in clusters has become a key tool to reconstruct the mass distribution and to investigate the dynamical properties of clusters. The advent of large spectroscopic datasets has enabled the application of increasingly sophisticated models and robust techniques, which make kinematic analyses competitive with other probes of cluster dynamics. In this review, we provide a comprehensive overview of cluster kinematics, covering the main methods to infer dynamical masses and mass profiles, their physical assumptions, and the impact of systematics such as deviation from dynamical equilibrium, triaxiality, and substructures. We discuss the complementarity with other techniques to investigate the structure of clusters and highlight recent applications to tests cosmological models. We focus in particular on the role of kinematical studies in constraining the dark sector (dark matter and dark energy) and in providing novel insights into the behavior of gravity at Mpc scales. Finally, we outline current limitations and future prospects, emphasizing that the combination of improved modeling and forthcoming spectroscopic surveys will establish cluster kinematics as a fundamental probe in the era of precision cosmology.
papers.comment: 76 pages plus references, 15 Figures; to be published in Astronomy & Astrophysics Review, re-submitted after revision

papers.title: Tracing the Cosmic Origins: Machine Learning Reconstruction of the Primordial Density Field from EoR Observations
papers.abstract: Reconstructing the initial conditions of the Universe from late-time tracers would unlock cosmological information buried by non-linear structure formation and astrophysics. We reconstruct the initial density field at $z\sim300$ from simulated 21-cm and CO(1-0) line-intensity maps at $z\sim8$ generated with LIMFAST. Using a three-dimensional U-Net, we reconstruct the initial conditions and evaluate its impact on cosmological parameter constraints. The two tracers probe complementary environments: 21-cm emission traces neutral, low-density regions of the intergalactic medium, while CO traces overdense, star-forming regions. To emulate realistic observations, we model instrumental effects for SKA1-Low- and COMAP-ERA-like surveys, including finite angular resolution and thermal noise. We assess reconstruction performance through the cross-correlation coefficient between reconstructed and true initial density fields, $|C(k)|$. In the noiseless case, combining both tracers delivers the most accurate recovery across ionisation states, with $|C(k)| \gtrsim$ 0.90 for $k \lesssim$ 0.75 Mpc$^{-1}$. With observational effects, small-scale information is degraded, but combining tracers still achieves $|C(k)| \gtrsim$ 0.70 for $k \lesssim$ 0.3 Mpc$^{-1}$. To quantify information gain, we perform simulation-based inference of cosmological parameters from power-spectrum summaries before and after reconstruction. In both noiseless and noisy settings, reconstruction tightens parameter constraints: uncertainties on $σ_8$ and $n_{\rm s}$ improve by $\sim2\times$, with smaller but consistent gains for other parameters. This is further confirmed using Kullback-Leibler divergence diagnostics for an ensemble of observations. These results indicate that joint analysis of future 21-cm and CO surveys, combined with such reconstruction, can partially recover otherwise inaccessible cosmological information.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 13 figures. Submitted to the Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society (MNRAS)

papers.title: Early against Late: A contrast on dark energy in the light of DESI DR2
papers.abstract: Recent findings from Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Baryon Acoustic Oscillation (BAO) measurements, combined with Type Ia supernovae and Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) data, suggest potential parameter-level deviations from $Λ\text{CDM}$. However, parameter exclusions omit prior-volume penalties, whereas Bayesian evidence uncovers a stark dichotomy between early- and late-time dynamics. To quantify this effect, we perform a Bayesian model comparison that explicitly accounts for the cosmological epoch of dark energy dynamics, contrasting two schemes acting in opposite epochs of cosmic history: pre-recombination Early Dark Energy (EDE) and late-time Chevallier--Polarski--Linder (CPL), both measured against a baseline $Λ$CDM. We validate the learned harmonic-mean estimator against \texttt{UltraNest} (at background level) before applying it to the CMB analysis. Background-only data already disfavor both extensions, yielding $\ln B_{Λ\text{CDM},\text{EDE}} = 2.45 \pm 0.25$ and $\ln B_{Λ\text{CDM},\text{CPL}} = 3.45 \pm 0.24$. Including CMB sharpens this result: EDE is decisively rejected ($\ln B_{Λ\text{CDM},\text{EDE}} = 12.44 \pm 0.05$) with its early-time fraction constrained to $10^3\,Ω_e^{\rm EDE} = 2.0^{+0.6}_{-1.0}$, whereas CPL remains moderately disfavored ($\ln B_{Λ\text{CDM},\text{CPL}} = 2.33 \pm 0.06$), even though 2D parameter posteriors for both models display a multi-$σ$ deviation from $Λ\text{CDM}$. Thus, Bayesian evidence weakens reported preferences for dark energy dynamics, with the impact depending on the cosmic epoch involved, confirmed by our functional reconstructions of $w_{\rm de}(z)$ and $Ω_{\rm de}(z)$ from posterior samples.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables and 2 appendices. Comments are welcome

papers.title: Initial conditions for inflation
papers.abstract: We propose a single-field mechanism that dynamically prepares the initial conditions required for exponential plateau inflation. The inflaton is decomposed into a coarse-grained mode and a high-occupancy, approximately Gaussian band of relativistic nonzero modes. Gaussian--Hartree averaging of the potential produces an exact variance-dependent minimum, which places the coarse-grained field high on the plateau when the excitation variance is large. Under a translation-invariant microcanonical measure, the available phase-space volume is exponentially concentrated near this minimum, while an order-one homogeneous kinetic-energy fraction is exponentially atypical. During expansion, the preparation modes redshift as radiation, $σ^2\propto a^{-2}$ and $ρ_χ\propto a^{-4}$. Although the induced minimum rapidly moves toward the vacuum, the force acting on the coarse-grained mode is bounded by an exponentially small factor, yielding analytic upper limits on its velocity, displacement, and kinetic fraction. We derive a sufficient condition for the subsequent number of slow-roll e-folds and exhibit a benchmark with more than 60 e-folds. The mechanism also motivates correlated finite-onset signatures: large-scale power suppression with decaying oscillations and a variance-convolution bispectrum.

papers.title: Fast Bayesian Inference for Long-Duration Gravitational-Wave Signals in 3G detectors
papers.abstract: Third-generation (3G) gravitational-wave detectors will observe binary-neutron-star inspirals for nearly a day, so Earth's rotation becomes part of the signal rather than a negligible correction. This destroys the usual separation between intrinsic and extrinsic parameters and creates a major computational bottleneck for Bayesian inference. We show that the exact five-harmonic Jaranowski-Krolak-Schutz (JKS) decomposition restores the separation of the rotating antenna amplitude response from the computationally expensive intrinsic waveform calculations. By sampling the intrinsic waveform on a frequency grid set by its phase curvature and then applying error-controlled relative binning, likelihood evaluations for a 21.3-h signal are accelerated by O(10^4), making day-long 3G signal inference practical.

analysis.title_zh: 第三代引力波探测器中长持续时间引力波信号的快速贝叶斯推断

papers.title: Supernovae Unite: Host-Galaxy Mass Measurements of Type Ia Supernovae and Their Impact on Cosmology
papers.abstract: Current consensus suggests that Type Ia supernova (SN Ia) brightnesses post light-curve standardization correlate with their host-galaxy stellar masses, which must be accounted for to obtain accurate cosmological constraints. For example, Vincenzi et al. (2025) showed that different host-galaxy stellar mass measurements for the same dataset produce redshift-dependent differences of order $\sim 0.01$ mag, large enough to appreciably shift cosmological constraints. We present internally consistent host-galaxy stellar masses remeasured using aperture photometry and spectral energy distribution (SED) fitting for SN-Unite, which combines the spectroscopic Pantheon+ and the photometric Dark Energy Survey five-year (DES-SN5YR) samples into the largest SN Ia cosmology sample to date, with 2884 likely SNe Ia. We find that photometry and SED fitting choices shift SN-Unite Flat$w$CDM parameters well below statistical uncertainties. Our stellar masses differ from the Pantheon+ data release partly due to a redshift-dependent internal inconsistency within Pantheon+, while remaining largely consistent with the DES-SN5YR (DES-Dovekie) data release. When the Pantheon+ subsample of SN-Unite is combined with Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO) and Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) measurements, the significance for time-evolving dark energy increases from 3.4$σ$ to 4.0$σ$ based on the maximum a posteriori when our newly derived host-galaxy stellar masses replace the Pantheon+ data-release host-galaxy stellar masses, while DES-Dovekie remains virtually unchanged, consistent with the findings of Hoyt et al. (2026). By remeasuring the host-galaxy stellar masses using a consistent framework throughout the whole sample, we improve the robustness of the SN-Unite cosmological constraints against systematic differences in host-galaxy stellar mass measurements.

The host-galaxy stellar mass measurements and photometry will be publicly available upon acceptance of the paper. V2: For our Youtube Cosmology Talks, see https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KT-j65gRnOQ. Removed inactive datalinks and fixed MAP significance. Submitted to the Astrophysical Journal

papers.title: Rapid quenching and early gas depletion in the core of a galaxy protocluster at z=2.2
papers.abstract: Understanding how galaxy evolution is affected in forming high-z overdensities is a major open question in modern astrophysics. Here, we present the average properties of the quiescent galaxy population recently identified in the core of the Spiderweb protocluster at z = 2.16. By stacking observations from the Hubble Space Telescope (HST; F160W imaging and G141 grism spectroscopy), the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST; PaBeta narrowband imaging), and the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA; 1.2 mm dust continuum imaging), we constrained their ensemble star formation history (SFH), residual dust-obscured star formation, and cold gas mass, respectively. The inferred average SFH indicates steady stellar mass growth, with progenitor SFRs consistent with those of massive Halpha emitters (HAEs) in the same structure. This is followed by rapid quenching, on average 500 Myr prior to observation. No significant age differences are found between active galactic nucleus (AGN) hosts and non-AGN systems. We find weak PaBeta emission for 80% of the sample, yet with dust-obscured star formation rates consistent with quiescence in all but one source (ID 443) excluded from the sample. Our galaxies remain individually and globally undetected in the dust continuum, yielding an average gas fraction fgas= Mmol/Mstar<7%, consistent with previously reported gas depletion trends with stellar mass observed in neighboring HAEs. We thus find the Spiderweb protocluster to host a sizable population of gas-depleted, massive quenched galaxies in its core, likely descending from main-sequence galaxy progenitors and building the first elements of the red sequence in this high-z forming cluster.
papers.comment: 16 pages (of which 2 pages for Appendices), 9 Figures, 4 Tables. A&A in press

analysis.title_zh: z=2.2 星系原星系团核心中的快速熄灭和早期气体耗尽
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 z=2.16 Spiderweb 原星系团核心中新近识别的静止星系群体，通过堆叠 HST、JWST 和 ALMA 观测来约束平均恒星形成史、残余尘埃遮蔽恒星形成和冷气体质量。摘要报告其平均约 500 Myr 前快速熄灭，尘埃连续谱未探测并给出平均气体分数 f_gas<7%，显示核心中已有大量气体耗尽的大质量静止星系。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文属于星系形成与高红移环境演化，对 CMB 本身关联较弱。其宇宙学相关性主要在于高红移大尺度结构和星系团前身的形成历史，可作为理解 CMB 之后结构增长、重子耗散与星系环境效应的观测背景。
key_points: 研究 Spiderweb 原星系团核心中 z=2.16 静止星系群体的平均性质。
堆叠 HST、JWST 和 ALMA 数据以约束恒星形成史、残余恒星形成和冷气体质量。
摘要称这些星系气体贫乏、已快速熄灭，可能构成高红移成团环境中红序的早期组成部分。
methods: HST F160W 成像
HST G141 grism 光谱
JWST PaBeta 窄带成像
ALMA 1.2 mm 尘埃连续谱成像
观测堆叠

尘埃遮蔽恒星形成率估计
冷分子气体质量/气体分数约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对样本选择和堆叠方法是否会偏向气体贫乏或低恒星形成率对象，以及 ALMA 非探测给出的 f_gas<7% 如何依赖尘埃温度、气体-尘埃转换和成员身份判定。

papers.title: Exploring the connection between Fast Radio Bursts and binary neutron star mergers
papers.abstract: Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) are highly energetic radio sources whose duration is of the order of milliseconds. The physical origin of these sources is still unknown. Many models suggest magnetars as possible progenitors of FRBs, and this is supported by the association between FRBs and the Galactic magnetar SGR 1935+2154; other proposed progenitors include binary neutron star (BNS) mergers, that are themselves linked to magnetar formation. In this work we investigate the possible connection between FRBs and BNS mergers, including magnetars that might be produced in such events, by comparing the detection rates inferred from synthetic BNS and associated FRB populations with the rates observed by CHIME. We produce a synthetic catalog of BNS mergers by combining recent theoretically predicted BNS merger rate as a function of redshift and the neutron star mass distribution inferred from measurements of Galactic BNSs. Using this catalog we predict the number of BNS systems ending as magnetars (stable or supramassive neutron star) or black holes (formed promptly or after the collapse of a hypermassive neutron star) for different equations of state. We then simulate for each BNS (and therefore for each magnetar remnant) an associated FRB and estimate how many of them can be potentially detected by CHIME. We find that the rate of BNS mergers and the rate of magnetars produced after BNS represents a non-negligible fraction of the FRBs detected by CHIME, both repeating and non-repeating. Although additional formation channels need to be considered to account for the entire population of FRBs, the existence of a fraction of FRBs that might genuinely be associated to BNS mergers has profound implications in the context of multi- messenger astronomy, supporting the systematic searches of coincident detections of FRBs and GWs from a BNS merger with current and future facilities.
papers.comment: 5 pages. Accepted for publication in A&A

analysis.title_zh: 探索快速射电暴与双中子星并合之间的联系
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究快速射电暴是否可能与双中子星并合及其形成的磁星有关。作者构造合成 BNS 并合星表，在不同状态方程下判断并合遗迹并为每个系统模拟关联 FRB，再与 CHIME 探测率比较；摘要报告这一路径可贡献 CHIME 所见重复和非重复 FRB 的非可忽略部分，但仍需其他形成通道解释全体 FRB。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文主要属于高能瞬变和多信使天文学，对 CMB 本身不是直接探针；但它涉及红移相关事件率、致密天体种群和引力波/射电联合观测，这些都是时域宇宙学和大尺度天体物理背景建模的相关输入。若 FRB 与 BNS 并合存在真实关联，未来 FRB-GW 联合样本也可能为宇宙学距离尺度和重子分布研究提供辅助信息。
key_points: 比较合成 BNS/FRB 种群与 CHIME 观测探测率。
按不同中子星状态方程估计 BNS 并合后形成磁星或黑洞的数量。
摘要称 BNS 并合及其后磁星可贡献 CHIME FRB 的非可忽略部分，但不能解释全部 FRB。
methods: 合成双中子星并合星表
随红移变化的理论 BNS 并合率
由银河系 BNS 测量推断的中子星质量分布
不同中子星状态方程下的并合遗迹分类
关联 FRB 模拟
与 CHIME 探测率比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 FRB 亮度函数、束射/重复假设、CHIME 选择函数以及 BNS 并合率和状态方程如何共同影响“非可忽略部分”这一结论。

papers.title: Euclid. A two-point correlation approach to diagnosing star-related systematics in the Euclid spectroscopic survey
papers.abstract: The Euclid spectroscopic survey will measure galaxy clustering with unprecedented precision, requiring stringent control of observational and instrumental systematics. Star-related effects may contaminate spectroscopic images through photometric persistence and imperfect masking of stars. We characterized their impact on galaxy clustering analyses, focusing on angular features identifiable in the data. We used angular and spatial auto- and cross-correlation statistics. For galaxies, we used mock spectroscopic catalogues from the EuclidLargeMocks in a 330 deg2 region of the Euclid Wide Survey (EWS). For stars, we used Gaia and 2MASS catalogues in the same area. To simulate photometric persistence, we implemented a simplified detector-level model calibrated on spectroscopic measurements and varied its strength to introduce different interloper fractions. For stellar masking, we modelled inconsistencies between the mask applied to the data and to the random catalogue. We measured star-star, galaxy-galaxy, and star-galaxy angular correlation functions using the Landy--Szalay estimator, and quantified deviations from the expected null star-galaxy correlation. We also evaluated the large-scale impact of such systematics through the three-dimensional two-point correlation function (2PCF). Photometric persistence produces a characteristic feature in the star-galaxy angular cross-correlation at scales of order 100", corresponding to the Euclid dithering pattern and grism dispersion geometry, and a spurious positive signal approximately constant up to 1°. Star-galaxy cross-correlation can detect residual persistence at contamination levels as low as 10% in a Data Release 1 spectroscopic catalogue. In contrast, stellar-mask mismatches produce strong small-scale angular signatures but have negligible impact on the large-scale 2PCF under realistic EWS conditions.

analysis.title_zh: Euclid：用两点相关方法诊断 Euclid 光谱巡天中的恒星相关系统误差
analysis.summary_zh: 本文面向 Euclid 光谱巡天的星系聚类分析，研究恒星 photometric persistence 与恒星遮罩不一致等系统误差如何污染角向和空间两点相关函数。摘要报告称，persistence 会在约 100 角秒产生与 Euclid dithering 和 grism 几何相关的特征，并导致至 1 度尺度的虚假正相关；星-星系互相关可在 DR1 光谱目录中检出低至 10% 的残余 persistence，而现实 EWS 条件下遮罩不匹配对大尺度 2PCF 影响可忽略。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Euclid 星系聚类将用于暗能量、结构增长和宇宙学参数约束，并与 CMB 结果形成重要互补。恒星相关系统误差若未被控制，会偏置大尺度结构测量，从而影响与 CMB 联合分析中的参数一致性检验、晚期宇宙张力研究和交叉相关宇宙学。
key_points: 研究 Euclid 光谱巡天中恒星相关系统误差对星系聚类测量的污染。
使用星-星、星系-星系、星-星系角相关函数和三维 2PCF 诊断 persistence 与恒星遮罩问题。
摘要称 photometric persistence 会在约 100 角秒尺度产生特征，并在至 1 度尺度上造成近似常数的虚假正相关。
methods: EuclidLargeMocks mock 光谱星系目录
330 平方度 Euclid Wide Survey 区域
Gaia 与 2MASS 恒星目录
简化探测器级 photometric persistence 模型
Landy-Szalay 估计量
角向 auto/cross-correlation
三维 two-point correlation function（2PCF）
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 persistence 模型与实际 Euclid 光谱测量的标定方式、10% 污染检出阈值的定义和统计假设，以及小尺度角向系统误差为何在现实 EWS 条件下对大尺度 2PCF 影响可忽略。

papers.title: Probing Neutron Star Equation of State Universality with Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: Current neutron star equation-of-state inferences assume that a common equation of state describes all neutron stars. However, {poorly understood dense-matter physics may give rise to distinct long-lived stellar subpopulations following different mass--tidal-deformability relations, invalidating this assumption. In this Letter, we demonstrate that next-generation gravitational-wave observatories enable neutron star equation-of-state universality to be transformed from an assumption into a testable hypothesis. By combining hierarchical Bayesian inference with a piecewise-polytropic parametrization of the neutron star equation of state, we establish a framework for testing equation-of-state universality with next-generation gravitational-wave observatories. We find that about 30 (50) loud binary neutron star mergers with network SNRs above 100 are sufficient to provide compelling evidence for departures from equation-of-state universality, even if only 20% (10%) of the population exhibits one of the representative non-universality parametrizations considered here.

analysis.title_zh: 用引力波探测中子星状态方程的普适性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论当前中子星状态方程推断中“普适状态方程”假设可能失效的问题。作者结合层级贝叶斯推断与分段多方状态方程参数化，展示下一代引力波观测可将状态方程普适性变成可检验假设；摘要称在其代表性非普适模型中，约 30 或 50 个高信噪比 BNS 事件足以提供偏离普适性的有力证据。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接分析 CMB，但与宇宙学中的引力波标准警报器和致密物质系统误差有关。BNS 潮汐参数和状态方程假设会影响引力波参数估计，而未来多信使宇宙学若要与 CMB 约束联合比较，需要理解这类源物理假设带来的偏差。
key_points: 挑战“所有中子星共享同一状态方程”的常用假设。
提出用下一代引力波观测和层级贝叶斯推断检验状态方程普适性。
摘要给出在代表性非普适参数化下，约 30 或 50 个高信噪比 BNS 事件可给出偏离普适性的有力证据。
methods: 层级贝叶斯推断
分段多方状态方程参数化
下一代引力波观测器模拟/预期
高网络信噪比双中子星并合样本
质量-潮汐形变关系的非普适性参数化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其“非普适性”的具体参数化是否覆盖真实致密物质可能性，以及事件选择、SNR>100 阈值、质量分布和探测器网络假设对所需事件数的影响。

papers.title: Supernovae Unite: Combining Pantheon+ and DES-SN5YR
papers.abstract: We present the Hubble diagram and cosmological constraints resulting from the combination of the Pantheon+ and DES-SN5YR supernova (SN) samples, which we refer to as Unite. Unite updates Pantheon+, including methodology improvements that the DES sample enabled, and adds the new SN from the DES survey. This represents the most comprehensive and internally consistent SN Ia dataset available, consisting of 2884 likely type Ia supernovae. This work features consistent SN Ia modelling, sample selection, and bias corrections. We also redetermine host-galaxy stellar masses for over 98% of the sample using a consistent framework. Using Unite alone, for a flat universe with a cosmological constant (Flat-$Λ$CDM), we find $Ω_{\rm m} = 0.310^{+0.012}_{-0.011}$. We further present constraints using the Unite sample combined with Cosmic Microwave Background and both DES and DESI Baryon Acoustic Oscillation data. We find strong evidence of tension between CMB measurements and the combined BAO and supernova datasets when fitting a model with constant dark energy equation of state ($w$), which is alleviated when allowing $w$ to vary with time. For a flat universe with dark energy that has a time-evolving equation of state parametrized by $w_0$ and $w_a$ we find $(Ω_{\rm m},w_0,w_a) = (0.305\pm0.004,-0.861^{+0.044}_{-0.042},-0.60^{+0.17}_{-0.19})$ with a dark energy Figure of Merit of 315. This corresponds to a $\sim30\%$ reduction in the area of the $w_0-w_a$ confidence region relative to previous constraints from the combination of DES Y6, DESI-DR2, and CMB data (arXiv:2605.27221). The Bayesian evidence indicates only weak preference for time evolving dark energy, whereas frequentist analyses yield a preference over Flat-$Λ$CDM at a significance of $3.3σ$ ($3.1σ$) when using the maximum $\textit{a posteriori}$ probability (maximum likelihood).
papers.comment: 26 pages, 22 figures. The Unite Hubble diagram and likelihood will be made publicly available upon acceptance of the paper; v2 Including a link to our Youtube Cosmology Talks video, see https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KT-j65gRnOQ. Removed inactive datalinks, fixed MAP significance, and adjusted the manuscript format for submission to PASA. Submitted to PASA

papers.title: Probing Dark Matter with Strongly Lensed Binary Black Hole Mergers: Prospects in the Near Future
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave~(GW) transients, strongly lensed by intervening galaxies and clusters, are expected to constitute a small fraction ($\sim 0.1$-$0.5\%$) of the events detectable by ground-based detectors. A strongly lensed binary black hole (BBH) merger will produce multiple copies of the GW signal arriving at different times at the detector. The abundance and time-delay distribution of these lensed events are sensitive to the mass, density profile, and redshift distribution of the lens population, and in turn, to the underlying nature of dark matter. Jana et al. (Phys.Rev.Lett. 135 (2025) 11, 111402) recently proposed a method to constrain the masses of warm dark matter (WDM) particles making use of the strongly lensed events detectable by next-generation GW detectors. In this work, we investigate the prospects of constraining the mass of the WDM particle using upcoming observations of the upgraded LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA network. This requires a careful modeling of the detector selection effects. The upcoming fifth observing run (O5) is expected to yield only a modest bound, since only a few lensed pairs are expected at that early stage. By the sixth observing run (O6), we forecast a bound on the WDM particle mass, $m_{\rm wdm}^{-1} \lesssim 0.1$-$0.2\text{keV}^{-1}$ ($m_{\rm wdm} \gtrsim 5$-$10\text{keV}$), which is comparable to the tightest existing astrophysical constraints. Runs beyond O6 will tighten the constraint by roughly an order of magnitude. Strongly lensed GWs therefore offer a complementary, competitive, and independent probe of dark matter.

analysis.title_zh: 用强透镜化双黑洞并合探测暗物质：近期前景
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究利用强透镜化双黑洞引力波事件来约束温暗物质粒子质量的近期前景，并特别纳入升级版 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 的探测选择效应。摘要报告 O5 只能给出较弱限制，而 O6 可能达到与现有最强天体物理约束相当的水平，后续运行或进一步改善。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接使用 CMB，但与宇宙学中的暗物质性质检验密切相关；强透镜引力波提供了独立于 CMB、星系团和 Lyman-alpha 等传统探针的结构形成信息，可作为检验温暗物质模型的互补路径。
key_points: 强透镜化双黑洞并合会产生多重引力波信号，其丰度和时延分布可追踪透镜群体性质。
论文将该统计量用于预估升级版 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O5/O6 对温暗物质质量的约束能力。
摘要称 O6 约束可接近现有最强天体物理限制，后续运行有望进一步收紧。
methods: 强透镜引力波事件统计
双黑洞并合多重信号的时延分布建模

papers.title: Expanding the scope of dark siren cosmology: Inferring the population properties of gravitational wave-hosting galaxies
papers.abstract: The field of gravitational wave "dark siren" cosmology is facing a number of challenges surrounding the way in which galaxy catalogue data is incorporated into the analysis. The three biggest challenges are adequately compensating for galaxy catalogue incompleteness, robust treatment of galaxy redshift and source properties, and the as-yet unknown host galaxy weighting model. We present an updated methodology for inferring cosmological parameters using dark sirens and incomplete galaxy catalogues. By switching to a sampled redshift prior, rather than one which is pre-computed on a grid, we can jointly infer parameters which describe the population of gravitational-wave hosting galaxies, alongside the gravitational wave population and cosmological model. Using the cosmological inference software gwcosmo, we reproduce a subset of GWTC-5.0 cosmology results, then extend the analysis to jointly infer the host galaxy weighting model - the first measurement of its kind to do so - leading to an updated measurement of the Hubble constant with $H_0 = {71.9}_{-7.5}^{+9.1}$ km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$ (median and 68% symmetric credible interval). This innovative new method opens the door to solving several of the biggest challenges currently facing the field of dark siren cosmology.

analysis.title_zh: 拓展暗警报器宇宙学的范围：推断引力波宿主星系的族群性质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对引力波暗警报器宇宙学中星系目录不完备、红移与源性质处理、宿主星系加权未知等问题，提出在 gwcosmo 中使用采样红移先验的联合推断方法。摘要报告该方法复现了部分 GWTC-5.0 宇宙学结果，并进一步联合推断引力波宿主星系加权模型，得到更新的 H0 测量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗警报器提供独立于传统电磁距离阶梯的 H0 测量，可用于检验 CMB 推断的 H0 与低红移测量之间的张力。该工作主要改进引力波-星系目录联合推断的系统误差处理，对 CMB 宇宙学的意义在于提供外部低红移膨胀率约束和模型一致性检验。
key_points: 面向暗警报器宇宙学中星系目录不完备、红移处理和宿主星系加权模型的不确定性。
将预计算网格红移先验替换为采样红移先验，以联合推断宿主星系族群、引力波源族群和宇宙学参数。
摘要报告复现部分 GWTC-5.0 结果，并首次联合测量宿主星系加权模型，同时给出更新的 H0 约束。

incomplete galaxy catalogues

papers.title: Late-Time Emergence of Dark Energy and Its Interaction with Dark Matter
papers.abstract: We present an interacting scenario between dark energy (DE) and dark matter (DM), where DE has an emergent nature, that means, DE was absent in the early universe but it becomes effective only at late times. We consider two specific emergent DE models, one with no free parameters and the other featuring two parameters describing the speed and epoch of the transition. We constrain both scenarios using the cosmic microwave background (CMB) measurements from the Planck 2018 release, baryon acoustic oscillations from DESI DR2, and three different compilations of Type Ia supernovae (PantheonPlus, DES-Dovekie, and Union3). Our analysis indicates that current cosmological probes are not able to tightly constrain the speed of the transition. For both scenarios, the posterior distribution of the interaction parameter is shifted away from zero at more than 95\% CL whenever the CMB data are combined with any of these additional probes, with the preferred direction corresponding to a transfer of energy from DE to DM. While CMB alone yields a high value of $H_0$, in agreement with local determinations, this effect is reduced when DESI is added and disappears once supernova data are included. In contrast, the clustering parameter $S_8$ is consistently shifted toward lower values in the combined datasets, and it is correlated with the preference for a negative interaction. However, according to the $Δχ^2_{\rm min}$ and Bayesian evidence, none of the interacting models is favored over $Λ$CDM or $w_0w_a$CDM, indicating that the interaction does not rescue these emergent DE models. Our results therefore highlight the limitations of these scenarios in addressing current cosmological tensions, while pointing to the crucial role of future data in further assessing their viability.
papers.comment: 15 pages including references; 10 captioned figures and 3 tables; version accepted by Phys. Rev. D

analysis.title_zh: 暗能量的晚期涌现及其与暗物质的相互作用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出暗能量只在晚期出现并可与暗物质相互作用的情景，考察两个具体涌现暗能量模型，并用 Planck 2018 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO 和多套 Ia 超新星数据联合约束。摘要报告当前数据难以限制转变速度，联合数据中相互作用参数偏向暗能量向暗物质转移，但整体模型证据并不优于 ΛCDM 或 w0waCDM，因而不能有效缓解宇宙学张力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接涉及 CMB 与低红移探针的联合拟合，核心问题是暗能量动力学和暗物质-暗能量相互作用是否能解释 H0 与 S8 张力。对 CMB 读者而言，关键在于 Planck 约束如何与 DESI BAO、超新星共同改变 H0、S8 和相互作用参数的后验。
key_points: 构造了晚期涌现暗能量并与暗物质相互作用的模型。
使用 Planck 2018 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO 和三套 Ia 超新星数据进行约束。
摘要称相互作用参数在联合数据中偏离零超过 95% CL，但贝叶斯证据和 Δχ² 不支持其优于 ΛCDM 或 w0waCDM。

papers.title: Rubin J122659.4+090236: An Extremely Low Surface Brightness Galaxy Candidate Discovered in the Rubin LSST Early Data Preview 2
papers.abstract: We report the serendipitous discovery of an exceptionally low surface brightness galaxy (LSBG) candidate, Rubin J122659.4+090236, in Rubin Observatory imaging of the interacting NGC 4410 system, identified in the Cosmic Treasure Chest public release. 2D Sérsic modelling of the Rubin g, r, and i images reveals a nearly round system with a shallow profile (n ~ 0.4), an effective radius of R_e ~ 6'', and central surface brightnesses of $μ_{0,g}=27.52\pm0.04$, $μ_{0,r}=27.62\pm0.07$, and $μ_{0,i}=27.04\pm0.08$ mag arcsec$^{-2}$. EAZY photo-z fitting favours an intermediate-z solution at z~0.3, while a low-redshift solution at z~0.028, consistent with the NGC 4410 system, is also permitted by a restricted EAZY fit over 0<z<0.1 without imposing a redshift prior. These alternatives imply substantially different physical interpretations, ranging from a diffuse dwarf-like system to an exceptionally extended background LSBG. This discovery demonstrates Rubin's sensitivity to extremely diffuse galaxies and highlights the potential of the LSST survey to uncover large samples of such elusive systems across wide areas, enabling systematic studies of the LSBG population and its role in galaxy evolution.

analysis.title_zh: Rubin J122659.4+090236：在 Rubin LSST 早期数据预览 2 中发现的一个极低表面亮度星系候选体
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告在 Rubin Observatory 对相互作用星系系统 NGC 4410 的成像中偶然发现极低表面亮度星系候选体 Rubin J122659.4+090236。作者用 Rubin g/r/i 图像进行二维 Sérsic 建模并用 EAZY 估计光度红移；摘要称其可能位于 z~0.3，也允许与 NGC 4410 一致的低红移解，因此对应从弥散矮星系到延展背景 LSBG 的不同解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文与 CMB 的联系较间接，主要价值在于展示 Rubin/LSST 对弥散低表面亮度星系的发现能力。此类星系普查有助于完善低表面亮度星系、暗物质晕和星系形成的统计图像，从而为解释大尺度结构和星系-物质关系提供背景信息，但摘要未涉及 CMB 数据或参数约束。
