papers.title: A guide to choosing data compression methods for cosmological inference
papers.abstract: We provide a pedagogical guide to help researchers choose an appropriate compression method for cosmological inference and numerical covariance estimation, trading off the balance between information loss and complexity. We describe methods used in the literature, categorising them by the form of the loss function -- Fisher information, mutual information, or mean squared error -- and by whether they are linear or non-linear. We consider in detail the linear compression methods: massively optimised parameter estimation and data compression (MOPED), canonical correlation analysis (CCA), principal component analysis, and linear neural networks. We also investigate simple non-linear methods based on neural networks with similar architectures but different loss functions. We use tomographic weak lensing power spectra as example data vectors, deriving constraints on the cosmological parameters $Ω_\mathrm{m}$, $σ_8$, $w_0$ and $w_a$ from compressed data. For our figure of merit (FoM) we use the log determinant of the Fisher matrix, which approximates the covariance of the full posterior well. MOPED and a Fisher information-based linear neural network both achieve lossless compression. Neural networks with loss functions which optimise mutual information achieve at most 84 per cent of the uncompressed FoM and those which minimise mean squared errors achieve at most 72 per cent. We show how to determine whether MOPED will retain information even if the fiducial cosmology is not known with certainty, and demonstrate a strategy for CCA which results in an FoM close to that of MOPED while requiring only an approximate idea of where the bulk of the posterior mass is located.

analysis.title_zh: 为宇宙学推断选择数据压缩方法的指南
analysis.summary_zh: 本文是一篇面向宇宙学推断的数据压缩方法指南，按损失函数和线性/非线性结构梳理文献方法，并用层析弱透镜功率谱约束 Ω_m、σ_8、w_0、w_a 作为示例。摘要报告称，在以 Fisher 矩阵 log determinant 为 FoM 时，MOPED 与基于 Fisher 信息的线性神经网络实现无损压缩，而互信息和均方误差目标的神经网络分别最多达到未压缩 FoM 的 84% 和 72%。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 和大尺度结构分析都面临高维数据向量、昂贵协方差估计与参数推断成本之间的权衡；这篇文章的分类框架和弱透镜示例可为 CMB lensing、联合探针和高维 summary statistics 的压缩选择提供直接参考。

papers.title: Studies on the dark sector interaction from joint analysis of cosmological probes
papers.abstract: We test whether constraints on the nonlinear interaction $ξ$IDE are stable under different treatments of the Type Ia supernovae absolute calibration. \textit{Fermi} GRBs measurements and the Amati-relation parameters are fitted jointly with PantheonPlus SNe Ia, DESI DR2 BAO, and an updated cosmic-chronometer compilation. We compare the PantheonPlus-SH0ES route, which retains the SN absolute calibration, with the PantheonPlus-only route, in which the SN absolute magnitude is analytically marginalized. The GOLD GRB sample is adopted for the main analysis, while the FULL GRB sample is used to assess sample dependence. For the interaction parameter $γ\equivξ+3w$, where $γ=0$ denotes the non-interacting limit, the GOLD sample gives $γ=1.453^{+1.297}_{-1.597}$ for the PantheonPlus-SH0ES and $γ=-0.634^{+1.668}_{-2.486}$ for the PantheonPlus-only. Although the posterior medians correspond to opposite directions of energy transfer, neither route excludes $γ=0$ at 68\% credibility, and the reconstructed interaction rate remains consistent with zero over the redshift range considered. Replacing the GOLD sample with the FULL sample produces negligible changes in the interaction constraints. Moreover, $w$CDM and CPL achieve likelihood improvements comparable to that of $ξ$IDE, while the information criteria do not consistently favor the interacting model. A redshift-bin diagnostic finds no significant redshift evolution of the Amati relation. We find no compelling evidence for a dark sector interaction that is robust to the choice of SN calibration or specifically favored over noninteracting dark energy extensions.

analysis.title_zh: 利用宇宙学探针联合分析研究暗部门相互作用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文通过联合 Fermi GRB、PantheonPlus Ia 超新星、DESI DR2 BAO 和 cosmic chronometer 数据，测试非线性暗部门相互作用 ξIDE 的约束是否受超新星绝对定标处理影响。摘要报告两种超新星处理路线给出的相互作用参数后验中值方向相反，但均不排除无相互作用，且信息准则不稳定支持相互作用模型。

papers.title: Implementation of frequency-correlated noise in CMB component separation: Method, Validation, and Early Applications
papers.abstract: Parametric component separation methods used in cosmic microwave background (CMB) analyses commonly assume instrumental noise to be uncorrelated between frequency channels. This approximation may become insufficient for experiments whose design naturally introduces cross-channel correlations, such as interferometric or multi-band bolometric systems. This work aims to provide a consistent framework to include frequency-correlated noise in Commander2 and to quantify its impact on component separation in controlled and instrument-motivated simulations. We generalized the amplitude sampling of the Commander2 framework to consistently handle dense frequency-frequency noise covariance matrices, modifying the likelihood evaluation and parallel architecture. The implementation is validated on low-resolution simulations of a simplified CMB-S4-like configuration. We applied the generalized framework to instrument-motivated simulations of the QUBIC bolometric interferometer, using representative noise models derived from end-to-end simulations. Validation tests show excellent convergence and agreement between sampled parameters and analytical maximum-likelihood estimates. Accounting for frequency correlations reduces the width of the maximum-likelihood residual distributions by up to 8% on average, and up to 11% for individual parameters, relative to the diagonal-noise approximation. In QUBIC-based simulations, accounting for an anti-correlated noise produces posterior widths reduced by about 60%, while a positive-correlation test increases them by about 40%. This shows that neglecting cross-channel correlations can lead to incorrect posterior estimates in either direction. The generalized implementation presented here enables the Commander2 software to consistently propagate such correlations into parameter estimation, providing a framework for assessing their impact in future CMB analyses.

analysis.title_zh: 在 CMB 成分分离中实现频率相关噪声：方法、验证与早期应用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 CMB 参数化成分分离中常用的“频率通道间噪声不相关”近似，将 Commander2 推广到可处理稠密频率-频率噪声协方差矩阵，并在简化 CMB-S4-like 与 QUBIC 动机模拟中验证。摘要报告该实现与解析最大似然结果符合良好，且考虑跨频噪声相关会显著改变残差分布和后验宽度，方向取决于相关性的符号和结构。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 未来 CMB 实验的多频数据会被用于前景去除和宇宙学参数估计，若仪器设计引入跨频噪声相关，忽略它可能直接影响成分分离的不确定度传播。该工作与 CMB-S4、QUBIC 等实验的数据建模和系统误差控制相关，特别关系到 B 模式和精密参数约束中后验宽度是否可信。

摘要报告：忽略跨频噪声相关会使后验宽度估计偏大或偏小。

papers.title: The Super-Sample Covariance of Line-Intensity Mapping Power Spectrum
papers.abstract: In this work, we provide the first derivation of the line-intensity mapping (LIM) power spectrum super-sample covariance (SSC) from first principles, and also derive as a by-product the non-Gaussian in-box contributions to the covariance for the first time. Previous studies have typically modelled the LIM power spectrum covariance using either the Gaussian approximation or estimates obtained from mocks or the data itself, neglecting uncertainties related to whether the limited volume surveyed sits in a cosmological overdensity. This contribution, known as the SSC or, depending on the context, the field-to-field variance, cannot be estimated from the data, but it is crucial for a correct inference of global quantities, i.e., for ensemble-averaged parameters rather than the actual values just within the patch of the Universe observed. For our derivation, we employ a combination of the halo model and standard perturbation theory that allows us to capture the nonlinearity and non-Gaussianity of the covariance. After a successful validation of our predictions against painted N-body simulations, we explore different scenarios related to current and future LIM experiments, quantifying the relative importance of the non-Gaussian in-box and SSC. We find that the newly derived contributions to the LIM power spectrum covariance are crucial at intermediate and small scales, especially for cases in which the covariance is not dominated by instrumental noise. We find that the relative relevance of the SSC with respect to the other covariance contributions is roughly independent of the survey volume, but does depend on the specific response of the power spectrum to large-scale modes for each line and redshift. Therefore, the impact of the SSC will be increasingly significant for parameter inference from the current and the next generation high signal-to-noise LIM surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 线强度映射功率谱的超样本协方差
analysis.summary_zh: 本文从第一性原理推导线强度映射功率谱的超样本协方差，并同时得到非高斯盒内协方差项，以 halo model 和标准微扰论刻画非线性与非高斯性。摘要报告其预测通过 painted N-body 模拟验证，并指出这些新协方差贡献在中小尺度、仪器噪声不占主导时会显著影响当前和未来高信噪比 LIM 参数推断。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: LIM 是未来三维大尺度结构和再电离/星系形成研究的重要探针，可与 CMB 透镜、CMB 二级各向异性和其他巡天交叉相关。协方差建模直接决定宇宙学参数误差和系统误差评估；若忽略 SSC，可能低估高信噪比 LIM 与 CMB 联合分析中的不确定性。
key_points: 首次从第一性原理推导 LIM 功率谱的超样本协方差。
同时给出非高斯盒内协方差贡献，并用 painted N-body 模拟验证。
摘要称 SSC 和非高斯项在中小尺度、高信噪比 LIM 实验中对参数推断重要。

papers.title: H I Absorbers as Beacons of Hidden Structure at $z \sim 3$: Multi-Component, Metal-Rich Absorption System near a Protocluster
papers.abstract: H I gas traces the large-scale structure and provides the primary fuel for star formation. High-$z$ protoclusters are ideal laboratories to study how H I gas is accreted and consumed during the formation of the most massive structures in the Universe. However, much remains unknown about the distribution and physical state of their H I gas. We examine a rare configuration in which a protocluster candidate is located in front of a quasar at $z=3.09$. Our spectroscopic campaign confirms a protocluster at $z=3.079$: however, no corresponding strong H I absorption is found in the background quasar spectrum. Instead, we serendipitously discover a prominent H I absorption feature at $z\sim 3.01$, offset by $\sim 60$ cMpc from the centre of the protocluster. Spanning an exceptionally broad velocity range of $\sim 2000$ km s$^{-1}$ ($\sim 40$ cMpc), this absorption is decoupled from the confirmed member galaxies. Detailed kinematic modelling reveals this absorption comprises five distinct components rather than a single cloud. Moreover, one of these components exhibits a super-solar metallicity ($[\mathrm{O/H}] = +1.19^{+0.91}_{-0.78}$). We propose two physical scenarios for this unique system: (1) an additional, hidden massive protocluster along the line of sight, and/or (2) metal-rich outflows and metal-poor inflows driven by a single massive galaxy. The discovery highlights that while protoclusters are not universally associated with strong H I absorption, targeting the strong H I absorbers may serve as a beacon for uncovering massive, metal-rich protoclusters or complex gas kinematics in the early Universe.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in MNRAS. 17 pages, 19 figures

analysis.title_zh: 作为 z~3 隐藏结构信标的 H I 吸收体：原星系团附近的多成分、富金属吸收系统
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用一个 z=3.09 类星体背后的特殊几何，研究高红移原星系团附近 H I 气体的分布和物理状态；光谱观测确认 z=3.079 原星系团，但未发现对应强 H I 吸收，反而在约 60 cMpc 外发现 z~3.01 的宽速度、多成分、含富金属成分的 H I 吸收系统。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要关联大尺度结构形成和高红移星系环境中的气体循环，而非直接 CMB 分析。对宇宙学读者的意义在于，它展示了 H I 吸收线如何补充星系巡天来追踪早期宇宙的物质分布和原星系团结构，可作为理解星系团形成环境和重子分布的观测线索。

papers.title: Model Predictive Scoring Shows Specific BAO Observations (not SNIa) Drives $w_0w_a$ Tension
papers.abstract: The recent analyses of DESI DR2 BAO, Planck CMB and various Supernovae datasets have shown preferences for evolving dark energy at various levels of significance, under frequentist model comparison tests. However, the same analysis done with a pure Bayesian model comparison test can lead to the opposite conclusion due to the impact of $w_0w_a$ priors. In contrast to these in-sample model comparison route, we approach the problem along a third axis -- which model better predicts unseen data. We use the Expected Log Predictive Density (ELPD) metric to score the predictiveness of $Λ$CDM and $w_0w_a$CDM models, using the leave-one-redshift-block-out cross-validation estimator. The comparison metric $Δ$ELPD is out-of-sample, unlike $Δχ^2_{\rm MAP}$ and Bayes Factor, and insensitive to prior width, unlike the Bayes factor. Aggregated, we find modest preferences for $w_0 w_a$CDM, primarily driven by the BAO. Decomposing the $Δ$ELPD score by redshift we find that a single BAO block, LRG2 ($z = 0.706$), supplies the entire BAO preference. Interestingly, the biggest outlier point, LRG1, contributes little to the model predictive scoring because both $Λ$CDM and $w_0w_a$CDM fail to predict the observation by equal amount. On the other hand, all SNIa datasets' $Δ$ELPD scores are consistent with $0$, indicating that at an out-of-distribution predictive level, the $w_0w_a$CDM tension is entirely driven by one BAO point, not SNIa.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables, Submitted to ApJL

analysis.title_zh: 模型预测评分显示特定 BAO 观测而非 SNIa 驱动 w0wa 张力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文不走传统的样本内模型比较路线，而用 ELPD 与留一红移块交叉验证评估 ΛCDM 和 w0waCDM 对未见数据的预测能力，数据组合包括 DESI DR2 BAO、Planck CMB 和超新星。摘要报告总体只有温和的 w0waCDM 偏好，且这种预测层面的偏好由 BAO 中一个 LRG2 红移块驱动，SNIa 数据的 ΔELPD 与 0 一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文直接涉及 Planck CMB 与 DESI BAO、SNIa 联合约束中的暗能量演化张力，关注的是张力是否来自真实的跨探针一致信号，还是由特定 BAO 数据点主导。对 CMB 宇宙学读者而言，它提供了一种区别参数拟合改进、贝叶斯证据和外推预测能力的诊断视角。
key_points: 用 ELPD 和留一红移块交叉验证比较 ΛCDM 与 w0waCDM 的预测能力。
摘要称总体上对 w0waCDM 的偏好较弱，主要由 BAO 驱动。
按红移分解后，BAO 偏好集中在 LRG2，而 SNIa 的 ΔELPD 与 0 一致。

papers.title: Widespread Inflows Reveal Baryonic Cycling in Star-forming and Quiescent Galaxies
papers.abstract: Cool-gas inflows, required to sustain star formation, have been fundamental in simulations yet remained observationally elusive. Using DESI spectroscopy of ~30,000 galaxies, we identify coherent inflowing gas (~100 km/s) in 20-50% of the sample, yielding a population-level census of gas flows. We uncover a striking inversion: inflows are detected in quiescent galaxies, whereas star-forming systems are dominated by gravitationally bound outflows. At fixed age, galaxies with inflows, outflows, or no/weak flows share similar masses, environments, and structures, indicating that these properties do not differentiate flow states. Instead, gas-flow state is linked to stellar population age and recent evolutionary history, consistent with age-dependent gas flows in two regimes. In some star-forming galaxies, elevated star formation surface densities drive outflows that recycle on ~0.5 Gyr timescales, consistent with a galactic fountain. In quiescent systems, low-level ``drizzling'' inflows persist, consistent with slowly cooling enriched halo gas and weak radio-mode nuclear activity. Broad gas-phase metallicity distributions---and absence of a pristine dilution signature---indicate that detected inflows are predominantly recycled or enriched. Detectability is modulated by dust, ionization, and geometry: in star-forming disks, inflowing gas lies near the disk plane and is obscured or ionized, while outflow hosts exhibit higher dust and metal content. As star formation declines, cold-outflow signatures weaken, and recycled or slowly cooling gas is more readily detected as inflow. Post-starburst galaxies provide snapshots of this transition. Our results resolve the scarcity of observed inflows, provide evidence for widespread gas accretion and recycling in present day galaxies, and establish an observational framework linking gas flows to star formation, chemical evolution, and galaxy structure.
papers.comment: 73 pages, 25 Figures (5 Main + 8 Extended Data + 12 Supplementary), submitted on 6th March 2026

analysis.title_zh: 广泛存在的内流揭示成星和静止星系中的重子循环
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用约 3 万个 DESI 星系光谱对冷气体内流和外流做总体统计，摘要称在 20-50% 样本中识别到约 100 km/s 的相干内流。结果显示气体流动状态与恒星族年龄和近期演化史相关，静止星系中可见低水平再循环/冷却内流，部分成星星系则由星系喷泉式外流主导。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的联系是间接的，重点在低红移星系的重子循环和反馈过程。它对宇宙学有价值，因为星系中的气体吸积、外流和再循环影响重子如何从暗物质晕进入恒星与星际/环星系介质，是把大尺度结构和星系形成模型同观测联系起来的关键物理。
key_points: 基于约 3 万个 DESI 星系光谱，在样本总体上识别出约 100 km/s 的相干内流信号。
摘要报告内流在静止星系中可见，而成星系统更常表现为受引力束缚的外流。
检测到的内流主要被解释为再循环或富集气体，而非原初气体直接稀释。
methods: DESI 光谱数据
约 30,000 个星系的统计样本
气体流动速度特征识别
按成星/静止、恒星年龄、环境、结构和金属丰度分布进行比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对内流/外流判据如何从光谱中定义，投影几何、尘埃和电离状态如何进入选择效应修正，以及“静止星系内流、成星星系外流”这一反转是否对样本划分和模型假设稳健。

papers.title: ALPACA I: Controlling source and PSF systematics in JWST time-delay cosmography with differentiable lens modeling
papers.abstract: Time-delay cosmography provides an independent probe of the Hubble constant ($H_0$), but exploiting the high-resolution imaging of the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) requires strong-lens models that capture complex source-galaxy morphologies and the point spread function (PSF) with high fidelity. Flexible source and joint PSF reconstruction are computationally expensive, motivating more rigid parameterizations that can bias the inferred time-delay distance $D_{Δt}$. We present ALPACA, a semi-automatic, GPU-accelerated, differentiable strong-lens modeling pipeline built on Herculens, Starred, and JAX. ALPACA jointly reconstructs a pixelated correlated-field source, the lens mass, and the PSF within a single likelihood, reducing per-system runtimes from weeks to less than 15 hours. We validate the pipeline on realistic mock JWST/NIRCam observations built from morphologically complex COSMOS galaxy sources. Holding an imperfect PSF (RMSE = 12% from truth) fixed biases $D_{Δt}$ by up to 14%, whereas joint PSF reconstruction reduces this bias to the percent level. We further show that the reconstructed PSF core can be marginalized over jointly with the lens parameters during posterior sampling. Propagating the per-lens posteriors of a ten-lens mock sample through hierarchical inference, we recover the input cosmology without significant bias. ALPACA shows that rigorous control of source and PSF systematics is computationally affordable, supporting reliable percent-level precision in the JWST era.
papers.comment: The ALPACA package will be made publicly available upon journal publication

analysis.title_zh: ALPACA I：用可微透镜建模控制 JWST 时延宇宙学中的源和 PSF 系统误差
analysis.summary_zh: 本文面向 JWST 时延宇宙学中的 H0 测量，提出 ALPACA 这一半自动、GPU 加速、可微的强透镜建模流程，在单一似然中联合重建复杂源星系、透镜质量和 PSF。摘要报告，在模拟 JWST/NIRCam 数据上，联合 PSF 重建可把由错误固定 PSF 引起的时延距离偏差从最高 14% 降至百分比水平，并在十透镜模拟样本的层级推断中无显著偏差恢复输入宇宙学。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇与宇宙学参数测量直接相关：强透镜时延给出独立的 H0 约束，可与 CMB 推断的 H0 比较，从而检验晚期宇宙和早期宇宙测量之间的张力。它强调 JWST 高分辨率成像带来的精度提升必须配合严格的源结构和 PSF 系统误差控制，否则时延距离和 H0 可能产生偏差。
key_points: 提出 ALPACA：基于 Herculens、Starred 和 JAX 的 GPU 加速、可微强透镜建模流程。
联合重建像素化相关场源、透镜质量分布和 PSF，以控制 JWST 时延宇宙学中的源和 PSF 系统误差。
在模拟 JWST/NIRCam 数据中，固定有误差 PSF 可使 DΔt 偏差最高达 14%，联合 PSF 重建将偏差降至百分比水平；十个透镜模拟样本的层级推断可无显著偏差恢复输入宇宙学。

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对模拟数据的真实性、PSF 误差设定是否覆盖实际 JWST 情况、源模型先验和透镜质量模型对 DΔt 的影响，以及十透镜层级推断中系统误差相关性如何处理。

papers.title: It's All About the Environment: Local $f_{\rm NL}$ from a Dark Matter Conditioned Multitracer Analysis
papers.abstract: Primordial non-Gaussianity (PNG) offers a powerful test of inflationary physics beyond the simplest single-field scenarios. In large-scale structure, biased tracers respond to local-type PNG with a distinctive scale-dependent signature that is strongest on large scales, but single-tracer measurements are fundamentally limited by cosmic variance. Multitracer methods can mitigate this limitation; however, many existing proposals require splitting tracers using a wide range of halo masses which are often not available, or using secondary halo properties that are not directly observable. Here we develop and validate an alternative strategy based on splitting a tracer sample by its large-scale dark matter environment. We derive a theoretical framework for the $f_{\rm NL}$ response of environmentally selected tracers and test it in $N$-body simulations, confirming consistency between separate-universe predictions and direct power-spectrum inference. To enable observational implementation, we show that a simple linear-theory reconstruction of the dark matter environment from halos yields unbiased $f_{\rm NL}$ constraints in $\mathtt{Quijote}$ simulations. Forecasts for the DESI LRG sample indicate that environmental multitracing can improve constraints on local PNG by a factor of 2-3 relative to conventional single-tracer analyses for high density tracers, comparable to gains achieved when halo formation time is assumed to be perfectly known. We develop an analytic model explaining why the gains are smaller for a halo environment split and why separate-universe predictions fail in this case. Unlike approaches that require modeling assembly bias or inferring secondary halo properties, our method relies only on linear theory. These results establish environmental multitracer techniques as a promising route toward $σ(f_{\rm NL})\sim 1$ with upcoming galaxy surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 环境才是关键：来自暗物质条件化多示踪体分析的局域型 f_NL
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对大尺度结构中 local 型原初非高斯性 f_NL 的宇宙方差限制，提出按大尺度暗物质环境划分示踪体的多示踪体策略。摘要称作者建立响应理论并用 N 体与 Quijote 模拟验证，线性理论环境重构可给出无偏 f_NL 约束，DESI LRG 预报中高密度示踪体相对单示踪体可改进约束约 2-3 倍。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: local f_NL 是检验暴胀物理、特别是超越最简单单场模型的重要参数；其大尺度尺度依赖偏置与 CMB 对原初非高斯性的约束高度互补。若这种环境多示踪体方法能在真实星系巡天中稳健实现，它可能帮助大型结构数据接近 σ(f_NL)~1，从而与 CMB 原初非高斯性研究形成关键交叉检验。
key_points: 提出按大尺度暗物质环境划分示踪体的多示踪体 local PNG 方法。
在 N 体模拟中检验 separate-universe 预言与功率谱推断的一致性。
摘要称对 DESI LRG 的预报可相对单示踪体改进 local f_NL 约束约 2-3 倍。

N 体模拟

papers.title: Supernova microlensing as a probe of ultracompact minihalos and primordial cosmology
papers.abstract: We propose using supernova microlensing to search for ultracompact minihalos and other extended dark structures seeded by enhanced primordial small-scale power. Unlike conventional microlensing searches, which are often optimized for primordial black holes, cosmological supernovae are sensitive to lenses with physical sizes comparable to their Einstein radii (up to $\sim {\rm pc}\left(M/10^4M_\odot\right)^{1/2}$ scale), opening a qualitatively different region of dark object parameter space. We compute the extended object detection efficiency relative to point lenses. We then show how projected limits on the abundance of ultracompact minihalos can be mapped, in benchmark formation scenarios, onto constraints on the primordial power spectrum. With the Vera C. Rubin Observatory expected to deliver an unprecedented LSST supernova sample, supernova microlensing is poised to become a timely and complementary probe of small-scale structure and the physics of the early Universe.

analysis.title_zh: 作为超致密小型晕和原初宇宙学探针的超新星微透镜
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出以宇宙学超新星微透镜作为探测由增强原初小尺度功率产生的超致密小型晕及其他扩展暗结构的方法。摘要称作者计算扩展天体相对点透镜的探测效率，并在基准形成情景中把未来丰度限制映射为原初功率谱约束，强调 Rubin/LSST 超新星样本的潜力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作主要不直接分析 CMB，但它瞄准 CMB 难以直接探测的原初小尺度功率谱和早期宇宙物理。若小尺度功率增强、超致密小型晕或相关暗物质结构存在，其约束可与 CMB 对大尺度扰动、暴胀模型和暗物质情景的限制互补。
key_points: 提出用宇宙学超新星微透镜搜寻超致密小型晕和其他扩展暗结构。
该方法对物理尺度接近爱因斯坦半径的透镜敏感，覆盖不同于原初黑洞点透镜搜索的参数空间。
摘要称 Rubin/LSST 超新星样本可提供对小尺度结构和早期宇宙物理的互补探针。
methods: 超新星微透镜
扩展透镜相对于点透镜的探测效率计算
超致密小型晕丰度投影限制
基准形成情景下映射到原初功率谱约束
Vera C. Rubin Observatory / LSST 超新星样本预期
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对从微透镜事件率/探测效率到超致密小型晕丰度、再到原初小尺度功率谱的映射对形成模型、晕密度剖面、超新星尺寸与光变模型、巡天选择效应的依赖程度。

papers.title: Euclid preparation. The shape of halo profiles in $Λ$CDM and non-standard cosmologies
papers.abstract: We study the shape of three-dimensional and projected dark-matter halo profiles extracted from cosmological $N$-body simulations in $Λ$CDM and non-standard cosmologies, using the \texttt{DUSTGRAIN-PF} and \texttt{DEMNUni} suites. The models considered include massive neutrinos, $f(\mathcal{R})$ gravity, and dynamical dark energy. By comparing density, mass, velocity-dispersion, and excess-surface-density profiles up to $5\,r_{500{\rm c}}$, we quantify the differential imprint of non-standard physics on halo structure in view of \textit{Euclid} cluster WL studies. Our main analysis is performed at $z=1.1$, a high-redshift regime where the weak-lensing signal-to-noise starts to degrade, providing a conservative stress test for detectability; for \texttt{DUSTGRAIN-PF} we additionally analyse $z=0.5$ and $z=0.3$ snapshots. In low-mass haloes ($M_{\rm 200c}<7\times10^{13}\,M_\odot$), $f(\mathcal{R})$ gravity produces deviations of order $10\,\%$ in projected and three-dimensional profiles, especially in the outskirts where screening is less efficient. Massive neutrinos partially reduce this signal, reflecting the competition between free streaming and fifth-force-enhanced growth. Dynamical dark energy and massive-neutrino cosmologies generally induce smaller, few-percent deviations, with the largest effects again found in low-mass haloes and at large radii. Under simplified assumptions for \Euclid WL, detecting such profile differences at $z=1.1$ requires stacks of $\sim10^5$ haloes, while a few thousands haloes may be sufficient at $z\lesssim0.5$. This further calls for the need of integrating such precise modelling of non-standard effects -- along with other observational effects -- in any likelihood involving \textit{Euclid} WL masses to avoid non-negligible systematic biases. Concentration--mass relations show weaker cosmology dependence, typically at the $\sim5\,\%$ level. [...]

analysis.title_zh: Euclid准备：ΛCDM与非标准宇宙学中晕剖面的形状
analysis.summary_zh: 本文面向Euclid星系团弱透镜研究，利用DUSTGRAIN-PF和DEMNUni宇宙学N体模拟比较ΛCDM、质量中微子、f(R)引力和动力学暗能量模型中的暗物质晕三维与投影剖面。摘要报告称，低质量晕在大半径处对非标准物理最敏感，f(R)可产生约10%的剖面偏离，而动力学暗能量和质量中微子通常为百分之几量级；在简化Euclid弱透镜假设下，高红移探测需要大量堆叠。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接分析CMB，但与宇宙学参数推断和结构增长检验密切相关。Euclid弱透镜星系团质量和晕剖面可与CMB给出的早期宇宙约束互补，尤其用于检验中微子质量、暗能量演化和修改引力；若晕剖面模型有系统偏差，可能影响与CMB联合分析中的增长率和物质聚集幅度解释。
key_points: 比较ΛCDM、质量中微子、f(R)引力和动力学暗能量下的暗物质晕剖面。
低质量晕和大半径处的非标准物理印记最明显，f(R)效应可达摘要所称约10%。
Euclid弱透镜质量似然若忽略这些剖面差异，可能引入系统偏差。

DUSTGRAIN-PF与DEMNUni模拟套件
三维密度、质量、速度弥散与投影过量面密度剖面比较
z=1.1主分析，并使用z=0.5、z=0.3快照

papers.title: Atmospheric neutrino up-scattering explanation of LZ 2026 excess
papers.abstract:
The recent observation of an isolated nuclear recoil at $248\pm 23\pm 23$ keV energy by LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment has motivated the community to look for a new physics explanation, as the Standard model background estimation fails to accomodate that. Most of the existing literature hitherto considers a galactic halo dark matter with a heavier partner. In this work, we traverse the alternate route of atmospheric neutrino ($ν$) up-scattering, thus producing a massive beyond standard model (BSM) particle $χ$. The kinematic requirement of such a scattering poses a cut off in the lower recoil energies providing an explanation of the unique isolated event at such a higher recoil energy. Such up-scattering with the nucleons ($
uc$), $ν
uc	o χ
uc$ can be naturally realized in sterile neutrino models, though we keep our analysis generic without specifying $χ$. We identify the region of parameter space that can produce such an isolated event assuming a scalar mediator with mass $m_φ$ and coupling $y_{χ,q}$. For example, with $m_χ\sim1$ GeV, and $\sqrt{y_χy_q}/m_φ=2 	imes 10^{-2}$ GeV$^{-1}$ can satisfy such an excess of events while remaining allowed by other existing constraints as well.

analysis.title_zh: 用大气中微子上散射解释 LZ 2026 超额
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 LUX-ZEPLIN 实验报道的一个约 248 keV 孤立核反冲事件，提出由大气中微子上散射产生 BSM 粒子 χ 的解释。摘要称，该机制的运动学低能截止可解释高反冲能的孤立性，并在标量媒介子假设下找到了可产生该事件且不被现有约束排除的参数区域。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于暗物质直接探测和中微子新物理方向，与 CMB 的关系较间接。它可能影响宇宙学读者对轻暗部门、无菌中微子或 BSM 粒子约束互补性的理解，但摘要没有涉及 CMB 数据、早期宇宙丰度或宇宙学参数推断。
key_points: 用大气中微子上散射解释 LZ 2026 的单个高能核反冲事件。
假设中微子与核子散射产生一个较重的 BSM 粒子 χ。
摘要给出标量媒介子参数空间示例，并声称可与现有约束相容。

papers.title: Confronting the Higgsino Interpretation of the LZ Event with the High-Energy Sideband
papers.abstract: The LZ experiment has reported a single 248 keV nuclear recoil event in their $2.84$ ton-yr exposure on a xenon target. The absence of lower nuclear recoil events is naturally explained by inelastically scattering dark matter (DM), for which the nuclear recoil energy spectra are shifted upwards from zero. Excitingly, the observed rate and spectra are consistent with a thermal $1.1$ TeV higgsino that explains all of DM with a mass splitting $δ\sim 370 - 490$ keV between the two lowest-lying Majorana states, with the range depending on the underlying DM velocity distribution. In this work, however, we show that higgsino DM with these properties would generically produce more higher-energy recoil events in a high-energy sideband along the LZ $S1c$ energy axis, while the LZ experiment reports no events in that bin. This suggests a possible tension which could be further explored by the LZ Collaboration, as the acceptance in that bin is not public. We further show that a non-thermal $\sim$500 GeV higgsino may evade the sideband constraint and that future experiments using heavy targets can potentially test the higgsino interpretation of the event either way.

analysis.title_zh: 用高能旁带检验 LZ 事件的 Higgsino 解释
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检验 LZ 单个 248 keV 核反冲事件的热 1.1 TeV higgsino 非弹性暗物质解释，重点利用 LZ S1c 能量轴上的高能 sideband。摘要称这类 higgsino 通常会在该 sideband 产生更多高能反冲事件，而 LZ 在相应 bin 未报告事件，因此可能存在张力；非热约 500 GeV higgsino 可能避开该限制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于直接探测暗物质现象学，与 CMB 的联系是暗物质丰度和粒子性质的一致性检验。若 higgsino 构成全部或部分暗物质，其热遗迹丰度需与 CMB 测得的宇宙暗物质密度相容，但摘要没有直接使用 CMB 数据。
key_points: 讨论 LZ 单个 248 keV 核反冲事件的 higgsino 暗物质解释。
摘要指出该解释通常会在 LZ 高能 sideband 产生更多事件，但该 bin 中未报告事件。
约 500 GeV 非热 higgsino 可能规避该 sideband 约束。

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对高能 sideband 的接受率假设，因为摘要明确说明该 bin 的 acceptance 未公开；还需检查速度分布、能量重建和背景建模如何影响所谓张力。

papers.title: Inelastic Signatures of Electroweak Dark Matter
papers.abstract: Minimal dark matter extended to include a Majorana and a Dirac multiplet coupled through the Higgs --- the HC-MDM model --- provides a compelling and predictive framework. We show that in certain limits of this model, the mass splitting and the inelastic interaction are representation-independent, while the thermal-relic masses are representation-dependent. We then show that this model can account for the high-energy recoil event recently reported by LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) while also respecting thermal-relic, elastic-scattering, and solar-capture constraints. Generic inelastic DM models do not connect all these tests and generic Higgsino models do not survive them.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Substantially improved version with expanded discussion, updated phenomenology, and additional consistency checks

analysis.title_zh: 电弱暗物质的非弹性信号
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究由 Majorana 与 Dirac 多重态经希格斯耦合组成的 HC-MDM 电弱暗物质模型，讨论其质量劈裂、非弹性相互作用和热遗迹质量的表示依赖性。摘要报告该模型可解释 LUX-ZEPLIN 最近的高能反冲事件，并同时满足热遗迹、弹性散射与太阳俘获约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要关联暗物质粒子模型与直接探测，不是 CMB 观测本身；但暗物质热遗迹丰度和电弱尺度候选体属于宇宙学参数与早期宇宙历史的基础输入。对 CMB 读者而言，它可作为理解非 CMB 暗物质约束如何补充宇宙学暗物质丰度测量的材料。
key_points: HC-MDM 模型包含通过希格斯耦合的 Majorana 与 Dirac 多重态。
摘要称某些极限下质量劈裂和非弹性相互作用与表示无关。
该模型被用来解释 LZ 高能反冲事件，同时满足多类暗物质约束。
methods: HC-MDM 电弱暗物质模型分析
热遗迹质量约束
弹性散射约束
太阳俘获约束
LUX-ZEPLIN（LZ）高能反冲事件比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：所谓“某些极限”的参数条件是什么，LZ 单个高能反冲事件的解释是否依赖特定先验或背景建模，以及热遗迹、弹性散射和太阳俘获约束是否在同一参数空间内一致处理。

papers.title: The moving lens effect: analytical modelling and foreground suppression
papers.abstract: The moving lens (ML) effect is a secondary anisotropy of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) generated by the transverse motion of gravitational potentials, providing a direct probe of the large-scale cosmic velocity field. Its detection relies on cross-correlating a CMB map with the transverse galaxy momentum field, constructed from the galaxy overdensity and a velocity field reconstructed from it. Restricting the reconstruction to large-scale modes strongly suppresses contamination from small-scale astrophysical foregrounds while preserving the ML signal. In this work, we develop a theoretical framework for the ML estimator and its foreground contamination. We show that the signal and foregrounds have a distinct dependence on the direction of the long-wavelength mode represented by the reconstructed galaxy velocity. In the squeezed limit enforced by the velocity reconstruction filter, the bispectrum sourcing the foreground correlation becomes independent of this direction, causing its leading contribution to vanish after angular averaging. In turn, the ML signal survives by matching this directional dependence, with its amplitude reduced only by the filtered velocity variance. Using the halo model, we derive the leading corrections beyond the squeezed limit and show that the residual contamination remains parametrically suppressed. Finally, we model the cross-correlation exactly in the curved sky, and show that it is sourced solely by the longitudinal component of the galaxy momentum field, in the form of a spin-1 $E$-mode, with all other contributions either strongly suppressed on small scales or exactly zero.

analysis.title_zh: 移动透镜效应：解析建模与前景抑制
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究CMB移动透镜效应的解析建模和前景抑制，构建ML估计量及其前景污染的理论框架。摘要称，通过只用大尺度模式重建速度场，可在保留ML信号的同时强烈抑制小尺度天体物理前景；在压缩极限中前景主导项经角平均消失，而ML信号因方向依赖匹配得以保留。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一篇直接面向CMB次级各向异性与大尺度速度场的论文。移动透镜效应若能稳健测量，可提供对宇宙大尺度速度场和结构增长的独立探针，并与kSZ、CMB透镜及星系巡天互补；前景抑制的解析理解对未来高分辨率CMB数据分析尤其关键。
key_points: 移动透镜效应是由引力势横向运动产生的CMB次级各向异性。
作者建立ML估计量及前景污染的解析框架，强调大尺度速度重建滤波可压低小尺度天体物理前景。
曲天球表述中，相关信号仅由星系动量场的纵向分量即spin-1 E模贡献。
methods: CMB图与横向星系动量场的互相关
由星系过密度重建速度场
大尺度模式速度重建滤波
压缩极限下的双谱分析
角平均前景抑制论证
halo model修正计算
曲天球精确建模
spin-1 E模分解
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对前景抑制结论依赖的压缩极限、速度重建滤波尺度和halo model近似是否覆盖实际CMB实验的前景复杂性；还要检查曲天球spin-1 E模表述与可实施估计量、掩膜和噪声处理之间的对应关系。

papers.title: Consistency between cosmological and standard siren observations in evolving dark energy
papers.abstract: A scalar field non-minimally coupled to gravity can be the driver of cosmic acceleration. Such a non-minimal coupling (NMC) can produce a non-zero gravitational-wave (GW) friction function $α_M(z)$, which modifies the luminosity distance inferred from GW sources relative to its electromagnetic counterpart. We use a particular NMC scalar-tensor model, that explains time-varying dark energy in good alignment with DESI, to predict $α_M(z)$ and the expected GW/EM luminosity-distance ratio $D_L^{\rm GW}/D_L^{\rm EM}$, and map it onto two common parametrizations---the $c_M$ and the $(Ξ_0,n)$ models. We find $c_M = -0.5\pm 0.2$ and $Ξ_0 = 0.88\pm 0.05$, $n=3.2\pm 0.3$, both consistent with GWTC-5 constraints at the $\lesssim 1σ$ level. This consistency is mostly driven by current large uncertainties in GW data, which lead to measurements consistent with both $Λ$CDM and the NMC model. By contrast, the dark energy constraints derived from analyzing cosmological data, under the common parametric scalar-tensor model using $α_M(z)=c_MΩ_Λ(z)/Ω_{Λ0}$ and the CPL parametrized equation of state $w_0w_a$, are in $2.2σ$ ($3.6σ$) tension with the NMC predictions for the $c_M$ ($w_0w_a$) parameter. We confirm that, in order to avoid cosmological instabilities, this parametrized model imposes strong implicit priors that are incompatible with physically-motivated scalar-tensor models when dark energy is dynamical.

analysis.title_zh: 演化暗能量中宇宙学观测与标准汽笛观测的一致性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论非最小耦合标量场驱动的演化暗能量如何改变引力波传播中的摩擦函数，从而改变标准汽笛推断的引力波亮度距离。摘要报告称，该具体NMC模型映射到常用c_M和(Ξ_0,n)参数化后与当前GWTC-5约束相容，但与某些基于常用参数化标量-张量模型的宇宙学暗能量约束存在张力，原因与稳定性要求带来的隐含先验有关。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要关联暗能量、修改引力和标准汽笛，不直接处理CMB数据。它对CMB宇宙学的重要性在于：CMB给出的几何距离和早期宇宙基准常与DESI、超新星和引力波标准汽笛联合约束暗能量；若引力波传播或标量-张量参数化存在隐含先验，可能影响与CMB联合分析时对ΛCDM偏离的解释。
key_points: 非最小耦合标量-张量模型会产生非零GW摩擦函数α_M(z)。
该模型预言的GW/EM亮度距离比与当前GWTC-5约束在摘要所称小于约1σ范围内一致。
常用参数化标量-张量模型在动力学暗能量情形下可能引入与物理模型不兼容的隐含先验。
methods: 非最小耦合标量-张量暗能量模型
GW摩擦函数α_M(z)预测
GW/EM亮度距离比D_L^GW/D_L^EM计算
映射到c_M与(Ξ_0,n)参数化
与GWTC-5约束比较
与DESI相关的演化暗能量模型对照
CPL w0wa参数化分析
宇宙学稳定性条件检查
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对NMC模型如何由DESI相关暗能量结果确定、GWTC-5约束的似然与先验如何使用，以及所谓常用参数化模型的稳定性先验是否确实导致与物理标量-张量模型不兼容。

papers.title: Sgr A* as a Galactic PeVatron: Multimessenger Signatures of the Magnetic Penrose Process
papers.abstract: The magnetic Penrose process (MPP) is one of the most efficient mechanisms for extracting rotational energy from a magnetized Kerr black hole (BH), enabling charged particles to reach very-high energies. We investigate this process in Sagittarius A* (Sgr A*), the supermassive BH at the Galactic center (GC), focusing on its ultra-high-efficiency regime, in which neutrons undergo beta decay inside the BH ergosphere. As a key novelty, we compute the neutron production spectrum in the accretion flow directly from the nuclear reaction kinematics and follow neutron trajectories in the Kerr spacetime to determine the population that reaches the ergosphere and undergoes the MPP. From this population, we derive the spectrum of accelerated protons and show that Sgr A* can accelerate them up to PeV energies, strengthening its interpretation as a candidate Galactic PeVatron. We further compute the gamma-ray and neutrino emission produced through hadronic interactions of the escaping protons in the Central Molecular Zone. The predicted gamma-ray fluxes exhibit distinctive spectral features that could provide an observational signature of the MPP and may constitute a non-negligible contribution to the very-high-energy emission detected by H.E.S.S. and HAWC. The associated neutrino fluxes remain below the diffuse Galactic component inferred by IceCube, but may still contribute to the high-energy emission from the GC. Remarkably, the predicted signals lie within the projected sensitivity of SWGO for all scenarios considered here and, for some models, only a factor of a few below the nominal CTAO sensitivity, while KM3NeT/ARCA and IceCube-Gen2 will provide complementary tests. Our results establish the MPP as an observable mechanism for extracting BH rotational energy, providing a direct connection between horizon-scale physics and multimessenger observations that can be extended to other magnetized BHs.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 12 figures and 2 tables. Comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 作为银河 PeVatron 的 Sgr A*：磁 Penrose 过程的多信使特征
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究银河中心超大质量黑洞 Sgr A* 中的磁 Penrose 过程，特别是中子在黑洞能层内 beta 衰变导致的高效率加速情形。摘要报告称，该机制可将质子加速到 PeV 能量，并通过逃逸质子在中央分子区的强子相互作用产生具有可观测前景的伽马射线和中微子信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 本身没有直接联系，但与高能中微子、伽马射线背景和强引力天体物理有关，是宇宙学多信使背景研究的相关外延。对 CMB 读者而言，其意义主要在于理解银河前景和高能天体源族，而不是早期宇宙参数或 CMB 各向异性。
key_points: 研究银河中心 Sgr A* 中磁 Penrose 过程对带电粒子的加速。
从吸积流核反应运动学计算中子产生谱，并追踪 Kerr 时空中的中子轨迹。
预言逃逸质子在中央分子区产生的伽马射线和中微子多信使信号。
methods: 磁 Penrose 过程模型
核反应运动学计算中子产生谱
Kerr 时空中子轨迹追踪
强子相互作用产生伽马射线和中微子辐射的计算
与 H.E.S.S.、HAWC、SWGO、CTAO、KM3NeT/ARCA、IceCube-Gen2 灵敏度比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对中子产生率和吸积流假设、进入能层并触发 MPP 的轨道选择效应、PeV 质子谱对黑洞自旋和磁场的敏感性，以及伽马射线/中微子预言与银河中心背景建模的区分度。

papers.title: Ionized Nebulae Around Two New Symbiotic Stars: GR Cygni and [D75] 141
papers.abstract: In the course of selecting targets for a spectroscopic survey of faint planetary-nebula nuclei, we encountered two anomalous cases of late-type variable stars surrounded by nebulosities discovered by amateur astronomers. We obtained follow-up deep narrow-band images of the two nebulae: StDr Objet 14 (diameter 1.5 arcmin) and StDr 4 (diameter 2.5 arcmin). StDr Objet 14 is found to be a low-excitation nebula, bright only in Ha+[N II], and showing a unique double-ring "bull's-eye" morphology. StDr 4 exhibits a bow-shock structure, bright in Halpha and [S II], embedded in an extended emission nebula. Both central stars, respectively GR Cygni and [D75] 141, are found to be pulsating semiregular variable stars. Our spectroscopic observations show GR Cyg to be a cool carbon star of type C9,2, with emission lines of the Balmer series, [O II] and [O III], [Ne III], [S II], and Fe II. A synthetic narrow-band image of GR Cyg shows that the source of its strong [O II] 3727 A emission line is a knot displaced from the star by about 1.6 arcsec, indicative of a recent collimated ejection event. [D75] 141 is a M6 III red giant, with weak Balmer-series emission. Both stars show a blue excess, and GR Cyg was detected in the near-UV by the GALEX spacecraft. These data establish both stars as new symbiotic binaries, containing a late-type red giant and a hot companion accreting from its stellar wind. We speculate that the double rings surrounding GR Cyg were ejected during helium-shell thermal pulses (or conceivably from recurring nova outbursts), while the nebula around [D75] 141 may be the result of a collision of the symbiotic star's ejecta with an interstellar cloud. Our accidental discoveries of these two binaries because they are surrounded by faint nebulae supports the view that there is a significant population of "missing" symbiotic stars yet to be discovered.

analysis.title_zh: 两个新共生星周围的电离星云：GR Cygni 和 [D75] 141
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在为暗弱行星状星云核光谱巡天选源时发现两个异常晚型变星及其周围星云，并通过深窄带成像、光谱和紫外资料确认 GR Cygni 与 [D75] 141 为新的共生双星。摘要报告了两者星云形态、中心星光谱类型和发射线特征，并推测星云可能来自热脉冲、复发新星或与星际云碰撞。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不以 CMB 或早期宇宙为主题，但它涉及银河系内暗弱弥散发射源、窄带成像和恒星外流星云的识别。对 CMB 读者的间接意义在于，银河系前景与各类弥散发射源的分类会影响多波段天区源表和前景理解，不过摘要未显示其对 CMB 前景建模有直接应用。
key_points: 报告两个被微弱星云包围的新共生双星：GR Cygni 与 [D75] 141。
StDr Objet 14 呈低激发、双环“靶心”形态；StDr 4 呈弓形激波结构。
结果主要属于恒星演化、星云与银河系天体物理，对 CMB 研究无直接关联。
methods: 深窄带成像
光谱观测
合成窄带图像
GALEX 近紫外探测
变星性质识别
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对共生双星判据是否充分区分行星状星云核、普通晚型变星外流或其他发射线天体；还应检查双环和弓形激波解释中观测证据与推测成分的边界。

papers.title: Prospects for probing dark matter with filamentary 21cm emission
papers.abstract: The cosmic web contains most of the matter in the Universe, and its filamentary structure is closely related to the properties of dark matter. Compared with the cold dark matter (CDM) model, warm dark matter (WDM) suppresses the formation of low-mass halos and produces smoother cosmic filaments. In this work, we explore whether filamentary 21cm emission can be used to distinguish between these two dark matter models at $z=4$ and $2.5$. We generate intrinsic 21cm brightness temperature maps from cosmological hydrodynamical simulations and produce mock observations by convolving them with Gaussian beams of different angular resolutions. We then compare the predicted filament signals with the expected sensitivities of SKA1-Low and SKA2-Low. We find that the intrinsic 21cm emission clearly reflects the different filament morphologies in the CDM and WDM models, particularly at $z=4$. However, these differences rapidly disappear as the beam size increases, especially for beam sizes larger than 6 arcsec. Although larger beams improve the observational sensitivity, they also erase the small-scale structures that encode the dark matter information. As a result, neither SKA1-Low nor the planned SKA2-Low can directly resolve individual filaments with sufficient sensitivity to distinguish between the two models. We therefore conclude that direct imaging of cosmic filaments and constraining dark matter through their morphology are unlikely to be feasible with current and planned SKA-Low facilities.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, accepted for publication in Research in Astronomy and Astrophysics

analysis.title_zh: 利用丝状结构 21cm 发射探测暗物质的前景
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用宇宙学流体动力学模拟生成 z=4 和 z=2.5 的丝状 21cm 亮温图，并经不同 Gaussian 波束卷积后评估 SKA1-Low/SKA2-Low 的观测前景。摘要报告 CDM 与 WDM 的内禀丝状形态差异在 z=4 较明显，但随波束增大迅速消失，当前和计划中的 SKA-Low 难以直接分辨单个纤维并据此约束暗物质。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作不直接研究 CMB，但属于大尺度结构和暗物质性质的观测检验，与 CMB 给出的暗物质丰度和初始条件约束互补。其负面预期也有助于判断未来 21cm 观测能否在 CMB 之外提供独立的暗物质模型判别。
key_points: 比较 CDM 与 WDM 在宇宙丝状结构的 21cm 发射形态差异。
小尺度形态差异在较大波束卷积后迅速被抹平。
摘要结论认为 SKA1-Low 和计划中的 SKA2-Low 难以通过直接成像单个纤维来区分模型。
methods: 宇宙学流体动力学模拟
内禀 21cm 亮温图
不同角分辨率 Gaussian beam 卷积生成 mock observations
与 SKA1-Low 和 SKA2-Low 预期灵敏度比较
红移 z=4 和 z=2.5 的模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模拟分辨率、WDM 模型参数、21cm 发射建模假设和 SKA 灵敏度/波束设定，因为这些直接决定“不可行”结论的稳健性。

papers.title: Bright star-forming galaxies naturally forming at z>10 in the Shark semi-analytic model
papers.abstract: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has unveiled the existence of numerous z>10 bright ultraviolet (UV) galaxies, potentially challenging galaxy formation models in a Lambda Cold Dark Matter (LCDM) universe. Modifications to star formation and stellar feedback models have been suggested to alleviate the tension. However, the fundamental challenge is to design a galaxy formation model that simultaneously reproduces observations from z=0 to those at the highest redshifts. Here, we present predictions from the Shark semi-analytic model of galaxy formation, which is tuned to reproduce the z=0 universe. We show that the same model is capable of reproducing the current UV luminosity function constraints even up to z=17 without the need to invoke variations in the baryon physics model. This model is also capable of reproducing reasonably well the stellar mass function evolution from z=0 to z=10 and the cosmic star formation rate (SFR) density at 0<z<15, again with the same baryon physics and parameters. The key to the success of Shark is the triggering of starbursts by violent disk instabilities included in the model, which leads to an increase in the variance of the UV luminosity with increasing halo mass at z>10. We demonstrate that without this mechanism, galaxies are not bursty enough in the model to reproduce the observations at z>10.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to MNRAS. Comments welcome!

analysis.title_zh: 在 Shark 半解析模型中自然形成于 z>10 的明亮恒星形成星系
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 JWST 发现的大量 z>10 明亮紫外星系是否挑战 ΛCDM 星系形成模型的问题，使用按 z=0 宇宙校准的 Shark 半解析星系形成模型给出预言。摘要称，在不改变重子物理模型和参数的情况下，该模型可再现至 z=17 的 UV 光度函数约束，并较好描述 z=0 到 z=10 的恒星质量函数演化及 0<z<15 的宇宙恒星形成率密度，关键机制是剧烈盘不稳定性触发星暴。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接分析 CMB，但与宇宙学的结构形成框架相关：若高红移明亮星系能在标准 ΛCDM 与常规重子物理下自然出现，就会减弱 JWST 高红移星系对早期结构增长、暗物质模型或初始条件提出的张力。对 CMB 读者而言，它提供了连接 CMB 所约束的早期宇宙参数与后期非线性星系形成观测的一种模型检验。
key_points: JWST 发现的 z>10 明亮紫外星系被用来检验 ΛCDM 下的星系形成模型。
Shark 半解析模型在保持 z=0 校准的重子物理与参数不变时，据摘要可再现高红移 UV 光度函数等观测约束。
模型成功的关键被归因于剧烈盘不稳定性触发的星暴，使 z>10 星系紫外光度更具爆发性。
methods: Shark 星系形成半解析模型
与当前 UV 光度函数约束比较至 z=17
恒星质量函数演化 z=0 至 z=10
宇宙恒星形成率密度 0<z<15
包含/不包含剧烈盘不稳定性机制的模型对比
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Shark 的 z=0 校准量、JWST 高红移样本选择函数与 UV 光度函数误差处理，以及“无需改变重子物理”是否对尘埃、恒星初始质量函数、星暴时标等假设敏感。

papers.title: Evolution of Virial Clouds - II: From the Formation of First Stars up to their Explosion
papers.abstract: The existence of cold gas and dust clouds close to the cosmic microwave background (CMB) temperature was proposed as a potential repository for a significant fraction of the missing baryons in galactic halos. While the evolution of the virial clouds from the last scattering surface (LSS) ($z=1100$) up to the formation of Population III (Pop III) stars ($z=48$) was studied in [N. Tahir, A. Qadir, M. Sakhi, \& F. De Paolis, The Euro. Phys. Jour. C 81, 827 (2021)] (Paper I), the subsequent evolution during the epoch of the first stars remained unexplored. In the present work, we investigate the second evolutionary phase of the virial clouds, covering the redshift range $48 \gtrsim z \gtrsim 10$. We develop a comprehensive model incorporating the coupled thermal, chemical, and dynamical evolution of the cloud, including CMB heating, adiabatic compression due to gravitational contraction, H$_2$ and metal-line cooling, and feedback from Pop III supernovae. Solving the coupled ordinary differential equations (ODE) numerically, we find that the cloud cools monotonically from $137$~K to $41.5$~K, contracts from $120$~pc to $89.8$~pc, and becomes enriched in metals and molecular hydrogen, while the cooling rate dominates the heating rate throughout the evolution.

analysis.title_zh: 维里云的演化 II：从第一批恒星形成到其爆炸
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究一种被提议为星系晕缺失重子储库、温度接近 CMB 的冷气体和尘埃云，在第一代恒星形成后到红移约 10 期间的演化。作者建立包含 CMB 加热、绝热压缩、H2/金属线冷却和 Pop III 超新星反馈的耦合热化学动力学模型，并数值求解 ODE，摘要报告云体从 137 K 冷却到 41.5 K、半径收缩且金属和分子氢增丰。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文直接涉及 CMB 温度背景对早期冷气体云热演化的作用，并把研究时段放在高红移第一代恒星时代。对 CMB/宇宙学读者而言，它关联缺失重子、星系晕冷气体、早期结构形成和 CMB 加热边界条件，但摘要中的模型属于解析/半解析云演化框架，需谨慎评估其宇宙学代表性。
key_points: 研究对象是温度接近 CMB 的星系晕冷气体/尘埃“维里云”。
模型覆盖第一代恒星形成之后至红移约 10 的演化阶段。
摘要报告云体持续冷却、收缩，并被金属和分子氢增丰，冷却率始终高于加热率。
methods: 耦合热、化学和动力学演化模型
CMB 加热
引力收缩导致的绝热压缩
H2 与金属线冷却
第一代恒星超新星反馈
数值求解耦合常微分方程
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“维里云可容纳缺失重子”这一前提、初始条件与 Paper I 的衔接、CMB 加热和冷却函数的实现，以及 Pop III 超新星反馈如何参数化；摘要给出的单调冷却结论是否对这些假设敏感也很关键。

papers.title: TDCOSMO XXIX: JWST/NIRSpec IFU Spatially Resolved Kinematics of Three Time-delay Lenses
papers.abstract: Spatially resolved stellar kinematics are critical to the high precision achieved by cosmological probes utilizing time delays of strongly lensed quasars. Combined with high-resolution imaging and lens modeling, dynamical models of the 2D resolved kinematics of the deflector galaxy tightly constrain the mass profile and break the mass-sheet degeneracy, in turn providing tight constraints on the Hubble constant when the time delays are included. We extract stellar kinematics of the deflector galaxies in the quadruply lensed quasar systems HE0435-1223, PG1115+080, and WFI2033-4723 from James Webb Space Telescope Near-Infrared Spectrograph (JWST-NIRSpec) integral field spectroscopy. The kinematic maps reach average per-bin total (statistical and systematic) uncertainties of 6-11%, with average bin-to-bin correlated errors of only $\sim 1.2\%$. The aperture-integrated velocity dispersions are statistically consistent with the values used in the previous TDCOSMO analysis (all within $0.9σ$), with their average uncertainty reduced from 3.7% to 2.4% owing to improvements in the data reduction and kinematic-extraction methodology. We classify PG1115+080 as a fast rotator, HE0435-1223 and WFI2033-4723 as slow rotators within the probed radii, and we refine the source redshifts from the kinematics of the lensed host galaxies. Kinematic maps will be combined with time delays, lens models, and line-of-sight convergence estimates to measure cosmological parameters in the upcoming TDCOSMO 2026 milestone publication.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 18 figures, 6 tables; submitted to Physical Review D

analysis.title_zh: TDCOSMO XXIX：JWST/NIRSpec IFU 对三个时间延迟透镜的空间分辨运动学观测
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇 TDCOSMO 论文利用 JWST/NIRSpec IFU 光谱提取 HE0435-1223、PG1115+080 和 WFI2033-4723 三个时间延迟强透镜系统中透镜星系的空间分辨恒星运动学。摘要报告这些运动学图达到较低的不确定性，孔径积分速度弥散与此前 TDCOSMO 分析一致但平均不确定性降低，并将用于后续结合时间延迟和透镜模型测量宇宙学参数。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 时间延迟强透镜是独立于 CMB 的 H0 测量通道，因此对哈勃张力具有直接背景意义。改进透镜星系运动学可降低质量轮廓和质量片简并带来的系统误差，从而检验与 CMB 推断 H0 是否一致。
key_points: JWST/NIRSpec IFU 提供三个四重透镜类星体系统透镜星系的二维恒星运动学图。
空间分辨运动学有助于约束透镜质量轮廓并打破质量片简并。
这些数据将与时间延迟、透镜模型和视线会聚估计结合，用于后续 TDCOSMO 宇宙学参数测量。
methods: JWST/NIRSpec 积分视场光谱
空间分辨恒星运动学提取
二维运动学图
孔径积分速度弥散比较
强引力透镜时间延迟宇宙学
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对运动学提取中的系统误差和 bin 间相关误差如何估计、这些二维运动学如何进入动力学-透镜联合模型，以及质量片简并和视线会聚的不确定性是否仍主导 H0 误差预算。

papers.title: Reassessing Evidence for Dark-Sector Interactions with Dynamical Dark Energy and DESI DR2
papers.abstract: Recent baryon acoustic oscillation measurements from DESI Data Release 2, when combined with CMB and supernova data, strengthen the motivation for exploring departures from $Λ$CDM in the late-time expansion history. Because an evolving dark-energy equation of state and an interaction within the dark sector can produce partially degenerate effects on the background expansion, their observational signatures should be assessed simultaneously. We first consider an interacting $w_0w_a$CDM model with $Q=βHρ_{\rm de}$, using Planck and ACT CMB data, DESI DR2, and DES-Dovekie supernovae. Allowing the dark-energy equation of state to evolve substantially weakens the preference for a nonzero coupling, while the preference for dynamical dark energy persists. The interaction provides essentially no additional improvement in the best fit, suggesting that part of the coupling preference found in more restricted interacting models may reflect a degeneracy with dark-energy dynamics. We then examine the same interaction for three one-parameter dynamical dark-energy trajectories: thawing, mirage, and generalized emergent dark energy (GEDE). The role of the interaction depends strongly on the assumed trajectory. The thawing and GEDE models favor sizable couplings of opposite signs, whereas the mirage trajectory already closely follows the dark-energy evolution preferred by the data and provides little support for an additional interaction. These models also predict markedly different signatures in structure growth, ranging from enhanced matter clustering in the interacting thawing model to strong suppression in interacting GEDE. These contrasting growth signatures, despite substantial degeneracies at the background level, highlight late-time large-scale-structure observations as a promising avenue for distinguishing dark-energy dynamics from dark-sector interactions.

analysis.title_zh: 结合动态暗能量与 DESI DR2 重新评估暗区相互作用的证据
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Planck 与 ACT CMB、DESI DR2 BAO 和 DES-Dovekie 超新星数据，重新评估动态暗能量与暗区相互作用同时存在时的观测证据。摘要报告，在相互作用 w0waCDM 中允许暗能量状态方程演化会显著削弱非零耦合偏好，而动态暗能量偏好仍持续；在 thawing、mirage、GEDE 三类轨迹中，相互作用的作用依赖具体轨迹，并给出不同的结构增长预言。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接使用 CMB 数据并讨论 late-time 宇宙学中 ΛCDM 的可能偏离，是 CMB 参数推断与低红移距离探针联合分析的核心议题。它强调背景膨胀层面的简并可能把动态暗能量误解为暗区耦合，因此对解读 Planck/ACT 与 DESI、超新星联合约束以及未来大尺度结构检验很重要。
key_points: 研究同时考虑动态暗能量状态方程和暗区相互作用，以处理二者在背景膨胀上的简并。
在相互作用 w0waCDM 中，允许暗能量演化会削弱非零耦合偏好，但动态暗能量偏好仍存在。
不同动态暗能量轨迹下，相互作用对结构增长的预言差异很大。
methods: Planck CMB 数据
ACT CMB 数据
DESI DR2 重子声学振荡数据
DES-Dovekie 超新星数据
相互作用 w0waCDM 模型，Q=βHρ_de
thawing、mirage、GEDE 三种一参数动态暗能量轨迹
背景膨胀与结构增长信号比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对参数先验、CMB/BAO/SN 数据组合方式、相互作用项 Q=βHρ_de 的稳定性条件，以及“偏好”是由哪些数据集和哪些模型限制驱动的；还应检查结构增长预言是否经过实际 LSS 数据约束或主要是模型外推。

papers.title: Beyond isolated curvature peaks: collective collapse and multiple Primordial Black Hole formation
papers.abstract: Primordial black hole (PBH) calculations usually treat rare curvature peaks as isolated collapsing regions. Using fully nonlinear $3+1$ numerical-relativity simulations in a radiation-dominated Universe, we demonstrate that neighbouring primordial curvature perturbations need not map one-to-one onto PBHs: they may ultimately disperse, collapse collectively into a single PBH, or undergo distinct local collapses and form more than one PBH. In the family of two-component profiles studied here, the latter outcome is a pair of PBHs, identified by the coexistence of two disconnected apparent horizons on at least one time slice. We introduce a nonspherical quasi-local compaction diagnostic based on the Hawking mass and referenced to a round flat-FLRW sphere of equal area. It retains the angular structure of the curvature field and reduces to the standard Misner-Sharp compaction function in spherical symmetry. The global maximum of this diagnostic, $\mathcal K_{\rm form}$, provides an empirical indicator of whether at least one PBH forms, with a transition near $\mathcal K_{\rm form,c}\approx0.56$ and modest profile-dependent scatter. For forming bimodal profiles, we supplement the nonlinear compactness with a signed linear surface strength evaluated on the same probing spheres. The viability of the weaker local branch and the competition between the local and common-enclosing branches improve the empirical discrimination between single- and double-PBH outcomes. Our results therefore show that the maximum curvature amplitude alone does not determine the collapse outcome, which also depends on the spatial extent, characteristic scales, and geometry of the surrounding curvature environment.

analysis.title_zh: 超越孤立曲率峰：集体坍缩与多个原初黑洞的形成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究相邻原初曲率峰在 PBH 形成中是否可被视为孤立坍缩区，使用辐射主导宇宙中的全非线性 3+1 数值相对论模拟分析两分量曲率轮廓。摘要报告这些扰动可能弥散、共同形成单个 PBH，或形成一对 PBH，并提出一个基于 Hawking 质量的非球对称准局域 compactness 指标来经验判别 PBH 形成及单双 PBH 结局。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: PBH 丰度常被用来连接早期宇宙小尺度扰动、暗物质候选体和暴胀模型；若相邻峰的几何环境会改变坍缩结局，基于峰统计或曲率振幅阈值的 PBH 预测可能需要修正。它与 CMB 的联系主要是早期宇宙扰动谱和非高斯性约束的外推：CMB 约束大尺度扰动，而 PBH 探测小尺度扰动，两者共同限制暴胀模型。
key_points: 相邻曲率扰动不一定与 PBH 一一对应。
全非线性 3+1 数值相对论显示可出现弥散、共同坍缩或多个局部坍缩。
提出基于 Hawking 质量的非球对称准局域 compactness 诊断。
methods: 辐射主导宇宙中的全非线性 3+1 数值相对论模拟
两分量曲率扰动轮廓族
表观视界识别
基于 Hawking 质量、等面积平坦 FLRW 圆球参照的准局域 compaction 诊断
有符号线性 surface strength 诊断
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对新的非球对称 compaction 诊断的定义、规范或切片依赖性、两分量轮廓族的代表性，以及从经验阈值推广到一般 PBH 初始条件时是否稳健。

papers.title: Universal CMB Phase Coherence from Single-Field Inflation
papers.abstract: The phase coherence of primordial perturbations shapes the acoustic peaks of the CMB and is regarded as a key signature of inflation. Inflationary scenarios at different energy scales, thus with different durations, are commonly expected to leave different levels of coherence. We show this expectation fails: because the curvature perturbation is conserved on super-Hubble scales, the coherence at recombination inherits a value fixed by the observed primordial spectrum alone. This holds irrespective of the inflationary energy scale and the subsequent expansion history.

analysis.title_zh: 单场暴胀产生的普适 CMB 相位相干性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论原初扰动相位相干性如何塑造 CMB 声学峰，并挑战“不同暴胀能标或持续时间会留下不同相干性水平”的常见预期。摘要称，由于曲率扰动在超哈勃尺度守恒，复合时期的相干性只继承由观测原初谱固定的数值，而与暴胀能标及后续膨胀历史无关。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接面向 CMB 声学峰的物理起源和暴胀判据。若其论证成立，它会澄清 CMB 相位相干性对暴胀能标、暴胀持续时间和后暴胀历史的判别能力，帮助避免把声学峰相干性过度解释为特定能标暴胀模型的独立证据。
key_points: CMB 声学峰依赖原初扰动的相位相干性。
作者声称单场暴胀下，复合时的相干性由观测到的原初功率谱固定。
这一结论据摘要称不依赖暴胀能标和后续膨胀历史。
methods: 单场暴胀理论分析
超哈勃尺度曲率扰动守恒
由观测原初谱推断复合时期相位相干性
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“相位相干性”的精确定义、它如何由原初谱唯一固定，以及结论对单场、绝热性、初态选择、再加热历史和可能的熵扰动或非标准演化的适用边界。

papers.title: Gravitational Backreaction in de Sitter: A Canonical ADM Approach
papers.abstract: We develop a canonical ADM framework for gravitational backreaction during inflation. Our approach extends the formalism used to compute cosmological correlators by applying it to the evolution of the quantum background, which we identify with the metric one-point function. The aim is to assess the quantum stability of inflationary geometries under gravitational backreaction. Within this framework, the backreaction is determined by the expectation values of the Hamiltonian constraint and the equations of motion for the spatial metric. Working in the exact de Sitter limit, we apply the framework to a massless minimally coupled spectator scalar field and the physical graviton polarizations. At one loop, their backreaction renormalizes the relation between the cosmological constant and the Hubble parameter without inducing any secular departure from de Sitter evolution, in agreement with previous results. We perform the calculation using a hard momentum cutoff and show that a fixed physical cutoff allows the homogeneous background equations to be renormalized with time- and background-independent coefficients, in contrast to a fixed comoving cutoff. Finally, we demonstrate that the explicit representation of the backreaction depends on the gauge condition imposed on the metric fluctuations, as well as on the background-fluctuation split. Nevertheless, these different representations are related by a gauge transformation and are therefore physically equivalent.

analysis.title_zh: de Sitter 中的引力反作用：正则 ADM 方法
analysis.summary_zh: 本文为暴胀期间的引力反作用建立正则 ADM 框架，把量子背景识别为度规一点评估，并用 Hamiltonian 约束和空间度规方程的期望值描述反作用。摘要报告在精确 de Sitter 中，对无质量最小耦合旁观标量和物理引力子极化的一圈计算只重整化宇宙学常数与 Hubble 参数关系，不产生相对于 de Sitter 的长期偏离。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暴胀背景是否受量子涨落反作用而发生长期漂移，是理解暴胀稳定性和计算宇宙学关联函数时的重要理论问题。CMB 各向异性和偏振来自暴胀扰动的统计性质；若背景演化或重整化处理发生改变，会影响从早期量子场论到可观测功率谱和相关函数的理论一致性。
key_points: 建立用于暴胀期引力反作用的正则 ADM 框架。
在精确 de Sitter 极限的一圈计算中，旁观标量场和引力子只重整化 Λ-H 关系。
摘要称未发现 de Sitter 演化的长期 secular 偏离，且不同表示由规范变换联系。
methods: 正则 ADM 形式
Hamiltonian 约束与空间度规运动方程的期望值
精确 de Sitter 极限
无质量最小耦合旁观标量场与物理引力子极化的一圈计算
硬动量 cutoff
固定物理 cutoff 与固定共动 cutoff 比较
规范条件和背景-涨落分解分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对背景一点评估与可观测量之间的关系、硬 cutoff 重整化的物理含义、规范依赖表示如何显式相互变换，以及结论是否仅限于精确 de Sitter 和一圈阶。

papers.title: Inelastic Dark Photon Dark Matter for the LUX-ZEPLIN High-Recoil Event and the Galactic Halo Gamma-Ray Excess
papers.abstract: We show that a single dark-photon dark matter framework can simultaneously account for two recently reported anomalies: the halo-like Galactic gamma-ray excess identified by Totani in 15 years of Fermi-LAT data, and the $E_{\rm nr}=248\pm23\,({\rm stat})\pm23\,({\rm sys})$ keV nuclear-recoil event of interest reported by the LUX-ZEPLIN Collaboration. The dark matter is a $U(1)_X$ dark photon $X$ with mass $m_X=420$ GeV, stabilized by a dark parity that forbids kinetic mixing with the Standard Model photon. A light scalar mediator $φ$, already required to explain the Totani excess via Sommerfeld enhancement, is extended to couple a nearly degenerate heavier vector partner $V$ to $X$. The resulting inelastic transition $X+N \to V+N$, with mass splitting $δ\simeq316$~keV close to the kinematic endpoint for $m_X=420$ GeV, naturally reproduces the localized LZ event once the detector energy resolution is included, while leaving the relic abundance and the halo phenomenology of the original Totani-motivated benchmark essentially unchanged.

analysis.title_zh: 用于解释 LUX-ZEPLIN 高反冲事件和银河晕伽马射线超额的非弹性暗光子暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一个非弹性暗光子暗物质框架，试图同时解释 Totani 基于 15 年 Fermi-LAT 数据报告的银河晕状伽马射线 excess，以及 LUX-ZEPLIN 报告的高能核反冲关注事件。摘要称质量约 420 GeV 的 U(1)_X 暗光子、轻标量媒介子和近简并矢量伙伴可通过非弹性跃迁再现 LZ 事件，并基本保持原有解释伽马射线 excess 的晕现象学和遗迹丰度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质性质是 CMB 和宇宙学参数解释中的核心背景问题；虽然本文聚焦直接探测和伽马射线异常，不直接分析 CMB 数据，但其暗物质模型若成立，需要与早期宇宙遗迹丰度、结构形成以及 CMB 对暗物质相互作用或能量注入的约束相容。
key_points: 提出一个暗光子暗物质框架同时解释 Fermi-LAT 银河晕伽马射线 excess 和 LUX-ZEPLIN 高反冲事件。
模型包含 U(1)_X 暗光子、暗宇称、轻标量媒介子和近简并较重矢量伙伴。
摘要称非弹性跃迁加上探测器能量分辨率可再现 LZ 局域事件，同时基本保持原有遗迹丰度和晕现象学。
methods: 暗光子暗物质模型构建
Sommerfeld enhancement
非弹性散射 X+N → V+N
纳入探测器能量分辨率
Fermi-LAT 15 年数据中的银河晕伽马射线 excess
LUX-ZEPLIN 核反冲事件
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该单一参数框架是否真正同时满足直接探测、伽马射线、遗迹丰度和其他天体物理/实验约束；还要关注 LZ 单个高反冲事件和银河晕 excess 的统计稳健性在模型论证中如何处理。

papers.title: A Peccei--Quinn Origin for Inelastic Electroweak Dark Matter after LUX-ZEPLIN
papers.abstract: The LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment has reported one nuclear recoil event reconstructed at $E_R=248\pm23_{\rm stat}\pm23_{\rm sys}$\,keV in a search extending to $E_R\simeq270$\,keV. We investigate an inelastic electroweak (EW) doublet interpretation in which spontaneous Peccei--Quinn (PQ) breaking leaves a residual parity that stabilizes the lighter neutral state and generates the Majorana splitting. A PQ-charged singlet fermion acquires its Majorana mass from the PQ-breaking vacuum expectation value and, after being integrated out, induces the dimension-five operator that splits a vectorlike EW doublet. A minimal KSVZ colored sector supplies the QCD anomaly. For a representative PQ-breaking scale $v_S=4.4\times10^{11}$\,GeV and Majorana mass $M_N\simeq50$\,TeV, the relation $M_N=y_Sv_S/\sqrt{2}$ gives $y_S\simeq1.6\times10^{-7}$, while the splitting relevant for LZ requires a Higgs--doublet Yukawa coupling $y\simeq0.023$. In a standard thermal history, the EW doublet constitutes only a subcomponent of the dark matter. A rate estimate probing the high velocity tail gives representative benchmarks with $M_D\simeq380$--$420$\,GeV, $\dchi\simeq323$--$330$\,keV, and $ξ_χ\simeq0.12$--$0.15$ yielding an order-one LZ event count. The remaining abundance is supplied by the QCD axion through vacuum misalignment for suitable $v_S$ and initial angle. The excited state has a radiative lifetime of order $3\times10^{-2}$\,s and a decay length of order $20$\,km, leaving the LZ topology as a single nuclear recoil while enabling a complementary luminous signal after terrestrial upscattering.

analysis.title_zh: LUX-ZEPLIN 之后非弹性电弱暗物质的 Peccei--Quinn 起源
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 LUX-ZEPLIN 报告的一个高能核反冲事件是否可由非弹性电弱双重态暗物质解释，并构造一个 Peccei--Quinn 破缺同时产生稳定残余宇称和 Majorana 劈裂的模型。摘要报告了若干代表性参数点可给出量级为一的 LZ 事件数，而电弱双重态只占暗物质的一部分，其余由 QCD 轴子通过真空错位机制提供。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于粒子暗物质模型构建，与 CMB 的联系是间接的：它讨论暗物质组成、热史和轴子丰度，这些都会影响宇宙学暗物质预算；但摘要没有涉及 CMB 各向异性、早期宇宙能量注入或 CMB 直接约束。
key_points: 提出一种把 LZ 高能核反冲事件与非弹性电弱双重态暗物质相联系的模型。
PQ 破缺同时提供残余稳定性、Majorana 劈裂，并由 QCD 轴子补足暗物质丰度。
摘要给出代表性参数点，但该解释依赖高速度尾部事件率估计和标准热史假设。
methods: 基于 LUX-ZEPLIN 核反冲事件的非弹性散射解释
Peccei--Quinn 自发破缺与残余宇称构造
积分出 PQ 带电单重态费米子得到维五算符
KSVZ 有色扇区提供 QCD 反常
标准热史下的热遗迹丰度估计
高速度尾部的事件率估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 LZ 单事件的能量重建与背景解释是否足以支撑模型动机，以及高速度尾部事件率、暗物质亚成分比例和轴子误差预算是否被一致处理。

papers.title: Strong Constraints on Higgsino Dark Matter from Solar Capture
papers.abstract: Higgsino dark matter remains one of the most convincing dark matter candidates. It can exist in a ``quasi-Dirac" regime, when the splitting between two Majorana components is on the order of $O(\rm few~\,MeV)$ or less. Owing to the strong gravitational pull of the Sun, the DM particles accelerate to up to $\sim 1400$\,km/sec in the solar core, which allows for inelastic scattering on heavy elements and very effective capture onto solar-bound trajectories. We evaluate the expected flux of the neutrinos from the expected $χχ\to W^+W^-,ZZ$ annihilation for the cosmologically preferred mass, $m_χ\simeq 1.08$\,TeV while keeping the mass splitting $δ$ as a free parameter. Confronting it with the non-observation of high-energy neutrinos from the Sun by the IceCube experiment, we obtain a robust limit, $δ>566$\,keV. These limits exclude the interpretation of the recent LZ event in terms of endothermic inelastic scattering of Higgsino dark matter on xenon nuclei.

analysis.title_zh: 来自太阳俘获的 Higgsino 暗物质强约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论准 Dirac 区域的 Higgsino 暗物质在太阳引力加速下通过重元素非弹性散射被俘获，并由随后湮灭产生高能中微子。摘要报告，在宇宙学偏好的约 1.08 TeV 质量处，将预期中微子通量与 IceCube 未观测到太阳高能中微子的结果比较，得到对质量劈裂的强限制，并用于排除近期 LZ 事件的一种解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 的联系主要在暗物质宇宙学背景上：Higgsino 热遗迹质量和暗物质候选体性质会影响宇宙学模型的粒子物理解释。不过摘要内容核心是太阳俘获、间接探测和地下实验解释，对 CMB 各向异性或早期宇宙扰动没有直接分析。
key_points: 研究准 Dirac Higgsino 暗物质在太阳中的非弹性俘获。
太阳核心高速度使其可在重元素上发生非弹性散射并被有效俘获。
摘要给出 IceCube 太阳高能中微子非观测对应的质量劈裂下限，并称其排除一种 LZ 事件解释。
methods: 太阳俘获计算
暗物质湮灭到 W+W-、ZZ 后的中微子通量估计
IceCube 太阳高能中微子非观测约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对太阳重元素丰度、非弹性散射截面、俘获-湮灭平衡假设和 IceCube 限制映射到质量劈裂下限的系统误差处理。

papers.title: Gravitational Imprints of Axion Clouds on Black-Hole Orbital Dynamics
papers.abstract: Black holes of primordial or astrophysical origin immersed in axion dark matter provide a natural laboratory for exploring the interplay between compact objects and ultralight scalar fields. While previous studies have primarily focused on superradiance and horizon-scale phenomena, the gravitational response of the surrounding axion distribution has received comparatively little attention. We investigate the dynamics of particles orbiting Schwarzschild and Kerr primordial black holes embedded in scalar-field dark matter halos. Using first-order perturbation theory, we show that the ambient halo redistributes the gravitationally bound axion cloud, shifting the characteristic radius of the gravitational atom. Numerical integrations of timelike geodesics demonstrate that the maximum orbital response consistently occurs at this perturbed radius, establishing a direct correspondence between the microscopic structure of the axion wavefunction and the macroscopic dynamics of orbiting particles. Our results identify a new purely gravitational signature of scalar-field dark matter around primordial black holes and provide a framework for probing mixed axion--primordial black hole dark matter scenarios.
papers.comment: Total of 6 pages for the main article and 17 pages of supplemental material

analysis.title_zh: 轴子云对黑洞轨道动力学的引力印记
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究浸没在轴子暗物质中的原初或天体物理黑洞，其周围标量场分布如何通过引力影响绕行粒子的轨道。作者用一阶微扰理论和类时测地线数值积分，报告环境晕会重分布引力束缚轴子云，并使轨道响应最大值出现在扰动后的“引力原子”特征半径处。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接处理 CMB 数据，但与宇宙学暗物质模型有关，尤其是轴子与原初黑洞混合暗物质情景。若这类纯引力信号可被观测约束，将为 CMB 之外的暗物质与早期宇宙模型检验提供互补信息。
key_points: 研究轴子暗物质晕中 Schwarzschild 与 Kerr 原初黑洞附近的粒子轨道动力学。
摘要称轴子云的扰动特征半径与轨道响应最大位置相对应。
提出一种围绕原初黑洞的标量场暗物质纯引力信号。
methods: 一阶微扰理论
Schwarzschild 与 Kerr 原初黑洞模型
标量场暗物质晕/引力束缚轴子云
类时测地线数值积分

papers.title: Ultralight Bosons Explain the Mass-Spin Correlations in the Merging Binary Black Hole Population
papers.abstract: Ultralight bosons could trigger superradiant instabilities in rapidly spinning black holes, forming oscillating clouds while extracting rotational energy. We consider an extended, superradiance-informed spin distribution model that characterizes possible environment-induced spin variations and compare its predictions with the observed population of merging black hole binaries in the Gravitational-Wave Transient Catalogs (GWTCs). We find that the mass-spin relation predicted by a scalar boson with mass $m_b\sim 10^{-12} \,\rm eV$ is consistent with the GWTCs, with increasing significance from GWTC-3.0 to 5.0. The Bayes factor reaches $\ln B \approx 7.8$ for GWTC-5.0. Intriguingly, this mass range largely coincides with a previous study based on a waveform analysis of the GW190728 gravitational wave event. Our findings provide compelling evidence that a superradiance-informed spin distribution model is highly compatible with the expanding binary black hole population dataset.

analysis.title_zh: 超轻玻色子解释并合双黑洞种群中的质量-自旋相关
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究超轻玻色子诱发的黑洞超辐射是否能解释并合双黑洞种群中的质量-自旋相关，构建超辐射启发且允许环境诱导自旋变化的分布模型，并与 GWTC 数据比较。摘要报告质量约为 m_b\sim10^{-12} eV 的标量玻色子模型与 GWTC 一致，且在 GWTC-5.0 中贝叶斯因子达到 \ln B\approx7.8。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接分析 CMB，但涉及暗物质/超轻粒子候选体的天体物理检验；若黑洞自旋种群确实支持特定质量的超轻玻色子，将与 CMB、LSS 和其他宇宙学探针对轻场暗物质或新粒子的约束形成互补。
key_points: 提出用超辐射启发的自旋分布模型解释并合黑洞的质量-自旋相关。
摘要称标量玻色子质量约为 10^{-12} eV 的预测与 GWTC 数据一致。
结果属于引力波黑洞种群与粒子宇宙学交叉，对 CMB 读者是间接相关。
methods: 超轻玻色子黑洞超辐射模型
包含环境诱导自旋变化的扩展自旋分布模型
与 GWTC 并合双黑洞种群数据比较
贝叶斯因子模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对自旋分布模型如何区分超辐射效应与天体物理形成通道、环境诱导自旋变化及选择效应，并检查摘要所称显著性随 GWTC-3.0 到 5.0 增强是否依赖特定先验或事件子样本。

papers.title: Feeding The Little Monster: An Accreting Intermediate-Mass Black Hole In A Minor Merger Secondary Galaxy
papers.abstract: We report the discovery of a luminous supersoft X-ray source associated with the secondary galaxy in a 10:1 minor merger at $z$=0.216. We identified the system in the 3D-HST survey and observed it serendipitously in more than 100 Chandra observations, providing a combined exposure of 6.6 Msec. The secondary galaxy ($\log$ (M$_*$/M$_\odot$)=8.24) exhibits X-ray emission detected exclusively below 2.0 keV, with no significant hard-band photons. Because the source is low-count, we characterize its spectrum using Bayesian hardness-ratio analysis combined with simulations of physically motivated spectral models folded through the Chandra response files. The observed count rates and hardness ratios are reproduced by a thermal accretion-disk spectrum with rest-frame inner-disk temperatures kT$_{in}$=0.18-0.30 keV and luminosities log(L$_X$/erg s$^{-1}$)=40.5-41.2. Interpreted using a standard thin-disk framework, these properties imply a black hole mass of M$_\bullet$$\approx 8\times10^{2}$--$5\times10^{3}\,M_\odot$ accreting at $\approx$0.2-0.5 of the Eddington rate. Alternative interpretations involving ultraluminous X-ray supersoft sources are disfavored by the source's luminosity, temperature, lack of variability, and the host galaxy's low star-formation rate. Numerical simulations predict that black holes in smaller, secondary galaxies could experience episodic rapid growth during minor mergers. This discovery provides observational support for this scenario and suggests that minor interactions may be an important channel for assembling supermassive black holes in dwarf galaxies.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ApJ. 8 pages, 4 figures, 1 table

analysis.title_zh: 喂养“小怪物”：小并合次级星系中一个正在吸积的中等质量黑洞
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告在 z=0.216 的 10:1 小并合系统次级星系中发现一个亮超软 X 射线源，并用 Chandra 多次观测的低计数数据进行贝叶斯硬度比和谱模型模拟分析。摘要称热吸积盘谱可再现观测计数率和硬度比，在标准薄盘解释下对应约 8×10^2 到 5×10^3 太阳质量、以约 0.2-0.5 Eddington 率吸积的中等质量黑洞。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作关注黑洞种子和中等质量黑洞在星系并合中的增长通道，对理解超大质量黑洞形成史有宇宙学相关性。它与 CMB 的关系不是直接观测层面，而是通过早期黑洞种子、星系演化和结构形成模型间接相关。
key_points: 报告一个位于小并合次级星系中的亮超软 X 射线源。
贝叶斯硬度比与 Chandra 响应模拟支持热吸积盘谱解释。
若采用标准薄盘框架，摘要称其对应正在较高 Eddington 比吸积的中等质量黑洞。

100 多次 Chandra 偶然观测，合并曝光 6.6 Msec
贝叶斯硬度比分析

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对低计数 X 射线数据下的谱模型退化、背景与源关联概率，以及从盘温和光度推断黑洞质量时对薄盘模型和吸积率的依赖。

papers.title: Dark Matter as the Z_2 Partner of the Standard Model Higgs Boson
papers.abstract: A possible gamma-ray excess from the Galactic halo favors dark matter with a mass of several hundred GeV. In previous work, we found that an electroweak scalar doublet is a particularly economical, and nearly uniquely selected, interpretation among simple renormalizable thermal dark-matter models. We point out that its unbroken Z_2 symmetry is exactly equivalent to an interchange symmetry between two Higgs doublets, making dark matter the Z_2-odd partner of the Standard Model Higgs boson and suggesting that the two doublets may share a common weak-scale origin. We connect this model to the recently reported 248 keV nuclear-recoil event in the LUX-ZEPLIN experiment. For dark-matter masses of 440--600 GeV, a technically natural, mass-dependent neutral-state splitting of order 350 keV defines a narrow strip near the kinematic boundary where the fixed off-diagonal Z interaction can produce the observed recoil. Because the scattering probes the extreme high-velocity tail of the Galactic distribution, this interpretation predicts a large annual modulation, with future events preferentially occurring around early summer. Neither observation is yet conclusive, but their common interpretation is sharply testable.
papers.comment: 6 pages; v2: added a note discussing the concurrent solar-capture constraint

papers.title: Disc-Based Estimation of the Local Dark Matter Density and Velocity Distribution in IllustrisTNG50
papers.abstract: We study the dark matter (DM) density and velocity distribution in the solar neighborhood of Milky Way-like galaxies using the TNG50-1 run of the IllustrisTNG simulation suite. Milky Way-like galaxies are selected according to both their halo mass and their bulge-to-total stellar mass ratio, and the solar-neighborhood region within each galaxy is identified from the positions and number density of stars, so that DM particles associated with the galactic disc are extracted while contributions from the halo component are suppressed. Averaging over the selected galaxies, we obtain a local DM density of $ρ\simeq 0.47\pm0.02~{\rm GeV\,cm^{-3}}$, consistent with the range inferred from observations. The disc-based extraction gives a higher peak density, $0.41\pm0.02~{\rm GeV\,cm^{-3}}$, than the value $0.34\pm0.02~{\rm GeV\,cm^{-3}}$ from a simple distance-based extraction, probably because it excludes the low-density DM in the halo. The width of the density distribution, on the other hand, is nearly unchanged. The velocity distribution is well described by an isotropic Maxwellian with a peak velocity of about $226~{\rm km~s^{-1}}$, close to the value assumed in the standard halo model. The differences in the density and velocity distributions between our disc-based and simple distance-based extractions are not so large as to significantly affect the interpretation of direct-detection experiments.

analysis.title_zh: 基于星系盘估计 IllustrisTNG50 中的局域暗物质密度与速度分布
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 IllustrisTNG50-1 模拟中的类银河系星系，基于恒星盘定义太阳邻域并估计局域暗物质密度和速度分布。摘要报告得到的局域密度与观测推断范围一致，盘基提取比简单距离提取给出更高峰值密度，而速度分布接近标准晕模型常用的各向同性 Maxwell 分布。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接分析 CMB，但它关系到暗物质宇宙学参数与粒子暗物质实验之间的连接：CMB 约束暗物质的宇宙平均性质，而直接探测解释依赖银河系局域暗物质密度和速度分布。若模拟支持标准晕模型近似，将有助于把 CMB、星系形成模拟和地下直接探测结果放在一致框架下比较。

摘要称速度分布可由各向同性 Maxwell 分布较好描述，盘基与距离基提取的差异不足以显著影响直接探测解释。

papers.title: Constraints on the Intranight Optical Variability of Intermediate-Mass Black Hole Candidates
papers.abstract: Intermediate-mass black holes (IMBHs) provide a unique regime for studying accretion variability at the low-mass end of the black hole population, yet their intranight optical variability (INOV) remains poorly constrained. We present a systematic investigation of INOV in an optically selected sample of IMBH candidates using high-cadence observations from the Zwicky Transient Facility (ZTF). From a parent sample of 1,447 broad H$α$-selected candidates, we identify 64 IMBH candidates (median $f_{\mathrm{AGN}}\sim0.06$) with 163 intranight monitoring sessions. Apparent INOV signals identified by conventional ZTF PSF-fit photometry are largely associated with seeing-dependent changes in the relative contributions of compact nuclear and extended host components, which can mimic intrinsic short-timescale variability. In contrast, no robust INOV is detected with difference-image analysis. An ensemble structure function spanning $Δt\sim0.003$--$1600$ days reveals long-term variability in a small subsample of sources, whereas intrinsic variability remains unresolved at intranight timescales. Monte Carlo simulations further show that ZTF-like single-night monitoring has a low INOV recovery probability ($\sim1.2%$) for the variability amplitudes inferred from the long-term analysis. The recovery probability is primarily controlled by source brightness, AGN contribution, intrinsic variability amplitude, and photometric precision. These results demonstrate that the absence of detected INOV does not imply the absence of rapid accretion variability, but can reflect the limited detectability of low-amplitude signals under current observing capabilities. Our findings highlight the importance of robust photometric methodologies for future high-cadence variability studies of low-mass accreting black holes.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, submitted to ApJ. Comments are welcome

analysis.title_zh: 中等质量黑洞候选体夜内光学变异的限制
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 ZTF 高频观测系统检验光学选择的中等质量黑洞候选体是否存在夜内光学变异。摘要报告常规 PSF 测光中的表观信号大多可由视宁度相关的核区与宿主成分变化模拟，而差分图像分析未检测到稳健夜内光变；长期结构函数仅在少数源中显示长期变异。
