papers.title: Quasicrystalline Inflation: From the Cosmological Dipole to Primordial Diffraction
papers.abstract: We propose quasicrystalline inflation. Six quasiperiodic phases decompose into three phonons and three phasons. It turns out that a coherent pure-phason displacement can generate a local power dipole while the linear traceless quadrupole vanishes. From spatially varying quadratic effective field theory, we derive off-diagonal correlations whose momentum transfer is restricted to integer combinations of the six icosahedral wavevectors. These correlated off-diagonal signals provide a characteristic observational signature of primordial quasiperiodic order, primordial diffraction.

analysis.title_zh: 准晶暴胀：从宇宙学偶极到原初衍射
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一种“准晶暴胀”设想，用六个准周期相位构造三种声子和三种相位子自由度，并在空间变化的二次有效场论中推导相关函数结构。摘要报告称，相干的纯相位子位移能够产生局域功率偶极而不产生线性无迹四极矩，并给出受二十面体波矢整数线性组合限制的非对角相关信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 中的大尺度功率不对称、偶极调制和非对角协方差一直是检验统计各向同性的重要窗口；该工作把这些现象与一种具有准周期空间有序的原初机制联系起来。若摘要中的“原初衍射”特征可转化为可观测模板，它可能为 CMB 和大尺度结构数据中的非平凡动量空间相关提供新的模型化语言。
key_points: 提出“准晶暴胀”框架，将六个准周期相位分解为三种声子与三种相位子。
纯相位子相干位移可产生局域功率偶极，同时线性无迹四极矩为零。
预言动量转移受六个二十面体波矢整数线性组合限制的非对角相关，即“原初衍射”。
methods: 空间变化的二次有效场论
非对角相关推导
六个二十面体波矢的准周期结构
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该准晶背景如何嵌入一致的暴胀动力学、相位子位移是否满足统计各向同性破缺与 CMB 偶极/四极约束，以及所谓原初衍射信号在实际 CMB/大尺度结构估计量中是否可分辨于系统误差和常见各向异性模型。

papers.title: Cosmological implications for hairy black holes via spontaneous symmetry breaking: Are Hairy Black Holes Primordial?
papers.abstract: We investigate whether hairy black holes generated through spontaneous symmetry breaking in Einstein-Scalar-Gauss-Bonnet (ESGB) theory, involving a complex scalar field with a global $U(1)$ symmetry, can be compatible with cosmological evolution. To this end, we introduce the ESGB theory with a scalar self-interaction that becomes relevant on cosmological scales while remaining negligible near the black hole. Owing to the time dependence of the GB term on cosmological scales, the scalar field dynamics in the evolving FLRW background differ qualitatively from those in the nearly static black hole background. In particular, for scalar-GB couplings compatible with hairy black hole formation, the effective potential supports a symmetry-broken vacuum throughout inflation. However, after inflation, a decelerated expansion changes the sign of the GB term, temporarily making the effective potential unbounded from below. As the GB contribution subsequently decreases, the scalar self-interaction eventually dominates and restores the symmetry. Within this schematic framework, we derive stringent constraints on the coupling strengths, the cutoff scale, and the black hole mass, which primarily arise for avoiding efficient tachyonic amplification of the scalar field perturbations during the unbounded phase. For cutoff scales compatible with both cosmological evolution and scalar hair formation, we find that only ultralight black holes with masses of the order of a few grams can develop scalar hair, identifying them as hairy primordial black holes.

analysis.title_zh: 通过自发对称破缺研究有毛黑洞的宇宙学含义：有毛黑洞是原初的吗？
analysis.summary_zh: 该文研究 Einstein-Scalar-Gauss-Bonnet 理论中由自发对称破缺生成的有毛黑洞能否嵌入宇宙学演化，并引入在宇宙尺度相关、在黑洞附近可忽略的标量自相互作用。摘要报告，由于 FLRW 背景中高斯-博内项随时间变化，暴胀后有效势会短暂无下界；为避免标量扰动的有效 tachyonic 放大，可得到对耦合、cutoff 尺度和黑洞质量的严格约束，且可形成标量毛的黑洞仅为数克量级的超轻原初黑洞。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 的联系较间接，主要在原初黑洞、暴胀后场演化和早期宇宙新引力自由度方面。若数克量级有毛原初黑洞是该机制的主要产物，其形成与演化可能受到早期宇宙历史约束；但摘要未涉及 CMB 各向异性、谱畸变或具体观测信号，因此对 CMB 读者更适合作为相关理论背景快速浏览。
key_points: 研究 ESGB 理论中由自发对称破缺产生的有毛黑洞是否可与宇宙学演化相容。
在 FLRW 背景中，高斯-博内项的时间依赖会使标量场有效势经历对称破缺、无下界阶段和对称恢复。
摘要称满足宇宙学演化和标量毛形成条件时，只有数克量级超轻黑洞可形成标量毛。
methods: Einstein-Scalar-Gauss-Bonnet 理论
带全局 $U(1)$ 对称性的复标量场
标量自相互作用
FLRW 宇宙学背景分析
暴胀后减速膨胀阶段的有效势分析
避免标量扰动 tachyonic amplification 的参数约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对从示意性框架得到的参数约束有多模型依赖，特别是高斯-博内耦合、cutoff 尺度、暴胀后历史和 tachyonic amplification 判据如何共同限制黑洞质量。

papers.title: BICEP/Keck XXII: Analysis of the South Pole Atmosphere for CMB Observations
papers.abstract: The South Pole is among the driest sites on Earth, and the resulting high atmospheric transparency makes it an excellent site for millimeter-wave astronomical observations. Nevertheless, for bolometric surveys of the cosmic microwave background (CMB), fluctuations in line-of-sight water vapor drive variable atmospheric emission, which has a significant impact on survey sensitivity. We have deployed a water vapor radiometer (WVR) to characterize these fluctuations in space and time and to compare atmospheric and CMB signals with other sites. This WVR has been monitoring conditions from the South Pole over the past nine years, co-located and co-observing with the BICEP series of telescopes. In this work, we analyze the performance of the WVR and the characteristics of the South Pole atmosphere and demonstrate coherent wind-driven transport of water vapor structures across the site. We show that fluctuations in CMB detector timestreams are well correlated with fluctuations in atmospheric water vapor, providing independent justification for baseline filtering procedures used to remove these fluctuations and providing a new pathway to detect and mitigate the temperature-to-polarization leakage that currently limits the precision of ground-based CMB polarization measurements.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 19 figures. Submitted to The Astrophysical Journal Supplement Series (ApJS)

analysis.title_zh: BICEP/Keck XXII：用于 CMB 观测的南极大气分析
analysis.summary_zh: 本文分析南极大气水汽涨落对地基 CMB 玻尔计观测的影响，使用与 BICEP 系列望远镜共址共同观测的九年水汽辐射计数据表征时空变化。摘要报告水汽结构存在风驱相干输运，且 CMB 探测器时间流涨落与大气水汽涨落良好相关，从而支持相关滤波流程并提供缓解温度到偏振泄漏的新路径。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 观测系统误差直接相关。地基 B 模式偏振实验受大气发射、水汽涨落和温度到偏振泄漏限制；对南极大气的长期定量刻画会影响 BICEP/Keck 及未来南极 CMB 实验的扫描策略、数据滤波和系统误差预算。
key_points: 南极水汽涨落会显著影响地基毫米波 CMB 测量灵敏度。
九年 WVR 数据与 BICEP 系列望远镜共址、共同观测。
摘要称 CMB 探测器时间流涨落与大气水汽涨落相关，可支持基线滤波并帮助缓解温度到偏振泄漏。
methods: 南极水汽辐射计 WVR
九年大气监测数据
与 BICEP 系列望远镜共址、共同观测
CMB detector timestreams 与水汽涨落相关性分析
水汽结构的风驱相干输运分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 WVR 与 BICEP 时间流相关性的量化方式、频段和角尺度依赖，以及这些结果如何具体支撑基线滤波和温度到偏振泄漏缓解而不损失真实 CMB 信号。

papers.title: Calculating the squeezed bispectrum in stochastic inflation by Monte Carlo simulation
papers.abstract: The bispectrum of cosmological perturbations is an important probe of inflation and the underlying particle physics. However, calculating it becomes challenging in inflation models where inflaton dynamics is dominated by quantum diffusion rather than slow-roll, especially in the multi-field case. In this paper, employing the stochastic-$δ\mathcal{N}$ formalism, we propose a Monte Carlo-based method to calculate the bispectrum in the squeezed limit, as an extension of the method for the power spectrum that we previously proposed. Our method involves generating paths of inflatons' time evolution that branch only several times, avoiding nested path generation, which incurs a prohibitive computational cost. As numerical demonstrations, we apply the proposed method to single- and double-field chaotic inflation for validation, and to hybrid inflation with mild waterfall, for which, to the best of our knowledge, the bispectrum is calculated for the first time in this work.

analysis.title_zh: 用蒙特卡罗模拟在随机暴胀中计算挤压双谱
analysis.summary_zh: 本文关注量子扩散主导、尤其多场暴胀中宇宙学扰动双谱难以计算的问题。作者基于随机-δN形式提出一种用于挤压极限双谱的蒙特卡罗方法，通过只让暴胀场演化路径少量分支来避免高成本的嵌套路径生成，并在混沌暴胀与温和瀑布混合暴胀中作数值演示。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初非高斯性，特别是挤压极限双谱，是连接暴胀动力学与CMB温度、偏振各向异性统计性质的重要量。若该方法能可靠处理量子扩散主导和多场暴胀情形，将有助于把更复杂的早期宇宙模型转化为可与CMB非高斯性约束比较的预言。
key_points: 提出用随机-δN形式计算挤压极限双谱的蒙特卡罗方法。
路径生成只需少数分支，以降低嵌套路径生成的计算成本。
摘要称方法已在单场、双场混沌暴胀中验证，并首次用于温和瀑布混合暴胀的双谱计算。
methods: 随机-δN形式
蒙特卡罗模拟
挤压极限双谱计算
单场和双场混沌暴胀数值演示
温和瀑布混合暴胀应用
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对蒙特卡罗估计量如何从随机-δN形式推出、分支路径数对偏差和方差的控制方式，以及在多场量子扩散主导情形下与已知可解析或数值结果的验证是否充分。

papers.title: Generalized Foldy-Wouthuysen approach for the derivation of non-relativistic effective field theories
papers.abstract: Effective field theories (EFTs) are a powerful framework for performing high-precision calculations at reduced complexity compared to their fundamental counterparts. A particularly important class of EFTs arises in the non-relativistic (NR) regime. Their construction relies on a different realization of the underlying symmetries, since Lorentz invariance is no longer manifest in covariant form in the NR regime. This behavior imposes a link between certain matching coefficients, and therefore additional constraints, commonly referred to as hidden Lorentz invariance. These constraints are established in quantum field theories on inertial flat spacetime, such as NR quantum electrodynamics. However, deriving these constraints becomes considerably more involved for theories involving physics beyond the Standard Model or formulated in non-inertial spacetime backgrounds, where the hidden symmetry structure is less transparent. In this work, we present an approach to obtain the NR EFT by first constructing a relativistic EFT and then performing a generalized NR reduction based on an extended Foldy-Wouthuysen transformation. We illustrate this method by a quantum chromo-electrodynamics EFT for inertial flat spacetime, describing both electromagnetic and strong interactions, and show how it reduces to the established Lagrangian of NR quantum chromodynamics and electrodynamics. The hidden Lorentz invariance emerges as a direct consequence of the construction. This approach provides a route to obtain the NR limits of more complex theories, \eg Dirac fields in non-inertial spacetime or extensions involving physics beyond the Standard Model. As an example, we apply the method to add the coupling of a pseudoscalar axion field in a simplified model and derive its NR limit.

analysis.title_zh: 用于推导非相对论有效场论的广义 Foldy-Wouthuysen 方法
analysis.summary_zh: 本文关注如何系统推导非相对论有效场论中由隐藏洛伦兹不变性带来的匹配系数约束。作者提出先建立相对论性 EFT，再通过扩展 Foldy-Wouthuysen 变换进行广义非相对论约化，并在含电磁和强相互作用的 EFT 以及赝标量轴子耦合简化模型中展示其非相对论极限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接研究 CMB 各向异性或宇宙学参数，但与粒子宇宙学中的低能有效描述有关。若暗物质候选体如轴子或其他超出标准模型粒子需要在非相对论介质、实验装置或引力/非惯性背景中建模，这类 EFT 推导框架可影响从微观耦合到宇宙学可观测量的理论连接。
key_points: 提出先构造相对论性 EFT、再用扩展 Foldy-Wouthuysen 变换做非相对论约化的流程。
在含电磁与强相互作用的量子色-电动力学 EFT 中示范，并回得到 NRQCD/NRQED 的既有拉氏量。
摘要称隐藏洛伦兹不变性约束可由该构造直接显现，并展示了赝标量轴子耦合的非相对论极限。
methods: 相对论性有效场论构造
广义非相对论约化
扩展 Foldy-Wouthuysen 变换
量子色-电动力学 EFT 示例
赝标量轴子场耦合的简化模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对扩展 Foldy-Wouthuysen 变换在含规范相互作用、轴子耦合或非惯性背景下的阶数展开、场重定义和匹配系数约束是否完整且无歧义；还要确认其“隐藏洛伦兹不变性直接显现”的论证是否超出已知 NRQED/NRQCD 情形。

papers.title: Inflationary Magnetogenesis with $f(R,φ)$ Coupling
papers.abstract: Inflationary magnetogenesis provides a promising mechanism for generating primordial large-scale magnetic fields, but faces challenges such as the strong coupling problem and backreaction issues. In this paper, we extend the Ratra model by introducing a coupling between the electromagnetic field and the background geometry, parameterized as $K(R)I^2(φ)$. Starting from a general action with $f^2(R,φ)F_{μν}F^{μν}$, we adopt $f^2(R,φ)=K(R)I^2(φ)$ as a concrete realization. Rather than focusing on the slow-roll inflationary stage (which reduces to the standard Ratra scenario), we concentrate on the post-inflationary reheating epoch, where the broken-power-law evolution of the scale factor and coupling function across the inflation-to-reheating transition allows us to derive analytic expressions for the magnetic and electric energy density spectra. Three key theoretical constraints are imposed on the model parameter space: the strong coupling condition, the backreaction constraint, and the CMB isotropy requirement. We obtain predictions for the present-day magnetic field strength $B_0$ and coherence length $L_{c0}$ for various combinations of the inflationary energy scale $H_f$ and the reheating temperature $T_r$. By comparing with observational constraints from radio observations and Fermi-LAT gamma-ray data, we demonstrate that the inflationary energy scale $H_f$, the reheating temperature $T_r$, the parameter $β$, and the e-folding numbers $N_f$, $N_r$ must satisfy stringent joint constraints. This work provides a viable theoretical framework for inflationary magnetogenesis that simultaneously satisfies theoretical consistency conditions and current observational bounds, with the reheating-stage nonlinear MHD evolution serving as a crucial ingredient for producing observationally compatible magnetic fields.

papers.title: Blast.jl: Differentiable Non-Limber Power Spectra for Joint Clustering, Shear, and CMB lensing Analyses
papers.abstract: Upcoming large-scale structure surveys require accurate theoretical predictions for angular power spectra on the largest angular scales, where the commonly used Limber approximation breaks down and multiple relativistic and observational effects become relevant. At the same time, modern cosmological analyses increasingly rely on gradient-based inference techniques, motivating the development of fast, fully differentiable algorithms. In this work, we present a major extension of Blast.jl, a numerical toolkit for the efficient computation of non-Limber angular power spectra. Building on the Chebyshev-polynomial decomposition of the original framework, the updated algorithm incorporates redshift-space distortions, magnification bias, primordial non-Gaussianity, intrinsic alignments, CMB lensing, and the integrated Sachs-Wolfe effect, while remaining fully differentiable through custom automatic differentiation rules. Despite the increased physical complexity, the algorithm retains favorable scaling by precomputing all cosmology-independent quantities. We validate the expanded framework against brute-force integration and established cosmological codes, and provide a detailed analysis of the trade-off between computational speed and precision as a function of the algorithm hyperparameters. We demonstrate the readiness of Blast.jl for gradient-based inference through a simulated likelihood analysis with LSST Y10-like mock data, recovering unbiased cosmological and nuisance parameter constraints from a 35-parameter model using gradient-based samplers.

analysis.title_zh: Blast.jl：用于联合聚类、剪切和 CMB 透镜分析的可微非 Limber 功率谱
analysis.summary_zh: 本文扩展 Blast.jl，用于联合星系聚类、弱透镜剪切和 CMB 透镜分析中的非 Limber 角功率谱快速可微计算。摘要称其在 Chebyshev 多项式分解框架上加入多种相对论和观测效应，并通过与直接积分、成熟宇宙学代码和 LSST Y10 类模拟似然分析进行验证，展示了对 35 参数模型的梯度推断能力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 透镜与大尺度结构的联合分析越来越依赖全协方差、多探针和梯度采样；在大角尺度上 Limber 近似失效，ISW、放大偏差和原初非高斯性等效应又可能影响宇宙学约束。若该工具的精度和梯度稳定性成立，它可直接服务于 LSST、CMB lensing 与低红移结构数据的联合参数推断。
key_points: 面向大尺度角功率谱的非 Limber 精确计算。
纳入 CMB 透镜、ISW、红移空间畸变、放大偏差、本征排列等效应。
强调可微分实现和梯度采样，适配未来联合宇宙学分析。
methods: Chebyshev-polynomial decomposition
non-Limber angular power spectra computation
custom automatic differentiation rules
precomputing cosmology-independent quantities
validation against brute-force integration and established cosmological codes
simulated likelihood analysis with LSST Y10-like mock data
gradient-based samplers
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：非 Limber 计算在最低多极和宽/窄红移核下的精度如何随超参数变化；CMB lensing、ISW 与各类 LSS 系统效应的符号约定和核函数实现是否与常用代码一致；自动微分梯度是否经过有限差分或独立实现验证。

papers.title: Dark Matter Halo Tumbling Induced by Torques from Massive Mergers
papers.abstract: Dark Matter halos exhibit slow tumbling known as `figure rotation'. Figure rotation occurs in roughly $80\%$ of isolated $Λ$CDM halos and is relatively unaffected by baryonic feedback, making it an attractive and relatively unexplored test for $Λ$CDM. However, galaxy mergers are capable of exerting strong torques on a host halo's quadrupole, warranting an investigation of whether such interactions are capable of influencing figure rotation. Using isolated $N-$body simulations and 6 TNG50 halos containing MW analog galaxies, we investigate figure rotation in the context of massive mergers. For isolated galaxies we find that massive mergers elicit rotation of the host halo in both a rapid transient phase during the satellite infall with pattern speeds between $10^\circ-60^\circ$ Gyr$^{-1}$, and post-merger as a steady tumbling with pattern speeds between $2^\circ-40^\circ$ Gyr$^{-1}$ lasting for at least $6-8$ Gyr. Both transient and long-lived tumbling depend on the trajectory of the infalling satellite. We find that figure rotation can be induced by radial mergers with no orbital angular momentum, suggesting that tidal torques from the satellite are a driving mechanism. Meanwhile, TNG50 halos show quadrupole tumbling modified during major mergers in both pattern speed (3/6 halos) and rotation axis orientation (6/6 halos). Quadrupole tumbling remains stable after the last major merger in 5 of our 6 halos. Our results suggest that, rather than tracing the early tidal shear, figure rotation at present day may instead retain a dynamical memory of a halo's last major merger.
papers.comment: 23 pages and 14 figures, accepted to ApJ

analysis.title_zh: 大质量并合的力矩诱导暗物质晕翻滚
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究大质量星系并合是否会通过力矩影响暗物质晕的 figure rotation。摘要报告，孤立 N 体模拟和 6 个 TNG50 银河系类似星系晕均显示并合可触发或改变四极矩翻滚，包括短暂快速相位和持续数 Gyr 的并合后翻滚。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质晕形状与动力学是 ΛCDM 结构形成的重要检验；若现今 figure rotation 主要记忆最近主并合而非早期潮汐剪切，则用晕翻滚测试 ΛCDM 或连接星系动力学时，需要显式考虑并合历史。它与 CMB 的联系是间接的：CMB 约束初始条件和 ΛCDM 参数，而该工作检验这些初始条件经非线性结构形成后的暗物质晕动力学预言。
key_points: 大质量并合可通过潮汐力矩改变暗物质晕的四极矩翻滚。
孤立 N 体模拟中，并合触发短暂快速相位和并合后的长期稳态翻滚。
TNG50 的银河系类似星系样本显示主并合会改变翻滚速度或旋转轴取向。
methods: 孤立 N 体模拟
6 个包含银河系类似星系的 TNG50 暗物质晕
暗物质晕四极矩 figure rotation / pattern speed 分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 figure rotation 的测量定义、四极矩主轴追踪方法、并合轨道参数如何控制结果，以及 6 个 TNG50 晕的小样本是否足以支持“现今翻滚记忆最后一次主并合”的解释。

papers.title: Tremaine-Gunn Control: Evading Bounds on Light Fermion Dark Matter
papers.abstract: Pauli exclusion is often regarded as imposing a model-independent lower bound on the mass of fermionic dark matter in galaxies. We show that dark-sector interactions can substantially weaken this conclusion. In particular, eV-scale fermions can form bound structures with the characteristic sizes and densities of dwarf galaxies, thereby circumventing the conventional Tremaine-Gunn mass constraint. Within these objects, the degeneracy pressure is balanced by an attractive finite-range scalar Yukawa force that is significantly stronger than gravity. The interaction acts on dwarf-galaxy scales while remaining screened on larger scales. We derive the evolution of the resulting dark-matter fluid and identify a viable cosmological history in which structures first form gravitationally, with the new interaction becoming active only at late times. As a proof of concept, we construct a model in which a single late-time phase transition generates the required dynamics. These results provide a new route to exceptionally light fermionic dark matter and demonstrate that dark-sector interactions can qualitatively alter conventional phase-space limits.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures; 9 pages of Supplemental Material with 2 figures

analysis.title_zh: Tremaine-Gunn 控制：规避轻费米子暗物质的界限
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论暗部门相互作用如何使轻费米子暗物质避开传统 Tremaine-Gunn 相空间质量下限。摘要称，eV 量级费米子可借助强于引力且有限程的标量 Yukawa 吸引力形成矮星系尺度束缚结构，并给出晚期相变触发该动力学的概念验证模型。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Tremaine-Gunn 界限常被用于排除过轻的费米子暗物质候选体；若暗部门自相互作用能定性改变该界限，将影响小尺度结构、矮星系暗物质解释和粒子暗物质模型空间。对 CMB 研究而言，它的关键在于这类晚期相互作用和轻暗物质历史必须与 CMB 对早期宇宙成分、自由流和扰动演化的约束相容。
key_points: 暗部门相互作用可削弱传统 Tremaine-Gunn 费米子暗物质质量下限。
eV 量级费米子可在强于引力的有限程标量 Yukawa 吸引力下形成类似矮星系的束缚结构。
摘要提出一种晚期相变作为概念验证，使新相互作用在晚期才变得活跃。
methods: 暗物质流体演化推导
有限程标量 Yukawa 相互作用模型
晚期相变概念验证模型
Tremaine-Gunn 相空间约束分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对新相互作用的筛蔽机制、晚期激活的宇宙学历史是否与结构形成和大尺度观测相容，以及绕开 Tremaine-Gunn 约束是否依赖特定模型假设而非真正模型无关。

papers.title: Primordial Black Hole Assisted Dirac Leptogenesis
papers.abstract: Dirac leptogenesis offers a qualitatively different route to the baryon asymmetry: total lepton number is conserved, but equal and opposite asymmetries are stored in the Standard Model and right handed neutrino sectors, with only the visible component processed by electroweak sphalerons. We present the first dedicated study of how evaporating primordial black holes (PBHs) modify this mechanism. In a minimal charged-scalar mediator setup, we solve the coupled Boltzmann system including thermal production, Hawking emission of the mediator $X$ and of right handed neutrinos, the PBH contribution to the expansion rate, and entropy injection. We find that Hawking emission can populate $X$ in regions where thermal production is inefficient, allowing its subsequent CP-violating decays to enhance the baryon asymmetry. For representative benchmarks, PBHs extend the successful region from mediator masses around $10^9\,{\rm GeV}$ down to about $10^6\,{\rm GeV}$ and can compensate for smaller effective CP asymmetries. This effect is not universal: where thermal Dirac leptogenesis is already efficient, PBHs can instead reduce the final asymmetry. Their evaporation also deposits energy in the right handed neutrino sector and contributes to $ΔN_{\rm eff}$. In the PBH parameter scan, part of the region that reproduces the observed baryon asymmetry lies below the Planck reference level $ΔN_{\rm eff}=0.284$ and above the projected CMB-S4 sensitivity $ΔN_{\rm eff}=0.06$.

analysis.title_zh: 原初黑洞辅助的 Dirac 轻子生成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究蒸发原初黑洞如何改变 Dirac 轻子生成机制，在带电标量媒介的最小模型中求解包含热产生、Hawking 发射、PBH 对膨胀率贡献和熵注入的耦合 Boltzmann 方程。摘要称 PBH 可在部分热产生不足区域增强重子不对称、降低可行媒介质量范围，但在热 Dirac 轻子生成已高效时也可能削弱最终不对称，并产生与 ΔN_eff 相关的 CMB 可观测信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 的联系主要通过有效相对论自由度 ΔN_eff：蒸发 PBH 向右手中微子部门注入能量，可能留下 CMB-S4 灵敏度可检验的辐射成分信号。它也把早期宇宙重子不对称、PBH 蒸发和中微子暗辐射约束联系起来，属于粒子宇宙学与 CMB 参数约束的交叉问题。
key_points: 研究蒸发原初黑洞对 Dirac 轻子生成的影响。
Boltzmann 系统包括 Hawking 发射、膨胀率贡献和熵注入。
摘要报告部分成功参数区会产生 CMB-S4 可探测的 ΔN_eff。
methods: coupled Boltzmann system
thermal production
Hawking emission of mediator X and right handed neutrinos
PBH contribution to expansion rate
entropy injection
PBH parameter scan
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：PBH 质量和丰度先验、蒸发历程及灰体因子的处理；右手中微子能量沉积如何转化为 ΔN_eff；所谓成功重子不对称区域与 BBN、CMB 和 PBH 约束是否同时相容。

papers.title: Axion Quality from Exact Proton Stability
papers.abstract: A discrete, anomaly-free $\mathbb Z_9$ gauge symmetry may persist to the deep infrared, exactly forbidding proton decay. This $\mathbb Z_9$ can emerge from Higgsing a lepton-flavour non-universal $U(1)_X$ that generates realistic neutrino masses and mixings through a high-scale seesaw and predicts an additional light Goldstone. Adding an anomaly-free chiral heavy-quark sector turns this mode into the QCD axion. The same selection rules that ban proton decay also forbid PQ-violating operators below a suitably high dimension, $d_{\rm PQ}\gtrsim10$, including operators involving the heavy quarks that radiatively match onto the scalar potential. We construct explicit models viable when PQ breaking occurs before or after inflation; in the latter case, avoiding stable heavy relics and eliminating the string-wall network tightly constrain the heavy-quark spectrum. We identify restricted regions of parameter space where thermal leptogenesis remains viable and, for $d_{\rm PQ}\geq13$, can coexist with a high-quality axion constituting all of the dark matter.

analysis.title_zh: 来自精确质子稳定性的轴子质量保护
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出用精确质子稳定性的离散规范对称性来解决轴子质量问题。摘要称，无反常 Z9 可由轻子味非普适 U(1)_X 破缺产生，在加入手征重夸克后给出 QCD 轴子，并在足够高维才允许 PQ 破坏算符的模型中兼容轴子暗物质和受限区域内的热轻子生成。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 轴子既可解决强 CP 问题又是重要暗物质候选体，但 PQ 对称性的质量问题会影响其理论可信度；该文把质子稳定性、中微子质量、轻子生成和轴子暗物质联系在同一选择定则下。与 CMB/宇宙学的关系在于轴子暗物质丰度、PQ 破缺相对暴胀的时序、拓扑缺陷以及热轻子生成都会影响早期宇宙历史，并需与 CMB 所约束的暗物质密度和辐射/扰动演化相容。
key_points: 一个离散无反常 Z9 规范对称性可精确禁止质子衰变。
加入无反常手征重夸克扇区后，额外轻 Goldstone 模式可成为 QCD 轴子。
相同选择定则可抑制低维 PQ 破坏算符，并在特定参数区允许高质量轴子构成全部暗物质。
methods: 离散无反常 Z9 规范对称性构造
由轻子味非普适 U(1)_X Higgsing 得到低能对称性
高尺度 seesaw 中微子质量机制
无反常手征重夸克扇区
PQ 破坏算符维度与热轻子生成可行性分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对异常抵消、Z9 对所有危险质子衰变与 PQ 破坏算符的选择定则、重夸克遗迹和弦-畴壁网络处理，以及热轻子生成与轴子暗物质参数区是否同时满足宇宙学约束。

papers.title: JWST Reveals a Candidate Supermassive Black Hole Binary at z=4.3 in the Brightest Sub-millimeter Galaxy in COSMOS-Web
papers.abstract: We present JWST/NIRSpec PRISM and G395M grating spectroscopy for AzTEC-1, a massive sub-mm bright galaxy at $z=4.34$ in the COSMOS extragalactic field. The PRISM spectrum reveals strong H$α$, a significant Balmer break, and no H$β$ detection, indicating a $100-400$ Myr-old stellar population and high dust attenuation. BPT line ratios indicate the presence of an Active Galactic Nucleus (AGN). Decomposing narrow and broad line components, we recover broad, blueshifted H$α$ with a velocity offset of $1245{\,\rm km\,s^{-1}}$ from the systemic narrow line velocity and with FWHM$\,\sim2500\,{\rm km\,s^{-1}}$. AzTEC-1's smooth morphology and stellar age is suggestive of a past merger-induced starburst period that would have brought in a second supermassive black hole, raising the possibility for a binary supermassive black hole system. In this scenario, we assume that the lower mass black hole hosts a broad line region orbiting a quiescent primary. Evidence for an extended outflow is not found in the 2D spectrum, NIRCam imaging, resolved ALMA observations of dust continuum, or CO, [C II]$_{157\,μ\rm m}$ and [N II]$_{\rm 205\,μm}$ kinematics. AzTEC-1's high central gas mass surface density and dynamically unstable gas disk indicates that massive gas clouds external to the candidate binary SMBH's orbit might have played a role in stalling infall from $\sim10$ Myr to $\sim100$ Myr through dynamical torques, which has been theorized to occur in the nuclei of massive galaxies like AzTEC-1. If the supermassive black hole binary is confirmed, AzTEC-1 would be an excellent laboratory into the astrophysics driving low-frequency gravitational wave detections.

analysis.title_zh: JWST 在 COSMOS-Web 最亮亚毫米星系中揭示 z=4.3 的候选超大质量黑洞双星
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 JWST/NIRSpec 观测 COSMOS-Web 中 z=4.34 的明亮亚毫米星系 AzTEC-1，报告强 Hα、明显 Balmer break、无 Hβ 探测以及 BPT 线比显示 AGN。通过线成分分解，作者发现相对系统窄线速度显著蓝移的宽 Hα，并在未见扩展外流证据的基础上提出候选超大质量黑洞双星解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于高红移星系和黑洞形成演化研究；若候选双超大质量黑洞得到确认，将关系到低频引力波源族群和早期宇宙并合历史。对 CMB 研究者而言，它不是直接的 CMB 观测论文，但与宇宙结构形成、星系并合、早期黑洞增长以及未来引力波宇宙学的背景模型有关。
key_points: JWST/NIRSpec 光谱显示 AzTEC-1 具有 AGN 线比特征和宽、蓝移的 Hα 成分。
作者将该宽线解释为候选超大质量黑洞双星情景的一种可能性，而非已确认结论。
摘要称多种成像、光谱和运动学资料未发现扩展外流证据。
methods: JWST/NIRSpec PRISM 光谱
JWST/NIRSpec G395M grating 光谱
BPT 线比诊断
窄线与宽线成分分解
NIRCam 成像
ALMA 尘埃连续谱观测
CO、[C II]157 μm 和 [N II]205 μm 运动学
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对宽、蓝移 Hα 成分为何更支持双超大质量黑洞而非外流、复杂窄线结构或其他 AGN 宽线区几何；同时检查系统红移、线分解模型和多波段非外流证据之间是否自洽。

papers.title: TeV Higgsino Dark Matter from LZ Nuclear Recoil to Fermi-LAT Gamma Rays
papers.abstract: The Higgsino dark matter of the minimal supersymmetric standard model is one of the most minimal and canonical WIMP candidates. We demonstrate that this classic candidate can account for both the high-energy nuclear-recoil excess reported by the LZ experiment and the mild preference in the 14 years of FermiLAT Galactic-center data, with the relic abundance fixing the Higgsino dark matter mass near 1.1 TeV and the recoil spectrum selecting a mass splitting of a few hundred keV. Together with the 10-year IceCube solar-neutrino constraint, the Higgsino interpretation further pins down a viable region of parameter space. It predicts a Galactic-center gamma-ray line and endpoint signal near the present H.E.S.S. sensitivity and within CTAO's projected reach, making this classic candidate testable in the near future.

analysis.title_zh: 从 LZ 核反冲到 Fermi-LAT 伽马射线的 TeV Higgsino 暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论最小超对称标准模型中的 TeV 级 Higgsino 暗物质，声称它可同时解释 LZ 实验报告的高能核反冲 excess 和 14 年 Fermi-LAT 银心数据中的温和偏好。摘要称热遗迹丰度将质量固定在约 1.1 TeV，反冲谱选择几百 keV 的质量劈裂，并在 IceCube 太阳中微子约束下得到可检验参数区。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文属于粒子宇宙学暗物质方向，与 CMB 的联系主要在于热遗迹丰度、早期宇宙粒子成分和暗物质湮灭/散射性质。它不是直接 CMB 分析，但若 Higgsino 湮灭截面或能量注入历史可被限定，原则上会与 CMB 对暗物质湮灭和宇宙物质密度的约束形成互补。
key_points: TeV 级 Higgsino 被用来同时解释 LZ 核反冲异常与 Fermi-LAT 银心数据中的温和偏好。
热遗迹丰度将暗物质质量固定在约 1.1 TeV，反冲谱偏好几百 keV 的质量劈裂。
摘要称该情景还受到 IceCube 太阳中微子约束，并预言可由 H.E.S.S./CTAO 检验的银心伽马线和端点信号。
methods: 最小超对称标准模型中的 Higgsino 暗物质解释
LZ 高能核反冲数据
14 年 Fermi-LAT 银心数据
10 年 IceCube 太阳中微子约束
与 H.E.S.S. 灵敏度和 CTAO 预期可达性比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：LZ 反冲 excess 与 Fermi-LAT 银心偏好的联合拟合是否处理了各自背景和系统误差；IceCube 约束与直接探测、间接探测之间的参数映射是否一致；所谓近未来可检验的伽马线/端点信号是否依赖特定晕模型或湮灭截面假设。

papers.title: Higgsino Dark Matter Interpretation of the LUX-ZEPLIN 248 keV Nuclear-Recoil Event
papers.abstract: We propose Higgsino dark matter as a potential interpretation of the $248~\mathrm{keV}$ nuclear-recoil event of interest reported by the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) experiment. LZ studied several rare background processes and detector effects in detail, but did not identify any as a likely explanation of the event. A nearly pure Higgsino with mass $m_{\widetilde H}\sim1~\mathrm{TeV}$ naturally realizes inelastic dark matter through the off-diagonal $Z$ coupling of two nearly degenerate neutral Majorana states separated by a mass splitting $δ$. The same electroweak interaction fixes the inelastic Higgsino-nucleon scattering cross section, rather than leaving it as a free parameter. We show that the predicted Higgsino inelastic scattering cross section approaches the published LZ two-sided 90% confidence interval for $δ\sim350~\mathrm{keV}$.

analysis.title_zh: LUX-ZEPLIN 248 keV 核反冲事件的 Higgsino 暗物质解释
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出近纯 Higgsino 暗物质可作为 LUX-ZEPLIN 实验报告的 248 keV 核反冲关注事件的一种解释。摘要称，约 1 TeV 的 Higgsino 通过两个近简并中性 Majorana 态的非对角 Z 耦合自然给出非弹性暗物质散射，且在质量劈裂 δ≈350 keV 时，预言的 Higgsino-核子非弹性散射截面接近 LZ 公开的双侧 90% 置信区间。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文主要属于暗物质直接探测和粒子宇宙学，而非 CMB 专题。它与宇宙学的联系在于暗物质候选体的性质会影响宇宙暗物质图景，但摘要未涉及 CMB 各向异性、早期宇宙能量注入或 CMB 对暗物质的直接约束。
key_points: 提出用约 1 TeV 的近纯 Higgsino 暗物质解释 LZ 的 248 keV 核反冲事件。
机制依赖两个近简并中性 Majorana 态之间的非弹性散射。
摘要称 δ≈350 keV 时预言截面接近 LZ 公开的双侧 90% 置信区间。
methods: LUX-ZEPLIN 248 keV 核反冲事件解释
近纯 Higgsino 暗物质模型
非弹性暗物质散射
利用 LZ 公开双侧 90% 置信区间进行比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该单一事件解释对局域暗物质速度分布、Higgsino 质量劈裂 δ、探测效率和背景建模的依赖，以及与其他直接探测和宇宙学暗物质丰度约束是否相容。

papers.title: Enabling gravitational-wave astronomy with spin-precessing black holes on generic orbits
papers.abstract: Binary black holes (BBHs) formed in dense stellar environments or in hierarchical triples can coalesce on eccentric orbits and carry spins of arbitrary orientation, leaving distinctive imprints on their gravitational-wave (GW) emission. We present SEOBNRv6EPHM: the first generic-orbit, spin-precessing model in the effective-one-body SEOBNR family, whose waveforms have underpinned LIGO-Virgo GW analyses since 2011. The model describes the dynamics and multipolar GW signal of generic BBHs, covering the inspiral-merger-ringdown of coalescing binaries and extending to dynamical captures and scattering encounters. We perform the first systematic accuracy assessment of a generic-orbit model against numerical relativity (NR) waveforms of spin-precessing BBHs, using 1437 quasi-circular (QC) and 87 eccentric simulations: median waveform mismatches remain below $1 \%$, matching the accuracy of the QC model SEOBNRv5PHM, and improving on the state-of-the-art generic-orbit model TEOBResumS-Dalí by a median factor of $ 4 $. The model also reproduces the non-perturbative phenomenology observed in NR simulations of generic-spin BBH scattering. It is $\sim 2 - 3$ times faster than SEOBNRv5PHM in the QC limit, and up to an order of magnitude faster than TEOBResumS-Dalí, bringing eccentric inference to the cost of current QC analyses. As a proof of principle, we analyze eleven GW events and focus on GW200129, strengthening its evidence for eccentricity $-$ a result supported by injection-recovery studies with synthetic NR signals of eccentric, spin-precessing BBHs. SEOBNRv6EPHM thus enables, for the first time, accurate and efficient GW analyses that jointly account for eccentricity and spin precession.

analysis.title_zh: 用泛轨道自旋进动黑洞实现引力波天文学
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 SEOBNRv6EPHM，一个用于偏心、散射、动力学俘获及自旋进动双黑洞的泛轨道有效一体波形模型。摘要称该模型在大量准圆和偏心数值相对论波形上达到中位 mismatch 低于 1%，速度优于若干现有模型，并可用于联合考虑偏心率和自旋进动的引力波参数推断。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要面向引力波宇宙学和强引力天体物理，并非 CMB 论文。它对宇宙学的意义在于改进双黑洞事件的参数推断和族群建模，进而影响利用引力波标准汽笛、黑洞形成通道和致密天体并合率来约束宇宙学与结构形成历史的可靠性。
key_points: 提出 SEOBNR 家族中首个泛轨道、自旋进动的有效一体模型 SEOBNRv6EPHM。
摘要报告其与数值相对论波形比较时中位 mismatch 低于 1%，并提升了相对 TEOBResumS-Dalí 的效率和精度。
作为示例分析 11 个引力波事件，并特别讨论 GW200129 的偏心率证据。
methods: 有效一体理论 SEOBNR 波形建模
泛轨道、自旋进动双黑洞动力学与多极引力波信号
与 1437 个准圆轨道和 87 个偏心数值相对论模拟比较
波形 mismatch 精度评估
11 个引力波事件分析
偏心、自旋进动双黑洞数值相对论合成信号的 injection-recovery 测试
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对泛轨道参数空间覆盖范围、数值相对论校准样本的代表性、mismatch 统计所用噪声曲线和质量/自旋分布，以及 GW200129 偏心率证据对波形模型先验和选择效应的敏感性。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves from Reheating beyond Instantaneous Thermalization
papers.abstract: We study gravitational-wave production during perturbative reheating without assuming instantaneous thermalization of the inflaton decay products. The injected energetic particles thermalize through an in-medium cascade of nearly collinear splittings subject to the Landau-Pomeranchuk-Migdal effect and are ultimately isotropized by elastic scatterings near the thermal scale. The non-thermal hard population present before complete thermalization produces an additional gravitational-wave component through hard-soft scatterings, with $Ω_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto f^{1/2}$ below the injection-scale turnover. The same isotropization erases the directional information underlying the vacuum $1/k$ bremsstrahlung soft pole, changing the deep-infrared spectrum from $Ω_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto f$ to $Ω_{\mathrm{GW}}\propto f^3$.

analysis.title_zh: 非瞬时热化情形下再加热产生的引力波
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究微扰再加热期间的引力波产生，重点是不假设 inflaton 衰变产物会瞬时热化。摘要称，非热硬粒子在完全热化前通过硬-软散射产生额外引力波分量，使注入尺度转折以下出现 Ω_GW∝f^{1/2}，而各向同性化会把深红外谱从 Ω_GW∝f 改为 Ω_GW∝f^3。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再加热时期的随机引力波背景可作为早期宇宙热史和粒子相互作用的探针，虽然它不是 CMB 本身，但会影响对暴胀后历史、有效自由度和早期宇宙能量注入的理解。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类工作有助于连接暴胀末期、再加热动力学与可能的多信使宇宙学约束。
key_points: 研究微扰再加热阶段的引力波产生。
显式放弃 inflaton 衰变产物瞬时热化假设。
摘要报告非热硬粒子成分会改变引力波谱的低频标度。

介质中近共线劈裂级联
Landau-Pomeranchuk-Migdal 效应

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对非瞬时热化过程的时间尺度、硬-软散射源项以及各向同性化如何消除真空 bremsstrahlung 软极点的推导是否自洽，并确认谱指数结论适用的频段边界。

papers.title: Energy deposited by black holes in the hot X-ray gas of elliptical galaxies, groups and clusters
papers.abstract: Galaxy groups show entropy excesses $ΔS$ with respect to theoretical expectations from models and simulations with purely gravitational heating. We determine the heat $Q_{\rm heat}\simeq TΔS$ deposited by non-gravitational sources into the hot gas of elliptical galaxies, groups and clusters, and to compare it with the energy output of their central black holes (BHs). We adopt a simple model for the hot gas with only one free parameter: the core entropy. We calibrate the core entropy on the observed relation between X-ray luminosity and halo mass, and we use it to determine the entropy $S$ of the hot gas. We determine $ΔS=S-S_0$ by taking the difference between $S$ and the entropy $S_0$ found in cosmological adiabatic simulations for haloes of the same mass. The temperature $T$ of the hot gas during the heating phase is determined from semi-analytic/semi-empirical modelling by assuming that heat absorption traces the accretion histories of supermassive BHs. Our findings suggest that supermassive BHs thermalise 1 to $3\%$ of their energy output in the surrounding gas. Our results suggest two regimes: (i) in elliptical galaxies and groups, active galactic nuclei (AGN) heat the gas much more rapidly than it can cool, generating the observed entropy excesses and quenching star formation when the accumulated heat is large enough to unbind the gas reservoir in the host halo; (ii) in galaxy clusters (at $M_{200}>10^{14}{\rm\,M}_\odot$), heating and cooling are in self-regulated equilibrium.
papers.comment: 13 pages (+4 pages of Appendix); accepted for publication in A&A

analysis.title_zh: 黑洞向椭圆星系、星系群和星系团的热 X 射线气体沉积的能量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文估算椭圆星系、星系群和星系团热 X 射线气体相对于纯引力加热预期的熵超额，并由 Q_heat≈TΔS 推断非引力热输入，再与中心黑洞能量输出比较。摘要称超大质量黑洞约有 1 到 3% 的能量输出热化到周围气体中，并提出低质量系统中 AGN 加热可快速产生熵超额、星系团中则与冷却自调节平衡。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于星系团/星系形成反馈研究，与 CMB 的关系较间接。它对宇宙学的相关性在于星系团气体热史和 AGN 反馈会影响星系团质量-可观测量关系、热 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 信号建模以及利用星系团进行宇宙学参数约束时的系统误差。
key_points: 用热气体熵超额估算非引力热输入。
将热输入与中心超大质量黑洞能量输出比较。
摘要报告椭圆星系/星系群与星系团呈现不同反馈状态。
methods: 单自由参数热气体模型，参数为核心熵
用 X 射线光度-晕质量观测关系校准核心熵
与宇宙学绝热模拟中的同质量晕熵 S0 比较
半解析/半经验模型估计加热阶段气体温度
假设热吸收追踪超大质量黑洞吸积历史
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对核心熵校准、Q_heat≈TΔS 的近似、黑洞吸积史与热吸收相追踪的假设，以及 1-3% 热化效率是否强依赖样本或模型选择。

papers.title: Gravitational-wave signatures of primordial black hole clusters and the imprint of an early dense-core collapse
papers.abstract: Primordial black holes (PBHs) are expected to be born essentially non-spinning and, if the primordial curvature fluctuations possess non-Gaussian tails, strongly clustered. Any spin measured in a PBH population must therefore be dynamically generated. Using direct $N$-body simulations with \textsc{nbody6++gpu}, modified to treat nearly parabolic dynamical-capture mergers, we quantify the conditions under which an initially non-spinning PBH cluster develops the spin, mass and stochastic-background signatures that gravitational-wave observations are now sensitive to. We find a sharp tension: producing a root-mean-square spin $χ_{\rm rms}\sim0.1 - 0.2$ in the $30 - 50\,M_\odot$ range requires initial Plummer radii of order $10^{-5}\,{\rm pc}$, whereas survival over cosmological times requires parsec-scale clusters. This tension is resolved naturally if PBHs form with a compact, short-lived core embedded in an extended halo, and we therefore simulate the two regimes as independent blocks. The core block ($4000$ PBHs, Plummer radii $3\times10^{-6} - 10^{-4}\,{\rm pc}$) collapses in days to years, producing a burst of mergers whose orbits are strongly non-circular ($e\to1$) and of low dimensionless orbital angular momentum, so that remnant spins are systematically below the quasi-circular value $χ\simeq0.7$. Redshifted from their formation epoch, the core mergers deposit a stochastic background peaking in the $10^{-6}$--$10^{-4}\,{\rm Hz}$ band accessible to LISA. The picture predicts a specific division of labour between observables, spins set in the primordial collapse, detectable mergers set by the long-term halo, and a two-component stochastic background, and, in particular, that both the spin and the mass data favour a primordial mass function truncated near $50\,M_\odot$.

analysis.title_zh: 原初黑洞团簇的引力波特征与早期致密核坍缩的印记
analysis.summary_zh: 该文研究强团簇原初黑洞若初生几乎无自旋，何时能通过动力学并合产生当前引力波观测可探测的自旋、质量和随机背景特征。摘要称直接 N 体模拟显示，生成较大均方根自旋所需的极紧致团簇与宇宙学时间存活所需的秒差距尺度团簇存在张力，并提出早期短寿命致密核心嵌入扩展晕的两阶段图像来解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要面向原初黑洞暗物质和引力波宇宙学，而非直接 CMB 观测；但 PBH 的形成通常与早期曲率扰动及其非高斯尾有关，因此其质量函数、团簇性和随机引力波背景可作为补充 CMB 的早期宇宙探针。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键联系在于它把小尺度原初扰动的非高斯结构与可观测的引力波背景、黑洞自旋和质量分布联系起来。
key_points: 初始无自旋 PBH 团簇可通过动力学并合生成自旋、质量和随机背景信号。
摘要强调紧致早期核坍缩与长期存活晕之间的两阶段图像。
预言 LISA 频段随机背景及自旋、质量数据对约 50 太阳质量附近截断的原初质量函数有偏好。
methods: 使用修改版 \textsc{nbody6++gpu} 的直接 N 体模拟
处理近抛物线动力学俘获并合
模拟核心块：4000 个 PBH，Plummer 半径 3×10^-6 至 10^-4 pc
将形成时期核心并合信号红移到观测频段
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对两阶段“紧致核心+扩展晕”分块模拟是否能自洽连接同一 PBH 形成场景，以及随机背景、质量函数截断和自旋分布对初始条件与并合处理细节的敏感性。

papers.title: AGN X-ray coronae at high luminosity: A broadband study of RBS 229 and PG 1407+265
papers.abstract: Context. The X-ray emission of active galactic nuclei (AGNs) is commonly interpreted as arising from Comptonisation in a hot corona above the accretion disc. A prominent soft X-ray excess is also observed in many sources and is often explained by a warm Comptonising layer. Aims. We investigate the X-ray-emitting coronae of the luminous radio-quiet quasars PG 1407+265 ($z=0.94$) and RBS 229 ($z=0.334$), testing whether a two-corona scenario consistently describes their broadband spectra. Methods. We combine XMM-Newton EPIC and Optical Monitor data with simultaneous NuSTAR observations and long-term Swift monitoring, and model the spectra using Comptonisation models. Results. Both quasars are X-ray loud relative to the standard $α_{\rm OX}$-$L_{\rm UV}$ relation, with PG 1407+265 showing the strongest deviation. Their spectra are well reproduced by a warm, optically thick Comptonising component accounting for the soft excess and a hot corona producing the hard X-ray continuum. Both sources show high-energy cut-offs at approximately 70-80 keV. RBS 229 exhibits moderate reflection and a weak neutral Fe K-alpha line, while no significant reflection features are detected in PG 1407+265. The warm-corona parameters of RBS 229 remain consistent across epochs, whereas PG 1407+265 shows strong variability, including an extreme soft-excess episode extending to approximately 3 keV in the rest frame. Conclusions. These results constrain AGN coronae in the poorly explored high-luminosity regime. The cut-offs are broadly consistent with trends in AGN luminosity and accretion rate and remain below the runaway pair-production limit. The contrasting variability suggests that the warm corona responds to changes in the accretion flow while remaining within a narrow range of physical conditions.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, accepted for publication in Astronomy & Astrophysics

analysis.title_zh: 高光度 AGN 的 X 射线冕：RBS 229 与 PG 1407+265 的宽波段研究
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 XMM-Newton、NuSTAR 和 Swift 数据研究高光度射电宁静类星体 PG 1407+265 与 RBS 229 的宽波段谱，检验暖冕加热冕的两冕图像。摘要称两者均相对标准 αOX-LUV 关系偏 X 射线亮，谱可由软超额的暖 Compton 化和硬 X 射线热冕解释，并显示约 70-80 keV 的高能截断。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文属于高能天体物理，对 CMB 的直接关联较弱。其宇宙学相关性主要在于类星体和 AGN 的高能辐射物理会影响活动星系核反馈、黑洞吸积历史和多波段巡天源建模；在 CMB 研究中，这类源也可能作为高频前景或点源污染的一部分，需要可靠的谱和变异性认识。
key_points: 研究两个高光度射电宁静类星体 PG 1407+265 与 RBS 229 的 X 射线冕。
宽波段谱可由暖、光学厚 Compton 化软超额成分和热冕硬 X 射线连续谱共同描述。
两源均显示约 70-80 keV 的高能截断，但反射特征和变异性表现不同。
methods: XMM-Newton EPIC 数据
XMM-Newton Optical Monitor 数据
同时 NuSTAR 观测

papers.title: First tomographic measurements of the angular clustering and bias of photometric quasars from S-PLUS
papers.abstract: We investigate the quasar clustering in the QuCatS photometric catalog, constructed from the fourth data release of the Southern Photometric Local Universe Survey (S-PLUS). The quasar sample for this study consists of $23,402$ quasars, spanning the redshift interval $1.1 \leq z_{\rm phot} \leq 2.6$, which we divided into four bins for our tomographic analyses. In each bin, we measured the two-point angular correlation function and compared it with theoretical predictions for the clustering of dark matter in the flat-$Λ$CDM cosmological model. We then estimate the effective linear bias in each bin that best fits the data, obtaining $b_{Q}(z_{\rm eff}=1.26)=2.17^{+0.30}_{-0.35}$, $b_{Q}(z_{\rm eff}=1.63)=2.67^{+0.36}_{-0.42}$, $b_{Q}(z_{\rm eff}=2.04)=3.29^{+0.52}_{-0.62}$, and $b_{Q}(z_{\rm eff}=2.38)=4.05^{+0.71}_{-0.86}$. These measurements are consistent with previous analyses in the literature. Moreover, the evolution of the bias agrees well with the $b(z)$ parameterization proposed by \cite{laurent2017}. Our measurements constitute the first cosmological study of the tomographic clustering of photometric quasars provided by the S-PLUS dataset, contributing to the mapping of the evolution of linear bias and paving the way for future analyses of data releases with larger datasets. In addition, our study also serves as a consistency test for the calibration procedure of the photometric redshift probability distributions of the quasars in the QuCatS catalog.

analysis.title_zh: S-PLUS 光度类星体角聚类与偏置的首次断层测量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 S-PLUS QuCatS 光度类星体的 tomographic 角聚类，在四个光度红移分箱中测量两点角相关函数，并与平直 ΛCDM 下暗物质聚类预测比较以拟合有效线性偏置。摘要报告得到的偏置随红移升高，与既有文献及 Laurent 等提出的 b(z) 参数化一致，并作为 QuCatS 光度红移概率分布校准的一项一致性检验。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 类星体角聚类和线性偏置是连接大尺度结构示踪体与暗物质分布的关键量，可用于检验 ΛCDM 框架下结构增长和高红移示踪体建模。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类 tomographic 偏置测量有助于未来与 CMB lensing、ISW 或大尺度结构交叉相关分析相结合，降低示踪体偏置和红移分布带来的系统误差。
key_points: 使用 S-PLUS DR4 构建的 QuCatS 光度类星体样本。
按光度红移分成四个 tomographic bin 测量角两点相关函数。
摘要报告线性偏置随红移升高，并与既有文献和 Laurent 等参数化一致。
methods: S-PLUS 第四次数据释放的 QuCatS 光度类星体目录
23,402 个类星体，红移范围 1.1 ≤ z_phot ≤ 2.6

papers.title: Angular power spectrum of induced gravitational waves: breaking model and parameter degeneracies in PTA observations
papers.abstract: Large primordial curvature and tensor perturbations on small scales can generate second-order tensor-scalar induced gravitational waves (TSIGWs) through scalar-scalar, tensor-scalar, and tensor-tensor source terms. TSIGWs are recognized as one of the principal contributors to the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) observations. We explore the energy density spectrum of second-order TSIGWs in the presence of non-Gaussian primordial curvature perturbations. Furthermore, we present the first calculation of the anisotropic angular power spectrum associated with second-order TSIGWs, which provides a promising tool to discriminate them from other SGWB sources.

analysis.title_zh: 诱导引力波的角功率谱：在 PTA 观测中打破模型与参数简并
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究小尺度大幅原初曲率和张量扰动通过二阶源项产生的 tensor-scalar induced gravitational waves，并考察非高斯原初曲率扰动下的能量密度谱。摘要进一步报告首次计算二阶 TSIGW 相关的各向异性角功率谱，提出其可用于在 PTA 随机引力波背景观测中区分不同来源。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初扰动、非高斯性和诱导引力波都与早期宇宙物理密切相关，也是 CMB 原初扰动约束在更小尺度上的延伸。若 PTA 可测的随机引力波背景各向异性能够区分源模型，它将与 CMB 对大尺度曲率扰动、张量扰动和非高斯性的约束形成互补。
key_points: 研究小尺度原初曲率和张量扰动产生的二阶 tensor-scalar induced gravitational waves。
纳入非高斯原初曲率扰动对能量密度谱的影响。
摘要声称首次计算二阶 TSIGW 的各向异性角功率谱，用于区分不同 SGWB 来源。

scalar-scalar、tensor-scalar、tensor-tensor 源项

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对各向异性角功率谱的推导假设、非高斯参数化、源项分解及其与 PTA 可观测角相关量之间的映射，尤其要确认所谓“打破模型和参数简并”的判别能力来自哪些可观测特征。

papers.title: The cosmic multipoles: a consistency test for the Szekeres cosmological model
papers.abstract: Some of the properties of the Szekeres solutions which have never been used in a cosmological context are known for long. In this letter, the total and unique decomposition of its matter energy density into a monopole and dipole moment is recalled and specialized to the axially symmetric quasi-spherical subclass of the model. All the model special features -- axial symmetry, spherical quasi-symmetry, location of the observer -- are observationally justified. Then, a consistency test of the model involving its no-high-multipole-in-mass-density property is proposed.

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙多极矩：Szekeres 宇宙学模型的一致性检验
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 Szekeres 宇宙学模型中长期已知但较少用于宇宙学语境的性质，特别是物质能量密度可完全且唯一地分解为单极和偶极矩。摘要称作者将其用于轴对称准球形子类，并提出一个基于质量密度无高阶多极矩性质的模型一致性检验。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Szekeres 模型是研究非均匀宇宙学的一类精确解，可用于检验超出 FLRW 均匀各向同性假设的结构。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类模型的一致性检验与大尺度各向异性、观测者位置效应以及宇宙学原则的检验相关，但摘要未直接给出 CMB 数据应用。
key_points: 回顾 Szekeres 解的物质能量密度可唯一分解为单极与偶极矩。
将这一性质专门化到轴对称准球形 Szekeres 子类。
提出利用质量密度中不存在高阶多极矩这一性质的模型一致性检验。
methods: Szekeres 宇宙学模型
轴对称准球形子类
物质能量密度的单极/偶极分解
基于无高阶质量密度多极矩性质的一致性检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该一致性检验如何从观测量映射到质量密度多极矩，以及轴对称、准球对称和观测者位置这些假设被“观测支持”的具体论证是否充分。

papers.title: Quantifying Sky Map Resolution Requirements for Beam Chromaticity Correction in Sky-Averaged 21 cm Experiments
papers.abstract: The 21 cm hyperfine transition of neutral hydrogen provides one of the few direct probes of the early cosmic history. High-redshift detections of this signal could shine light on the poorly understood epochs of the Dark Ages and Cosmic Dawn, periods that remain among the least understood in the Universe's history. However, this signal is masked by bright foregrounds and is distorted by the chromaticity of the antenna used to detect it. Correcting for the chromaticity requires an accurate representation of the radio sky across relevant frequencies. However, base sky maps used for this correction, such as instances of the Global Sky Model (GSM), are limited by resolution, calibration and extrapolation uncertainties, especially when scaled to lower frequencies relevant for Cosmic Dawn studies. This work quantifies how accurately the base map must represent the true sky to produce a reliable beam correction. Using simulated sky data, we generate beam chromaticity corrections generated from progressively degraded versions of the base map, and compare how well they do in comparison to a correction based on the full-resolution map. We find that degradation in map resolution of $\sim 1^\circ$ does not introduce measurable increases in the amplitude of the residuals when correcting for the chromaticity and subtracting three different foreground models (two polynomials and a power law expansion). These results provide practical constraints on the required resolution and accuracy of sky models used in beam correction pipelines, informing future design and calibration strategies for global 21 cm experiments, and future efforts to map the low frequency sky.

analysis.title_zh: 量化全天平均 21 cm 实验中波束色度校正对天空图分辨率的要求
analysis.summary_zh: 本文量化全球平均 21 cm 实验中，用于波束色度校正的低频天空基准图需要达到何种分辨率和准确度。作者用模拟天空数据生成逐步降分辨率的基准图校正，并与全分辨率校正比较；摘要报告约 $1^\circ$ 的分辨率退化在扣除三种前景模型后未造成可测的残差幅度增加。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 全球 21 cm 信号是探索黑暗时代和宇宙黎明的重要观测窗口，与 CMB 一样高度依赖前景建模、波束系统学和天空图校准。该研究直接服务于低频前景去除和仪器系统误差控制，对早期宇宙观测与 CMB 互补探针具有方法学意义。
key_points: 全球 21 cm 实验的天线色度会扭曲被强前景掩盖的宇宙信号。
作者用模拟天空图构造不同分辨率退化下的波束色度校正并与全分辨率校正比较。
摘要报告约 $1^\circ$ 的地图分辨率退化在三类前景模型扣除后未带来可测的残差幅度增加。
methods: 模拟天空数据
Global Sky Model 类基准天空图
逐步降低基准图分辨率
波束色度校正
与全分辨率地图校正比较
三种前景模型扣除：两个多项式模型和一个幂律展开
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“未引入可测残差增加”的度量标准、天线波束和天空模拟的代表性，以及结论是否依赖所选前景模型、频段和 GSM 外推误差。

papers.title: A Class of Exact Single-Field Inflationary Solutions beyond Slow Roll
papers.abstract: We construct exact solutions for single-field inflaton dynamics without invoking the slow-roll approximation. A suitable change of variables reduces the background equation to an Abel equation of the first kind. Although a generic Abel equation is not analytically solvable, we identify a class of inflaton potentials for which the transformed equation admits exact solutions. The resulting framework contains constant-roll inflation as a special case and also accommodates solutions with a constant second Hubble-flow parameter. We analyze the linear local attractor behavior and superhorizon evolution of these rolling backgrounds. Using the public joint CMB likelihood contours in the $(n_s,r)$ plane, we identify compatible parameter regions and show that one rolling branch can also yield $50\leq N_*<60$. Direct numerical evolution of the scalar and tensor modes at representative points validates the local-index predictions to better than $7\times10^{-4}$ in $n_s$ and $2\times10^{-6}$ in $r$. The exact family extends beyond slow roll, although the observationally selected regions displayed here lie close to the slow-roll regime.

analysis.title_zh: 超越慢滚的一类精确单场暴胀解
analysis.summary_zh: 该文构造一类超越慢滚近似的单场暴胀精确背景解，通过变量变换把背景方程化为第一类 Abel 方程，并找出可解析求解的一类势。摘要报告该解族包含 constant-roll 情形，部分参数区与公开 CMB 联合似然的 (n_s,r) 约束相容，且代表点的模函数数值演化验证了局域指标预言。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接关系到 CMB 暴胀参数解释，因为它讨论在不预设慢滚的情况下如何预测并约束标量谱指数 n_s 与张量标量比 r。对 CMB 研究者而言，它提供了检验“观测允许区域是否真的要求慢滚”以及如何处理 constant-roll 或更一般 rolling 背景的理论参照。
key_points: 构造不依赖慢滚近似的单场暴胀精确解族。
该框架包含 constant-roll 暴胀，并允许第二 Hubble-flow 参数为常数的解。
使用公开 CMB 联合似然在 (n_s,r) 平面筛选参数区，所展示的可观测区域接近慢滚。
methods: 变量变换将背景方程化为第一类 Abel 方程
解析识别可精确求解的一类 inflaton 势
线性局域吸引子行为分析
超视界演化分析
使用公开联合 CMB 似然轮廓的 (n_s,r) 约束
标志点处标量和张量模的直接数值演化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对可精确求解势函数族的物理范围、吸引子条件是否足够保证初始条件鲁棒性，以及用公开 CMB 似然轮廓筛选参数时是否完整处理了 N_*、再加热假设和慢滚邻近性。

papers.title: Dissipative Multi-Field Dynamics from Non-Hermitian Inflationary Potentials
papers.abstract: In this work, we develop a perturbative framework for inflation driven by a complex inflaton with non-minimal gravitational coupling and a non-Hermitian potential. During the observable cosmic microwave background radiation era, the dynamics reduce to an effectively conservative two-field model, preserving the predictions of the $α$-attractor class and satisfying Planck 2018 and BICEP/Keck constraints on $n_s$, $r$, and $f_{\mathrm{NL}}$. Near the end of inflation, trajectory bending activates the non-Hermitian sector, triggering geometric reheating. The resulting non-unitary evolution modifies the curvature spectrum and stochastic gravitational-wave background through a calculable damping factor determined by the complex mass eigenvalues. While cosmic microwave background-scale observables remain essentially unchanged, a distinctive suppression emerges in the high-frequency gravitational-wave spectrum ($f > 10^2$ Hz), potentially testable by future detectors such as the Einstein Telescope and the Big Bang Observer.

analysis.title_zh: 来自非厄米暴胀势的耗散多场动力学
analysis.summary_zh: 该文发展一个由复 inflaton、非最小引力耦合和非厄米势驱动的暴胀扰动框架。摘要称在 CMB 可观测时期模型约化为有效保守双场动力学并保持 α-attractor 类对 n_s、r 和 f_NL 的预言，而在暴胀末期轨迹弯曲激活非厄米扇区，引入阻尼因子并抑制高频随机引力波背景。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的关系在于它声称 CMB 尺度上的 n_s、r 和非高斯性约束仍可满足 Planck 2018 与 BICEP/Keck，而新物理主要显现在再加热及高频随机引力波背景。对 CMB 宇宙学而言，这类模型说明仅用 CMB 尺度观测可能难以区分某些暴胀末期耗散动力学，需要与引力波背景探测联合检验。
key_points: 提出复 inflaton、非最小引力耦合和非厄米势驱动的扰动框架。
CMB 可观测时期动力学近似为保守双场模型，保留 α-attractor 类预言。
非厄米扇区在暴胀末期被激活，并抑制高频随机引力波谱。
methods: 复 inflaton 的扰动框架
非最小引力耦合与非厄米势
有效保守双场模型约化
与 Planck 2018 和 BICEP/Keck 对 n_s、r、f_NL 的约束比较
由复质量本征值确定的可计算阻尼因子
高频随机引力波背景预测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对非厄米势与非幺正演化的物理解释和一致性，以及“CMB 尺度几乎不变但高频引力波受抑制”是否依赖特定轨迹弯曲、复质量本征值或再加热建模。

papers.title: Combining Systematic Effects in CMB Polarization Experiments through map-based simulations: application to LiteBIRD's HWP non-idealities and detectors non-linearity
papers.abstract: We quantify the impact of coupled instrumental systematics on next-generation CMB polarization experiments targeting primordial $B$-mode polarization, with a focus on the forthcoming \textit{LiteBIRD} satellite mission. We study the interplay between the non-linear response of Transition-Edge Sensor (TES) bolometers and Half-Wave Plate (HWP) non-idealities, in particular synchronous signals arising from differential emissivity. We develop a map-based formalism that captures the resulting intensity-to-polarization leakage by explicitly solving the binning map-making equations, avoiding the need for computationally expensive time-ordered data simulations. We apply this framework to \textit{LiteBIRD}, adopting its baseline scanning strategy and frequency configuration, and perform analyses at both single- and multi-frequency levels, including Galactic foregrounds and blind component separation. We find that while detector non-linearity and HWP non-idealities individually induce negligible bias on the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$, their coupling can generate non-trivial contamination, driven by large signals such as the solar dipole and amplified in high-frequency channels by foreground leakage. From these results, we derive joint requirements on detector non-linearity and HWP differential emission, and discuss their implications for the instrument design and calibration strategy of \textit{LiteBIRD} and future CMB polarization missions targeting $r \lesssim 10^{-3}$.

analysis.title_zh: 通过基于地图的模拟合并 CMB 偏振实验中的系统效应：应用于 LiteBIRD 的 HWP 非理想性和探测器非线性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文量化下一代 CMB 偏振实验中耦合仪器系统误差对原初 B 模搜索的影响，重点研究 LiteBIRD 中 TES 探测器非线性与半波片 HWP 非理想性，尤其差分发射导致的同步信号。作者提出通过显式求解 binning map-making 方程的地图级模拟框架，并报告称两类效应单独作用时对张量标量比 r 的偏差可忽略，但耦合后可由太阳偶极等大信号驱动产生非平凡污染，并在高频通道因前景泄漏而放大。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 面向 r≲10^{-3} 的 CMB B 模实验，仪器系统误差之间的耦合可能比单个误差预算更关键。该工作直接关系到 LiteBIRD 及类似卫星任务的系统误差建模、前景分离稳健性、仪器设计指标和定标策略。
key_points: 研究 TES 探测器非线性与 HWP 非理想性之间的耦合系统误差。
提出基于地图的形式化方法，避免昂贵的时序数据模拟。
摘要称单独效应对 r 偏差可忽略，但二者耦合会产生非平凡污染。
methods: 基于地图的模拟与形式化建模
显式求解 binning map-making 方程
LiteBIRD 基线扫描策略与频率配置
单频与多频分析
包含银河前景与盲成分分离
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对地图级形式化对时序系统效应的近似条件、HWP 差分发射与 TES 非线性耦合项的推导，以及联合需求如何依赖前景模型、盲成分分离方法和 LiteBIRD 扫描假设。

papers.title: Baryonic feedback suppression of the matter power spectrum: a three-parameter fitting formula and its single-parameter reduction
papers.abstract: Baryonic feedback can suppress matter clustering by $\sim 10\%$ at $k\sim 1h$/Mpc and $z\sim 1$, and is therefore a major source of systematic errors in weak lensing cosmology. We investigate this effect through the ratio $S(k,z)\equiv P_{\rm hydro}(k,z)/P_{\rm DMO}(k,z)$ measured in the FLAMINGO, IllustrisTNG, and Illustris hydrodynamical simulation suites, together with the one-parameter-at-a-time (1P) variation runs of CAMELS-TNG and CAMELS-SIMBA. We present a three-parameter fitting formula that reproduces all but one of these runs with maximum error less than $0.03$ (and typical error less than $0.01$) at $k\leq 3h/$Mpc and $z\leq 2$; the only exception is a run with unrealistically low $Ω_m=0.1$. Each of the three parameters ($B_0$, $n$, and $a$) has a clear physical interpretation: $B_0$ sets the characteristic scale of the suppression at $z=0$, corresponding to a gas particle displacement scale of $B_0^{1/2}$; $n$ sets the suppression floor $(1-Ω_b/Ω_m)^n$; and $a$ sets the redshift $z_B$ at which the suppression peaks. Furthermore, we find that $B_0$ and $z_B$ are significantly correlated for most runs. Also, $n\simeq 1$ for FLAMINGO, TNG and CAMELS-TNG. For these simulations, the description reduces to a single parameter formula with maximum error less than $0.03$. The formulas remain accurate at max$(|ΔS|)<0.03$ (and typical error less than $0.01$) for cosmologies well away from the calibration cosmology, spanning the range $Ω_m\in [0.2,0.5]$, $Ω_b\in [0.029,0.069]$ and $σ_8\in [0.6,1.0]$. These results imply that, despite the diversity of baryonic physics implementations, an accurate description of $S(k,z)$ requires at most three effective degrees of freedom. Therefore the impact of feedback on weak lensing cosmology can in principle be mitigated internally without significant loss of cosmological constraining power.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 12 figures. To be submitted to JCAP

analysis.title_zh: 重子反馈对物质功率谱的抑制：三参数拟合公式及其单参数约化
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对弱透镜宇宙学中的重子反馈系统误差，利用 FLAMINGO、IllustrisTNG、Illustris 以及 CAMELS 系列流体模拟中的 P_hydro/P_DMO 比值，构造并检验三参数拟合公式。摘要报告该公式在给定 k、z 和宇宙学范围内通常达到较小误差，且对 FLAMINGO、TNG 和 CAMELS-TNG 可约化为单参数形式。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 物质功率谱是 CMB 透镜、星系弱透镜和大尺度结构联合宇宙学的核心输入；重子反馈若建模不足，会偏置 σ8、Ωm 等参数，并影响与 Planck CMB 结果的比较。该摘要提出的低维有效描述若稳健，可帮助在 CMB 透镜和低红移结构探针联合分析中控制小尺度非线性系统误差。
key_points: 给出重子反馈抑制物质功率谱比值 S(k,z) 的三参数拟合公式。
在多个流体动力学模拟套件和 CAMELS 变化运行上检验，摘要报告多数情况下误差较小。
对部分模拟可进一步约化为单参数描述，指向弱透镜系统误差的内部缓解。
methods: FLAMINGO 流体动力学模拟
IllustrisTNG 流体动力学模拟
Illustris 流体动力学模拟
CAMELS-TNG 与 CAMELS-SIMBA 的 one-parameter-at-a-time 变化运行
物质功率谱比值 S(k,z)=P_hydro/P_DMO
三参数拟合公式及单参数约化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对拟合公式的具体函数形式、校准样本覆盖的反馈模型多样性、误差定义与 k/z 适用范围，以及在真实弱透镜推断中这些有效参数与宇宙学参数的退化是否如摘要所称可控。

papers.title: Search for Neutrinos from Tidal Disruption Events with IceCube
papers.abstract: Tidal disruption events (TDEs) are theorized to produce high-energy neutrinos through photohadronic interactions between accelerated protons and multi-wavelength photons in the accretion disk and outflows. Detecting these neutrinos would provide insight into the dynamics of TDEs. Taking advantage of the recent increase in observed TDEs from wide field-of-view telescopes, we conduct a dedicated search for neutrinos coincident in optical/UV and X-ray wavelengths. We searched for neutrino emission from 89 TDEs selected based on X-ray and optical/UV observations using time-dependent likelihood analysis methods in two parts. First, we searched for emission from individual sources, where we fit the time window of expected neutrino emission. Second, we performed a study of jetted and non-jetted TDE subpopulations using a stacking search with a fixed one year time window. No significant neutrino excess was observed in either search. We set upper limits to the contribution of jetted and non-jetted TDEs detected in optical/UV and X-ray wavelengths to the diffuse astrophysical neutrino flux assuming TDEs are standard candles.

analysis.title_zh: 用 IceCube 搜索来自潮汐瓦解事件的中微子
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对潮汐瓦解事件可能通过光强子相互作用产生高能中微子的情景，利用IceCube对89个由光学/紫外和X射线观测选出的TDE进行符合搜索。摘要报告单源时间依赖似然搜索和喷流/非喷流叠加搜索均未发现显著中微子超额，并给出这些TDE对子弥散天体物理中微子通量贡献的上限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接研究CMB，但属于多信使宇宙学与高能天体物理背景源约束。对CMB读者而言，其相关性主要在于理解高能宇宙源族群、瞬变事件率和黑洞吸积环境；这些内容与大尺度结构、星系核活动和宇宙背景辐射的多波段互补研究有关。
key_points: 以89个光学/紫外和X射线选出的潮汐瓦解事件为样本搜索IceCube中微子符合信号。
单源时间依赖似然搜索和喷流/非喷流子样本叠加搜索均未见显著中微子超额。
在标准烛光假设下给出这些TDE对子弥散天体物理中微子通量贡献的上限。
methods: IceCube中微子数据
基于X射线与光学/紫外观测选择的89个TDE样本
时间依赖似然分析
单源搜索中拟合预期中微子发射时间窗
喷流与非喷流TDE子样本的一年固定时间窗叠加搜索
标准烛光假设下的上限估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对TDE样本选择函数、时间窗拟合方式、叠加权重以及“标准烛光”假设如何影响弥散通量上限；摘要未给出具体上限数值和相对既有约束的改进幅度。

papers.title: Status of the strong $CP$ problem
papers.abstract: The strong $CP$ problem remains one of the major open questions in the Standard Model of particle physics. Its best-known solution is the Peccei--Quinn mechanism, which predicts a new pseudoscalar boson, the QCD axion. In recent years, alternative solutions and new perspectives on the foundations of the strong $CP$ problem have also received renewed attention. In this review, we provide a pedagogical account of the underlying physics and summarise the current theoretical and phenomenological status of the problem.
papers.comment: 125 pages including refs, 6 figures, 4 tables; comments are welcome

analysis.title_zh: 强 CP 问题的现状
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于标准模型中强 CP 问题的教学式综述，概述其物理基础、Peccei--Quinn 机制与 QCD 轴子方案，并总结当前理论和现象学状态。摘要还指出，替代解决方案和对强 CP 问题基础的新理解近年受到更多关注。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: QCD 轴子是重要的暗物质候选体，强 CP 问题的解法直接影响轴子宇宙学、早期宇宙相变和暗物质实验目标设定。对 CMB 研究者而言，其关联主要在粒子宇宙学层面，例如轴子暗物质丰度、等曲率扰动和早期宇宙历史假设。
key_points: 综述强 CP 问题的物理基础、理论状态与现象学状态。
重点讨论 Peccei--Quinn 机制及其预言的 QCD 轴子。
摘要还提到近年替代方案和对问题基础的新视角。
methods: 理论综述
现象学状态总结
Peccei--Quinn 机制与 QCD 轴子讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者如何界定强 CP 问题的“基础”假设，以及对各类替代方案的评价是否依赖特定模型或自然性标准。

papers.title: Nanohertz Gravitational-Wave Constraints on Supermassive Binary Black Holes at Cosmic Dawn
papers.abstract: Standard continuous gravitational-wave searches with pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) neglect cosmological redshift, restricting their applicability to the local Universe. We introduce a redshift-aware PTA framework and apply it to the Parkes PTA Data Release 3, deriving the first direct constraints on supermassive binary black holes (SMBBHs) at the cosmic dawn. Evaluating our limits across a broad redshift range, we observationally establish the non-monotonic mass-redshift exclusion boundary driven by the theoretical ``redshift bias", demonstrating how PTAs can effectively probe sources at extreme distances. Redshift-aware targeted searches toward high-redshift systems, including the ultraluminous quasar J0100+2802 ($z=6.327$) and the JWST-discovered galaxy JADES-GS-z14-0 ($z=14.32$), rigorously exclude SMBBHs with chirp masses $\mathcal{M}_c \gtrsim 10^{10} M_\odot$ across the nanohertz frequency band. Finally, we demonstrate that high-redshift binaries can be robustly detected and localized, allowing for the accurate measurement of their intrinsic properties. Our results provide the tightest constraints to date on SMBBHs at $z > 6$ and establish a practical framework for probing early-Universe black hole assembly.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures; Accepted for publication in PRL

analysis.title_zh: 纳赫兹引力波对宇宙黎明时期超大质量双黑洞的约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文指出标准PTA连续引力波搜索通常忽略宇宙学红移，因而主要适用于近邻宇宙，并提出一个红移感知框架用于Parkes PTA DR3。摘要报告该方法给出了对宇宙黎明时期超大质量双黑洞的直接约束，展示非单调质量-红移排除边界，并对若干高红移目标排除约为大于10^10太阳质量量级的啁啾质量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与CMB同属早期宇宙和大尺度宇宙学探针体系，但观测信使不同：PTA探测纳赫兹引力波，CMB探测早期光子背景。其意义在于为高红移黑洞形成与并合历史提供独立约束，可与CMB推断的早期结构形成、再电离和宇宙学参数背景相互参照。
key_points: 提出考虑宇宙学红移的PTA连续引力波搜索框架。
将该框架用于Parkes PTA Data Release 3，约束宇宙黎明时期的超大质量双黑洞。
摘要称对高红移目标系统给出直接排除，并展示高红移双星可被稳健探测和定位。
methods: 红移感知的脉冲星计时阵列框架
Parkes PTA Data Release 3
纳赫兹连续引力波搜索
宽红移范围上的质量-红移排除边界评估
针对J0100+2802与JADES-GS-z14-0等高红移系统的定向搜索
高红移双星探测与定位演示
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点检查红移如何进入连续波模板、频率与啁啾质量参数的定义、所谓“redshift bias”的理论来源，以及对高红移候选天体的排除是否依赖先验、轨道假设或噪声模型；摘要中的质量阈值和“最强约束”需要结合频段与置信水平核对。

papers.title: Formation of Heavy Seed Black Holes and Little Red Dots-like Compact Clusters in Metal-enriched Star-forming Regions
papers.abstract: The origin of supermassive black holes (SMBHs) in the early Universe remains uncertain. While the classical direct-collapse scenario requires pristine gas exposed to intense Lyman-Werner (LW) radiation, recent JWST observations suggest that early growing BHs may reside in compact, metal-enriched environments. We investigate early BH formation using a cosmological radiation-hydrodynamic simulation that self-consistently follows the formation and evolution of rapidly accreting supermassive stars (SMSs). We find that intense LW radiation develops in clustered star-forming regions; by the time the first heavy seed forms, the mass-weighted internal intensity has reached $J_{21}\sim1000$. Most seeds form in weakly metal-enriched gas with [Z/H]$\sim-3$ to $-2$, because the strongest LW fields occur in regions already enriched by previous stellar feedback. All halos above $10^9M_\odot$ in our zoom-in region host a BH more massive than $10^5M_\odot$. We construct stellar spectra using MIST/PHOENIX libraries for normal stars and $6000~\mathrm{K}$ blackbody spectra for bloated SMSs. Five of eight massive clusters with stellar masses larger than $10^6~M_\odot$ exhibit intrinsically V-shaped spectra similar to those of Little Red Dots (LRDs). In the most prominent cases, luminous SMSs dominate the red optical emission, although Balmer breaks in normal stellar populations also contribute. We also identify off-center LRD-like systems in our simulation resembling those recently reported in strongly lensed observations. Our results suggest that heavy-seed formation, compact-cluster formation, and LRD-like continuum emission are linked outcomes of clustered, weakly metal-enriched, strongly irradiated environments.

analysis.title_zh: 富金属恒星形成区中重种子黑洞与类 Little Red Dots 致密星团的形成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用宇宙学辐射流体模拟研究早期宇宙中重种子黑洞与类似 Little Red Dots 的致密星团如何在富金属恒星形成区产生。摘要报告，强 Lyman-Werner 辐射出现在成团恒星形成区，重种子多形成于弱金属增丰气体中，并且若干大质量星团表现出类似 LRD 的 V 形连续谱。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 早期超大质量黑洞种子的形成会影响再电离时期的辐射背景、早期结构形成和高红移星系解释，这些都与 CMB 的大尺度光学深度、次级各向异性和宇宙再电离历史相关。该文更直接服务于 JWST 高红移源解释，但其早期黑洞和星团形成情景对宇宙学模型有间接约束意义。
key_points: 使用宇宙学辐射流体模拟研究早期重种子黑洞形成。
摘要报告重种子多形成于弱金属增丰且强 Lyman-Werner 辐射环境。
模拟中的部分大质量致密星团呈现类似 Little Red Dots 的内禀 V 形光谱。

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模拟分辨率、辐射反馈和金属混合处理是否足以支持重种子形成结论，并检查 LRD-like 光谱与观测选择效应、尘埃和星族模型之间的退化。

papers.title: The Canadian Galactic Emission Mapper (CGEM): A Cosmic Microwave Foreground Experiment
papers.abstract: The Canadian Galactic Emission Mapper (CGEM) is a 4-meter single-dish radio telescope located at the Dominion Radio Astrophysical Observatory (DRAO) in Penticton, Canada. CGEM is designed to map polarized Galactic synchrotron emission across the entire northern sky at 8-10 GHz with 1 MHz frequency resolution and 0.5 degree angular resolution. Its goal is to obtain high-fidelity, low-noise maps of polarized Galactic synchrotron radiation, at frequencies where synchrotron dominates, in order to provide a reliable template for CMB B-mode foreground cleaning. We will show on sky performance of CGEM's single-pixel azimuthally-symmetric telescope, its coherent, dual-polarized radiometer, and show maps made from commissioning data from the first few months of operation.

analysis.title_zh: 加拿大银河辐射成图仪（CGEM）：一项宇宙微波背景前景实验
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍Canadian Galactic Emission Mapper，一台位于加拿大DRAO的4米单碟射电望远镜，用于以8-10 GHz、1 MHz频率分辨率和0.5度角分辨率绘制北天偏振银河同步辐射。摘要称其目标是获得高保真、低噪声的同步辐射图，服务于CMB B模前景清除，并将展示仪器在天表现和早期调试数据制图结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇与CMB B模研究直接相关。银河同步辐射是低频偏振前景的重要成分，CGEM在同步辐射占优的8-10 GHz提供北天偏振模板，可帮助约束前景谱行为和空间结构，从而降低原初B模搜索中的前景清除系统误差。

papers.title: Flux jump correction in the QUBIC TES data pipeline
papers.abstract: Flux jumps occur in the readout electronics of Transition Edge Sensor (TES) detectors coupled to Superconducting Quantum Interference Devices (SQUIDs), as a consequence of the periodic transfer function of SQUIDs in the superconducting regime. These events manifest as discontinuities in the Time Ordered Data (TOD) and can significantly degrade the quality of the measured signals. In this work, we present an automated pipeline to identify and correct flux jumps in the calibration data of the QUBIC (Q \& U Bolometric Interferometer for Cosmology) instrument, designed to measure the B-mode polarization of the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB). Using data from multiple observation campaigns, we characterize the statistical properties of flux jumps and compare them with expectations based on the electronic configuration of the instrument. The proposed pipeline successfully corrects these events, allowing the recovery of affected data and enabling their use in subsequent CMB analysis.

analysis.title_zh: QUBIC TES 数据处理流程中的磁通跳变校正
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 QUBIC 的 TES 探测器与 SQUID 读出电子学中因 SQUID 周期性传输函数导致的 flux jump，提出自动化流程在时间有序数据中识别并校正这些不连续事件。摘要报告该流程已用于多个观测 campaign 的校准数据，能够表征 flux jump 的统计性质、与仪器电子学配置预期比较，并恢复受影响数据以供后续 CMB 分析。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: QUBIC 旨在测量 CMB 的 B 模偏振，而 TES/SQUID 读出链中的不连续跳变会直接污染 TOD，进而影响噪声建模、地图制作和偏振系统误差控制。若校正流程稳健，它能提高可用数据量并降低仪器读出效应对 B 模搜索的影响。
key_points: 研究 QUBIC TES/SQUID 读出中的 flux jump 对 TOD 的影响。
提出自动化识别与校正流程，并用于校准数据。
摘要称该流程可恢复受影响数据，使其进入后续 CMB 分析。

papers.title: Radiative Corrections and Reheating in Supergravity Models of Inflation
papers.abstract: We consider the effects of radiative corrections in Starobinsky-like models of inflation, concentrating on models of inflation formulated in N=1 no-scale supergravity. Inflaton couplings to matter fields are necessary for reheating and these have an impact on loop corrections to the inflaton potential. Whilst corrections due to the supergravity couplings of the inflaton to Standard Model (MSSM) fields are negligible, we use {\it Planck} data to obtain interesting constraints on GUT bilinear couplings, vevs, and gauge boson masses that could be sharpened by future CMB measurements.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 13 figures, prepared for: "String Theory and Particle Physics: A Themed Issue of Universe in Honor of Professor Ignatios Antoniadis on the Occasion of His 70th Birthday", edited by George K. Leontaris

analysis.title_zh: 超引力暴胀模型中的辐射修正与再加热
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察 Starobinsky 类暴胀模型中的辐射修正，重点放在 N=1 no-scale 超引力框架，并讨论再加热所需的暴胀子与物质场耦合如何影响暴胀势的圈修正。摘要报告称，暴胀子与标准模型或 MSSM 场的超引力耦合修正可忽略，而 Planck 数据可对 GUT 双线性耦合、真空期望值和规范玻色子质量给出有意义约束，未来 CMB 测量可进一步收紧。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对暴胀谱指数、张量扰动等观测量的约束可反推高能暴胀势的形状和修正项。该论文把再加热耦合、超引力模型和 GUT 尺度参数与 Planck 及未来 CMB 测量联系起来，属于 CMB 约束早期宇宙高能物理的方向。
key_points: 研究 Starobinsky 类暴胀在 N=1 no-scale 超引力中的辐射修正。
再加热所需的暴胀子-物质场耦合会影响暴胀势的圈修正。
摘要称 Planck 数据可约束 GUT 双线性耦合、真空期望值和规范玻色子质量。

papers.title: TDCOSMO XXVIII. The Hubble constant from the quadruply lensed quasar J1537$-$3010 with precise time delays
papers.abstract: We present the first measurement of the Hubble constant ($H_0$) from the quadruply-lensed quasar J1537$-$3010, which has optically-measured time delays at $\sim2 \%$ precision. We combine these delays with multi-band imaging data from the Hubble Space Telescope (HST) and model the system with two independent software and teams. We adopt a mass profile that is maximally degenerate with $H_0$ to fully incorporate the mass-sheet degeneracy in the error budget, with nuisance parameters constrained by spatially resolved stellar kinematics from the Multi Unit Spectroscopic Explorer (MUSE) and a line-of-sight (LoS) analysis using the Euclid Flagship simulation. The entire analysis is performed blindly to $H_0$, distances and mass density slope of the main deflector. After unblinding, we measure $H_0 = 75.5^{+9.3}_{-5.8}\ {\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$, corresponding to a $10\%$ precision measurement from a single system. This precision is driven by conservative lens modeling assumptions including differences between lens modeling methods and the limited stellar kinematics constraints, from which we infer a total mass-sheet parameter $λ\equiv(1-κ_{\rm ext})λ_{\rm int} = 0.89^{+0.11}_{-0.06}$ ($λ_{\rm int}=0.89^{+0.09}_{-0.07}$) that is consistent with current results for elliptical galaxies ($λ\approx 1$). Our lensing constraints, stellar kinematic measurements and LoS characterization will be included in subsequent population-level measurements of $H_0$. Moreover, our lens models combined with future near-infrared spectroscopy and imaging from the James Webb Space Telescope will further reduce the uncertainties on $H_0$ from J1537$-$3010 alone, bringing it closer to the few percents precision of the time delays.
papers.comment: 14 pages (+ 9 pages in appendix), 16 figures, submitted to Physical Review D

analysis.title_zh: TDCOSMO XXVIII：利用具有精确时延的四重透镜类星体 J1537−3010 测量哈勃常数
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告四重强透镜类星体 J1537−3010 的首次 H0 测量：作者把约 2% 精度的光学时延与 HST 多波段成像结合，并用两个独立团队/软件进行透镜建模。摘要给出的盲分析解盲结果为 H0=75.5^{+9.3}_{-5.8} km s^{-1} Mpc^{-1}，单系统精度约 10%，误差主要受保守质量建模和有限恒星运动学约束影响。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H0 是 CMB 推断宇宙学参数时最受关注的低红移交叉检验之一，强透镜时延提供了与 CMB 声学尺度和距离梯度不同的独立距离探针。该工作对 mass-sheet degeneracy 的保守处理也直接关系到强透镜 H0 结果能否用于评估 CMB 与局域宇宙 H0 张力。
key_points: 首次用四重透镜类星体 J1537−3010 给出 H0 测量。
结合约 2% 精度的光学时延、HST 多波段成像、MUSE 恒星运动学和视线结构分析。
摘要强调采用保守透镜质量建模并显式纳入 mass-sheet degeneracy。

papers.title: Extended radio emission in and around the merging cluster A520 as seen by MeerKAT
papers.abstract: We present results from a deep MeerKAT 1.28 GHz observation of Abell 520, a galaxy cluster in the middle of a merger and a treasure trove of merger-generated phenomena. MeerKAT's combination of high angular resolution and sensitivity to extended radio emission lets us uncover unprecedented detail of the cluster's giant halo and puzzling features beyond the halo. We find that the main radio halo is sharply bounded along the direction of the NE-SW merger axis by the two X-ray shock fronts. In the perpendicular direction, the halo wings smoothly span over 2 Mpc, with the spectrum steepening in the outskirts. We detect faint radio emission upstream of the main (SW) bow shock; the emissivity jump across this shock can be used to constrain the physical mechanisms at work there. We discover a tail of radio emission extending past the NE shock to the gas-poor, high-entropy ``dark subcluster'' in the NE outskirts. The tail and subcluster have a higher radio/X-ray brightness ratio than the main halo's, suggesting efficient reacceleration of cosmic rays. We also discover two peripheral radio relics beyond the cluster virial radius, and a faint, $\sim2$ Mpc long, broad radio bridge connecting the dark subcluster to one of the relics along the direction perpendicular to the merger axis. The spectral slopes of the dark subcluster and the bridge are consistent with that of the main halo. This bridge and both relics may be caused by another giant merger-generated shock front at the virial radius.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 9 figures, accepted for publication in ApJ

analysis.title_zh: MeerKAT 所见合并星系团 A520 内部及周围的扩展射电发射
analysis.summary_zh: 本文基于 MeerKAT 1.28 GHz 深观测研究合并星系团 Abell 520 的扩展射电发射，展示主射电晕、激波相关边界、暗子团方向的射电尾以及外围遗迹/射电桥等结构。摘要指出这些结构的射电/X 射线亮度比和谱斜率支持宇宙线再加速及可能的合并激波解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于星系团等离子体和高能天体物理，但星系团非热成分、激波和射电晕关系到星系团质量估计、热 SZ/射电前景建模以及 CMB 小尺度观测中的星系团污染理解。对 CMB 读者而言，它更像是前景与星系团物理背景材料，而非核心宇宙学参数论文。

papers.title: Early Supermassive Black Holes and Little Red Dots Require Free-Fall Growth
papers.abstract: Supermassive black holes/active galactic nuclei (SMBHs/AGN), forming only a few hundred million years after the Big Bang as observed with the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), challenge theoretical understanding. How could they grow so massive $(M_{\rm BH} > 10^6 {\rm \,M}_\odot)$ so quickly after initial seeding? Is this rapid growth related to the numerous and enigmatic Little Red Dots (LRDs), compact sources with AGN-like characteristics, discovered by JWST? To address these mysteries, we consider the first-order constraint on SMBH growth: enough baryonic material has to reach the vicinity of the SMBH seed, located near the bottom of the gravitational potential well of the host dark matter halo. We specifically examine cold-mode accretion, where gas from the cosmic environment flows into the virialized halo in cold streams without being shock-heated, efficiently reaching the center on a free-fall timescale. We find that cold mode accretion is necessary to supply material for the SMBHs to reach the observed masses, whereas for shock-heated gas inflow the required amount could only be supplied by implausibly rare halos. Moreover, cold-mode inflow in rare $(\sim1$ Gpc$^{-3}$) halos matches the mass and number of the massive quasars, and halos able to support super-Eddington accretion for massive SMBHs ($\sim10^7$ M$_\odot$) match LRD number densities. The decreasing LRD abundance at lower redshifts may then reflect the termination of cold-mode accretion in the growing host halos. The populations of massive SMBHs and LRDs at early times may thus arise naturally from cosmological structure formation, based on the abundance of halos capable of supplying sufficient material through cold accretion.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, Submitted to the Open Journal of Astrophysics

analysis.title_zh: 早期超大质量黑洞和小红点需要自由落体增长
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 JWST 发现的早期超大质量黑洞/AGN 与 Little Red Dots 是否需要极快供气增长。作者从宿主暗物质晕能否把足够重子物质输送到中心出发，比较冷模吸积和激波加热内流，摘要报告冷模自由落体供气是达到观测黑洞质量和相关数量密度的必要条件。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要关联早期结构形成、黑洞种子增长和 JWST 高红移星系/AGN 解释，而非直接 CMB 数据分析。其宇宙学意义在于利用暗物质晕丰度和重子吸积物理检验 ΛCDM 结构形成框架下早期天体能否自然产生；对 CMB 读者而言，它涉及再电离时代能源注入、早期黑洞种群和小尺度结构形成的背景问题。
key_points: JWST 早期 SMBH/AGN 与 Little Red Dots 的快速形成对供气速率提出强约束。
摘要认为冷模吸积可在自由落体时标把气体输送到中心，而激波加热气体需要不现实的稀有暗物质晕。
稀有晕中的冷流供气被用来同时解释大质量类星体与 LRD 的数量密度趋势。

papers.title: Evolution of Cosmic String Loops under Gravitational Backreaction
papers.abstract: Nambu-Goto cosmic string loops generically develop cusps, points where the string momentarily reaches the speed of light. These cusps produce strong gravitational wave bursts with a characteristic strain spectrum $\tilde{h}(ω)\propto (Gμ)\,ω^{-4/3}$, making them prime targets for gravitational wave searches, where $μ$ is the string mass per unit length. However, this picture is modified when one accounts for gravitational backreaction. Using a convenient gauge, we reformulate the Nambu-Goto equations of motion for a loop moving in its own dynamically sourced gravitational field, enabling the first continuous numerical evolution of loops under this backreaction. A key finding is that locally cusps survive backreaction. Nevertheless, the gravitational waveform calculated in this formalism is significantly modified, weakening the cusp burst and introducing a high-frequency cutoff at $f_c\propto(Gμ)^{-3/2}$. This suppression above $f_c$ reduces the expected signal-to-noise ratio in current and near-future detectors relative to unperturbed waveform predictions.

analysis.title_zh: 引力反作用下宇宙弦环的演化
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究宇宙弦环尖点在引力反作用下是否仍能形成以及相应引力波信号如何改变。摘要称，作者将 Nambu-Goto 弦环在自身动态产生的引力场中的运动方程重写并进行连续数值演化，发现局域尖点仍存活，但尖点暴波形显著减弱，并出现与弦张力相关的高频截止。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙弦是早期宇宙和粒子宇宙学的重要遗迹候选，其引力波背景或爆发现象可为超越标准模型的物理提供探针。虽然这篇论文不直接研究 CMB，但宇宙弦同样会影响 CMB 各向异性和非高斯性；对弦环辐射和反作用的更可靠建模，有助于联合 CMB 与引力波数据约束弦张力和宇宙弦网络。
key_points: Nambu-Goto 宇宙弦环通常会形成尖点，并产生特征引力波暴。
作者在自洽的动态引力场中连续数值演化弦环，研究引力反作用。
摘要称局域尖点仍可存活，但波形被显著改变，高频端受到抑制。
