analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其规范选择、反作用近似和数值稳定性如何保证；尤其要检查高频截止标度与波形削弱是否依赖特定环构型或正则化方案。

papers.title: Agentic research is oxymoronic
papers.abstract: The use of agentic large language models obviates human interpretation of scientific results, and will lead to substantial distrust in the literature.
papers.comment: 3 pages, no figures. Published as a Comment in Nature Astronomy

analysis.title_zh: 自主代理式研究是自相矛盾的
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 agentic 大语言模型在科研中的使用，摘要认为这类模型会取代人类对科学结果的解释，并造成文献中的严重不信任。摘要没有报告具体实证方法或天体物理结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章与 CMB/宇宙学的联系主要在科研方法和文献可信度层面，而非具体宇宙学观测或理论。若其讨论涉及自动化文献生产、数据解释或仪器方法，可能影响 CMB 数据分析和结果发布的规范，但摘要本身没有给出领域内案例。
key_points: 摘要主张 agentic 大语言模型会削弱人类对科学结果的解释。
作者认为这将导致文献可信度显著下降。
摘要未给出具体案例、数据或检验方法。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对作者是否给出了可检验的论证、实例或文献分析；仅凭摘要无法判断其结论是方法论批评、评论文章还是立场性短文。

papers.title: Ad Astra White Paper: A Pitch for the Next 25 Years of NASA's Physics of the Cosmos Program
papers.abstract: Astrophysical observations of our universe have been key to our understanding of how the universe works. Shortly after the turn of the millennium, the National Research Council delivered \textit{Connecting Quarks with the Cosmos: Eleven Science Questions for the New Century}. In the subsequent quarter-century, we have made substantial progress in answering each question. These advancements have, in part, arisen because of the success of major US facilities across several domains of physics, guided by long-term planning documents which still largely focus on these questions. This report seeks to provide a status update on each question, and to outline what space-based facilities are crucial for future progress, intended to guide NASA's preparatory work for the Astro2030 Decadal.
papers.comment: First version submitted ahead of the Ad Astra September workshop. Feedback welcome

analysis.title_zh: Ad Astra 白皮书：对 NASA“宇宙物理”项目未来 25 年的建议
analysis.summary_zh: 本文是一份规划性白皮书，回顾过去四分之一个世纪中美国主要设施在若干宇宙物理核心问题上的进展。摘要说明其目标是更新这些科学问题的现状，并概述哪些空间设施对未来进展至关重要，以服务 NASA 面向 Astro2030 十年规划的准备。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 研究高度依赖长期空间任务和地面设施规划；此类白皮书可能影响未来 NASA 在宇宙学、暗能量、早期宇宙和多信使观测方面的任务布局。对 CMB 读者而言，它更像是政策与任务路线背景材料，而非具体数据分析论文。
key_points: 这是一份面向 NASA Physics of the Cosmos 未来规划的白皮书。
摘要称其回顾过去约 25 年围绕“Connecting Quarks with the Cosmos”科学问题的进展。
重点是提出未来空间观测设施对 Astro2030 十年规划准备工作的意义。
methods: 科学规划白皮书
历史进展综述
空间观测设施需求梳理
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点查看白皮书如何排序未来空间任务优先级，以及其对 CMB、暗能量、引力波、高能宇宙等主题的设施需求是否有具体、可执行的论证。

papers.title: Slysh haloes: the waste heat of cold computing as a submillimetre technosignature
papers.abstract: Searches for Dysonian waste heat have operated almost exclusively in the mid-infrared and are therefore sensitive primarily to technology radiating at 100-600K. We argue that mature, computation-dominated civilisations may instead dissipate much of their energy at far lower temperatures. The Landauer cost of irreversible computation scales linearly with temperature, while ambient temperatures at large circumstellar radii approach the 2.7K cosmic microwave background floor. Cold computation is therefore thermodynamically attractive and, because the required radiating area scales as T**-4, potentially conspicuous. These considerations predict a new object class, which we term the SLYSH HALO after the first advocate of cold Dysonian searches. A Slysh halo is a physically motivated partial Dyson swarm producing grey, line-free thermal emission from the cold outer regions of planetary systems. We show that such structures are energetically and materially plausible, and that M dwarfs provide especially favourable search targets. Archival far-infrared and submillimetre surveys of nearby stars (DEBRIS, DUNES and SONS) can in principle be reinterpreted to constrain cold circumstellar dissipation at approximately the 10**20 Watt level, several orders of magnitude below the waste-heat luminosities targeted by previous infrared searches. Additional opportunities are provided by archival observations from Planck and the JCMT, together with the reprocessing of interferometric data from facilities such as ALMA and NOEMA. We assemble six observational discriminants that separate engineered radiators from natural cold sources and outline a three-tier search programme. Even a null result would provide the first temperature-complete assessment of Dysonian technosignatures.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, submitted to MNRAS

analysis.title_zh: Slysh 晕：冷计算废热作为一种亚毫米技术特征
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一种名为 Slysh halo 的亚毫米技术特征：若成熟文明将计算废热在接近 CMB 温度下限的低温环境中辐射，其信号可能表现为外行星系统冷区域的灰体、无谱线热辐射。摘要称，现有远红外和亚毫米巡天及 Planck、JCMT、ALMA/NOEMA 档案数据可用于约束这种冷环星耗散，并提出了若干观测判据和分层搜索方案。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文不是标准宇宙学参数研究，但与 CMB 观测频段和前景识别有关：它把 2.7 K CMB 作为热力学温度下限，并讨论 Planck 等亚毫米/毫米数据中的冷热辐射搜寻。对 CMB 研究者而言，相关性主要在于点源/冷尘埃前景、档案数据再分析和非标准亚毫米信号的鉴别。
key_points: 提出低温计算文明的废热可能出现在远红外/亚毫米波段。
概念依赖 Landauer 极限和接近 2.7 K CMB 温度下限的外行星系统环境。
建议重释 DEBRIS、DUNES、SONS、Planck、JCMT 以及 ALMA/NOEMA 档案数据。
methods: thermodynamic argument based on Landauer cost
archival far-infrared and submillimetre surveys: DEBRIS, DUNES, SONS
archival observations from Planck and JCMT
reprocessing of interferometric data from ALMA and NOEMA
six observational discriminants
three-tier search programme
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其“冷计算”热力学假设、辐射面积与物质预算的可行性，以及自然冷尘埃源与工程辐射体的判据是否足够可操作；对 CMB 读者还应关注 Planck 亚毫米/毫米数据在点源、银河前景和冷尘埃混淆下能给出的真实限制。

papers.title: SPT-3G D1: Quadratic-Estimator CMB Lensing Reconstruction and Cosmology
papers.abstract: We present a map of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) lensing potential reconstructed from observations taken during the 2019 and 2020 seasons with the third-generation camera on the South Pole Telescope (SPT), covering the $1500\,{\rm deg}^{2}$ SPT-3G Main field, referred to as the SPT-3G D1 dataset. From the multi-frequency temperature and polarization data, we reconstruct the CMB lensing field using a quadratic estimator that jointly accounts for the $T$, $E$, and $B$ fields and their covariance. The resulting lensing map is dominated by polarization information for $L \lesssim 600$ and provides the highest signal-to-noise measurement per mode reported to date. With nuisance parameters fixed to their best-fit values, we measure a lensing amplitude consistent with unity at $2\%$ precision relative to the $Λ$CDM model that best fits the combined Planck, ACT DR6, and SPT-3G D1 $TT/TE/EE$ likelihoods (${\rm CMB}_{\rm SPA}$). We further measure the structure-growth parameter $σ_{8}Ω_{\rm m}^{0.25}$ to be $0.6046\pm0.0096$ from the SPT-3G D1 lensing spectrum alone and $0.6020\pm0.0084$ when combined with ACT DR6 and Planck PR4 CMB lensing. By further combining this with ${\rm CMB}_{\rm SPA}$ and the latest DESI DR2 BAO data, we obtain $\sum m_ν < 0.072\,\mathrm{eV}$ (95% C.L.) when allowing the neutrino mass to vary within $Λ$CDM. Compared with previous work, the better agreement of our measurement with DESI DR2 BAO yields both this relaxed upper bound and reduced ($\mathord{\sim}2σ$) preferences for nonzero spatial curvature and for deviations of $(w_0,w_a)$ from the $Λ$CDM expectation. When we combine CMB lensing with the DES Y3 3$\times$2pt analysis, we obtain $S_{8}=0.811\pm0.011$, corresponding to a $1.4\%$ constraint on the late-time clustering amplitude. This precision is competitive with that obtained from the primary CMB within $Λ$CDM.

analysis.title_zh: SPT-3G D1：基于二次估计器的 CMB 透镜重建与宇宙学
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 SPT-3G D1 数据集的 CMB 透镜势重建：利用 2019–2020 年覆盖 1500 平方度主场的多频温度和偏振数据，通过联合 T/E/B 的二次估计器得到透镜图。摘要称该透镜谱给出与 ΛCDM 一致的透镜振幅、对 σ8Ωm^0.25 的约束，并在结合 ACT、Planck、DESI BAO 和 DES Y3 等数据后给出中微子质量、S8 及扩展宇宙学模型限制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这是直接面向 CMB 透镜和参数约束的核心结果，涉及 SPT-3G 偏振数据在透镜重建中的作用，并与 Planck、ACT 形成互补。对研究结构增长、S8、Σmν、空间曲率和暗能量参数的 CMB 读者尤其重要。
key_points: 基于 SPT-3G 2019–2020 年、1500 平方度主场数据重建 CMB 透镜势图。
使用联合 T/E/B 及其协方差的二次估计器，摘要称低 L 处由偏振信息主导。
给出 CMB 透镜、结构增长、中微子质量、曲率和暗能量参数等宇宙学约束，并与 Planck、ACT、DESI、DES 联合。
methods: SPT-3G D1 多频温度与偏振观测数据
CMB 透镜二次估计器
联合 T、E、B 场及其协方差的重建
与 ACT DR6、Planck PR4 CMB lensing、Planck/ACT/SPT 主 CMB 似然、DESI DR2 BAO、DES Y3 3×2pt 的联合宇宙学约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对二次估计器的偏置扣除、前景和噪声建模、nuisance 参数固定对 2% 透镜振幅精度的影响，以及与 DESI DR2 BAO 联合后中微子质量和曲率/暗能量结论对数据组合选择的敏感性。

papers.title: Bekenstein--Hod Bound: A $3.3σ$ Confirmation from GW250114
papers.abstract: Black holes link gravity, thermodynamics and information via limits on the relaxation rate of a perturbed system. The Bekenstein-Hod bound imposes a minimum relaxation time at fixed temperature, but its observational test demands both black hole thermodynamic characterization and decay time measurement. Here we test this bound with GW250114, the loudest gravitational-wave signal yet observed from a binary black-hole merger. We infer the remnant temperature from pre-merger data truncated at least $10\,M$ before the peak and its longest-lived decay time from post-merger data, thereby avoiding direct reuse of the same strain samples. The ringdown frequencies and damping times are allowed to vary independently rather than being fixed to the Kerr spectrum. For the primary $t_{<}=-10\,M$ analysis, the bound is verified at $3.3-3.6σ$ across the focal ringdown start times, representing a substantial improvement over the $91\%$ confidence level set by GW150914. The conclusion remains robust under varied pre-merger cutoffs and explicit inclusion of the short-lived first overtone in waveform modelling. This separated-data measurement converts an information-theoretic relaxation bound into a precision test of a single astrophysical black hole.

analysis.title_zh: Bekenstein–Hod 界限：来自 GW250114 的 3.3σ 确认
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用双黑洞并合引力波事件 GW250114 检验 Bekenstein–Hod 弛豫界限：从并合峰值前截断数据推断遗迹黑洞温度，并从并合后 ringdown 数据测量最长寿衰减时间。摘要称，主分析在不同关注的 ringdown 起始时间上给出 3.3–3.6σ 的验证，并对并合前截断和包含第一泛音的建模作了稳健性检查。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于引力波、黑洞热力学和广义相对论检验，并非 CMB 研究。其宇宙学关联在于检验强引力和信息论界限的基本物理；对 CMB 读者而言，它更多是与引力理论基础相关的背景进展，而不是直接影响 CMB 数据分析。
key_points: 用 GW250114 检验 Bekenstein–Hod 弛豫时间下界。
从峰值前截断的并合前数据推断遗迹黑洞温度，从并合后数据测量最长寿衰减时间。
摘要报告主分析中在若干 ringdown 起始时间下达到 3.3–3.6σ 验证。
methods: gravitational-wave event GW250114
pre-merger data truncated at least 10 M before the peak
post-merger ringdown data
independent variation of ringdown frequencies and damping times
waveform modelling including short-lived first overtone
robustness checks with varied pre-merger cutoffs
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对事件 GW250114 的数据质量与选择、并合前后样本分离是否真正避免相关性、ringdown 起始时间选择对显著性的影响，以及放松 Kerr 频谱假设后温度和衰减时间的统计误差如何传播。

papers.title: Constraining equation of state of neutron star using neutron star-black hole mergers
papers.abstract: In this work, we study tidal effects that can be observed in gravitational wave transient from neutron star-black hole (NSBH) mergers. It has been well known that neutron star's tidal deformation has imprint of equation of state and hence composition of neutron star matter. Compared to binary neutron star mergers, where we observe a combined effect of two neutron stars by measuring the parameter known as lambda tilde. In neutron star black hole mergers, we measure the tidal deformability of the neutron star component clearly. In this work, we study the feasibility of measuring the bare tidal deformability of a neutron star with planned gravitational detectors in the near and far future. We use the parameter estimation computation framework, Bilby is used to perform Bayesian inference for hundreds of NSBH mergers in current and future GW detector networks and obtain the posterior probability distribution functions of binary parameters. We find that we need at least 20 events to clearly distinguish the equation state of neutron stars in future detectors, including the Einstein Telescope and Cosmic Explorer.

analysis.title_zh: 利用中子星—黑洞并合约束中子星状态方程
analysis.summary_zh: 该文研究中子星—黑洞并合引力波中的潮汐效应，目标是用中子星的裸潮汐形变率约束中子星物质状态方程。作者用 Bilby 对当前和未来探测器网络中的大量 NSBH 事件做贝叶斯参数估计，摘要报告称在包括 Einstein Telescope 和 Cosmic Explorer 的未来探测器中，至少需要 20 个事件才能清楚区分状态方程。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接研究 CMB，但属于多信使宇宙学和致密天体物理的重要输入：中子星状态方程影响引力波源建模，而未来引力波探测器与 CMB/大尺度结构共同构成对强引力、核物质和宇宙高能瞬变的互补约束。
key_points: NSBH 并合中可更直接测量中子星单体的潮汐形变率。
使用 Bilby 对大量模拟 NSBH 事件进行贝叶斯参数估计。
摘要称未来探测器网络至少需要约 20 个事件来区分中子星状态方程。
methods: 引力波瞬变中的潮汐效应分析
Bilby 贝叶斯推断参数估计框架
当前与未来引力波探测器网络的数百个 NSBH 并合事件模拟/分析
Einstein Telescope 与 Cosmic Explorer 未来探测器设定
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其 NSBH 事件族群假设、波形模型和潮汐参数先验如何影响“至少 20 个事件”的结论，以及不同状态方程之间的可分辨性判据是什么。

papers.title: Resonant Dynamics of Gravitational Wave and Chiral Alfvén wave in the Early Universe
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the resonant interaction between stochastic gravitational waves (GWs) and chiral Alfvén waves in a magnetized chiral plasma in the early Universe. Starting from covariant chiral magnetohydrodynamics coupled to linearized gravity, we derive a closed system of equations for the coupled chiral-Alfvén velocity and magnetic-field perturbations. Both analytics and numerics show a parametric resonance at the sum frequency of the two CVE-split branches, with an instability band that widens as the GW strain grows. This CVE-to-Alfvén ratio is not a free parameter. In the early Universe, it is fixed by the Standard Model's relativistic degrees of freedom. Including the plasma's backreaction on the GW makes the energy exchange nonlinear, breaking the usual single-frequency Manley-Rowe picture. For a self-consistent choice of parameters, where backreaction is only a small correction, the unsuppressed resonance still drives the system to a finite-time blow-up within a few Hubble times. We then work out the resonant frequencies and growth rates involved, mapping out what current and future gravitational-wave detectors could observe.

analysis.title_zh: 早期宇宙中引力波与手征 Alfvén 波的共振动力学
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究早期宇宙磁化手征等离子体中随机引力波与手征 Alfvén 波的共振相互作用，从协变手征磁流体力学耦合线性化引力出发，建立速度和磁场扰动的闭合方程。摘要报告解析和数值结果显示在两个 CVE 分裂分支的和频处存在参数共振，考虑反作用后能量交换呈非线性，并讨论了对应频率和增长率对引力波探测的潜在可观测性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作涉及早期宇宙等离子体、原初磁场和随机引力波背景之间的能量交换，可能影响对原初引力波信号及其传播历史的理解。对 CMB 研究而言，原初引力波和早期宇宙磁流体过程都与 B 模偏振、宇宙再加热前后物理以及非标准早期宇宙模型的可检验性相关。
key_points: 研究早期宇宙磁化手征等离子体中随机引力波与手征 Alfvén 波的共振耦合。
摘要称在两个由 CVE 分裂的分支的和频处出现参数共振，且不稳定带随引力波应变增大而变宽。
加入等离子体对引力波的反作用后，能量交换变为非线性，并可能在若干哈勃时间内出现有限时发散。
methods: 协变手征磁流体力学
线性化引力
解析推导
数值计算
包含等离子体对引力波的反作用
现有与未来引力波探测器可观测频率和增长率的映射
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对共振条件、参数选择是否确属早期宇宙自洽范围，以及“有限时发散”是否提示近似失效而非真实物理发散；还应检查探测器可观测性的频率换算和早期宇宙等离子体假设。

papers.title: The DSA/Chronoscope fast radio burst survey: forecasts and science overview
papers.abstract: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are bright extragalactic transients with several mysteries surrounding their origins. Large FRB samples enable accurate measurements of the cosmic matter distribution, in particular on scales $\lesssim 10$ Mpc. These measurements will impact cosmological inference and our understanding of astrophysical feedback, from the circumgalactic medium to cluster scales. Here we forecast the expected yields, redshifts, and host galaxies of FRBs as observed by the Deep Synoptic Array (DSA), and describe the key science cases enabled by the large FRB sample. The DSA will be an interferometer consisting of 1650$\times$6.15 m antennas, operating between 0.7--2 GHz, to be located in Nevada, USA. The Chronoscope backend on the DSA, hereafter DSA/Chronoscope, is designed to search for FRBs across the field of view in real time, enabling the storage of full-polarization voltage data. Extrapolating from existing FRB surveys, we expect roughly $10^4$ FRB detections per year in each of three search sub-bands. Combining across sub-bands, the survey could produce $\sim$ 10$^5$ FRBs over the nominal 5-year DSA survey, assuming Euclidean source counts and a baseline compute backend that can search $6\times10^6$ beams at 1 ms sampling. The well-characterized DSA synthesized beam and deep simultaneous reference images will enable localization precisions of $\lesssim$ 250 milliarcseconds. Key science cases include the use of FRB propagation effects in probing cosmic baryons, and studies of the FRB phenomenon using FRB host galaxies and their local environment, as well as multiwavelength counterparts.

analysis.title_zh: DSA/Chronoscope 快速射电暴巡天：预报与科学概述
analysis.summary_zh: 本文为 DSA/Chronoscope 快速射电暴巡天给出探测数量、红移分布和宿主星系的预报，并概述其科学目标。摘要称该系统通过大规模实时成像搜索和全偏振电压数据保存，有望在五年名义巡天中产生约 10^5 个 FRB，从而支持宇宙重子分布和 FRB 物理研究。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: FRB 的色散量和传播效应可作为独立的宇宙大尺度重子探针，特别适合研究星系晕、星系团和小于约 10 Mpc 尺度上的物质分布。它不是 CMB 论文，但与 CMB 推断的宇宙重子总量和大尺度结构图景互补，可帮助追踪低红移“缺失重子”和反馈过程，从而改进宇宙学物质分布模型。
key_points: 介绍并预报 DSA/Chronoscope 快速射电暴巡天的探测产额、红移和宿主星系样本。
摘要预期在每个搜索子频段每年约探测 10^4 个 FRB，五年合并样本可达约 10^5 个，前提包括欧几里得源计数和基线计算后端。
科学目标包括利用 FRB 传播效应探测宇宙重子、研究宿主星系和局域环境以及多波段对应体。
methods: 基于现有 FRB 巡天外推的产额预报
DSA 干涉阵观测设计
Chronoscope 实时 FRB 搜索后端
全偏振电压数据存储
合成波束定位
同步深度参考图像
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 FRB 产额预报对源计数、束数、采样时间、子频段合并和选择函数的依赖，并检查定位精度及宿主识别如何影响用 FRB 推断宇宙重子分布的系统误差。

papers.title: Measuring peculiar velocity and tomographic redshift dipole with DESI DR1 catalogs
papers.abstract: The so-called ``cosmic dipole tension'' challenges the Cosmological Principle by positing a discrepancy between the Solar System's peculiar velocity inferred from the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) dipole and that derived from large-scale structure number-count dipoles. Here we provide a high-precision determination of the kinematic dipole using the redshift-dipole method applied to the first data release (DR1) of the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI). By exploiting the Doppler-induced modulation of observed redshifts, this estimator is intrinsically less sensitive to imaging systematics and selection-function uncertainties that can bias traditional number-count measurements. We conduct a tomographic analysis of four tracer populations, Bright Galaxy Sample, Luminous Red Galaxies, Emission Line Galaxies, and quasars, spanning $0.1<z<2.1$. Survey geometry and statistical uncertainties are quantified using 1,000 \texttt{EZmock} realizations. We find that the high-redshift QSO sample implies a peculiar velocity of $v = 357.95_{-48.47}^{+55.05}\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$, in excellent agreement with the CMB-inferred value of $369.82 \pm 0.11\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$. By contrast, a complementary number-count analysis yields a significantly enhanced dipole amplitude, which we attribute to leakage of large-scale power and to incompleteness within the DESI DR1 footprint. These results indicate that the redshift dipole provides a cleaner and more reliable probe of the kinematic rest frame, offering strong support for the standard kinematic interpretation at high redshift and helping to resolve the apparent dipole anomaly.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 DESI DR1 目录测量本动速度与层析红移偶极
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对“宇宙偶极张力”，用 DESI DR1 光谱目录的红移偶极方法测量太阳系本动速度，并对 BGS、LRG、ELG、QSO 四类示踪体做层析分析。摘要报告高红移 QSO 样本得到的速度与 CMB 偶极推断值符合，而数目计数偶极显示更大振幅并被认为受 footprint 不完备性和大尺度功率泄漏影响。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 偶极通常被解释为太阳系相对于宇宙静止系的运动学信号；大尺度结构偶极若不一致会挑战宇宙学原理或暴露系统误差。该文提供了一个与 CMB 偶极直接对照的 DESI 光谱检验，因此与 CMB 大尺度各向异性和宇宙学原理研究相关。
key_points: 使用 DESI DR1 光谱星系/类星体样本测量红移偶极。
高红移 QSO 样本得到的本动速度与 CMB 偶极推断值一致。
数目计数偶极给出更大振幅，摘要将其归因于大尺度功率泄漏和 DESI DR1 footprint 内的不完备性。
methods: DESI DR1 目录
红移偶极方法
四类示踪体：BGS、LRG、ELG、QSO

papers.title: Cosmic variance and ergodicity in finite systems with correlations
papers.abstract: We consider the difference between ensemble and volume average in cosmology. It is known that for sufficiently weak long-range correlations the root mean square of the difference, which we call ergodicity bias, decays like $R^{-3/2}$ in the limit of large volume $R^3$. We calculate the condition this imposes on the power spectrum of a Gaussian random field. We quantify the bias for finite $R$, and show that the $R\to\infty$ limit is of little relevance for cosmological observations when the measured scales and correlations extend to the size of the observable universe. We consider curvature, density, and velocity perturbations. On large scales the bias is important in all three cases. For the density perturbations, which are observationally the most relevant, the relative bias first exceeds 100% at the separation $r=177$ Mpc, and is larger than 100% for all $r>560$ Mpc. It should be taken into account when comparing ensemble and volume averages for large-scale structure. The bias is also large for the cosmic microwave background temperature perturbations on large angular scales, but this is not relevant for observations, as their analysis does not involve volume averaging.

analysis.title_zh: 有限相关系统中的宇宙方差与遍历性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究宇宙学中系综平均与有限体积平均的差异，特别是在存在相关的有限系统中如何产生所谓 ergodicity bias。作者对高斯随机场推导功率谱条件并量化有限体积效应，摘要称该偏差在大尺度曲率、密度、速度扰动中重要，对 CMB 大角尺度温度扰动也可很大但与通常观测分析的体积平均关系有限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 和大尺度结构都依赖把观测到的一个宇宙与统计系综模型相比较；有限可观测体积和大尺度相关会影响这种比较的解释。该文对 cosmic variance、遍历性和大尺度异常的概念边界有启发，但摘要也明确指出其 CMB 大角尺度讨论并不直接改变常规 CMB 观测分析流程。
key_points: 讨论有限体积中系综平均与体积平均的差异，并称之为 ergodicity bias。
为高斯随机场推导长程相关条件对功率谱的要求，并量化有限 R 下的偏差。
摘要称大尺度密度扰动和 CMB 大角尺度温度扰动中该偏差可很大，但 CMB 分析通常不涉及体积平均。
methods: 高斯随机场理论分析
功率谱条件计算

对曲率、密度和速度扰动的考察
对 CMB 温度扰动大角尺度情形的讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“ergodicity bias”的定义与通常 cosmic variance 概念的关系、功率谱条件的适用假设，以及摘要中给出的密度扰动尺度阈值是否依赖特定宇宙学模型或平滑/窗口函数选择。

papers.title: Radio measurements of air showers with the IceCube-Gen2 surface prototype station at the Pierre Auger Observatory
papers.abstract: The design of the IceCube-Gen2 observatory, proposed as a next-generation extension of IceCube, includes a surface array consisting of scintillators and radio antennas. In addition to several such detectors already deployed at IceCube's surface array at the South Pole, a complete prototype station including three SKALA antennas has been operating at the Pierre Auger Observatory for several years. This setup has been used to successfully observe radio signals from air showers, demonstrated through coincident observations with the Auger Surface Detector. In this contribution, we present an updated analysis of these radio signals, and compare them to CoREAS simulations using the reconstruction from the Auger Surface Detector as input.

analysis.title_zh: 利用位于 Pierre Auger 天文台的 IceCube-Gen2 表面原型站进行空气簇射的射电测量
analysis.summary_zh: 该文介绍 IceCube-Gen2 表面阵列原型站在 Pierre Auger Observatory 对空气簇射射电信号的更新分析。作者利用与 Auger Surface Detector 的符合观测确认射电信号，并将其与以 Auger 重建为输入的 CoREAS 模拟进行比较。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要面向高能宇宙线和中微子探测仪器，不是 CMB 研究本身；但射电阵列的标定、背景控制和大气簇射模拟经验，对未来大面积宇宙粒子观测和与宇宙学高能信使的交叉研究有间接价值。
key_points: IceCube-Gen2 表面阵列原型站包含闪烁体和 SKALA 射电天线。
原型站在 Pierre Auger Observatory 通过与 Auger Surface Detector 符合观测探测到空气簇射射电信号。
本文更新射电信号分析，并与 CoREAS 模拟比较。

papers.title: A consistent, physical, and analytical model for CMB observables of reionisation I. Derivation, constraining power, and detectability of the auto-spectra
papers.abstract: The Epoch of Reionisation imprints its history and morphology on the Cosmic Microwave Background temperature and polarisation anisotropies through two effects: The kinetic Sunyaev Zel'dovich (kSZ) effect and Thomson scattering. To perform joint analyses of these observables and put tight constraints on the reionisation history and morphology, a common reionisation model is necessary. We present a quick, physically-accurate analytical approach to derive consistently the angular power spectra of the three main resulting imprints that are the spatial fluctuations of the Thomson optical depth, the patchy kSZ effect, and the scattering and screening B-modes. The approach differs from existing analytical models, as it is calibrated on high-resolution hydrodynamical simulations and depends on physical parameters of reionisation. Our predicted power spectra are consistent with the ones derived from cosmological simulations, whilst including more physical information -- such as the typical size of ionised bubbles and the duration of reionisation. We provide an updated detectability assessment and show that both $C_\ell^{ττ}$ and $C_\ell^{BB}$ could be measured by experiments similar to CMB Stage 4 and CMB-HD, respectively. We show the complementarity of the three observables in constraining reionisation history and morphology, and illustrate the potential of their joint analysis to get a global picture of reionisation. This analytical model will be a powerful tool in the analysis of upcoming CMB data, either alone or in combination with independent datasets such as measurements of the high-redshift 21cm signal. The code to derive these spectra is publicly available online as the preion Python package.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, code available at https://github.com/adeliegorce/preion, comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 一个用于再电离 CMB 可观测量的一致、物理且解析的模型 I：自功率谱的推导、约束能力与可探测性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对再电离时期在 CMB 温度与偏振中留下的三类主要印迹，构建一个共同且物理化的解析模型，用于一致地计算光学深度涨落、斑块状 kSZ 效应以及散射/屏蔽 B 模的角功率谱。摘要称该模型经高分辨率流体模拟校准，能复现宇宙学模拟谱形，并显示 CMB Stage 4 类实验可能测量 C_ell^{ττ}、CMB-HD 类实验可能测量 C_ell^{BB}。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离是 CMB 次级各向异性和大尺度/小尺度偏振分析中的关键物理过程；若 kSZ、光学深度涨落和 B 模屏蔽/散射能在同一模型中联合解释，将有助于从未来 CMB 数据中同时约束再电离历史与形态，并与高红移 21 cm 等探针互补。
key_points: 提出用于再电离 CMB 印迹的统一解析模型。
同时处理光学深度空间涨落、斑块状 kSZ、散射与屏蔽 B 模。
摘要称模型经高分辨率流体模拟校准，并给出公开 Python 包 preion。
methods: 解析角功率谱建模

papers.title: Not all those missing are lost: leveraging galaxy clustering in incomplete catalogs to unleash dark sirens cosmology
papers.abstract: Gravitational waves offer a unique opportunity to solve the Hubble tension. In order to do so, we have to extract as much information as possible from cross correlating gravitational wave events (used as "dark sirens") with incomplete galaxy catalogs. Traditional methods assume a uniform in comoving volume distribution for galaxies missing from the catalogs, which neglects the fact that galaxies tend to cluster, leading to less precise and possibly biased posteriors. In this paper, we introduce a new method for accounting for galaxy clustering when dealing with an incomplete galaxy catalog, by adding back galaxies to the incomplete catalog and distributing them in pixels according to the correlation function $ξ(r)$. We find that our method drastically improves on traditional ones when the galaxy catalog is only $1\%-10\%$ complete, leading to posteriors that are between 2 and 4 times as precise, depending on the completeness fraction, without introducing any biases. Our method produces results comparable to traditional methods at extremely low catalog completeness fractions (<0.5\%) or for very high uncertainties in the recovered luminosity distance and sky localization of the gravitational wave events.

analysis.title_zh: 并非所有缺失者都迷失了：利用不完整星系目录中的星系成团释放暗警报宇宙学潜力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论利用暗警报引力波事件与不完整星系目录的互相关来约束宇宙学，特别是与哈勃张力相关的距离—红移信息提取。作者提出用星系相关函数 ξ(r) 在像素中补充分布缺失星系的方法，摘要称在星系目录仅 1%–10% 完备时，相比传统均匀缺失星系假设可使后验精度提高约 2–4 倍且不引入偏差。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接研究 CMB，但与低红移宇宙学参数、尤其 Hubble tension 相关；其改进暗警报 H0 推断的方法可作为 CMB 推断所得 H0 的独立交叉检验，对理解 CMB 与晚期宇宙测量之间的张力有间接意义。
key_points: 研究暗警报引力波与不完整星系目录的互相关。
用星系相关函数 ξ(r) 为缺失星系建模，而非假设均匀分布。
摘要称在 1%–10% 完备度时可显著提高后验精度且不引入偏差。
methods: 暗警报引力波事件与星系目录互相关

papers.title: Cascades from ultra-high-energy neutrinos
papers.abstract: Neutrinos produced at the highest energies can interact with cosmic neutrino and radiation backgrounds during their propagation to Earth. The many available $νν$, $ν\barν$, and $νγ$ channels can lead to their absorption or energy redistribution, whilst the leptonic and hadronic final states may feed secondary fluxes of neutrinos, protons, and electromagnetic particles through the decay or hadronisation of the heavy leptons, bosons, and quarks produced. We present a framework to characterise these propagation effects in detail, \texttt{$ν$propa}, an extension of the CRPropa Monte Carlo code that interfaces with event generators and to dedicated computations of the relevant cross sections. It also treats flavour oscillations in vacuum. Using this code, we investigate sources at high redshifts ($z = 10$), and find a strong absorption of the prompt flux beyond~$\sim 10^{21} \; \text{eV}$, although the copious secondary neutrinos partially compensate this depletion, also contributing to the spectrum at lower energies. The framework is designed to study scenarios of cosmological neutrino production beyond~EeV energies such as superheavy dark matter, cosmic strings, and primordial black holes, and to yield reliable predictions for the forthcoming neutrino observatories.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 11 figures. To be submitted to JCAP. Comments are welcomed!

analysis.title_zh: 来自超高能中微子的级联
analysis.summary_zh: 该文研究超高能中微子在传播到地球途中与宇宙中微子背景和辐射背景相互作用导致的吸收、能量再分配和二级粒子级联。作者提出 νpropa 框架，并用其研究 z=10 源，摘要报告在约 10^21 eV 以上 prompt 通量强烈吸收，但二级中微子会部分补偿并贡献较低能量谱。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的联系在于超高能粒子传播依赖宇宙背景辐射和宇宙中微子背景；对早期宇宙遗迹背景、超重暗物质、宇宙弦和原初黑洞等宇宙学源的预言，会影响未来中微子天文台与 CMB/宇宙学约束的联合解释。
key_points: 超高能中微子传播中会与宇宙中微子背景和辐射背景相互作用。
作者提出 νpropa 框架，扩展 CRPropa 并接入事件发生器和截面计算。

papers.title: Thermodynamic reconstruction in observationally constrained dynamical dark energy models
papers.abstract: We perform an observational and thermodynamic analysis of four cosmological models $Λ$CDM, CPL, MPL, and the three-parameter MmAH parametrization. All dynamical models improve the fit relative to $Λ$CDM, with $Δχ^2 \sim 6$-$6.5$, with MPL providing the best fit, while MmAH remains viable. Although Bayesian evidence mildly favors $Λ$CDM due to its lower complexity, the dynamical dark energy models remain competitive alternatives given current observations. We then reconstruct thermodynamic quantities within observationally constrained cosmological models, extending previous theoretical studies. The bestfit heat capacity reconstruction indicates that the divergence associated with a second order thermodynamic phase transition coincides with the deceleration-acceleration transition only in $Λ$CDM, whereas for the dynamical dark energy models it occurs at distinct redshifts, suggesting that this coincidence is not universal. The generalized second law is satisfied for all models over $0 \le z \le 1$, while the Hessian analysis reveals a transient instability at the phase transition; however, the late time thermodynamic stability is model dependent, with CPL and MPL remaining stable and $Λ$CDM and MmAH failing to satisfy both stability conditions simultaneously. These results show that thermodynamic properties reconstructed within observationally constrained cosmological models provide a complementary probe of dark energy, with the thermodynamic phase transition emerging as an intrinsically model dependent phenomenon.

analysis.title_zh: 观测约束的动力学暗能量模型中的热力学重建
analysis.summary_zh: 本文对 ΛCDM、CPL、MPL 和 MmAH 四类宇宙学模型进行观测拟合并重建相应热力学量，以考察动力学暗能量的热力学特征。摘要报告动力学模型相对 ΛCDM 改善 χ² 约 6–6.5，但贝叶斯证据温和偏向 ΛCDM；热容量发散、广义第二定律和 Hessian 稳定性显示热力学相变与稳定性具有模型依赖性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗能量模型的选择会影响 CMB 与低红移观测联合推断中的背景膨胀历史和参数退化。该文提供一种热力学角度的互补检验，但从摘要看其结论仍依赖具体参数化和观测约束，适合作为暗能量模型比较的补充线索。
key_points: 比较 ΛCDM、CPL、MPL 和三参数 MmAH 暗能量模型。
摘要称动力学暗能量模型在 χ² 上优于 ΛCDM，但贝叶斯证据因复杂度较低而温和偏向 ΛCDM。
热力学相变与稳定性结论在不同模型中表现为模型依赖。

papers.title: SNAD: enabling discovery in the era of big data
papers.abstract: In the era of wide-field surveys and big data in astronomy, the SNAD team is exploiting the potential of modern datasets for discovering new, unforeseen, or rare astrophysical objects and phenomena with machine learning (ML). The SNAD pipeline was built under the hypothesis that, although automatic ML algorithms have a crucial role to play in this task, the scientific discovery is only completely realized when such systems are designed to boost the impact of domain knowledge experts. Our key contributions include the development of the Coniferest Python library, which offers implementations of two active learning algorithms with an ``expert in loop'', and the creation of the SNAD Transient Miner, facilitating the search for specific types of transients. We have also developed the SNAD Viewer, a web portal that provides a centralized view of individual objects from the Zwicky Transient Facility's (ZTF) data releases, making the analysis of potential anomalies more efficient. Finally, when applied to ZTF data, our approach has resulted in more than a hundred new supernova (SN) candidates, along with a few other non-catalogued objects, such as red dwarf flares, superluminous SNe, RS CVn type variables, and young stellar objects.
papers.comment: Frontier Research in Astrophysics - IV (FRAPWS2024), 9-14 September 2024, Mondello, Palermo, Italy
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of Science, Volume 482, published on: October 07, 2025

analysis.title_zh: SNAD：助力大数据时代的发现
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 SNAD 团队在宽场巡天和天文大数据时代利用机器学习发现新奇、罕见或未预期天体的工具链。摘要报告其贡献包括带“专家在环”的 Coniferest 主动学习库、瞬变源搜索工具和 ZTF 对象浏览门户，并在 ZTF 数据中得到百余个新的超新星候选体及若干其他未编目对象。
