Zwicky Transient Facility（ZTF）数据发布
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：这些“新候选体”的筛选标准、人工专家介入流程、训练/验证样本构成，以及异常发现的假阳性控制和后续证认程度。

papers.title: Building a Better Beta: Nucleation and Timescales in Cosmological Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: First-order phase transitions in the early universe can generate a stochastic background of gravitational waves, offering a unique probe of high-energy physics. In this work, we investigate aspects of bubble nucleation and transition timescales, which play a central role in shaping the resulting gravitational wave spectrum. Many common approaches characterise the transition rate via a Taylor expansion of the false vacuum decay rate. We argue that a more fundamental description is instead given by the distribution of bubble lifetimes, and define a new timescale, $β_ν$, as the first moment of this distribution. We show that $β_ν$ reproduces the behaviour of previous timescale definitions in the appropriate limits, while avoiding their pathologies, and offers a more natural description of the ensemble of nucleated bubbles. We then quantify the impact of this improved timescale on the predicted gravitational wave spectrum, finding that it shifts the peak amplitude by up to an order of magnitude relative to previous definitions. As next-generation gravitational wave detectors come online, robust theoretical predictions will be essential; we hope this work represents a step in that direction.

analysis.title_zh: 构建更好的 Beta：宇宙学相变中的成核与时间尺度
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究早期宇宙一阶相变中的气泡成核与转变时间尺度，并提出用气泡寿命分布的一阶矩来定义新的时间尺度 β_ν。摘要称该定义在合适极限下能复现既有做法且避免其病态，并会使预测的引力波谱峰值幅度相对旧定义发生可达数量级的变化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 一阶相变是很多早期宇宙引力波信号模型的核心，而时间尺度定义会直接影响谱形与可探测性预估。虽然这篇工作不直接讨论 CMB，但它关系到与 CMB 互补的早期宇宙探针，尤其是未来引力波背景搜索与粒子宇宙学模型的可靠建模。
key_points: 作者关注一阶相变中的气泡成核与持续时间刻画。
提出用气泡寿命分布的一阶矩定义新的时间尺度 β_ν。
该定义在适当极限下可复现旧定义行为，并减少旧方法中的病态；对引力波谱峰值幅度的预测会带来可观变化。
methods: 分析 false vacuum decay rate 的常见 Taylor 展开刻画
基于气泡寿命分布定义新时间尺度 β_ν
将新旧时间尺度用于引力波谱预测对比
讨论一阶相变核化与转变时间尺度的理论一致性
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最需要核对的是：β_ν 的严格定义、它与常用 β 参数/时间尺度之间的极限关系，以及引力波谱幅度变化是在哪些假设下得到的。还应注意摘要只说明了谱峰幅度变化，并未给出对具体模型的普适结论。

papers.title: Host Dependence and Line-of-Sight Effects on Galaxy-Galaxy Strong Lensing in Clusters
papers.abstract: The cross section for galaxy-galaxy strong lensing (GGSL) events in galaxy clusters has repeatedly been found to be higher in observations than in cosmological simulations. We revisit this discrepancy using updated simulation methodology and investigate the dependence of the GGSL probability, $P_{\rm GGSL}$, on host-cluster lensing properties, baryonic physics, and correlated and uncorrelated line-of-sight structure. We find that correlated material within $\sim 35$ cMpc of the cluster along the line of sight enhances $P_{\rm GGSL}$ by a few percent for typical systems and by up to $\sim15\%$ for the most efficient lenses. At fixed cluster mass, dark-matter-only simulations yield GGSL probabilities up to an order of magnitude lower than hydrodynamical simulations. We also find a strong dependence on the host-cluster Einstein radius, with an approximate scaling $P_{\rm GGSL} \propto θ_{\rm E}^{2}$. Matching simulated and observed clusters in both mass and Einstein radius seems to reduce the discrepancy relative to previous comparisons. However, our analysis does not clearly resolve the GGSL discrepancy, as the inferred tension depends strongly on the field-of-view definition: square fields are approximately consistent with simulations, while cluster member-bounded fields yield observed probabilities a factor of $\sim 2-3$ higher. Until observations and simulations share a matched selection function and matched measurement methodology, the residual tension cannot be cleanly attributed to either astrophysics or cosmology.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, submitted to ApJ, comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 宿主依赖性与视线方向效应对星系团中星系-星系强透镜的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文重新考察星系团中星系-星系强透镜事件观测截面高于宇宙学模拟的张力，研究宿主星系团透镜性质、重子物理以及视线方向结构对 GGSL 概率的影响。摘要报告称，相关视线物质可带来几个百分点到约 15% 的增强，流体模拟相较暗物质-only 模拟可显著提高概率，且与宿主爱因斯坦半径近似呈平方标度；但是否仍有张力取决于视场定义。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 强透镜统计常被用于检验星系团质量分布、重子物理和宇宙学模拟的可信度。虽然这篇论文不直接研究 CMB，但它触及从 CMB 约束的宇宙学模型出发形成的结构是否能同时解释小尺度透镜观测；若模拟与观测差异来自选择函数而非宇宙学，将影响对所谓宇宙学张力的解释。
key_points: 星系团中星系-星系强透镜截面长期存在观测高于模拟的张力。
视线方向相关结构、重子物理和宿主星系团爱因斯坦半径都会影响 GGSL 概率。
残余张力强烈依赖视场定义，作者强调需要匹配选择函数和测量方法。
methods: 更新的宇宙学模拟方法
暗物质-only 模拟与流体动力学模拟比较
考虑星系团附近约 35 cMpc 内相关视线结构及非相关视线结构
按星系团质量和爱因斯坦半径匹配模拟与观测样本
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 GGSL 概率和视场定义的具体测量方式、观测样本与模拟样本如何在质量和爱因斯坦半径上匹配，以及不同视线结构分量是否被一致纳入选择函数。

papers.title: The Structural Abundance Crisis of Massive Galaxies in Current Cosmological Simulations
papers.abstract: The internal structure of galaxies encodes the complex baryon cycle driven by gas accretion, star formation, and feedback, together with secular evolution and environmentally driven processes such as mergers and tidal interactions. We present a population-level census of massive nearby galaxies ($\log(M_\star/M_\odot) > 10$) by comparing Hyper Suprime-Cam Subaru Strategic Program observations with matched mock images from IllustrisTNG, EAGLE, and SIMBA. Using a consistent, like-for-like imaging pipeline, we construct structural abundance functions (SAFs) for key morphological parameters, revealing a structural abundance crisis. Across Sérsic index, concentration, size, and ellipticity, all simulations exhibit large, systematic discrepancies ($>5σ$; RMSE $\sim 0.2$--$1.8$\,dex), typically corresponding to abundance differences of factors of several. While individual simulations display diverse failures---underproducing or overproducing compact spheroids, extended or round galaxies ---all underproduce highly flattened disks. Although TNG shows the closest agreement and SIMBA the largest offsets, this shared failure indicates that current models---despite matching global demographics such as the stellar mass function---do not uniquely constrain internal galaxy structure. Our results demonstrate that agreement in integrated observables can mask fundamental shortcomings in the modelling of mass and angular momentum redistribution. We therefore establish SAFs as a stringent, multidimensional, and observationally accessible benchmark for testing and calibrating next-generation galaxy formation models in the era of upcoming deep, wide-field surveys.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, Accepted for publication in the Astrophysical Journal Letters

analysis.title_zh: 当前宇宙学模拟中大质量星系的结构丰度危机
analysis.summary_zh: 本文比较近邻大质量星系观测样本与 IllustrisTNG、EAGLE、SIMBA 模拟 mock 图像，在统一成像流程下构建 Sérsic 指数、集中度、尺寸和椭率等结构丰度函数。摘要称，所有模拟在多个结构参数上与 HSC 观测存在显著系统偏差，尤其共同低估高度扁平盘星系，显示仅匹配整体星系统计量不足以约束内部结构形成。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系形成模型是连接 CMB 初始条件、暗物质结构增长和低红移星系观测的关键环节。该工作指出当前大型宇宙学流体模拟在星系形态结构上仍有系统不足，这会影响用星系巡天进行弱透镜、星系聚类和前景建模时对星系-暗晕关系及重子反馈的理解。
key_points: 作者用统一成像流程比较 HSC 观测与 IllustrisTNG、EAGLE、SIMBA 模拟。
多种结构参数的丰度函数显示模拟与观测存在系统差异。
即使模拟能匹配恒星质量函数，也可能无法正确再现星系内部结构。
methods: Hyper Suprime-Cam Subaru Strategic Program 观测
IllustrisTNG、EAGLE 和 SIMBA 的匹配 mock images
一致的 like-for-like 成像处理流程
结构丰度函数 SAFs
Sérsic 指数、集中度、尺寸和椭率等形态参数比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对观测样本与模拟 mock 图像的匹配条件、表面亮度限制和形态测量流程，以及 SAF 中报告的显著性和 RMSE 是否受选择效应、成像深度或拟合系统误差主导。

papers.title: Seesaw and Axion in No-Scale Gravity
papers.abstract: The No-Scale gravity is a compelling framework to describe particle physics, gravity and cosmology, in which all mass scales are an illusion given by the value of a scalar field $φ$. This theory, however, falls under the umbrella of more general scalar-tensor theories, which propagate different modes depending on the scalar field, and faces the extensive debate regarding the equivalence between its Jordan and Einstein frame descriptions. In this work we advocate that by excluding the singular point in the transformation between the two frames (e.g., $φ=0$) we can have the classical equivalence between them. To show the merit of removing this singular point, we argue the Jordan frame makes the symmetries of the model manifest, which creates a suitable playground for the particle-physics model building which we illustrate by showing the emergence of discrete symmetries which leads to a high-quality axion and also naturally incorporate the seesaw mechanism.

analysis.title_zh: No-Scale 引力中的跷跷板机制与轴子
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 No-Scale gravity 框架中讨论质量尺度由标量场取值产生时，Jordan 与 Einstein 两种表述的经典等价性问题。摘要称，若排除两框架变换中的奇点，可保持经典等价，并且 Jordan 框架有利于显式展示对称性，从而构造包含高质量轴子和 seesaw 机制的粒子物理模型。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文属于粒子宇宙学与修正引力交叉方向，可能与早期宇宙、暗物质候选体轴子以及中微子质量起源相关。对 CMB 读者而言，主要相关性在于这类标量-张量或轴子模型可能影响早期宇宙动力学或暗物质物理；但摘要未给出具体 CMB 可观测预言。
key_points: 论文讨论 No-Scale gravity 中 Jordan 框架与 Einstein 框架的经典等价性问题。
作者主张排除两框架变换中的奇点后可保持经典等价。
在 Jordan 框架中展示离散对称性、高质量轴子和 seesaw 机制的模型构建可能性。
methods: No-Scale gravity 理论框架分析
标量-张量理论中的 Jordan frame 与 Einstein frame 比较
排除框架变换奇点的论证
粒子物理模型构建：离散对称性、轴子与 seesaw 机制
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对排除奇点的物理与数学合理性、Jordan 与 Einstein 框架等价性的适用范围，以及所谓高质量轴子和 seesaw 机制是否给出可检验的宇宙学或粒子物理后果。

papers.title: Primordial Black Hole Seeds for Little Red Dots in $f(R)$ Gravity
papers.abstract: The discovery by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) of an abundant population of compact little red dots (LRDs) and supermassive black holes at high redshifts poses a severe timing challenge for standard Eddington-limited growth from stellar remnants. In this work, we present a unified hybrid assembly framework in which intermediate-mass seed black holes are formed via hierarchical primordial black hole (PBH) mergers within dense clusters in Hu-Sawicki $f(R)$ gravity, followed by galactic gas accretion. We demonstrate that the screened $f(R)$ fifth force nonlinearly accelerates early seed formation through a quadratic enhancement of the gravitational-wave radiation-capture kernel, while environmental chameleon screening dynamically self-regulates the growth. Because subsequent gas accretion scales multiplicatively with seed mass, the $f(R)$ seed enhancement is preserved throughout the accretion history, drastically reducing the time-averaged Eddington ratios required to assemble $10^{6}\text{-}10^{9}\,M_{\odot}$ LRDs by cosmic dawn. Confronting our active mass functions with JWST data reveals that a small clustered PBH fraction ($f_{\rm PBH} \lesssim 10^{-3}$) under a realistic active galactic nucleus duty cycle ($δ\approx 10^{-2}$) naturally matches observed LRD space densities at $z \sim 5.5\text{-}6.5$ while remaining fully compliant with LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA limits, with modified gravity naturally driving the high-mass tail. Finally, we show that parameter degeneracies between modified gravity and cluster density can be cleanly broken by combining three multi-messenger diagnostics: remnant spin state signatures, a stochastic GW background cutoff, and a scale-dependent inversion in the PBH spatial correlation function.

analysis.title_zh: f(R) 引力中作为小红点种子的原初黑洞
analysis.summary_zh: 本文试图解释 JWST 发现的高红移 little red dots 与早期超大质量黑洞的快速形成问题，提出在 Hu-Sawicki f(R) 引力中，致密星团内 PBH 分层并合先形成中等质量种子黑洞，再通过气体吸积增长。摘要称修正引力的第五力可增强早期种子形成，并在小 PBH 成团比例和合理 AGN duty cycle 下匹配 z≈5.5–6.5 的 LRD 数密度，同时不违反现有引力波限制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要关联早期结构形成、原初黑洞暗物质、修正引力和高红移黑洞增长，而非直接 CMB 分析。对 CMB 读者的相关性在于：PBH 丰度、成团性和修正引力都受到早期宇宙扰动、CMB 各向异性、透镜和次级效应的约束；若该框架成立，也会影响对早期宇宙小尺度功率谱和暗物质组成的解释。
key_points: 提出 PBH 合并、修正引力增强成核、随后气体吸积的混合形成框架。
摘要称 Hu-Sawicki f(R) 中的筛选第五力可加速早期中等质量种子黑洞形成。
作者声称小的成团 PBH 比例与合理 AGN duty cycle 可匹配 JWST LRD 数密度并满足引力波限制。
methods: Hu-Sawicki f(R) 引力模型
致密星团中的 PBH 分层并合
引力波辐射俘获核的增强建模
星系气体吸积历史建模
与 JWST little red dots 观测质量函数/空间密度比较
与 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 限制比较
多信使诊断：遗迹自旋、随机引力波背景截止、PBH 空间相关函数
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 PBH 初始成团假设、f(R) 筛选机制在高红移致密环境中的适用性、与 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 约束的参数一致性，以及 JWST LRD 质量和活动占空比的系统不确定性是否足以改变结论。

papers.title: Spheroidal Resampling Analysis of High-Redshift Gamma-Ray Burst Spatial Densities
papers.abstract: Gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) are bright transient sources that can be observed at high redshift. They can therefore be used as tracers of the distant large-scale structure, although the GRB redshift sample is sparse and affected by strong selection effects. We analyze the three-dimensional distribution of 542 GRBs with spectroscopic redshifts. The method extends our earlier spherical-window search by replacing spherical counting volumes with axisymmetric spheroids. The angular positions of the observed GRBs are kept fixed in the Monte-Carlo null samples, while the redshifts are shuffled within each Galactic hemisphere. In the Northern Galactic hemisphere, the overdensity associated with the Hercules--Corona Borealis Great Wall remains significant for a range of spheroidal shapes. This supports the stability of the previously reported signal and shows that it is not only a consequence of using spherical counting volumes. In the Southern Galactic hemisphere, the same method finds no structure with comparable significance. A small candidate grouping is present, but its significance is only marginal, and it is sensitive to the small number of events. We conclude that spheroidal resampling is a useful check of GRB overdensity searches, but the physical nature of any candidate structure still requires confirmation with independent tracers such as galaxy or quasar samples.

analysis.title_zh: 高红移伽马射线暴空间密度的椭球重采样分析
analysis.summary_zh: 本文分析 542 个具有光谱红移的 GRB 三维分布，用轴对称椭球计数体替代球形窗口，并通过在银道半球内打乱红移构造 Monte Carlo 零假设样本。摘要报告北银半球与 Hercules–Corona Borealis Great Wall 相关的过密度在多种椭球形状下仍显著，而南银半球没有可比显著结构。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: GRB 可作为高红移大尺度结构的稀疏示踪体，因此这项工作触及宇宙大尺度均匀性和各向同性检验，这是 CMB 宇宙学的核心假设之一。若超大尺度结构信号得到独立确认，可能对与 CMB 推断相联系的宇宙学原理、结构形成统计和选择效应建模提出进一步检验。
key_points: 使用 542 个有光谱红移的 GRB 构建三维空间分布样本。
将以往球形窗口过密度搜索推广到轴对称椭球窗口。
摘要称北银半球的 Hercules–Corona Borealis Great Wall 相关过密度在一系列椭球形状下仍显著，但仍需独立示踪体确认。
methods: 542 个具有光谱红移的伽马射线暴样本
三维空间分布分析
轴对称椭球计数体/窗口搜索
Monte Carlo 零假设样本
固定角位置并在每个银道半球内打乱红移
南北银半球分别检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Monte Carlo 零假设是否充分刻画 GRB 探测选择效应和红移不完备性；还需检查所谓显著性是否经过窗口形状、位置和尺度扫描的 look-elsewhere 修正，并比较独立星系或类星体样本是否支持同一结构。

papers.title: Photon--Dark Matter Elastic Scattering: An Effective-Operator Scan and First Operator-Resolved Sensitivity Estimates from the Galactic Halo
papers.abstract: Elastic photon--dark matter scattering attenuates gamma-ray spectra along a line of sight, probing the same operators as dark matter annihilation to photons but at a rate linear, rather than quadratic, in dark matter density. We consider Standard Model gauge-invariant effective operators of mass-dimension 5 to 7, suppressed by a cutoff scale $Λ$, coupling scalar, Majorana or Dirac dark matter to the photon. The leading operators with non-vanishing real-photon amplitudes enter at dimension-5 for Dirac dark matter and dimension-7 for Majorana dark matter. In the electroweak-doublet dipole portal, the inelastic splitting invoked to evade direct detection also closes the CMB annihilation bound, leaving attenuation the only one of the three photon-sector probes that survives. Applying this to a pixel-level reanalysis of 17 years of \textit{Fermi}--LAT Pass~8 data toward the Galactic centre, we derive the first operator-resolved sensitivity estimates for photon--dark matter scattering from the Galactic halo: $Λ\simeq 0.32~\mathrm{GeV}$ for the dimension-5 Dirac dipoles, $0.21~\mathrm{GeV}$ for the dimension-6 scalar Rayleigh operator and $0.79$--$1.06~\mathrm{GeV}$ for the dimension-7 Rayleigh family. The reach is weak: it lies below the EFT-validity threshold across the cold dark matter mass range, and is superseded on the dipole plane by CMB and direct-detection constraints. The framework is calibrated against pseudo-experiments, and recomputes the sensitivity for any instrument that provides a per-bin spectrum with uncertainties and a line-of-sight column density.

analysis.title_zh: 光子—暗物质弹性散射：有效算符扫描及来自银河晕的首个按算符区分的灵敏度估计
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究光子—暗物质弹性散射导致伽马射线沿视线传播时的谱衰减，并用质量维数 5–7 的规范不变有效算符描述标量、Majorana 或 Dirac 暗物质与光子的耦合。摘要报告作者对 17 年 Fermi-LAT Pass 8 银河中心数据做像素级再分析，给出首个按算符区分的银河晕散射灵敏度估计，但认为当前可达范围较弱、低于冷暗物质质量范围内的 EFT 有效性门槛，且在偶极平面上被 CMB 和直接探测限制超过。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 暗物质约束直接相关：摘要明确比较了光子扇区的三类探针——湮灭到光子、光子—暗物质散射衰减、以及直接探测/CMB 约束，并指出某些非弹性劈裂情形会关闭 CMB 湮灭界限，使衰减成为幸存探针之一。对 CMB 研究者而言，它有助于理解 CMB 对暗物质—光子耦合或湮灭模型约束的互补性与局限。
key_points: 研究光子—暗物质弹性散射对伽马射线谱的沿视线衰减效应。
扫描质量维数 5–7 的标准模型规范不变有效算符，并给出按算符区分的灵敏度估计。
摘要称银河晕伽马射线衰减约束较弱，且在偶极情形被 CMB 和直接探测约束超过。
methods: 标准模型规范不变有效算符扫描
质量维数 5 到 7 的有效场论算符
17 年 Fermi-LAT Pass 8 数据
指向银河中心的像素级再分析
伪实验校准
逐能段谱及不确定度与视线柱密度输入的灵敏度重算框架
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对：有效场论适用性阈值如何定义并与给出的 Λ 灵敏度比较；CMB 湮灭约束在不同算符和非弹性劈裂假设下为何失效或仍然有效；Fermi-LAT 银河中心背景建模和视线暗物质柱密度的不确定性如何传播到灵敏度。

papers.title: How much of the black hole ringdown is sourced within the light ring?
papers.abstract: Not much. It has been proposed that applying a rational filter to a black hole ringdown gravitational waveform reveals a direct wave component sourced near the event horizon. By solving the Teukolsky equation for a point particle plunging into a Kerr black hole, I show that the maximum amplitude of the waves sourced within the prograde light ring is $\lesssim 10\%$ that of those sourced by the full trajectory no matter if the waves are filtered or not. This agrees with the interpretation of quasinormal modes as waves orbiting the light ring and the direct wave as the power of these modes redistributed in time. Therefore, both quasinormal modes and direct waves are more a probe of the light ring than the near-horizon region. For GW250114, I estimate that the component of the waves sourced within the light ring have a signal-to-noise ratio $ρ\lesssim 1$ measured after the peak of the filtered waves.

analysis.title_zh: 黑洞铃宕有多少源自光环以内？
analysis.summary_zh: 该文检验一种说法：对黑洞铃宕引力波施加有理滤波可显露近事件视界的直接波成分。作者通过求解点粒子坠入Kerr黑洞的Teukolsky方程，报告顺行光环以内产生的波振幅最多约为全轨迹贡献的10%，并认为铃宕准正则模和直接波更主要反映光环区域而非近视界区。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文主要属于引力波和强引力检验，和CMB观测没有直接联系。其宇宙学相关性在于黑洞引力波事件可作为独立的强场引力实验，并影响未来利用引力波进行基础物理和宇宙学推断时对波形物理含义的理解。
key_points: 检验黑洞铃宕波中有多少来自顺行光环以内。
通过粒子坠入Kerr黑洞的Teukolsky方程计算波形源贡献。
摘要称光环以内贡献的最大振幅不超过全轨迹贡献的约10%，铃宕和直接波更主要探测光环而非近视界区。
methods: 求解Teukolsky方程
点粒子坠入Kerr黑洞模型
黑洞铃宕引力波波形分析
有无有理滤波情况下的源区贡献比较
GW250114事件的滤波后峰值之后信噪比估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“光环以内”源贡献的定义、滤波器构造、点粒子近似对真实并合的适用性，以及GW250114信噪比估计依赖的波形和噪声假设。

papers.title: The onset of the strong backreaction regime in axion inflation, an analytical study
papers.abstract: Models where an axion-like inflaton is coupled to a $U(1)$ gauge field are theoretically well motivated and can display a rich phenomenology. The regime in which the quanta of the gauge field strongly backreact on the rolling inflaton has been studied for well more than a decade, and yet we cannot say that it is fully understood. In this paper we present an analytical study of the onset of the strong backreaction regime. Our formalism relies on a Laplace transform to convert a complicated integro-differential equation into the search of the poles of an analytic function. We confirm the existence, previously observed using a completely different formalism, of a stable region of strong backreaction. Our work provides, for the first time, analytical formulae that allow to study the evolution of the system as it transitions from the weak to the strong backreaction regime.

analysis.title_zh: 轴子暴胀中强反作用区间的开启：一项解析研究
analysis.summary_zh: 本文对轴子样暴胀子耦合 U(1) 规范场模型中强反作用 regime 的开启进行解析研究。摘要称，作者用拉普拉斯变换把复杂积分微分方程化为解析函数极点搜索，确认稳定强反作用区域的存在，并首次给出描述系统从弱反作用过渡到强反作用的解析公式。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暴胀模型的动力学会决定原初扰动的性质，进而影响 CMB 中的标量谱、张量模或潜在非高斯信号。该文偏理论，但若强反作用区间改变轴子暴胀的可观测预言，就会与 CMB 对早期宇宙模型的约束相关。
key_points: 研究轴子样暴胀子与 U(1) 规范场耦合模型中的强反作用开启。
使用拉普拉斯变换将复杂积分微分方程转化为解析函数极点问题。
确认了先前用不同形式发现的稳定强反作用区域，并给出描述弱到强反作用过渡的解析公式。
methods: 解析研究
拉普拉斯变换
积分微分方程到解析函数极点搜索的转化
轴子样暴胀子与 U(1) 规范场耦合模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对解析形式的适用范围：强反作用开启的判据、极点分析与原积分微分方程解之间的等价性，以及所得公式是否覆盖对 CMB 标量/张量扰动或非高斯性有观测影响的参数区间。

papers.title: Primordial black holes and induced gravitational waves from localized features in DBI inflation
papers.abstract: We investigate primordial black hole formation in a Dirac-Born-Infeld inflationary framework in which the background dynamics are determined by explicit functional forms of the inflaton potential $V(φ)$ and the warp factor $f(φ)$. The background equations are solved numerically to obtain the evolution of the slow-roll parameters. We show that a localized feature in the potential, accompanied by a correlated structure in the warp factor, dynamically induces a transient suppression of the slow-roll parameter, leading to a short-lived non-attractor phase. This behavior generates an enhancement of the curvature power spectrum on small scales, while preserving consistency with CMB-scale observables. The Mukhanov-Sasaki equation is then solved numerically to compute the resulting power spectrum, which exhibits narrow and localized peaks in the PBH abundance across different mass ranges. We also evaluate the associated stochastic background of induced gravitational waves and find that the predicted signal can fall within the sensitivity bands of future pulsar timing arrays and space-based interferometers, depending on the scale of the inflationary feature. A parameter scan in the $(r,n_s)$ plane shows that the large-scale predictions remain consistent with current observational constraints.

analysis.title_zh: DBI 暴胀中局域特征产生的原初黑洞与诱导引力波
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 Dirac-Born-Infeld 暴胀框架中研究局域势能特征及相关 warp factor 结构如何产生短暂非吸引子阶段，从而增强小尺度曲率功率谱并形成原初黑洞。摘要称作者数值求解背景与 Mukhanov-Sasaki 方程，得到不同质量范围的局域 PBH 丰度峰，并评估了可能进入未来脉冲星计时阵列和空间干涉仪灵敏度的诱导随机引力波背景，同时保持与 CMB 尺度观测量相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把 CMB 尺度的暴胀约束与小尺度曲率扰动、原初黑洞和诱导引力波联系起来；对 CMB 读者而言，关键在于模型如何在保持 n_s、r 等大尺度可观测量满足当前约束的同时，在小尺度产生足够强的功率谱增强。
key_points: 研究 DBI 暴胀中局域特征导致的 PBH 形成。
局域势能特征与 warp factor 结构触发短暂非吸引子阶段并增强小尺度曲率功率谱。
摘要称大尺度预测仍与当前观测约束一致，诱导引力波可能落入未来实验灵敏度范围。
methods: 数值求解背景演化方程
数值计算慢滚参数演化
数值求解 Mukhanov-Sasaki 方程
计算曲率功率谱、PBH 丰度和诱导随机引力波背景
在 (r,n_s) 平面进行参数扫描
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 CMB 尺度可观测量与小尺度功率谱增强能否在同一参数选择下同时成立，以及 PBH 丰度和诱导引力波计算对非高斯性、再入历史和约束条件的处理。

papers.title: Reconstructing stochastic gravitational-wave signals from flavour deconstruction with LISA
papers.abstract: We investigate the reconstruction of a stochastic gravitational-wave background generated by a first-order phase transition in flavour-deconstruction models using the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). In these scenarios, the spontaneous breaking of an extended flavour-non-universal gauge symmetry at the TeV scale can both generate the observed hierarchies of Standard Model fermion masses and mixing angles and induce a strong first-order phase transition. We consider representative benchmark points of the model, compute the corresponding thermodynamic transition parameters, and construct the resulting gravitational-wave spectra using a state-of-the-art sound-wave template. We then inject these spectra into simulated LISA data and perform Bayesian inference with SGWBinner, jointly reconstructing the cosmological signal, instrumental noise, and astrophysical foregrounds. We find that the strongest benchmark signal can be successfully reconstructed, whereas weaker signals are substantially degenerate with the unresolved extragalactic compact-binary foreground. We further show that tighter prior information on this foreground, motivated by observations with ground-based detectors, can reduce this degeneracy and improve signal reconstruction. Our results demonstrate that flavour-deconstruction models can produce signals accessible to LISA, while highlighting the importance of astrophysical-foreground modelling for their identification and characterization.

analysis.title_zh: 用 LISA 重建来自 flavour deconstruction 的随机引力波信号
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 flavour-deconstruction 模型中 TeV 标度强一阶相变产生的随机引力波背景能否由 LISA 重建。作者将模型引力波谱注入模拟 LISA 数据，并用 SGWBinner 进行贝叶斯联合重建；摘要报告最强基准信号可成功重建，而较弱信号与未分辨河外致密双星前景存在明显简并，收紧该前景先验可改善重建。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作不直接涉及 CMB 观测，但与早期宇宙相变和随机引力波背景有关，是 CMB 之外检验新物理和宇宙热史的重要互补窗口。其关于天体物理前景建模影响信号识别的结论，也与 CMB 随机背景、B 模式或谱畸变等弱信号分析中的前景退化问题在方法论上相通。
key_points: 研究 TeV 标度 flavour-deconstruction 模型一阶相变产生的随机引力波背景。
用模拟 LISA 数据和贝叶斯推断同时重建宇宙学信号、仪器噪声与天体物理前景。
强信号基准点可被重建，弱信号与未分辨河外致密双星前景显著简并。
methods: 代表性模型基准点
热力学相变参数计算
state-of-the-art sound-wave template
模拟 LISA 数据注入
SGWBinner 贝叶斯推断
联合重建宇宙学信号、仪器噪声和天体物理前景
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：所选基准点是否覆盖模型的关键参数空间，声波模板与相变参数计算的适用条件，以及对河外致密双星前景先验的假设是否会主导可探测性结论。

papers.title: Comment on `Measuring the Hubble Constant Using Strongly Lensed Gravitational Wave Signals'
papers.abstract: In Huang et al (JCAP08(2023)003), the work claimed that the Hubble constant can be constrained from lensed gravitational waves, despite the absence of information on GW source redshift or Einstein radius (angular size of the lens), as long as lens redshift is provided independently. To demonstrate, the authors set up a singular isothermal sphere lens model and applied Fisher information matrix and Bayesian parameter estimation on injected lensed GWs. However, their conclusion contradicts our previous work on degeneracies of GW lens system parameters. In this comment, we illustrate that Hubble constant cannot be measured with lens redshift alone, in the absence of source redshift or (Einstein radius).

analysis.title_zh: 关于“利用强透镜引力波信号测量哈勃常数”的评论
analysis.summary_zh: 本文评论 Huang et al. 关于用强透镜引力波测量哈勃常数的结论。摘要称，在缺少引力波源红移或透镜爱因斯坦半径角尺度信息时，即使独立给出透镜红移，也不能测量 Hubble 常数，因为存在透镜系统参数简并。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 哈勃常数张力是 CMB 宇宙学与低红移距离标尺之间的核心问题之一，强透镜引力波被视为潜在独立探针。该评论提醒读者，若关键红移或角尺度信息缺失，所谓独立测量 H0 的能力可能被参数简并削弱，因此对评估未来引力波宇宙学能否缓解 H0 张力很重要。
key_points: 该文是对一篇用强透镜引力波测量哈勃常数工作的评论。
作者指出仅有透镜红移、而无源红移或爱因斯坦半径信息时，不能测量 Hubble 常数。
核心问题是强透镜引力波系统参数之间的简并。
methods: 奇异等温球透镜模型的概念性检验
与既有参数简并性工作的对照
针对 Fisher 信息矩阵和贝叶斯参数估计结论的评论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者给出的不可测性论证具体依赖哪些透镜观测量，以及原文 Fisher/Bayesian 注入分析是否通过隐含先验或参数设定打破了本应存在的简并。

papers.title: Investigating the magnetic field in the inter-cluster filament between Abell 3667 and Abell 3651 with POSSUM
papers.abstract: [Abridged abstract] The objective of this study is to measure the magnetic field within the prominent inter-cluster filament recently detected in X-rays by the extended ROentgen Survey with an Imaging Telescope Array (eROSITA). This filament spans over 13 Mpc projected on the sky, connecting the galaxy clusters Abell 3667 and Abell 3651. We employed the Polarisation Sky Survey of the Universe's Magnetism (POSSUM) Rotation Measure (RM) grid to isolate the RM dispersion and median value of background polarised sources induced by the filament's magnetised plasma, and to infer the strength of this magnetic field. The filament region is sampled by 54 background polarised sources. After subtracting the foreground Galactic RM, we detected a marginal residual RM dispersion in the filament region of $6.9\pm3.6$ rad/m$^{2}$, together with a coherent residual RM signal with median $6.3\pm1.3$ rad/m$^{2}$. Assuming simplified single-scale magnetic-field models and adopting informed priors on the thermal electron density distribution derived from the X-ray analysis, we constrained the magnetic field strength to the range 0.1-3.5 $μ$G within 95$\%$ confidence, with preferred values around 0.2-0.3 $μ$G depending on the assumed magnetic-field coherence scale. However, we also found that the Galactic foreground RM in this region is highly structured on angular scales comparable to the extent of the filament itself, representing a major source of uncertainty for the RM analysis. Our results provide the first magnetic field constraints based on Faraday rotation measurements in an individual X-ray-detected inter-cluster filament, with field strengths consistent with theoretical expectations for gas in bridges and cluster outskirts. Our analysis also highlights the critical importance of accurately modelling Galactic RM foregrounds for future studies of extra-galactic magnetism with POSSUM and the SKA.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 POSSUM 研究 Abell 3667 与 Abell 3651 之间星系团际纤维中的磁场
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 POSSUM 的法拉第旋转量度网格，研究 eROSITA 在 Abell 3667 与 Abell 3651 之间发现的约 13 Mpc 星系团际纤维中的磁场。摘要报告在扣除银河前景后得到边缘残余 RM 离散和相干残余 RM 信号，并在简化磁场模型及 X 射线电子密度先验下给出 0.1–3.5 μG 的磁场强度约束，同时强调银河 RM 前景结构是主要不确定性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团际纤维的磁场与宇宙大尺度结构、重子分布和宇宙磁场起源相关，属于 CMB 之外的低红移宇宙学环境探针。对 CMB 读者而言，该研究尤其提示银河偏振/旋转量度前景在弱信号提取中的关键作用；这与 CMB 偏振前景建模和未来大面积巡天的系统误差控制有直接方法学关联。
key_points: 利用 POSSUM 旋转量度网格研究 Abell 3667 与 Abell 3651 间 X 射线探测到的星系团际纤维磁场。
54 个背景偏振源用于估计纤维区的残余 RM 离散和中位数信号。
推断磁场强度约束为 0.1–3.5 μG（95% 置信），但银河 RM 前景结构是主要不确定性。
methods: POSSUM Rotation Measure grid
背景偏振源法拉第旋转测量
银河前景 RM 扣除
eROSITA X 射线分析给出的热电子密度先验
简化单尺度磁场模型
RM 离散和中位数统计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对银河 RM 前景建模和扣除方法是否足以支撑纤维本征 RM 信号，单尺度磁场模型与电子密度先验对磁场强度区间的影响有多大。

papers.title: Inspiralling Binary merger parameter reconstruction with lunar and satellite Laser Ranging
papers.abstract: Precision tracking of Earth--Moon and Earth--satellite ranges offers a novel, low-frequency avenue for detecting gravitational waves from inspiralling massive black hole binaries, complementary to space-based interferometers. In this paper, we propose a first study of the reconstruction of the binary parameters from a synthetic set of range observations. \textit{Set-up}: Assuming an ideal unperturbed Keplerian motion for the earth-satellite binary, we develop a framework for reconstructing the chirp mass $\mathcal M_c$ and luminosity distance $D_L$ of chirping sources from the perturbations they induce on ranging observables, using both Lunar Laser Ranging (LLR) and a two-satellite ranging configuration (GUEST) as concrete case studies. \textit{Result}: We find that chirp-mass recovery tightly converges as a power law in SNR ($σ_{M_c}/M_c \propto \mathrm{SNR}^α$, $α\simeq -1$ to $-1.8$) for both LLR and GUEST. In contrast, the luminosity distance suffers from a severe, SNR-independent degeneracy with the sky-orientation angles in the LLR configuration, yielding fractional biases and uncertainties of tens to over a hundred percent regardless of signal strength. The two-satellite GUEST configuration breaks this degeneracy and restores a convergent, SNR-dependent recovery of $D_L$ comparable in scaling to that of the chirp mass. These results demonstrate that multi-baseline ranging architectures are essential for extracting luminosity-distance information from ranging-based gravitational wave searches, while chirp-mass measurements remain reliably accessible even with a single ranging baseline such as the Earth--Moon system.
papers.comment: 20 pages, way too many figures, and appendices

analysis.title_zh: 利用月球和卫星激光测距重建内旋双星并合参数
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究利用地月和地—卫星精密测距探测并重建并合大质量黑洞双星低频引力波参数的可能性。摘要报告，在合成观测和理想开普勒设定下，啁啾质量可随信噪比稳定收敛，而 LLR 单基线对光度距离存在严重取向退化，双卫星 GUEST 构型可恢复其随信噪比改善的重建。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接研究 CMB，但涉及引力波标准汽笛可能给出的光度距离信息，因而与独立宇宙学距离尺度、黑洞并合史和低频引力波探测互补性有关。对 CMB 研究者而言，它的价值主要在于未来多信使宇宙学中与 CMB 参数约束相互校验的潜在路径。
key_points: 提出用地月测距与双卫星测距的低频引力波参数重建框架。
啁啾质量的恢复随信噪比按幂律收敛。
单一地月基线下光度距离与天空取向角存在严重退化，双基线构型可缓解。
methods: 合成测距观测
理想无扰开普勒运动假设
月球激光测距（LLR）
双卫星测距构型（GUEST）
由测距扰动重建啁啾质量和光度距离
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对理想开普勒轨道与未建模扰动的假设是否会高估参数重建能力，尤其是光度距离—天空取向角退化在更真实噪声和多体动力学下是否仍能被 GUEST 构型有效打破。

papers.title: Lynx2030 Science Analysis Group: Final Report
papers.abstract: The Lynx2030 Science Analysis Group (SAG) was convened to reassess the scientific goals and technical drivers of the Lynx mission concept amid a rapidly evolving astrophysics landscape. Building on the original Lynx Concept Study, the SAG examined how recent discoveries, emerging facilities, and advances in instrumentation influence the scientific opportunities for a next-generation flagship X-ray observatory. Through focused working groups, the SAG investigated the scientific impact of enhanced capabilities: (i) improved angular resolution, (ii) broader bandpass coverage, (iii) an enhanced microcalorimeter, (iv) new capabilities and observing modes, and (v) larger fields of view. Across a broad range of topics, from the formation of the first black holes and the evolution of galaxies to the baryon cycle, compact objects, stellar explosions, multi-messenger astrophysics, and the dynamic high-energy Universe, the SAG finds that the scientific motivation for a Lynx-class observatory remains compelling and, in many areas, has significantly strengthened over the past decade, prominently through JWST's discovery of the "Little Red Dots", likely massive accreting black holes in infant galaxies whose nature is fundamentally an X-ray question. This report shows that modest extensions beyond the original Lynx design reference mission can unlock transformative science while preserving the observatory's core architecture. Powerful current and future facilities such as Roman, Rubin, JWST, SKA, ngVLA, LISA, and NewAthena highlight the unique role a high-angular-resolution, high-throughput X-ray observatory would play in the multi-wavelength and multi-messenger ecosystem of the 2030s and beyond. The findings of the Lynx2030 SAG confirm Lynx's central vision: an unprecedented view of the hot and energetic Universe, enabling discoveries that will define high-energy astrophysics in the coming decades.
papers.comment: White paper based on the Final Report by NASA's Lynx2030 Science Analysis Group

analysis.title_zh: Lynx2030 科学分析组：最终报告
analysis.summary_zh: 本文是 Lynx2030 Science Analysis Group 的最终报告，重新评估 Lynx 任务概念在当前天体物理背景下的科学目标和技术需求。摘要称，通过多个专题工作组的分析，报告认为 Lynx 级高角分辨率、高通量 X 射线天文台的科学动机仍然强，并因 JWST 等新发现而进一步增强。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该报告不是 CMB 论文，但与宇宙学观测生态有关：下一代 X 射线设施可追踪早期吸积黑洞、星系形成反馈和宇宙重子循环，这些主题影响再电离、热气体分布和大尺度结构解释。对 CMB 研究者而言，它更像是多波段互补观测路线图，可为 CMB 透镜、SZ 效应和星系团/热气体建模提供外部信息。
key_points: 这是 Lynx2030 科学分析组对下一代旗舰级 X 射线天文台科学目标与技术驱动的总结报告。
报告强调高角分辨率、高通量 X 射线观测在研究早期黑洞、星系演化、重子循环和多信使天体物理中的独特作用。
JWST 发现的 Little Red Dots 被列为加强 Lynx 科学动机的重要新背景，其本质被摘要称为根本上需要 X 射线回答的问题。
methods: 科学分析组报告与专题工作组评估
对改进角分辨率、更宽能段覆盖、增强微量热计、新观测模式和更大视场的科学影响分析
与 Roman、Rubin、JWST、SKA、ngVLA、LISA、NewAthena 等设施的多波段/多信使协同定位
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对哪些科学目标真正要求超出原 Lynx 设计的能力扩展，以及这些扩展与 CMB/宇宙学相关问题，如早期黑洞、重子循环和星系形成反馈，之间是否有明确可检验的观测指标。

papers.title: Super-Eddington Little Blue Dots May Reionize Helium Too Early
papers.abstract: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has identified an abundant population of faint Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) at $z \gtrsim 4$ which display broad emission lines, compact morphologies, and blue ultraviolet--optical continua. These ``Little Blue Dots' (LBDs) have been suggested to belong to the same family of objects as the more controversial ``Little Red Dots' (LRDs), with differences between the two largely owing to viewing angle effects. In this scenario, super-Eddington accretion resulting in high Extreme UV (EUV) and weak X-ray emission is invoked to explain the properties of both populations. We study the consequences of this super-Eddington scenario for the timing of Helium reionization. We find that observations which support an end to helium reionization no earlier than $z \approx 3$ disfavor scenarios in which the majority of observed $3 \lesssim z \lesssim 7$ LBDs are highly super-Eddington. For our fiducial super-Eddington accretion scenario, we find that the fraction of the LBD population in this state must be $\lesssim 10\%$, assuming LBDs make up $5\%$ of the $M_{ m UV} < -18$ galaxy population and have average escape fractions of $15\%$, comparable to recent observations. Our constraint assumes that LBDs dominate the Helium reionization budget, and would be tighter if bright quasars also contributed significantly. For a majority of LBDs to be super-Eddington, they would need to have small escape fractions ($\lesssim 1.5\%$) and/or be less abundant than observations suggest. Our conclusions are sensitive to the shape of the EUV spectra of super-Eddington black holes, motivating further study.
papers.comment: 9+1 pages, 4+1 figures, submitted to ApJL. Comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: 超爱丁顿 Little Blue Dots 也许会过早再电离氦
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察 JWST 发现的高红移 Little Blue Dots 若处于超爱丁顿吸积状态，对氦再电离时序的影响。摘要报告，若多数 z≈3–7 的 LBD 高度超爱丁顿，将倾向于使氦再电离过早发生；在其基准情景下，满足观测要求的超爱丁顿 LBD 比例需较低，除非逃逸分数很小或丰度低于观测暗示。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离史是 CMB 大尺度偏振和光学深度解释的重要背景，虽然氦再电离主要发生在较低红移、不同于氢再电离对 CMB 的主要贡献，但它影响热历史和高红移辐射源建模。该文把 JWST 高红移 AGN 候选体与电离历史联系起来，对理解早期黑洞增长及其宇宙学反馈有直接意义。
key_points: JWST 发现的高红移 Little Blue Dots 若普遍超爱丁顿，会产生强 EUV 辐射。
摘要称氦再电离不早于 z≈3 的观测会排斥多数 LBD 高度超爱丁顿的情形。
结论对超爱丁顿黑洞的 EUV 谱形、逃逸分数和 LBD 丰度敏感。
methods: JWST 高红移 LBD 观测背景
氦再电离时序约束
超爱丁顿吸积情景建模
EUV 与 X 射线辐射假设
逃逸分数与星系族群占比参数
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对氦再电离历史的观测先验、LBD 的数密度和逃逸分数假设，以及超爱丁顿 EUV 谱形如何进入电离预算；这些假设直接决定“多数 LBD 不能高度超爱丁顿”的强度。

papers.title: AXIS Could Have Accessed Dark Matter Decays
papers.abstract: The Advanced X-ray Imaging Satellite (AXIS) was a mission concept designed to improve upon the sensitivity and spatial resolution of the Chandra X-ray Observatory and XMM-Newton. Although AXIS was not selected for implementation, the concept study defined a mature instrument design with low-background, arcsecond imaging over the $0.3$-$10$ keV energy range, a large effective area, and a wide field of view. These capabilities provide a useful benchmark for the dark matter decay sensitivity of future X-ray observatories. We estimate the reach of a future AXIS-like instrument for narrow photon lines from decaying keV-scale dark matter, including axion-like particles and sterile neutrinos. For Galactic center observations, we find projected lifetime sensitivities of order $10^{31}$ s, improving upon existing limits by up to an order of magnitude over part of the keV mass range.

analysis.title_zh: AXIS 本可探测暗物质衰变
analysis.summary_zh: 本文以未获实施的 AXIS 任务概念作为未来 X 射线望远镜性能基准，估计其搜索 keV 级衰变暗物质窄光子线的能力。摘要报告，针对银河中心观测，类 AXIS 仪器对暗物质寿命的预期灵敏度可达约 10^31 秒，并在部分 keV 质量范围比现有限制提高最多约一个数量级。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质的微观性质是 CMB 宇宙学参数解释的核心背景之一；CMB 精确测量主要约束暗物质的总丰度和部分能量注入效应，而 X 射线衰变线搜索可检验具体 keV 暗物质候选体。该文为未来高分辨率 X 射线任务与 CMB 所给暗物质丰度框架之间的互补性提供了一个灵敏度基准。
key_points: 评估类 AXIS 未来 X 射线望远镜对 keV 级衰变暗物质窄线的灵敏度。
目标包括轴子样粒子和惰性中微子等候选体。
摘要称银河中心观测的寿命灵敏度可达约 10^31 秒，并在部分质量范围改进现有限制。
methods: AXIS-like 仪器性能基准
0.3–10 keV X 射线能段
低背景角秒成像设定
银河中心观测预估
窄光子线衰变暗物质灵敏度估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对暗物质晕分布、天体 X 射线背景建模、能量分辨率与线搜索统计方法；这些因素会显著影响寿命灵敏度预估和与现有限制的比较。

papers.title: Exploring the sensitivity of in-ice radio detectors to cosmic ray mass composition
papers.abstract: In-ice radio detectors have been developed primarily for the detection of high-energy neutrinos via the Askaryan effect, but have recently been shown to also be sensitive to cosmic ray air showers impacting the ice sheet. Using CORSIKA 8 to simulate impacting air showers, we find that the lateral width of the in-ice cascade is sensitive to the atomic mass of the primary cosmic ray. The width of the shower core is accessible through the shape of the Askaryan radio spectrum, while the amplitude encodes the total in-ice charge excess. Using these two observables, we show that in-ice radio detectors can be used to measure cosmic ray mass composition in the region above $10^{17}$eV, if the in-ice receivers are placed to adequately sample the Askaryan emission pattern. We also show that the in-ice core width is highly, but not exactly, correlated with the depth of maximum particle count ($\mathrm{X}_{\mathrm{max}}$), the most commonly-used observable for reconstructing cosmic ray mass composition.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 11th International Workshop on Acoustic and Radio EeV Neutrino Detection Activities, ARENA 2026

analysis.title_zh: 探索冰内射电探测器对宇宙线质量组成的灵敏度
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究原本用于高能中微子 Askaryan 探测的冰内射电探测器，是否也能通过入射到冰盖的宇宙线空气簇射来测量 10^17 eV 以上的宇宙线质量组成。摘要称，CORSIKA 8 模拟显示冰内级联的横向宽度与原初宇宙线质量有关，簇射核宽度可由 Askaryan 射电频谱形状获取，而振幅编码总电荷过量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作属于高能宇宙线与中微子探测方法学，对 CMB 本身关联较弱；但宇宙线质量组成影响高能天体物理背景和粒子天体物理源模型，是多信使宇宙学背景知识的一部分。对 CMB 研究者而言，主要相关性在于大型低背景探测、射电信号建模和南极/冰环境实验技术，而非 CMB 各向异性或宇宙学参数。
key_points: 研究冰内射电探测器是否可用于宇宙线质量组成测量。
CORSIKA 8 模拟显示冰内级联横向宽度对原初宇宙线原子质量敏感。
需要接收机充分采样 Askaryan 辐射图样才能利用这些观测量。
methods: CORSIKA 8 空气簇射模拟
Askaryan 射电频谱形状用于获取簇射核宽度
射电振幅用于表征冰内总电荷过量
与 Xmax 的相关性比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对质量组成灵敏度对探测器几何布置、冰介质模型、Askaryan 发射采样充分性以及强子相互作用模型的依赖；还应确认“与 Xmax 高度但非完全相关”在重建中如何转化为可用的质量判别能力。

papers.title: Fast and efficient nested sampling with BEST
papers.abstract: Nested sampling is widely used for Bayesian evidence computation, but its intrinsically sequential structure limits how efficiently it can exploit modern vectorised likelihoods and emulators. We present a new nested-sampling implementation in \textsc{best}, written entirely in TensorFlow and designed for efficient XLA compilation on both CPUs and GPUs. The sampler combines clustering and slice sampling with the possibility of updating several live points simultaneously. Since batching breaks the strict ordering of conventional nested sampling, we introduce sorting and history-based corrections to reduce the resulting bias in the evidence estimate. We test the sampler on Gaussian, Rosenbrock, and multimodal likelihoods and compare its performance with JAXNS and UltraNest. The results show that accurate evidence estimates can be retained for moderate batch sizes, with $m/N_{\rm live}\lesssim 0.1$ providing a useful practical regime. Finally, using a 27-dimensional cosmological likelihood emulator, we show that batched live-point updates can substantially reduce the wall-clock time while remaining consistent with sequential sampling within the reported uncertainties. The new implementation therefore extends \textsc{best} with an efficient nested-sampling method tailored to fast, vectorised likelihoods and emulator-based inference.

analysis.title_zh: 使用 BEST 进行快速高效的嵌套采样
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 BEST 中一种完全用 TensorFlow 编写、适合 XLA 在 CPU/GPU 上编译的快速嵌套采样实现，目标是更好利用现代向量化似然和 emulator。摘要称，该方法通过聚类、slice sampling 和批量 live-point 更新提高效率，并用排序及历史校正减小 evidence 偏差；在标准测试和 27 维宇宙学似然仿真器上，适中批量大小可保持 evidence 精度并降低墙钟时间。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 与大尺度结构参数推断常需要贝叶斯 evidence、模型比较和高维后验采样，计算代价很高。若该类批量嵌套采样能可靠利用 emulator 与 GPU/CPU 向量化，就可能加速宇宙学模型选择、系统误差模型比较以及联合数据分析。
key_points: BEST 提供基于 TensorFlow/XLA 的嵌套采样实现，面向 CPU/GPU 上的向量化似然。
方法允许批量更新多个 live points，并用排序与历史校正降低 evidence 偏差。
在 27 维宇宙学似然仿真器示例中，批量更新可减少墙钟时间且与顺序采样在报告不确定度内一致。
methods: 嵌套采样
TensorFlow 实现与 XLA 编译
CPU/GPU 向量化似然与仿真器
聚类与 slice sampling
多个 live points 同时更新的批处理
排序校正与基于历史的校正
Gaussian、Rosenbrock、多峰似然测试
与 JAXNS 和 UltraNest 比较
27 维宇宙学似然 emulator
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对批量更新破坏传统嵌套采样严格排序后，evidence 偏差校正的推导与适用条件，特别是 m/N_live≲0.1 这一实用范围在复杂宇宙学后验、多峰结构和真实似然中的稳定性。

papers.title: Enhancing Cosmological Constraints from Foreground-Cleaned CMB Maps Using Large-Scale Structure Surveys
papers.abstract: Extragalactic foregrounds contaminate cosmic microwave background (CMB) temperature maps at small angular scales and limit their utility for precision cosmology. The internal linear combination (ILC) is a well-known technique for suppressing these contaminants, but residual foreground power remains a limiting factor. Kusiak et al. (2023) proposed adding galaxy number-density maps as additional ILC channels, exploiting their correlation with the large-scale structure sourcing these foregrounds to suppress contamination. Here we apply this framework to forecast the gains in CMB-based cosmological parameter constraints from near- and next-generation experiments. Using a halo-model foreground pipeline and a Fisher forecast from joint TT+TE+EE power spectra, we quantify the improvement from galaxy-tracer-assisted ILC cleaning across three configurations: enhanced Simons Observatory (SO) with unWISE or Rubin-like galaxy catalogs, and a futuristic CMB-HD configuration with a hypothetical deep galaxy survey. We find that adding galaxy tracers reduces the residual foreground power in the cleaned temperature map by $\sim4\%$, $\sim22\%$, and $\sim32\%$ at $\ell\sim10,000$ for the unWISE, Rubin-like, and futuristic samples, respectively. For the overall variance of the cleaned map at $\ell\sim10,000$, it provides $8\%$, $24\%$, and $17\%$ improvements for each combination. The resulting reduction in marginalized parameter error bars is modest for the base six-parameter $Λ$CDM model: sub-percent for SO+unWISE, rising to $\sim2\%$ for SO+Rubin-like tracer. Including the effective number of relativistic species $N_{\rm eff}$, we find at most $2.2\%$ improvements for both SO+Rubin-like and CMB-HD+Futuristic tracer. These results establish the expected gains from combining near-term CMB experiments with current and forthcoming large-scale-structure surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 利用大尺度结构巡天增强前景清理后 CMB 图的宇宙学约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究利用大尺度结构巡天中的星系数密度图辅助 ILC 清理 CMB 温度图小尺度星系外前景，并用 halo-model 前景管线与 TT+TE+EE Fisher 预报评估 SO、Rubin-like 和 CMB-HD 等配置下的参数约束增益。摘要报告在 ℓ≈10,000 处残余前景功率和清理后图的总方差可降低，但对六参数 ΛCDM 和 Neff 的边缘化误差条改善多为百分之几以内。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 小角尺度 CMB 温度各向异性受 tSZ、CIB、射电源等星系外前景限制，是未来 CMB 精密宇宙学的重要系统误差来源。该工作直接评估 CMB 实验与星系巡天联合清理前景能否转化为 ΛCDM 和 Neff 等参数约束的提升，对 SO、Rubin 和 CMB-HD 时代的联合分析策略有参考价值。
key_points: 研究把星系数密度图作为额外 ILC 通道，用于降低 CMB 温度图的小尺度星系外前景残留。
基于 halo-model 前景管线和 TT+TE+EE Fisher 预报，评估 SO、Rubin-like、CMB-HD 等组合的参数约束增益。
摘要报告：前景残留功率可有可观下降，但对 ΛCDM 与 Neff 参数误差条的改善总体较温和。
methods: internal linear combination（ILC）前景清理
加入 galaxy number-density maps 作为额外 ILC channels
halo-model foreground pipeline
基于 joint TT+TE+EE power spectra 的 Fisher forecast
配置包括 enhanced Simons Observatory、unWISE、Rubin-like galaxy catalogs、CMB-HD、hypothetical deep galaxy survey
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：星系示踪物与各类星系外前景的相关性如何建模，ILC 加入 LSS 通道是否引入 CMB 信号损失或宇宙学参数偏差，以及 Fisher 预报中前景残差协方差和实验噪声假设是否稳健。

papers.title: Follow-up of SN 2025wny V: Lens Modelling and Cosmography of a Strongly Lensed Superluminous Supernova at $z = 2.015$ using Space Data
papers.abstract: We present a lensing and cosmographic analysis of the strongly lensed Type I superluminous supernova SN 2025wny at redshift $z=2.015$, multiply imaged by two foreground galaxies at $z=0.376$. Using imaging obtained with the Hubble Space Telescope and the James Webb Space Telescope, we model the lens system with two elliptical power-law mass distributions and an external shear component. In addition to the supernova image positions, the modelling incorporates the surface-brightness distribution of the lensed host galaxy. The inferred Einstein radii are $θ_{\rm E,1}\simeq 1.6$" and $θ_{\rm E,2}\simeq 0.7$ - $0.8$", with broadly consistent results across all filters. After accounting for microlensing by stars in the lens galaxies, the posterior distribution spans total magnifications of approximately $μ_{\rm tot}\sim 5$--$50$, with flux ratios of the multiple images consistent with observations. Combining the lens models with spectroscopically and photomerically measured time delays yields a filter-marginalized constraint of \[ H_0 = 66.7^{+7.6}_{-6.3}\; {\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}, \] for a fiducial model with isothermal mass profiles. Allowing the density slopes of the lens galaxies to vary over a broad range results in \[ H_0 = 70.8^{+8.2}_{-6.1}\; {\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}. \] These values are conditional on the adopted parameterization of the lens mass distribution, the assumed priors on the density slopes, and possible additional lensing contributions from the surrounding large-scale environment. We find that incorporating the currently available stellar kinematic measurements has only a modest effect on the inferred value of $H_0$. Future measurements of the lens-galaxy kinematics and a detailed characterization of the lens environment will further strengthen the utility of SN 2025wny as a cosmological probe.
papers.comment: Submitted to the ApJ Focus Issue on SN 2025wny (Paper V)

analysis.title_zh: SN 2025wny 后续研究 V：利用空间望远镜数据对 z=2.015 强透镜化超亮超新星进行透镜建模与宇宙志研究
analysis.summary_zh: 本文对 z=2.015 的强透镜化 I 型超亮超新星 SN 2025wny 进行透镜建模和宇宙学分析，使用 HST 与 JWST 成像、超新星多重像位置以及透镜化宿主星系面亮度来约束由两个前景星系产生的强透镜系统。摘要报告，在考虑微透镜后总放大率后验约为 μ_tot∼5–50，并在给定透镜模型和时间延迟数据下得到 H0 约束；这些结果被明确说明依赖于质量分布参数化、密度斜率先验和环境透镜贡献。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这类强透镜超新星的时间延迟宇宙学可提供不依赖本地距离阶梯的 H0 测量，是当前 H0 张力背景下的重要独立探针。它与 CMB 宇宙学的关系在于：CMB 给出早期宇宙框架下的 H0 推断，而强透镜时间延迟提供低红移几何距离约束，可用于检验 ΛCDM 内部一致性及潜在系统误差。
key_points: 研究对象是 z=2.015 的强透镜化 I 型超亮超新星 SN 2025wny。
用 HST/JWST 成像、宿主星系面亮度和超新星像位置约束双透镜质量模型。
给出依赖透镜质量参数化和环境假设的 H0 约束。
methods: Hubble Space Telescope 成像
James Webb Space Telescope 成像
两个椭圆幂律质量分布加外部剪切的强透镜建模
纳入透镜化宿主星系面亮度分布
微透镜效应修正
结合光谱与测光时间延迟进行宇宙学推断
恒温质量剖面模型与可变密度斜率模型
恒星运动学测量的纳入测试
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 H0 结果对透镜质量参数化、密度斜率先验、外部环境收敛/剪切以及微透镜处理的敏感性；摘要已明确这些系统误差可能限制其宇宙学解释。

papers.title: Follow-up of SN 2025wny IV: Photometric Time-delay Measurements of a Strongly Lensed Superluminous Supernova
papers.abstract: We present photometric time-delay measurements of SN 2025wny, the first strongly lensed Type I superluminous supernova (SLSN-I), discovered at $z = 2.015$. Time-delay measurements from strongly lensed supernovae provide an independent probe of cosmology and the Hubble constant, $H_0$, without reliance on the local distance ladder. Using multi-facility imaging data, we performed scene-modelling photometry to deblend four of the lensed images (A-D) and construct $grizJ$-band light curves. We modelled the resolved light curves with Gaussian process regression using GausSN (Hayes et al. 2024) to infer relative time delays and magnifications between the lensed images. We found that a constant magnification model provides a suboptimal description of the data, motivating a time-dependent sigmoid magnification model to account for evolving relative magnification of image A. We measured time delays of $Δt_{AB} = -10.6^{+2.2}_{-2.5}$ days and $Δt_{AC} = 1.2^{+2.7}_{-2.6}$ days (68% credible intervals), consistent with independent spectroscopic measurements from Johansson et al. (2026). Combining the photometric time delays with the lens model of Mörtsell et al. (2026) gives $H_{0,\:\rm photo} = 80.5^{+26.4}_{-16.7}\;\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}$, while including the spectroscopic time delays as well yields $H_{0,\:\rm comb} = 70.8^{+8.2}_{-6.1}\;{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$. Our results further demonstrate the potential of strongly lensed supernovae as independent probes of $H_0$.
papers.comment: Submitted to the ApJ Focus Issue on SN 2025wny (Paper IV)

analysis.title_zh: SN 2025wny 后续研究 IV：强透镜化超亮超新星的测光时间延迟测量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用多设施成像数据测量首个强透镜化 I 型超亮超新星 SN 2025wny 的测光时间延迟，通过场景建模测光分离四个透镜像并用高斯过程回归拟合多波段光变曲线。摘要报告 AB 和 AC 的相对延迟与独立光谱测量一致，并在结合透镜模型后给出基于测光延迟及合并光谱延迟的 H0 估计。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 强透镜超新星的时间延迟提供一种几何宇宙学测量，能够独立约束 H0，而不依赖造父星—Ia 型超新星等本地距离阶梯。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类低红移 H0 探针可与 Planck 等 CMB 推断进行交叉比较，帮助区分早期宇宙模型张力与晚期宇宙系统误差。
key_points: 给出 SN 2025wny 多重像的测光时间延迟测量。
使用场景建模测光分离 A–D 四个像，并构建 grizJ 波段光变曲线。
单独测光时间延迟给出的 H0 误差较大，与光谱延迟合并后约束收紧。
methods: 多设施成像数据
scene-modelling photometry 场景建模测光
grizJ 波段光变曲线

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对场景建模测光如何处理拥挤透镜系统中的去混叠、背景和宿主光污染，以及时间依赖放大率模型是否会与本征光变或微透镜效应发生退化。

papers.title: Follow-up of SN 2025wny III: Spectroscopic Time-delay Measurements of a Strongly Gravitationally Lensed Superluminous Supernova
papers.abstract: We present spatially resolved spectra and infer the time-delays between the multiple images of the strongly gravitationally lensed superluminous supernova (SLSN) 2025wny at z=2.015. SN 2025wny is the first known spatially resolved strongly lensed SLSN and provides a unique opportunity to measure lensing delays through the temporal evolution of supernova spectra. We present a spectroscopic dataset spanning several months, including spatially resolved spectra of images A, B, C, D, and E. We identify and measure the wavelength evolution of spectral features using Gaussian-process modeling. The time delays are inferred by jointly fitting the temporal evolution of the spectral features, yielding $Δt_{AB}=-10.3 \pm 2.3$, $Δt_{AC}=0.1 \pm 3.6$, $Δt_{AD}=-65.7 \pm 3.5$, and $Δt_{AE}=3.7 \pm 8.8$ days (68% confidence intervals). These are the among most precise time-delay measurements obtained for a lensed supernova to date, whether from spectroscopic or photometric methods. The longest delay ($Δt_{AD}$) is particularly well constrained, with a ~5% precision. Combined with the lens model presented by Mörtsell et al. (2026), the spectroscopic time-delays give a Hubble constant $H_0 = 70.2^{+8.2}_{-6.1}$ km/s/Mpc. Our analysis demonstrates that spectroscopic evolution provides an independent and complementary route to time-delay measurements in lensed supernova systems, avoiding reliance on photometric light curves alone. As future surveys discover larger samples of lensed supernovae, spectroscopic time-delay measurements will provide an important avenue for precision cosmography.
papers.comment: Submitted to the ApJ Focus Issue on SN 2025wny (Paper III)

analysis.title_zh: SN 2025wny 后续研究 III：强引力透镜化超亮超新星的光谱时间延迟测量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文基于数月跨度的空间分辨光谱，利用超亮超新星 SN 2025wny 多重像的光谱随时间演化来推断强透镜时间延迟。摘要报告了 A、B、C、D、E 多个像之间的延迟，其中最长的 AD 延迟约达到 5% 精度，并与透镜模型结合得到 H0 估计。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作展示了除测光光变曲线之外，利用超新星光谱演化测量强透镜时间延迟的路径。对 CMB/宇宙学而言，这有助于扩展独立 H0 测量手段，为检验 CMB 推断的 H0 与晚期宇宙距离测量之间的一致性提供新的系统误差结构和样本来源。
key_points: 通过空间分辨光谱追踪 SN 2025wny 多重像的谱演化来测量时间延迟。
使用高斯过程建模识别并测量谱特征的波长演化。
与透镜模型结合后给出 H0 约束，并强调光谱延迟可补充测光光变方法。
methods: 数月跨度的光谱数据集
A、B、C、D、E 像的空间分辨光谱
谱特征波长演化测量

papers.title: Follow-up of SN 2025wny II: Superluminous Supernova Physics at Cosmic Noon
papers.abstract: SN 2025wny is a gravitationally lensed, hydrogen-poor superluminous supernova (SLSN-I) at z = 2.015. To date, it is the most extensively observed high-redshift core-collapse SN and has the most detailed rest-frame UV observations of any SLSN. We present densely sampled rest-frame UV-to-optical photometry and spectroscopy out to +80 d post-peak (rest frame) from several facilities, including JWST, Keck, VLT, Gemini, the Palomar 200-inch, the Fraunhofer Telescope at Wendelstein, and the Liverpool Telescope. Correcting for lensing magnification, SN 2025wny reaches a peak pseudo-bolometric luminosity of $L_{\rm peak}\gtrsim4\times10^{44}$ erg s$^{-1}$ over rest-frame 1500-4230 Å, placing it within the luminosity range of typical SLSNe-I. SN 2025wny exhibits several unusual features, including a continuum excess and sharp spectral features in the FUV from +20-60 d that coincide with an FUV light-curve plateau and higher inferred blackbody temperatures. SN 2025wny's spectra also show little to no UV line blanketing, no obvious O II absorption despite high temperatures, and evidence for C II, H$α$, and possible He I. Light-curve modeling suggests that SN 2025wny may require a hybrid or non-standard power source. This work provides some of the first detailed constraints on high-redshift SLSNe and establishes SN 2025wny as an essential spectral and photometric reference for identifying and interpreting high-redshift SLSNe discovered by Rubin and Roman.
papers.comment: Submitted to the ApJ Focus Issue on SN 2025wny (Paper II). 40 pages, 37 figures, 9 tables

analysis.title_zh: SN 2025wny 后续观测 II：宇宙正午时期的超亮超新星物理
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告对 z=2.015 的引力透镜放大贫氢超亮超新星 SN 2025wny 的密集静止系紫外到光学测光和光谱随访。摘要称该源峰值亮度处于典型 SLSNe-I 范围，但呈现 FUV 连续谱过量、光变平台、少量 UV 线遮蔽及若干异常谱线迹象，光变建模提示可能需要混合或非标准能量源。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不是直接的 CMB 研究，但高红移瞬变源和 Rubin、Roman 等巡天的样本识别会影响宇宙学瞬变天体应用与星系演化背景研究。对 CMB 读者而言，它主要作为高红移天体物理和未来大巡天科学的相关背景，而非 CMB 参数约束或前景建模的核心文献。
key_points: SN 2025wny 是 z=2.015 的引力透镜放大、贫氢超亮超新星。
论文给出从静止系紫外到光学的密集测光和光谱随访，覆盖峰值后约 80 天。
摘要称其具有 FUV 平台、异常谱特征和可能需要混合或非标准能量源。
methods: JWST、Keck、VLT、Gemini、Palomar 200-inch、Fraunhofer Telescope at Wendelstein、Liverpool Telescope 观测

papers.title: Follow-up of SN 2025wny I: Space-based Observations of the First Multiply-imaged Superluminous Supernova
papers.abstract: We present space-based follow-up observations of the superluminous Type I supernova (SLSN-I) SN 2025wny at redshift $z_{SN}=2.0151$, gravitationally lensed by two galaxies at redshifts $z_{G1}=0.3755$ and $z_{G2}=0.3766$ into five resolved images. SN 2025wny is the first strongly lensed SLSN discovered and the first galaxy-scale lensed supernova for which both photometric and spectroscopic time-delay measurements are feasible. As such, it opens a new observational window for precision cosmology and the study of stellar explosions near the epoch of peak cosmic star formation. Our follow-up observations comprise two epochs of Hubble Space Telescope (HST) imaging, together with near-infrared imaging and spectroscopy obtained with the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST). From these data, we measure precise astrometry and multi-band photometry for the five resolved supernova images, the host galaxy, and the two deflecting galaxies. HST provides accurate relative image positions and rest-frame ultraviolet photometry, while JWST delivers complementary near-infrared imaging and spectroscopy probing the rest-frame optical at high signal-to-noise ratio. Together they yield a detailed characterization of both the lensing configuration and the supernova spectral energy distribution over a broad wavelength range. The data presented here provide the observational foundation for the accompanying analyses of the supernova properties, lens modeling, and time-delay cosmography, including the astrometric, photometric, and spectroscopic information required to measure $H_0$.
papers.comment: Submitted to the ApJ Focus Issue on SN 2025wny (Paper I)

analysis.title_zh: SN 2025wny 随访 I：首个多重成像超亮超新星的空间观测
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告红移 z=2.0151 的超亮 I 型超新星 SN 2025wny 的空间望远镜随访观测；该源被两个约 z=0.376 的星系强透镜成五个可分辨像。摘要称 HST 与 JWST 数据给出了多像、宿主星系和透镜星系的精密位置、多波段测光及近红外光谱，为后续超新星性质、透镜建模和时间延迟宇宙学分析奠定观测基础。

key_points: 首个被强透镜成五个可分辨像的超亮 I 型超新星随访数据。
HST 提供相对天体测量与静止系紫外测光，JWST 提供近红外成像和光谱。
数据将服务于超新星性质、透镜建模和时间延迟宇宙学，包括 H0 测量。
methods: Hubble Space Telescope 两个历元成像
James Webb Space Telescope 近红外成像
James Webb Space Telescope 近红外光谱
多波段测光
精密天体测量

papers.title: Astrophysical Sensitivity Projections for the IceCube Upgrade
papers.abstract: Embedded in the South Pole's glacial ice, IceCube detects neutrino-induced Cherenkov light using an array of digital optical modules equipped with single photomultiplier tubes (PMTs). The new extension installed in 2025/2026, the IceCube Upgrade, introduces densely instrumented multi-PMT optical modules within the existing infill array known as IceCube DeepCore. It is expected to enhance sensitivity in the GeV regime, with commissioning of the detector expected to be complete by the end of 2026. We present the projected sensitivities of the IceCube Upgrade for three key analyses: neutrino transient searches, steady emission from point sources such as NGC 1068, and diffuse emission from the Milky Way. These case studies represent direct extensions of current IceCube analyses. Using new Monte Carlo datasets, we demonstrate that the IceCube Upgrade achieves order-of-magnitude improvement in sensitivity at low energies ($\lesssim 10$ GeV) for time-dependent sources across short timescales. Conversely, for time-independent searches, the relative impact of the IceCube Upgrade's low-energy data is diluted by the decade-long accumulation of high-energy archival data. Nevertheless, we project significant improvements for soft-spectrum sources especially across the southern sky, driven by the IceCube Upgrade's superior background rejection capabilities. The improved sensitivity at low energies for both transient and steady sources will open up an expanded discovery window for IceCube in the GeV band over the next decade.

analysis.title_zh: IceCube 升级的天体物理灵敏度预估
analysis.summary_zh: 本文给出计划于 2025/2026 安装、2026 年底完成调试的 IceCube Upgrade 在若干天体物理分析中的灵敏度预估。摘要报告称，升级将在 GeV 能区提升低能灵敏度，对短时标时变源在约 10 GeV 以下可达数量级改进，而对稳态点源和银河系弥散发射的提升取决于源谱、天空位置和既有高能数据积累。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文主要面向中微子天文学和高能天体物理，不直接涉及 CMB 观测或宇宙学参数推断。不过，IceCube 的低能中微子灵敏度提升有助于多信使研究瞬变源、软谱源和银河系弥散发射，这些高能背景与宇宙结构、星系活动和粒子天体物理相关，是广义宇宙学观测体系的一部分。
key_points: 给出 IceCube Upgrade 对三类天体物理分析的预期灵敏度。
低能 GeV 区域，特别是小于约 10 GeV 的短时标瞬变源，预期有数量级灵敏度提升。
对稳态源，长期高能历史数据会稀释升级低能数据的相对影响，但软谱源和南天区仍有改进。

papers.title: PIFFLE: Characterizing the Foreground Contributions from 4 Decades in Halo Mass to the FRB20230907D Dispersion Measure
papers.abstract: We characterize the foreground environment of FRB20230907D, localized to a galaxy at $z=0.464$, which has an observed dispersion measure of ${\rm DM}_{\rm obs}=1031~{\rm pc~cm^{-3}}$. At its redshift, FRB20230907D lies above the Macquart relation, the expected relation between cosmological dispersion measure and the source redshift, indicating a substantial excess DM along this line of sight. We use Subaru/PFS and SDSS spectroscopy, published group catalogs, Rubin/LSST imaging, and eROSITA X-ray data to characterize the foreground structures that may account for this excess. A friends-of-friends search identifies a massive foreground system at $z\simeq0.09$ with $M_{200}\simeq5.2\times10^{14}~M_\odot$, while low redshift catalogs reveal an additional group at $z\simeq0.02565$. Assuming that the halo gas follows a modified-NFW halo density profile, we estimate observer frame contributions of $150^{+110}_{-70}~{\rm pc~cm^{-3}}$ and $80^{+60}_{-40}~{\rm pc~cm^{-3}}$ from these systems, respectively. Together with the Milky Way, diffuse intergalactic medium, Virgo cluster, M49 group, and host galaxy contributions, these foreground structures can account for the excess dispersion measure of FRB20230907D within uncertainties. This highlights the importance of dense foreground spectroscopy and multi-wavelength data.

analysis.title_zh: PIFFLE：刻画跨越 4 个数量级晕质量的前景对 FRB20230907D 色散量的贡献
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究定位于 z=0.464 的 FRB20230907D 过高观测色散量的前景来源，利用多种光谱、成像、星系群目录和 X 射线数据刻画视线方向结构。摘要报告识别出两个低红移前景系统，并在 modified-NFW 气体晕模型下估计其 DM 贡献，连同其他已知分量可在不确定度内解释该 FRB 相对 Macquart 关系的超额色散量。

key_points: 研究 FRB20230907D 视线方向的前景结构对色散量的贡献。
结合光谱、成像、X 射线和星系群目录识别低红移前景系统。
摘要称这些前景、银河系、IGM、星系团/群及宿主贡献可在不确定度内解释超额 DM。
