papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave standard sirens provide an independent probe of the Hubble constant. Dark siren analyses that rely on galaxy catalogues are sensitive to catalogue-related uncertainties. While incompleteness, weighting schemes, and redshift errors have been studied extensively, the impact of magnitude uncertainties and K-corrections has received little attention so far. We assess how magnitude errors and K-corrections propagate into the Hubble constant inference, and compare their impact to that of realistic spectroscopic redshift errors to determine their relevance. We use a modified version of the gwcosmo Python package to construct line-of-sight redshift priors from a complete, volume-limited mock galaxy catalogue up to $z<0.2$. We simulate and analyse a sample of $\sim200$ binary black hole events with luminosity weighting in the $B$- and $K$-bands and test different uncertainty models for redshifts, magnitudes, and K-corrections. The choice of luminosity-weighting scheme has a substantial impact on the inferred Hubble constant posterior, with the direct $B$- and $K$-band comparison producing differences comparable to the largest uncertainty-induced changes. Spectroscopic redshift errors produce the largest integrated changes in the Hubble constant posterior among the tested uncertainty treatments. Photometric magnitude uncertainties lead to substantially smaller, band-dependent deviations. In the $K$-band, the tested K-correction treatments have only a minor impact in the present low-redshift mock analysis, with the empirical correction slightly reducing the integrated deviation relative to the no-correction case. In realistic, flux-limited catalogues with larger localization areas and photometric or mixed redshift errors, the relative impact of magnitude uncertainties is expected to be even smaller, indicating that they need not be prioritized in near-future dark siren analyses.

analysis.title_zh: 星等不确定性和 K 修正对标准汽笛测量哈勃常数的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文评估暗标准汽笛利用星系目录推断 Hubble 常数时，星等误差和 K 修正如何传播到 H0 后验，并与光谱红移误差的影响比较。摘要报告，在其低红移模拟分析中，光度加权波段选择对 H0 后验影响显著，光谱红移误差是测试不确定性中影响最大的，星等误差较小，而 K 波段 K 修正影响很弱。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H0 张力是 CMB 宇宙学与低红移距离梯测量之间的核心问题之一；引力波标准汽笛提供了独立于传统电磁距离梯的 H0 探针。本文关注星系目录相关系统误差，有助于判断未来暗标准汽笛结果在与 CMB 推断 H0 比较时，哪些误差源需要优先控制。
key_points: 研究暗标准汽笛 Hubble 常数推断中的星系星等误差和 K 修正影响。
使用模拟星系目录和约 200 个双黑洞事件，比较 B 波段与 K 波段的光度加权。
摘要报告：红移误差影响最大，星等不确定性较小，低红移 K 波段 K 修正影响较弱。
methods: 修改版 gwcosmo Python 包
完整、体积受限的模拟星系目录，红移范围 z<0.2
约 200 个双黑洞事件的模拟与分析
基于 B 波段和 K 波段的光度加权
红移、星等和 K 修正不确定性模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：模拟目录的完整性和体积受限假设如何影响结论；不同光度加权方案为何会显著改变 H0 后验；结果能否推广到真实的通量受限星系表、较大定位区域以及光度/混合红移误差情形。

papers.title: Paleo-Detectors as a Novel Probe of Dark Matter-Nucleus Effective Interactions
papers.abstract: Paleo-detectors are a proposed approach to the direct detection of dark matter (DM) based on the observation of DM-induced nuclear recoils. Rather than relying on large detector masses required for conventional detectors, paleo-detectors exploit extremely long integration times, using small samples of naturally occurring minerals that have resided deep underground and accumulated damage tracks over geological timescales of order a gigayear. In this contribution, we review recent theoretical predictions for the sensitivity of paleo-detectors to WIMP-nucleus interactions within the framework of a Non-Relativistic Effective Field Theory (NREFT). We discuss both elastic and inelastic scattering processes and consider isoscalar couplings, taking into account backgrounds from neutrinos and radiogenic sources. We present projected sensitivities of paleo-detectors for different readout and exposure scenarios and compare the reach of paleo-detectors to that of conventional direct-detection experiments. For DM masses in the range $1\ \mathrm{GeV}/c^2$-$10\ \mathrm{GeV}/c^2$, paleo-detectors are expected to achieve sensitivities exceeding those of conventional experiments for WIMP-nucleus interactions mediated by all NREFT operators, with only a weak dependence on the read-out scenario or target mineral. For larger DM masses, $10\ \mathrm{GeV}/c^2$-$5\ \mathrm{TeV}/c^2$, paleo-detectors are projected to attain sensitivities comparable to or surpassing conventional experiments for interactions mediated by several NREFT operators, depending on the specific read-out scenario and choice of target mineral.

analysis.title_zh: 古探测器作为暗物质-原子核有效相互作用的新型探针
analysis.summary_zh: 本文综述古探测器作为暗物质直接探测新方案的理论预期：利用深地天然矿物在约十亿年地质时间中累积的核反冲损伤径迹来寻找 WIMP-原子核相互作用。摘要称，在 NREFT 框架下并考虑中微子及放射性本底后，古探测器在低质量暗物质区间可能超过常规直接探测实验，在更高质量区间则对部分相互作用可达到相当或更好的灵敏度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质性质是连接 CMB、结构形成和粒子宇宙学的核心问题；CMB 主要通过宇宙学效应约束暗物质丰度和相互作用，而直接探测尝试识别其微观散射性质。古探测器若能实现，可为解释 CMB 所指示的冷暗物质成分提供互补的实验约束，但摘要内容更偏粒子宇宙学和探测技术，和 CMB 分析本身的直接关联较弱。
key_points: 综述古探测器探测 WIMP-原子核相互作用的理论灵敏度预期。
采用非相对论有效场论框架，考虑弹性和非弹性散射及等标量耦合。
摘要称在 1–10 GeV/c² 暗物质质量范围，古探测器对所有 NREFT 算符介导的相互作用有望超过常规实验灵敏度。
methods: 古探测器中的暗物质诱导核反冲损伤径迹
非相对论有效场论（NREFT）
弹性与非弹性散射过程
等标量耦合
中微子和放射性本底
不同读出与曝光情景的投影灵敏度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：地质时间尺度损伤径迹的保存与读出假设是否现实；中微子和放射性本底建模是否足以支持投影灵敏度；不同矿物和读出方案对各 NREFT 算符的灵敏度差异是否稳健。

papers.title: The host galaxies of 2003fg-like type Ia supernovae
papers.abstract: SN~2003fg-like events are a peculiar type Ia supernova (SN~Ia) subtype characterized by broader light curves, higher near-infrared luminosities, and stronger carbon absorptions at early times. Here we present observations of the largest compilation of 2003fg-like SN Ia host galaxies to date, obtained with Integral Field Spectroscopy (IFS). For 20 objects, we study both the global host-galaxy properties and, for the first time for a sizeable sample, the local environment at the SN position. Globally, 2003fg-like SNe~Ia occur in galaxies with lower stellar mass, lower oxygen abundance, and marginally higher specific star-formation rate (sSFR) than those of normal SNe~Ia, although their hosts are not as extreme in such properties as superluminous SNe, nor representative of metal-poor dwarf-galaxy samples. Locally, the SN positions show lower star-formation-rate, stellar-mass surface densities, and lower sSFR, than normal SN~Ia environments, consistent with a significant preference for the outskirts of their hosts, while their stellar age indicators are typical. The most distinctive local property is metallicity, with 2003fg-like SNe~Ia occupying the most metal-poor environments among SNe~Ia. We also find a tentative positive correlation between the light-curve width and the oxygen abundance for 2003fg-like events. Our results imply that 2003fg-like SNe~Ia arise from the merger of two white dwarfs (WDs) or the core-degenerate scenario, but disfavor the single, rapidly rotating super-M$_{ch}$ C-O WD progenitor, as this channel requires a young stellar population that we do not observe at the SN positions. The preference of 2003fg-like SNe~Ia for low-metallicity environments suggests that they may have been more common in the early Universe. (abridged)

analysis.title_zh: 2003fg-like Ia 型超新星的宿主星系
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究特殊的 2003fg-like Ia 型超新星的宿主星系和爆发位置环境，使用 20 个目标的积分视场光谱样本同时分析全局与局部性质。摘要报告称，这类事件整体上偏好较低恒星质量、较低氧丰度的宿主，局部环境尤其低金属丰度，并据此倾向于双白矮星并合或核退化前身星情景。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Ia 型超新星是距离标尺和暗能量研究的重要工具，其子类的环境依赖会影响标准化、族群演化和高红移宇宙学系统误差评估。虽然本文不直接研究 CMB，但它关系到低红移距离探针与早期宇宙约束联合时的系统误差控制。
key_points: 汇总了迄今最大的一批 2003fg-like Ia 型超新星宿主星系 IFS 观测。
这类超新星更偏好低质量、低氧丰度宿主，并在宿主外围、低金属丰度局部环境中出现。
摘要称其结果支持双白矮星并合或核退化情景，不利于年轻星族要求的单颗快速旋转超钱德拉塞卡 C-O 白矮星情景。
methods: 积分视场光谱观测（IFS）
20 个 2003fg-like Ia 型超新星宿主样本
全局宿主星系性质分析
超新星位置的局部环境分析
与正常 Ia 型超新星环境比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对样本选择与“2003fg-like”分类标准、局部金属丰度和恒星年龄指标的测量方法，以及由环境性质推断前身星通道时是否存在选择效应或退化解释。

papers.title: $\texttt{SPINE}$: Symbolic Models to Predict the Evolution of the $Λ$CDM Nonlinear Power Spectrum
papers.abstract: We present $\texttt{SPINE}$ and $\texttt{SPINEX}$, a pair of analytical emulators developed to predict the nonlinear power spectrum based on its linear counterpart and several essential cosmological parameters within the range of $0.01\;h\;\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1} <k< 2\;h\;\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1} $. The primary difference between the two models is their parameterisation. Our methodology is grounded in the mapping originally proposed by Peacock and Dodds (1996). Both models are defined by clear mathematical expressions derived from symbolic regression, a machine learning technique that utilises genetic programming to identify analytical equations that accurately represent the underlying data. This approach provides a more interpretable and efficient alternative to conventional numerical methods that should also exhibit superior extrapolation behaviour beyond the training range. The emulators have been trained on the $Λ$CDM Quijote Latin Hypercube simulations. We provide fits for both emulators across three distinct scenarios: cosmologies within 20$σ$ of the Planck-2018 observations, a designated fiducial cosmology, and a broader range of cosmologies sampled from the Quijote simulations. Our findings indicate that $\texttt{SPINE}$ and $\texttt{SPINEX}$ maintain an accuracy of better than 5% in the majority of cases. These emulators provide a rapid alternative to numerical methods, and future initiatives will focus on developing expressions that incorporate galaxy bias and redshift-space distortions. This advancement aims to enhance the modelling of redshift space power spectra across multiple redshifts, enabling their application in large-scale cosmological surveys.

analysis.title_zh: SPINE：用于预测 ΛCDM 非线性功率谱演化的符号模型
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 SPINE 和 SPINEX，用解析 emulator 从线性功率谱及基本宇宙学参数预测 ΛCDM 非线性物质功率谱。摘要称二者由符号回归得到显式表达式，在 Quijote 模拟训练的多个参数场景中多数情况下达到优于 5% 的精度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 非线性物质功率谱是弱引力透镜、星系聚类和 CMB 透镜等宇宙学观测建模的核心输入。若解析 emulator 足够快且可解释，可帮助大型巡天与 CMB 透镜交叉相关分析更高效地进行参数推断，但摘要显示其后续仍需扩展到星系偏置和红移空间畸变。
key_points: 提出 SPINE 与 SPINEX 两个解析型非线性功率谱 emulator。
模型基于 Peacock–Dodds 映射思想，并用符号回归/遗传规划给出显式数学表达式。
在摘要所述多数情形下精度优于 5%，训练数据来自 ΛCDM Quijote Latin Hypercube 模拟。
methods: 符号回归
遗传规划
基于 Peacock and Dodds (1996) 的线性到非线性功率谱映射
ΛCDM Quijote Latin Hypercube 模拟训练集
与 Planck-2018 观测附近、基准宇宙学和更宽 Quijote 参数范围相关的拟合场景
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对训练参数范围、红移适用范围、误差定义和最差情形表现，并比较其相对 HALOFIT、HMcode 或数值 emulator 在外推与可解释性上的真实优势。

papers.title: Assembly bias from nuisance to probe II: Salvaging linear clustering from DESI and SDSS data
papers.abstract: Galactic conformity links the properties of neighbouring galaxies and is usually interpreted as a signature of assembly-biased galaxy occupation. We study projected and redshift-space compensated conformity statistics in colour-selected DESI BGS and SDSS MGS samples. These combine correlations of related galaxy populations, suppressing shared nonlinear clustering contributions while retaining a differential large-scale response. We test whether this exposes the linear matter correlation-function shape where ordinary colour-selected clustering has a scale-dependent nonlinear response. We split galaxies into red and blue subsamples and measure ordinary correlations, conformity, and compensated combinations in projection and redshift-space monopoles, using central primaries by default. We fit linear matter templates, diagnose the response with effective kernels, and compare with MTNG, FLAMINGO, and MDPL2--SAG. Ordinary high-colour clustering broadly follows the linear templates but develops a scale-dependent small-scale response. In DESI, $Δf_0(s)$, projected $Δf(r_p)$, and $C_w(r_p)$ track the linear matter shape substantially further into the nonlinear regime, consistent with suppression of nonlinear clustering modes while leaving a linear-matter-like mode visible. The effect is stronger for central-primary and dense samples. Projected effective kernels are enhanced at low line-of-sight separations, helping the residual resemble $ξ_{\rm mm}^{\rm lin}(r_p)$ rather than $w_{\rm mm}^{\rm lin}(r_p)$. Simulations reproduce the qualitative behaviour with model-dependent amplitudes and residual scale dependence. These results suggest that assembly-sensitive population differences can filter nonlinear clustering modes, although surviving nonlinear contamination must be calibrated before precision cosmological use. (abridged)

analysis.title_zh: 从干扰项到探针的组装偏差 II：从 DESI 和 SDSS 数据中挽救线性聚类
analysis.summary_zh: 本文把星系一致性从“干扰项”转化为可能的聚类探针，分析 DESI BGS 和 SDSS MGS 中红、蓝星系的投影及红移空间补偿一致性统计。摘要报告称，这些组合在 DESI 中比普通按颜色选择的聚类更深入非线性尺度地跟踪线性物质相关函数形状，模拟可定性复现但振幅和残余尺度依赖具有模型差异。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 给出早期宇宙初始扰动和线性物质功率谱的高精度约束，而低红移星系聚类用于检验这些扰动如何在晚期增长。若组装偏差相关的星系族群差异能过滤部分非线性聚类，它可能为把 DESI/SDSS 等大尺度结构数据与 CMB 约束联合起来提供新的稳健统计量，但摘要也明确提醒其非线性残余仍需校准。
key_points: 研究 DESI BGS 与 SDSS MGS 中按颜色选择的星系样本的星系一致性统计。
补偿的一致性组合可压低共同的非线性聚类贡献，并在更小尺度上保留近似线性物质相关函数形状。
摘要强调仍需校准残余非线性污染，才能用于精密宇宙学。
methods: DESI BGS 与 SDSS MGS 数据
红/蓝星系子样本划分
投影与红移空间单极的普通相关函数、一致性统计和补偿组合
线性物质模板拟合
有效核诊断
与 MTNG、FLAMINGO、MDPL2--SAG 模拟比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对补偿一致性统计如何构造、其对非线性模式的抑制是否依赖样本选择和中心星系定义，以及残余尺度依赖在多大程度上会偏置未来 BAO/RSD 或全形状宇宙学分析。

papers.title: Barren but not Empty: The Impact of Void Environments on Galaxy and Halo Populations
papers.abstract: The combination of gravitational collapse and an accelerating expansion of the Universe drive an increasing fraction of volume toward becoming low-density voids across cosmic time. These regions present a unique environment due to their low density, which leads to them behaving similarly to "pocket universes" with modified cosmological parameters. Since the formation and evolution of galaxies is strongly tied to the environment, we aim to discern how voids alter halos and galaxies compared to the general population in the universe. We use the hydrodynamical cosmological simulation suite Magneticum Pathfinder and introduce a set of void halo mass functions (VHMFs), which trace the halo population as a function of void-centric distance. We find galactic halos in voids to be overall less massive than in the general simulation volume. This discrepancy between void and field halos evolves with time as the voids grow more underdense, while the populations are still very similar at cosmic dawn. Expanding on this, we evaluate whether specific properties of the voids affect the VHMFs. We find the only relevant parameter for the void halo population to be the core density, a measure of the strength of underdensity. To assess the impact of the density environment on the evolution of galaxies, we investigate whether there are any distinctions between void and field galaxies with regard to stellar properties. We compute the stellar-mass function, halo mass-stellar mass relation, as well as the star-forming main sequence using the same void-centric shells. Although voids contain overall less stellar mass, the distribution of galaxies along the stellar mass-halo mass follows that of other regions. This implies that SF proceeded "conventionally" in void regions, in agreement with more recent observations.

analysis.title_zh: 贫瘠但并非空无一物：空洞环境对星系和暗晕族群的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 Magneticum Pathfinder 流体宇宙学模拟，研究低密度空洞环境如何改变暗晕和星系族群，并提出随空洞中心距离变化的空洞暗晕质量函数。摘要报告称，空洞中星系暗晕总体质量更低，核心密度是影响空洞暗晕族群的主要空洞参数，但空洞星系在恒星质量—暗晕质量关系和恒星形成行为上与其他区域相近。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙空洞是大尺度结构中对环境依赖、引力增长和暗能量背景扩张敏感的区域，可作为与 CMB 所约束的初始条件互补的晚期宇宙探针。理解空洞中暗晕与星系的占据关系，也有助于在星系巡天中使用空洞统计进行宇宙学分析时控制星系形成偏差。
key_points: 使用 Magneticum Pathfinder 模拟研究空洞环境中的暗晕和星系。
空洞内星系暗晕总体质量低于一般宇宙体积，且差异随时间演化。
恒星质量—暗晕质量关系等结果显示空洞星系的恒星形成总体上仍较“常规”。
methods: Magneticum Pathfinder 流体宇宙学模拟
空洞暗晕质量函数 VHMFs
按距空洞中心距离划分的壳层分析
恒星质量函数
暗晕质量—恒星质量关系
恒星形成主序
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对空洞定义、空洞中心距壳层和核心密度的具体量化方式，以及 VHMF 与恒星性质结论是否受模拟分辨率、反馈模型和样本选择影响。

papers.title: Getting Warmer: IceCube Nears Freeze Out
papers.abstract: IceCube has recently detected a diffuse population of high-energy neutrinos arising from the Milky Way. We use this high-significance detection to place new limits on dark matter (DM) annihilation to neutrinos with two complementary approaches. The first method uses the background-subtracted Galactic longitude distribution of shower events to place a conservative bound on the DM annihilation cross section that does not rely on any assumed Galactic cosmic ray emission model; the resulting limits on the velocity-averaged annihilation cross section improve upon existing bounds by factors of a few. The second method uses the template-dependent neutrino energy spectra from the Inner Galaxy, inferred under different Galactic cosmic ray emission models. This complementary approach shows that the inferred Galactic neutrino intensities are already sensitive to DM contributions near the thermal-relic benchmark for a range of TeV-scale DM masses, though this comparison is more model-dependent. Our results demonstrate that measurements of diffuse Galactic neutrino emission can be used as a powerful probe of DM annihilation into neutrinos. Future observations with IceCube-Gen2 and KM3NeT will substantially extend this sensitivity, potentially allowing a decisive test of the thermal freeze-out mechanism with Galactic neutrino observations.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. End Matter (5 pages, 6 figures)

analysis.title_zh: 逐渐升温：IceCube 逼近冻结退出
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 IceCube 对银河系弥散高能中微子的高显著性探测，提出两种互补方式限制暗物质湮灭到中微子。摘要称，基于银经分布的保守方法可将现有速度平均湮灭截面限制改善数倍，而基于内银河区能谱模板的方法显示对一系列 TeV 量级暗物质质量的热遗迹基准附近贡献已有敏感性，但模型依赖更强。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质的粒子性质是 CMB 与大尺度结构共同指向但尚未解决的核心宇宙学问题；CMB 可约束早期能量注入，而银河中微子观测提供晚期暗物质湮灭的独立通道。若未来 IceCube-Gen2 和 KM3NeT 提升灵敏度，将与 CMB 对热遗迹暗物质和湮灭截面的约束形成互补。
key_points: 利用 IceCube 已探测到的银河系弥散高能中微子信号限制暗物质湮灭到中微子。
一种方法基于扣除背景后的银经方向 shower 事件分布，较少依赖银河宇宙线发射模型。
另一种方法使用内银河区、依赖模板的中微子能谱，对 TeV 量级暗物质和热遗迹基准附近贡献已有敏感性。
methods: IceCube 弥散银河高能中微子观测
shower 事件的背景扣除银经分布
暗物质湮灭截面限制
内银河区中微子能谱模板
不同银河宇宙线发射模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对两种限制方法对银河弥散中微子背景建模、暗物质密度分布、事件选择和能谱模板的依赖程度，尤其区分稳健上限与模型依赖性较强的热遗迹基准比较。

papers.title: Scatter, bias, and chaos of satellite orbits in triaxial dark matter haloes
papers.abstract: The pericentric distances of satellite galaxies govern their tidal stripping, quenching, and survival, yet their orbits are almost universally computed in spherical host potentials, whereas dark matter haloes are generically triaxial. We quantify, orbit by orbit, the error this simplification incurs. We integrate $10^6$ satellites, drawn from a cosmological infall distribution, in static NFW hosts of systematically varying triaxiality at fixed mass profile. Triaxiality leaves the population medians of pericentre, apocentre, and orbital period essentially unchanged. Instead, successive pericentres of an individual orbit scatter by 5-23% depending on host shape, irrespective of orbital energy; the minimum pericentre distance reached within a Hubble time shrinks systematically by up to 21%, enhancing the peak tidal mass loss. This triaxiality-driven orbital dephasing is overwhelmingly regular rather than chaotic; chaotic satellite orbits are common and dominate the near-centre pericentric passages in strongly flattened hosts, but diverge on time-scales far exceeding the Hubble time. Satellite orbits spherically reconstructed via direct backward integration in a truly triaxial host diverge by a tenth of the virial radius within 2-4 Gyr, with comparable uncertainties sourced separately by the unconstrained shape of the host and by its unknown absolute orientation. For the Milky Way dwarf Triangulum II, the unknown halo shape and orientation alone spread the inferred pericentre by ~50%, five times its reported uncertainty and more than ten times the LMC-induced shift, and bias it by 6-70%. This host-shape uncertainty can dominate satellite orbital error budgets and should be incorporated in future inferences.

analysis.title_zh: 三轴暗物质晕中卫星轨道的散布、偏差与混沌
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究在通常用球对称宿主势计算卫星星系轨道时，忽略暗物质晕三轴性会带来多大误差。作者在不同三轴形状的静态 NFW 宿主中积分大量卫星轨道，摘要报告总体近心点、远心点和周期中位数几乎不变，但单个轨道近心点会出现显著散布，最小近心点可系统性减小，并在 Triangulum II 的轨道反推中造成主导性不确定性和偏差。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接处理 CMB 各向异性，但与宇宙学中的暗物质晕结构和小尺度结构形成有关。卫星星系的潮汐剥离、淬火和存活是检验冷暗物质模型、银河系质量分布和小尺度宇宙学的关键观测量；如果轨道反推系统性依赖晕三轴性，相关暗物质约束也需重新评估。
key_points: 三轴暗物质晕会使单个卫星星系的近心点逐次散布，而总体轨道量中位数变化不大。
近心点最小值可系统性变小，从而影响潮汐剥离和卫星存活的推断。
以球对称势反推真实三轴晕中的轨道会产生显著偏差；银河系矮星系 Triangulum II 被作为案例讨论。
methods: 在静态 NFW 宿主晕中积分 10^6 个卫星轨道
卫星初始条件来自宇宙学落入分布
系统改变固定质量剖面下的三轴性
与球对称重构/直接向后积分比较
应用于 Milky Way dwarf Triangulum II 的轨道推断
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：静态 NFW 且固定质量剖面的三轴势如何参数化，是否忽略宿主晕增长、盘势、LMC 等时变扰动；“规则而非混沌”的判据和时间尺度定义；以及 Triangulum II 案例中观测误差、晕形状先验和取向先验如何进入误差预算。

papers.title: Primordial Black Holes as Cosmic Architects: Imprints of an extended mass function
papers.abstract: Primordial black holes (PBHs) remain compelling dark-matter candidates and possible relics of early-Universe physics, with observable imprints across both cosmological structure formation and gravitational-wave astronomy. We investigate the consequences of a PBH population described by an extended, physically motivated mass function shaped by features in the thermal history of the early Universe. We compute the associated Poisson contribution to the matter power spectrum and propagate its effects to the halo mass function, the cosmic star-formation rate density, and the reionization history. The PBH component produces a moderate enhancement of small-scale power, leading to earlier low-mass halo formation and a correspondingly mild increase in the high-redshift star-formation rate density while remaining consistent with current constraints on the Thomson optical depth. We then evaluate the merger-rate distribution expected for current and future gravitational-wave detectors. In the stellar-mass regime, the predicted PBH binary population occupies the region probed by LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA and can contribute to the observed compact-object merger population. For LISA, the detectable signal is dominated by intermediate-mass binaries with component masses of $10^3$-$10^4\,M_\odot$, with cumulative rates of order a few events per year extending to redshifts as high as $z \sim 50$. The detection of such high-redshift intermediate-mass black hole mergers would constitute a distinctive signature of a primordial origin, providing evidence that PBHs contribute non-negligibly to the dark matter budget and may have served as early seeds for the supermassive black holes observed at later cosmic epochs.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures + 4 pages appendix. Submitted for publication to ApJ

analysis.title_zh: 作为宇宙建筑师的原初黑洞：扩展质量函数的印记
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察具有物理动机扩展质量函数的原初黑洞群体对结构形成、再电离和引力波事件率的影响。摘要报告 PBH 泊松项会温和增强小尺度功率，使低质量晕和高红移恒星形成略提前，同时仍符合当前 Thomson 光学深度约束，并可能在 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 和尤其 LISA 中留下并合信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 宇宙学的联系主要在暗物质和再电离两方面：PBH 作为暗物质成分会改变小尺度物质功率谱和早期结构形成，而再电离历史会通过 Thomson 光学深度影响 CMB 大尺度偏振约束。若高红移中等质量黑洞并合被探测到，也将为早期宇宙物理和暗物质组成提供与 CMB 互补的证据。
key_points: 研究带扩展质量函数的原初黑洞作为暗物质候选体的宇宙学和引力波信号。
PBH 的泊松涨落可增强小尺度物质功率谱，促进更早的低质量晕形成和高红移恒星形成。
摘要称模型仍与当前 Thomson 光学深度约束相容，并预言 LISA 可见的高红移中等质量黑洞并合信号。
methods: 采用由早期宇宙热历史特征塑造的扩展 PBH 质量函数
计算 PBH 对物质功率谱的泊松贡献
传播到暗物质晕质量函数、宇宙恒星形成率密度和再电离历史
评估当前和未来引力波探测器的并合率分布
比较 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 与 LISA 可探测质量和红移范围
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对扩展质量函数的具体物理来源和归一化、PBH 暗物质丰度是否满足各类现有限制；小尺度功率增强到恒星形成和再电离的天体物理建模假设；Thomson 光学深度与 CMB 约束的实现方式；以及引力波并合率对 PBH 成团、二体形成通道和探测选择函数的敏感性。

papers.title: Finding and using interpretable latents in a neutrino foundation model with sparse autoencoders
papers.abstract: We present a first application of sparse-autoencoder-based mechanistic interpretability to particle physics. Studying a neutrino foundation model pretrained on IceCube data and fine-tuned for direction reconstruction, we identify a validated atlas of physical concepts in the model representation, using a strict validation protocol consisting of held-out tests, matched nuisance controls, and replication across independent dictionary trainings. Causal interventions show that the direction head barely draws on this atlas. Motivated by this underused information, we train an uncertainty head on the same event-level representation to predict the model's angular reconstruction error. Unlike the direction head, it depends causally on quality and brightness features from the atlas. At $20\%$ selection efficiency, this interpretable estimator improves the median angular resolution from $20.2^\circ$ to $3.2^\circ$. These results suggest that mechanistic interpretability can reveal learned latent physics encoded within a model's internal representation and help design downstream tasks that exploit it.

analysis.title_zh: 用稀疏自编码器在中微子基础模型中寻找并利用可解释潜变量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文将基于稀疏自编码器的机制可解释性首次应用到粒子物理场景，分析一个在 IceCube 数据上预训练并用于方向重建的中微子基础模型。摘要报告，作者识别并验证了模型内部的物理概念图谱，发现方向头很少因果使用这些信息，而新训练的不确定性头会使用质量和亮度等特征，并在 20% 选择效率下显著改善中位角分辨率。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接涉及 CMB，但与多信使宇宙学和高能中微子天文学的数据分析方法相关。对 CMB 研究者的潜在价值主要在 AI 可解释性和不确定性估计方法，可能启发对大规模宇宙学数据模型内部表征的审计。
key_points: 将稀疏自编码器机制可解释性用于 IceCube 中微子基础模型。
识别模型表征中的物理概念图谱，并用留出测试、干扰控制和独立字典训练复现实验验证。
基于可解释特征训练不确定性头，用于预测角重建误差并改善筛选后角分辨率。
methods: sparse autoencoders
mechanistic interpretability
neutrino foundation model pretrained on IceCube data
fine-tuning for direction reconstruction
held-out tests
matched nuisance controls
replication across independent dictionary trainings
causal interventions
uncertainty head for angular reconstruction error
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对物理概念图谱的验证标准是否足以排除探测器或数据处理伪相关，以及 20% selection efficiency 下角分辨率改进是否依赖特定样本分布。

papers.title: REBELS-25: multi-phase morphology and kinematics at z = 7.31
papers.abstract: We present a spatially resolved, multi-wavelength study of the massive, star-forming galaxy REBELS-25 at a redshift of $z=7.31$. We combine new high-resolution ALMA [O III]88$μ$m observations with resolution-matched [C II], dust continuum, and JWST/NIRSpec IFU spectroscopy, providing a $\lesssim1$ kpc view of the morphology, interstellar medium (ISM) conditions, and multi-tracer gas kinematics of one of the most mature galaxies known in the reionisation era. We find differing morphologies from the rest-frame UV to far-infrared (FIR) emission, with the UV and optical emission appearing clumpy and irregular, whereas the FIR emission is well-described by near-exponential disc profiles, with [C II] being the most extended. Comparing the resolved UV and FIR emission, we find that obscured star formation contributes $\sim55$-$98$% of the total star formation rate across the galaxy, demonstrating that dust obscuration strongly shapes the observed UV and optical morphology. Resolved ionisation-line diagnostics show no significant variation across the source at $\sim1$ kpc resolution, consistent with broadly similar ISM conditions among the identified regions. Kinematic modelling reveals that both the warm ionised gas, traced by [O III]88$μ$m, and the colder neutral gas, traced by [C II], share the same large-scale rotating structure and are dynamically cold, with ratios of ordered-to-random motion, $V/σ$, of $\sim11$ and 4.5, respectively, although we find evidence for non-circular motions that are not well-described by a simple rotating disc. Overall, these results further support a picture in which REBELS-25 hosts a dusty, chemically enriched, and dynamically cold ISM already in place at $z=7.31$.

analysis.title_zh: REBELS-25：z = 7.31 处的多相形态与运动学
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究红移 z=7.31 的大质量恒星形成星系 REBELS-25 的多相形态、ISM 条件和气体运动学，结合 ALMA [O III]88 μm、[C II]、尘埃连续谱与 JWST/NIRSpec IFU 数据。摘要报告 UV/光学形态团块且不规则，而 FIR 近似指数盘；遮蔽恒星形成占总恒星形成率约 55%-98%，[O III] 与 [C II] 追踪的气体共享大尺度旋转结构并呈动力学冷态，但存在简单旋转盘难以描述的非圆周运动。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接研究 CMB，但与 CMB 宇宙学中的再电离时期和早期结构形成相关。高红移星系的尘埃、金属富集和气体动力学状态会影响对早期星系形成、再电离源族以及与 CMB 光学深度相关的星形成历史的理解。
key_points: 研究对象是再电离时期大质量恒星形成星系 REBELS-25。
ALMA 与 JWST/NIRSpec IFU 给出小于约 1 kpc 的多波段、空间分辨视图。
摘要报告其 FIR 呈近指数盘，[C II] 最延展，并显示冷的旋转气体结构。
methods: 高分辨率 ALMA [O III] 88 μm 观测
分辨率匹配的 [C II]、尘埃连续谱数据
JWST/NIRSpec IFU 光谱
空间分辨电离线诊断
多示踪气体运动学建模
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对不同波段数据的分辨率匹配、盘模型假设、非圆周运动的证据强度，以及尘埃遮蔽恒星形成率占比的推断依赖哪些 SED 或线发射校准。

papers.title: Dark Matters of Principle: Principles in the Dark Matter Paradigm
papers.abstract: This paper re-examines the Dark Matter (DM) problem through the lens of physical principles. We first develop a functionalist account and taxonomy of principles. We propose to define principles in terms of their intended functions or purposes. Their argumentative force boils down to context-sensitive and often tentative reasons for believing them adequate for those purposes. In research contexts in which novel theories or models are sought which push the boundaries of knowledge into new domains, reliance on well-motivated principles as principal building blocks is a historically widespread, natural, and methodologically prudent research strategy---what we'll dub "principled inquiry". In a second step, we apply this methodological machinery to the DM problem. Through detailed analyses of four mainstream DM approaches---supersymmetric WIMPs, axions, sterile neutrinos, and primordial black holes---we substantiate four claims. (C1) The DM paradigm is formed by the framework of possibilities, circumscribed by a shared cluster of regulative and constitutive principles of gravitational and non-gravitational physics. (C2) Besides those common principles, the four DM models also depart from other principles of orthodox physics in distinct ways. (C3) They do so to different degrees---displaying different forms and extents of "minimal mutilation" with respect to some of the principles of established non-gravitational physics. (C4) The guidelines of principled inquiry clarify the sense in which the DM problem constitutes an ever-more disconcerting crisis: worries are growing that the principles on which DM researchers have routinely and rationally relied may have run out of heuristic steam. Pressure is mounting to "leave no stone unturned" (Bertone and Tait 2018): scientists ought to increasingly explore ideas that stray more radically from the cautious explorations of principled inquiry.

analysis.title_zh: 原则中的暗物质：暗物质范式中的原则
analysis.summary_zh: 本文从物理原则和“有原则的探究”方法论出发重新审视暗物质问题，并分析超对称 WIMP、轴子、惰性中微子和原初黑洞四种主流方案。摘要称，暗物质范式由一组共同的引力与非引力物理原则所界定，但不同模型以不同程度偏离既有原则，且这些原则的启发式作用可能正在减弱。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不是直接的 CMB 数据或参数分析，但暗物质是标准宇宙学模型的核心组成部分，并与 CMB 各向异性、结构形成和早期宇宙约束密切相关。它对暗物质范式的原则性反思可帮助 CMB 研究者理解在模型扩展、替代理论和原初黑洞等候选方案中，哪些假设属于方法论选择而非单纯观测结论。
key_points: 文章从物理原则与方法论角度重新审视暗物质范式。
讨论四类主流暗物质方案：超对称 WIMP、轴子、惰性中微子和原初黑洞。
摘要主张暗物质研究可能面临启发式原则效力下降的危机。
methods: 原则的功能主义说明与分类
对四种暗物质方案的详细分析：supersymmetric WIMPs、axions、sterile neutrinos、primordial black holes
物理学史与科学方法论分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者如何界定“原则”的功能与论证效力，以及四类暗物质模型偏离正统非引力物理原则的判断是否只是哲学分类，还是能具体影响模型评估与研究策略。

papers.title: An Inverse Lyth Bound for Non-Attractor Inflation
papers.abstract: I present a novel physics result generated entirely autonomously by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol. The Lyth bound relates an observable primordial tensor amplitude to a lower limit on the field excursion during single-field slow-roll inflation. We show that non-attractor evolution obeys a complementary upper bound. For a canonically normalized scalar field, the nonconstant superhorizon curvature mode is anti-damped whenever the second Hubble-flow parameter satisfies $ε_2\equiv d\lnε/dN<-3$. The same condition requires the inflaton kinetic energy to decrease sufficiently rapidly that the field-space distance traversed during a non-attractor interval obeys $Δφ_{\rm NA} / M_{\text{P}} < \left(2\sqrt{2ε_{\rm in}}/3\right) \left(1-e^{-3ΔN/2}\right) < \left(2\sqrt{2ε_{\rm in}}/3\right)$.The result is independent of the potential and does not require the slow-roll approximation. If $ε_2=-p<-3$ is constant, the stronger bound $Δφ/M_{\text{P}}<2\sqrt{2ε_{\rm in}}/p$ is saturated asymptotically. In ultra-slow-roll inflation, $p=6$, giving $Δφ<\sqrt{2ε_{\rm in}}M_{\text{P}}/3$. We derive an exact relation between field excursion and amplification of the velocity of the nonconstant curvature mode, and give the corresponding scalar-power relation in the quasi-de Sitter limit. In contrast with the usual Lyth relation, arbitrarily large non-attractor amplification approaches a finite field distance. This provides a model-independent field-range constraint on canonical single-field mechanisms for amplifying primordial fluctuations.

analysis.title_zh: 非吸引子暴胀的反 Lyth 界
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论单场暴胀中非吸引子演化对场位移的约束，提出与通常 Lyth bound 互补的上界。摘要称在规范归一化标量场且 ε₂<-3 时，非恒定超视界曲率模被反阻尼，而非吸引子阶段场空间距离有势能无关、无需慢滚近似的上界，并给出常数 ε₂ 与 ultra-slow-roll 的特例。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初张量、标量扰动放大和暴胀场程是连接 CMB 可观测量与早期宇宙模型的核心问题。若该上界成立，它会限制规范单场非吸引子机制能在多小场程内放大原初曲率扰动，从而影响对 CMB 标量谱、张量信号以及小尺度扰动模型的解释。
key_points: 提出非吸引子阶段场位移的互补上界。
条件为第二 Hubble-flow 参数 ε₂<-3，且不依赖势能形式。
大幅放大非恒定曲率模时，场空间距离趋于有限值。
methods: 解析推导
规范归一化单标量场
Hubble-flow 参数条件 ε₂=dlnε/dN<-3
常数 ε₂=-p 情形
准 de Sitter 极限下的标量功率关系
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该“反 Lyth 界”的适用假设：规范单场、非吸引子区间定义、ε₂<-3 条件与曲率模放大的关系是否严格，以及从场位移到标量功率放大的对应是否依赖未明说的边界条件或匹配条件。

papers.title: Filaments within filaments: unraveling the hierarchy of the cosmic web
papers.abstract: Cosmic filaments are the most striking feature of the hierarchical cosmic web. Yet, their own sub-structure remains unexplored, unlike the well-known, universal halo/sub-halo hierarchy. We use a hierarchical reconstruction scheme to identify sub-filaments within larger filaments. Examining differences in the radial phase-space profiles of parent and sub-filaments, we argue that the latter constitute a statistically distinct class of structures. Establishing the existence of a universal filament hierarchy must then account for these differences, with implications for cosmology and dark matter.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, prepared for submission to PRL

analysis.title_zh: 丝状体中的丝状体：揭示宇宙网的层级结构
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究宇宙网丝状体内部是否存在类似 halo/sub-halo 的层级子结构。作者使用层级重构方案识别大丝状体中的子丝状体，并通过父、子丝状体径向相空间剖面的差异，认为子丝状体构成统计上不同的结构类别。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙网形态是初始扰动、暗物质性质和非线性结构形成共同作用的结果，最终要与 CMB 给出的初始条件相衔接。若丝状体存在普适层级结构，它可为从 CMB 约束的早期涨落到晚期大尺度结构的演化检验提供新的统计量。
key_points: 提出在大尺度丝状体中识别子丝状体的层级重构方案。
父丝状体与子丝状体的径向相空间剖面不同。
摘要认为子丝状体是统计上不同的一类结构。
methods: 层级重构方案
宇宙网丝状体识别
径向相空间剖面比较
父丝状体与子丝状体统计对比
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对层级重构算法如何定义父丝状体和子丝状体、样本与模拟/数据来源、统计显著性，以及相空间剖面差异是否对宇宙学模型或暗物质性质具有稳健区分力。

papers.title: Constraining primordial non-Gaussianity and energy injection with the thermal Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect and integrated Sachs-Wolfe effect cross-correlation
papers.abstract: Constraining primordial non-Gaussianity (PNG) provides key insights into the physics of cosmic inflation and the initial conditions of the Universe, which remain central topics in cosmology. In this study, we use the cross-correlation between the integrated Sachs-Wolfe (ISW) effect and the thermal Sunyaev-Zeldovich (tSZ) effect derived from Ibitoye et al. (2024) to jointly constrain PNG and early-Universe energy injection, including the standard intergalactic medium contribution. For scale-independent PNG we obtain $f_{\rm NL} = -358^{+140}_{-114}$ ($68\%$~C.L.). For a scale-dependent model ($f_{\rm NL}=f_{\rm NL}^{0}(\ell/\ell_{0})^{n_{\rm NL}}$, with $\ell_{0}=200$), we find $f^{0}_{\rm NL} = -296^{+173}_{-157}$ and $n_{\rm NL} = 0.62^{+1.02}_{-0.64}$, both consistent with Gaussian initial conditions. We also constrain the early-Universe energy injection amplitude to be $α_{\rm inj} = -3.93^{+1.34}_{-0.99}$, with uncertainty reduced by a factor of $\sim\!2.6$ if Planck 2018 $f_{\rm NL}$ constraint is applied as a prior. Future surveys such as Simons Observatory and Euclid will tighten these constraints further. Complementary to conventional probes, this work provides the first ISW-tSZ constraint on exotic energy injection and enables precision tests of early-Universe physics while probing late-time gravitational potential and thermal energy perturbations.

analysis.title_zh: 用热 Sunyaev-Zeldovich 效应与积分 Sachs-Wolfe 效应的互相关约束原初非高斯性和能量注入
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 ISW 效应与热 Sunyaev-Zeldovich 效应的互相关联合约束原初非高斯性和早期宇宙能量注入，并包含标准星系际介质贡献。摘要报告了尺度无关与尺度相关 PNG 参数以及能量注入幅度的约束，并指出加入 Planck 2018 f_NL 先验可将能量注入幅度的不确定度约缩小 2.6 倍。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接涉及 CMB 次级各向异性：ISW 反映晚期引力势演化，tSZ 追踪热电子压力场，二者互相关可作为传统 CMB 原初非高斯性探针之外的互补约束。它还把早期宇宙能量注入纳入同一框架，关系到早期宇宙物理、CMB 统计性质和晚期大尺度结构热历史的联合检验。
key_points: 利用 ISW-tSZ 互相关约束原初非高斯性与早期宇宙能量注入。
摘要给出尺度无关和尺度相关 PNG 参数约束，并称尺度相关模型与高斯初始条件一致。
Planck 2018 的 f_NL 先验可进一步收紧能量注入幅度不确定度。
methods: Ibitoye et al. (2024) 给出的 ISW-tSZ 互相关
尺度无关 PNG 模型
尺度相关 PNG 模型 f_NL=f_NL^0(ℓ/ℓ0)^{n_NL}，ℓ0=200
包含标准星系际介质贡献的早期宇宙能量注入建模
Planck 2018 f_NL 约束作为先验
面向 Simons Observatory 和 Euclid 的未来预期讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 ISW-tSZ 互相关信号的协方差、系统误差和前景处理，负的 f_NL 与能量注入幅度约束如何受模型先验和 IGM 贡献假设影响，以及为何摘要中部分结果被表述为与高斯初始条件一致。

papers.title: The properties of the first continuous gravitational waves: Optimizing pulsar timing observations for supermassive black hole binary detection
papers.abstract: Several pulsar timing arrays have reported evidence for a nanohertz gravitational-wave background. This background is thought to arise from the superposition of signals from a population of inspiraling supermassive black hole binaries. A key test of this interpretation is the search for individually resolvable binaries whose signals emerge above this background. Here we investigate this possibility by addressing two related questions: (1) what are the most probable properties of the first resolvable binary; and (2) how can pulsar timing observations be optimized to maximize its prospects for electromagnetic identification? By simulating populations of supermassive black hole binaries constrained by evidence for the gravitational-wave background and studying the loudest binary in each simulation, we infer the expected properties of the first individually resolvable systems. If MeerKAT continues its current observing strategy for a total of 9 years, the probability of detecting an individual binary is $\approx10-27\%$. Improving the timing precision by a factor of two changes this probability to $\approx11-28\%$, whereas increasing the cadence by a factor of four gives $\approx12-30\%$. Combining both improvements yields a detection probability of $\approx12-33\%$. Furthermore, implementing a high-cadence observing campaign preferentially resolves higher-frequency systems ($\gtrsim\unit[10]{nHz}$), whose shorter orbital periods make them considerably easier to identify through electromagnetic observations than lower-frequency binaries that repeat infrequently. We discuss prospects of electromagnetic follow-up of gravitational-wave resolved binaries with current high-cadence all-sky optical surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 首批连续引力波的性质：为探测超大质量黑洞双星优化脉冲星计时观测
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究脉冲星计时阵列中首批可单独分辨的超大质量黑洞双星连续引力波源可能具有什么性质，以及如何优化观测以利于电磁识别。摘要通过受引力波背景证据约束的双星族群模拟，报告 MeerKAT 不同观测策略下单个双星探测概率的变化，并指出高频率系统更有利于电磁后随识别。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于纳赫兹引力波和超大质量黑洞双星研究，与 CMB 的直接联系较弱。其宇宙学意义在于利用大尺度黑洞并合族群检验星系演化和低频引力波背景来源，这与 CMB 所约束的早期宇宙背景不同，但同属多信使宇宙学框架中的背景信号与结构形成问题。
key_points: 目标是预测首个可单独分辨的纳赫兹连续引力波源性质。
通过模拟受引力波背景证据约束的超大质量黑洞双星族群，研究每次模拟中的最亮信号。
摘要比较了 MeerKAT 延长观测、提高计时精度和增加观测频率对单源探测概率及电磁对应体识别的影响。
methods: 受纳赫兹引力波背景证据约束的超大质量黑洞双星族群模拟
逐次模拟中最亮双星的统计分析
MeerKAT 脉冲星计时观测策略评估
计时精度提升与观测频率提升情景比较
当前高频全天光学巡天的电磁后随讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对双星族群模型如何由引力波背景证据约束、MeerKAT 噪声和观测策略假设是否现实，以及探测概率与电磁识别前景对频率分布和源定位能力的依赖。

papers.title: Distinguishing cold and self-interacting dark matter through topological analysis
papers.abstract: Alternative dark matter (DM) models have emerged to solve the challenges faced by the predictions of collisionless cold dark matter (CDM) on galactic scales ($\lesssim 1$ Mpc). However, disentangling alternative models from CDM is difficult on such small scales because of the degeneracy with baryonic physics. It is therefore necessary to use DM probes that are not affected by baryons, e.g. that stand on intermediate scales, larger than galactic while remaining smaller than the scale at which the models converge to CDM. For the first time, we distinguish self-interacting DM (SIDM) from CDM using the genus statistic, a metric that characterises the topology of the density field. We carried out the analysis on the Darkium DM-only cosmological simulations, using one CDM model and four SIDM models with cross-sections of various amplitudes and velocity dependencies. We computed the genus on selected 3-virial radius wide regions centred around halos, for few hundred halos with masses ranging from $10^{12}$ to $10^{14}$ M$_\odot/h$ over redshifts $z=0$ to $z=2$. We also explored a more observation-like configuration, where the DM density field is traced only from the halo distribution in thick 2D projection since in principle redshift errors hinder a 3D reconstruction of the density field. We find that the density field is systematically clumpier in CDM than in SIDM models up to $0.05~\mathrm{Mpc}/h$, for halos of masses larger than $10^{12}$ M$_\odot/h$ at $z=0$. These predictions show that the genus of the density field is sensitive to DM self-interactions, suggesting that topological analysis could provide a valuable probe for distinguishing SIDM from CDM in observed halo distributions.

analysis.title_zh: 通过拓扑分析区分冷暗物质与自相互作用暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文尝试在星系尺度以上、模型尚未完全退化到 CDM 的中间尺度上，用密度场拓扑的 genus 统计区分冷暗物质和自相互作用暗物质。作者基于 Darkium 暗物质-only 模拟分析不同质量和红移的晕环境，并报告 CDM 在特定小尺度上比 SIDM 模型呈现系统性更强的团块性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质性质是 CMB 宇宙学参数解释和大尺度结构形成模型的核心假设；若拓扑统计能在较少受重子物理影响的尺度上区分 CDM 与 SIDM，可为 CMB 与低红移结构观测的联合检验提供新的暗物理探针。
key_points: 首次用 genus 统计区分冷暗物质与自相互作用暗物质。
分析基于 Darkium 的暗物质-only 宇宙学模拟。
摘要报告在 z=0、质量大于 10^12 M_sun/h 的晕附近，CDM 密度场在 0.05 Mpc/h 以内比 SIDM 更团块化。
methods: genus 拓扑统计量
Darkium 暗物质-only 宇宙学模拟
一个 CDM 模型与四个 SIDM 模型比较
以晕为中心的 3 倍维里半径区域分析
厚二维投影中的晕分布示踪密度场
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 genus 对平滑尺度、晕选择、投影厚度和红移误差的敏感性，并特别注意摘要所用暗物质-only 模拟如何限制其与真实观测中重子效应的比较。

papers.title: A Population Study for Searching Supermassive Binary Black Holes in Active Galactic Nuclei: Continuum Spectral Features and Periodic Variabilities
papers.abstract: Active sub-pc supermassive binary black holes (SMBBHs) are expected to exhibit various electromagnetic signatures due to unique dynamical and geometric structures of their accretion, but observational identification of them remains challenging. In this paper, we adopt semianalytic models to investigate both deficits in spectral-energy-distributions (SEDs) of these systems induced by gaps/holes in their accretion disks and periodic variations in their light curves induced by either orbital-modulated Doppler boosting or accretion rate variation of each SMBH component. We construct a population model to generate SMBBHs across cosmic time by considering their orbital evolution and associated accretion and radiation processes. By estimating the continuum emission from each mock system and its variation, we investigate the detection of SMBBHs via either SED-deficit signature or light curve periodicity under reasonably given criteria. We find that all-sky surveys with filters similar to those of the China Space Station Telescope or Rubin/LSST could identify up to approximately $3\times 10^2$ SMBBHs via SED-deficit features and/or $10^3$ SMBBHs via periodicity ($\lesssim5$\,yr), although both selections may suffer from a high rate of false positives. A few to a dozen SED-deficit SMBBHs may be detected by future pulsar timing arrays with signal-to-noise ratio $\gtrsim3$, enabling multi-messenger observations. Only $\sim20\%-53\%$ of SED-deficit selected SMBBHs may also be detected via periodic variations, and $\sim7\%-9\%$ of periodic variation selected SMBBHs may be detected via SED-deficit signatures. The false positives for those SMBBHs selected jointly by both methods are negligible, highlighting the importance of searching for active SMBBH systems using joint methods.
papers.journal_ref: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society, Volume 551, Issue 1, September 2026

analysis.title_zh: 在活动星系核中搜寻超大质量双黑洞的族群研究：连续谱特征与周期性变异
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用半解析模型研究活动星系核中活跃亚秒差距超大质量双黑洞的电磁搜寻，重点考察吸积盘间隙/空洞导致的 SED 缺口，以及 Doppler boosting 或吸积率变化导致的周期性光变。摘要报告，类 CSST 或 Rubin/LSST 的全天巡天可分别通过这些特征识别大量候选体，但单一方法假阳性较高，联合方法的假阳性可忽略，并有少量 SED 缺口候选可能被未来 PTA 探测。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要属于高能天体物理和引力波多信使方向，与 CMB 的直接联系较弱。不过，超大质量黑洞并合史、AGN 族群和纳赫兹引力波背景会影响宇宙结构形成与大尺度天体物理背景建模，对广义宇宙学和未来多信使约束有间接价值。
key_points: 建立活动星系核中亚秒差距超大质量双黑洞的族群模型。
比较连续谱能量分布缺口与光变周期性两类电磁识别方法。
摘要强调联合选择可显著降低假阳性，并可能与未来脉冲星计时阵列形成多信使观测。
methods: 半解析模型
跨宇宙时间的 SMBBH 族群模型
轨道演化、吸积与辐射过程建模
模拟系统的连续谱发射与变化估计
SED 缺口筛选
由轨道调制 Doppler boosting 或吸积率变化导致的光变周期性筛选
类中国空间站巡天望远镜与 Rubin/LSST 滤光片的全天巡天假设
未来脉冲星计时阵列探测评估
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对族群模型、筛选阈值和假阳性估计的假设，特别是 SED 缺口与周期性光变的可观测性是否对吸积盘结构、巡天 cadence 和 AGN 本征变异模型高度敏感。

papers.title: Multi-messenger signal from QCD-Axion Ultracompact Minihalos
papers.abstract: We explore the multimessenger signatures from ultracompact minihalos (UCMHs) seeded by stellar-mass primordial black holes (PBHs) and composed of QCD-axion dark matter. Using the secondary-infall framework, with relic-abundance and isocurvature conditions from a pre-inflationary Peccei-Quinn scenario, we numerically recover the characteristic halo profile and adopt a conservative constant-density core for the innermost region. We study the gravitational wave and electromagnetic signatures from neutron-star-PBH inspirals inside these dense structures. Dynamical friction produces a gravitational-wave dephasing relative to the vacuum binary, observable with LISA for primordial black holes with masses $\lesssim\! 10M_\odot$. Simultaneously, gravitationally focused axions can resonantly convert into photons in the neutron-star magnetosphere, producing a narrow-band radio signature. For nearby galactic neutron stars, the projected sensitivity of the Green Bank radio telescope GBT captures the QCD-axion band in the $μ{\rm eV}$ mass range. Gravitational waves therefore probe the presence and structure of the UCMH, while the radio signal probes the particle nature of its dark matter, making their joint observation a distinctive test of a mixed dark sector.

analysis.title_zh: 来自 QCD 轴子超致密微晕的多信使信号
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究由恒星质量原初黑洞播种、QCD 轴子暗物质组成的超致密微晕的多信使信号，使用二次内落框架并结合预暴胀 Peccei-Quinn 场景的遗迹丰度和等曲率条件来构造晕剖面。摘要报告称，中子星-原初黑洞并合中的动力学摩擦可导致 LISA 可观测的引力波退相干，同时轴子在中子星磁层中可共振转化为窄带射电信号，从而分别探测晕结构和暗物质粒子性质。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章与 CMB 宇宙学的联系主要在于原初黑洞、轴子暗物质和预暴胀 Peccei-Quinn 场景中的等曲率约束；这些成分都受 CMB 对初始扰动、暗物质组成和等曲率模式的限制。它本身不是 CMB 数据分析论文，但为将 CMB 约束与引力波、射电观测联合检验混合暗部门提供了一个具体场景。
key_points: 研究由恒星质量原初黑洞播种、QCD 轴子暗物质构成的超致密微晕。
中子星-原初黑洞并合中的动力学摩擦可产生相对真空双星的引力波相位偏移。
轴子在中子星磁层中共振转化为光子，可给出窄带射电信号。
methods: secondary-infall framework（二次内落框架）
预暴胀 Peccei-Quinn 场景下的遗迹丰度与等曲率条件
数值恢复晕剖面
内区采用保守的常密度核
中子星-原初黑洞并合的引力波与电磁信号建模
LISA 可观测性与 Green Bank Telescope 预期灵敏度评估
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 UCMH 密度剖面、常密度核假设和动力学摩擦处理如何影响引力波退相干，以及轴子-光子转化信号对中子星磁场、等离子体环境和距离假设的敏感性。

papers.title: The optimal redshift for dark energy II: application to cosmological data and the evidence for the phantom crossing of the CPL equation of state
papers.abstract: Recent results from DESI and other cosmological datasets have indicated a preference for dynamical dark energy, with a time-evolving equation of state (EOS), $w(z)$. Furthermore, analyses using the CPL parameterization give an EOS with a phantom crossing of the $w(z)=-1$ line. In a companion paper-I, we assumed the CPL parameterization and its generalization, and introduced the formalism of the optimal scale factor (or redshift), a quantity designed to simultaneously maximize the distance from the cosmological constant value of $-1$ and to minimize the uncertainty on the EOS, thereby maximizing the tension with the cosmological constant at that specific redshift for a given dataset combination. In this paper-II, we apply the optimal-redshift formalism to available baryon acoustic oscillation, Cosmic Microwave Background, and supernova dataset combinations, with a particular focus on the phantom-line crossing within CPL. Motivated by the relatively low significance of previous constraints on the EOS in the region below the phantom line, we calculate the optimal redshift for a variety of dataset combinations to identify those that best constrain departures from $w(z)=-1$ before and after the crossing. We find combinations and corresponding optimal redshifts for which $w(z)$ lies below the ``$-1$'' line with new significance levels reaching $3.01$--$3.22σ$ before the crossing point, and $3.30$--$3.55σ$ above ``$-1$" after the crossing. Our focus in this work is the application of a new framework that maximizes the significance of the phantom-crossing signal within CPL using currently available datasets. Determining whether this crossing is effective or intrinsic, and identifying the underlying microphysical models, constitute separate questions from the aim of the present work and remain important directions for future investigation, further motivated by our findings. Abridged.

analysis.title_zh: 暗能量的最优红移 II：在宇宙学数据中的应用以及 CPL 状态方程幻影线穿越的证据
analysis.summary_zh: 本文把伴随论文提出的最优红移形式应用于现有 BAO、CMB 和超新星数据组合，用于在 CPL 暗能量状态方程中寻找相对 $w(z)=-1$ 偏离最显著的红移。摘要报告称，一些数据组合在幻影线穿越前后给出约 $3.01$--$3.55σ$ 的偏离显著性，但作者也说明穿越是否有效或内禀及其微观模型并非本文目标。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接使用 CMB 与 BAO、超新星联合约束暗能量状态方程，关系到当前关于动力学暗能量和 DESI 相关张力的讨论。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键在于 CMB 如何通过几何距离、早期宇宙参数退化和与低红移探针的组合影响 $w(z)$ 穿越 $-1$ 的证据强度。
key_points: 将“最优红移”形式应用于 BAO、CMB 和超新星数据组合。
目标是在 CPL 参数化中最大化相对于宇宙学常数 $w=-1$ 的偏离显著性。
摘要报告了若干数据组合中幻影线穿越前后达到约 3σ 以上的偏离显著性。
methods: CPL 暗能量状态方程参数化
最优尺度因子/最优红移形式
重子声学振荡数据
Cosmic Microwave Background 数据
超新星数据组合
对幻影线 $w(z)=-1$ 穿越前后约束的比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对“最优红移”是否引入后验选择效应或 look-elsewhere 问题，以及 BAO、CMB、超新星数据组合、协方差和 CPL 先验如何影响所报告的 3σ 级显著性。

papers.title: The optimal redshift for dark energy I: formalism and interpretation
papers.abstract: We introduce the concept of the optimal redshift for dark energy, a statistically motivated redshift at which departures of the dark-energy equation of state (EOS) from the cosmological-constant value are tested most effectively. Within a generalized CPL parameterization, we derive an analytic expression for the optimal redshift by maximizing the separation of the EOS from $w=-1$ relative to the corresponding uncertainty. We establish the optimal redshift relationship to the phantom-crossing and pivot redshifts. As an illustration, we apply the formalism to the dataset combination of DESI DR2 BAO measurements, the DES Year-6 independent BAO measurement, and the recalibrated DES-Dovekie supernova sample. Adopting the null hypothesis $\mathcal{H}_0:w(a_{\rm opt})=-1$, we find a tension of ~$2.8σ$ with the cosmological-constant prediction at the optimal redshift, compared with ~$2.6σ$ at the pivot redshift, despite the latter having a smaller EOS uncertainty. This behavior reflects the specific design of the optimal redshift to maximize the statistical significance of a departure of the EOS from the -1 value of the $Λ$CDM model. We further provide statistical and geometrical interpretations of the optimum. In the CPL parameter space, the pivot corresponds to the projection that minimizes the variance of the equation of state, whereas the optimum maximizes its squared-distance from the cosmological-constant value over its variance. While the optimum is dataset and parameterization dependent, the underlying optimization principle and definition of the optimal redshift can be extended beyond the CPL framework. Future applications to DESI, Rubin LSST, Euclid, Roman Space Telescope, and other Stage-IV dark-energy surveys appear particularly promising.

analysis.title_zh: 暗能量的最优红移 I：形式体系与解释
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出用于检验暗能量状态方程偏离宇宙学常数值 w=-1 的“最优红移”概念，并在广义 CPL 参数化中通过最大化偏离量相对不确定度推导解析表达式。摘要中的示例将该形式应用于 DESI DR2 BAO、DES Year-6 BAO 和 DES-Dovekie 超新星组合，报告最优红移处与 ΛCDM 预言约 2.8σ 的张力，高于枢轴红移处约 2.6σ。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 本身主要锚定早期宇宙和距离尺度，但暗能量约束常依赖 CMB 与 BAO、超新星等低红移探针的联合解释。该工作关注如何选择红移来表达 w=-1 偏离的统计显著性，因此对解读 CMB+大尺度结构联合约束中的暗能量张力有直接方法学意义。
key_points: 定义并推导“暗能量最优红移”，用于最有效检验状态方程相对 w=-1 的偏离。
在广义 CPL 参数化中，最优红移不同于枢轴红移和 phantom-crossing 红移。
示例数据组合下，摘要报告最优红移处相对 ΛCDM 的张力略高于枢轴红移处。
methods: 广义 CPL 暗能量状态方程参数化
解析最大化 EOS 偏离量与不确定度之比
DESI DR2 BAO 测量
DES Year-6 独立 BAO 测量
重新校准的 DES-Dovekie 超新星样本
CPL 参数空间中的统计和几何解释
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“最优红移”的定义是否对参数化、先验和数据协方差高度敏感，以及与枢轴红移比较时张力提升是否来自独立统计检验还是同一后验的重参数化表达。

papers.title: Tracing Galaxy Bias Through the Cosmic Web: The Role of Filaments
papers.abstract: The large-scale clustering of galaxies depends not only on their internal properties but also on their location within the cosmic web, which defines the anisotropic environments where galaxies form and evolve. Filaments serve as bridges through which galaxies and dark matter flow from low-density regions toward the highest-density nodes. In this work, we aim to map galaxy bias, which quantifies how these tracers follow the underlying dark matter density field, through the cosmic web, with a special emphasis on filaments. We look for dependencies on filament properties, such as length and density, and characterize the spatial variations of the large-scale bias along the filamentary spine. We applied the DisPerSE algorithm to identify the cosmic web in the TNG300 volume of the IllustrisTNG simulation. To measure large-scale galaxy bias, we utilized an object-by-object estimator, which provides advantages over standard estimators. We find that galaxies in node outskirts exhibit the highest large-scale bias values, reaching up to $\sim4$ times the values expected from theoretical models based on halo mass alone. Low-mass red galaxies in filaments and filament outskirts also display enhanced bias, which is strongly reduced after excluding galaxies close to nodes. Together, these results suggest that proximity to massive nodes plays a central role in shaping environmental secondary bias. Furthermore, galaxy bias decreases with filament length, from mean values of $1.4$ for short filaments to $-0.5$ for longer structures. This relation persists at fixed halo mass and galaxy color, and is not primarily driven by the average local galaxy density of the filament. Finally, short filaments exhibit an approximately uniform longitudinal bias profile, whereas long filaments show an increase in normalized bias from $\sim0.85$ near the saddle point to $\sim1.06$ close to the node.

analysis.title_zh: 通过宇宙网追踪星系偏置：丝状体的作用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 IllustrisTNG 的 TNG300 模拟和 DisPerSE 宇宙网识别算法，研究星系大尺度偏置如何随其在节点和丝状体中的位置及丝状体性质变化。摘要报告节点外围星系偏置最高，低质量红星系在丝状体及其外围有增强偏置，且偏置随丝状体长度降低并沿长丝状体呈纵向变化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系偏置是把星系巡天观测转化为暗物质密度场和宇宙学参数约束的关键系统量，也影响 BAO、RSD 和透镜交叉相关的解释。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类环境依赖偏置会影响 CMB lensing 与星系分布交叉相关、ISW 相关分析以及 CMB+大尺度结构联合约束中的系统误差建模。
key_points: 使用 IllustrisTNG 的 TNG300 模拟研究 cosmic web 中星系偏置的环境依赖。
DisPerSE 被用于识别节点、丝状体等宇宙网结构。
摘要报告靠近大质量节点是环境次级偏置的重要因素，且偏置随丝状体长度和位置变化。
methods: IllustrisTNG 模拟的 TNG300 体积
DisPerSE cosmic web 识别算法
逐对象的大尺度星系偏置估计器
按丝状体长度、密度、距节点位置、晕质量和星系颜色分组比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对逐对象偏置估计器的定义、尺度选择和误差评估，并确认负偏置及强环境依赖是否受样本选择、节点排除标准或模拟体积限制影响。

papers.title: Cosmic topology. Part Va. Information content of the observable Universe
papers.abstract: If the Universe possesses a compact spatial topology with characteristic scale not much larger than the diameter of the observable Universe, then the associated symmetry transformations imprint specific statistical correlations on density perturbations. We derive the covariance between perturbation modes in the full topology volume and compute the induced covariance between modes in the observable subvolume. We then use this covariance to estimate the available information about topology contained in the full set of observable linear perturbations. For two sample Euclidean examples - the cubic three-torus ($E_1$) and a three-torus with a quarter turn ($E_3$) - the three-dimensional density field carries enough information to detect topology on scales up to 25 percent larger than those accessible from the two-dimensional cosmic microwave background anisotropies alone. Future probes of the cosmic density field using deep galaxy surveys or neutral-hydrogen 21-cm intensity mapping, combined with computationally intensive searches over the large parameter space of admissible topologies, thus offer a plausible avenue to extending the range of detectable cosmic topologies.

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙拓扑。第五部分 a：可观测宇宙的信息含量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究若宇宙具有尺度接近可观测宇宙直径的紧致空间拓扑，相关对称变换会如何在密度扰动中产生统计相关；作者推导全拓扑体积与可观测子体积扰动模的协方差，并估计可观测线性扰动包含的拓扑信息量。摘要称，在两个欧几里得样例中，三维密度场可探测的拓扑尺度比仅用二维 CMB 各向异性大约扩展 25%。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙拓扑是 CMB 大尺度异常和匹配圆搜索等问题的经典背景；本文将焦点从二维 CMB 各向异性扩展到三维密度场，说明深度星系巡天和 21 cm 强度映射可能补充或超越 CMB 的拓扑探测能力。对 CMB 读者而言，它提供了比较 CMB 与大尺度结构在全局拓扑约束中信息含量的框架。
key_points: 研究紧致空间拓扑在可观测线性扰动中留下的统计相关。
推导全拓扑体积扰动模与可观测子体积模之间的协方差。
三维密度场可能比仅用二维 CMB 各向异性探测到更大的拓扑尺度范围。
methods: 扰动模协方差推导
可观测子体积中的诱导协方差计算
线性扰动信息量估计
欧几里得样例：立方三环面 $E_1$
欧几里得样例：带四分之一转动的三环面 $E_3$
与二维 CMB 各向异性拓扑探测范围比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对信息量估计的统计假设、可观测子体积处理、线性扰动适用范围，以及“可探测尺度较 CMB 扩展 25%”这一结论对具体拓扑族和搜索参数空间的依赖。

papers.title: Quantifying the systematic impact of differential beam response on the BICEP CMB polarization data from 2016 through 2024
papers.abstract: As cosmic microwave background (CMB) polarization experiments, including BICEP3, BICEP Array, and future BICEP experiments, achieve ever-deeper polarization maps in search of primordial B-modes sourced from inflation, constraining instrumental systematics below statistical uncertainties becomes progressively more challenging. Since polarimetry in the BICEP telescopes is performed by pair-differencing co-located, orthogonally polarized detectors, differential beam response leads to temperature-to-polarization ($T \rightarrow P$) leakage, introducing a potential systematic bias on the inferred tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$. To mitigate this leakage, the lowest-order beam mismatch modes are filtered out of the CMB polarization maps through deprojection; however, residual undeprojected modes remain. To quantify this residual contamination, we perform dedicated in situ far-field beam measurements of the BICEP receivers during austral-summer calibration campaigns. We quantify the systematic impact of the undeprojected residuals with a specialized set of timestream simulations based on the measured per-detector beams. These "beam measurement-informed simulations" yield an estimate of the false polarized signal sourced by the undeprojected residuals. We summarize the beam measurements relevant to the BK24 data release and present preliminary residual-leakage results for BICEP3 at 95 GHz. For BICEP3 over 2016-2024, deprojecting all six standard templates together with readout-crosstalk templates and their radially smoothed counterparts reduces the equivalent-$r$ leakage amplitude from $ρ=(4.5\pm0.7)\times10^{-3}$ to $(1.12\pm0.06)\times10^{-3}$. We further describe an ongoing program to extend the deprojection basis beyond its historical six modes, guided by a forward optical model that relates candidate leakage modes to perturbations of physical instrument parameters.

analysis.title_zh: 量化差分波束响应对 2016 至 2024 年 BICEP CMB 偏振数据的系统影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文量化 BICEP 系列 CMB 偏振数据中差分波束响应造成的温度到偏振泄漏及其对张标量比 r 的潜在系统偏差。作者利用原位远场波束测量和基于实测逐探测器波束的时间流模拟估计未去投影残差，摘要报告 BICEP3 2016-2024 年 95 GHz 数据在加入标准、串扰及径向平滑模板去投影后，等效 r 泄漏幅度由 ρ=(4.5±0.7)×10^-3 降至 (1.12±0.06)×10^-3。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初 B 模搜索要求仪器系统误差低于统计误差，而 T→P 泄漏会直接污染 B 模功率并影响 r 的推断。该工作与 BK/BICEP 类地面 CMB 偏振实验的系统误差建模、去投影策略和未来更深巡天的仪器设计密切相关。
key_points: 面向 BICEP 2016-2024 偏振数据的差分波束系统误差评估。
差分波束响应会造成 T→P 泄漏，并可能偏置张标量比 r。
摘要报告，扩展去投影模板后 BICEP3 95 GHz 的等效 r 泄漏幅度明显降低。
methods: 原位远场波束测量
南半球夏季定标观测
基于逐探测器实测波束的时间流模拟
去投影六个标准模板、读出串扰模板及其径向平滑对应模板
前向光学模型指导扩展泄漏模式基
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：等效-r 泄漏幅度 ρ 的定义、从波束测量到时间流模拟的误差传播、去投影模板是否会同时滤除真实天空信号，以及这些 BICEP3 95 GHz 初步结果如何并入 BK24 的 r 约束系统误差预算。

papers.title: Status of BICEP Array and Integration of the 220/270 GHz Receiver
papers.abstract: Measurements of the polarization of the cosmic microwave background are critical for modern cosmology as they constrain the physics of the early universe and cosmic inflation. BICEP Array is using a series of small-aperture polarimeters located at the South Pole to measure this signal with a projected uncertainty on the tensor-to-scalar ratio r of approximately 0.001 by 2034. The 30/40 GHz receiver and the 150 GHz receiver have been observing the cosmic microwave background for multiple years, and data from these receivers will be included in the next published BICEP analysis result which includes all data taken through 2024. The 220/270 GHz receiver is partially completed with seven out of twelve detector modules installed, and is planned to be filled with five additional modules prior to the 2027 observation season. Finishing this receiver is a top priority for BA as the science goals of the experiment require the dust foreground cleaning this receiver will enable. On-site characterization efforts for this receiver from the 2025-26 austral summer show satisfactory spectroscopy, beam pointing, and 220 GHz efficiency, while the 270 GHz efficiency is an active area of work.

analysis.title_zh: BICEP Array 的状态与 220/270 GHz 接收机的集成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 BICEP Array 的运行状态以及 220/270 GHz 接收机集成进展，背景目标是通过 CMB 偏振测量约束早期宇宙和暴胀。摘要称 30/40 GHz 与 150 GHz 接收机已有多年观测并将纳入下一次包含 2024 年前数据的 BICEP 分析；220/270 GHz 接收机已部分完成，现场表征显示光谱、波束指向和 220 GHz 效率令人满意，而 270 GHz 效率仍在推进。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这是直接面向 CMB B 模式和原初引力波搜寻的仪器论文。220/270 GHz 通道对银河尘埃前景清理至关重要，而前景建模和仪器系统误差控制直接决定张量标量比 r 的约束能力，因此对关注 BICEP/Keck、CMB-S4 及低 r 测量的读者值得精读。
key_points: BICEP Array 正以南极小口径偏振仪阵列测量 CMB 偏振。
目标是到 2034 年将张量标量比 r 的预期不确定度推进到约 0.001。
220/270 GHz 接收机用于尘埃前景清理；220 GHz 表现满意，270 GHz 效率仍在改进。
methods: 南极小口径偏振仪阵列
CMB 偏振观测
30/40 GHz 与 150 GHz 接收机多年观测数据
220/270 GHz 接收机集成
现场表征：光谱、波束指向、220 GHz 效率、270 GHz 效率
截至 2024 年数据将纳入下一次 BICEP 分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 220/270 GHz 接收机的效率、波束和光谱表征如何进入前景清理与系统误差预算，尤其是 270 GHz 效率问题是否会影响实现 r 约 0.001 目标的路径。

papers.title: Engineering of titanium transition edge sensor wafers for the BA4-90/150 receiver of BICEP Array
papers.abstract: BA4-90/150, the fourth receiver to be deployed in the BICEP Array (BA) series, is a dichroic 90/150 GHz instrument targeting the frequency space where sensitivity to the CMB polarization is maximized. The receiver will be deployed in the 2026-2027 austral summer, and is set to position BA to achieve exceptionally precise measurements of cosmic microwave background (CMB) polarization and strengthen constraints on inflationary models. Recent measurements in existing BA receivers suggest that unexpectedly high loop gain in the titanium (Ti) transition edge sensors (TESs) produces excess high-frequency noise that is consequently aliased down into the science band through the time-division multiplexed readout. To reduce the loop gain, we fabricated and tested prototype Ti TES wafers containing 16 modified detector architectures designed to broaden the superconducting transition and reduce the transition steepness (alpha). We present detector performance results, which will directly inform the final integrated wafer now being designed for full receiver commissioning.

analysis.title_zh: 用于 BICEP Array BA4-90/150 接收机的钛 transition edge sensor 晶圆工程
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 BICEP Array 第四台 BA4-90/150 双频 90/150 GHz 接收机所用钛 transition edge sensor（TES）晶圆的工程优化。针对已有 BA 接收机中 Ti TES 环路增益偏高、导致高频噪声经时分复用读出混叠进科学频段的问题，作者制作并测试了包含 16 种改进探测器结构的原型晶圆，以拓宽超导转变并降低转变陡峭度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇仪器论文与 CMB 偏振观测直接相关。BA4-90/150 瞄准 CMB 偏振最敏感的 90/150 GHz 频段，其探测器噪声和读出混叠会影响 B 模式测量能力，从而影响对暴胀模型的约束；因此 TES 设计优化是降低仪器噪声和系统误差的重要环节。
key_points: 面向 BICEP Array BA4-90/150 接收机的 Ti TES 晶圆工程优化。
问题源于已有接收机中 TES 环路增益偏高导致高频噪声混叠进入科学频段。
测试了含 16 种改进探测器结构的原型晶圆，以降低 alpha 并指导最终晶圆设计。
methods: prototype titanium TES wafer fabrication
testing of 16 modified detector architectures
transition broadening to reduce superconducting transition steepness alpha
time-division multiplexed readout noise considerations
detector performance measurements
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：各 TES 架构如何改变转变宽度和 alpha，环路增益与噪声混叠的实测证据是否充分，以及这些性能指标如何传递到 BA4-90/150 的最终 CMB 偏振灵敏度和系统误差控制。

papers.title: Aliased noise characterization and mitigation in BICEP Array 150, 220 and 270 GHz time-division multiplexed detectors
papers.abstract: Early observations with the BICEP Array 150 GHz (BA2-150) and 220/270 GHz (BA3-220/270) receivers revealed detector noise equivalent temperatures (NETs) higher than expected, together with substantial detector-to-detector and module-to-module scatter. Noise measurements acquired with multiplexing off and high frequency sampling demonstrate that this excess originates from elevated high-frequency detector noise that aliases into the science band during time-division multiplexing. We show that the excess high-frequency noise is correlated with anomalously large logarithmic TES transition slopes, α, resulting in elevated electrothermal loop gain and operation near the detector stability boundary. Measurements of α indicate values substantially larger than expected, consistent with the sharper superconducting transitions introduced by the inverted TES fabrication process adopted for BA2-150 and BA3-220/270 detectors. Operational mitigation strategies were investigated through both increased multiplexing rates and elevated focal-plane operating temperatures. Faster multiplexing reduces aliasing by shifting the multiplexing Nyquist frequency beyond the excess noise roll-off, while elevated bath temperatures reduce TES electrical power and loop gain, improving detector stability and reducing NET by approximately 10%. These results demonstrate the importance of balancing TES responsivity, electrothermal stability, and multiplexed readout performance in next-generation CMB polarimeters.
papers.comment: Submitted to SPIE Astronomical Telescopes + Instrumentation 2026

analysis.title_zh: BICEP Array 150、220 和 270 GHz 时分复用探测器中的混叠噪声表征与缓解
analysis.summary_zh: 本文分析 BICEP Array BA2-150 与 BA3-220/270 接收机早期观测中 NET 偏高且离散较大的原因。摘要称，通过关闭复用和高频采样噪声测量，作者将超额噪声归因于时分复用导致的高频探测器噪声混叠，并报告提高复用速率及升高焦平面温度可降低混叠或改善稳定性，其中升温使 NET 约降低 10%。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 偏振实验的最终灵敏度不仅取决于探测器数量，也取决于读出噪声、TES 稳定性和 NET。该工作直接关系到 BICEP Array 多频通道在前景分离和 B 模搜索中的实际权重，并为下一代 CMB 偏振仪的 TES 制备与复用读出设计提供经验。
key_points: 研究 BICEP Array 150、220、270 GHz TDM 探测器中的混叠噪声。
过高 NET 被追溯到高频探测器噪声在时分复用中混叠进入科学频段。
提高复用速率和升高焦平面工作温度是摘要中报告的缓解策略。
methods: 关闭复用的噪声测量
高频采样噪声测量
TES 对数转变斜率 α 测量
提高时分复用速率的运行测试
升高焦平面或浴温的运行测试
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对高频噪声到科学频段混叠的定量模型、α 与环路增益及稳定边界的关系、升温带来的 NET 改善是否在灵敏度、产额和长期稳定性之间存在代价，以及这些设置是否影响偏振系统误差。

papers.title: Optical characterization of the BICEP array 150 and 220/270GHz CMB polarimeters in the 2026 season
papers.abstract: BICEP Array (BA) is the current-generation instrument in the BICEP series of small-aperture, on-axis refracting telescopes at the South Pole, designed to constrain the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$ through degree-scale measurements of B-mode polarization in the cosmic microwave background (CMB). As BA pushes to deeper sensitivity, control of instrumental systematics, and beam shape mismatch between the co-located orthogonally polarized detectors in particular, has become an increasingly important factor in translating raw sensitivity into a robust constraint on $r$. In these proceedings we report on the 2026 far field beam mapping (FFBM) campaign, which used a thermal chopped source to characterize the BA2 (150~GHz) and BA3 (220/270~GHz) beams. We fit two-dimensional elliptical Gaussians to each detector's beam, derive per-pair differential parameters (differential pointing, beamwidth, and ellipticity). The resulting high-signal-to-noise array-averaged beam maps are used to compute the beam window function $B_l$ for the power spectrum analysis, while the individual per-detector beams feed dedicated beam convolution simulations used to validate the temperature-to-polarization (T$\rightarrow$ P) deprojection procedure. After correcting for the chopper aperture, the recovered beamwidths follow the expected $λ/D$ ordering. We also describe two pipeline improvements carried out during the 2026 campaign: an out-and-back jackknife for noise quantification and an elnod-based gain calibration.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, submitted to Proc. SPIE

analysis.title_zh: BICEP Array 150 和 220/270 GHz CMB 偏振仪在 2026 观测季的光学表征
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 BICEP Array 在 2026 季对 BA2 150 GHz 和 BA3 220/270 GHz 偏振仪的远场波束测绘，用热斩波源和二维椭圆高斯拟合提取波束及探测器对差分参数。摘要称，阵列平均波束图用于功率谱分析的窗口函数 B_l，逐探测器波束用于验证温度到偏振泄漏去投影；孔径修正后波束宽度符合预期的 λ/D 次序，并介绍了噪声 jackknife 与 elnod 增益定标改进。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: BICEP 的科学目标是用度尺度 CMB B 模限制张量标量比 r，而波束形状不匹配会把温度各向异性泄漏到偏振信号中，直接影响原初 B 模搜索的系统误差控制。该工作提供的波束窗口函数和波束卷积模拟，是从地图到功率谱再到 r 约束过程中必须核查的仪器模型环节。
key_points: 面向 BICEP Array 2026 季的远场波束表征。
重点量化正交偏振探测器对之间的差分指向、波束宽度和椭率。
波束结果用于功率谱窗口函数和 T→P 去投影验证模拟。
methods: 南极 BICEP Array BA2 150 GHz 与 BA3 220/270 GHz 数据
热斩波源远场波束测绘（FFBM）
二维椭圆高斯拟合
逐探测器对差分参数推导
阵列平均波束图计算 beam window function B_l
逐探测器波束卷积模拟
