analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对斩波器孔径修正、二维椭圆高斯模型对真实旁瓣/非高斯波束的适用性，以及 T→P 去投影验证模拟如何把逐探测器波束不匹配传播到 r 约束的不确定度中。

papers.title: Slowly Rolling on a Quantum Correction
papers.abstract: Recent advances in cosmological measurements such as DESI and ACT may indicate an increase in the preferred value of the spectral tilt $n_s$ such that it disfavors rather popular models such as the Higgs or Starobinski inflation models. We argue that it actually means that the data is now sensitive enough to quantum corrections beyond simple tree-level models. Resurrecting the old theme of Coleman-Weinberg effective potential, we analyze the predictions of such models, as well as likelihood analysis, leading to a more established and interesting predictive framework.

analysis.title_zh: 在量子修正上缓慢滚动
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 DESI、ACT 等近期宇宙学测量可能偏好更大的标量谱指数 ns，从而对 Higgs 或 Starobinsky 等常见暴胀模型形成压力。作者主张这可能反映数据已对树级模型之外的 Coleman-Weinberg 型量子修正敏感，并分析此类模型的预言及似然。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 标量谱指数 ns 是 CMB 温度与偏振各向异性约束暴胀物理的核心参数之一，ACT 等 CMB 数据直接参与这一讨论。若量子修正改变暴胀势的可检验预言，将影响 CMB 与大尺度结构联合约束下对经典暴胀模型的评价。
key_points: DESI 和 ACT 等测量可能提高对谱指数 ns 的偏好值。
作者将这种变化解释为数据已开始对树级暴胀模型之外的量子修正敏感。
摘要提到 Coleman-Weinberg 有效势和似然分析。
methods: Coleman-Weinberg 有效势
暴胀模型预言分析
似然分析
DESI 和 ACT 等宇宙学测量
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对似然分析使用了哪些数据组合、先验和模型参数化，以及量子修正是否真的改善与 ns 相关数据的拟合，而非仅通过额外自由度缓解张力。

papers.title: Anti-Ultralocality and Plateau Models of Inflation
papers.abstract: Anti-ultralocality refers to the growth of spatial gradient terms relative to velocity terms in the coupled Einstein--scalar field equations. It is a characteristic feature of decelerated expansion before the onset of inflation. Previous numerical relativity studies have shown that anti-ultralocality prevents the onset of inflation in models with power-law inflaton potentials. In this paper, we show that models with plateau-shaped inflaton potentials, which are considered to be the simplest way to generate a tensor-to-scalar ratio below current observational upper limits, are especially vulnerable to anti-ultralocality effects. The reasons are the flatness of the plateau and the energy density gap of $\sim 10$ orders of magnitude between the Planck density and the plateau potential energy. To study the problem, we develop a protocol for assessing the viability of inflationary models in general, and we apply it to a plateau potential using a previously validated numerical relativity code. We find that, starting from generic initial conditions, the growth of gradient terms in the Einstein equations relative to non-gradient terms either prevents inflation from lasting for enough $e$-folds or triggers a phase of quantum runaway. We show that the fine-tuning of initial conditions necessary to avoid these issues becomes more severe as the energy scale of inflation is made smaller, disfavoring common approaches for reducing the tensor-to-scalar ratio.

analysis.title_zh: 反超局域性与平台型暴胀模型
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究在暴胀开始前，耦合 Einstein--标量场方程中空间梯度项相对速度项增长的反超局域性如何影响平台型暴胀模型。作者用一个评估暴胀模型可行性的流程和已验证的数值相对论代码分析平台势，摘要称从一般初始条件出发，梯度项增长会导致暴胀 e-folds 不足或触发量子 runaway，且降低暴胀能标会加剧所需初始条件微调。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 平台型暴胀模型常被用来获得低于当前观测上限的张量标量比 r，因此它们与 CMB B 模和原初引力波约束直接相关。若摘要中的结论成立，CMB 对低 r 的非探测或上限解释不仅取决于势形状，也需要考虑暴胀初始条件和广义相对论非线性动力学的可行性。
key_points: 研究暴胀开始前减速膨胀阶段的反超局域性效应。
摘要声称平台型暴胀势对梯度项增长尤其脆弱。
结果指向低暴胀能标和降低 r 的常见路径需要更严格初始条件调谐。
methods: 耦合 Einstein--标量场方程中的空间梯度项与速度项分析
用于评估暴胀模型可行性的 protocol
先前验证过的数值相对论代码
平台型 inflaton 势模型
generic initial conditions 初始条件研究
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“generic initial conditions”的定义、足够 e-folds 的判据、量子 runaway 的触发条件，以及数值相对论设置和边界/规范选择是否会影响对平台势脆弱性的结论。

papers.title: What would it take for dark matter to be literally warm?
papers.abstract: Warm dark matter (WDM) has served as a valuable benchmark for constraining small-scale structure in the past decades. In this note, I examine what it would take for dark matter to be warm in the literal sense assumed by that benchmark, i.e., a thermal relic that decoupled while relativistic. Satisfying current constraints on the WDM mass, which approach the $\sim$10 keV scale, requires one of three possibilities. One possibility is that there were $\sim 10^4$ relativistic degrees of freedom in the thermal bath at the time of decoupling, which is far beyond what is available in the Standard Model or plausible extensions of it. An alternative is that there was a period of early matter domination whose entropy injection diluted the relic density. However, in this scenario, the perturbations would have evolved through an expansion history that was different from the radiation-dominated one assumed in deriving WDM transfer functions. The third possibility is a dark sector that was never in thermal contact with the Standard Model and was simply born colder via asymmetric reheating. All of these possibilities rely on strong coincidences, where physics that has nothing to do with WDM happens to provide the exact initial conditions assumed in a WDM cosmology. Meanwhile, WDM is often used as a proxy for models with self-consistent thermal histories that generically predict the suppression of structure formation on small scales in a way that is both quantitatively and qualitatively different from WDM. I therefore advocate for a transition to more expressive parameterizations and simulation-based methods in order to extract more useful information from the wealth of upcoming data.

analysis.title_zh: 要让暗物质在字面意义上是温暖的，需要什么？
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检视暗物质若真是“温暖”的相对论解耦热遗迹，需要满足哪些热史条件。摘要指出，在当前接近约 10 keV 的 WDM 质量约束下，需要极多相对论自由度、早期物质主导的熵注入，或从未与标准模型热接触且通过非对称再加热产生的更冷暗部门；作者因此主张转向更灵活的参数化和基于模拟的方法。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: WDM 常被用于解释或约束小尺度结构抑制，而这些结构约束与 CMB 给出的初始扰动和宇宙学参数共同构成暗物质模型检验框架。该文提醒 CMB/大尺度结构联合分析中，简单 WDM transfer function 可能并不对应自洽的热史，特别是在存在早期非标准膨胀史时。
key_points: 作者质疑“字面意义上温暖”的热遗迹 WDM 是否自然可行。
满足接近 10 keV 的质量约束需要大量相对论自由度、早期物质主导熵稀释，或与标准模型脱耦的暗部门。
摘要主张用更具表达力的参数化和基于模拟的方法替代简单 WDM 代理。
methods: 热遗迹 WDM 的解耦条件分析
当前 WDM 质量约束的理论解释
早期物质主导与熵注入情景讨论
暗部门非热接触/非对称再加热情景
小尺度结构形成参数化与模拟方法的论证
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者如何把 WDM 质量约束转化为相对论自由度、熵稀释或暗部门温度条件，并确认其对传统 WDM transfer function 适用性的批评是否依赖特定小尺度结构数据或模拟假设。

papers.title: Enhancing dark siren cosmology via Gaussian process reconstruction of incomplete galaxy catalogs
papers.abstract: We present a novel framework for improving dark siren cosmology by applying a Gaussian process (GP) to the line-of-sight (LOS) reconstruction of incomplete galaxy catalogs. In the standard galaxy catalog method for inferring the Hubble constant $H_0$ from gravitational-wave (GW) dark sirens, missing galaxies are typically assumed to follow a uniform distribution in comoving volume, an assumption that discards galaxy redshift clustering information crucial for cosmological inference. We propose instead to model the LOS galaxy redshift distribution as a non-parametric function drawn from a GP realization, which is fitted to the observed incomplete catalog via a hierarchical Bayesian likelihood that explicitly accounts for the survey selection function. Applied to mock GW and galaxy catalogs extending up to redshift $z\leq0.4$, our method yields $H_0$ constraints that are on average 23% more precise than the standard homogeneous completion when using a 24%-complete galaxy catalog, and 37% more precise for an 8%-complete catalog. The largest improvement, reaching 66%, is obtained in configurations where the GP most effectively reconstructs the redshift over- and under-density features that the homogeneous completion fails to capture.

analysis.title_zh: 通过对不完备星系表进行高斯过程重建来增强暗标准汽笛宇宙学
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对用引力波暗标准汽笛和不完备星系表推断 H0 时常用的“缺失星系均匀分布”假设，提出用高斯过程非参数重建视线方向星系红移分布，并在分层贝叶斯似然中显式处理巡天选择函数。摘要报告，在 z≤0.4 的模拟 GW 和星系表上，该方法相对标准均匀补全在不同完备度下给出平均更精确的 H0 约束，尤其在能恢复红移过密/欠密结构时改进最大。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H0 张力和低红移距离标尺是 CMB 宇宙学的重要外部检验；暗标准汽笛提供独立于传统距离梯和早期宇宙模型的 H0 约束。若星系表不完备性的处理更可靠，可帮助将引力波标准汽笛与 CMB 推断进行更稳健的比较。
key_points: 用高斯过程重建不完备星系表的视线方向红移分布。
在模拟暗标准汽笛和星系表中，相比均匀补全得到更精确的 H0 约束。
改进来自恢复红移过密和欠密结构，而非假设缺失星系均匀分布。
methods: Gaussian process 非参数重建
视线方向 galaxy redshift distribution 建模
分层贝叶斯似然
显式纳入 survey selection function
mock GW and galaxy catalogs up to z≤0.4
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 GP 先验、核函数和选择函数建模是否会在低完备度星系表中引入偏差，以及模拟星系聚类与真实巡天不完备性的相似程度。

papers.title: Impact of Scale-dependent Primordial Non-Gaussianity on Scalar-induced Gravitational Waves
papers.abstract: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) probe primordial curvature perturbations beyond cosmic microwave background scales, while primordial black holes (PBHs) probe the rare tail of the same statistics. We ask whether SIGW morphology can reveal scale-dependent primordial non-Gaussianity. We adopt the internal-leg separable kernel, $\mathcal F_{\rm NL}(\mathbf{k};\mathbf q,\mathbf{k}-\mathbf q)=\bar f_{\rm NL}f(q)f(\lVert\mathbf{k}-\mathbf q\rVert)$, and compute Gaussian, reducible, and connected contributions through $\mathcal O(\bar f_{\rm NL}^{4})$ in the second-order tensor-source approximation. We compare persistent power-law running with a UV-matched tanh weight that saturates at high scalar momentum. Across narrow, finite-width, asymmetric, and multi-slope scalar spectra, running produces more than amplitude renormalization. Power-law running shifts the scalar support sampled by non-Gaussian convolutions, generating peak displacement, asymmetric shoulders, and persistent ultraviolet deformations. The tanh template instead produces a transition-localized modification and approaches a momentum-independent ultraviolet plateau. Analytical estimates of the perturbative hierarchy, weighted slopes, log-normal saddle displacement, peak shifts, and infrared scaling explain the trends and the enhanced sensitivity of the $\mathcal O(\bar f_{\rm NL}^{4})$ sector. For localized sources with finite weighted moments, smooth running preserves the leading $k^3$ infrared behavior up to logarithmic corrections. Since the PBH mass scales as $M\propto k^{-2}$, preferential high-wavenumber weighting conditionally favors lower PBH masses in a narrow-support interpretation. Peak position, spectral curvature, shoulders, and ultraviolet slopes are diagnostics for PTAs, LISA, and third-generation observations, providing finite-order templates for primordial interactions on otherwise inaccessible scales.

analysis.title_zh: 尺度依赖原初非高斯性对标量诱导引力波的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究标量诱导引力波的谱形是否能揭示尺度依赖的原初非高斯性，采用内部腿可分离非高斯核并在二阶张量源近似下计算至 \(\mathcal O(\bar f_{\rm NL}^{4})\)。摘要称，幂律 running 会导致峰位移动、非对称肩部和持续紫外形变，而 UV 匹配的 tanh 模板主要产生局域过渡并在高动量处趋于平台。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章关注的是 CMB 之外的小尺度原初扰动信息：SIGW 和 PBH 可补充 CMB 对原初统计性质的约束。若谱形诊断能区分尺度依赖非高斯性，它将为连接 CMB 尺度、PTA/LISA/三代引力波观测和早期宇宙相互作用模型提供模板。
key_points: SIGW 可探测远小于 CMB 尺度的原初曲率扰动。
尺度依赖非高斯性会改变谱形，而不仅是整体幅度。
峰位、肩部结构、紫外斜率等被提出作为 PTA、LISA 和三代探测器诊断量。
methods: 内部腿可分离核 \(\mathcal F_{\rm NL}=\bar f_{\rm NL}f(q)f(|\mathbf{k}-\mathbf q|)\)
二阶张量源近似
计算 Gaussian、reducible 和 connected 贡献至 \(\mathcal O(\bar f_{\rm NL}^{4})\)
比较幂律 running 与 UV 匹配 tanh 权重
窄峰、有限宽、非对称和多斜率标量功率谱模板
解析估计：微扰层级、加权斜率、log-normal 鞍点位移、峰移和红外标度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对二阶张量源近似和有限阶 \(\bar f_{\rm NL}\) 展开在所讨论参数范围内是否自洽，尤其是 \(\mathcal O(\bar f_{\rm NL}^{4})\) 项增强时微扰层级是否仍受控；还应检查不同标量谱模板对峰移和紫外形变结论的依赖程度。

papers.title: The GPSP Atlas: High-resolution Galactic Photon Survival Probability Atlas for Very-High- and Ultra-High-Energy Gamma-Ray Astronomy
papers.abstract: The emergence of Galactic PeV astronomy makes photon--photon ($γγ$) absorption an increasingly important component of gamma-ray data analysis. In this work, the Galactic Photon Survival Probability (GPSP) atlas is presented as the first Galactic framework describing gamma-ray survival probabilities over the full parameter space $P(l,b,d,E_γ)$ between 1 TeV and 10 PeV. The atlas is constructed using two independent GALPROP-based interstellar radiation field (ISRF) models, allowing direct assessment of ISRF-related systematics, and is released in a FITS format compatible with standard analysis frameworks. A novel gamma-ray survival phase space representation is introduced, extending 1D survival profiles into a 2D energy--distance framework that visualizes Galactic transparency and gamma-ray horizons. Using the full atlas, Galactic transparency and Galactic plane survival maps are constructed. These reveal that Galactic opacity is highly structured, with enhanced attenuation along spiral-arm tangent directions in the $\sim$100--300 TeV regime, while attenuation becomes nearly isotropic and cosmic microwave background (CMB) dominated near PeV energies. The framework naturally accommodates attenuation calculations for extended and diffuse sources. The atlas is further extended to subluminal Lorentz invariance violation (LIV) scenarios through the GPSP-LIV atlas, incorporating LIV-modified pair production kinematics and cross sections. Sources emitting in the 2--3 PeV regime beyond gamma-ray horizons are identified as promising targets for probing LIV effects. Finally, practical applications are presented for the Galactic Center PeVatron and the Cygnus X-3 regions. The GPSP and GPSP-LIV atlases establish a publicly available foundation for studies of Galactic PeVatrons, diffuse gamma-ray emission, and fundamental physics searches in the emerging era of Galactic PeV astronomy.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 15 figures. Published in The Astrophysical Journal (ApJ). Public release of the GPSP and GPSP-LIV atlases, including FITS data products and Python helper modules. Data available via Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/21403524. Documentation and example notebooks available at https://gpsp-atlas.readthedocs.io

analysis.title_zh: GPSP 图谱：面向甚高能与超高能伽马射线天文学的高分辨率银河光子存活概率图谱
analysis.summary_zh: 本文发布 GPSP 图谱，用两个独立的 GALPROP 型星际辐射场模型计算银河系内 1 TeV 到 10 PeV 伽马射线的存活概率 P(l,b,d,Eγ)，并以 FITS 格式提供。摘要报告银河不透明度具有明显结构，在约 100–300 TeV 沿旋臂切向方向衰减增强，而接近 PeV 时衰减近乎各向同性并由 CMB 主导，同时给出 LIV 扩展图谱和若干实际区域应用。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 的联系来自高能伽马射线在传播中与背景光子发生 γγ 吸收，其中 PeV 能区摘要称衰减由 CMB 主导。对 CMB/宇宙学读者而言，它展示了 CMB 作为宇宙背景辐射场在非热各向异性之外的作用，也关系到用伽马射线传播检验基本物理和银河高能源的系统误差建模。
key_points: GPSP atlas 给出银河系内 TeV 到 PeV 伽马射线的光子存活概率。
摘要称 PeV 附近的衰减趋于近各向同性并由 CMB 主导。
该框架还扩展到亚光速洛伦兹不变性破缺情形。
methods: 两个独立的基于 GALPROP 的星际辐射场 ISRF 模型
FITS 格式图谱
二维能量-距离伽马射线存活相空间表示
银河透明度图和银道面存活图
LIV 修正的成对产生运动学与截面
Galactic Center PeVatron 和 Cygnus X-3 区域应用
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 CMB 主导 PeV 衰减的能区界定、ISRF 系统误差如何传播到存活概率，以及 LIV 扩展中对成对产生阈值和截面的具体假设。

papers.title: The impact of the IGM thermal state on the Ly$α$ flux 3D power spectrum from linear to highly non-linear scales
papers.abstract: Recently initiated and upcoming spectroscopic surveys, such as DESI and WST, will provide more than $10^6$ high-$z$ quasar spectra, enabling dense sky coverage by the Ly$α$ forest. This is expected to establish the three-dimensional (3D) Ly$α$ forest power spectrum, $P_{\rm 3D,α}$, as a probe of the thermal and ionization history of the intergalactic medium (IGM). To exploit this opportunity, we quantify the imprints of reionization on the post-reionization IGM using high-fidelity numerical models. We use the Sherwood and Sherwood-Relics cosmological hydrodynamical simulations with box sizes up to $160\,h^{-1}\,\rm cMpc$ to investigate the impact of box size, mass resolution, and extracted grid resolution on $P_{\rm 3D,α}$ over $2.4\leq z\leq4.8$. After applying a Zel'dovich control variate correction, simulation volume has a modest impact over most scales and orientations, whereas degrading the mass resolution produces differences of up to $\sim13\%$. Insufficient resolution of the grid used for the optical-depth calculation can artificially enhance small-scale power by up to $\sim35\%$. The timing of $\mathrm{H\,I}$ reionization leaves only a percent-level imprint on $P_{\rm 3D,α}$ at $z=2.4$, whereas varying the photoheating rate by a factor of two changes the large-scale power by $\sim4-8\%$. Our results demonstrate that numerical effects can be comparable to, or exceed, the relic astrophysical signatures encoded in $P_{\rm 3D,α}$, making numerical convergence essential for interpreting precise Ly$α$ forest measurements. The strongest astrophysical imprint arises from spatially inhomogeneous $\mathrm{H\,I}$ reionization, which enhances the large-scale power by up to $\sim70\%$ at $z=4.2$. This highlights the potential of post-reionization Ly$α$ forest measurements as a probe of the thermal history and spatial morphology of cosmic reionization.

analysis.title_zh: IGM 热状态对从线性到高度非线性尺度的 Lyα 通量三维功率谱的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究星系际介质热状态和再电离历史如何影响后再电离时期三维 Lyα 森林通量功率谱，使用 Sherwood 系列宇宙学流体模拟并系统考察盒子大小、质量分辨率和光深网格分辨率等数值效应。摘要报告数值效应可与甚至超过再电离遗迹信号，而空间非均匀 H I 再电离会在高红移大尺度功率上留下最强印记。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Lyα 森林三维功率谱是 DESI 等大规模光谱巡天可提供的重要大尺度结构探针，可补充 CMB 对早期宇宙、再电离和物质功率谱的约束。该文强调解释精密 Lyα 测量时必须控制数值收敛，否则可能误把模拟误差当作再电离热史或空间形态的宇宙学信号。
key_points: 研究 2.4≤z≤4.8 的三维 Lyα 森林通量功率谱对 IGM 热状态和再电离遗迹的响应。
数值分辨率、盒子大小和光深计算网格会显著影响 P3D,α。
摘要称非均匀 H I 再电离在 z=4.2 可显著增强大尺度功率。
methods: Sherwood 与 Sherwood-Relics 宇宙学流体动力学模拟
最大 160 h^{-1} cMpc 的模拟盒
Zel'dovich control variate correction
三维 Lyα 森林通量功率谱 P_{3D,α}

papers.title: Discovery Potentials for the Cosmic Neutrino Background using Single Arm Interferometer
papers.abstract: We study the interaction between light and non-relativistic cosmic neutrino background (CNB). We propose single arm laser interferometry with coherent laser source and two distinct squeezing operators to probe such interaction. We analyze the induced phase shift in four distinct quantum regimes of the interferometer operation: the standard quantum limit (SQL), the Heisenberg limit, super-Heisenberg limit with $N^{3/2}$ enhancement, and super-Heisenberg limit with $N^{2}$ enhancement where $N$ is the number of photons in the interferometer. We demonstrate that the $N^{2}$ super-Heisenberg enhancement has the potential to probe the magnetic moment down to $10^{-25}\, μ_{B}$ where $ μ_{B}$ is the Bohr magneton. If the CNB and photons interact via its magnetic moment, this interaction could be revealed in single arm interferometer operating at super-Heisenberg limit with $N^{2}$ enhancement.

analysis.title_zh: 使用单臂干涉仪探测宇宙中微子背景的发现潜力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究光与非相对论性宇宙中微子背景的相互作用，并提出使用单臂激光干涉仪、相干光源和两种压缩算符来探测相互作用诱导的相移。摘要称在 N² 超海森堡增强工作区间下，该方案有潜力探测低至 10^-25 μB 的中微子磁矩，从而揭示 CNB 与光子的磁矩相互作用。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙中微子背景是标准热宇宙学的关键遗迹背景，与 CMB 同属早期宇宙的基本背景场；其直接探测将补充 CMB 对有效中微子数、质量和早期宇宙热史的间接约束。该论文的 CMB 相关性不是数据分析层面，而是粒子宇宙学与早期宇宙背景探测层面的互补。
key_points: 论文讨论光与非相对论性宇宙中微子背景的相互作用。
提出单臂激光干涉仪与压缩算符方案。
摘要称 N² 超海森堡增强可能探测到 10^-25 μB 的中微子磁矩。
methods: 单臂激光干涉测量
相干激光源
两个不同的压缩算符
四种量子工作区间分析：标准量子极限、海森堡极限、N^(3/2) 超海森堡增强、N^2 超海森堡增强
基于相互作用诱导相移的估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对光子-CNB 磁矩相互作用导致相移的推导、N² 超海森堡增强的物理可实现性，以及背景噪声和系统误差是否会淹没该效应。

papers.title: Chebyshev interpolation in Einstein-Boltzmann codes
papers.abstract: Einstein-Boltzmann codes compute theoretical predictions of cosmological models and rely heavily on interpolation in their independent variables: time $τ$, wavenumber $k$ and multipole $\ell$. We give a practical summary of interpolation with Chebyshev polynomials, which converges rapidly for smooth functions and thus pairs naturally with approximation-free Einstein-Boltzmann codes. By solving the perturbations and line-of-sight integrals at Chebyshev nodes in $k$ and $\ell$, we show that Chebyshev polynomials interpolate to higher precision than traditional cubic splines from fewer explicit solutions. On a set of example spectra for matter and the cosmic microwave background (CMB), we find up to four orders of magnitude lower interpolation error using the same number of points. For a typical CMB temperature spectrum computed with interpolation in both $k$ and $\ell$, Chebyshev polynomials converge to $10^{-4}$-$10^{-5}$ relative error with only 50-80 points per variable, while cubic splines approach $10^{-4}$ error with 200 points, translating to a $2.5\times$-$4\times$ speedup. The exact improvement depends on the target function and is generally more dramatic at high precision levels. Standard Chebyshev $\ell$-interpolation needs line-of-sight integrals generalized to non-integer $\ell$, but we show a way to avoid this by rounding the nodes to integers. Chebyshev interpolation is implemented in SymBoltz, which is available at https://github.com/hersle/SymBoltz.jl.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, submitted to A&A, SymBoltz is available at https://github.com/hersle/SymBoltz.jl

analysis.title_zh: Einstein-Boltzmann 代码中的 Chebyshev 插值
analysis.summary_zh: 本文面向 Einstein-Boltzmann 代码中的时间、波数和多极矩插值问题，总结并测试 Chebyshev 多项式插值在 \(k\) 和 \(\ell\) 方向的应用。摘要报告称，在物质谱和 CMB 谱示例中，相同点数下 Chebyshev 插值误差可比三次样条低至多四个数量级，并可在典型 CMB 温度谱计算中带来约 \(2.5\times\)-\(4\times\) 加速。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 理论谱计算的精度和速度直接影响 Boltzmann 代码、似然评估和参数推断。若 Chebyshev 插值能稳健减少显式求解次数，它对高精度 CMB 分析、未来实验的数据处理和理论模型扫描都有直接方法学价值。
key_points: Einstein-Boltzmann 代码大量依赖对 \(\tau\)、\(k\)、\(\ell\) 的插值。
Chebyshev 插值在示例物质谱和 CMB 谱上用更少采样点达到更低误差。
方法已在 SymBoltz 中实现，并讨论了整数 \(\ell\) 节点的处理。

在 \(k\) 和 \(\ell\) 的 Chebyshev 节点求解扰动和 line-of-sight 积分
与传统三次样条插值比较

papers.title: Testing $f(Q)$ Gravity with DESI DR2 and Strong-Lensing Time Delays
papers.abstract: Symmetric teleparallel gravity provides an alternative description of gravitation in which non-metricity replaces curvature and torsion. Its extension through $f(Q)$ gravity offers a different geometric description of the late-time expansion of the Universe and its accelerated phase. In this work, we investigate two $f(Q)$ models, a normalized power-law model and a square-root exponential model, and test their ability to describe the late-time expansion history. We constrain the model parameters through Markov chain Monte Carlo analyses using Cosmic Chronometer measurements, DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillations, strong-lensing time-delay observations, and three Type Ia supernova compilations, Pantheon$^+$, Union 3.0, and DES Y5. We compare both models with the flat $Λ$CDM model using the minimum $χ^2$, Akaike information criterion, and Bayesian information criterion. The square-root exponential model provides a better statistical fit than $Λ$CDM for the combinations of Cosmic Chronometer, DESI DR2, and strong-lensing time-delay data with Pantheon$^+$ and Union 3.0, with improvements in both the goodness of fit and information criteria. The normalized power-law model remains statistically competitive with $Λ$CDM for the supernova-inclusive combinations, although the information criteria do not favor its additional parameter. We also determine the transition redshift from cosmic deceleration to acceleration for both models, obtaining consistent values across the different dataset combinations. The transition redshifts agree with observational estimates of the cosmic acceleration epoch. Overall, our results support $f(Q)$ gravity as a viable alternative to $Λ$CDM for explaining the late-time accelerated expansion of the Universe without requiring a cosmological constant.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. v2: references added and minor corrections

analysis.title_zh: 用 DESI DR2 和强透镜时延检验 f(Q) 引力

papers.title: First application of weak lensing peak steepness statistics to HSC Y1 data: effectively probing halo density profiles
papers.abstract: As a new probe, the weak lensing (WL) peak steepness statistics is sensitive to the density profile of halos that encodes important information of baryonic feedback and dark matter properties, leading to a promising means to statistically constrain these effects using WL data. In this article, we present its first application to HSC Y1 data to demonstrate the great potential of this new statistics. Within the phenomenological framework of HMcode2016 that attributes the baryonic feedback solely to the reduction of the halo concentration parameter and focusing on high peaks originated dominantly from massive clusters, our analyses by combining WL peak height and steepness statistics resulted in $S_8=0.76^{+0.08}_{-0.07}$ with the maximum-a-posteriori (MAP) of $0.79$ and low concentrations. Taking the form of the concentration-mass relation as $c(M,z)=A(1+z_{\rm f})/(1+z)$ with $z_{\rm f}$ being the formation redshift of halos with mass $M$ at redshift $z$, we obtain $A=1.93^{+1.33}_{-1.16}$ (MAP=$1.70$) in comparison with $A=3.34^{+1.52}_{-1.74}$ (MAP=3.31) from dark matter only simulated mocks. The result tends to support phenomenologically strong baryonic feedback effects at cluster scales.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 10 figures, accepted for publication in ApJ

analysis.title_zh: 弱透镜峰陡峭度统计在 HSC Y1 数据上的首次应用：有效探测晕密度轮廓
analysis.summary_zh: 本文把弱透镜峰陡峭度统计首次用于 HSC Y1 数据，目标是利用其对晕密度轮廓的敏感性来探测重子反馈和暗物质相关效应。摘要报告，在 HMcode2016 的现象学框架下联合峰高度与陡峭度得到 S8 约束和偏低的浓度参数，并相对于暗物质-only mock 倾向支持星系团尺度较强重子反馈。

联合峰高度和峰陡峭度统计，在 HMcode2016 现象学框架下约束 S8 与 halo concentration。

papers.title: CMB Birefringence from Axion String Networks Calibrated to an AMR Simulation
papers.abstract: A cosmological network of axion strings may exist in the Universe today. If axion-like particles couple to electromagnetism, such a network induces spatially varying birefringence in the polarization of the cosmic microwave background (CMB), which can be probed by current and next-generation CMB experiments. We calibrate a loop-crossing model against a large-scale adaptive-mesh-refinement (AMR) simulation of axion-string network dynamics in the early Universe and use the calibrated model to predict CMB birefringence from recombination to today. We find that the non-detection of anisotropic birefringence in CMB observations places a strong upper bound on the electromagnetic anomaly coefficient $\mathcal{A}$ that enters the axion-photon coupling $g_{aγγ} = - \mathcal{A} α_\mathrm{em} / πf_a$. A joint analysis of available anisotropic birefringence measurements constrains $|\mathcal{A}| < 0.24$ at 95% C.L., which is independent of the Peccei-Quinn scale $f_a$, assuming that the axions are hyperlight so that the network survives until today. This limit strongly restricts the high-energy embedding of hyperlight axions, excluding the minimal Grand Unified Theory prediction for the electromagnetic anomaly coefficient at high significance. In addition, we discuss the implications of an axion-string origin for the recently reported evidence of isotropic birefringence.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures + 19 pages references and appendix

analysis.title_zh: 由 AMR 模拟校准的轴子弦网络产生的 CMB 双折射
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究若宇宙中存在与电磁场耦合的轴子弦网络，其会在 CMB 偏振中产生空间变化的双折射信号。作者用大尺度 AMR 模拟校准 loop-crossing 模型并预测从复合到今天的 CMB 双折射，摘要报告各向异性双折射非探测给出 \(|\mathcal A|<0.24\) 的 95% C.L. 上限，且在超轻轴子网络存活至今的假设下与 \(f_a\) 无关。

papers.title: Gaussian process reconstruction of scalar field dynamics from recent cosmological data
papers.abstract: We reconstruct the late-time expansion history and dark energy dynamics using available cosmological data. We consider dark energy as an effective minimally coupled canonical scalar field without assuming a specific form for its potential. For reconstruction, we use Gaussian Process (GP) regression with a joint dataset consisting of 32 cosmic chronometer measurements (CC32), DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation data, three Type Ia supernova compilations (Pantheon+, Union3, and DES Y5), and compressed CMB distance priors. From the reconstructed Hubble parameter and its derivatives, we obtain the scalar field kinetic and potential energy densities, the equation of state $w(z)$, and the dimensionless slope parameter $|λ(z)|$ of the scalar field potential. The reconstructed potential is nearly constant at late times, with $\tilde{V}(0) \simeq 0.68$--$0.70ρ_{c,0}$, close to the dark-energy density in flat $Λ$CDM. The kinetic term remains small over $0 \lesssim z \lesssim 2.5$, while $w(z)$ remains close to $-1$ within the uncertainties. Using only CC32 and DESI DR2, we find a mild ($1σ$) hint of a phantom-divide crossing near $z\sim0.5$. However, this feature depends on the supernova compilation and cannot be regarded as a firm conclusion with current data. The slope parameter $|λ(z)|$ shows mild evolution, with present-day central values around $0.8$--$1.0$, but large uncertainties due to its dependence on higher-order derivatives of the expansion history. The curvature parameter $Γ(z)$ requires even higher-order derivatives and is not constrained by current data; therefore, we do not report its reconstruction. Allowing small spatial curvature, $Ω_k=0$--$0.02$, changes the results only slightly and remains within the existing uncertainty bands.

analysis.title_zh: 利用近期宇宙学数据对标量场动力学进行高斯过程重建

papers.title: Dark-to-black super-accretion as a spin-imprinting mechanism for supermassive Kerr black holes
papers.abstract: The existence of supermassive black holes with masses $M\gtrsim10^9\,M_{\odot}$ and large dimensionless spins $χ\sim0.9-0.99$ at high redshift remains a challenge to our understanding of the early Universe. In this work, we study the adiabatic co-evolution of a Kerr black hole seed surrounded by two ultralight scalar dark matter clouds occupying different bound states, and show that this configuration allows the black hole to grow into the supermassive mass range while imprinting a characteristic final spin. The evolution proceeds through two stages. During the first stage, a spherical cloud described by the $\ell=0$ mode is completely depleted through a runaway dark-to-black accretion mechanism on a timescale of hundreds of millions of years for boson masses $μ\sim10^{-18}-10^{-17}\,\mathrm{eV}$. Since the accreted material does not carry angular momentum, the black hole spin is universally driven to $χ\simeq0$, independently of its initial spin. Throughout this stage, the second cloud, described by the $\ell=m=1$ mode, remains in the superradiant regime with negligible evolution. However, once the first stage is completed, this cloud transitions to the accreting regime, rapidly transferring both mass and angular momentum to the black hole. Starting from $χ\simeq0$, the black hole spin increases until the evolution self-consistently saturates close to the threshold $χ_{\rm sat}$, defined by the condition $Ω_H(χ_{\rm sat})=μ$, on an e-folding timescale of thousands of years, orders of magnitude shorter than the first stage. This final saturation spin is largely independent of both the initial black hole spin and the mass of the secondary cloud, providing a spin-imprinting mechanism in which the primordial spin is first erased by spherical accretion and then reset to a value determined only by the boson mass and the final black hole mass.

analysis.title_zh: 暗到黑超吸积作为超大质量 Kerr 黑洞的自旋印记机制
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究一个 Kerr 黑洞种子被两个不同束缚态的超轻标量暗物质云包围时的绝热共同演化，试图解释高红移大质量且高自旋超大质量黑洞。摘要报告了两阶段机制：先由球对称云经暗到黑吸积使自旋趋近零，再由 l=m=1 云快速转移质量和角动量，把黑洞自旋重置到由玻色子质量和最终黑洞质量决定的饱和值附近。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的直接联系较弱，但涉及超轻暗物质和早期宇宙中超大质量黑洞形成，这些主题会影响宇宙学暗物质模型、早期结构形成和高红移天体种群解释。对 CMB 研究者而言，它主要是暗物质粒子性质与非线性小尺度结构形成之间联系的理论背景。
key_points: 研究 Kerr 黑洞种子与两个超轻标量暗物质云的绝热共同演化。
摘要提出先由 l=0 云的暗到黑吸积抹除自旋，再由 l=m=1 云快速传递质量和角动量。
最终自旋接近由 Ω_H(χ_sat)=μ 定义的饱和值，并主要由玻色子质量和最终黑洞质量决定。

papers.title: The Primordial power spectrum from the largest to smallest CMB scales
papers.abstract: We reconstruct the primordial power spectrum (PPS) across the full range of cosmological scales accessible to Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) observations. Using the Modified Richardson--Lucy algorithm, we perform free-form reconstructions through deconvolution of Planck PR3 and PR4, Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) DR6, and South Pole Telescope 3G (SPT-3G) D1 data. Across different regularization schemes, we find no evidence for significant deviations from a power-law primordial spectrum. The reconstructed spectra show a strong correlation between Planck and ACT, even at the level of localized features over their overlapping range, $0.07 < k < 0.14\,\mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$, demonstrating consistency between the two observations. Using a complementary parametric Bayesian reconstruction, we find that the previously discussed preference for a blueward tilt in the ACT data at small scales is preferred only at the $1σ$ level.

analysis.title_zh: 从最大到最小 CMB 尺度的原初功率谱
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Modified Richardson--Lucy 算法对 Planck PR3/PR4、ACT DR6 和 SPT-3G D1 数据进行反卷积，重建 CMB 可探测尺度上的原初功率谱。摘要称在不同正则化方案下没有发现显著偏离幂律谱的证据，Planck 与 ACT 在重叠尺度上高度一致，而 ACT 小尺度蓝倾偏好在参数化贝叶斯重建中仅为 1σ。

papers.title: A "MeerKAT-meets-LOFAR" Study of 2A 0335+096: Discovery of a Complex 500 kpc Radio Halo in a Disturbed Cool-Core Cluster
papers.abstract: The emerging picture of radio haloes and mini-haloes in galaxy clusters is more blurred and far less distinct than once thought. While both trace cosmic ray electrons and magnetic fields in the intracluster medium (ICM), our knowledge of the mechanisms powering these sources, their properties and their connection to cluster dynamics, is incomplete. We present new deep MeerKAT L-band (856$-$1712\,MHz) observations of the sloshing cool-core cluster 2A~0335+096, performed as part of the ``MeerKAT-meets-LOFAR'' mini-halo census, as well as reprocessed LOFAR 120$-$168\,MHz LOFAR Two-metre Sky Survey data. We present highly sensitive radio continuum images, from which we perform a spectral analysis and a comparison of the thermal and non-thermal properties using reprocessed archival \textit{XMM-Newton} data. Our MeerKAT data reveal that the known mini-halo is embedded in a large-scale radio halo spanning up to 510\,kpc in this sloshing cluster, although only the inner mini-halo is detected by LOFAR. We find a typical steep spectrum of $α= -1.20 \pm 0.09$ for the mini-halo; the non-detection of the larger-scale halo by LOFAR indicates a spectral index no steeper than $-1.2$. Our results are broadly consistent with an interpretation of turbulent (re-)acceleration powered by sloshing within the cluster potential well. This work emphasises the need for using deep, high-dynamic multi-frequency radio observations in conjunction with high-quality X-ray observations to complete our understanding of the connection between radio halo properties and cluster dynamics.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in A&A. Main article is 13 pages, appendix 3 pages

analysis.title_zh: 2A 0335+096 的 MeerKAT 与 LOFAR 联合研究：在一个受扰动冷核星系团中发现复杂的 500 kpc 射电晕
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用新的 MeerKAT L 波段观测并结合重处理的 LOFAR 数据，研究冷核星系团 2A 0335+096 的非热辐射结构。摘要报告称，已知的小尺度 mini-halo 被一个延伸到约 510 kpc 的大尺度射电晕包围，而 LOFAR 只探测到内层 mini-halo；其谱指数大致为 -1.20 ± 0.09，结果与湍流再加速解释相符。

MeerKAT 比 LOFAR 更清楚地揭示了外层结构。

结合 XMM-Newton 归档数据比较热/非热性质
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最需要核对的是：大尺度 halo 的边界如何定义，谱指数约束是否受频段覆盖和灵敏度差异影响，以及与 X 射线扰动特征之间的对应关系是否足够强。

papers.title: The Effect of Slitless Spectroscopic Redshift Uncertainty and Interlopers on BAO Measurements from CSST-like Samples
papers.abstract: The baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) is a vital probe to measure cosmological distances and constrain dark energy. The ongoing and near-future space-based telescopes, including the Chinese Space Station Survey Telescope (CSST), will perform galaxy redshift surveys using slitless spectroscopy. Due to the relatively low spectral resolution and observational effects, there will be uncertainties and interloper contamination in measured redshifts. In this study, we consider the Gaussian-distributed redshift uncertainty and [O III]-H$β$ interlopers in the CSST-like slitless spectroscopic redshift (spec-z) samples, which are simulated using the approximate $N$-body code FastPM. We study the effect of spec-z errors on BAO before and after density field reconstruction. Both the redshift uncertainty and interlopers can damp the BAO signal, and the latter can further induce oscillations in the broadband shape of the power spectrum. We model the interloper effect on the propagator, i.e. the cross-correlation between the observed and initial density fields, as well as on the BAO power spectrum. We study the influence of the spec-z errors on the fitted anisotropic BAO parameters $α_{\perp}$ and $α_{\parallel}$. The resulting systematic bias on $α_{\perp}$ and $α_{\parallel}$ is mild, mostly within $0.1$ per cent and $0.2$ per cent, respectively. Even with the spec-z errors, BAO reconstruction can still significantly reduce the systematic bias and statistical errors on the $α$ parameters. Furthermore, we vary the redshift uncertainty and study the reconstruction performance.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 (and 7 supplementary) figures, accepted by MNRAS

analysis.title_zh: CSST 类样本中无缝光谱红移不确定性与前景体对 BAO 测量的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究了 CSST 类无缝光谱星系样本中的红移误差与前景体污染对重子声学振荡测量的影响。摘要报告称，作者用 FastPM 模拟样本，在重建前后分析了 Gaussian 红移不确定性和 [O III]-Hβ 前景体对 BAO 信号、传播子以及各向异性 BAO 参数 α_perp 和 α_parallel 的影响，得到的系统偏差通常很小，且 BAO 重建仍能有效降低系统偏差与统计误差。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: BAO 是距离尺度和暗能量研究的核心工具，而 CMB 常通过早期宇宙标尺与低红移大尺度结构观测联合来收紧宇宙学参数。这里讨论的是未来巡天在谱红移系统误差下能否维持 BAO 的精度，因此对后续联合宇宙学分析很关键。
key_points: 讨论了 CSST 类无缝光谱样本的 BAO 系统误差。
前景体污染不仅削弱振荡，还会扰动功率谱广域形状。
摘要称重建对误差抑制仍然有效。
methods: Gaussian 红移不确定性建模
[O III]-Hβ interloper 污染建模
FastPM 近似 N 体模拟
BAO 重建前后比较
传播子与 BAO 功率谱建模
各向异性 BAO 拟合
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：interloper 模型如何进入传播子与功率谱，重建算法对不同红移误差宽度的敏感性，以及系统偏差“通常在 0.1% 和 0.2% 内”的适用范围。

papers.title: An HI study of a large sample of ultra-diffuse galaxies
papers.abstract: By cross-matching the SMUDGes catalog with the FASHI and ALFALFA HI surveys, we construct an HI-detected sample of 112 ultra-diffuse galaxies (UDGs) and 48 low-surface-brightness (LSB) galaxies, providing HI-based redshifts for 76 galaxies for the first time. Using DESI DR1 redshifts, we assemble an HI-non-detected sample of 168 galaxies for stacking analysis, with detections in two stellar mass bins below 10^{8.5} M_sun. Combining optical, UV, and HI data, we investigate stellar masses, star formation rates, gas fractions, and kinematics. We present a systematic analysis of the HI mass--optical size relation for UDGs and LSBs, showing both populations follow a mass--optical size scaling similar to normal galaxies, suggesting an average HI surface density, under the assumption that the optical size traces the extent of the HI distribution. Their stellar mass--size relation indicates nearly constant stellar surface densities for galaxies with central surface brightness mu_{0,g}>~24mag arcsec^{-2}, independent of UDG or LSB classification. Many UDGs and LSB galaxies are systematically offset from the baryonic Tully--Fisher relation toward higher baryonic masses at a given velocity, consistent with trends found in UDGs with resolved HI kinematics. Both populations exhibit low star formation efficiencies and long gas depletion times, supporting multiple formation pathways for UDGs.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal; 25 pages, 10 figures

analysis.title_zh: 大样本超弥散星系的 HI 研究
analysis.summary_zh: 本文通过将 SMUDGes 星表与 FASHI、ALFALFA HI 巡天交叉匹配，构建了 112 个 HI 探测到的超弥散星系和 48 个低表面亮度星系样本，并用 DESI DR1 红移对未探测样本做叠加分析。摘要报告称，UDG 和 LSB 的 HI 质量--光学大小关系类似普通星系，许多对象相对重子 Tully--Fisher 关系在给定速度下偏向更高重子质量，同时表现出低恒星形成效率和长气体耗尽时间。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于近邻星系形成与气体含量研究，并非直接 CMB 论文；但 UDG/LSB 的重子含量、暗物质主导程度和速度标度关系会影响小尺度结构形成图景，而这些图景需要与 CMB 给出的宇宙学背景参数和暗物质模型相容。对 CMB 读者而言，它可作为连接早期宇宙参数约束与低红移低表面亮度星系族群的观测材料。
key_points: 交叉匹配 SMUDGes 与 FASHI、ALFALFA，构建 HI 探测到的 UDG/LSB 样本。
为 76 个星系首次给出基于 HI 的红移。
UDG 与 LSB 在 HI 质量--光学大小、恒星质量--大小和重子 Tully--Fisher 关系上呈现摘要所述系统趋势。
methods: SMUDGes 星表与 FASHI、ALFALFA HI 巡天交叉匹配
DESI DR1 红移
HI 未探测样本的 stacking analysis
光学、紫外与 HI 数据联合分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对光学大小追踪 HI 分布范围这一假设如何影响 HI 表面密度和质量--大小关系的解释，以及 stacking 样本的选择函数和环境依赖是否会改变 UDG/LSB 的形成路径判断。

papers.title: Interplay of Compaction, Quenching, and Black Hole Growth in the Most Massive Galaxies since $z\sim5$: Insights from JWST and Chandra Data
papers.abstract: The buildup of dense stellar cores is expected to mark an important transition in the star-formation and black-hole growth of massive galaxies. Using spatially resolved spectral energy distribution (SED) fitting of James Webb Space Telescope near-infrared imaging, combined with stacking analysis of Chandra X-ray data, we trace stellar mass buildup and average black hole accretion in the most massive galaxies at $z<5$, selecting 50 most massive galaxies per redshift bin at constant number density of $\sim4.4\times10^{-5}$ cMpc$^{-3}$. To robustly constrain central stellar populations, we separate active galactic nuclei (AGN) components affecting the photometry using multi-band morphological decomposition and SED analysis. We find that the sample selected with constant number density exhibits evolutionary trend of rapid central compaction at $z\sim4$, during which the median central 1 kpc stellar mass increases by $\sim0.60$ dex over $\sim400$ Myr. The majority of X-ray detected AGN ($63\%\pm12\%$) are hosted by galaxies undergoing the compaction, while we find neither individually detected X-ray sources nor a significant stacked X-ray signal at $z>4$, indicating that substantial average black-hole growth emerges primarily during, rather than before, the compaction. Following the compaction, central specific star formation rates (sSFR) decline by $\sim1.24$ dex over $\sim700$ Myr at $z\sim3$ while remaining elevated galaxy-wide, signaling the onset of inside-out quenching. Despite this central suppression, specific black hole accretion rate remains coupled to the total sSFR. Our results suggest that dense-core formation in the most massive galaxies marks the onset of inside-out quenching and a transition toward enhanced black-hole to stellar growth ratio.

analysis.title_zh: 自 z\sim5 以来最大质量星系中致密化、淬火与黑洞增长的相互作用：来自 JWST 和 Chandra 数据的认识
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 JWST 近红外成像的空间分辨 SED 拟合，并结合 Chandra X 射线叠加分析，研究 z<5 最重大质量星系中致密核心形成、恒星形成淬火与黑洞增长的关系。摘要报告称，样本在 z~4 出现快速中心致密化，X 射线探测到的 AGN 多位于致密化阶段，随后 z~3 中心 sSFR 下降而星系整体仍较高，指向由内向外淬火。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项研究关注高红移大质量星系的形成和黑洞增长，属于 CMB 约束宇宙学模型之后的结构形成阶段。对 CMB 研究者而言，它提供了检验 ΛCDM 背景下早期大质量星系装配、重子反馈和黑洞增长历史是否与早期宇宙参数一致的观测线索，但摘要并未涉及 CMB 数据本身。
key_points: 使用 JWST 近红外成像的空间分辨 SED 拟合追踪大质量星系恒星质量增长。
结合 Chandra X 射线叠加分析研究平均黑洞吸积。
摘要称致密核心形成与由内向外淬火、黑洞相对增长增强的转变有关。
methods: JWST 近红外成像
空间分辨光谱能量分布 SED 拟合
Chandra X 射线数据 stacking analysis
恒定数密度样本选择
多波段形态分解
AGN 分量分离与 SED 分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对恒定数密度选择是否可靠追踪同一演化族群，以及 AGN 光度污染分解、中心 1 kpc 恒星质量增长和 X 射线叠加信号的系统误差如何评估。

papers.title: Occultation of microlensed images by circum-lens disks: Implications for surveys
papers.abstract: Microlensing surveys typically apply automated criteria to exclude lightcurves that depart from time-symmetric and achromatic Paczyński curves. In surveys using such automated detection pipelines, occultation of microlensed images by circum-lens material could lead to underdetection or misclassification of ring- or disk-bearing compact object populations. This work characterizes the family of lightcurve morphologies by which uniform thin circum-lens disks of varying size and orientation, and low mass relative to their host lens, can intersect the ray paths produced during microlensing events. These morphology classes are paired with squared residuals relative to an unocculted lightcurve. We find that substantial deviations from an unocculted microlensing curve can occur across a wide range of parameter space. This effect holds relevance for free-floating planets and brown dwarfs where disks or ring systems can be present. Another potential consideration is that disk-shaped accretion flows onto primordial black holes (PBHs) during the cosmic dark ages could have resulted in remnant quiescent disks of baryonic material. Pipelines should be designed to account for disk-bearing lens populations, opening previously underutilized avenues to potentially observe disks and rings in these contexts and ensuring populations are accurately characterized.

analysis.title_zh: 透镜周盘对微透镜像的掩食：对巡天的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究透镜周围的薄盘或环状物质遮掩微透镜像时，会如何使光变曲线偏离标准的时间对称、无色 Paczyński 曲线。摘要报告称，在较宽参数空间内可出现显著偏离，因而自动化微透镜巡天管线可能低估或误分类带盘/环的致密透镜天体族群。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文与 CMB 的联系主要通过暗物质和原初黑洞问题间接相关：CMB 对 PBH、早期能量注入和暗物质模型提供宇宙学约束，而微透镜巡天是低红移寻找致密暗天体的互补途径。摘要还提到宇宙黑暗时代 PBH 吸积流可能留下静默盘的设想，因此对用巡天结果约束 PBH 族群的系统误差有潜在意义。
key_points: 研究带盘或环的透镜天体对微透镜光变曲线的遮掩效应。
自动化巡天管线可能漏检或误分类偏离标准 Paczyński 曲线的事件。
潜在适用对象包括自由漂浮行星、褐矮星，以及摘要中提到的 PBH 吸积盘遗迹设想。
methods: 微透镜光变曲线形态分类
均匀薄环透镜盘模型，改变大小和取向
与未遮掩光变曲线的平方残差比较
面向自动化巡天探测管线的影响分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对薄盘、低质量盘和均匀盘假设的适用范围，以及这些非标准光变曲线在真实巡天噪声、采样和选择函数下是否仍能与其他变源或透镜模型区分。

papers.title: Gravitational Wave Parity-Violating Strain from Pulsar Glitches in Chern-Simons Modified Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate gravitational-wave birefringence from pulsar glitches in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity, a parity-violating extension of general relativity motivated by string theory and quantum gravity. Using the Hartle-Thorne slow-rotation formalism to model the neutron star background and a perturbative treatment of the Chern-Simons coupling $α$, we derive the modified Regge-Wheeler equation governing axial gravitational perturbations and compute the resulting polarization-dependent phase shift. The parity-violating interaction produces a fractional asymmetry between the right- and left-handed circular polarizations that scales as $α^2$, grows linearly with frequency and rotation rate, and falls as the fourth power of the stellar radius. For a constant-density interior model we obtain an analytic matching solution for the background scalar field, and show that the interior curvature factor vanishes identically--the interior solution being conformally flat--so that the scalar dipole is sourced entirely in the vacuum exterior; a centrally condensed equation of state can only increase the predicted signal. We further extend the analysis to a two-fluid model incorporating differential rotation between the neutron superfluid and the charged component; the resulting correction is bounded by the fractional glitch amplitude itself, independently of the equation of state, and is negligible for typical pulsar parameters. Expressed through the dimensionless quantity $ζ\propto αM/R_\star^{3}$, the fractional polarization asymmetry for millisecond pulsars reaches $\sim 10^{-3}$ at kilohertz frequencies at the boundary of perturbative validity--four orders of magnitude above the sensitivity of current ground-based detectors to strain asymmetries. However, realistic bounds are limited by the signal-to-noise ratio required to resolve a ratio of gravitational wave strains.

analysis.title_zh: Chern-Simons 修正引力中脉冲星 Glitch 产生的宇称破缺引力波应变
analysis.summary_zh: 该文在动力学 Chern-Simons 修正引力中研究脉冲星 glitch 引发的引力波双折射，用慢自转中子星背景和对耦合 α 的微扰推导轴向扰动方程并计算偏振相关相移。摘要报告称左右圆偏振之间出现随 α²、频率和自转率增长的分数不对称；常密度模型中标量偶极源自真空外部，两流体差分自转修正对典型脉冲星很小。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要面向引力波和修正引力而非直接 CMB；但宇称破缺传播效应与 CMB 中寻找宇称破缺信号、手征原初引力波或偏振旋转的思想相关。对 CMB 研究者而言，它提供了一个晚期强场天体环境中检验宇称破缺引力的互补通道，可与宇宙学尺度上的张量扰动约束形成对照。
key_points: 在动力学 Chern-Simons 引力中研究脉冲星 glitch 产生的引力波双折射。
摘要称左右圆偏振的相位/振幅不对称随耦合参数平方、频率和自转率增强。
两流体差分自转修正被认为受 glitch 分数幅度限制，对典型脉冲星可忽略。
methods: Hartle-Thorne 慢自转形式
对 Chern-Simons 耦合 α 的微扰处理
修正 Regge-Wheeler 方程
常密度中子星内部模型的解析匹配解
包含中子超流体与带电组分差分自转的两流体模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对从脉冲星 glitch 到可观测引力波应变不对称的信号模型与探测可分辨性假设，特别是扰动有效边界、ζ 的定义、以及“现实限制来自信噪比”的量化方式是否自洽。

papers.title: Projected Constraints on Primordial Black Holes from Scalar-Induced Gravitational Waves with Taiji
papers.abstract: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) provide a direct probe of the enhanced primordial curvature perturbations that may also produce primordial black holes (PBHs). We forecast the capability of the space-based gravitational-wave observatory Taiji to search for an SIGW background generated by a broken-power-law curvature spectrum. A signal-injection study is used to validate the analysis pipeline, after which a pure-noise realization is employed to derive projected upper limits on the curvature-spectrum parameters. We translate these limits into constraints on the PBH abundance using the nonlinear compaction function, critical collapse, and the joint Gaussian distribution of the compaction amplitude and curvature at its peak. The resulting projected $95\%$ upper limits on the PBH dark-matter fraction satisfy $f_{\mathrm{PBH}}^{95\%}<1$ over PBH masses from approximately $6.2\times10^{-18}\,M_\odot$ to $1.7\times10^{-8}\,M_\odot$. We compare the forecast with representative Hawking-evaporation and microlensing bounds. In part of the asteroid-mass interval, the projected Taiji limit is more restrictive than the current Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam (HSC) microlensing constraint.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Submit to Sci.China Phys.Mech.Astron

analysis.title_zh: 太极对标量诱导引力波约束原初黑洞的预期能力
analysis.summary_zh: 本文预估空间引力波探测器太极通过标量诱导引力波背景搜索增强原初曲率扰动和原初黑洞的能力，使用 broken-power-law 曲率谱、信号注入验证流程，并用纯噪声 realization 给出投影上限。摘要报告这些上限可转化为 PBH 暗物质丰度限制，在约 6.2×10^-18 到 1.7×10^-8 太阳质量范围内给出 f_PBH 的 95% 上限小于 1，并在部分小行星质量区间强于当前 Subaru HSC 微透镜约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然该文的主要观测通道是空间引力波而非 CMB，但它研究的是增强原初曲率扰动，这与 CMB 对大尺度原初扰动的约束共同限定早期宇宙功率谱形状。对 CMB/宇宙学读者而言，它补充了 CMB 不易直接探测的小尺度扰动和 PBH 暗物质参数空间。
key_points: 预估太极探测标量诱导引力波背景的能力。
采用 broken-power-law 曲率谱，并把 SIGW 限制转换为 PBH 丰度限制。
摘要称在部分小行星质量区间，预期太极限制强于当前 Subaru HSC 微透镜约束。
methods: Taiji 空间引力波观测预估
标量诱导引力波背景 SIGW
broken-power-law 曲率扰动谱
信号注入检验分析流程
纯噪声 realization 推导预期上限
非线性 compaction function
critical collapse
compaction amplitude 与峰值曲率的联合高斯分布
与 Hawking evaporation 和 microlensing bounds 比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对从曲率谱到 PBH 丰度的映射假设，包括非线性 compaction function、临界坍缩参数和联合高斯分布；还要检查 Taiji 噪声模型、前景/混淆背景是否进入预估上限。

papers.title: A New Probe of Dark Matter Subhalos: Stellar Aberration with TESS
papers.abstract: Small-scale dark matter (DM) structure encodes key information about the particle nature of DM and therefore provides a sensitive test of competing models. Yet, it remains hidden from electromagnetic surveys and is instead inferred through its gravitational effects. Stellar aberration, the apparent shift in a light source's position induced by the observer's motion, offers a largely unexplored channel to access such signatures. DM subhalos can perturb the observer's motion, imprinting characteristic, spatially correlated shifts in stellar positions across the sky. We show that the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), with its long temporal baseline, wide sky coverage, and high-cadence observations, is well suited to search for these aberration signals. We derive Fisher-matrix-based sensitivity estimates for constant observer accelerations, forecasting a sensitivity down to $6.3\times 10^{-9}\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ from the combined sample of TESS stars with magnitude $\mathrm{Tmag}\leq 10$. This sensitivity allows TESS to probe concentrated DM subhalos over a broad parameter space, from $\gtrsim 10^{-6}\,\mathrm{M_{\odot}}$ at AU-scale distances to $\gtrsim 10^{7}\,\mathrm{M_{\odot}}$ at $\mathcal{O}(10\,\mathrm{pc})$. TESS's sector-based observing strategy further provides intrinsic temporal resolution of potential DM-induced aberration signals. Moreover, we briefly discuss challenges for future data analysis, including the modeling of instrumental systematics and stellar astrometric foregrounds, such as parallax and proper motion. Our results establish stellar aberration as a novel probe of DM substructure, paving the way for dedicated searches in TESS and next-generation wide-field surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 暗物质子晕的新探针：利用 TESS 测量恒星像差
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出以恒星像差作为探测暗物质子晕的新通道：子晕扰动观测者运动，从而在全天恒星位置中留下空间相关位移。作者用 TESS 的长时间基线、宽视场和高 cadence 数据特性进行 Fisher 矩阵灵敏度估计，摘要称 Tmag ≤ 10 的合并样本可达到对常量加速度 6.3×10^-9 m/s^2 的预报灵敏度，并可覆盖从近 AU 尺度低质量子晕到约 10 pc 距离大质量子晕的参数空间。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作不直接研究 CMB，但与暗物质小尺度结构有关，而小尺度结构是区分冷暗物质及其替代理论的重要宇宙学问题。对 CMB 读者而言，它提供了 CMB 大尺度初始条件之外、通过近场引力效应检验暗物质聚团性质的互补路径，同时其前景/系统学处理也与精密宇宙学数据分析有方法上的相似性。
key_points: 提出用恒星像差寻找暗物质子晕引起的观测者运动扰动。
TESS 的长时间基线、全天覆盖和高 cadence 被用于灵敏度预估。
摘要明确指出未来分析需处理仪器系统学以及视差、自行等恒星天体测量前景。
methods: TESS 恒星样本，Tmag ≤ 10
恒星像差信号建模
Fisher 矩阵灵敏度估计
常量观测者加速度预报
仪器系统学、视差和自行等天体测量前景讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 Fisher 预报中对 TESS 天体测量误差、时间相关系统学、恒星视差和自行建模的假设，因为这些会决定暗物质子晕灵敏度是否可在真实数据中达到。

papers.title: Topics in the phenomenology of axions: the cases of cosmic strings and superradiance
papers.abstract: Originally proposed as a solution to the strong CP problem and later understood to be a good dark matter candidates, axions have appeared in a variety of beyond-the-standard-model theories and are imbued with rich phenomelogical consequences. In this dissertation, we will examine two of these consequences: the emission of axions from cosmic strings and the superradiant mechanism in black hole physics. The spontaneous symmetry breaking of a global symmetry in the early universe can give rise to a network of cosmic strings, which emit ultra light, axion-like particles that can contribute to the dark matter density. We will discuss how the associated density fluctuations of these particles can be computed from first principles by treating them as a collection of plane waves. We will then calculate the density power spectrum and compare it to well-established cosmological observables, as well as to observables from future surveys, to derive constraints on the mass of the particles and the symmetry breaking scale. These light axion-like particles can also form a gravitational atom around a spinning black hole through the superradiance process. Considering the black hole to be part of a binary system, the tidal potential of the companion periodically perturbs the gravitational atom such that an atomic transition occurs between two of its energy states. Gravitational waves are emitted by the cloud during this transition. We will derive the analytical formulae of both the strain waveform and frequency spectrum of the signal and identify the systems that would be the most promising for detecting it in future, space-based gravitational wave observatories.
papers.comment: PhD thesis, defended on April 2026 at the University of Florida. Based on papers published in JHEP 11 (2025) 062 and Phys. Rev. D 114, 035035 (2026)

analysis.title_zh: 轴子现象学专题：宇宙弦与超辐射情形
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇学位论文讨论轴子现象学的两个方向：宇宙弦发射轴子样粒子及其暗物质密度涨落，以及旋转黑洞超辐射形成的轴子云在双星潮汐扰动下的跃迁。摘要称作者将弦辐射粒子作为平面波集合来计算密度功率谱并与宇宙学观测比较以约束粒子质量和对称破缺尺度，同时推导黑洞伴星系统中跃迁引力波的应变波形和频率谱。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 轴子暗物质及其由宇宙弦产生的密度涨落会影响小尺度结构，并可能通过宇宙学观测受到限制；这与 CMB 对早期宇宙、暗物质组成和初始扰动的约束互补。黑洞超辐射部分更多关联引力波和粒子物理，但同样服务于用多信使观测限制超轻玻色子暗物质。
key_points: 这是一篇学位论文，聚焦轴子现象学中的宇宙弦辐射和黑洞超辐射。
宇宙弦部分计算轴子样粒子的密度功率谱，并与已有和未来宇宙学观测比较以给出约束。
超辐射部分研究双星伴星潮汐势诱发引力原子能级跃迁及其引力波信号。
methods: 宇宙弦网络产生超轻轴子样粒子
将粒子视作平面波集合的一阶原理计算
密度功率谱计算
与既有宇宙学观测和未来巡天观测比较
黑洞超辐射形成的引力原子
双星伴星潮汐势扰动
解析推导应变波形和频率谱
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对宇宙弦辐射轴子密度涨落从平面波描述到功率谱的推导假设，以及这些功率谱与具体宇宙学观测量之间的映射是否稳健。

papers.title: Defining higher memory signals and forecasting their observation prospects for binary-black-hole mergers with next-generation gravitational-wave detectors
papers.abstract: In asymptotically flat spacetimes far from an isolated source, gravitational waves (GWs) undergo nonlinear interactions with themselves and with the parts of the spacetime curvature related to the time-dependent four-momentum and angular momentum of the spacetime. These spacetime nonlinearities produce distinctive offsets in the GW strain and its time integrals, which have been referred to as the displacement memory effect for the strain and ``higher'' GW memory effects for the integrals of the strain. There are existing data analysis pipelines that search for evidence for the displacement memory effect in the population of binary-black-hole mergers observed by current GW detectors (though conclusive evidence for the effect has not yet been found). The first set of higher memory effects include the spin and center-of-mass effects (collectively, ``drift'' memory), and the second is the ``ballistic'' memory effect. Prior work has shown that next-generation, ground-based GW detectors could find evidence for the spin memory effect in the large population of binary black holes that these detectors will be capable of observing. In this paper, we investigate how well a detector network of two Cosmic Explorer detectors can measure the displacement through ballistic memory signals. We first formulate what are appropriate notions of time-dependent GW signals associated with these memory effects. With these definitions of displacement and higher memory signals, we find that the Cosmic Explorer network is capable of detecting the displacement memory from tens of individual mergers per year and capable of finding evidence for the spin and center-of-mass memory effects in a population of mergers after a roughly one-year observation run at design sensitivity. [Abstract abridged]

analysis.title_zh: 定义更高阶记忆信号并预报下一代引力波探测器观测双黑洞并合中这些信号的前景
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论双黑洞并合中的引力波位移记忆及更高阶记忆效应，先给出适合这些效应的时间依赖信号定义，再预报下一代引力波探测器网络的观测前景。摘要报告，由两个 Cosmic Explorer 组成的网络可探测每年数十个单事件的位移记忆，并在约一年设计灵敏度运行后从并合群体中获得自旋和质心记忆效应的证据。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于引力波基本物理和下一代探测器预报，与 CMB 的联系较间接。其宇宙学相关性在于下一代 GW 样本和强场引力检验可作为独立探针，补充 CMB 对引力理论和宇宙学模型的约束，但摘要未涉及 CMB 数据或早期宇宙参数。
key_points: 定义与位移记忆及更高阶记忆效应相关的时间依赖 GW 信号。
研究两个 Cosmic Explorer 探测器组成的网络对这些记忆信号的测量能力。
摘要称该网络可逐年探测若干类记忆效应的个体或群体证据。
methods: 理论定义 asymptotically flat spacetimes 中的 GW memory signals
binary-black-hole merger population forecasts
two-Cosmic-Explorer detector network
design sensitivity observation scenario
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“higher memory signals”的具体定义如何与可观测滤波量对应，以及预报中对双黑洞并合率、质量/自旋分布和 Cosmic Explorer 噪声曲线的假设。

papers.title: Beyond $w_0-w_a$ and Phantom Crossing: Testing Models of Coupled Dark Sector
papers.abstract: The combination of cosmic microwave background (CMB) measurements with distance measurements from baryon acoustic oscillations (BAO) and type Ia supernovae (SNIa) suggests that dark energy is dynamical, with an equation of state crossing the phantom divide at low redshifts. This feature can not be described within canonically normalized, minimally coupled, self-interacting scalar field models. We investigate the possibility of achieving phantom crossing by introducing an interaction in the dark sector such that the dark matter particle mass is dependent on the dark energy field $φ$ as $m \propto φ^α$. We consider a self-interacting potential of the inverse power-law form $V \propto φ^{-β}$. We implement this model both at the background and perturbative levels in a Boltzmann solver and use a bayesian framework to constrain its parameters using using CMB, BAO and SNIa data. We find best-fits that have similar goodness-of-fits as the commonly used phenomenological $w_0-w_a$ parameterization, providing a more fundamental understanding of the dark sector.

analysis.title_zh: 超越 w0-wa 与 phantom crossing：检验耦合暗部门模型
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 CMB、BAO 与 Ia 型超新星联合数据暗示的低红移 phantom crossing，考察一种耦合暗部门模型：暗物质粒子质量依赖暗能量标量场，且标量场势为反幂律形式。作者将模型在背景和扰动层级实现进 Boltzmann solver，并用贝叶斯框架约束参数；摘要报告其最佳拟合与现象学 w0-wa 参数化具有相近的拟合优度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接使用 CMB 与低红移距离探针的联合约束来研究暗能量动力学，是当前 CMB 宇宙学中缓解或解释暗能量状态方程偏离 ΛCDM 的一类模型检验。若耦合暗部门能在扰动层级自洽地复现 phantom crossing，它会影响 CMB 推断中的晚期宇宙演化、增长历史和参数退化关系。
key_points: CMB+BAO+SNIa 的联合距离信息被用于检验暗能量是否具有低红移 phantom crossing。
模型通过暗物质质量依赖暗能量标量场来引入暗部门相互作用。
摘要称最佳拟合的 goodness-of-fit 与常用 w0-wa 参数化相近。
methods: CMB、BAO、SNIa 数据联合约束
暗物质质量标度 m ∝ φ^α
反幂律自相互作用势 V ∝ φ^{-β}
在 Boltzmann solver 中实现背景与扰动层级
贝叶斯参数约束框架
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对暗部门耦合模型在扰动层级的实现是否稳定、自洽，以及与 w0-wa 的拟合比较是否在相同数据组合和参数自由度下进行。

papers.title: Deuterium Production in an Effective Field Theory Constructed from On-Shell Amplitudes
papers.abstract: We compute the deuterium-production reaction $n+p \to d+γ$ in an effective field theory whose degrees of freedom are the nuclear states themselves: the amplitude is assembled from on-shell three-point vertices, glued across its factorization channels, and completed by the contact terms consistent with the symmetries. The deuteron enters through the $d$-$n$-$p$ vertex, normalized to the measured asymptotic normalization coefficient. Rescattering of the nucleon pair is resummed dispersively, leaving two short-distance constants, an isovector magnetic and an electric dipole contact interaction. A joint Bayesian fit to the thermal capture measurements and the SLEGS photodisintegration data finds both of natural size and determines the thermonuclear rate to 0.22-0.24% across the nucleosynthesis window, including systematics spanning the defensible treatments of the SLEGS data and of the $P$-wave rescattering. Truncating the expansion is bounded separately at 0.12%, of which the next order of contact terms -- degenerate with the two fitted constants -- supplies 0.03%, for a total theory uncertainty of 0.25-0.27%. Propagated through a BBN network, the rate shifts the predicted primordial deuterium by -0.06% and cuts this reaction's contribution to the D/H uncertainty from 0.089% to 0.050%, retiring it from the primordial D/H error budget for practical purposes.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 8 figures; companion to arXiv:2607.05514; ancillary file anc/npdg_rate_table.csv tabulates the thermonuclear rate with its total theory uncertainty on the PRIMAT temperature grid

analysis.title_zh: 在由壳上振幅构造的有效场论中计算氘生成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用一种由壳上振幅构造的有效场论计算 BBN 关键反应 n+p→d+γ 的氘生成率。作者通过热俘获实验和 SLEGS 光致裂解数据进行 Bayesian 拟合，摘要报告在核合成温区内得到高精度热核反应率，并使该反应对原初 D/H 理论不确定性的贡献降至较低水平。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 宇宙学高度相关，因为原初氘丰度是大爆炸核合成检验和重子密度测量的重要探针，而 CMB 也精确测量重子密度。降低 n+p→d+γ 反应率的不确定性，有助于更清晰地比较 BBN 预测、天文 D/H 观测和 CMB 推断，从而检验标准宇宙学或寻找新物理。
key_points: 利用由壳上振幅构造的有效场论计算 n+p→d+γ 氘生成反应。
结合热俘获测量与 SLEGS 光致裂解数据做联合 Bayesian 拟合。
摘要称热核反应率在 BBN 窗口内达到约千分之几精度，并显著降低该反应对原初 D/H 误差预算的贡献。
methods: 由壳上三点顶点、因子化道拼接和对称性允许的接触项构造有效场论振幅
用实测渐近归一化系数归一化 d-n-p 顶点
色散方法重求和核子对再散射
两个短程常数：同位旋矢量磁接触项和电偶极接触项
对热俘获测量和 SLEGS 光致裂解数据进行联合 Bayesian 拟合
将反应率传播通过 BBN 网络
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 EFT 功率计数和接触项截断误差的定义，SLEGS 数据不同处理方式如何影响后验，P 波再散射的处理是否稳健；还应检查 BBN 网络中采用的其他核反应率、重子密度输入以及与 CMB 推断的 Ω_b h^2 结合时对原初 D/H 的影响。

papers.title: Color-Kinematics Duality and the Double Copy in Curved Spacetimes
papers.abstract: The double copy relates gravitational data to gauge-theory data, most sharply through color-kinematics duality for flat-space scattering amplitudes. This review surveys the extent to which this idea can be formulated beyond asymptotically flat backgrounds. After recalling the flat-space ingredients needed for comparison, we describe curved-space constructions for boundary correlators and scattering observables in AdS, dS, and other non-trivial backgrounds. We then review classical and field-level maps, including Kerr--Schild, Weyl, Cotton, twistor, and convolutional double copies. A separate part is devoted to self-dual sectors. Throughout, we emphasize both the common structures that survive from flat space and the obstructions introduced by curvature.
papers.comment: 191 pages plus appendices and references, invited review article for Physics Reports

analysis.title_zh: 弯曲时空中的色-运动学对偶与双拷贝
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇综述，讨论色-运动学对偶和 double copy 如何从平直空间散射振幅推广到非渐近平直的弯曲时空。摘要称文章比较了 AdS、dS 及其他背景中的边界关联函数、散射观测量、经典和场论层面的多种 double-copy 映射，并强调曲率带来的共同结构与障碍。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该主题主要属于引力理论和高能理论，但 dS/AdS 以及弯曲背景中的关联函数技术与宇宙学扰动、暴胀关联函数和引力相互作用计算有概念联系。对 CMB 研究者而言，它更可能提供形式理论工具，而非直接给出 CMB 数据分析方法。
key_points: 综述平直时空中的色-运动学对偶与 double copy，并考察其在弯曲背景中的推广。
覆盖 AdS、dS 及其他非平庸背景中的边界关联函数和散射观测量。
讨论 Kerr-Schild、Weyl、Cotton、twistor、卷积 double copy 以及自对偶扇区。
methods: 综述性比较分析
AdS、dS 和其他弯曲背景中的边界关联函数构造
弯曲时空中的散射观测量构造
Kerr-Schild、Weyl、Cotton、twistor 与 convolutional double copy
自对偶扇区分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对不同弯曲背景下所谓 double copy 的对象是否相同、哪些结构是真正从平直空间保留下来的、曲率造成的障碍是否限制其宇宙学背景中的物理解释。

papers.title: Exact Equivalence of the Observed Redshift and the Pulsar Timing Modulation in the Infinitesimal-Pulse Limit
papers.abstract: The pulsar timing arrays (PTA) collect the times of arrival of radio signals from the millisecond pulsars, and gravitational waves can modulate their arrival times. Although the PTA observable involves successive radio pulses propagating along different light paths, its standard theoretical description at linear order in perturbations is equivalent to the Sachs-Wolfe formula for the observed redshift, which describes the fractional change in photon frequency along a single geodesic. While this equivalence is well known at linear order, its validity beyond first order has not been systematically addressed in the PTA literature. Here we show that, in the limit of vanishing proper-time separation between successive emission events, the timing modulation is exactly equal to the observed redshift, without expanding the spacetime geometry. For a finite emission interval, we derive the exact relation between the timing modulation and the observed redshift, and show that their difference is controlled by the ratio between the emission interval and the characteristic timescale over which the observed redshift varies.

analysis.title_zh: 无穷小脉冲极限下观测红移与脉冲星计时调制的精确等价
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究脉冲星计时阵列中连续射电脉冲的到达时刻调制与单条测地线上观测红移之间的关系。摘要称，在相邻发射事件固有时间间隔趋零的极限下，计时调制与观测红移精确相等且无需展开时空几何；有限间隔时，两者差异由发射间隔相对红移变化特征时间尺度的比值控制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: PTA 是低频引力波宇宙学的重要观测手段，与 CMB 的 Sachs-Wolfe 红移公式共享光子传播和度规扰动响应的理论结构。该结果有助于澄清红移、计时残差和引力波响应之间的非线性或非微扰关系，对跨探针比较随机引力波背景和大尺度扰动效应有参考价值。
key_points: 证明在相邻脉冲发射间隔趋零时，PTA 计时调制与观测红移完全相等。
该等价不依赖对时空几何作微扰展开。
有限发射间隔下，两者差异由发射间隔与红移变化特征时间尺度之比控制。
methods: PTA 到达时刻调制的理论推导
与 Sachs-Wolfe 观测红移公式的比较
无穷小脉冲间隔极限分析
有限发射间隔下的精确关系推导
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“无穷小脉冲极限”的数学定义、有限发射间隔修正的适用范围，以及该精确关系在实际 PTA 数据建模和高阶扰动或强场情形中是否引入可测修正。

papers.title: When the HL-LHC is blind, LISA is deaf (but not vice versa): 2HDM collider-cosmology synergies
papers.abstract: Extensions of the Standard Model scalar sector can render the electroweak phase transition first-order and thereby provide the departure from thermal equilibrium required for electroweak baryogenesis, while at the same time sourcing a stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background in the milli-Hertz range. In this work, we investigate electroweak phase transitions in the CP-conserving type-I two-Higgs-doublet model (2HDM), focusing on the interplay between collider constraints at the HL-LHC and the projected sensitivity of LISA. We compute the expected GW background due to strong first-order electroweak phase transitions and perform extensive Monte Carlo scans over the collider-viable model parameter space. We find that GW signals within reach of LISA arise almost exclusively in regions of parameter space that necessarily predict observable deviations at the HL-LHC, in particular through the $H \to ZZ$ decay channel of the heavy CP-even and neutral Higgs state with $m_H \simeq 180\text{--}250 \, \text{GeV}$. Our results highlight the decisive complementarity between collider and GW probes and show that the largest parts of the 2HDM parameter space relevant for phase transition signals at LISA can already be tested by HL-LHC. A possible future discovery of 2HDM states at the HL-LHC, however, would not allow conclusive statements about LISA being able to find a GW background due to the amount of parameter tuning required for an observable GW signal. In order to evaluate possible caveats of this statement we study the theoretical uncertainties related to the GW predictions in a two-fold approach using both state-of-the-art tools, BSMPT and TransitionListener, and also allow for model realizations in which the electroweak symmetry is not restored in the high-temperature limit, which are the ones combining the loudest GW signals with the weakest collider coverage.

analysis.title_zh: 当HL-LHC看不见时，LISA听不见（反之则不然）：2HDM中的对撞机-宇宙学协同
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究CP守恒I型二Higgs双重态模型中强一阶电弱相变、HL-LHC对撞机约束与LISA mHz随机引力波探测之间的互补性。摘要报告称，LISA可及的引力波信号几乎只出现在HL-LHC也应能观测到偏离的参数区，尤其通过约180–250 GeV重CP偶中性Higgs的 H→ZZ 衰变通道，但HL-LHC发现2HDM态并不必然意味着LISA可见。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接处理CMB观测，但涉及早期宇宙电弱相变、重子生成和随机引力波背景，是连接粒子物理模型与宇宙学信号的重要案例。对CMB研究者而言，它提供了一个与CMB互补的早期宇宙探针框架，并展示了如何用非CMB数据约束超出标准模型的相变历史。
key_points: 研究CP守恒I型2HDM中的强一阶电弱相变及其mHz随机引力波背景。
摘要称，LISA可及的引力波信号几乎都落在HL-LHC也会看到偏离的参数区，尤其是重CP偶中性Higgs的 H→ZZ 通道。
HL-LHC发现2HDM态并不能反向保证LISA可见，因为可观测引力波需要较强参数调节。
methods: CP守恒I型二Higgs双重态模型（2HDM）
强一阶电弱相变产生的随机引力波背景计算
对满足对撞机约束的参数空间进行大规模Monte Carlo扫描
HL-LHC约束与LISA投影灵敏度比较
BSMPT与TransitionListener工具
允许高温极限下电弱对称性不恢复的模型实现
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对相变与引力波谱预测对热有效势、泡壁动力学、BSMPT/TransitionListener差异以及HL-LHC可观测性假设的依赖，特别是“LISA可见几乎必被HL-LHC覆盖”是否受理论不确定性削弱。

papers.title: Wilsonian Cosmology: de Sitter (in)Stability
papers.abstract: We develop a (Wilsonian) functional-renormalisation-group framework for scalar cosmology in which quantum fluctuations of a scalar field are coarse-grained on cosmological spacelike hypersurfaces. Integrating out quantum fluctuations with wavelengths smaller than the Hubble radius $H(t)^{-1}$, we obtain an effective scalar potential $U(φ(t),H(t))$ that evolves in time. We derive a non-perturbative flow equation for this potential, together with the coupled set of (modified) Friedmann equations. We then apply this formalism to the simplest possible case of a de Sitter vacuum when the scalar field is at rest, in two situations which satisfy exactly our flow equation: $(i)$ A flat potential, for which we find that the only pure de Sitter solution is unstable and corresponds to a saddle point. $(ii)$ A quadratic potential with curvature $m^2>0$, for which we find that the presence of the mass term stabilises the system. The latter case leads to a de Sitter attractor either at the Hubble scale when the mass is larger than the Hubble scale at initial time, or by introducing a new attractor located at $H=m$ in the case the mass is smaller, which may be particularly relevant to the phenomenological study of dark energy and inflation theories.

analysis.title_zh: Wilsonian宇宙学：de Sitter的（不）稳定性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一个用于标量宇宙学的Wilsonian函数重整化群框架，在Hubble半径尺度上粗粒化量子涨落，并推导有效势的非微扰流方程及修正Friedmann方程。摘要报告，在标量场静止的de Sitter真空中，平坦势只给出不稳定的纯de Sitter鞍点，而带正质量项的二次势可稳定系统并形成de Sitter吸引子。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: de Sitter稳定性直接关系到暴胀、暗能量和量子涨落的有效描述，而这些都会影响CMB初始扰动、背景演化和晚期宇宙学解释。虽然摘要未给出具体CMB可观测量预测，但其框架若成立，可能改变对标量场势、de Sitter吸引子和有效场论适用性的理解。
key_points: 建立在宇宙学类空超曲面上粗粒化标量量子涨落的Wilsonian函数重整化群框架。
积分掉短于Hubble半径的模式后，得到随时间演化的有效标量势 U(φ(t),H(t))。
摘要称平坦势的纯de Sitter解不稳定，而正质量二次势可稳定系统并产生de Sitter吸引子。
methods: Wilsonian函数重整化群框架
在宇宙学类空超曲面上对标量场量子涨落粗粒化
积分波长小于Hubble半径 H(t)^−1 的量子涨落

papers.title: Primordial spectra from modified Bekenstein-Hawking entropy law
papers.abstract: Many approaches to quantum gravity predict logarithmic corrections to the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy. Within the spacetime-thermodynamic description of gravity, such corrections lead to modified gravitational field equations. We study their effect on primordial perturbations during standard single-field slow-roll inflation. We derive the evolution equation for the comoving curvature perturbation and show that it retains the standard Mukhanov--Sasaki form, with the quantum-gravity correction entering through the time-dependent effective frequency. We compute the scalar and tensor primordial spectra at next-to-next-to-next-to-leading order ($\mathrm{N}^3\mathrm{LO}$) in the Hubble-flow parameters, keeping the leading contribution from the logarithmic correction. The scalar spectrum remains nearly scale invariant, but the quantum-gravity correction shifts its tilt and runnings. Free tensor modes still propagate as in general relativity, although on the quantum-gravity-corrected background. This different response of the two sectors shifts both the tensor-to-scalar ratio and the single-field consistency relation, which provide the starting point for tracing the model's signatures through the post-inflationary evolution and into the CMB.

analysis.title_zh: 来自修正 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵定律的原初谱
analysis.summary_zh: 该文研究 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵的量子引力对数修正在时空热力学引力框架下对标准单场慢滚暴胀原初扰动的影响。摘要称共动曲率扰动仍满足 Mukhanov-Sasaki 形式但有效频率被修正，并在 Hubble-flow 参数 N³LO 下得到标量和张量谱，发现标量谱近似尺度不变但倾斜和 running 偏移，张量模式在修正背景上传播，从而改变张标比和单场一致性关系。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接连接暴胀原初标量/张量谱与 CMB 观测，因为谱指数、running、张标比和一致性关系都是 CMB 温度和偏振数据约束早期宇宙模型的核心量。若摘要所述修正可计算地传递到后暴胀演化，它将给 CMB 中检验量子引力诱导熵修正提供参数化入口。
key_points: 研究 Bekenstein-Hawking 熵的对数修正如何改变单场慢滚暴胀扰动谱。
摘要称曲率扰动方程保持 Mukhanov-Sasaki 形式，但有效频率含量子引力修正。
标量谱倾斜、running、张标比和单场一致性关系均可能发生偏移。
methods: 时空热力学引力描述
修正引力场方程
标准单场慢滚暴胀
共动曲率扰动演化方程
Hubble-flow 参数的 N³LO 展开
标量和张量原初谱计算
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对熵对数修正如何进入背景方程和有效频率、N³LO 展开的慢滚阶数 bookkeeping、以及修正后的张标比和单场一致性关系是否可稳定传递到 CMB 可观测量。

papers.title: More Numerous and Bluer: Companions of the Brightest Little Red Dots Differ from Control Galaxies at $>3σ$, Hinting at Synchronized Black Hole Seed Formation
papers.abstract: The Little Red Dots (LRDs) are a population of compact, red sources, detected abundantly at $4 \lesssim z \lesssim 9$. While their nature is still debated, many models suggest they are powered by accreting massive black holes. Multiple studies have detected blue companions in their vicinity, motivating our analysis: we compare $253$ LRDs uniformly selected across several JWST deep fields against $>7000$ matched controls in the same mosaics. We find that $27.7\%$ of the brightest LRD quartile host a blue ($β<-1$) companion at $0.5-2$ kpc, versus $11.6\%$ of redshift-matched controls: a $\times 2.39$ excess, significant at $3.3σ$. This phenomenon is limited to the brightest LRDs, as the full LRD sample pairs at a rate indistinguishable from controls. Moreover, the excess is confined to the close-pair window ($< 2$ kpc), outside which LRD environments are ordinary. The companions of the brightest LRDs are overwhelmingly ($92\%$) blue, and significantly bluer, with a median $β\approx-2.32$, versus $β\approx-1.92$ for those of controls, rejecting a common parent distribution at $3.4σ$. The signal is thus directional in three independent ways: luminosity, separation, and companion color, all expected for synchronized-pair seed formation. Therefore, we conclude that the association between the brightest LRDs and their close blue companions is physical, i.e., the two phenomena are causally connected: either one drives the other, or both emerge from the same synchronized formation event. A natural explanation for why the most luminous LRDs have nearby, young, star-forming neighbors is that the radiation from these neighbors enabled the direct collapse of the massive black holes powering the LRDs themselves.
papers.comment: Submitted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal Letters. 10 pages, 4 figures

analysis.title_zh: 更多且更蓝：最亮Little Red Dots的伴星系与控制星系在>3σ水平上不同，暗示同步黑洞种子形成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文比较多个JWST深场中253个Little Red Dots与超过7000个匹配控制星系，检验最亮LRD附近是否更常出现蓝色近邻伴星系。摘要报告，最亮LRD四分位在0.5–2 kpc内的蓝伴星系发生率、颜色分布和距离依赖均不同于控制样本，并将其解释为可能与同步黑洞种子形成有关。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要属于高红移星系和黑洞种子形成研究，与CMB的联系较间接。它可能影响对再电离时期早期黑洞、星系形成和辐射背景的理解，这些主题与CMB光学深度、二级各向异性和早期结构形成模型有背景层面的关联。
key_points: 使用JWST深场中253个LRD与超过7000个匹配控制星系比较近邻伴星系。
摘要报告最亮LRD四分位在0.5–2 kpc内拥有蓝色伴星系的比例相对控制样本显著过量。
作者将亮LRD与近距离蓝伴星系的关联解释为可能指向同步黑洞种子形成。

超过7000个匹配控制星系
红移匹配控制样本比较

papers.title: The descendants of $z \gtrsim 10$ JWST galaxies in the COLIBRE simulations
papers.abstract: Recent observations with JWST have revealed a population of UV-bright galaxies at $z\gtrsim 10$. This discovery naturally raises the question: what do such early galaxies evolve into by the present day? In this work, we address this descendant question using the new-generation COLIBRE cosmological hydrodynamical simulations to trace bright galaxies selected at $z=10$ and follow their descendants to the present day. Most of the high-redshift galaxies do not survive as distinct, self-bound objects to $z=0$; instead, the majority are incorporated into more massive systems through merging or disruption. The surviving descendants span a broad range of present-day stellar masses, although they are most commonly intermediate- to high-mass, $M_\star\sim10^{10}$--$10^{11} M_\odot$. They typically reside in galaxy groups and clusters, with host halo masses, $M_{200c}\sim10^{13}$--$10^{14} M_\odot$. The large scatter in descendant stellar mass shows that present-day outcomes retain only a weak memory of the stellar mass of the high-redshift progenitor. We show that the evolution of descendant host halo masses is consistent with the forward conditional distribution predicted by extended Press--Schechter (EPS) theory, both in the median growth and in the large scatter in descendant mass. In particular, EPS confirms that massive present-day galaxies typically do not originate from the most massive objects at high redshift. A galaxy observed at $z\gtrsim10$ therefore cannot be interpreted as the direct progenitor of a single class of $z=0$ galaxies.

analysis.title_zh: COLIBRE 模拟中 z≳10 JWST 星系的后代
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 JWST 在 z≳10 发现的 UV 亮星系到今天会演化成什么，用新一代 COLIBRE 宇宙学流体模拟在 z=10 选取亮星系并追踪其后代。摘要报告称，多数对象到 z=0 不再作为独立自束缚星系存在，幸存后代常见于星系群/星系团环境，且其 z=0 恒星质量与高红移祖先质量只保留较弱关联。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇更偏星系形成与宇宙大尺度结构，但与 CMB 宇宙学的联系在于它检验了 ΛCDM 框架下早期结构形成、暗晕增长和并合树的解释是否能容纳 JWST 高红移亮星系。对 CMB 读者而言，它可作为把早期星系观测与初始扰动、暗物质层级增长和解析 EPS 预言相连接的参考。
key_points: 用 COLIBRE 宇宙学流体模拟追踪 z=10 亮星系到 z=0 的后代。
多数高红移星系到今天不再作为独立自束缚天体存在，而是经并合或扰动并入更大系统。
摘要称后代宿主暗晕质量演化与扩展 Press--Schechter 理论的前向条件分布一致。
methods: COLIBRE cosmological hydrodynamical simulations
在 z=10 选择亮星系并追踪其 z=0 后代
extended Press--Schechter (EPS) theory forward conditional distribution
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 z=10 亮星系的选择函数、JWST 观测可比性、模拟体积与分辨率对并合/扰动判定的影响，以及“后代”匹配算法如何处理不再自束缚的系统。

papers.title: Strong Lensing Cosmology with Population-level Calibrated Neural Ratio Estimation
papers.abstract: Strong gravitational lensing contains key information about cosmic acceleration. Modern and next-generation galaxy imaging surveys are expected to provide high-quality data on $\mathcal{O}(10^5)$ galaxy-galaxy lensing systems. The plethora and complexity of the data are likely to present computational challenges for parameter inference methods for fitting high-dimensional likelihoods, which are often analytically intractable. Neural Ratio Estimation (NRE) efficiently computes individual likelihood ratios that can be combined into population-level posteriors. We use simulations to study the capacity of NRE to jointly predict the dark energy equation-of-state parameter $w$ and the total matter density $Ω_{m}$ from lensing images and companion spectroscopic information. We also introduce a post hoc posterior coverage calibration procedure that mitigates the model overconfidence that is typically found in neural density estimation applications. Our experiments show that the errors on both parameters decrease with increasing inference population sizes. In particular, for 100 lenses in a standard $Λ$CDM Universe, our calibrated NRE model achieves median fractional uncertainty of $22.8\%$ in $w$ and $2.9\%$ in $Ω_{m}$. This proof of concept demonstrates a potentially scalable approach for efficient cosmological parameter inference with large populations of galaxy-scale lenses observed in future surveys.
papers.comment: 50 pages, 48 figures, 3 tables, code available at https://github.com/deepskies/CosmoLensNRE , Submitted to Machine Learning: Science and Technology

analysis.title_zh: 使用总体层级校准的神经比值估计进行强透镜宇宙学研究
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究如何用大样本星系尺度强透镜进行暗能量状态方程参数 w 和总物质密度 Ω_m 的推断。作者在模拟数据上使用神经比值估计，并引入事后后验覆盖率校准；摘要报告随推断样本增大参数误差下降，在 100 个透镜的标准 ΛCDM 情形下给出经校准模型的中位相对不确定度。

key_points: 面向未来大规模星系-星系强透镜样本的宇宙学参数推断。
使用神经比值估计从透镜图像和光谱辅助信息联合约束 w 与 Ω_m。
摘要报告后验覆盖率校准可缓解神经密度估计中的过度自信。
