papers.title: Generalized Chiral $U(1)_{B-L}$: Towards a Less Constrained $Z'$ and Dark Matter
papers.abstract: Extensions of the Standard Model by a $U(1)_{X}$ gauge symmetry predict a new $Z'$ boson, whose mass is severely constrained by high-mass dilepton resonance searches at the LHC. We show that these bounds can be relaxed by generalizing the chiral $(B-L)$ charge assignment while preserving gauge anomaly cancellation. The resulting $U(1)_X$ charges are parameterized by two independent parameters, and an appropriate choice of these parameters suppresses the $Z'$ branching fraction into charged leptons, substantially weakening the dilepton constraints. The framework accommodates Dirac neutrino masses through a Dirac type-I seesaw mechanism and a stable singlet scalar DM candidate without requiring an additional discrete symmetry. We find that the modified charge assignment, although beneficial for collider phenomenology, introduces a tension between obtaining the observed relic abundance and satisfying direct detection limits when DM annihilation proceeds solely through the $Z'$ portal. The inclusion of scalar-mediated annihilation channels resolves this tension and opens up a broad viable parameter space, with DM masses ranging from $M_{\rm DM}\simeq 60~{\rm GeV}$ to $10~{\rm TeV}$. The resulting parameter space is consistent with the observed relic density, direct detection, collider, and electroweak precision constraints, demonstrating that a generalized chiral charge structure can simultaneously accommodate a less constrained $Z'$ sector, neutrino masses, and viable dark matter phenomenology.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Comments are welcome!

analysis.title_zh: 广义手征 U(1)_{B-L}：迈向受限更少的 Z' 与暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究标准模型的 U(1)_X 规范扩展，通过推广手征 (B-L) 荷分配并保持规范反常抵消，降低 Z' 玻色子到带电轻子的分支比，从而放松 LHC 双轻子共振约束。摘要报告称，该框架可容纳 Dirac 中微子质量和稳定单重态标量暗物质；仅 Z' portal 暗物质湮灭会面临遗迹丰度与直接探测张力，而加入标量介导湮灭后可得到较宽的可行参数空间。

papers.title: The Road to Normalcy: Environment-Driven Evolutionary Pathways for Primordial Black Holes
papers.abstract: We investigate how cosmological environment regulates the evolution of primordial black hole (PBH) seeds in the early universe using a suite of hydrodynamical simulations. Unlike traditional seeding channels, PBHs provide early BH seeds without the need of special conditions for gas collapse/fragmentation that favor overdense regions, thus covering diverse large-scale environments. We find that PBHs follow distinct evolutionary pathways depending on the gas supply and halo assembly history. In underdense regions, limited inflow suppresses both accretion and star formation, producing faint, metal-poor systems, while in overdense environments, sustained gas inflow drives rapid BH growth and the formation of compact, centrally concentrated stellar components. These differences lead to large variations in BH-to-stellar mass ratio, metallicity, and morphology, collectively bracketing a range of possible evolutionary pathways for PBH-seeded systems. We show that compact, BH-dominated sources resembling recently observed Little Red Dots naturally arise as one phase within these evolutionary pathways before evolving into more extended galaxy--AGN systems. Our results suggest that both the initial seed properties and cosmological environment jointly shape early BH--galaxy co-evolution, while subsequent environmental regulation can erase the memory of the initial seeding channel.

analysis.title_zh: 通往常态之路：原初黑洞的环境驱动演化路径
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用一组流体动力学模拟研究宇宙学环境如何调控早期宇宙中原初黑洞种子的成长。摘要报告 PBH 在欠密和过密区域会走向不同的吸积、恒星形成、金属丰度和形态演化路径，并指出类似 Little Red Dots 的紧致黑洞主导源可自然出现在其中一个阶段。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初黑洞同时关联暗物质、早期结构形成和再电离时期的高红移源族群，这些过程会受到 CMB 对早期宇宙扰动、物质含量和光学深度等约束的限制。该工作更偏星系形成与黑洞演化，但可为把 PBH 场景与高红移观测及 CMB 间接约束相结合提供模型背景。
key_points: 用流体动力学模拟研究早期宇宙中 PBH 种子的环境调控。
欠密与过密环境导致吸积、恒星形成、金属丰度和形态的不同演化路径。
摘要称类似 Little Red Dots 的紧致黑洞主导源可作为演化路径中的一个阶段自然出现。

papers.title: Updated Upper Limits on the Isotropic Gravitational-Wave Background from LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA Data through April 2025
authors: J. F. J. van den Brand
papers.abstract: We report results from a search for an isotropic stochastic gravitational-wave background using data collected by the LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA Collaboration. The analysis uses data from the first observing run through April 1, 2025, during the fourth observing run. New frequency-domain cuts are implemented to address a class of non-stationary spectral noise features that were not effectively identified and mitigated by existing data-quality checks in past analyses. Consequently, previously analyzed data from the fourth observing run are re-processed with the updated cuts. We find no evidence for a stochastic background signal and place upper limits on the gravitational-wave energy density. In particular, for a background following a power law with spectral index 2/3 as predicted by inspiralling compact binaries, we find $Ω_\mathrm{GW}(25\,\mathrm{Hz}) \leq 2.0 \times 10^{-9}$, while scale-invariant backgrounds are constrained to $Ω_\mathrm{GW}(25\,\mathrm{Hz}) \leq 2.8 \times 10^{-9}$, both at the 95\% credible level for a log-uniform prior on $Ω_\mathrm{GW}$. Relative to the constraints from previous data recomputed with the new frequency-domain cuts, these limits improve by a factor of 1.4. We also update bounds on alternative gravity scenarios predicting non-standard polarization modes, and we verify that correlated magnetic noise sources remain below the sensitivity of this search. Combining these observational constraints with population models of compact binary coalescences informed by the latest gravitational-wave transient catalog, GWTC-5.0, we predict the amplitude of the compact binary background to be $Ω_\mathrm{CBC}(25\,\mathrm{Hz}) = 6.3^{+5.0}_{-2.2} \times 10^{-10}$ at the 90\% credible level.

analysis.title_zh: 截至 2025 年 4 月 LIGO、Virgo 和 KAGRA 数据给出的各向同性引力波背景更新上限
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA 从第一观测轮到 2025 年 4 月 1 日的数据搜索各向同性随机引力波背景，并加入新的频域剔除来处理非平稳谱噪声。摘要报告未发现随机背景信号，给出了不同谱形的 Ω_GW 上限，更新了非标准偏振约束和紧致双星背景幅度预测。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 随机引力波背景是早期宇宙物理和天体物理源族群的重要探针，与 CMB 中对原初张量扰动、额外辐射成分和早期宇宙相变的限制互补。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类上限有助于把低频 CMB 张量约束与地面干涉仪频段的随机背景约束放在同一宇宙学图景中比较。
key_points: 使用 LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA 第一观测轮至 2025 年 4 月 1 日的数据搜寻各向同性随机引力波背景。
引入新的频域剔除以处理非平稳谱噪声，并重新处理部分第四观测轮数据。
未发现随机背景信号，并给出引力波能量密度上限及紧致双星背景幅度预测。
methods: LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA 数据，覆盖第一观测轮至第四观测轮 2025 年 4 月 1 日
各向同性随机引力波背景搜索
新的频域数据剔除
功率律谱模型，谱指数 2/3
尺度不变背景模型
非标准偏振模式约束
相关磁噪声检验
结合 GWTC-5.0 的紧致双星并合族群模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对新的频域剔除如何定义、对灵敏度和潜在信号保留率的影响，以及与以往上限比较时是否使用了完全一致的先验、频段和数据选择。

papers.title: Inflationary Kicks and Coulomb Filtering of Spectator Dark Matter
papers.abstract: Light spectator fields provide a compelling inflationary origin for scalar dark matter, but their primordial fluctuations often generate excessive isocurvature perturbations on large scales. We develop a novel, exactly solvable filtering mechanism based on a tower of $δ-$function contributions to the spectator mass, which we call kicks, whose dense limit converges to a smooth Coulomb-like profile. The filter produces a isocurvature spectrum during inflation that is strongly suppressed on large scales, rises with momenta as $k^3$ in the infrared, and, after a rapid turnover, smoothly approaches a constant plateau at small scales. This construction is motivated by a discrete translational invariance, admits an EFT regime in which radiative corrections can be systematically controlled, and can find a concrete realization in terms of an inflationary massive-clock model. We embed the filter in a minimal dark-matter scenario in which a spectator condensate oscillates about the minimum of a quadratic potential and behaves as pressureless matter. In this framework, the spectator dark-matter mass is directly related to the turnover scale of the inflationary isocurvature spectrum. We determine the resulting dark-matter abundance and analyze the relevant isocurvature and backreaction constraints. The most restrictive realization, in which the spectator condensate is generated during inflation, favors a relatively low inflationary scale.

analysis.title_zh: 暴胀踢击与 spectator 暗物质的 Coulomb 过滤
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对轻 spectator 标量暗物质在暴胀中容易产生过量大尺度等曲率扰动的问题，提出由 δ 函数质量“kicks”构成、稠密极限为类 Coulomb 剖面的可精确求解过滤机制。摘要报告该机制能强烈抑制大尺度等曲率谱，使其红外按 k^3 上升并在小尺度趋于平台，同时在最小暗物质场景中计算丰度并分析等曲率与反作用约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对原初等曲率扰动有强约束，因此任何 spectator 暗物质模型都必须解释为什么大尺度等曲率没有超标。该工作直接面向这一 CMB 约束问题，并把暴胀期间的谱形过滤、暗物质质量和小尺度 turnover 联系起来，值得关注其可观测预言与 Planck/未来 CMB 数据的兼容性。
key_points: 提出由 inflationary kicks 构成的可精确求解过滤机制，稠密极限趋于类 Coulomb 质量剖面。
该机制使 spectator 暗物质的等曲率谱在大尺度受强抑制，红外按 k^3 上升，并在小尺度趋于平台。
在最小暗物质场景中，spectator 质量与等曲率谱 turnover 尺度直接相关，并分析丰度、等曲率和反作用约束。
methods: 轻 spectator 场暗物质框架
δ 函数质量贡献塔，即 inflationary kicks
稠密极限的平滑 Coulomb-like profile
可精确求解的等曲率谱过滤机制
EFT 辐射修正控制论证
inflationary massive-clock 实现
二次势中 spectator 凝聚体振荡并表现为无压物质
暗物质丰度、等曲率约束和反作用约束分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对过滤机制对大尺度等曲率抑制的推导、EFT 可控条件、massive-clock 具体实现以及“低暴胀尺度”偏好是否依赖于最受限的凝聚体生成假设。

papers.title: Action-selected currents and a singular conservation closure in two-fluid energy--momentum-squared cosmology
papers.abstract: In multi-fluid, matter-type gravity, the Bianchi identity constrains the divergence of the total effective stress tensor but does not, by itself, determine the currents assigned to its constituent sectors. Those currents are selected only after the off-shell matter action and equations, or an additional phenomenological closure, have been specified. We formulate this distinction and examine a spatially flat two-fluid background inspired by scale-independent EMSG. The case study combines an algebraic perfect-fluid prescription with a vanishing contracted-Hessian contribution, together with separate conservation of the total conventional and modification sectors. Because neither assumption is derived here from a concrete off-shell fluid action, the resulting system is an effective background closure rather than a microscopic EMSG model. For unequal EoS and every $α\ne0$, the closure yields a Barrow-Clifton system whose transfer coefficients depend on $(w_1,w_2)$ but not on $α$. Hence the nonzero-$α$ family is singular: its $α\to0$ limit does not recover the uncoupled GR conservation laws. We solve the two density eigenmodes and derive the associated modified Liénard equation for $H$. We also prove that the discriminant governing rank loss of the density-reconstruction map is strictly positive for every finite $w_1\ne w_2$. Thus each genuinely quadratic case has two distinct real rank-degenerate couplings. Exact vacuum and stiff-fluid families illustrate modal cancellation. When today's conventional densities are positive, the intervals on which both remain positive generally terminate at finite endpoints in the parameter ranges analyzed explicitly. These results provide a consistency diagnostic for separating action-level predictions from closure artifacts in multi-fluid, matter-type gravity; they do not establish an observationally viable EMSG model.

analysis.title_zh: 双流体能量--动量平方宇宙学中的作用量选择流与奇异守恒闭合
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论多流体 energy--momentum-squared cosmology 中，Bianchi 恒等式不足以决定各组分流，必须由 off-shell 物质作用量、方程或额外现象学闭合来选择。摘要中的两流体平直背景例子显示，在若干未由具体 off-shell 流体作用量推出的假设下，非零 α 家族具有奇异的 α→0 极限，并给出密度本征模、H 的改进 Liénard 方程及秩退化判别。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 宇宙学依赖对背景膨胀、组分守恒和扰动源项的精确定义；多流体修正引力若闭合条件不来自一致的物质作用量，可能在拟合 CMB 时引入非物理背景演化或错误的 GR 极限。该文为评估 EMSG 类模型是否能可靠进入 CMB/大尺度结构约束提供了方法论警示。
key_points: 强调多流体 matter-type gravity 中，Bianchi 恒等式只约束总有效应力张量散度，不能单独决定各组分流。
以受 scale-independent EMSG 启发的平直两流体背景为例，展示额外守恒闭合可能产生奇异的 α→0 极限。
作者将结果定位为区分 action-level 预言与闭合假象的一致性诊断，而非可观测可行的 EMSG 模型。
methods: 多流体 matter-type gravity 的 Bianchi 恒等式分析
空间平直两流体背景模型
代数 perfect-fluid prescription
vanishing contracted-Hessian contribution 假设
总 conventional 与 modification sectors 分别守恒的 phenomenological closure
Barrow-Clifton 系统
两密度 eigenmodes 求解
H 的 modified Liénard equation 推导
density-reconstruction map 的判别式与秩退化分析
真空与 stiff-fluid 精确族示例
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对该两流体系统的守恒闭合是否有作用量层面的支撑，以及 α→0 不回到 GR 是否是物理特征还是闭合假象；还要检查正密度区间有限终止对背景宇宙学适用性的影响。

papers.title: Black holes from a Higgs-like field in the radiation era
papers.abstract: Light spectator fields during inflation can acquire superhorizon fluctuations that cross a potential barrier between positive and negative regions of their potential. Motivated by the Standard Model Higgs instability, in this work we study the subsequent evolution of patches where this occurs in the radiation era after inflation ends for a Higgs-like spectator field. We utilise fully nonlinear, spherically symmetric numerical relativity. Across the black hole forming configurations in our investigation we find a robust two-stage evolution. First, the central negative potential region reverses its expansion, becomes kinetic dominated, and forms a primordial black hole that hides the runaway core. The positive potential barrier that survives outside this first horizon then determines one of two late-time branches. In the subcritical branch the original apparent horizon grows smoothly and engulfs the remaining scalar structure. In the supercritical branch, however, the potential energy of the barrier dominates the local evolution. The result is a transient wormhole throat, a bifurcating trapping horizon, and an inflating child universe branch. In both branches the parent radiation dominated universe is ultimately left with an ordinary primordial black hole whose subsequent growth is governed by radiation accretion.

analysis.title_zh: 辐射时代中由类 Higgs 场产生的黑洞
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究受标准模型 Higgs 不稳定性启发的 Higgs-like 旁观者场，在暴胀后辐射时代中跨越势垒的斑块如何演化。摘要称，完全非线性球对称数值相对论显示黑洞形成构型具有两阶段演化，并可能出现亚临界吞并分支或超临界的瞬态虫洞喉、分叉 trapping horizon 与暴胀子宇宙分支。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初黑洞形成机制与早期宇宙小尺度扰动、暴胀旁观者场和潜在暗物质候选有关；这些场景会受到 CMB 对大尺度扰动、等曲率、非高斯性及能量注入的间接约束。该文主要是早期宇宙强引力演化问题，但其结果可能影响将 Higgs-like 场涨落与 PBH 丰度联系起来的宇宙学模型。
key_points: 暴胀期间轻旁观者场的超视界涨落可跨越势垒。
辐射时代中负势能区域可反转膨胀并形成原初黑洞。
势垒外层决定亚临界和超临界两种晚期分支；最终母宇宙中留下普通原初黑洞。
methods: 全非线性球对称数值相对论
辐射时代中 Higgs-like 旁观者场斑块演化模拟
表观视界和 trapping horizon 演化分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对初始条件如何由暴胀超视界涨落映射到辐射时代斑块、球对称假设的影响，以及黑洞形成分支对势垒形状和辐射背景的敏感性。

papers.title: Analytical Cosmological Collider at Strong Mixing in Laplace Space
papers.abstract: Primordial non-Gaussianities are at their largest when the curvature perturbation is coupled to a massive field by a mixing too strong to be treated perturbatively. We show that this regime, naturally reached in multifield inflation, is solved analytically by the Laplace-space representation we recently introduced, in which every mode becomes a superposition of plane waves weighted by a single kernel. The bispectrum then follows as a rapidly convergent series of elementary functions, in perfect agreement with independent numerical results. We find that the cosmological collider signal at strong mixing is larger than widely believed, with only half of the usual Boltzmann suppression. Its amplitude further grows with the number of time derivatives of the curvature perturbation in the interaction, singling out the most promising observational targets.

analysis.title_zh: Laplace 空间中强混合情形的解析宇宙学对撞机
analysis.summary_zh: 本文处理多场暴胀中曲率扰动与大质量场强混合、不能微扰处理时的原初非高斯性问题。作者使用 Laplace 空间表示解析求解模式并计算双谱，摘要报告该结果与独立数值计算一致，且强混合下宇宙学对撞机信号大于通常预期。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初非高斯性是 CMB 与大尺度结构寻找暴胀高能物理的重要通道；若强混合会增强宇宙学对撞机信号并改变质量抑制，可能影响 CMB 双谱或未来非高斯性搜索的理论模板与目标优先级。
key_points: 讨论多场暴胀中曲率扰动与重场强混合时的原初非高斯性。
用 Laplace 空间表示给出解析求解，并将双谱写成快速收敛级数。
摘要称强混合下宇宙学对撞机信号比通常预期更大。
methods: Laplace-space representation
mode functions as superpositions of plane waves weighted by a kernel
bispectrum expressed as rapidly convergent series of elementary functions
与独立数值结果比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Laplace 空间解析表示的适用条件，特别是“强混合”参数范围、与数值结果比较的基准，以及“Boltzmann suppression 只有通常一半”的推导是否依赖特定相互作用形式。

papers.title: Dynamics of Wave Structures in Multifield Fuzzy Dark Matter Halos
papers.abstract: As a natural extension of the single-field fuzzy dark matter (FDM) model, multifield FDM has attracted increasing attention in recent years. This scenario is motivated both by the axiverse scenario predicted by string theory and by the possibility that multifield FDM may provide a better match to astrophysical observations than its single-field counterpart. In this work, we perform high-resolution numerical simulations to systematically investigate the dynamics of wave structures in multifield FDM halos. In particular, we study the oscillatory and stochastic motions of the central core, the evolution and statistical properties of granules, and the resulting dynamical heating of embedded stellar systems. We find that the frequency spectra of the core density oscillations develop multiple peaks and shift toward higher frequencies relative to the single-field case. The centers of different field components undergo nearly synchronized random walks, while subdominant components exhibit larger random-walk amplitudes. We further show that the suppression of granule density fluctuations with increasing number of fields is largely insensitive to the fractional abundance of each component over a broad parameter range. Moreover, using self-consistent simulations, we find that the dynamical heating induced by granules is progressively suppressed as the number of fields increases. However, once the contribution from the central core is taken into account, this trend would become much less pronounced.

analysis.title_zh: 多场模糊暗物质晕中波结构的动力学
analysis.summary_zh: 本文通过高分辨率数值模拟研究多场模糊暗物质晕中的核心振荡、粒状结构和对嵌入恒星系统的动力学加热。摘要报告，多场会使核心振荡频谱呈多峰并偏向更高频，同时随场数增加抑制粒状密度涨落和由其导致的加热，但考虑中央核心后该抑制趋势会变弱。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要关联暗物质小尺度结构和星系动力学，而非直接 CMB 分析；不过模糊暗物质模型属于宇宙学暗物质候选，其小尺度结构效应可与 CMB 给出的总体暗物质约束形成互补。
key_points: 用高分辨率数值模拟研究多场模糊暗物质晕的波结构动力学。
多场情形下核心密度振荡出现多峰并向更高频率移动。
粒状结构导致的动力学加热随场数增加而受抑，但纳入中央核心贡献后趋势减弱。
methods: 高分辨率数值模拟
自洽模拟
核心密度振荡频谱分析
granule 统计性质与嵌入恒星系统动力学加热分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对多场组分的质量、丰度和初始条件设置，以及粒状结构加热与中央核心贡献如何分离，因为这些选择会影响其对星系尺度观测的可比性。

papers.title: Impact of Bubble Nucleation History and Friction on Primordial Black Hole Formation
papers.abstract: Cosmological first-order phase transitions (FOPTs) in the early Universe are an exciting prediction of many beyond the Standard Model scenarios. Owing to the stochastic nature of bubble nucleation, some causal patches may remain trapped in the false vacuum long after the surrounding regions have completed the transition and started to redshift. Under suitable conditions, these delayed patches can become sufficiently overdense to collapse into primordial black holes (PBHs). One therefore expects characteristic parameters, such as the PBH mass and PBH formation time to be sensitive to the underlying phase-transition dynamics. Here, we adopt a model-independent framework with a fixed mean bubble separation scale ($R_*$) to directly compare the impact of exponential and Gaussian nucleation profiles on PBH formation. We further incorporate the effects of friction on the bubble walls arising from interactions with the surrounding plasma. We find that friction significantly modifies the bubble dynamics, leading to significant changes in the PBH mass and formation time for both nucleation histories. Moreover, the stochastic gravitational-wave spectrum generated by the FOPT can provide a complementary probe of the underlying dynamics, allowing the effects of friction on the bubble wall evolution to be distinguished from the frictionless case.

analysis.title_zh: 泡成核历史与摩擦对原初黑洞形成的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究早期宇宙一阶相变中，泡成核历史和泡壁摩擦如何影响延迟假真空区域形成原初黑洞。作者在固定平均泡间距尺度的模型无关框架下比较指数型与高斯型成核，并发现摩擦会显著改变 PBH 质量和形成时间，同时相变产生的随机引力波谱可辅助区分相关动力学。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初黑洞和一阶相变都可能改变早期宇宙的扰动、能量组分和随机引力波背景，是 CMB 约束暗物质、早期能量注入和小尺度扰动时的相关背景。虽然摘要未直接使用 CMB 数据，但其 PBH 与相变引力波预测可与 CMB 对 PBH 丰度、谱畸变或额外辐射的约束形成互补。
key_points: 研究一阶相变中泡成核历史对延迟假真空区域坍缩成原初黑洞的影响。
比较指数型与高斯型成核剖面，并加入等离子体摩擦对泡壁动力学的作用。
摘要称摩擦会显著改变 PBH 质量和形成时间，随机引力波谱可作为互补探针。
methods: 模型无关框架
固定平均泡间距尺度 R_*
指数型泡成核剖面
高斯型泡成核剖面
泡壁摩擦效应
随机引力波谱
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对固定 R_* 的比较是否足以隔离成核历史效应、摩擦项的物理参数化是否通用，以及 PBH 丰度约束和引力波谱预测是否依赖未在摘要中说明的相变模型假设。

papers.title: Observational Evidence for the Kinematic Memory of Cosmic Filaments from Satellite Orbital Orientations
papers.abstract: We present an observational study of the kinematic coherence between satellite orbital planes and the cosmic web. Using the SDSS DR12 galaxy sample combined with the Bisous filament catalogue, we investigate whether the orbital motion of satellites preserves the memory of filamentary accretion. For each satellite system, we define a projected orbital-normal vector using galaxy sky positions and line-of-sight velocity offsets. By measuring the angle $θ$ between this vector and the local projected filament direction, we detect a distinctive preferred orientation: satellite orbital planes tend to contain or lie parallel to the filament axis. This signal deviates from the isotropic expectation at a high significance level of $12.8σ$. The strength of this kinematic connection depend strongly on environment and host properties. The preference for orbital planes to track the filament direction is most pronounced for groups in close distance to the filament spine and for more massive hosts. Conversely, at intermediate distances from the filament and at large group-centric radii, the signal reverses, indicating a tendency for orbital planes to be oriented perpendicular to the filament. Our findings provide direct observational evidence for the two-phase model of filamentary accretion, where a transition from initial perpendicular collapse toward the filament spine to subsequent parallel streamwise infall into dark matter haloes governs the orientation of satellite orbital angular momentum and galaxy spin. The observed transition may further trace the characteristic radial scale of filaments, offering a dynamical perspective on the internal structure and assembly of the cosmic filament.

analysis.title_zh: 来自卫星轨道取向的宇宙纤维运动学记忆观测证据
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 SDSS DR12 星系样本结合 Bisous 纤维目录，考察卫星星系轨道平面是否保留沿宇宙纤维吸积的运动学记忆。摘要报告称，卫星轨道平面相对局部纤维方向存在显著取向偏好，且该信号随到纤维脊的距离、宿主质量和群心半径而变化，并被解释为支持纤维吸积的两阶段图像。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇主要面向星系形成、暗物质晕装配和宇宙网动力学；对 CMB/宇宙学读者的价值在于它从低红移大尺度结构的各向异性吸积和角动量排列角度检验结构形成图像。它可与 CMB 给出的初始条件和 ΛCDM 结构增长预言相衔接，但并非直接使用 CMB 观测。
key_points: 使用 SDSS DR12 星系样本和 Bisous filament catalogue 研究卫星星系轨道取向与宇宙网的关系。
通过投影轨道法向量与局部投影纤维方向的夹角 θ 检验取向偏好。
摘要报告卫星轨道平面倾向于包含或平行于纤维轴，并存在随环境和宿主性质变化的取向转变。
methods: SDSS DR12 galaxy sample
Bisous filament catalogue
projected orbital-normal vector from sky positions and line-of-sight velocity offsets
angle θ between orbital-normal vector and local projected filament direction
comparison with isotropic expectation
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对投影轨道法向量对真实三维角动量的可靠性、卫星/宿主样本选择和纤维识别误差、12.8σ 显著性的统计定义，以及环境分箱中的 look-elsewhere 或系统误差处理。

papers.title: Toward a Unified Axion Cosmology
papers.abstract: We explore a unified axion framework connecting grand unification, string-inspired axion-like particles (ALPs), and cosmology. Starting from the QCD axion associated with Peccei--Quinn symmetry in supersymmetric SO(10) GUT, we consider the broader spectrum of ultralight ALPs motivated by heterotic string theory. Within this multi-axion structure, we focus on two ultralight scales selected by cosmological requirements. A mode of order $10^{-22}$ eV is assumed to constitute the dominant dark-matter component and can form a Bose--Einstein condensate whose attractive self-interaction leads to nonlinear collapse, providing possible seeds for high-redshift supermassive black holes. A lighter eigen-direction with a characteristic dynamical scale of order $10^{-28}$ eV can transiently increase the pre-recombination expansion rate and reduce the sound horizon. An order-of-magnitude estimate shows that addressing the Hubble tension requires a sound-horizon-weighted axion fraction of order 0.1, corresponding, for a large initial displacement, to an effective decay constant of order $10^{18}$ GeV. We show that a multi-axion--multi-instanton system can in principle provide both the required aligned light direction and a higher-order effective potential that makes the $10^{-28}$ eV contribution transient. The framework links theoretically motivated axionic degrees of freedom to the distinct scales required by dark-matter, early-black-hole, and Hubble-tension phenomenology.

analysis.title_zh: 迈向统一的轴子宇宙学
analysis.summary_zh: 本文尝试构建统一轴子宇宙学框架，把超对称 SO(10) GUT 中的 QCD 轴子、异质弦启发的超轻 ALP 谱与暗物质、高红移超大质量黑洞种子和 Hubble 张力联系起来。摘要报告称，多轴子-多瞬子系统原则上可给出约 10^{-22} eV 的暗物质模式和约 10^{-28} eV 的瞬态轻方向，后者可提高复合前膨胀率并减小声学视界，所需声学视界加权轴子比例为约 0.1。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 宇宙学的核心联系在于复合前膨胀史和声学视界：若 10^{-28} eV 轴子分量能在早期短暂贡献能量密度，它会改变 CMB 推断 H0 所依赖的声学标尺。与此同时，10^{-22} eV 超轻轴子暗物质也会影响结构形成、小尺度功率谱和潜在的 CMB 透镜信号，因此其统一框架需要同时面对 CMB、BAO 和大尺度结构约束。
key_points: 讨论从 QCD 轴子到异质弦启发的超轻 ALP 谱的统一框架。
摘要提出约 10^{-22} eV 模式作为主要暗物质，并可能通过非线性坍缩为高红移超大质量黑洞提供种子。
约 10^{-28} eV 的轻方向被用于暂时提高复合前膨胀率、减小声学视界，以关联 Hubble 张力。
methods: 超对称 SO(10) GUT 中 Peccei--Quinn 对称性关联的 QCD 轴子框架
异质弦理论启发的超轻 ALP 多轴子结构
多轴子-多瞬子系统
数量级估计
声学视界加权轴子比例估计
大初始位移与有效衰变常数估计
高阶有效势构造以产生瞬态贡献
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：10^{-28} eV 轴子分量如何在不破坏 CMB 峰结构、早期暗能量约束和大尺度结构约束的情况下实现“瞬态”减小声学视界；摘要中的数量级估计是否来自完整 Boltzmann/CMB 拟合，还是仅为参数层面的可行性论证。

papers.title: Cosmological extra dimensions can mimic dark matter I. Dark matter in galaxies
papers.abstract: We present a simple model with a n + 4-dimensional metric with compactified extra dimensions with a space dependent radius R. We show that changes in the profile of R are sourced by (visible) matter density and Newtonian potential. We can reproduce rotation curves of spiral galaxies and provide an expression for R. In order to test our hypothesis, we propose six experiments.

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙学额外维度可以模拟暗物质 I：星系中的暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 论文提出一个额外维度紧致半径随空间变化的模型，其中半径变化由可见物质密度和牛顿势源起。摘要称该模型能够重现螺旋星系旋转曲线，并给出半径表达式，同时提出六项实验来检验这一解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系旋转曲线通常是暗物质存在的重要观测依据；该工作探讨几何上的额外维度效应是否能够产生类似暗物质的引力现象。它与宇宙学的关系主要在于为星系尺度的暗物质现象提供一种修正引力或高维几何解释，但摘要未涉及 CMB 预测，因此其能否与 CMB 约束相容仍需进一步核查。
key_points: 额外维度半径的空间变化由可见物质密度和牛顿势源起。
模型能够重现螺旋星系的旋转曲线，并给出额外维度半径的表达式。
摘要提出六项用于检验该假说的实验。
methods: 构造具有紧致额外维度且半径随空间变化的 n+4 维度规模型。
分析额外维度半径与可见物质密度、牛顿引力势之间的关系。
用模型拟合或重现螺旋星系旋转曲线。
提出六项实验检验方案。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对额外维度半径的动力学方程及其边界条件，确认旋转曲线重现所需的物质分布假设，并仔细检查六项实验的可行性、可区分预测及其与标准暗物质模型的比较。

papers.title: Constraining Gravitational Waves from Superconducting Cosmic Strings with the Dark Ages $21$-cm Signal
papers.abstract: Superconducting cosmic strings (SCSs) are characterized by three parameters: the dimensionless string tension $Gμ$, the current amplitude $Y$, and the vector coupling, $\tilde{e}$ as recently explored in \cite{Rybak:2024our}. Using the Charge-Velocity-dependent One-Scale (CVOS) model, we compute the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB) emitted by current-carrying loops, including the suppression effect of vector radiation. While previous studies have shown that large $\tilde{e}$ suppresses the SGWB, allowing larger $Gμ$ to evade pulsar timing array (PTA) bounds \cite{Rybak:2024our}, we demonstrate that this parameter space is definitively constrained by an independent, astrophysically clean probe: the Dark Ages global $21$-cm signal. We recalculated the recently derived $21$-cm bounds \cite{Si:2025vsj} into the generic $(\tilde{e},Y,Gμ)$ parameter space and find that at the threshold where vector radiation emission starts dominating, any coupling $\tilde{e}\gtrsim 10^{-7}$ and $Y\simeq 0.67$ and $Gμ\gtrsim 10^{-13}$ injects sufficient ionizing radiation to completely erase the $21$-cm absorption signal at redshift $z\simeq89$. Greater current amplitudes impose more stringent constraints. This excludes a large parameter space considered viable. Our model-independent results highlight the complementarity between future lunar-based $21$-cm experiments and gravitational wave (GW) observatories.

analysis.title_zh: 用暗时代 21 cm 信号约束来自超导宇宙弦的引力波
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究超导宇宙弦在带电流弦圈中产生的随机引力波背景，并用暗时代全球 21 cm 信号约束其参数空间。摘要称，在矢量辐射开始主导的阈值附近，特定耦合、电流幅度和弦张力范围会注入足够电离辐射，从而抹去 z≈89 的 21 cm 吸收信号，排除一大片此前被认为可行的参数空间。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙弦属于早期宇宙和高能物理遗迹，其随机引力波背景可与 CMB 的原初张量、谱畸变或额外能量注入约束互补。暗时代 21 cm 信号提供了不依赖复杂再电离天体源的早期宇宙探针，因此对 CMB 之外检验新物理参数空间有直接价值。
key_points: 研究超导宇宙弦产生的随机引力波背景及暗时代全球 21 cm 约束。
使用 CVOS 模型并包含矢量辐射对 SGWB 的抑制。
摘要称暗时代 21 cm 吸收信号可排除一大片 PTA 约束下仍可行的参数空间。
methods: Charge-Velocity-dependent One-Scale（CVOS）模型
计算带电流弦圈产生的随机引力波背景
纳入矢量辐射的抑制效应
将既有 21 cm 约束重算到通用的 (tilde e, Y, Gμ) 参数空间
暗时代全球 21 cm 信号约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 21 cm 吸收被“完全抹除”的判据、能量注入到电离/加热历史的转换假设，以及这些约束相对于 PTA 和未来月基 21 cm 实验灵敏度的依赖。

papers.title: Primordial Asymmetries, Primordial Equation of State & Primordial Black Holes
papers.abstract: We study the thermal history of the primordial Universe in the presence of non-zero lepton and baryon asymmetries. Considering different scenarios, we determine the equation of state (EoS) of the Universe from T = 10 GeV down to T = 1 keV, spanning the QCD transition, hadron gas phase and neutrino decoupling epochs. Using a combination of numerical codes, we track the cosmic trajectories of chemical potentials associated with the baryonic, leptonic and electric charges, and follow the evolution of lepton asymmetries including through the era where neutrino oscillations take place. Combining peak theory with numerical-relativity simulations of the collapse threshold, we show the EoS-induced modifications to the primordial black hole (PBH) mass spectrum. We determine the associated Gravitational Wave (GW) signal, showing how lepton asymmetries and a particular spectral index of curvature perturbations can be hinted at by current ground interferometer-based GW observations. Finally, we discuss constraints and positive evidence for PBHs.
papers.comment: 27 pages totals, 16 main text pages, 6 main text figures, 3 appendix, 9 appendix figures

papers.title: Anisotropies in the PTA gravitational wave background: what can they teach us about supermassive black hole binaries?
papers.abstract: The gravitational wave background detected by pulsar timing arrays is sourced by a finite population of supermassive black hole binaries, and is therefore anisotropic. We ask what measuring that anisotropy can teach us about the population, using models that span a wide range of effective source counts, all normalized to the measured background amplitude. We find four things. First, the expected anisotropy is produced by the single brightest binary: a dipole at the level of the published NANOGrav 95% upper limit would require one source to supply about 60% of the power in the band. Second, no model that also reproduces the measured strain spectrum contains a source that bright. In every case the loudest binary stays below the NANOGrav continuous-wave upper limit at every frequency it covers, consistent with the joint search of the 15-year data, which finds no resolved source. Third, because the anisotropy is produced by one source, compressing the sky to an angular power spectrum discards the phase information that locates it. Such a search is never more sensitive than looking for the source directly, and is strictly worse once more than a dipole is kept. Fourth, the published upper limits on the angular power spectrum therefore reflect the analysis prior rather than the data: they coincide with the 95th percentile of the prior induced by the square-root spherical harmonic basis adopted in the analysis. What does constrain the population today is the shape of the strain spectrum. Rare, bright sources depress the median spectrum below its mean, and fitting the measured spectrum already disfavors mass functions dominated by binaries above about 10^10 solar masses.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 11 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/matiaszaldarriaga/pta-gwb-anisotropy Data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21911100

analysis.title_zh: PTA 引力波背景中的各向异性：它们能告诉我们关于超大质量黑洞双星的什么？
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论脉冲星计时阵列探测到的引力波背景各向异性能否约束超大质量黑洞双星源族。摘要称，在满足已测背景振幅和应变谱的模型中，各向异性通常由最亮单个双星主导；当前更有约束力的是应变谱形状，而不是角功率谱上限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: PTA 引力波背景是低频引力波宇宙学的重要观测前沿，其各向异性分析在方法上与 CMB 各向异性和角功率谱有明显类比。该摘要特别指出角功率谱压缩可能丢失定位单个亮源的相位信息，这对熟悉 CMB 功率谱方法的读者具有方法论上的警示意义。
key_points: PTA 探测到的引力波背景因有限 SMBH 双星源族而具有各向异性。
摘要称预期各向异性主要由最亮单个双星贡献。
作者认为当前角功率谱上限更多反映分析先验，而源族约束主要来自应变谱形状。
methods: 超大质量黑洞双星源族模型
按已测背景振幅归一化的模型比较
PTA 引力波背景各向异性分析
与 NANOGrav 95% 上限、连续波上限和 15 年数据联合搜索结果比较
角功率谱与球谐基分析

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对各向异性由单个最亮源主导这一结论对源族模型、先验和归一化方式的依赖，以及关于角功率谱上限“反映先验”的论证是否严格。

papers.title: Particle Dark Matter in the 1980s and 1990s
papers.abstract: In 1980, the Universe was made of stars, cosmology was the province of less than 100 astronomers, the Hubble constant was only known to within a factor of two, and the hot big bang was the ``the standard model of cosmology.'' Particle physics was a thriving enterprise concerned with the inner space of quarks, leptons and the strong, weak and electromagnetic interactions. The Standard Model was newly established and the aspirations were for a ``grand unification'' of the forces and particles. By 2000, the agendas of inner space and outer space were inextricably linked, and $Λ$CDM with its inflation, particle dark matter and dark energy -- and a Hubble constant reliably known to better than 10\% -- was the new standard model. The big questions connecting inner space and outer space included the origin of ordinary matter, the identity of dark matter, the nature of dark energy, and an understanding of the origin of space, time and the Universe. Particle dark matter, the idea that the bulk of the mysterious dark matter is a new, long-lived or stable elementary particle, played a central in bringing together inner space and outer space, and today is still a hot topic in both fields.
papers.comment: Talk presented at the 4th International Symposium on the History of Particle Physics (November 2025, CERN), to be published by Cambridge University Press

analysis.title_zh: 20 世纪 80 年代和 90 年代的粒子暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文回顾 1980 年到 2000 年间粒子暗物质思想如何把粒子物理的“内空间”问题与宇宙学的“外空间”问题联系起来。摘要称，这一时期 ΛCDM、暴胀、粒子暗物质和暗能量共同成为新的标准宇宙学框架，粒子暗物质至今仍是两大领域的核心议题。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 研究通常以 ΛCDM 为基准模型，而冷暗物质的粒子本质是该模型中最关键但尚未直接确认的物理假设之一。该文虽非数据分析论文，但可为理解 CMB 参数模型、暴胀初始条件和暗物质候选体之间的历史联系提供背景。
key_points: 这是一篇关于粒子暗物质概念在 1980 至 2000 年间形成与发展的历史性综述。
摘要强调粒子物理与宇宙学议程在这一时期逐渐融合。
与技术性 CMB 分析关系间接，但有助于理解 ΛCDM、暴胀和暗物质框架的思想背景。
methods: 历史回顾
粒子物理与宇宙学发展脉络梳理
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者如何界定“粒子暗物质”在 ΛCDM 成为标准模型中的作用，以及是否区分历史事实、理论动机和后见之明的叙述。

papers.title: Searching for signatures of self-interacting dark matter in halos from full-physics simulations: From 3D structure to projected observables
papers.abstract: In this work we explore the imprints of self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) on the structure of simulated galaxy groups and clusters in view of future optical surveys. We find that both baryonic and projection effects lead to a significant alleviation of the SIDM core-forming behavior on the mass and density profiles, resulting in very small ($\lesssim 5\%$) deviations from standard collisionless dark matter. The opposite trend emerges for our most massive halos, where SIDM tends to significantly enhance the central density instead; we compare those halos with the observed dark matter profiles of two galaxy clusters, MACS J1206 and Abell S1063, finding that SIDM may leave potentially detectable imprints on cluster cores when considering the small observational uncertainty of current kinematic mass measurements. Finally, we find that weak lensing observations provide a promising tool for testing SIDM on cluster scales: in an idealized scenario where systematics are under control, weak lensing shear profiles exhibit up to $\sim 20\%$ level deviations for $M_{200} \gtrsim 10^{13}\ \text{M}_\odot$ halos. Conversely, the projected concentration-mass relation is only slightly modified by our SIDM models. We also discuss the limitiations of our analysis and the impact of the simulation resolution, as well as possible extension of this work. Overall, our results provide a baseline for future SIDM studies: although line-of-sight projection and baryonic effects significantly reduce SIDM imprints on halo mass profiles, weak lensing and kinematic analyses in galaxy clusters may potentially allow for robust detection and constraining of dark matter self-interactions in massive structures from megaparsec down to kiloparsec scales.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 15 figures, submitted to Astronomy and Astrophysics

analysis.title_zh: 在全物理模拟晕中寻找自相互作用暗物质的特征：从三维结构到投影可观测量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用全物理模拟研究自相互作用暗物质在星系群和星系团晕中的三维结构及投影可观测量印记。摘要报告，重子和投影效应会使质量与密度轮廓上相对无碰撞暗物质的偏离很小，但在高质量星系团核心、运动学质量测量和理想化弱透镜剪切轮廓中仍可能出现可检测信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质微观性质会影响小尺度和星系团尺度结构，而这些结构增长信息与 CMB 给出的早期宇宙 ΛCDM 初始条件互补。该文对弱透镜和星系团观测能否检验 SIDM 给出摘要层面的判断，有助于评估未来光学巡天与 CMB 联合限制暗物质物理的潜力。
key_points: 论文用全物理模拟研究自相互作用暗物质在星系群和星系团晕中的可观测印记。
摘要称重子效应和投影效应会显著削弱 SIDM 对质量与密度轮廓的核心形成特征。
弱透镜剪切轮廓和星系团运动学质量测量被认为是测试 SIDM 的有前景手段。

papers.title: Beyond dynamical dark energy: the role of dark sector interactions after DESI DR2
papers.abstract: Recent DESI DR2 observations have renewed interest in extensions of the $Λ$CDM cosmological model, particularly through indications of a time-varying dark energy equation of state. In this work, we investigate whether such deviations may also involve interactions within the dark sector. We consider an interacting dark energy scenario in which the dark matter density evolves as $ρ_{\rm dm}\propto a^{-3+δ}$, with the constant $δ$ quantifying the interaction strength, and allow the dark energy equation of state to be either constant but different from $-1$, or dynamically evolving through the CPL parametrization. The models are constrained using Planck CMB data, DESI DR2 BAO measurements, and three Type Ia supernova compilations: PantheonPlus, Union3, and DES-Dovekie. For the constant equation-of-state case, the inclusion of DESI and supernova data leads to a preference for a small negative interaction parameter, with a significance above $2σ$. When dynamical dark energy is allowed, the evidence for interaction becomes weak, while the data favor a quintessence-like evolving dark energy component. In both scenarios, Bayesian model comparison still favors $Λ$CDM. Our results show that the inferred role of dark-sector interactions depends strongly on the nature of dark energy, highlighting the importance of jointly testing dark energy dynamics and interactions in the DESI era.
papers.comment: 15 pages including bibliography; 7 captioned figures, 3 tables. Comments are welcome

analysis.title_zh: 超越动力学暗能量：DESI DR2 之后暗部门相互作用的作用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 DESI DR2 背景下检验暗能量偏离 ΛCDM 是否可能伴随暗部门相互作用，采用 ρ_dm ∝ a^{-3+δ} 的相互作用模型，并分别考虑常数状态方程和 CPL 动力学暗能量。摘要报告常数状态方程时联合 DESI 与超新星数据偏好小的负相互作用参数，而允许动力学暗能量后相互作用证据变弱，整体贝叶斯模型比较仍支持 ΛCDM。

PantheonPlus、Union3、DES-Dovekie Ia 型超新星汇编

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Planck、DESI DR2 与不同超新星样本组合下 δ、w 或 CPL 参数的退化关系，以及贝叶斯证据和所谓相互作用偏好是否对先验、数据组合和系统误差处理敏感。

papers.title: Hydrodynamical simulations of the merging cluster El Gordo in a two-state self-interacting dark matter scenario
papers.abstract: A large suite of N-body/hydrodynamical simulations is used to demonstrate that the physical properties of the merging cluster El Gordo are well reproduced within a two-state self-interacting dark matter scenario. Our findings show that, in addition to elastic scattering, the presence of an inelastic, endothermic, up-scattering channel is essential to satisfy observational constraints derived from the measured weak lensing profiles of the two colliding clusters. We find that the observational properties of El Gordo are adequately matched by our self-interacting dark matter model within the following interval of parameters: an elastic cross-section in the range of ~ 4 -5 cm^2/gr, and an up-scattering channel bounded by an inelastic cross-section of approximately ~ 2 -4 cm^2/gr with a threshold velocity of ~1200 - 1600 kms, respectively. We argue that our conclusions depend critically on current uncertainties in the primary mass and the projected separation d_{DM}. In fact, our findings suggest that if error estimates in weak lensing measurements were significantly reduced - with future observations showing evidence of a low primary mass (<~ 10^{15} M_sun ) and a larger projected separation d_{DM} >~ 740 kpc - it would then be difficult for the proposed self-interacting scenario to be reconciled with observational constraints. We further suggest that future lensing surveys of massive, high-velocity merging clusters could be decisive in testing the proposed dark matter scenario.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 6 figures, 2 Tables, accepted for publication in ApJ

analysis.title_zh: 两态自相互作用暗物质情景下并合星系团 El Gordo 的流体动力学模拟
analysis.summary_zh: 该文用一大套 N 体/流体模拟检验两态自相互作用暗物质能否重现并合星系团 El Gordo 的物理性质。摘要报告称，除弹性散射外，非弹性吸热上散射通道对满足两团弱透镜剖面约束是必要的，并给出一组可匹配观测的参数范围，同时强调主团质量和暗物质投影分离的不确定性会显著影响结论。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 并合星系团是检验暗物质自相互作用和结构形成模型的重要实验场；这些约束会影响 CMB 所偏好的 ΛCDM 背景下小尺度和非线性结构的暗物理解释。对 CMB 研究者而言，它属于后期宇宙结构对暗物质性质的互补约束，而非直接 CMB 各向异性分析。
key_points: 用大规模 N 体/流体模拟研究 El Gordo 并合星系团。
模型包含弹性自相互作用和非弹性吸热上散射通道。
摘要称弱透镜质量与暗物质投影分离的不确定性对结论很关键。
methods: N-body/hydrodynamical simulations
two-state self-interacting dark matter scenario
weak lensing profiles of the two colliding clusters
future lensing surveys of massive, high-velocity merging clusters
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模拟初始条件、弱透镜质量与 d_{DM} 约束的采用方式，以及给出的截面和阈值速度范围是否依赖特定观测误差或投影假设。

papers.title: The Schwarzschild Black Hole in an External Gravitational Tidal Field: the Quasinormal Spectrum
papers.abstract: A black hole need not ring down in isolation, since a nearby companion can subject it to an external gravitational tide. We calculate how a quadrupole tide modifies the Schwarzschild black hole resonances. Linearising the exact tidally distorted Schwarzschild solution in the tidal amplitude $A$, we derive the diagonal odd- and even-parity perturbation equations on the deformed background and compute the formal first order displacements of analytically continued Schwarzschild resonances. Each diagonal first order shift factorises as $δω_{n\ell m}=A\,c_{\ell m}κ_{n\ell}$, giving one reduced complex coefficient for each $(n,\ell)$, expressed as a ratio of contour integrals, multiplied by a universal Zeeman-like pattern that splits the $2\ell+1$ azimuthal multiplet. For the $\ell=2$ and $\ell=3$ sectors analysed explicitly, the odd- and even-parity shifts coincide, so Schwarzschild isospectrality survives at first order in the tidal amplitude. Quadratic tidal forces, by contrast, can break this degeneracy. Moreover, for a physical companion, the astrophysically dominant $(n,\ell,m)=(0,2,2)$ mode oscillates faster and decays more slowly. Finally, we show that the eikonal shifts admit a geometric description in terms of the Penrose limit about the tidally deformed photon ring.

analysis.title_zh: 外部引力潮汐场中的 Schwarzschild 黑洞：准正规谱
analysis.summary_zh: 该文研究 Schwarzschild 黑洞不孤立振铃时，外部四极引力潮汐场如何改变其准正规模谱。作者在线性潮汐振幅下推导奇、偶宇称扰动方程并计算一阶共振位移，摘要称频移可分解为模式相关复系数与普适的方位多重态分裂，并在显式分析的 l=2、l=3 扇区保持一阶等谱性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要关联引力波环降和强场广义相对论，而不是 CMB 观测本身。对宇宙学读者的意义在于，黑洞环境效应会影响引力波标准源和强引力检验的建模，间接关系到多信使宇宙学中的系统误差控制。
key_points: 计算外部四极潮汐场对 Schwarzschild 黑洞准正规模的修正。
一阶频移呈类 Zeeman 的 m 多重态分裂形式。
摘要称 l=2、l=3 中奇偶宇称一阶频移相同，但二阶潮汐力可破坏简并。
methods: linearising the exact tidally distorted Schwarzschild solution in tidal amplitude A
diagonal odd- and even-parity perturbation equations
formal first order displacements of analytically continued Schwarzschild resonances
ratio of contour integrals
eikonal/geometric description via the Penrose limit about the tidally deformed photon ring
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对外部潮汐近似的适用范围、边界条件和解析延拓共振的处理，以及“物理伴星”情形下主导模频率和衰减变化的符号约定。

papers.title: Simulation Tests of PSF Modeling for Cosmic Shear with the Vera C. Rubin Observatory
authors: the LSST Dark Energy Science Collaboration
papers.abstract: Exceptional control of systematic effects is required in order to achieve unbiased cosmic shear two-point correlation function measurements with the next generation of galaxy imaging surveys, such as the Vera C. Rubin Observatory Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST). One critical challenge is accurately modeling the point-spread function (PSF), as errors in PSF estimation can introduce spatially correlated biases in galaxy shape measurements. The LSST Science Pipelines, which will be used to process Rubin data, include an implementation of the PIFF (PSFs in the Full Field of View) package originally developed for, and demonstrated to perform well on, DES-Y3 and Y6 data. In this work we use semi-realistic image simulations, mimicking LSST observing conditions in $i$-band over 100 square degrees, to perform an end-to-end test of the Rubin PSF modeling pipeline. PSF model residuals are quantified using both second- and fourth-order moment parameters and performance is evaluated, for both LSST year 1 and year 10 depth, with a series of diagnostic tests. We find that the additive bias contribution from PSF modeling errors to the non-tomographic cosmic shear data vector is well below 30% of the cosmic shear uncertainty estimated from our analytic covariance matrix. Though our simulations exclude several known effects that may further challenge PSF modeling, these results demonstrate promising performance from PIFF on LSST-like data and provide an early benchmark for ongoing PSF validation efforts for LSST weak lensing analyses.

analysis.title_zh: Vera C. Rubin 天文台 cosmic shear 点扩散函数建模的模拟测试
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 Rubin/LSST 弱透镜 cosmic shear 对 PSF 建模系统误差的敏感性，使用模拟 LSST i 波段、100 平方度的半真实图像，对 Rubin PSF 建模管线进行端到端测试。摘要报告，在第 1 年和第 10 年深度的诊断中，PSF 建模误差对非 tomographic cosmic shear 数据向量的加性偏差低于解析协方差估计的 cosmic shear 不确定度的 30%，但模拟尚未包含若干已知挑战因素。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然主题是星系弱透镜而非 CMB 本身，但 LSST cosmic shear 是与 CMB lensing、CMB-S4/Simons Observatory 等数据联合约束宇宙学参数的重要低红移探针。PSF 建模误差会影响弱透镜两点函数，从而影响与 CMB 组合时对暗能量、结构增长和物质涨落幅度的解释。
key_points: 用半真实图像模拟检验 Rubin/LSST 的 PSF 建模流程。
以二阶和四阶矩残差诊断 PSF 模型误差。
摘要报告 PSF 建模导致的非分箱 cosmic shear 加性偏差低于解析协方差给出的 cosmic shear 不确定度的 30%。
methods: 半真实图像模拟
模拟 LSST i 波段、100 平方度观测条件
LSST Science Pipelines 中的 PIFF PSF 建模
二阶和四阶矩参数残差诊断
LSST 第 1 年和第 10 年深度评估
解析协方差矩阵
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模拟中排除的已知效应具体有哪些，以及这些缺失效应是否可能改变 PSF 残差对 tomographic cosmic shear 或实际 LSST 系统误差预算的影响。

papers.title: High-Energy Neutrino Constraints on memory burdened Bardeen and Kerr Primordial Black Holes
papers.abstract: The quantum memory burden effect can suppress the late-time Hawking evaporation of primordial black holes (PBHs), allowing PBHs below the standard evaporation threshold of approximately $10^{15}\,\mathrm{g}$ to survive until the present epoch and potentially contribute to the dark matter abundance. We investigate primary and secondary neutrino emission from memory burdened Bardeen and Kerr PBHs, including Galactic and extragalactic fluxes and the effects of memory suppression, Bardeen regularization, and Kerr rotation. We constrain their abundance using observations from IceCube, Super-Kamiokande, and ANTARES, together with the projected sensitivities of IceCube-Gen2, GRAND200k, and Hyper-Kamiokande. We find that Bardeen regularization and Kerr rotation produce qualitatively different effects. Increasing the Bardeen parameter suppresses the Hawking temperature and neutrino flux, thereby weakening the abundance constraints. In contrast, rapidly rotating Kerr PBHs that retain a significant residual spin at the onset of the memory burdened phase can exhibit enhanced neutrino emission and substantially stronger constraints. Increasing the memory burden suppression index $k$ reduces the flux normalization but also allows lighter and hotter PBHs to survive, shifting the relevant signal toward higher energies. Consequently, HESE provides the leading sensitivity for weak suppression, whereas IceCube-Gen2 and GRAND200k become particularly important for stronger suppression. These results demonstrate the complementarity of current and future neutrino observations in probing memory burdened PBHs and the effects of regular geometry and rotation on their evaporation.

analysis.title_zh: 高能中微子对具有记忆负担的 Bardeen 和 Kerr 原初黑洞的约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究量子记忆负担效应可能使低质量原初黑洞延迟 Hawking 蒸发并存活至今的情形，计算带 Bardeen 正则化或 Kerr 旋转的 PBH 原初和次级中微子发射，并用 IceCube、Super-Kamiokande、ANTARES 及未来实验灵敏度约束其丰度。摘要报告称，Bardeen 参数增大会降低温度和通量、削弱约束，而保留显著残余自旋的快速旋转 Kerr PBH 可增强中微子发射并加强约束；抑制指数增大同时降低通量归一化并允许更轻更热 PBH 存活，使信号移向更高能。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: PBH 是暗物质候选之一，其蒸发产物会影响宇宙学和高能多信使约束；若记忆负担改变低质量 PBH 的存活条件，传统 PBH 暗物质排除图需要重估。虽然本文核心观测量是中微子而非 CMB，但它直接关联暗物质丰度、早期宇宙遗迹和 PBH 蒸发物理，是 CMB 宇宙学参数与暗物质模型解释中的背景约束。
key_points: 研究记忆负担效应下低于标准蒸发阈值的 PBH 是否仍可存活并贡献暗物质。
比较 Bardeen 正则化与 Kerr 自旋对 Hawking 中微子通量和丰度约束的不同影响。
使用当前与未来高能中微子实验约束这类 PBH 丰度。
methods: 原初与次级中微子发射计算
银河系与河外中微子通量
记忆负担抑制、Bardeen 正则化、Kerr 旋转效应建模
IceCube、Super-Kamiokande、ANTARES 观测
IceCube-Gen2、GRAND200k、Hyper-Kamiokande 预期灵敏度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对记忆负担抑制指数、残余自旋与 Bardeen 参数如何进入蒸发历史和中微子谱计算，以及当前/未来实验约束是否依赖特定背景建模或能区选择。

papers.title: Diversity of Galaxy Centers from Small-Scale Isocurvature
papers.abstract: The observed diversity of galaxy centers motivates the possibility that the local dark matter composition may vary among galaxies. In conventional multicomponent dark matter scenarios, however, large stochastic variations in the relative abundances are not generically expected, with the cold component typically remaining dominant. We perform $N$-body simulations with a subdominant ultralight dark matter component carrying significant large-amplitude small-scale isocurvature perturbations. We find that although nonlinear evolution largely homogenizes its fraction on galactic scales,ultralight dark matter can still be enhanced and even dominate the centers of small halos because large initial ultralight dark matter fluctuations seed early potential wells that later form halo centers. The ultralight-dominated region can extend beyond $0.01R_{\rm vir}$ and account for more than half of the central dark matter density, even for a cosmological ultralight dark matter fraction below $O(10\%)$. This central segregation provides a possible route to stochastic cusp--core diversity, potentially explaining the observed diversity of galaxy centers.

analysis.title_zh: 小尺度等曲率扰动导致的星系中心多样性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对星系中心观测多样性，研究带有显著小尺度等曲率扰动的次主导超轻暗物质组分能否在局域改变暗物质组成。摘要称 N 体模拟发现，虽然非线性演化会在星系尺度上大体均匀化其比例，但早期超轻暗物质涨落可播种势阱并成为后来的晕中心，使小晕中心出现超轻暗物质富集甚至主导。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 等曲率扰动是 CMB 对早期宇宙和暗物质初始条件的重要约束对象；该文关注的是小尺度等曲率及其对星系中心结构的影响，连接了 CMB 初始扰动约束、暗物质微物理和小尺度结构问题。对 CMB 读者而言，关键在于这种小尺度等曲率设定是否能避开或满足现有 CMB 与大尺度结构限制。
key_points: 探讨小尺度等曲率扰动是否能造成星系中心暗物质组成的随机差异。
N 体模拟显示非线性演化会在星系尺度上趋于均匀化，但星系晕中心仍可富集超轻暗物质。
该机制被提出作为星系中心 cusp-core 多样性的可能来源。
methods: N 体模拟
包含次主导超轻暗物质组分的多组分暗物质模型
大振幅小尺度等曲率扰动
小质量晕中心暗物质分布分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对初始小尺度等曲率扰动的设定是否与 CMB 和大尺度结构约束相容，以及 N 体模拟是否充分处理超轻暗物质的波动/量子压力效应。

papers.title: The Random Magnetic Field of the Milky Way
papers.abstract: We constrain the large-scale isotropic random component of the Galactic magnetic field using the Planck reconstruction of the 408 MHz synchrotron sky. Our analysis simultaneously fits the random-field structure, the synchrotron contributions of the coherent field and local foregrounds, and isotropic and dipolar offsets. A new element of the analysis is the use of excess polarized emission at 30 GHz to model local foregrounds, allowing us to retain 97% of the sky without absorbing these structures into Galaxy-wide features of the magnetic field. Across variations in the coherent-field model, cosmic-ray electron distribution, sky mask, and field profile, we consistently find that the dominant random-field component is a vertically compact disk with a local rms strength of about 4 $μ$G and a 1/e scale height of approximately 1 kpc, substantially thinner than in most previous models. An annular enhancement in the inner Galaxy improves the fit to the data, whereas we find no evidence for either a large-scale spiral pattern or a thick random-field disk. The fits also yield an intensity monopole of 4-7 K, whose possible origin we discuss. We quantify the implications of the inferred random field for the angular smearing of ultrahigh-energy cosmic rays. Compared with previous models, the sky-median smearing angle is smaller by up to a factor of 1.7, and by up to 2.4 in individual directions.

analysis.title_zh: 银河系的随机磁场
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Planck 重建的 408 MHz 同步辐射天图约束银河系大尺度各向同性随机磁场，并同时拟合相干磁场贡献、本地前景以及单极和偶极偏置。摘要报告称，主导随机磁场分量是垂直方向较紧致的盘，本地 rms 强度约 4 μG、1/e 标高约 1 kpc，且不支持大尺度螺旋图样或厚随机场盘。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 银河同步辐射和磁场模型是 CMB 前景建模的核心组成，尤其影响低频偏振、尘埃/同步辐射分离以及大尺度偏振系统误差评估。该文用 Planck 相关重建和 30 GHz 偏振信息改进银河随机磁场约束，对 CMB B 模式和大尺度偏振前景分析具有直接参考价值。
key_points: 利用 Planck 对 408 MHz 同步辐射天图的重建约束银河系大尺度各向同性随机磁场。
模型同时拟合随机磁场结构、相干磁场同步辐射、本地前景以及各向同性和偶极偏置。
摘要称主要随机磁场是垂直方向较薄的盘，并讨论其对超高能宇宙线角向弥散的影响。
methods: Planck reconstruction of the 408 MHz synchrotron sky
30 GHz 过量偏振辐射用于建模本地前景
同步拟合随机磁场结构、相干场同步辐射、本地前景、各向同性和偶极偏置
改变相干场模型、宇宙线电子分布、天区掩膜和磁场轮廓进行稳健性检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 Planck 408 MHz 同步辐射重建和 30 GHz 过量偏振前景模板的构造方式，确认本地结构没有被错误地从银河尺度随机磁场中剥离或吸收；同时检查各向同性单极 4-7 K 的来源解释与 CMB/射电背景分析的兼容性。

papers.title: The [Ne V] AGN Diagnostic in SDSS-IV/eBOSS: An Anticorrelation Between Ionization State and AGN Luminosity in Low-Redshift Coronal-Line Galaxies
papers.abstract: Traditional narrow-line diagnostics fail at high redshift, where low metallicity drives star-forming galaxies and Active Galactic Nuclei (AGN) into overlapping regions of the Baldwin-Phillips-Terlevich (BPT) diagram. Coronal lines, with ionization potentials exceeding 100 eV, offer a robust alternative: they cannot be produced by normal stellar populations, arise almost exclusively from AGN or fast shocks, and are insensitive to abundance evolution. Among these, the [Ne V] doublet is the brightest optical coronal line tracer of AGN activity. Existing coronal line catalogs contain only about 1750 objects, too few to statistically assess the completeness and purity of [Ne V]-selected AGN samples. We identify 33,817 galaxies with [Ne V] S/N > 5 at z = 0.147-1.12 in the Sloan Digital Sky Survey IV extended Baryon Oscillations Spectroscopic Survey (SDSS-IV/eBOSS), exceeding the combined literature total by more than an order of magnitude. [Ne V] preferentially selects rapidly accreting, relatively unobscured AGN; only 41.5% of BPT AGN show detectable emission. By stacking spectra that lack [Ne V] on a grid of black hole mass and [O III] luminosity, we recover [Ne V] in the majority of bins, implying that non-detections reflect limited survey sensitivity rather than a deficit of coronal emission. We find [Ne V]/[Ne III] is only weakly correlated with [O III]/[O II]. Galaxies with high [Ne V]/[Ne III] for their [O III]/[O II] ratio have lower Eddington ratios and are more likely classified as LIERs or Composites. The [Ne V]/[O III] ratio shows a strong anticorrelation with [O III] luminosity, with the most extreme coronal-line strengths found among the lowest-luminosity AGN, in analogy with the accretion states of stellar-mass black holes. Comparison with a sample of z=2-9 [Ne V]-detected galaxies suggests some, but not all, high-redshift AGN follow the same relations.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 16 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to The Open Journal of Astrophysics. For the eBOSS-DAP catalog and associated data products, see https://datalab.noirlab.edu/data/sdss#sdss-iv-eboss-dap-value-added-catalog ; for the eBOSS-DAP source code, see https://github.com/owenmatthewsa/ebossdap

analysis.title_zh: SDSS-IV/eBOSS 中的 [Ne V] AGN 诊断：低红移冕线星系中电离状态与 AGN 光度的反相关
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 SDSS-IV/eBOSS 光谱识别 z=0.147-1.12 的 [Ne V] 发射星系，评估 [Ne V] 冕线作为 AGN 诊断的完备性、选择偏好和物理关联。摘要报告样本包含 33,817 个 [Ne V] S/N > 5 星系，[Ne V] 倾向选择快速吸积且相对无遮挡的 AGN，并发现 [Ne V]/[O III] 与 [O III] 光度强反相关。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于星系与 AGN 光谱诊断，并非 CMB 前景或基础宇宙学的直接问题。其间接相关性在于高红移 AGN 识别会影响星系演化、再电离源族和大尺度结构示踪体研究，但对 CMB 分析本身的直接影响有限。
key_points: 构建了一个 SDSS-IV/eBOSS 低红移 [Ne V] 星系样本，用于评估 [Ne V] 作为 AGN 诊断的表现。
[Ne V] 更偏向选择快速吸积、相对无遮挡的 AGN，未探测到 [Ne V] 的情况常与巡天灵敏度有关。
摘要报告 [Ne V]/[O III] 与 [O III] 光度强反相关，并与恒星级黑洞吸积态作类比。
methods: SDSS-IV/eBOSS 光谱数据
[Ne V] S/N > 5 样本选择
BPT 窄线诊断比较
按黑洞质量和 [O III] 光度网格叠加无 [Ne V] 光谱
与 z=2-9 的 [Ne V] 探测星系样本比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 [Ne V] 选样的完备性和纯度估计，特别是快激波污染、选择函数、信噪比阈值以及叠加谱恢复 [Ne V] 时的系统误差；若用于高红移 AGN 研究，还需检查低红移关系外推的适用性。

papers.title: Model independent lensing sub-structure detection with multiply-imaged star clusters constellations
papers.abstract: A broad class of dark matter (DM) models predicts the existence of sub-structures residing in DM haloes on sub-resolvable angular scales. Techniques to extract such a generic feature from diffraction-limited observations are lacking. In this work, we propose a model-independent 'super-resolving' method applicable to strong gravitational lens systems that is fully data-driven, without reference to any lens models. This method relies on a specific way of applying the optical Liouville theorem across multiple scales in the imaging data, a technique we refer to as geometrical-duality. We test this method using realistic simulations and apply it to a 'constellation' consists of 11 compact star clusters seen in two giant arcs in the lensing cluster SMACS0723 imaged by JWST as a proof-of-concept. We find reasonable self-consistency with the expectation of non-detection given the statistical sensitivity, except for one pair of star clusters. Such an outlier can be explained in the context of CDM as sub-haloes lensing in the mass range $M_{\rm sub} = 10^8 - 10^9\,M_\odot$, for which the corresponding Einstein radius is smaller than the diffraction limit of JWST.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 9 figures (+3 extra figures in the appendix)

analysis.title_zh: 利用多重成像星团星座进行模型无关的透镜子结构探测
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对暗物质晕中低于角分辨率的子结构探测，提出一种适用于强透镜系统、无需透镜模型的数据驱动“超分辨”方法。摘要称其经现实模拟测试，并在 JWST 观测的 SMACS0723 中 11 个多重成像紧致星团组成的“星座”上作概念验证，整体与统计灵敏度下的非探测预期相符，但有一对星团可用 CDM 中 10^8–10^9 M_⊙ 子晕透镜解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质小尺度子结构约束直接关系到冷暗物质及替代理论的可检验性，是与 CMB 给出的早期宇宙参数互补的晚期结构形成探针。若该类方法能稳健绕开宏观透镜模型不确定性，将有助于把 JWST 强透镜数据转化为对小尺度功率谱和暗物质性质的约束。
key_points: 提出不依赖透镜质量模型的数据驱动“超分辨”子结构探测方法。
方法基于在成像数据多尺度上应用光学刘维尔定理，作者称为几何对偶。
JWST/SMACS0723 的概念验证总体与非探测预期自洽，但有一对星团离群。

光学刘维尔定理
几何对偶方法
现实模拟

papers.title: Physical Calibration of a Minimal Effective Field Theory of the Three-Dimensional Lyman-$α$ Forest
papers.abstract: We study a minimal effective field theory description of the three-dimensional Lyman-$α$ forest using the Sherwood and Sherwood--Relics hydrodynamical simulations. We model the Lyman-$α$ flux auto-power spectrum and its cross-correlation power spectrum with the dark matter density field using a tree-level bias model supplemented by the leading counterterms and stochastic contributions. We find that the model describes the simulated auto- and cross-power spectra well up to $k_{\mathrm{max}}=3\,h\,{\rm Mpc}^{-1}$ and $k_{\mathrm{max}}=2\,h\,{\rm Mpc}^{-1}$, respectively. We analyse simulations spanning multiple redshifts, reionisation histories, box sizes and resolutions to assess the robustness of the model. Even within this minimal model, we find strong parameter degeneracies, highlighting the need for independent constraints on nuisance parameters in applications to real data analyses. The redshift evolution of the linear bias parameters is consistent with previous simulation-based studies and is driven primarily by the evolution of the effective optical depth, $τ_{\mathrm{eff}}$. We also find that the inferred parameters are affected by the resolution of the simulation and, to a lesser extent, by the simulation box size. We also explore the impact of reionisation history, finding that variations mainly affect the linear bias parameters over the range of scales considered. Moreover, we find empirical correlations between model parameters and the Lyman-$α$ forest density bias that show some scatter, indicating that one single parameter is not enough to determine the model parameters. Finally, we compare our results with theoretical predictions from analytical models of the Lyman-$α$ forest.

analysis.title_zh: 三维 Lyman-α 森林最小有效场论的物理校准
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Sherwood 与 Sherwood--Relics 流体模拟校准三维 Lyman-α 森林的最小有效场论模型，拟合通量自功率谱及其与暗物质密度场的互功率谱。摘要报告该模型在给定最大波数范围内能较好描述模拟结果，但存在强参数简并，且推断参数受有效光学深度演化、模拟分辨率、盒子大小和再电离历史影响。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Lyman-α 森林是高红移大尺度结构和小尺度物质功率谱的重要探针，可与 CMB 对初始涨落、暗物质性质和再电离历史的约束互补。摘要中特别指出 nuisance 参数简并和再电离历史影响，这些都是把 Lyman-α 数据与 CMB 联合分析时必须控制的系统误差来源。
key_points: 建立三维 Lyman-α 森林的最小有效场论描述并进行物理校准。
使用 Sherwood 与 Sherwood--Relics 流体模拟检验自功率谱及其与暗物质密度的互功率谱。
摘要强调参数简并、模拟分辨率和再电离历史对推断参数的影响。

papers.title: Resonance crossings as entire functions of the Koopman operator
papers.abstract: Astrophysical binaries formed by a stellar-mass compact object and a massive black hole are among the most promising sources for future space-based gravitational-wave detectors. These extreme mass-ratio inspiral (EMRI) systems are tracked coherently over more than $10^{5}$ orbits, encoding detailed information about strong-field gravity. Translating a detection into physical parameters requires models of comparable precision. One outstanding difficulty is the treatment of transient orbital resonances. In this work we address the problem at the level of the Koopman operator, where the waveform is promoted to an observable and the evolution over one radial cycle is a linear operator. Removing the fast timescale without a singularity at a crossing is then a matter of choosing a function of that operator. We demonstrate the approach on a Kerr geodesic driven through the 3:2 crossing by a modelled forcing term. There the coefficient of the standard near-identity transformation diverges, while the finite-window generator attains its analytic bound to better than one part in $10^{6}$. Averaging over twice the crossing duration recovers the resonant jump with its predicted magnitude and phase dependence.

analysis.title_zh: 作为 Koopman 算符整函数的共振穿越
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对极端质量比旋近系统中瞬时轨道共振难以精确建模的问题，把波形作为 Koopman 算符的 observable，并将去除快速时标的问题转化为选择该算符的函数。摘要报告，在受模型化外力驱动的 Kerr 测地线 3:2 共振穿越例子中，标准近恒等变换系数发散，而有限窗口生成元保持受控，并可通过跨越平均恢复预测的共振跃迁幅度和相位依赖。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要面向引力波和强场相对论建模，而非 CMB 本身；但它涉及未来空间引力波探测对黑洞系统参数的高精度反演。对宇宙学读者而言，其相关性在于多信使宇宙学和强引力检验可能与 CMB 对引力理论、黑洞种群和宇宙结构形成的约束形成互补。
key_points: 将 EMRI 瞬时轨道共振问题表述为 Koopman 算符上的函数选择问题。
在受模型化外力驱动的 Kerr 测地线 3:2 共振穿越上演示方法。
摘要称有限窗口生成元保持有限并达到解析界，跨越平均可恢复共振跃迁的幅度和相位依赖。

papers.title: Ultra-Deep imaging of the starless galaxy candidate Cloud-9
papers.abstract: We report the non-detection of stellar light associated with the dark galaxy candidate Cloud-9. Ultra-deep imaging obtained with HiPERCAM at the Gran Telescopio Canarias (GTC) reaches surface-brightness limits of 31.4 and 31.0 mag/arcsec$^2$ in g and r, respectively, approximately ten times deeper than previous deep imaging of the region. No stellar emission is detected within the central 1'$\times$1' ($\sim$1.3$\times$1.3 kpc) region of Cloud-9. Assuming an old, metal-poor stellar population, these limits imply a stellar surface mass density of no more than $\sim$0.01 M$_\odot$/pc$^2$ and an upper limit on the total stellar mass of 1.6$\times$10$^4$ M$_\odot$. This independent constraint from integrated light complements previous limits based on resolved-star counts and strengthens the case for Cloud-9 as a candidate starless galaxy.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Research Notes of the American Astronomical Society

analysis.title_zh: 无星星系候选体 Cloud-9 的超深成像
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 GTC/HiPERCAM 对暗星系候选体 Cloud-9 进行超深成像，寻找与其相关的恒星光。摘要报告在中心约 1.3×1.3 kpc 区域未探测到恒星发射，并给出很低的恒星表面质量密度和总恒星质量上限，从而加强其作为无星星系候选体的证据。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作不直接涉及 CMB，但与宇宙学中的小尺度结构、暗物质晕内重子形成效率和“暗星系”问题相关；这些问题可与 CMB 所约束的整体宇宙学模型和暗物质框架形成互补检验。
key_points: 对暗星系候选体 Cloud-9 进行超深成像并未探测到恒星光。
给出 g、r 波段表面亮度极限和恒星质量上限。
结果支持 Cloud-9 作为无星星系候选体，但依据摘要仍是候选而非最终确认。

papers.title: Probing cosmological phase transitions with SKAO through nano-Hz gravitational-wave portal
papers.abstract: The recent evidence for a stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background at nano-Hz frequencies from pulsar timing arrays (PTAs) provides a strong science case for exploring cosmological histories and phase transitions at the Square Kilometer Array Observatory (SKAO). The latter cosmological events are of primary interest for physics of the early Universe associated with out-of-equilibrium and relaxation phenomena in the vicinity the quantum chromodynamics (QCD) epoch as well as those originating from dark sectors or other phenomena beyond the Standard Model of particle physics. Such a novel GW portal provides a complimentary access to particle physics phenomena that have so far escaped detection at particle colliders, and also probes fundamental aspects of out-of-equilibrium dynamics beyond the perturbation theory and their cosmological implications. This chapter aims at elucidating most interesting physics cases, theoretical models and approaches, as well as cosmological scenarios that are of particular relevance for future GW measurements at SKAO. We elaborate on how such measurements can deepen our understanding of particle interactions and violent processes in the early Universe, and discuss possible competitive advantages and complementarity of SKAO in this research compared to other experiments.
papers.comment: Published in Advancing Astrophysics with the SKA II (AASKAII), 2026 (arXiv:2606.20366). Report-no: AASKAII/Pasechnik01. Advancing Astrophysics with the SKA II (AASKAII) outlines the transformative scientific advances that will be enabled by the SKA telescopes

analysis.title_zh: 通过纳赫兹引力波门户用 SKAO 探测宇宙学相变
analysis.summary_zh: 本文围绕 PTA 已报告的纳赫兹随机引力波背景证据，讨论 SKAO 探测早期宇宙相变和非平衡过程的科学潜力。摘要称文章将梳理相关物理案例、理论模型、宇宙学情景，以及 SKAO 相对其他实验的优势与互补性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然这篇文章不直接处理 CMB 数据，但早期宇宙相变、QCD 时期动力学和暗部门都会影响宇宙热史；纳赫兹引力波为 CMB 之外的早期宇宙探针，可与 CMB 对辐射成分、相变遗迹和新物理的限制形成互补。

摘要表明文章偏综述/章节性质，强调与其他实验的互补性。

papers.title: Anomaly-free axion-like particle in Nelson-Barr models
papers.abstract: We study Nelson--Barr models with a discrete $Z_N$ symmetry that solve the strong CP problem through spontaneous CP violation, and show that they naturally predict a light axion-like particle (ALP) without introducing any additional ingredients. Unlike the QCD axion, this ALP is anomaly-free: its couplings to photons and gluons are highly suppressed, rendering it naturally long-lived. Instead, it couples to quarks through flavor-violating interactions whose structure is dictated by the CKM matrix. These interactions induce rare meson decays, providing a unique probe of the Nelson--Barr mechanism. We study the cosmological production of the ALP through both freeze-in and misalignment mechanisms. We show that the parameter space in which the observed relic abundance is explained by the freeze-in mechanism is subject to stringent constraints from precision flavor experiments and stellar cooling bounds from SN1987A, leaving only a small viable region that will be comprehensively tested by future structure-formation observations such as the Vera Rubin Observatory and next-generation X-ray missions like Athena, GECCO and THESEUS. In contrast, misalignment production remains a robust and viable mechanism for explaining the observed dark matter abundance over a broad region of parameter space. Our results demonstrate that precision flavor measurements, cosmological observations, and X-ray searches provide complementary probes of this anomaly-free ALP and, consequently, of the Nelson--Barr solution to the strong CP problem.

analysis.title_zh: Nelson-Barr 模型中的无反常类轴子粒子
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究带离散 Z_N 对称性的 Nelson-Barr 模型，指出其在自发 CP 破缺解决强 CP 问题的同时可自然预言一种轻的、无反常的类轴子粒子。摘要报告，该粒子可通过 freeze-in 或 misalignment 产生暗物质丰度，其中 freeze-in 区域受味物理、SN1987A 和未来结构形成/X 射线观测强约束，而 misalignment 在较宽参数空间内仍可行。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 类轴子粒子和暗物质产生机制是 CMB/宇宙学的重要外延主题，因为其遗迹丰度、寿命、结构形成影响和可能的辐射信号都可能与 CMB 推断的暗物质性质相互约束。摘要未声称直接使用 CMB 数据，但提到未来结构形成观测和 X 射线搜索，可与 CMB 的暗物质丰度及小尺度结构约束形成互补。
key_points: Nelson-Barr 模型中的离散 Z_N 对称性可自然给出轻的 anomaly-free ALP。
该 ALP 与光子和胶子的耦合被高度压低，主要通过 CKM 结构规定的味变夸克相互作用受限。
freeze-in 解释遗迹丰度的参数空间受到味物理、SN1987A 和未来结构形成/X 射线观测约束；misalignment 在更宽区域内可行。

papers.title: A Dark Matter Masquerade: Degeneracies in Black Hole and Accretion Inference from X-ray Reflection Measurements and Prospects for Compact Dark Matter Halo Constraints
papers.abstract: X-ray reflection spectroscopy is an established probe of black hole (BH) spin and accretion geometry, and many studies have examined its systematic uncertainties. In this work, we explore a possible environmental effect associated with compact dark matter (DM) halos. We adopt numerical BH-DM spacetimes and perform general-relativistic ray-tracing calculations to generate broadened Fe\, K$α$ line profiles. For the configurations studied here, compact DM halos shift the lines toward lower observed energies relative to their Kerr counterparts. We fit the simulated profiles with standard Kerr models and find that the inferred spin and inclination can differ from their input values; in some cases, the spin is overestimated. These results suggest that compact DM halos may introduce an additional uncertainty in reflection-based measurements. Conversely, reflection models that include the environment could ultimately help constrain key halo parameters, such as its mass and characteristic scale, complementing gravitational-wave probes.

analysis.title_zh: 暗物质伪装：由 X 射线反射测量推断黑洞与吸积时的退化，以及约束紧致暗物质晕的前景
analysis.summary_zh: 本文考察紧致暗物质晕这一环境效应是否会影响基于 X 射线反射谱的黑洞自旋和吸积几何推断。摘要报告，作者用数值黑洞-暗物质时空和广义相对论射线追踪生成 Fe Kα 线轮廓，并发现相对 Kerr 模型谱线可向低观测能量移动，用标准 Kerr 模型拟合会使自旋和倾角推断产生偏差。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章与 CMB 的联系在于暗物质分布和紧致晕的天体物理约束，而不是直接的早期宇宙观测。若黑洞附近暗物质环境能通过 X 射线反射或引力波被约束，它可补充 CMB 对暗物质总丰度和大尺度性质的约束，并帮助检验暗物质在小尺度强引力环境中的行为。
key_points: 研究紧致暗物质晕对 X 射线反射谱黑洞自旋和吸积几何推断的系统影响。
数值 BH-DM 时空与广义相对论射线追踪显示，所研究构型下 Fe Kα 线相对 Kerr 情形向较低观测能量移动。
用标准 Kerr 模型拟合模拟谱线会导致自旋和倾角偏离输入值，某些情况下自旋被高估。
