papers.title: Qubits for Dark Matter Hunting
papers.abstract: An introductory review is provided for those who are interested in exploring applications of qubits and other quantum excitations to the detection of dark matter (and any other physics beyond the Standard Model). Topics covered include the fundamental properties of qubits, the excitation mechanism of qubits due to the electric field induced by dark matter (with attention to the effects of the coherence of dark matter), the dynamics of coupled qubit-cavity systems modeled by the Jaynes-Cummings framework, and the influence of noise and decoherence (especially Markovian noise described by the Lindblad equation). In addition, the article introduces essential concepts in quantum sensing, including the operator-sum representation and positive operator-valued measures, the Cramér-Rao bound, the standard quantum limit and the Heisenberg limit, and the potential enhancement of sensitivity to dark matter achievable with entangled states. Throughout, these topics are discussed with particular emphasis on their application to the detection of wave-like dark matter.

analysis.title_zh: 用于搜寻暗物质的量子比特
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于用量子比特和其他量子激发探测暗物质及标准模型之外物理的入门综述，重点面向波状暗物质。摘要称文章介绍量子比特基本性质、暗物质诱导电场导致的激发、耦合量子比特-腔动力学、噪声退相干以及量子传感灵敏度界限和纠缠增强。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文不直接研究 CMB 数据，但暗物质性质是 CMB 宇宙学参数解释和早期宇宙物理的核心组成部分。量子传感若能拓展波状暗物质的实验搜索，将为 CMB 对暗物质丰度和相互作用的间接约束提供互补检验。
key_points: 面向量子比特探测波状暗物质的入门综述。
讨论暗物质诱导电场激发量子比特以及暗物质相干性的影响。
涵盖量子传感、噪声退相干和纠缠态增强灵敏度等概念。
methods: 量子比特与其他量子激发的综述性讨论
Jaynes-Cummings 框架建模耦合量子比特-腔系统
Lindblad 方程描述 Markovian 噪声
算符和表示、POVM、Cramér-Rao 界、标准量子极限与 Heisenberg 极限
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其暗物质诱导电场与量子比特激发机制的适用假设，尤其是波状暗物质相干性、噪声模型和纠缠增强灵敏度之间的关系是否被清楚限定。

papers.title: Causal Gravitational-Wave Production Does Not Generate Infrared Adiabatic Curvature
papers.abstract: Short tensor modes can generate a white noise contribution to the local scalar $K=8πGρ/3-θ^2/9$, but this does not induce an infrared-enhanced adiabatic curvature spectrum. For a conserved causal source, analyticity of the longitudinal velocity correlator requires $P_V=\mathcal O(k^2)$, hence $P_{\mathcal R}=\mathcal O(k^0)$ and $Δ_{\mathcal R}^2=\mathcal O(k^3)$, excluding the $Δ_{\mathcal R}^2\propto k^{-1}$ relic. We also construct a conserved conversion of radiation into gravitational waves: the white field resides in a compensated entropy mode, and the fluid response cancels the slowly decaying $a^{-2}$ relic. Adiabatic bounds on such sources are therefore source- and matching-dependent.

analysis.title_zh: 因果引力波产生不会生成红外绝热曲率
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论短波张量扰动或因果引力波源是否会生成红外增强的绝热曲率扰动。摘要给出的解析论证认为，对守恒因果源，纵向速度相关函数的解析性排除了 Δ_R^2∝k^{-1} 的遗迹；其构造例子中白噪声场表现为补偿熵模而非绝热曲率。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初曲率扰动的红外行为直接关系到 CMB 大角尺度各向异性和早期宇宙源项的初始条件设定；若因果引力波源不能普遍生成红外增强的绝热曲率，就会限制用此类机制解释大尺度 CMB 信号或约束早期相变、缺陷等源的方式。
key_points: 因果守恒源下，纵向速度相关函数的解析性要求低 k 标度受限。
短波张量模可给局域标量 K 贡献白噪声，但摘要称不会产生红外增强的绝热曲率谱。
构造的辐射到引力波守恒转换中，白场位于补偿熵模，流体响应抵消慢衰减遗迹。
methods: 解析低 k 标度论证
守恒因果源条件
纵向速度相关函数解析性
构造辐射向引力波的守恒转换模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对其“守恒因果源”假设、匹配条件以及从 P_V=O(k^2) 推到 P_R=O(k^0) 的规范与变量定义，确认结论适用的源类型边界。

papers.title: One-point matter PDFs beyond TopHat filters
papers.abstract: We study the one-point probability distribution function (PDF) for matter densities averaged with an arbitrary spherically symmetric window function. The PDF is analytically modeled within the path integral framework, enabling a non-perturbative description of large-scale structure. It contains a leading order contribution controlled by the spherically symmetric gravitational collapse dynamics, as well as an order-one factor arising from aspherical fluctuations. We develop a numerical pipeline to compute the leading spherical-collapse part of the PDF and apply it to a family of window functions interpolating between the TopHat and Gaussian filters in coordinate space, as well as to a window function with non-monotonic radial dependence. We find that the PDF weakly depends on the choice of the filter, provided the width of the filter is normalized to yield a fixed linear averaged density variance. For each filter and each value of the averaged density, our pipeline gives the most probable density profile. We find that these profiles vastly differ for different filters in the case of overdensities, but closely follow a universal curve at underdensities. We obtain a perturbative expression for the aspherical part of the PDF valid at small density contrasts. We find from it that all PDFs are equally sensitive to the effective field theory (EFT) corrections accounting for short-scale clustering, regardless of how smooth the filter's boundary is. We test our PDF model against the results of high-resolution N-body simulations. The agreement is excellent for filters with widths larger than 10 Mpc/h. Small discrepancies at a few percent level arise for narrower filters and are interpreted as higher-order perturbative corrections.

analysis.title_zh: 超越 TopHat 滤波器的一点物质概率分布函数
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究用任意球对称窗口函数平均后的物质密度一点评价 PDF，并在路径积分框架下给出包含球对称塌缩主导项和非球对称涨落因子的非微扰模型。摘要称，在固定线性平均密度方差归一化后 PDF 对滤波器选择依赖较弱，但最概然密度剖面在过密区随滤波器显著变化、在欠密区趋于普适；模型与高分辨率 N 体模拟在大于 10 Mpc/h 的滤波宽度上符合很好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 物质密度一点评价 PDF 是大尺度结构非高斯信息的压缩统计量，可连接早期 CMB 给出的初始涨落与晚期非线性结构形成。对 CMB/宇宙学读者而言，这类统计可用于补充两点函数约束，并帮助理解弱透镜、星系巡天和 CMB 透镜重建中滤波选择与短尺度 EFT 修正带来的系统效应。
key_points: 将一点评价的物质密度 PDF 推广到任意球对称窗口函数，而不限于 TopHat 滤波。
路径积分框架中，主导项由球对称引力塌缩控制，非球对称涨落给出阶一因子。
与高分辨率 N 体模拟比较后，摘要称宽度大于 10 Mpc/h 的滤波器符合很好，较窄滤波器有百分之几差异。
methods: 路径积分解析建模
球对称引力塌缩动力学
任意球对称窗口函数
TopHat 与 Gaussian 滤波之间插值的窗口函数族
非单调径向窗口函数
非球对称 PDF 部分的小密度反差微扰表达式
有效场论修正分析
高分辨率 N 体模拟检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对窗口宽度归一化到固定线性平均密度方差的定义、非球对称因子的近似范围、EFT 修正的具体参数化，以及与 N 体模拟比较时的尺度、红移和协方差处理。

papers.title: On what scales does strong lensing robustly constrain the mass profile of low-mass perturbers?
papers.abstract: Galaxy-galaxy strong gravitational lensing is an established method to detect and characterise low-mass haloes, which are otherwise too faint to be directly observed. Recent analyses have shown empirically that there exists a characteristic radius within which the projected enclosed mass of these haloes can be robustly measured. Here we provide a physically and mathematically motivated definition of this robust radius based on the Fisher information matrix. We show that for any spherically symmetric smooth profile with at least two free parameters, there exists a pivot radius at which estimates of the projected mass become decorrelated from the local logarithmic slope and have minimum relative uncertainty. As a result, the projected mass within this radius can be recovered consistently by any profile that fits the data well enough. This robust radius coincides, to leading order, with the weighted geometric mean of the arc pixel distances from the halo, where the weights depend on the perturber deflection angle, the macro-model magnification, and the source surface brightness gradient. Beyond leading order, corrections are of order the weighted log-width of the arc. The data constraining power on the local properties of the halo profile beyond amplitude is shown to depend on the radial leverage of the arc around the perturber, and on the imprint of the perturber deflection angle on high signal-to-noise-ratio pixels. Our definition generalises to both subhaloes and line-of-sight haloes and naturally captures the important physical aspects of the problem and the effect of the data resolution and signal-to-noise ratio.

analysis.title_zh: 强透镜在何种尺度上能稳健约束低质量扰动体的质量轮廓？
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究星系-星系强透镜中低质量晕质量轮廓在哪些尺度上能被稳健约束，并用 Fisher 信息矩阵给出稳健半径的物理和数学定义。摘要称，对任意至少含两个自由参数的球对称平滑轮廓，都存在一个使投影质量估计与局部对数斜率去相关且相对不确定度最小的 pivot radius，其主导近似对应弧像素到扰动体距离的加权几何平均。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 低质量暗物质晕和子结构的强透镜探测是检验冷暗物质及替代理论小尺度结构的重要途径，间接影响宇宙学模型中的暗物质性质约束。虽然它不直接处理 CMB 数据，但与 CMB 给出的早期宇宙参数和暗物质模型在小尺度结构预言上互补。
key_points: 用 Fisher 信息矩阵定义强透镜低质量扰动体质量约束的“稳健半径”。
球对称且至少含两个自由参数的平滑质量轮廓存在一个 pivot radius，使投影包围质量与局部对数斜率去相关。
稳健半径的主导近似由弧像素到扰动体距离的加权几何平均给出，权重包含偏折角、宏模型放大率和源表面亮度梯度。
methods: 星系-星系强引力透镜建模
Fisher 信息矩阵
球对称平滑质量轮廓的投影包围质量分析
对弧像素距离的加权几何平均近似
适用于子晕和视线方向晕的推广
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Fisher 矩阵推导中对球对称、平滑轮廓和参数数目的假设，以及“拟合数据足够好”这一条件如何限制不同质量轮廓之间的可比性。

papers.title: Tunneling from a Slowly Rolling Multifield Background Using Tadpole Subtraction
papers.abstract: We study semiclassical tunneling in scalar field theories with slowly evolving homogeneous backgrounds. We formulate the problem by combining tadpole subtraction with an adiabatic expansion: the former maps the rolling system to an instantaneous multi-field tunneling problem, while the latter systematically tracks the slow evolution of the background. This formulation is particularly useful for tunneling during slow-roll inflation, where the tunneling direction may be transverse to the rolling inflaton direction. For a time-reflection-symmetric bounce on a fixed on-shell geometry, we show that the real tunneling exponent receives no direct correction linear in the rolling velocity. The tunneling rate nevertheless drifts along the rolling trajectory because the frozen tadpole-subtracted potential evolves. We also find that the exponent approaches a finite but nonanalytic limit as the tangential curvature vanishes, suggesting that a weakly tachyonic tangential direction can yield an exponent of the same order.

analysis.title_zh: 使用 Tadpole Subtraction 研究缓慢滚动多场背景中的隧穿
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究缓慢演化的均匀多标量场背景中的半经典隧穿，方法是把 tadpole subtraction 与绝热展开结合，将滚动系统映射为瞬时多场隧穿问题。摘要报告，在固定 on-shell 几何上的时间反射对称 bounce 中，实隧穿指数没有滚动速度的一阶直接修正，但隧穿率会因冻结后的有效势沿滚动轨迹演化而漂移。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 多场慢滚动暴胀中的真空跃迁会影响暴胀历史、初始条件和可能的宇宙泡结构，从而间接关联 CMB 各向异性、非高斯性或张量扰动等早期宇宙观测。该文偏理论方法，适合关注暴胀模型构造和相变/隧穿效应的读者。
key_points: 将 tadpole subtraction 与绝热展开结合，处理缓慢滚动背景中的半经典隧穿。
在固定 on-shell 几何和时间反射对称 bounce 下，实隧穿指数没有与滚动速度线性相关的直接修正。
隧穿率仍会随滚动轨迹漂移，因为冻结的 tadpole-subtracted 势随时间演化。
methods: 半经典隧穿分析
tadpole subtraction
绝热展开
瞬时多场隧穿问题构造
固定 on-shell 几何上的时间反射对称 bounce
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“无滚动速度线性直接修正”的适用条件，特别是固定 on-shell 几何、时间反射对称 bounce、慢滚动和多场势形状等假设是否限制了暴胀场景中的应用。

papers.title: Imaging the vacuum fluctuations of a quantum field
papers.abstract: Heisenberg uncertainties lead to inevitable fluctuations in the measurement outcomes for quantum-mechanical observables. For quantum fields, these uncertainties result in random spatial structures in snapshots of a field, even when the field is in its ground (vacuum) state. Such `vacuum fluctuations' are at the heart of a wide range of phenomena, from spontaneous decay processes to the Casimir force and Hawking radiation. Their existence is a key manifestation of the quantumness of the physical world, but usually it is only their consequences that are directly observed. Here, we directly observe spatial vacuum fluctuations of a bosonic quantum field. Our experiments are based on a homogeneous planar atomic Bose--Einstein condensate. The condensate comprises two coherently coupled interacting components (spin states), and the quantum field describes its spin degrees of freedom. In the regime where the interactions dominate over the coherent coupling, our system emulates a (massive relativistic) sine-Gordon field. Images of the field reveal simultaneous fluctuations on different length scales, with scale-dependent amplitudes consistent with theoretical predictions for a vacuum state. Observing such fluctuations in the sine-Gordon limit opens many possibilities for laboratory simulations of relativistic fields in regimes that are presently not theoretically tractable.

analysis.title_zh: 量子场真空涨落的成像
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究量子场真空态在单次空间图像中呈现的随机涨落，并用均匀平面原子 Bose--Einstein 凝聚体的自旋自由度进行实验观测。摘要称在相互作用强于相干耦合的 regime 中系统模拟有质量相对论 sine-Gordon 场，图像显示多尺度涨落且振幅与真空态理论预言一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 真空涨落是暴胀量子涨落、Hawking 辐射等早期宇宙和量子场现象的核心概念，也是 CMB 初始扰动叙事的基础之一。该文提供的是冷原子平台上的类比观测，对 CMB 的关系在概念和方法启发层面，而非直接测量宇宙微波背景。
key_points: 实验直接成像了玻色量子场真空态中的空间涨落。
平台是均匀平面原子 BEC，两个相干耦合相互作用组分的自旋自由度构成量子场。
在 sine-Gordon 极限中，涨落在不同尺度上的振幅与真空态理论预言一致。
methods: 均匀平面原子 Bose--Einstein 凝聚体
两个相干耦合相互作用组分/自旋态
自旋自由度量子场成像
相互作用主导相干耦合的 sine-Gordon 场模拟
尺度依赖涨落振幅与理论预言比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“直接观测真空涨落”的判据：成像量与场算符的关系、制备真空态的证据、有限温度和探测噪声如何扣除，以及尺度依赖振幅与理论曲线比较的系统误差。

papers.title: A blind spot in transverse BAO calibration
papers.abstract: Transverse baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) measurements are increasingly used for cosmological inference, and carry a calibration that no such inference can constrain. A constant error in the transverse BAO scale is exactly degenerate with the combination $r_{\rm d} h$: it leaves the goodness of fit unchanged and the recovered parameters plausible, and is therefore invisible to any analysis that uses these measurements alone. The radial BAO sector removes this degeneracy, supplying $D_{\rm M}/r_{\rm d}$ by integration without reference to $H_0$ or to any model for the expansion rate. In flat Friedmann--Lemaître--Robertson--Walker (FLRW) geometry the relation between the two sectors is an identity, so the sound horizon and the dark-energy equation of state cancel as well. An integrated form of this identity reduces the consistency test to a straight line, whose slope measures a relative transverse calibration $\varepsilon$. A departure from $\varepsilon = 1$ cannot be produced by any dark-energy model, nor by spatial curvature: it indicates an inconsistency in the measurement chain rather than in the cosmology. We apply the test to the two main SDSS transverse BAO compilations, which give $\varepsilon = 1.073 \pm 0.021$ and $1.021 \pm 0.029$. The first differs from unity at $3.8σ$ using the published independent errors, while the second is consistent with unity. The two compilations themselves differ by $(5.4 \pm 1.4)\%$, or $3.9σ$, and the offset is constant in redshift. The test provides a direct diagnostic for current and future angular BAO measurements.

analysis.title_zh: 横向 BAO 校准中的盲点
analysis.summary_zh: 本文指出横向 BAO 标尺的常数校准误差与 r_d h 完全简并，单独使用横向 BAO 进行宇宙学推断时无法自洽识别。作者利用径向 BAO 与平直 FLRW 几何中的恒等关系构造一致性检验，并在两个主要 SDSS 横向 BAO 汇编上得到一个显著偏离 unity、另一个与 unity 一致的相对校准结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: BAO 标尺与 CMB 推断的声学尺度、声视界 r_d 和 H0 张力密切相关；若横向 BAO 存在不可由其自身约束的校准偏差，会影响将低红移距离测量与 CMB 早期宇宙标尺联合解释的可靠性。该文直接涉及宇宙学距离标尺的系统误差诊断，CMB/BAO 联合分析读者应重点关注。
key_points: 横向 BAO 标尺的常数校准误差与 r_d h 完全简并，单独使用横向 BAO 难以发现。
径向 BAO 可打破该简并，并在平直 FLRW 几何中给出不依赖 H0 或膨胀率模型的扇区一致性检验。
作者将检验用于两个主要 SDSS 横向 BAO 汇编，报告一个存在偏离 unity 的结果，另一个与 unity 一致。
methods: 横向 BAO 与径向 BAO 一致性检验
平直 FLRW 几何恒等式
积分形式直线检验
相对横向校准参数 ε
两个主要 SDSS 横向 BAO 汇编
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对该一致性检验的假设边界：径向 BAO 积分是否确实不引入隐藏模型依赖、SDSS 两个汇编的误差独立性和协方差处理、以及 ε 偏离 unity 是否可能来自选择函数、重构、角向系统误差或样本重叠。

papers.title: Non-Minimally Coupled Warm Inflation in the Defining Frame
papers.abstract: Warm inflation in $F(Φ)R$ scalar-tensor theories of gravity is investigated in the `defining' frame, where the theory and its parameter values are specified. Translating the resulting dynamics to the Einstein frame, we find that the dissipation ratio is suppressed by the modified-gravity effects. Thus, although the effective warm-inflation dynamics can be consistently analysed in either frame, the dissipative regimes need not coincide between them. In particular, we find that quantum perturbations can dominate over thermal fluctuations in the scalar power spectrum even in a high-temperature, strong-dissipation regime in the defining frame. Finally, we compute the scalar spectral index and tensor-to-scalar ratio for a non-minimal coupling function $F(Φ) = 1+ξ(Φ/m_{\rm P})^2$ with a quartic potential and both constant and quadratic field-dependent dissipation coefficients, and identify benchmark points compatible with current CMB constraints.

analysis.title_zh: 定义框架中的非最小耦合暖暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 $F(\Phi)R$ 标量-张量引力中的非最小耦合暖暴胀，并强调理论参数在“defining frame”中给定后再变换到爱因斯坦框架时，修正引力会抑制耗散比。摘要报告称，在定义框架的高温强耗散区间内，标量功率谱仍可能由量子扰动而非热涨落主导，并在四次势与两类耗散系数下给出与当前 CMB 约束相容的基准点。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接关联 CMB 对暴胀模型的检验，因为它计算标量谱指数和张量标量比，并讨论暖暴胀中扰动来源如何影响标量功率谱。对 CMB 读者而言，关键意义在于提醒非最小耦合和框架选择可能改变对“强耗散”“热涨落主导”等条件的物理判读，从而影响与 CMB 观测约束的比较。
key_points: 在定义理论参数的“defining frame”中研究非最小耦合暖暴胀。
变换到爱因斯坦框架后，耗散比会受到修正引力效应抑制。
给出四次势与两类耗散系数下满足当前 CMB 约束的基准点。
methods: $F(\Phi)R$ 标量-张量引力中的暖暴胀动力学分析
从 defining frame 到 Einstein frame 的动力学转换
非最小耦合函数 $F(\Phi)=1+\xi(\Phi/m_{\rm P})^2$
四次势
常数耗散系数与二次场依赖耗散系数
计算标量谱指数和张量标量比
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对不同 conformal frame 中耗散比、温度条件和扰动源的定义是否一致，以及所谓与当前 CMB 约束相容的基准点是否依赖特定势能、耗散系数或参数先验。

papers.title: Transient Early Dark Energy-Like Dynamics as a Mechanism for Enhanced Early Structure Formation in the JWST Era
papers.abstract: The discovery of massive galaxies at redshifts $z\gtrsim10$ by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has renewed interest in cosmological mechanisms capable of enhancing early structure formation while preserving the successful large-scale predictions of the standard $Λ$CDM model. We investigate a phenomenological scenario in which an exotic dark matter species can undergo a transient early dark energy-like phase during the radiation-dominated era ($10^{-7}\lesssim a\lesssim10^{-5}$) before reverting to pressureless cold dark matter. We utilize the generalized dark matter framework to model this species, which is restricted to a sub-percent fraction of the total dark matter component by CMB, BAO and Type Ia supernova data. Its background and perturbation dynamics are characterized by a time-dependent equation of state, $w(a)$, and a time- as well as scale-dependent sound speed, $c_s^2(a,k)$. The temporary negative equation of state, combined with our phenomenological pressure-response prescription, induces a finite interval of negative effective sound speed squared. This triggers an instability-driven growth of density perturbations over a limited range of comoving scales, thereby enhancing the formation of early dark matter halos. We find that the enhanced halo abundance can substantially reduce the star-formation efficiencies required to reproduce the observed abundance of JWST galaxies relative to the standard $Λ$CDM scenario, especially at higher redshifts. Our results demonstrate that transient early dark energy-like dynamics in a subdominant dark matter component provide a viable mechanism for enhancing early structure formation and offer a new framework for interpreting the abundance of high-redshift galaxies observed by JWST and future surveys.
papers.comment: 12 pages text, 3 pages appendices, 2 pages references. Comments are welcome

analysis.title_zh: 作为增强 JWST 时代早期结构形成机制的短暂早期暗能量样动力学
analysis.summary_zh: 本文为解释 JWST 在 $z\gtrsim10$ 发现的大质量星系，研究一种奇异暗物质组分在辐射主导时期短暂表现为早期暗能量样状态、随后回到无压冷暗物质的现象学模型。摘要称，该亚主导组分通过时间依赖状态方程和尺度依赖声速产生有限尺度上的扰动增长，可提高早期暗晕丰度并降低相对标准 $\Lambda$CDM 所需的恒星形成效率。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然该论文主要面向早期星系与结构形成问题，但它必须同时满足 CMB 对早期宇宙能量组分和扰动演化的严格约束。对 CMB/宇宙学研究而言，这类模型检验了是否存在一种只占很小比例、但能在特定时期和尺度上改变小尺度结构增长的暗部门自由度。
key_points: 提出一种亚主导暗物质组分的短暂早期暗能量样动力学。
该组分受 CMB、BAO 和 Ia 型超新星数据限制在暗物质总量的亚百分比水平。
负有效声速平方在有限尺度范围内触发扰动增长，从而增强早期暗晕丰度。
methods: 广义暗物质框架
时间依赖状态方程 $w(a)$
时间和尺度依赖声速 $c_s^2(a,k)$
CMB、BAO、Ia 型超新星数据约束
早期暗物质晕丰度建模
与 JWST 高红移星系丰度比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对负有效声速平方导致的扰动不稳定性是否在理论上可控、是否与线性扰动处理相容，以及 CMB、BAO、超新星约束如何允许同时增强小尺度早期结构形成。

papers.title: SPT-3G+: A Cosmic Microwave Background Experiment for the South Pole Telescope
papers.abstract: SPT-3G+ is the next survey receiver planned to be installed in early 2029 on the 10-meter South Pole Telescope (SPT). This new receiver will feature 6,020 polarization-sensitive dichroic pixels with transition-edge sensors observing in frequency bands centered at 90 GHz and 150 GHz. The 24,080 detectors in the SPT-3G+ receiver will be cooled to 100 mK by a dilution refrigerator and read out using microwave SQUID multiplexing. The optical design of the receiver enables a 4 degree diameter field of view, which is broken up into 14 individual optics tubes each containing cryogenic alumina, silicon, and nylon lenses. These technology choices will allow the SPT-3G+ receiver to improve on the mapping speed of the currently operating SPT-3G receiver by nearly an order of magnitude. Once deployed, the SPT-3G+ receiver will observe for 6-years an area overlapping with the BICEP survey to achieve a combined (90 GHz and 150 GHz) CMB map depth of 0.5 uK-arcmin. Data from these observations will be used to create unprecedentedly deep CMB lensing maps, discover new galaxy clusters, and detect astrophysical transients. The lensing map produced by SPT-3G+ will be used to remove or "delens" foreground B modes, where large-scale structure gravitationally lenses the CMB and converts E modes into B-mode polarization, with the goal of revealing inflationary B modes. Together with data from the BICEP Array as part of the South Pole Observatory, SPT-3G+ data will be used to constrain the tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$ with a goal of achieving a measurement of $σ(r) = 0.001$
papers.comment: 22 pages, 7 figures, Proceedings for SPIE Astronomincal Telescopes + Instrumentation 2026 Paper 14156-14

analysis.title_zh: SPT-3G+：用于南极望远镜的宇宙微波背景实验
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍计划安装于 10 米南极望远镜的下一代 CMB 接收机 SPT-3G+，包括探测器、频段、低温、读出和光学设计。摘要报告称，该仪器将通过 6 年与 BICEP 区域重叠的深场观测产生高深度 CMB 图和透镜图，用于星系团、瞬变源、CMB 透镜和 B 模去透镜，并以联合 BICEP Array 约束 $r$ 为目标。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这是直接服务于 CMB 偏振和原初引力波搜寻的实验方案。其核心科学链条是用深度 CMB 透镜图去除由大尺度结构透镜化产生的前景 B 模，从而提高对暴胀 B 模和张量标量比 $r$ 的灵敏度，同时也会产出星系团和瞬变源等宇宙学数据产品。
key_points: SPT-3G+ 是计划 2029 年初安装在南极望远镜上的下一代 CMB 巡天接收机。
接收机将以 90 和 150 GHz 观测，目标是显著提升相对 SPT-3G 的制图速度。
其深度透镜图将用于去透镜 B 模，并与 BICEP Array 联合约束张量标量比 $r$。
methods: 南极望远镜 10 米口径平台
90 GHz 和 150 GHz 双频偏振观测

100 mK 稀释制冷

papers.title: The SPT-3G+ receiver design
papers.abstract: We present the thermo-mechanical design of the cryostat and camera optics for SPT-3G+, a new receiver being developed for the South Pole Telescope (SPT). The receiver consists of 14 detector arrays of 90/150 GHz dichroic polarization-sensitive pixels, totaling 24,080 transition-edge sensor detectors. Each detector array lies at the end of an optics tube, each approximately 240 mm in diameter and 772 mm in length, which are arranged in a hexagonal close-packed configuration to achieve a 4 degree diameter field of view. Each optics tube contains four anti-reflection coated lenses fabricated from different materials (alumina, silicon, and nylon) that are designed to also provide infrared filtering that reduces the radiative loading on the cryogenic stages. The optics and detectors are cooled by a combination of a pulse tube cooler for the 40 K and 4 K stages, and a dilution refrigerator for the 1 K and 100 mK stages. Thermal modeling predicts the heat load to be less than 26 W and 1 W for the 40 K and 4 K stages, respectively. The 1,550 kg cryostat has a 1.1 meter diameter at the vacuum window, which is located near the telescope Gregorian focus, and 1.75 meters in height and length. Fabrication of the cryostat will begin in 2026, with installation on the SPT scheduled for the 2028-29 austral summer, ahead of the 2029 winter observing season.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, Proceedings for SPIE Astronomical Telescopes + Instrumentation 2026 Paper 14156-90

analysis.title_zh: SPT-3G+ 接收机设计
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 SPT-3G+ 接收机的低温恒温器与相机光学热机械设计。摘要报告了探测器数量、光学管布局、透镜/滤波材料、制冷方案、热负载预测和制造安装时间表。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: SPT 是 CMB 温度和偏振观测的重要平台，90/150 GHz 偏振接收机的视场、探测器数量、低温稳定性和光学系统误差会影响 CMB 透镜、星系团、偏振及前景分离等分析。该文是理解下一阶段 SPT 数据能力和仪器系统误差预算的基础性资料。
