papers.title: Inflation on the lattice: scalar Gauss-Bonnet single field inflation
papers.abstract: We use lattice methods to study inflation in the scalar Gauss-Bonnet (SGB) gravity theory. We focus on the ultra-slow-roll scenario with the peak frequency falls into the PTA band. In the parameter range we consider, we find that the lattice results exceed the perturbative predictions, which differs from the case in Einstein gravity. We further find that lattice corrections become significant when the peak of the primordial curvature spectrum reaches $\sim 10^{-2}$. We calculate the energy density spectra of second-order scalar induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) using the primordial power spectra obtained from both the lattice method and the traditional perturbative method, and analyze the SGB model in light of current pulsar timing array (PTA) observations. Our results indicate that lattice corrections enhance the ability of the SGB model to dominate the PTA observations.

analysis.title_zh: 格点上的暴胀：标量 Gauss-Bonnet 单场暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 作者用格点方法研究标量 Gauss-Bonnet 单场暴胀的超慢滚情形，重点放在峰频落入 PTA 波段的参数区间。摘要称，在所考察范围内格点结果高于扰动论预测，且当原初曲率谱峰值达到约 10^-2 时格点修正变得显著；这些修正也增强了该模型解释 PTA 观测的能力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作把原初曲率扰动的非线性演化和二阶诱导引力波联系到 PTA 信号，直接关联到 CMB 相关的暴胀原初条件与小尺度原初功率谱的重建。对宇宙学读者而言，它提供了一个检验“暴胀模型是否能同时满足 CMB 约束与 PTA 尺度信号”的具体例子。
key_points: 用格点方法研究标量 Gauss-Bonnet 暴胀中的超慢 रोल情形。
当原初曲率谱峰值达到约 10^-2 时，格点修正开始变得重要。
把格点得到的原初谱用于二阶标量诱导引力波，并与 PTA 观测联系起来。
methods: 格点数值模拟
扰动论对照计算
由原初功率谱计算二阶标量诱导引力波能谱
结合脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）观测进行分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对的是：作者的格点设置、超慢滚阶段的初始条件、以及格点修正相对扰动论偏离的来源是否稳健；还要确认将原初谱映射到 SIGW 能谱时采用的假设是否与 PTA 拟合一致。

papers.title: Testing Statistical Isotropy in the FRB Sky Distribution: A Selection-Function-Aware Framework
papers.abstract: We perform a test of statistical isotropy in the Universe using the sky distribution of fast radio bursts (FRBs), based on a compilation of $4066$ events detected by multiple surveys. Our method is based on the two-point angular correlation function $w(θ)$ as in the Landy--Szalay estimator, together with a tomographic absolute-anisotropy statistic, and estimates their observational uncertainties from complementary jackknife and bootstrap resampling. Both estimators are confronted with hierarchical ensembles of isotropic mock catalogs that propagate the uncertainties of empirically reconstructed survey selection functions, as well as the Poisson fluctuations of the isotropic realizations. The significances are obtained from a covariance-aware, SVD-regularized $χ^2$ statistic calibrated empirically against the mock ensemble, and we evaluate four nested scenarios that progressively incorporate a Galactic-plane mask and the survey selection functions. As for our results, we find that the raw FRB sky is strongly inconsistent with isotropy; Galactic masking alone reduces the tension by only a factor of $\sim 3$, whereas the selection functions reduce it by nearly four orders of magnitude, showing that the apparent anisotropy is driven by the highly non-uniform sky coverage of the contributing surveys, overwhelmingly dominated by CHIME. Only when both effects are combined we obtain that the observed distribution is fully consistent with statistical isotropy. This result is independently corroborated by the absolute-anisotropy estimator, and is stable under variations of the analysis parameters. Therefore, we find that the FRB sky distribution is consistent with statistical isotropy, helping confirm one of the main predictions of the standard model scenario.

analysis.title_zh: 检验 FRB 天区分布中的统计各向同性：一种考虑选择函数的方法
analysis.summary_zh: 作者用 4066 个 FRB 事件的天空分布检验宇宙统计各向同性，并同时建模银河平面遮罩与各巡天的选择函数。摘要报告说，原始分布看似强烈偏离各向同性，但在把选择函数和遮罩都纳入后，结果与统计各向同性相容。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 各向同性是标准宇宙学的基本假设之一，CMB 研究尤其依赖这一前提。虽然这篇文章用的是 FRB 而非 CMB，但它在方法上强调了选择效应对各向异性检验的影响，对任何大尺度天空分布分析，包括 CMB 低多极异常和巡天系统学处理，都有直接参考价值。
key_points: 用 FRB 的全天分布检验宇宙统计各向同性。
显著的表观各向异性主要来自观测选择函数，而不是天空本征分布。
在同时考虑银河平面遮罩和选择函数后，分布与统计各向同性一致。
methods: 基于 4066 个 FRB 事件的样本
两点角相关函数 $w(θ)$ 的 Landy--Szalay 估计量
层级各向同性模拟目录
jackknife 与 bootstrap 误差估计
协方差感知、SVD 正则化的 $χ^2$ 统计
绝对各向异性统计量
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对选择函数的重建方式、CHIME 主导带来的非均匀覆盖如何进入模拟，以及不同遮罩/选择函数组合下的显著性评估是否对统计细节敏感。

papers.title: Non-minimal Unimodular Inflation
papers.abstract: We study an extension of the unimodular cosmological inflation in the context of the non-minimal coupling of a generic scalar field with gravitational sector. We consider the non-minimal coupling of the scalar field and gravity as the only source of energy-momentum tensor in this setup. Without introducing new particles other than those already existing in electroweak theory, the generic scalar field's non-minimal coupling is responsible for the generation of the seeds of perturbations for structure formation and the observed Cosmic Microwave Background anisotropies in this scenario. We calculate inflation parameters in both the Jordan and Einstein frames, and then we study primordial spectral indices for slow-roll parameters in Einstein's frame at the first and second orders. The numerical results of this model are consistent with the Planck2018 and BICEP/Keck joint data sets in some subspaces of the model parameters space. By considering a sufficient amount of inflation, we estimate the strength of the non-minimal coupling parameter, $ξ$, to find appropriate new constraints on the values of this parameter. By comparing the numerical values of the inflation observables in two frames and also with observation, we comment on the issue of frames in this framework.

analysis.title_zh: 非最小极化暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 作者在非极化暴胀框架下引入标量场与引力的非最小耦合，计算了 Jordan 框和 Einstein 框中的暴胀参数及慢滚谱指数。摘要称，该模型在部分参数子空间内与 Planck2018 和 BICEP/Keck 联合数据一致，并据此给出了对耦合参数 $ξ$ 的约束讨论。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这类模型直接针对原初标量扰动的生成机制，因此与 CMB 温度和偏振各向异性约束高度相关。对 CMB 读者来说，重点在于它是否能在不引入新粒子的前提下，同时满足原初谱指数、张量比和框选择问题的观测要求。
key_points: 研究非极化宇宙论中的非最小耦合暴胀。
将 Jordan 框与 Einstein 框下的暴胀参数和谱指数都做了对比。
摘要称在部分参数空间内与 Planck2018 和 BICEP/Keck 联合数据一致。
methods: 非极化宇宙学暴胀框架
标量场与引力部门的非最小耦合
Jordan 框与 Einstein 框下的参数计算
一阶与二阶慢滚谱指数计算
与 Planck2018 和 BICEP/Keck 联合数据比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对的是：非极化条件如何具体实现、Jordan/Einstein 两框之间的物理量对应关系、以及作者对框依赖问题的讨论是否只是一种参数化比较还是确有可观测差异。

papers.title: Effective Field Theory for Freezing Gravity with Minimally Coupled Matter
papers.abstract: Freezing gravity (FG), a phantom-crossing dark energy model, was recently proposed in the absence of matter. In this work, we study FG minimally coupled to a perfect fluid through a detailed cosmological perturbation analysis and derive the conditions for the absence of ghost and gradient instabilities. The ghost stability conditions are obtained analytically without taking the high-$k$ limit, yielding the ghost-free range of scales and a finite cutoff when it exists. In the branch where a finite cutoff is already present in vacuum, we find that matter coupling lowers it relative to its vacuum value. Moreover, in the high-$k$ regime, the gradient stability condition guarantees a positive effective gravitational coupling for cold dark matter. We further show that two characteristic properties of FG persist in the presence of matter. First, the background and perturbation sectors remain separated, in the sense that they are controlled by independent sets of parameters, allowing FG to realize arbitrary background evolutions, including phantom crossing, while maintaining stable perturbation dynamics. Second, the scalar degree of freedom of FG becomes non-dynamical in the large-scale limit at linear order, while propagating with a finite speed of sound on small scales. Whether this behavior persists to arbitrarily high orders in perturbation theory, thereby avoiding the potential strong-coupling issue, requires further investigation through a nonlinear perturbation analysis. To make contact with large-scale structure and gravitational lensing observables, we also derive the effective gravitational coupling and gravitational slip within the quasi-static regime and express our results in terms of the EFT parameters.

analysis.title_zh: 含最小耦合物质的 Freezing Gravity 有效场论
analysis.summary_zh: 本文把 phantom crossing 暗能量模型 freezing gravity 推广到与完美流体最小耦合的情形，并通过宇宙学扰动分析推导无 ghost 和无 gradient 不稳定性的条件。摘要称，物质耦合会降低某一已有有限 cutoff 分支的 cutoff，高 k 下的 gradient 稳定性保证冷暗物质的有效引力耦合为正，并在准静态 regime 中给出有效引力耦合和引力滑移。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗能量和修改引力模型会改变晚期宇宙膨胀、结构增长、引力透镜势以及 CMB 的 ISW 效应和透镜重构信号。该文直接讨论有效引力耦合与引力滑移，因而与用 CMB 及大尺度结构联合检验引力和暗能量性质密切相关。
key_points: 研究 freezing gravity 与完美流体最小耦合后的宇宙学扰动稳定性。
解析给出 ghost 稳定条件，且不依赖高 k 极限；物质耦合会降低某一分支中已有的有限 cutoff。
在准静态 regime 中推导有效引力耦合和引力滑移，以连接大尺度结构和透镜观测。
methods: 有效场论参数化
宇宙学扰动分析
ghost 与 gradient 稳定性条件推导
完美流体最小耦合
准静态近似
有效引力耦合与引力滑移计算
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对稳定性条件的参数范围、有限 cutoff 的物理含义，以及大尺度标量自由度非动力学是否可能导致摘要所提到的强耦合问题。

papers.title: Analyzing Quasi-normal modes spectrum in asymptotically de Sitter black bounces and their optical appearance
papers.abstract: This work explores asymptotically de Sitter black-bounce spacetimes, obtained as a regular extension of the Schwarzschild-de Sitter geometry via the Simpson-Visser prescription. The resulting family of solutions provides a smooth interpolation between regular black holes, extremal configurations, and traversable wormholes within a single geometrical framework. In particular, we verify the regularity of the spacetime by showing that (some of) curvature invariants, including the Kretschmann and Ricci scalars, remain finite at the origin for any non-vanishing value of the regularization parameter $a$, ensuring geodesic completeness. An analysis of the effective stress-energy tensor reveals a violation of the null energy condition, which can be consistently interpreted in terms of a composite source involving a phantom scalar field coupled to nonlinear electrodynamics. Subsequently, we investigate the observational signatures of these geometries by studying: i) null geodesic propagation and ii) constructing the associated optical appearance. In particular, we determine the shadow radius and characterize the structure of photon rings through numerical ray-tracing procedure. Finally, we compute the spectrum of axial gravitational perturbations using a pseudospectral approach, obtaining the quasinormal mode frequencies and their overtones. Our results show a non-trivial interplay between the cosmological constant and the regularization scale $a$, which imprints itself on both the light-ring structure and the quasinormal spectrum. These features suggest potential observational discriminants that could distinguish these regular spacetimes from their singular counterparts in future gravitational-wave and high-resolution electromagnetic observations.

analysis.title_zh: 渐近 de Sitter 黑洞-bounce 中准正则模谱及其光学外观的分析
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究由 Simpson-Visser 处方构造的渐近 de Sitter 黑洞-bounce 时空，分析其正则性、有效物质源、零测地线、光学外观和轴向引力扰动准正则模。摘要称宇宙学常数与正则化尺度 a 对光环结构和准正则模谱有非平凡共同影响，可能为区分正则时空与奇异对应物提供观测判据。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文主要属于广义相对论和强场引力，和 CMB 的直接联系较弱；其宇宙学相关性在于包含正宇宙学常数的渐近 de Sitter 背景，以及潜在的引力波强场检验。对 CMB 读者而言，它更多是背景引力理论与黑洞观测判据方面的参考，而非直接影响 CMB 数据分析或早期宇宙参数约束的论文。
key_points: 研究对象是 Simpson-Visser 处方得到的渐近 de Sitter 黑洞-bounce 时空。
摘要报告曲率不变量在非零正则化参数下有限，并讨论零能条件破缺的有效物质解释。
通过光线追踪和赝谱方法研究阴影、光子环与轴向引力扰动准正则模。
methods: Simpson-Visser 正则化处方
曲率不变量分析，包括 Kretschmann 标量和 Ricci 标量
有效应力-能量张量与零能条件分析
零测地线传播分析
数值光线追踪构建光学外观
赝谱方法计算轴向引力扰动准正则模及泛音
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对边界条件如何适配渐近 de Sitter 情形、准正则模计算的数值收敛性、阴影/光子环定义是否受坐标和观测者位置影响，以及所谓观测判别量与实际引力波或电磁观测灵敏度之间的距离。

papers.title: A Prediction for DESI Full-Shape: Increasing Tomographic $Ω_m(z)$ Trend
papers.abstract: To confirm $Λ$CDM deviations are due to missing physics (not systematics), one should demonstrate that the model fitting parameters exhibit qualitatively similar redshift drift across independent observables. This is the only way one guarantees new physics. Here, we show that a recent Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) DR2 Full-Shape (FS) modelling Lyman-$α$ constraint at $z_{\rm eff} = 2.33$ combined with earlier DR1 FS modelling constraints with $0.295 \leq z_{\rm eff} \leq 1.491$ leads to a straight line $Ω_m(z) = m z + c$ with slope $m = 0.022 \pm 0.012$, $1.8 σ$ removed from constant $Ω_m$. Akaike Information Criterion and Bayesian evidence confirm that constant $Ω_m$ and increasing $Ω_m(z)$ are statistically indistinguishable. Through the $Om(z)$ diagnostic, we review how increasing and decreasing $Ω_m(z)$ trends map to phantom and quintessence dark energy (DE) regimes, respectively. While FS modelling constraints map to phantom DE, the decreasing and increasing $Ω_m(z)$ trends in DESI BAO and DESI with external data make a phantom crossing inevitable. Since dynamical DE is but one interpretation for $Ω_m(z)$ trends, it is imperative that different datasets converge on their $Ω_m(z)$ trends before one jumps to physical conclusions. We forecast how DESI FS modelling $Ω_m$ constraints will improve up to the final data release and explore the implications for model selection.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures plus references; v2 references added

analysis.title_zh: 对 DESI 全形状分析的一个预测：层析 Ω_m(z) 趋势上升
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 DESI Full-Shape 建模中按红移分层得到的 Ω_m 约束是否呈现随红移增加的趋势，并将 DR2 Lyman-α 结果与 DR1 较低红移结果合并作线性检验。摘要报告斜率为正但仅偏离常数 Ω_m 约 1.8σ，且 AIC 与贝叶斯证据认为常数模型和增长趋势统计上不可区分，同时作者预测未来 DESI Full-Shape 约束的改进。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Ω_m 与暗能量性质是 CMB 基准宇宙学参数推断的核心；若低红移大尺度结构给出随红移漂移的有效 Ω_m，可能指向系统误差、模型参数化问题或 ΛCDM 之外的物理。该文直接关系到如何将 DESI 与 CMB 约束进行一致性检验，而摘要本身也强调当前证据尚不足以得出新物理结论。
key_points: 关注 DESI Full-Shape 拟合得到的分层 Ω_m(z) 是否随红移漂移。
摘要称当前线性增长趋势仅为 1.8σ，常数 Ω_m 与增长 Ω_m(z) 在 AIC 和贝叶斯证据上不可区分。
作者强调不同观测量的 Ω_m(z) 趋势需相互收敛后才宜作新物理解释。
methods: DESI DR2 Full-Shape Lyman-α 约束
DESI DR1 Full-Shape 建模约束
线性参数化 Ω_m(z)=m z+c
Akaike Information Criterion（AIC）
贝叶斯证据
Om(z) 诊断
DESI Full-Shape 未来数据发布预测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对不同红移 Full-Shape 约束是否可被一致地解释为 Ω_m(z)，其协方差和系统误差如何处理，以及将 Ω_m(z) 趋势映射为 phantom/quintessence 暗能量时依赖了哪些模型假设。

papers.title: Quasi-periodic Eruptions from Recurrent Satellite Black Hole Transits through Magnetized Galactic Nucleus Accretion Disks
papers.abstract: Quasi-periodic eruptions (QPEs) are recurrent soft X-ray flares from galactic nuclei, but their origin remains uncertain. The delayed ultraviolet (UV) counterpart detected in Ansky provides a new constraint on viable models. We present a two-channel model in which a satellite black hole (sBH) repeatedly crosses a nuclear accretion disk threaded by a large-scale magnetic field. Gravitational focusing and dynamical drag generate hot, optically thick ejecta whose expansion and photon diffusion power the soft X-ray QPE. For fiducial Bondi-scale parameters, the model yields a characteristic X-ray duration of $\sim10^3\ \mathrm{s}$ and luminosity of $\sim10^{42}\ \mathrm{erg\,s^{-1}}$; at lower orbital inclinations, the duration extends to the day-long scale observed in Ansky. Simultaneously, the sBH motion compresses and bends the background magnetic field, triggering in-disk reconnection. The dissipated energy then emerges after photon diffusion as a broader, delayed UV response. The resulting thermal power is comparable to the variable UV luminosity of Ansky. Unfavorable magnetic fields or diffusion times longer than the QPE recurrence period can weaken or smear out the UV signal, potentially explaining the lack of clear UV counterparts in other QPE sources.

analysis.title_zh: 由卫星黑洞反复穿越磁化星系核吸积盘产生的准周期爆发
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对星系核准周期爆发的起源，提出卫星黑洞反复穿越带大尺度磁场的核区吸积盘的双通道模型。摘要称，引力聚焦和动力学阻力产生的热、光学厚喷出物可解释软 X 射线 QPE，而磁场压缩弯折触发的盘内重联经光子扩散后可给出 Ansky 中较宽且延迟的 UV 响应。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇主要属于高能天体物理和星系核瞬变研究，并非直接 CMB 论文。它与宇宙学的联系在于黑洞、吸积盘和星系核瞬变可影响时域巡天中的活动星系核背景识别；对 CMB 研究者而言，相关性偏间接，主要是理解多波段前景源和黑洞增长环境。
key_points: 提出卫星黑洞反复穿越磁化核区吸积盘的双通道模型。
软 X 射线 QPE 由热的光学厚喷出物膨胀与光子扩散供能。
盘内磁重联可产生更宽、更滞后的 UV 响应，用于解释 Ansky 的约束。
methods: 双通道物理模型
卫星黑洞穿越带大尺度磁场的核区吸积盘
引力聚焦与动力学阻力
光子扩散
盘内磁重联
与 Ansky 的延迟 UV 对应体约束比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Bondi 尺度参数、轨道倾角、磁场构型和扩散时间的取值是否能同时满足 X 射线持续时间、复发周期与 Ansky 的 UV 延迟，而不是只分别拟合各通道。

papers.title: Quintessential α-attractors, updated
papers.abstract: Quintessential $α$-attractor models of single-field inflation and evolving dark energy were constructed about a decade ago. Recently, it was pointed out that some of them might be disfavored due to dark-radiation constraints on gravitational waves and the higher values of $n_s$ favored by ACT. Here we present a class of updated quintessential $α$-attractor models in which a single field describes both inflation and evolving dark energy, yields higher values of $n_s$, and admits reheating scenarios consistent with the dark-radiation bound on $ΔN_{\rm eff}$. Depending on the value of the cosmological constant $Λ$, these models interpolate between $Λ$CDM with $Λ> 0$ (future dS universe), dynamical dark energy with $Λ= 0$ (future Minkowski universe), and dynamical dark energy with $Λ< 0$ (future cosmological collapse). We also study quintessential $α$-attractor models based on an axion-inflaton complex scalar field with hyperbolic geometry, which describe inflation and dark energy of a ``phantom illusion'' type compatible with DESI DR2.

analysis.title_zh: 更新的 Quintessential α-吸引子模型
analysis.summary_zh: 本文更新了约十年前提出的 quintessential α-attractor 框架，用单一标量场同时描述暴胀和演化暗能量，以回应暗辐射引力波约束和 ACT 偏好的较高 n_s。摘要称新模型允许与 ΔN_eff 约束相容的再加热，并可随 Λ 的取值连接未来 dS、Minkowski 或塌缩宇宙，也讨论了带双曲几何的轴子-暴胀子复标量场版本。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这类模型直接连接早期暴胀、CMB 标量谱指数 n_s、原初引力波背景及暗辐射约束，并把这些早期宇宙信息与晚期暗能量演化联系起来。对 CMB 读者而言，关键在于 ACT 等 CMB 数据对 n_s 的偏好和 ΔN_eff 约束如何改变可行的暴胀-暗能量统一模型空间。
key_points: 提出更新的 quintessential α-attractor 单场模型。
模型旨在同时描述暴胀与演化暗能量，并给出较高的 n_s。
讨论与 ΔN_eff 暗辐射约束相容的再加热情形，以及不同 Λ 下的宇宙未来。
methods: 单场暴胀与演化暗能量的 quintessential α-attractor 构造
考虑暗辐射对引力波的 ΔN_eff 约束
不同宇宙学常数 Λ 的模型分类
基于双曲几何的轴子-暴胀子复标量场模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对更新模型如何具体提高 n_s、再加热历史怎样满足 ΔN_eff 约束，以及这些条件是否依赖特定势能或参数选择。

papers.title: Kerr Quasinormal Modes without Variable Separation: A Two-Dimensional Hyperboloidal Teukolsky Solver with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.abstract: We use physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) to solve the gravitational quasinormal-mode (QNM) eigenvalue problem for Kerr spacetime directly in the two-dimensional hyperboloidal formulation of the Teukolsky equation. This formulation does not require separation of variables and thus retains the coupled radial--angular structure. Such a scheme provides a prototype for calculating the QNMs of beyond-Kerr black holes for which the perturbation equations are non-separable. Sequences with increasing angular momentum are constructed, reaching close to the extremal limit. We focus on the fundamental modes $(\ell,m,n)=(2,0,0)$, $(2,1,0)$, $(2,2,0)$, $(3,3,0)$ and $(4,4,0)$, together with the first overtone $(2,2,1)$. Independent benchmark evaluation shows that every reported real and imaginary frequency component remains below $0.5\%$ error, with a median deviation of $0.1\%$. This accuracy is maintained in the near-extremal regime, where the damping rate becomes small and the modes are longest-lived. The results establish a non-spectral numerical route to multidimensional black-hole perturbation eigenproblems which does not match the substantially higher precision of dedicated Kerr solvers but offers greater flexibility and requires less analytical pre-processing. Non-separable rotating backgrounds and coupled systems, such as gravitational--electromagnetic Kerr--Newman perturbations, are natural extensions of the same construction.

analysis.title_zh: 无变量分离的 Kerr 准正则模：采用物理信息神经网络的二维超曲面 Teukolsky 求解器
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用物理信息神经网络在二维超曲面 Teukolsky 方程中直接求解 Kerr 黑洞引力准正则模本征值，避免变量分离并保留径向-角向耦合。摘要报告多个基频和一个泛音在独立基准下频率实部与虚部误差均低于 0.5%，中位偏差为 0.1%，且在近极端区域保持该精度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 准正则模是黑洞扰动和引力波环降阶段的核心量，直接服务于强引力检验。它与 CMB 的联系不是观测上的直接联系，而是同属引力理论和宇宙学基本物理；若推广到超越 Kerr 或耦合扰动系统，可为检验广义相对论和早期宇宙/粒子宇宙学模型中的引力部门提供数值工具。
key_points: 用 PINN 直接求解 Kerr 时空二维超曲面 Teukolsky 方程中的引力 QNM 本征值问题。
方法不依赖变量分离，保留径向-角向耦合结构。
摘要报告相对专用 Kerr 求解器精度较低，但对非可分背景更灵活。
methods: physics-informed neural networks，PINNs
二维超曲面形式 Teukolsky 方程
不进行变量分离的 QNM 本征值求解
独立基准评估
接近极端 Kerr 的角动量序列
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 PINN 损失函数、边界条件和超曲面紧化如何编码 QNM 的出射/入射条件，以及基准误差是否在近极端和长寿命模态中稳定。

papers.title: Cluster finding with outskirt stellar masses and percolation
papers.abstract: The abundance of galaxy clusters is a powerful cosmological probe, but optical cluster cosmology is limited by selection systematics, in particular the projection effects that affect cluster finders based on galaxy populations such as the red sequence. The outer stellar mass ($M_\mathrm{out}$) of cluster central galaxies -- e.g., the stellar mass in a 50-100 kpc annulus -- offers an alternative selection that relies only on the central galaxy and is therefore largely free from projection effects. Its primary systematic is instead satellite contamination, since massive clusters can host more than one galaxy with high outer stellar mass. Using the IllustrisTNG300 simulation at $z=0.4$, we quantify this contamination and investigate a simple, proximity-based percolation method to mitigate it, in which galaxies with lower outer stellar mass lying within a given radius of a more massive galaxy are removed from the sample. We find that the satellite fraction defined by the friends-of-friends (FoF) algorithm is modest even without percolation ($\leq 15\%$ for $M_\mathrm{out} > 10^{10}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$ and $<10\%$ for $M_\mathrm{out} > 10^{11}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$), and that percolation reduces it further, with the improvement increasing for percolation radii up to $3.0\,R_{200c}$. For a moderately high outer stellar mass cut ($\sim 4\times10^{10}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$) and percolation radius ($\sim 2.0\,R_{200c}$), we recover a cluster sample that is both highly complete and pure for halo masses $\gtrsim 10^{14}\,\mathrm{M}_\odot$. These results indicate that outer stellar mass, combined with simple percolation, has the potential to provide a clean and readily calibratable selection of massive galaxy clusters.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 6 figures, to be submitted to the Open Journal of Astrophysics

analysis.title_zh: 利用外侧恒星质量和渗流法寻找星系团
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对光学星系团宇宙学中的投影选择系统误差，研究用中央星系外侧恒星质量 M_out 作为星系团选择指标，并用基于近邻的 percolation 方法降低卫星污染。摘要报告在 IllustrisTNG300 的 z=0.4 样本中，卫星污染本身较温和，percolation 可进一步降低污染，并在适当 M_out 阈值与半径下恢复高完整度和高纯度的大质量 halo 样本。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团丰度是约束 Ω_m、σ8 和结构增长的重要低红移探针，也常与 CMB 结果进行一致性检验。更干净、可标定的星系团选择函数有助于减少投影效应导致的质量函数偏差，从而改进 CMB 与星系团宇宙学联合分析中的系统误差控制。
key_points: 外侧恒星质量被提出作为光学星系团选择量，以降低投影效应。
主要系统误差转为卫星星系污染，作者用基于近邻的 percolation 剔除方法缓解。
IllustrisTNG300 z=0.4 结果显示该方法有望得到较纯且较完整的大质量星系团样本。
methods: IllustrisTNG300 模拟
z=0.4 快照
中央星系外侧恒星质量 M_out，例：50-100 kpc 环带
friends-of-friends 卫星定义
基于距离的 percolation 方法
按 M_out 阈值和 percolation 半径评估纯度、完整性和卫星污染
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 M_out 与真实 halo mass 的散布、投影观测中的测量误差和恒星质量系统误差，以及 IllustrisTNG300 给出的卫星污染和 percolation 半径是否能迁移到实际光学巡天。

papers.title: How Inflation Might Explain Large-Scale Anisotropy
papers.abstract: Several recent observational analyses have suggested the possible existence of a large-scale anisotropy in our Universe. It is often thought that this would contradict the inflationary picture of the earliest times. We show that this is not the case: if we relax the artificial restriction that spacetime torsion must be zero, then such anisotropies arise naturally, indeed almost inevitably, in a theory of torsional Inflation. This is seen most clearly if one uses a ``$1\,+\,3\,$'' analysis of a torsional spacetime, leading naturally to concepts of intrinsic torsion and extrinsic torsion. An anisotropic quantum fluctuation of the inflaton leads to an extrinsic torsion field which is anisotropic and which grows throughout the inflationary era, even though the intrinsic geometry of the spatial sections is isotropised in the conventional manner. The competition between the intrinsic torsion (which does inflate away) and the extrinsic torsion leads to a short interval, early in the inflationary era, during which there is a torsion-induced energy flux, which leaves an anisotropic signal in superhorizon modes and thus ultimately at large scales in the present Universe.

analysis.title_zh: 暴胀可能如何解释大尺度各向异性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论近期观测分析所提示的宇宙大尺度各向异性是否与暴胀相矛盾，并提出在放宽“时空挠率为零”的限制后，挠率暴胀可自然产生此类各向异性。摘要称，通过带挠率时空的“1+3”分析，暴胀子各向异性量子涨落会产生并增强各向异性的外禀挠率场，从而在超视界模和当今大尺度结构中留下各向异性信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 大角尺度异常、低多极各向异性和统计各向同性检验一直是宇宙学中的敏感问题；若该机制成立，它提供了一种在暴胀框架内解释大尺度各向异性信号的理论路径，而不是将其视为暴胀的直接反例。
key_points: 讨论大尺度各向异性是否必然与暴胀图像冲突。
在允许时空挠率非零的暴胀理论中，各向异性可自然出现。
摘要声称超视界模中会留下由挠率诱导的各向异性信号。
methods: 带挠率时空的“1+3”分析
内禀挠率与外禀挠率的区分
暴胀子各向异性量子涨落的理论建模
超视界模的大尺度信号讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该挠率暴胀模型的动力学假设是否自洽、外禀挠率增长是否与标准暴胀的各向同性化兼容，以及其预言的大尺度各向异性是否可与 CMB 低多极观测约束相联系。

papers.title: Towards independent event horizon imaging of the supermassive black holes in M87 and the Milky Way
papers.abstract: The Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) Collaboration's images of the supermassive black holes in M87 and the Milky Way have provided the first event-horizon-scale views of these objects, opening new avenues for studies of gravitation, accretion physics, and black hole astrophysics. Achieving these results, however, requires imaging under some of the most challenging conditions in radio astronomy, including low signal-to-noise ratios, severe calibration uncertainties, and sparse aperture coverage. With the aim of presenting independent analyses of the public EHT datasets for M87* and Sgr A*, we adopt an approach that is independent in observables, and reconstruction methodology. Our framework is based on closure invariants, a class of interferometric observables that are intrinsically immune to station-based calibration errors and therefore provide robust constraints on source structure. We combine these observables with Generative Deep learning Image Reconstruction with Closure Terms (GenDIReCT), a diffusion-based image reconstruction framework that operates in the latent space of images conditioned on closure invariants. We present independent reconstructions obtained using GenDIReCT on synthetic challenge data sets as well as real EHT data on 3C279 and Centaurus A, and compare them with previously reported results. This work demonstrates the potential of closure-invariant-driven generative imaging as a calibration-resilient framework for Very Long Baseline Interferometry (VLBI) and provides an independent and complementary avenue for interpreting horizon-scale black hole observations.
papers.comment: 7 pages excluding references, 5 figures, submitted to Proceedings of SPIE Astronomical Telescopes + Instrumentation 2026
papers.journal_ref: Proc. SPIE 14153, Radio Telescopes, Technologies, and Methods, 141530O (17 Aug 2026)

analysis.title_zh: 迈向对 M87 和银河系中超大质量黑洞的独立事件视界成像
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 EHT 对 M87* 和银河系中心 Sgr A* 成像中低信噪比、校准不确定性和稀疏孔径覆盖等困难，采用对台站校准误差免疫的闭合不变量，并结合基于扩散模型的 GenDIReCT 图像重建框架。摘要称，该方法已在合成挑战数据和 3C279、Centaurus A 的真实 EHT 数据上给出独立重建，并与既有结果比较，显示其可作为抗校准误差的 VLBI 成像框架。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不是 CMB 研究本身，但与高精度天文成像和干涉测量方法有关；其闭合量、校准鲁棒重建和生成式先验的讨论，对理解强系统误差条件下的宇宙学观测数据反演有方法学参考价值。对 CMB 读者而言，相关性主要在统计成像、系统误差控制和贝叶斯/生成式重建思想，而非直接宇宙学参数约束。
key_points: 用闭合不变量降低台站校准误差对 VLBI 成像的影响。
将 GenDIReCT 扩散式生成重建用于合成挑战数据和真实 EHT 数据。
目标是为 M87* 与 Sgr A* 的事件视界尺度图像提供独立、互补的解释路径。
methods: 公开 EHT 数据集
闭合不变量 interferometric observables
Generative Deep learning Image Reconstruction with Closure Terms, GenDIReCT
扩散模型、图像潜空间重建
合成挑战数据集
真实 EHT 数据：3C279、Centaurus A
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其“独立性”具体体现在哪些观测量、先验和重建流程上，以及 GenDIReCT 与 EHT 已发表成像结果的比较是否受训练集、潜空间先验或闭合量选择影响。

papers.title: Diversity of Ionized Gas Structures in Nearby Metal-poor Dwarf Galaxies
papers.abstract: We investigate whether optical and far-infrared [O III] emission from nearby metal-poor dwarf galaxies can be represented by a homogeneous one-zone ionized-gas model with a single electron temperature and density. Our sample comprises five galaxies from the Herschel Dwarf Galaxy Survey: HS1222+3741, SBS0335-052E, POX186, Haro11, and IZw18. We combine galaxy-integrated or nearly galaxy-integrated [O III] 4363 and 5007 measurements from Seimei/KOOLS-IFU observations and published or archival spectroscopy with Herschel/PACS [O III] 88um measurements. Because [O III] 4363 is not detected in HS1222+3741, the analysis is based on the remaining four galaxies. SBS0335-052E and Haro11 lie near or slightly beyond the low-density boundary of the one-zone diagnostic. Their nominal line ratios favor effective densities of ne<1cm-3, while conservative treatment of the uncertainties allows values up to 40 and 10cm-3, respectively. These remain substantially below densities inferred from independent diagnostics. By contrast, POX186 and IZw18 show no significant discrepancy between the optical--far-infrared [O III] and low-ionization optical diagnostics. Additional optical and ultraviolet diagnostics show that inferred densities can span several orders of magnitude within a galaxy. Representative two-zone models reproduce the [O III] 4363, 5007, and 88um emission in SBS0335-052E and Haro11 by combining relatively dense gas with cooler, low-density gas. The low-density component contributes approximately 61% and 72% of the 88um luminosity, but only 14% and 23% of the 5007 luminosity, respectively. These solutions are not unique and may represent a broader unresolved distribution of gas conditions. Our results show that temperatures and densities inferred from integrated one-zone analyses are effective quantities and that similar diagnostic discrepancies can arise in nearby metal-poor galaxies.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to PASJ. Comments are very welcome!

analysis.title_zh: 附近贫金属矮星系中电离气体结构的多样性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究附近贫金属矮星系的光学与远红外 [O III] 发射是否可用单一电子温度和密度的一区模型表示，结合 Seimei/KOOLS-IFU、文献/档案光谱和 Herschel/PACS 88 微米数据。摘要报告，在四个可分析星系中，SBS0335-052E 和 Haro11 的一区诊断给出异常低的有效密度并与独立诊断不一致，而 POX186 和 IZw18 未显示显著差异；两区模型可复现前两者的 [O III] 线发射但解不唯一。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 贫金属矮星系常被用作早期星系和再电离时期星系的近邻类比体，因此其电离气体诊断会影响星系辐射场、金属丰度和星际介质结构的解释。对 CMB 宇宙学读者而言，它与再电离源建模和星系反馈背景相关，但不直接提供 CMB 观测或参数约束。
key_points: 检验贫金属矮星系的积分 [O III] 发射能否由单一区域电离气体模型描述。
部分星系的光学-远红外 [O III] 诊断与其他密度诊断存在差异。
两区模型可解释 SBS0335-052E 和 Haro11 中不同气体组分对 88 微米与 5007 线的不同贡献。
methods: Herschel Dwarf Galaxy Survey 五个星系样本
Seimei/KOOLS-IFU [O III] 4363 和 5007 观测
已发表或档案光谱
Herschel/PACS [O III] 88um 测量
一温度一密度 one-zone 电离气体模型
代表性 two-zone 模型
光学、远红外、紫外诊断
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对不同孔径和积分范围的光学、远红外、紫外数据如何匹配，以及两区模型参数是否存在强退化；摘要明确说解不唯一，因此不宜把具体组分比例过度解释为唯一物理结构。

papers.title: Optimal Extension Regularity at the McVittie Event Horizon
papers.abstract: We determine the optimal local extension regularity of the future black-hole event horizon in the exact spatially flat McVittie solutions sourced by a positive cosmological constant and a barotropic fluid with constant equation-of-state parameter $w>-1$. Let $H_\infty$ be the asymptotic Hubble constant, $κ$ the surface gravity of the limiting black-hole root, and $p=3(1+w)H_\infty/κ$. Ingoing radial null geodesics reach the horizon in finite affine length. A parallelly propagated angular curvature component is asymptotic to $C s^{p-2}$, with $C\ne0$ and $s$ the remaining affine distance, which excludes every anchored $C^2$ extension for $0<p<2$. For $p\ge2$ we construct a parameter-uniform Gaussian-null compactification and an explicit two-sided Lorentzian collar. If $p=N+\vartheta$ is nonintegral, with $N\ge2$ and $0<\vartheta<1$, the optimal regularity is the standard big Hölder class $C^{N,\vartheta}$: extensions of this class exist, whereas no $C^{N,\vartheta'}$ extension exists for $\vartheta'>\vartheta$. Every integer $p\ge2$ instead belongs to an analytic island and admits a real-analytic local extension. At the critical value $p=2$ the boundary Einstein endomorphism has a nonzero rank-one nilpotent part. The ratio of cosmological decay to horizon redshift therefore determines a sharp, arithmetic hierarchy of geometric regularity.

analysis.title_zh: McVittie 事件视界处的最优延拓正则性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究由正宇宙学常数和常数状态方程参数流体支撑的空间平直 McVittie 精确解中，未来黑洞事件视界的最优局部延拓正则性。摘要称，参数 p=3(1+w)H_∞/κ 决定从无 C² 延拓到 Hölder 类最优正则性、再到整数 p 情形解析延拓的层级。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: McVittie 时空描述嵌入宇宙膨胀背景中的黑洞，是连接黑洞物理、宇宙学常数和暗能量模型的严格相对论问题。对 CMB 研究者而言，它不直接影响 CMB 数据分析，但有助于理解含 Λ 或暗能量背景下局部强引力结构的数学一致性。
key_points: 研究带正宇宙学常数和平直空间切片 McVittie 解中未来黑洞事件视界的最优局部延拓正则性。
正则性由宇宙学衰减与视界红移的比值参数 p 控制。
摘要给出非整数 p 的 Hölder 正则性层级和整数 p 的解析延拓情形。
methods: 精确空间平直 McVittie 解
入射径向零测地线分析
平行传播曲率分量的渐近分析
Gaussian-null compactification
显式双侧 Lorentzian collar 构造
Hölder 正则性与解析延拓判别
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对参数 p 的定义、曲率分量渐近式如何排除更高正则延拓，以及整数 p 的“解析岛”是否依赖特殊坐标或边界构造。

papers.title: WIMP Freeze-Out in Diffusive Unimodular Gravity
papers.abstract: We study a non-standard cosmology (NSC) scenario within the Unimodular Gravity (UG) framework, sourced by a scalar field $φ$ that undergoes energy diffusion, parametrized by the diffusion parameter $x$, the initial energy densities rate $κ\equivρ_φ/ρ_γ|_{\text{ini}}$, and the end-of-domination temperature $T_{\text{end}}$. We compare this UG+NSC scenario with standard NSC and $Λ$CDM cosmologies for WIMP Dark Matter (DM) production via the freeze-out mechanism. We find that energy diffusion reshapes the allowed $(m_χ, \langleσv\rangle)$ parameter space, where $m_χ$ is the DM mass and $\langle σv \rangle$ is the thermally averaged annihilation cross section, opening regions otherwise excluded by DM overproduction in $Λ$CDM, and shifting the mass and cross-section ranges accessible to WIMP candidates depending on $x$, $κ$, $T_{\text{end}}$, and the barotropic index $ω$ of $φ$. As a concrete application, we implement this framework for the Real Singlet Scalar WIMP and test its $(m_χ, λ_{HS})$ parameter space against current direct detection bounds from the LZ experiment, showing that energy diffusion opens previously unconstrained regions in the Higgs-portal coupling $λ_{HS}$ and thereby alters the detectability prospects of this benchmark model in future searches.

analysis.title_zh: 扩散型单模引力中的 WIMP 冻结退耦
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在含能量扩散的单模引力非标准宇宙学中研究 WIMP 暗物质 freeze-out，并与标准非标准宇宙学和 ΛCDM 情形比较。摘要报告能量扩散会重塑暗物质质量与湮灭截面参数空间，并在实单态标量 WIMP 的 Higgs portal 耦合中打开部分此前受限或未约束的区域。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质热产生依赖早期宇宙膨胀史，因此任何偏离 ΛCDM 的非标准宇宙学都会影响 CMB 所约束的物质丰度和早期宇宙背景。该工作与 CMB 的关系主要在于其模型必须同 CMB 对暗物质密度、膨胀历史和额外能量组分的限制相容。
key_points: 研究单模引力中的能量扩散非标准宇宙学对 WIMP freeze-out 的影响。
比较 UG+NSC、标准 NSC 与 ΛCDM 下的暗物质产生参数空间。
以实单态标量 Higgs portal WIMP 为例，并与 LZ 直接探测限制比较。
methods: Unimodular Gravity 框架
含能量扩散的标量场非标准宇宙学
WIMP freeze-out 计算
与标准 NSC 和 ΛCDM 比较
Real Singlet Scalar WIMP 模型实现
LZ 直接探测界限检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对扩散参数 x、κ、T_end 与标量场状态方程参数 ω 如何进入膨胀史和热历史，以及这些非标准宇宙学设定是否满足 BBN、CMB 背景演化和结构形成约束。

papers.title: Does Early Dark Energy Absorb the DESI Late-Time Dynamics Signal? A Combined Analysis
papers.abstract: While the recent Baryon Acoustic Oscillation (BAO) measurements from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) collaboration are largely consistent with a flat $Λ$CDM cosmology, the preferred parameters are in mild tension with those determined from the cosmic microwave background (CMB). A late-time dynamical dark energy (DDE) solution has been proposed by the DESI collaboration to address this tension. In this work, we investigate whether the statistical preference for DDE is a genuine late-time phenomenon or an artifact of unresolved early-universe physics. To do so, we simultaneously allow for both early- and late-time modifications to the expansion history by combining the Early Dark Energy (EDE) framework with the Chevallier-Polarski-Linder (CPL) parametrization. Excluding the DESI BAO measurements, our joint analysis of the CMB+Pantheon+ datasets demonstrates that within an EDE-extended framework, the CPL parameters remain statistically consistent with the standard $Λ$CDM model. This supports the hypothesis that a DDE signal at low redshifts can be effectively accounted for by an EDE component within the $Λ$CDM background. However, upon the inclusion of the DESI BAO measurements in the joint analysis, a statistically significant deviation from a cosmological constant emerges. Within this combined framework, the best-fit CPL parameters robustly indicate a departure from the standard $Λ$CDM model, favoring a phantom-to-quintessence transition in the DE equation of state. This demonstrates that the DESI preference for the late-time DDE is a robust signature that cannot be absorbed by modifying the physics of the early Universe.

analysis.title_zh: 早期暗能量会吸收 DESI 的晚期动力学信号吗？一项联合分析
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检验 DESI 偏好的晚期动力学暗能量信号是否可能由早期宇宙物理、特别是早期暗能量所吸收，方法是在 EDE 框架中同时引入 CPL 晚期暗能量参数并做联合数据分析。摘要报告称，不含 DESI BAO 时 CMB+Pantheon+ 下 CPL 与 ΛCDM 相容；加入 DESI BAO 后仍出现偏离宇宙学常数的结果，偏好暗能量状态方程从 phantom 到 quintessence 的转变。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接处理 CMB 推断参数与 DESI BAO 晚期膨胀史之间的张力，并检验早期暗能量这种常用于缓解 CMB 相关张力的机制是否会误导晚期暗能量解释。它对判断 DESI 暗能量信号是早期物理退化效应还是晚期宇宙真实动力学具有直接意义。
key_points: 联合考察早期暗能量与晚期动力学暗能量。
不含 DESI BAO 时，CMB+Pantheon+ 中 CPL 参数在 EDE 扩展框架内与 ΛCDM 相容。
加入 DESI BAO 后，摘要称仍出现显著偏离宇宙学常数并偏好 phantom-to-quintessence 转变。
methods: CMB+Pantheon+ 联合分析
DESI BAO 数据的加入与排除对比
Early Dark Energy 框架
Chevallier-Polarski-Linder parametrization
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对数据组合、先验和模型参数退化如何影响“DESI 晚期 DDE 信号不能被 EDE 吸收”的结论，尤其是统计显著性和与 CMB 参数张力的关系。

papers.title: Bayesian Forecasts on Cosmic Superstring Searches with LISA
papers.abstract: Cosmic superstrings are well-motivated early-Universe sources of stochastic gravitational waves, with phenomenology controlled by the string tension $Gμ$ and the intercommutation probability $P$. We study whether LISA can reconstruct these parameters and distinguish different superstring signal models in the presence of instrumental noise and astrophysical foregrounds. We consider two phenomenological models. In Model I, reduced intercommutation acts only as an amplitude enhancement of a cusp-dominated spectrum, $Ω_{\rm SS}^{\rm I}=P^{-β}Ω_{\rm cusp}$. In Model II, the signal is a cusp--kink mixture, $Ω_{\rm SS}^{\rm II} =P^{-β}[p_cΩ_{\rm cusp}+(1-p_c)Ω_{\rm kink}]$, so that $P$ controls both amplitude and spectral shape. Using simulated LISA data, we perform Bayesian inference with noise uncertainties, unresolved extragalactic compact-binary backgrounds, and a flexible Galactic double-white-dwarf foreground. We compare the models using Bayesian evidences and map the $(Gμ,P)$ posterior geometry with marginalized widths, correlations, covariance anisotropy, principal eigenvalues, posterior area, and bias. We find that reduced intercommutation generically produces strong $Gμ$--$P$ correlations, because the data often constrain an amplitude-like combination. However, when the cusp--kink spectral difference lies in the LISA band and the signal is sufficiently loud, Model II can be favored and the posterior can retain genuine shape information. As an optimistic foreground scenario, we also compute the Bayes factor using a reduced tanh Galactic foreground template, finding improved model discrimination when the foreground shape is constrained.

analysis.title_zh: 用 LISA 搜索宇宙超弦的贝叶斯预测
analysis.summary_zh: 本文预测 LISA 是否能在仪器噪声和天体物理前景存在时重建宇宙超弦参数 Gμ 与 P，并区分两个随机引力波信号模型。作者用模拟 LISA 数据做贝叶斯推断和证据比较，摘要报告 reduced intercommutation 通常导致强 Gμ--P 相关，但在谱形差异进入 LISA 频段且信号足够强时，cusp--kink 混合模型可能被偏好。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接研究 CMB，但面向早期宇宙遗迹和随机引力波背景，与 CMB 对宇宙弦张力、早期宇宙相变或缺陷模型的约束互补。对 CMB 读者而言，关键价值在于理解未来空间引力波观测如何打破或暴露宇宙弦参数退化，并如何受银河前景建模限制。
key_points: 研究 LISA 对宇宙超弦随机引力波背景中弦张力 Gμ 与重联概率 P 的重建能力。
比较两个现象学信号模型，并把仪器噪声、河外致密双星背景和银河双白矮星前景纳入贝叶斯推断。
摘要称 Gμ--P 通常强相关；若 cusp--kink 谱形差异落在 LISA 频段且信号足够强，模型 II 可被偏好并保留谱形信息。
methods: 模拟 LISA 数据
贝叶斯推断
贝叶斯证据与 Bayes factor 模型比较
包含噪声不确定性、未分辨河外致密双星背景、灵活的银河双白矮星前景
后验几何量化：边缘宽度、相关、协方差各向异性、主特征值、后验面积、偏差
简化 tanh 银河前景模板的乐观前景情景
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对两类超弦谱模型的物理假设是否覆盖真实网络不确定性，以及前景模板选择、信号响度和 LISA 频段内 cusp--kink 谱形差异如何驱动 Bayes factor 与 Gμ--P 后验退化。

papers.title: Stochastic Schwinger Effect: de Sitter and beyond
papers.abstract: We develop a stochastic formulation of the Schwinger effect in de Sitter spacetime using the Schwinger--Keldysh (in-in) formalism, tailored to particle production by non-stationary gauge backgrounds in the early Universe. Treating the gauge field as a prescribed classical stochastic ensemble, we integrate out massless charged matter and derive the corresponding influence functional and particle-production kernel to leading non-trivial order in the gauge coupling. Conformal invariance allows the result to be extended directly from de Sitter to generic spatially flat FLRW spacetimes, without relying on asymptotic out states. We establish the infrared safety and classicality conditions of the stochastic description and clarify its relation to the conventional static Schwinger effect. We further extend the framework to massless conformally coupled scalars and to weakly coupled non-Abelian gauge sectors, including Standard Model and hidden-sector examples, in regimes where thermal corrections are negligible. Our results provide a general framework for matter creation by stochastic gauge fields in inflation, preheating, and non-thermal BSM sectors, connecting quantum field theory in curved spacetime with early-Universe and high-energy phenomenology.

analysis.title_zh: 随机 Schwinger 效应：de Sitter 及其以外
analysis.summary_zh: 本文为早期宇宙非定常规范背景中的 Schwinger 粒子产生建立随机场论表述。作者用 Schwinger--Keldysh 形式推导影响泛函和粒子产生核，并称结果可由 de Sitter 通过共形不变性推广到一般空间平坦 FLRW，同时扩展到共形耦合标量和弱耦合非阿贝尔扇区。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 的联系主要是间接的：它涉及暴胀、预热和非热新物理扇区中的粒子产生，这些过程可能影响早期宇宙能量组分、扰动源或后续可观测信号。对 CMB 研究者而言，它更像是早期宇宙微观机制的理论背景，而非直接给出 CMB 可观测量预测。
key_points: 建立 de Sitter 时空中随机规范场背景下 Schwinger 效应的随机表述。
使用 Schwinger--Keldysh in-in 形式，积分掉无质量带电物质并得到影响泛函和粒子产生核。
摘要称共形不变性允许结果推广到空间平坦 FLRW 时空，并讨论红外安全性、经典性条件及若干标量和非阿贝尔推广。
methods: Schwinger--Keldysh（in-in）形式
经典随机规范场系综
积分出无质量带电物质
影响泛函与粒子产生核的推导
规范耦合的领先非平凡阶展开
共形不变性推广到空间平坦 FLRW
无质量共形耦合标量与弱耦合非阿贝尔规范扇区扩展
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对随机规范场作为外加经典系综的适用条件、红外安全与经典性条件的具体判据，以及从 de Sitter 到一般空间平坦 FLRW 的推广是否依赖无质量和共形耦合等限制。

papers.title: TeV-scale leptogenesis in a parity symmetric neutrino mass model
papers.abstract: We study leptogenesis via out-of-equilibrium decays of right-handed neutrinos in a parity symmetric extension of the Standard Model with gauge group $SU(3)_c \times SU(2)_L \times SU(2)_R \times U(1)_X$, spontaneously broken to the Standard Model gauge group at a scale $v_R$. We focus on the minimal Higgs realization, in which the strong CP problem is resolved without invoking additional symmetries. In this framework, lepton number is violated through Yukawa interactions, while neutrino masses arise only at higher loop order, a feature that permits the CP-violating quantum corrections to right-handed neutrino decays to be parametrically large. For thermal production of right-handed neutrinos, we find that successful leptogenesis requires $v_R \gtrsim 6\times 10^{12}$ GeV. Non-thermal production, however, relaxes this bound dramatically, requiring only $v_R \gtrsim 10$ TeV, a scale accessible to collider searches for new particles and searches for rare processes.

analysis.title_zh: 奇偶对称中微子质量模型中的 TeV 尺度轻子生成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在一个奇偶对称的标准模型扩展中研究右手中微子非平衡衰变导致的轻子生成，其中轻子数由 Yukawa 相互作用破坏，而中微子质量只在高圈阶产生。摘要报告称，热产生右手中微子时成功轻子生成要求 v_R ≳ 6×10^12 GeV，而非热产生可将要求降至 v_R ≳ 10 TeV。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 轻子生成是解释重子不对称的重要粒子宇宙学机制，其参数空间会影响早期宇宙热史和可观测的新物理尺度。虽然本文不直接分析 CMB 数据，但重子不对称是 CMB 精确测量所约束的基本宇宙学背景量，因此这类模型与 CMB 所刻画的早期宇宙一致性相关。
key_points: 在奇偶对称的左-右规范扩展中研究右手中微子衰变产生轻子不对称。
热产生情形要求很高的 SU(2)_R 破缺尺度，非热产生可把尺度降到 TeV 量级。
摘要强调该模型同时涉及强 CP 问题、轻子数破坏和高圈阶中微子质量生成。
methods: 奇偶对称标准模型扩展，规范群 SU(3)_c × SU(2)_L × SU(2)_R × U(1)_X
右手中微子非平衡衰变的轻子生成机制
最小 Higgs 实现
热产生与非热产生右手中微子的比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对非热产生机制的具体假设、初始丰度来源以及重子不对称计算是否依赖额外未在摘要中说明的参数选择；同时检查 TeV 尺度可及性与现有对右手规范玻色子、稀有过程和中微子质量的限制是否一致。

papers.title: Design, assembly, and initial test results of a cryostat for holographic characterization of microwave telescopes
papers.abstract: We describe the design, fabrication, assembly, and room-temperature vacuum qualification of a 1.4-m long cylindrical cryostat developed for holographic testing of cryogenic microwave telescope optics. The system consists of a welded 6061-aluminum vacuum vessel containing nested 45- and 4-K aluminum radiation shields, cooled by a two-stage pulse-tube cryocooler through commercial OFHC copper flexible thermal straps. The intermediate 45-K stage intercepts radiative, conductive, and wiring heat loads from room temperature, while the 4-K stage defines the volume used for optical testing. The cryostat includes a 38-cm aperture for a microwave-transparent vacuum window and is sized to accommodate full-scale optical assemblies relevant to cosmic microwave background instrumentation. We summarize the cryostat architecture, lightweighted radiation shields, G-10 support flexures, welded vacuum-vessel fabrication, and room-temperature leak-checking campaign. Iterative helium leak checking and weld repair reduced the observed leak rate in the cryostat by over three orders of magnitude.
papers.comment: SPIE Astronomical Telescopes + Instrumentation 2026, paper 14156-89, 8 pages, 5 figures

analysis.title_zh: 用于微波望远镜全息表征的低温恒温器的设计、装配与初步测试结果
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍一套用于低温微波望远镜光学全息表征的1.4米圆柱形低温恒温器，涵盖设计、制造、装配和室温真空资格测试。摘要报告该装置采用嵌套45 K/4 K辐射屏和两级脉管制冷结构，并通过迭代氦检漏与焊缝修复将观测漏率降低超过三个数量级。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB实验的光学系统常在低温下工作，望远镜波前、反射/折射光学组件和窗口在真实热环境中的表征会影响波束模型、旁瓣控制和系统误差评估。该论文聚焦支持全尺寸低温光学组件全息测试的硬件平台，属于CMB仪器校准与系统误差控制的基础设施工作。
key_points: 介绍用于低温微波望远镜光学全息测试的1.4米圆柱形低温恒温器。
系统包含6061铝真空容器、嵌套45 K与4 K铝辐射屏，以及两级脉管制冷机。
室温氦检漏与焊缝修复使观测到的漏率降低超过三个数量级。
methods: 低温恒温器设计、制造与装配
室温真空资格测试
迭代氦检漏与焊缝修复
两级脉管制冷机、OFHC铜柔性热带、G-10支撑挠性件
微波透明真空窗孔径与低温辐射屏结构
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对真空与热设计是否足以支持实际4 K光学测试：包括最终漏率、预期热负载预算、冷却时间、窗口材料与全息测量链路对微波波前的影响；摘要只报告了室温真空资格结果，尚不能等同于低温运行性能。

papers.title: Detectable subhalo impacts in Milky Way streams
papers.abstract: Dark matter subhalos leave gravitational imprints in the stellar streams of the Milky Way. Observing individual strong impacts of subhalos offers a compelling way to constrain and discover potentially dark subhalos down to $10^6 M_\odot$, allowing for new tests of the particle physics properties of dark matter. We develop a pipeline and statistical framework to forecast the expected number of detectable subhalo impacts on stellar streams, based on morphological and kinematic data from surveys such as LSST and Via. Starting from a catalog of confirmed stellar streams, we focus our efforts on 14 promising streams that are relatively well-modeled with a particle spray algorithm. Our criteria for a detectable impact is a deviation at 95% CL from the best-fit polynomial proxy model for the stream, which accounts for stream modeling uncertainties and regulates the effect of distant impacts that are degenerate with these uncertainties. Among the 14 streams studied, we find that 5 streams have an expected number of detectable impacts greater than 0.2. With LSST and Via data, the stream Jet has $5.15^{+1.10}_{-0.95}$ expected detectable impacts, followed by Orphan-Chenab ($1.40^{+0.62}_{-0.47}$), ATLAS-Aliqa Uma ($1.25^{+0.60}_{-0.44}$), GD-1 ($0.55^{+0.43}_{-0.28}$), and Palomar 5 ($0.40^{+0.39}_{-0.23}$), where error bars are the 95% containment on the Poisson mean. These values rely on the assumed subhalo population, which can give a factor of few systematic uncertainty in the predictions. We also consider effects of different particle dark matter models on the number of impacts, finding a suppression by a factor of $\sim 4$ for warm dark matter and fuzzy dark matter models at their current mass bounds and an $O(1)$ enhancement for a toy model of self-interacting dark matter.

analysis.title_zh: 银河系恒星流中可探测的亚晕撞击
analysis.summary_zh: 本文预测银河系恒星流中由暗物质亚晕造成的可探测强引力扰动数量，以评估 LSST 和 Via 等数据对低质量暗亚晕的发现潜力。作者建立包含恒星流建模不确定性的统计流程，摘要给出若干恒星流的预期碰撞数，并指出温暗物质和模糊暗物质在当前质量下限附近会压低碰撞数，自相互作用暗物质玩具模型可带来量级为一的增强。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不以 CMB 为核心，但它检验小尺度暗物质结构，是 CMB 所约束的宇宙学模型向非线性、小尺度延伸的重要互补。CMB 主要约束早期宇宙和大尺度暗物质性质，而恒星流亚晕扰动可直接探测或限制小质量暗物质结构，从而区分冷、温、模糊或自相互作用暗物质情景。
key_points: 研究银河系恒星流中暗物质亚晕强碰撞信号的可探测数量。
基于已确认恒星流目录，重点分析 14 条可用 particle spray 算法较好建模的恒星流。
摘要报告 Jet、Orphan-Chenab、ATLAS-Aliqa Uma、GD-1 和 Palomar 5 的预期可探测碰撞数较高，但结果依赖亚晕族群假设并有数倍系统不确定性。
methods: 面向 LSST 和 Via 等巡天的形态学与运动学数据预测框架
恒星流目录筛选
particle spray 算法建模
以最佳拟合多项式代理模型的 95% CL 偏离作为可探测碰撞准则
Poisson 均值的 95% containment 误差表示
比较温暗物质、模糊暗物质和自相互作用暗物质玩具模型对碰撞数的影响
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对多项式代理模型如何吸收恒星流建模不确定性、95% CL 可探测准则是否会漏掉与模型退化的真实碰撞，以及亚晕质量函数和空间分布假设如何导致数倍系统误差。

papers.title: Low Ly$α$ Visibility in Galaxy Overdensities: Reionization Topology and Neutral-Fraction Ceilings from DIVER over $4.8<z<11$
papers.abstract: Ly-alpha emission is widely used to trace cosmic reionization, but its interpretation depends on how Ly-alpha visibility varies with galaxy environment. We use deep JWST/NIRSpec observations from Deep Insights into UV Spectroscopy at the Epoch of Reionization (DIVER) in GOODS-N to measure Ly-alpha visibility for 250 galaxies at 4.8<z<11. The sample contains 84 Ly-alpha detections, including 44 strong emitters with rest-frame Ly-alpha equivalent width W_Lyalpha>25 A. We combine these measurements with H-alpha and [O III] emitters from JWST/NIRCam wide-field slitless spectroscopy to map the density field around each DIVER galaxy. Galaxies with high Ly-alpha equivalent widths (W_Lyalpha>25 A) or high effective Ly-alpha escape fractions (f_esc,Lyalpha^eff>0.05) tend to lie farther from nearby H-alpha and [O III] emitters than galaxies with lower Ly-alpha visibility. The clearest signal occurs near the prominent GOODS-N overdensity at z~5.2, where fewer than 15% of galaxies show strong Ly-alpha emission. This trend is opposite to the simplest inside-out reionization expectation that overdensities produce larger ionized regions and enhance Ly-alpha visibility. Possible explanations include circumgalactic and local intergalactic opacity, dense absorbers, and gas kinematics. We also derive an empirical upper envelope for f_esc,Lyalpha^eff and calibrate it with reionization simulations. Interpreting this envelope as a limiting IGM-attenuation signal gives neutral-fraction ceilings of <x_HI>_max=0.36, 0.76, 0.74, 0.84, and 1.0 at z~5.2, 5.8, 6.7, 7.7, and 9.8, respectively. The z~8 ceiling disfavors an almost completely neutral IGM at this epoch. These results support patchy reionization already underway by z~8 and show that galaxy Ly-alpha visibility encodes both large-scale ionization topology and near-source gas structure.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 17 figures, 3 tables; submitted to ApJ

analysis.title_zh: 星系过密区中的低 Lyα 可见度：DIVER 在 4.8<z<11 给出的再电离拓扑与中性氢比例上限
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 GOODS-N 中 DIVER 的 JWST/NIRSpec 深度观测测量 4.8<z<11 的 250 个星系 Lyα 可见度，并结合 JWST/NIRCam 无缝光谱的 Hα 与 [O III] 发射体刻画局部密度场。摘要报告高 Lyα 可见度星系反而更远离发射体密集区域，z≈5.2 过密区强 Lyα 比例低，并由经验 f_esc,Lyalpha^eff 上包络推得若干红移处中性氢比例上限，支持 z≈8 时再电离已呈斑块状进行。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离历史会影响 CMB 的 Thomson 光学深度和大尺度极化信号，而高红移 Lyα 可见度是约束再电离拓扑与中性氢比例的重要外部探针。该工作强调 Lyα 不只反映大尺度电离泡，也受近源气体结构影响，因此对把星系观测与 CMB 再电离约束联合解释很重要。
key_points: DIVER 的 JWST/NIRSpec 样本用于测量 4.8<z<11 星系的 Lyα 可见度。
高 Lyα 等效宽度或高有效逃逸分数的星系更倾向于远离邻近 Hα 和 [O III] 发射体。
摘要报告的趋势与最简单的 inside-out 再电离图像相反，并给出中性氢比例上限估计。
methods: JWST/NIRSpec 深度光谱观测 DIVER GOODS-N 样本
250 个 4.8<z<11 星系的 Lyα 可见度测量
JWST/NIRCam 宽场无缝光谱中的 Hα 和 [O III] 发射体用于绘制密度场
与再电离模拟校准的 f_esc,Lyalpha^eff 经验上包络
数值/模拟解释 IGM 衰减限制
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对密度场重建、Lyα 可见度选择函数、等效宽度/逃逸分数阈值以及把经验上包络解释为 IGM 衰减并转化为中性氢比例上限的假设是否稳健。

papers.title: The Challenge of Observing Patchy Reionization with CMB Optical-Depth Fluctuations
papers.abstract: Spatial fluctuations in the Thomson optical depth encode information about the inhomogeneous nature of cosmic reionization. We compute the optical-depth angular power spectrum, $C_\ell^{ττ}$, using past lightcones constructed from five Cosmic Reionization on Computers (CROC) radiation-hydrodynamical simulations. By decomposing the electron-density field into patchy and density components, we quantify the separate contributions of ionization-fraction and baryon-density fluctuations to the optical-depth anisotropy. Because the simulations end at $z\approx5$, we supplement the reionization-era signal with an analytic estimate of the fully ionized low-redshift contribution. We find that baryon-density fluctuations dominate the high-redshift signal over most angular scales, while the accumulated low-redshift contribution exceeds the high-redshift signal across the full multipole range considered. Our results demonstrate that a significant fraction of the optical-depth power is not uniquely associated with reionization morphology, implying that future interpretations of $C_\ell^{ττ}$ must account for the density contribution in addition to patchy ionization.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 CMB 光学深度涨落观测斑块状再电离的挑战
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究用 CMB Thomson 光学深度涨落观测斑块状再电离的困难，基于五个 CROC 辐射流体模拟光锥计算 C_l^{ττ}，并区分电离分数涨落与重子密度涨落的贡献。摘要报告称，重子密度涨落在多数角尺度上主导高红移信号，而累积的低红移完全电离贡献在所考虑的多极范围内超过高红移信号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 光学深度及其各向异性是约束再电离历史和形态的重要途径，但本文指出 C_l^{ττ} 并不只反映斑块电离结构，还包含密度涨落和低红移电离气体的贡献。这会影响未来 CMB 实验用光学深度重建解释再电离泡结构、再电离时间尺度和相关宇宙学参数的可靠性。
key_points: 用 CROC 辐射流体模拟光锥计算 CMB 光学深度涨落功率谱。
将电子密度场分解为斑块再电离和密度涨落贡献。
摘要称重子密度涨落和低红移完全电离贡献会显著污染或主导 C_l^{ττ}。
methods: 五个 CROC 辐射流体模拟构造的过去光锥
计算 Thomson 光学深度角功率谱 C_l^{ττ}
电子密度场的 patchy 与 density 分量分解
对 z≈5 以下完全电离低红移贡献作解析估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对高红移模拟终止于 z≈5 后的低红移解析补充、密度与电离分量分解定义，以及这些处理如何影响未来用 C_l^{ττ} 反演再电离形态的可行性。

papers.title: Diffuse HI emission in the circumgalactic medium of NGC891 and NGC4565 - III: azimuthal profiles
papers.abstract: Diffuse HI emission in the circumgalactic medium (CGM) of NGC891 and NGC4565 has been previously shown to trace an inflow along minor axes pointings and to co-rotate with the HI disk along major axes pointings out to ~100 kpc (Das2020b,Das2024a). To obtain a 360$^\circ$ view of the inner neutral CGM ($\rm < 25 kpc$ for NGC891, $\rm < 30 kpc$ for NGC4565), we perform deep stare observations with the Green Bank Telescope (GBT) along the off-axes, 45$^\circ$ between principal axes, achieving a 5$σ$ column density sensitivity of $1.1-1.2 x 10^{17} \rm cm^{-2}$ over a 20 kms$^{-1}$ velocity width. While detecting HI emission in the inner CGM with single-dish telescopes is common, separating the true CGM emission from disk contamination is extremely challenging and has so far been largely unsuccessful. To achieve that, we compare our single-dish detections to deep interferometric maps from the Westerbork Synthesis Radio Telescope (WSRT) HALOGAS survey, and improve upon our previous methods by incorporating velocity offset corrections and channel-wise brightness-temperature scaling. We find that $30-38$ % and $18-28$ % of the emission detected by the GBT cannot be explained by WSRT in NGC891 and NGC4565, respectively, implying a true CGM detection. There is $4-6$ ($3-7$) times more HI along the off-axes than major (minor) axes, nullifying the common assumption of azimuthal symmetry of the neutral CGM. The velocity profile of the diffuse inner CGM suggests a lagged co-rotation with the HI disk in both galaxies. This exercise illustrates the power of deep observation and careful cross-instrument comparisons to characterize the diffuse HI in the CGM.
papers.comment: Accepted to ApJ. 18 pages and 9 figures

analysis.title_zh: NGC891 和 NGC4565 环星系介质中的弥散 HI 发射 III：方位角轮廓
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 NGC891 和 NGC4565 内部中性环星系介质的 HI 方位分布，利用 GBT 在偏离主轴 45 度方向的深观测，并与 WSRT HALOGAS 深干涉图比较以剔除盘发射污染。摘要报告称，GBT 探测到的一部分 HI 不能由 WSRT 盘发射解释，偏离主轴方向的 HI 多于主轴和次轴方向，表明中性 CGM 不满足方位对称并可能相对 HI 盘滞后共转。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于近邻星系和环星系介质研究，与 CMB 本身关系较远。其宇宙学相关性在于重子循环、冷气体吸积和星系形成反馈会影响低红移物质分布与重子预算，是解释大尺度结构和星系形成模型时的背景物理。
key_points: 使用 GBT 深积分观测 NGC891 和 NGC4565 内部中性 CGM 的偏离主轴方向。
通过与 WSRT HALOGAS 干涉图比较来分离盘污染和真实 CGM HI 发射。
摘要称中性 CGM 的方位分布不满足常用的方位对称假设，并显示相对 HI 盘的滞后共转。
methods: Green Bank Telescope 深 stare 观测
Westerbork Synthesis Radio Telescope HALOGAS 深干涉图
单碟与干涉数据交叉比较
速度偏移修正
逐通道亮温缩放
HI 21 cm 柱密度灵敏度观测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对 GBT 与 WSRT 数据匹配、速度偏移修正和逐通道亮温缩放如何影响“真实 CGM”分量的分离，因为盘污染处理是结论成立的核心。

papers.title: Viability of Big Bang Nucleosynthesis in $f(R,L_m)$ Gravity
papers.abstract: We examine the viability of Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN) constraints in $f(R,L_m)$ gravity, where the gravitational Lagrangian is an arbitrary function of the the Ricci scalar $R$ and matter Lagrangian density $L_m$. We derive stringent bounds on the underlying model parameters of four different $f(R,L_m)$ gravity models by examining both the primordial abundances of helium-4 ($^4\text{He}$) and the fractional variations in the neutron--proton freeze out temperature. Our results reveal that $f(R,L_m)$ gravity remains viable under the BBN constraints. With the freeze-out condition offering the most dominat constraint on the parameter space, whereas the bounds from $^4\text{He}$ abundance act as a separate abundance level consistency checks on the modified expansion rate. In summary, the presence of these feasible parameter regions demonstrates that $f(R,L_m)$ gravity models can successfully accommodate primordial element abundances without disrupting standard early Universe dynamics.

analysis.title_zh: $f(R,L_m)$ 引力中大爆炸核合成的可行性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 $f(R,L_m)$ 修改引力是否能满足大爆炸核合成约束。作者针对四种模型，利用氦-4 原初丰度和中子-质子冻结温度分数变化推导参数界限，摘要称这些模型仍存在不破坏标准早期宇宙动力学的可行参数区。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: BBN 是 CMB 之外约束早期宇宙膨胀史和引力理论的关键探针；任何修改引力若改变辐射时代的哈勃率，也会影响 CMB 对有效自由度、重子密度和早期宇宙物理的解释。因此这类工作可作为 CMB 约束修改引力模型前的早期宇宙一致性筛选。
key_points: 论文检验 $f(R,L_m)$ 引力在大爆炸核合成约束下是否可行。
作者使用氦-4 原初丰度和中子-质子冻结温度分数变化来限制四类模型参数。
摘要报告存在可行参数区域，且冻结条件给出最主要的参数空间约束。
methods: 大爆炸核合成约束分析
四种 $f(R,L_m)$ 引力模型的参数限制
氦-4 原初丰度检验
中子-质子冻结温度分数变化约束
修改膨胀率与标准早期宇宙动力学的一致性检查
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对四个 $f(R,L_m)$ 模型的具体形式、物质拉氏量选择、修改膨胀率推导，以及 BBN 约束是否只用了氦-4和冻结温度而未纳入氘丰度等更强或互补的轻元素限制。

papers.title: Inferring the Dark from the Observable: Estimating Halo Masses Using Galaxy Properties
papers.abstract: The formation and evolution of galaxies are interconnected with that of their host halos. Given this closely related evolutionary history, it should follow that galaxy properties are correlated with their host halo mass. Previous works have shown that star formation rates of galaxies in cluster halos differ systematically from those in field halos, suggesting that host halo mass plays a significant role in the history of galaxy evolution. Here, we examine the correlations between observable galaxy properties - such as stellar mass, star formation rate, half-stellar radius, $r-$band magnitude, and color - and the underlying host halo mass of galaxies. Central galaxy observables are used to probe host halo mass, while satellite galaxy properties are used to estimate subhalo mass. We perform this analysis using random forest, ordinary least squares (OLS), and symbolic regression. Random forest regression can assess the relative significance of different observable galaxy properties, while OLS and symbolic regression can quantify their relationship with the host halo mass. Our results show that gas mass is generally the most significant property in central galaxies of all halo mass ranges, followed by stellar mass and observed $r-$band magnitude. Adding parameters such as the colour and magnitude of galaxies improves host halo mass estimations compared to standard stellar-to-halo mass relations. These results show that halo mass likely has a multi-dimensional dependence on galaxy properties and open the avenue of finding a simple way to constrain halo mass based on what is directly observable in galaxy surveys. Finding the observables that have the strongest correlation with halo mass can also motivate future surveys on which areas to concentrate in detail.

analysis.title_zh: 从可观测量推断暗物质：利用星系性质估计晕质量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究能否用星系的恒星质量、恒星形成率、半恒星半径、r 波段星等、颜色等可观测性质估计宿主晕质量，并分别用中心星系和卫星星系信息探测宿主晕与子晕质量。摘要报告称，随机森林、OLS 和符号回归分析显示中心星系中气体质量通常最重要，加入颜色和星等等信息可优于标准恒星-晕质量关系。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 晕质量是连接星系巡天与大尺度结构、弱透镜和 CMB 透镜交叉相关的重要中介量。若能用多维星系可观测量更好地估计晕质量，将有助于构建星系-晕连接模型、校准星系偏置，并改善与 CMB 透镜或 SZ 星系团研究相关的质量代理。
key_points: 研究可观测星系性质与宿主晕质量或子晕质量的相关性。
随机森林结果显示气体质量通常是中心星系中最重要的预测量，其次为恒星质量和观测 r 波段星等。
加入颜色、星等等多参数信息可改进相对于标准恒星-晕质量关系的晕质量估计。
methods: 随机森林回归
普通最小二乘回归（OLS）
符号回归
中心星系可观测量用于探测宿主晕质量
卫星星系性质用于估计子晕质量
使用的星系性质包括恒星质量、恒星形成率、半恒星半径、r 波段星等、颜色和气体质量
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对样本或模拟/观测目录的来源、训练与测试划分、气体质量等量是否在真实巡天中可直接观测，以及随机森林重要性是否受特征相关性和选择效应影响。

papers.title: Dipolar power asymmetry in wide-angle correlations of galaxy density, velocity and ellipticity
papers.abstract: The large-scale structure of the universe has the potential to probe anomalies suggested by observations of the cosmic microwave background. In this work, we focus on a position-dependent dipolar modulation of the primordial power spectrum and develop a full-sky formalism for computing correlation functions of galaxy density, velocity and ellipticity. By comparing the correlation functions obtained with and without the plane-parallel approximation, we show that wide-angle corrections become non-negligible for opening angles $Θ\gtrsim 30^\circ$. Our results demonstrate that wide-angle corrections must be taken into account when testing the dipolar modulation with future large-scale structure surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 星系密度、速度和椭率宽角相关中的偶极功率不对称
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 CMB 观测提示的偶极功率不对称，研究其在大尺度结构中的可检验信号，建立了星系密度、速度和椭率相关函数的全天计算形式。摘要报告称，与平行平面近似相比，开角 Θ≳30° 时宽角修正变得不可忽略，因此未来巡天检验偶极调制时必须纳入这些修正。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 大尺度反常中的偶极功率不对称若有原初起源，应在大尺度结构中留下相关信号；该文关注从星系巡天独立检验 CMB 反常时所需的宽角理论建模，对连接 CMB 异常与晚期宇宙结构观测有直接意义。
key_points: 研究由位置依赖偶极调制的原初功率谱引起的大尺度结构相关函数信号。
建立了星系密度、速度和椭率相关函数的全天形式。
摘要指出开角 Θ≳30° 时宽角修正不可忽略。
methods: 位置依赖的原初功率谱偶极调制模型
星系密度、速度和椭率相关函数的全天形式计算
与平行平面近似下相关函数的比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其全天相关函数形式如何处理观测量的投影、规范选择和红移空间效应，以及 Θ≳30° 的“不可忽略”在具体巡天误差预算中意味着多大偏差。

papers.title: The progenitors of $z\gtrsim10$ JWST galaxies in the COLIBRE simulations
papers.abstract: JWST has revealed a large population of luminous galaxies ($M_{\rm UV}\lesssim -20$) at redshifts $z \gtrsim 10$, widely interpreted as posing a challenge to models of galaxy formation within the $Λ$CDM cosmology. Here, we search for counterparts of the JWST galaxies in the COLIBRE simulations of galaxy formation. Although these simulations have not been tuned to reproduce any $z > 0$ observations, we find a population of COLIBRE galaxies with properties similar to those of the JWST galaxies, and trace them to their earliest evolutionary phases, $z\simeq25$, to investigate the onset of galaxy formation. We study the evolution of galaxy stellar masses, sizes, star formation rates, UV magnitudes, metallicities, central black hole masses, and molecular gas and dust content, finding good agreement with observationally inferred properties at $z > 10$, except for UV magnitudes and dust masses, which COLIBRE underpredicts and overpredicts, respectively. Our results indicate that the standard galaxy formation physics and $Λ$CDM cosmology adopted in COLIBRE are sufficient to reproduce a broad range of properties of the most extreme $z > 10$ JWST galaxies - including their compact sizes, stellar masses, gas content, and metallicities. We show that the discrepancies with the UV magnitudes and dust masses can both be attributed to the uncertain rate of grain growth at high redshift, possibly alongside a top-heavy stellar initial mass function. These findings provide strong evidence that the standard cosmological model can naturally explain even the most extreme galaxies in the early Universe.

analysis.title_zh: COLIBRE 模拟中 z≳10 JWST 星系的前身天体
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 COLIBRE 星系形成模拟中寻找 z≳10 JWST 亮星系的对应体，并将其追踪到 z≈25 以研究星系形成开端。摘要称，在标准星系形成物理和 ΛCDM 宇宙学下，模拟能较好解释这些早期极端星系的尺寸、恒星质量、气体含量和金属丰度等性质，但低估 UV 亮度并高估尘埃质量。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: JWST 高红移亮星系是否挑战 ΛCDM 是当前宇宙学和早期结构形成的重要问题，也影响再电离历史、早期恒星形成效率以及与 CMB 光学深度约束的一致性。该文摘要支持标准 ΛCDM 加常规星系形成物理可解释多数观测性质，但关键仍取决于高红移尘埃和 IMF 等天体物理不确定性。
key_points: 在 COLIBRE 星系形成模拟中寻找 z≳10 JWST 亮星系的对应体。
模拟未针对 z>0 观测调参，但摘要称可再现多类高红移星系性质。
UV 星等和尘埃质量存在偏差，作者将其归因于高红移尘埃晶粒增长率不确定，并可能涉及偏重高质量恒星的 IMF。
methods: COLIBRE 星系形成模拟
追踪模拟星系至 z≈25 的早期演化
比较恒星质量、尺寸、恒星形成率、UV 星等、金属丰度、中心黑洞质量、分子气体和尘埃含量
与 JWST z>10 观测推断性质比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 JWST 样本选择与模拟对应体匹配标准，尤其是 UV 星等、尘埃质量、尘埃增长和 IMF 假设如何共同影响“ΛCDM 足以解释极端早期星系”的论断。

papers.title: Towards end-to-end Bayesian forward models in global 21-cm cosmology: surrogate modelling and marginalisation of beam uncertainty
papers.abstract: Robust statistical inference in global 21-cm cosmology requires end-to-end uncertainty quantification that jointly handles the highly degenerate cosmological signal, foreground emission, and instrumental response. Although electromagnetic simulations capture physical antenna properties in a parametrised way, multi-hour runtimes make their integration within likelihood-based sampling frameworks infeasible. Most existing approaches therefore assume a single precomputed beam, a fragile assumption given our demonstration that realistic mismatches can severely bias the recovered cosmological and foreground parameters. To address this, we present an accelerated and differentiable Bayesian framework that incorporates an informed surrogate representation of chromatic beam uncertainty directly into a forward-modelling pipeline. Treating the physical antenna properties as nuisance quantities, we apply a two-stage decomposition directly to simulated directivity patterns, reducing the instrumental parameterisation by two orders of magnitude while retaining the angular and spectral structure required for accurate beam reconstruction. Exploiting the linearity of the resulting surrogate, we use analytical marginalisation to allow the continuous instrumental uncertainty to be propagated into the final posteriors and Bayesian evidence without directly sampling the beam space. Testing the framework against a suite of unseen beams and cosmological signals, we recover the true inputs at approximately the instrumental-noise level. We further show that, for the uncertainty considered here, as few as 100 electromagnetic simulations are sufficient to construct an effective surrogate, substantially reducing the simulation burden for future analyses. This framework provides a scalable, statistically rigorous route towards hardware-accelerated uncertainty quantification in global 21-cm cosmology.

analysis.title_zh: 迈向全球 21-cm 宇宙学中的端到端贝叶斯前向模型：替代建模与波束不确定性的边缘化
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对全球 21-cm 宇宙学中宇宙学信号、前景和仪器响应高度退化的问题，提出把色散波束不确定性纳入端到端贝叶斯前向模型的可加速、可微框架。摘要称该方法用少量电磁模拟构建替代模型，并通过解析边缘化把连续仪器不确定性传递到后验和贝叶斯证据，在未见过的波束与宇宙学信号测试中可在约仪器噪声水平恢复真实输入。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 全球 21-cm 信号是 CMB 之后、再电离和宇宙黎明时期的重要互补探针，其系统误差控制与前景分离难度类似甚至高于 CMB 实验中的波束和前景问题。该工作关注仪器波束不确定性如何进入宇宙学后验，对 CMB 读者理解低频射电宇宙学的系统误差传播、似然构建和模型比较有直接参考价值。
key_points: 面向全球 21-cm 宇宙学的端到端贝叶斯前向建模。
用替代模型表示色散波束不确定性，并把天线物理参数作为 nuisance quantities。
通过解析边缘化传播连续仪器不确定性，避免直接采样波束空间。
methods: 电磁模拟 directivity patterns
替代模型 surrogate modelling
两阶段分解
可微贝叶斯前向建模 pipeline
解析边缘化
Bayesian evidence
未见过的 beams 和 cosmological signals 测试
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对波束不确定性的参数化范围是否覆盖真实硬件误差、两阶段分解对角向与频谱结构的保真度、解析边缘化所依赖的线性假设，以及测试中前景模型与宇宙学信号退化是否足够接近实际观测。

papers.title: Constraining Cosmic-Ray Acceleration and Escape in Middle-Aged Supernova Remnants with GeV-TeV Gamma-Ray Observations
papers.abstract: In this work, we perform a systematic, time-dependent study of the gamma-ray emission from four representative middle-aged SNRs (W51C, IC~443, W44, W28), incorporating both CRs within the remnant shells and escaped CRs interacting with surrounding molecular clouds. We compare our results with GeV--TeV gamma-ray observations from Fermi-LAT, H.E.S.S., MAGIC, and LHAASO, including a dedicated analysis of the Fermi-LAT data for regions A and B associated with W28. We find that the observed spectra favor steeper CR injection spectra with indices of \(α\sim4.2\)--\(4.3\), maximum proton energies of $\sim$ \(100\)--\(300\) TeV, diffusion coefficients below the Galactic average, and CR acceleration efficiencies from a few to tens of percent. In particular, the VHE emission detected by LHAASO from W51C is more naturally explained by escaped CRs interacting with a nearby molecular cloud. We also investigate the contribution of escaped CRs to the VHE emission from IC~443, W44, and W28. We further demonstrate that escaped CRs can substantially enhance the TeV neutrino flux from middle-aged SNRs, improving their prospects as potential neutrino sources. These results provide new constraints on CR acceleration and escape in middle-aged SNRs and highlight the important role of escaped CRs in shaping their high-energy gamma-ray and neutrino emission.

analysis.title_zh: 用 GeV-TeV 伽马射线观测约束中年超新星遗迹中的宇宙线加速与逃逸
analysis.summary_zh: 本文对 W51C、IC 443、W44、W28 四个代表性中年超新星遗迹的 GeV-TeV 伽马射线辐射进行系统的时间依赖研究，同时纳入遗迹壳层内宇宙线和逃逸宇宙线与分子云的相互作用。摘要报告观测谱支持较陡注入谱、约 100-300 TeV 的最大质子能量、低于银河平均的扩散系数，并指出 W51C 的 LHAASO 甚高能辐射更自然地由逃逸宇宙线解释。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接研究 CMB，但涉及银河系高能源、宇宙线传播和伽马射线前景。对 CMB 研究者而言，相关意义主要在于理解银河高能辐射和宇宙线环境，而非原初宇宙学参数约束。
key_points: 研究对象是中年超新星遗迹中的宇宙线加速、逃逸及其伽马射线辐射。
观测谱倾向于较陡的宇宙线注入谱、低于银河平均的扩散系数，以及从几个百分点到几十个百分点的加速效率。
逃逸宇宙线可能显著影响甚高能伽马射线和 TeV 中微子通量。
methods: 时间依赖的伽马射线发射建模
同时考虑遗迹壳层内宇宙线和逃逸宇宙线与周围分子云相互作用
与 Fermi-LAT、H.E.S.S.、MAGIC、LHAASO 的 GeV-TeV 观测比较
对 W28 相关 A、B 区域进行专门 Fermi-LAT 数据分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模型中壳层内宇宙线与逃逸宇宙线两部分的相对贡献如何被观测谱区分，以及扩散系数、最大质子能量和注入谱指数之间是否存在强退化。

papers.title: Estimation of systematic error from bulk deformation of end test mass induced by photon calibrator for LIGO post-O5 gravitational wave projects
papers.abstract: We studied the bulk deformation of the end test masses (ETMs) of gravitational wave (GW) detectors caused by calibration devices named Photon Calibrator (Pcal). This bulk deformation is one of the source of calibration error since it induces non-linear displacement from the ideal pendulum motion of the ETM. Particularly, it is the dominant error source above 1500 Hz which is crucial to the studies of neutron star mergers. The displacement also depends on beam offsets of the main interferometer (IFO) beam and Pcal beams. We conceptually described frequency dependent effect of bulk deformation and evaluated it in several cases of the beam offset with finite-element analysis (FEA) software, for ETM models of Advanced LIGO (aLIGO), KAGRA, Advanced Virgo (AdVirgo), and LIGO A#.

analysis.title_zh: 由光子校准器诱导的端测试质量体形变导致的系统误差估计：面向 LIGO 后 O5 引力波项目
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 LIGO 后 O5 引力波项目中，光子校准器作用于端测试质量所引起的体形变及其带来的系统校准误差。摘要报告作者用有限元分析在多种光束偏移情形下评估了 aLIGO、KAGRA、Advanced Virgo 和 LIGO A# 的端测试质量模型，并强调该效应在 1500 Hz 以上对中子星并合研究相关的校准误差很重要。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接研究 CMB，但与精密宇宙学的实验系统误差控制有方法论关联。高频引力波校准会影响中子星并合波形与多信使宇宙学推断，而这些推断可与 CMB 给出的宇宙学参数约束互补。
key_points: 研究对象是光子校准器引起的端测试质量体形变。
摘要称该效应在 1500 Hz 以上是主导校准误差源，并与干涉仪主光束和 Pcal 光束偏移有关。
使用有限元分析比较 aLIGO、KAGRA、Advanced Virgo 与 LIGO A# 的 ETM 模型。
methods: 对体形变的频率依赖效应作概念性描述
有限元分析（FEA）软件
不同光束偏移情形
Advanced LIGO、KAGRA、Advanced Virgo、LIGO A# 的端测试质量模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对有限元模型的边界条件、材料与几何参数、光束偏移设定，以及体形变如何转化为频率依赖校准误差；还需确认“1500 Hz 以上主导误差源”在各探测器模型中的适用范围。

papers.title: Automatically distinguishing Rubin transients from AGN using variability metrics
papers.abstract: Stochastic variability of active galactic nuclei (AGN) can produce contaminants in the search for explosive extragalactic transients (such as supernovae and tidal disruption events). In the new era of the Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), previously uncatalogued AGN, especially those with luminosity near the survey detection limits, are expected to produce a flood of detections that have the potential to contaminate surveys targeting other transients, leading to inefficient use of spectroscopic follow-up time. For surveys aiming to statistically characterise transient demographics, it is advantageous to use easily modelled and reproducible selection criteria to distinguish AGN from other transients, rather than machine learning. We test enacting cuts based on simple data-driven photometric variability parameters to distinguish non-AGN extragalactic transients from standard AGN variability on both Zwicky Transient Facility photometry and simulated LSST photometry from the MALLORN data set. We also investigate the impact of light curve history availability, redshift range and filter selection on selection efficiency. We find that a two-dimensional cut incorporating the ratio of detection flux and pre-detection standard deviation and the ratio of detection flux to pre-detection mean flux is the most effective cut. This approach is easily scalable as these values are included in the LSST alert packets. We provide estimates of the completeness and purity of the sample produced by enacting this cut, and gauge the AGN contamination avoided. The parameters utilised in this approach could also be implemented as features for identifying AGN in a photometric classifier.

analysis.title_zh: 使用变异性指标自动区分 Rubin 暂现源与活动星系核
analysis.summary_zh: 本文面向 Rubin Observatory/LSST 的海量警报，研究如何用简单、可建模且可复现的光度变异指标自动区分 AGN 随机变光与超新星、潮汐瓦解事件等河外爆发暂现源。摘要报告作者在 ZTF 光度和 MALLORN 模拟 LSST 光度上测试多种切割，发现由探测流量相对预探测标准差和预探测平均流量构成的二维切割最有效，并给出完整度、纯度和避免 AGN 污染的估计。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 本身关系较远，但与大规模时域巡天的数据筛选和后续光谱资源分配有关。LSST 暂现源样本可服务于超新星宇宙学和低红移结构/膨胀史研究，这些结果通常与 CMB 约束联合用于检验宇宙学模型。
key_points: 目标是在 Rubin/LSST 时代用简单可复现的光变指标区分 AGN 与爆发型河外暂现源。
测试数据包括 ZTF 光度和 MALLORN 模拟 LSST 光度。
摘要称最有效的是结合探测流量与预探测标准差之比、探测流量与预探测平均流量之比的二维切割。
methods: 基于数据驱动光度变异参数的选择切割
Zwicky Transient Facility 光度数据
MALLORN 数据集中的模拟 LSST 光度
考察光变曲线历史、红移范围和滤光片选择对选择效率的影响
完整度、纯度和避免的 AGN 污染估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 AGN 与非 AGN 暂现源样本如何构建、ZTF 到 LSST 模拟的域差异、完整度和纯度的定义，以及二维切割在不同红移、滤光片和光变历史长度下是否稳定。

papers.title: Technical Proposal for the Atom Interferometer CERN Experiment (AICE) Facility
papers.abstract: We present the technical proposal for the Atom Interferometer CERN Experiment (AICE), a $\mathcal{O}(100)$ m vertical atom interferometer to be installed against the wall of the PX46 access shaft to the LHC. AICE is conceived as a versatile and flexible long-baseline atom-interferometry facility whose primary scientific goal is probing for bosonic ultralight dark matter (ULDM) in a mass range inaccessible to other experiments, with a secondary goal of pioneering the exploration of gravitational waves (GWs) with frequencies in the range ${\sim}$0.03-3 Hz as a pathfinder for future longer-baseline detectors. The initial configuration employs ultracold $^{87}$Sr atoms in a single-photon 698-nm interferometer with three shaft-based atom sources in a multi-source gradiometer geometry, supported by one surface reference source for laser stabilisation and diagnostics, to target scalar ULDM. Operation with $^{88}$Sr will give sensitivity to axion-like particles (ALPs), vector ULDM with $B-L$ couplings and violation of the principle of equivalence, while a $^{171}$Yb upgrade will improve the sensitivity to $B-L$ couplings and equivalence violations. Probing the Einstein equivalence principle (EP) and measuring $α$ will proceed in parallel with the ULDM searches. A conceptual feasibility study and a detailed technical implementation study have established that PX46 is a uniquely mature and implementation-ready site, with no technical showstoppers. Completing site preparation works during LS3 would enable the subsequent installation and operation of AICE without impacting HL-LHC operations. The detector design builds on the VLBAI and MAGIS experiments and the AION-10 Technical Design Report, scaling the strontium gradiometer architecture to the $\sim$100 m baseline. AICE is endorsed by the TVLBAI Proto-Collaboration, comprising 57 institutions in 22 countries.
papers.comment: 170 pages, 64 figures, 24 tables. Technical Proposal for CERN review process of AICE

analysis.title_zh: CERN 原子干涉实验（AICE）设施技术提案
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 CERN 原子干涉实验 AICE 的技术方案：在 LHC PX46 竖井中建设约 100 米垂直原子干涉仪，以探测当前其他实验难以覆盖的玻色型超轻暗物质，并作为未来更长基线中频引力波探测器的先导。摘要称可行性和技术实施研究认为 PX46 场址成熟且没有技术阻碍，初始设计采用 87Sr 多源梯度仪架构，并可通过 88Sr 和 171Yb 扩展物理目标。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 超轻暗物质和中频引力波都是 CMB 宇宙学之外的重要互补探针：前者可与 CMB 对暗物质性质和等效原理的约束形成互补，后者覆盖 CMB B 模和激光干涉仪之间的频段空白。该文主要是仪器与实验方案，对 CMB 读者属于相关但非直接的宇宙学基础设施进展。
key_points: AICE 是拟安装在 CERN LHC PX46 竖井中的约 100 米垂直原子干涉仪设施。
主要科学目标是探测玻色型超轻暗物质，次要目标是作为 0.03-3 Hz 引力波探测的先导设施。
方案还包括等效原理检验和精细结构常数 α 测量。
methods: 约 100 米垂直长基线原子干涉仪
超冷 87Sr 原子
698 nm 单光子干涉仪
三个位于竖井中的原子源构成多源梯度仪几何
一个地表参考源用于激光稳定和诊断
88Sr 运行方案与 171Yb 升级方案
PX46 场址概念可行性研究和详细技术实施研究
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对其超轻暗物质质量范围和 0.03-3 Hz 引力波灵敏度的来源、关键系统误差预算，以及 PX46 场址和 LHC 运行环境对噪声与可实施性的约束。

papers.title: Broadband Chiral Primordial Gravitational Waves from Constant-roll Inflation in Parity-violating Symmetric Teleparallel Gravity
papers.abstract: We investigate primordial gravitational waves (GWs) generated during constant-roll inflation in a parity-violating extension of symmetric teleparallel gravity. The parity-violating interactions leave the background evolution and linear scalar perturbations unchanged, while inducing velocity birefringence in the tensor sector. Consequently, one of the two circular polarization states undergoes tachyonic amplification, producing a strongly blue and nearly fully chiral tensor spectrum from the cosmic microwave background (CMB) to interferometer scales. We identify viable constant-roll parameter regions consistent with current CMB constraints and determine the largest coupling strength compatible with both CMB B-mode measurements and the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) O1--O4a bound on the stochastic GW background. The predicted CMB B-mode spectra may be detectable by LiteBIRD, while the enhanced high-frequency signal could be accessible to the LISA--Taiji network and LVK O5 run. The model also predicts nonvanishing TB and EB correlations. These results highlight the potential of combining CMB and multi-band GW observations to test parity-violating gravity during inflation.

analysis.title_zh: 宇称破坏对称遥平行引力中常滚动暴胀产生的宽频手征原初引力波
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究宇称破坏对称遥平行引力中的常滚动暴胀如何产生原初引力波，并指出宇称破坏相互作用不改变背景和线性标量扰动，但会在张量扇区引入速度双折射，使一个圆偏振态发生快子放大。摘要报告称该机制可在从 CMB 到干涉仪尺度产生强蓝倾、近乎完全手征的张量谱，并可受 CMB B 模、LVK 随机背景及未来多频段观测检验。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初引力波及其手征性直接关系到 CMB B 模、TB/EB 相关和暴胀期引力理论的检验；该工作把 CMB 偏振与 LISA、Taiji、LVK 等引力波观测联系起来，是面向 CMB B 模和宇称破坏新物理的高相关研究。
key_points: 研究常滚动暴胀和宇称破坏对称遥平行引力中的原初引力波。
宇称破坏相互作用使张量模出现速度双折射，并放大一个圆偏振态。
摘要称模型可产生手征张量谱、TB/EB 相关，并受 CMB B 模与 LVK 随机背景约束。
methods: 常滚动暴胀模型
宇称破坏的对称遥平行引力扩展
张量扇区速度双折射与快子放大分析
当前 CMB 约束、CMB B 模测量和 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O1--O4a 随机引力波背景约束
LiteBIRD、LISA--Taiji 和 LVK O5 的可探测性讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对可行常滚动参数区间如何同时满足标量扰动、CMB B 模和 LVK 约束，以及“近乎完全手征”和 TB/EB 信号是否依赖特定耦合取值或稳定性条件。

papers.title: Probing Sub-GeV Dark Matter with the Migdal Effect at JUNO
papers.abstract: We discuss the sensitivity of the JUNO neutrino detector to the Migdal ionization signal triggered by nuclear scattering events produced by sub-GeV weakly interacting massive particles (WIMPs). Exploiting JUNO's large target mass and the annual modulation effect we find that the aggregate rate from many independent and indistinguishable WIMP events in JUNO's liquid scintillator can be isolated from the total dark rate of the photomultipliers, potentially providing for spin-dependent interactions a world-leading sensitivity across the sub-GeV mass range.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 JUNO 中的 Migdal 效应探测亚 GeV 暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论 JUNO 中微子探测器利用核散射触发的 Migdal 电离信号探测亚 GeV 弱相互作用大质量粒子暗物质的潜力。摘要称，借助 JUNO 的大靶质量和年调制效应，许多不可区分 WIMP 事件的总率可从光电倍增管总暗率中分离出来，并可能在自旋相关相互作用的亚 GeV 质量范围给出领先灵敏度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文主要属于暗物质直接探测与中微子探测器应用，对 CMB 研究的联系较间接；其宇宙学意义在于补充 CMB 对暗物质性质和丰度的间接约束，尤其是低质量暗物质参数空间的实验检验。
key_points: 讨论 JUNO 对亚 GeV WIMP 诱发 Migdal 电离信号的灵敏度。
利用 JUNO 大靶质量和年调制效应区分聚合信号与光电倍增管暗计数。
摘要称自旋相关相互作用在亚 GeV 质量范围可能达到世界领先灵敏度。

液体闪烁体靶
Migdal 电离信号
