analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对暗率背景建模、年调制提取方法、Migdal 电离率计算和系统误差假设，因为摘要中的灵敏度结论很可能依赖这些实验细节。

papers.title: Axion-like particle at the 10 GeV scale: Higgs decays to wide jets and photons
papers.abstract: If axion-like particles (ALPs) exist, they may have renormalizable couplings only to the Higgs boson ($h^0$) or to fields beyond the Standard Model. An ALP $A_h$ lighter than about 60 GeV would allow the $h^0 \to A_h A_h$ decay, with a branching fraction determined by the explicit global symmetry breaking responsible for the main contributions to the $A_h$ mass ($M_A$). New heavy fields that carry color and electric charge, such as squarks, can mediate $A_h$ decays at one loop mostly into gluons, but also into photons. Exploring LHC sensitivity to $A_h$, we show that the $h^0 \to A_h A_h \to (gg)(γγ)$ channel leads to a diphoton resonance at $M_A$ whose production rate is consistent with a $3.5σ$ excess reported by a CMS search at $M_A \approx 13.6$ GeV. For $M_A$ of order 10 GeV, the $h^0 \to A_h A_h \to 4g$ cascade decay leads to two wide jets (each with 2-prong substructure) that form a resonance at 125 GeV.

analysis.title_zh: 10 GeV 标度的类轴子粒子：Higgs 衰变到宽喷注和光子
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究约 10 GeV 质量的类轴子粒子 Ah，其可通过 Higgs 衰变 h0 -> Ah Ah 产生，并经由新重带色荷/电荷场的一圈效应主要衰变为胶子、也可衰变为光子。摘要称 ggγγ 通道可给出与 CMS 在约 13.6 GeV 报告的双光子共振超额一致的产生率，而 4g 级联衰变会表现为两个带双叉子结构的宽喷注并重建到 125 GeV。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文属于粒子现象学，与 CMB 的联系较间接；类轴子粒子常出现在暗物质和早期宇宙模型中，但这篇摘要聚焦 LHC Higgs 衰变信号，而非 CMB 可观测量或宇宙学约束。
key_points: 讨论一种约 10 GeV 标度的类轴子粒子，可通过 Higgs 衰变成对产生。
该粒子可由带色荷和电荷的新重场经一圈过程衰变为胶子和光子。
摘要称 ggγγ 末态可对应 CMS 在约 13.6 GeV 双光子共振处报告的 3.5σ 超额，4g 末态表现为两个宽喷注并在 125 GeV 成共振。
methods: 类轴子粒子与 Higgs 的有效耦合情景分析
Higgs 级联衰变通道 h0 -> Ah Ah
一圈诱导的 Ah -> gg 和 Ah -> γγ 衰变
LHC/CMS 双光子共振搜索结果对比
宽喷注及 2-prong 子结构的现象学讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模型参数如何同时满足 Higgs 总宽度、现有 LHC 异常 Higgs 衰变搜索、低质量双光子共振限制，以及所谓 CMS 3.5σ 超额是否为局部显著性并是否经受其他数据检验。

papers.title: The MAGPI Survey: Emission Line Products Data Release and the Role of Spectroscopic Aperture Covering Fraction on the Balmer Decrement-Stellar Mass Relation
papers.abstract: The Middle Ages Galaxy Properties with Integral field spectroscopy (MAGPI) survey is a Large Program on the European Southern Observatory Very Large Telescope using the MUSE instrument. This paper presents the data release for the MAGPI emission line products and includes emission line maps for 836 galaxies at $0.05\leq z_\mathrm{spec}\leq 0.424$ ($\mathrm{H}α$-window) and aperture-based emission line measurements for 2,607 galaxies at $0.05\leq z_\mathrm{spec}\leq 1.50$ (upper bound is [OII] cut-off), both based on the GIST software, for all 56 MAGPI fields. We use these data to examine dust attenuation, which represents a major source of uncertainty in the derived properties of galaxies that are critical to constrain models of galaxy evolution. We examine the role that the spectroscopic aperture covering fraction ($f_c$) has on the relationship between the Balmer decrement ($\mathrm{BD}=F(\mathrm{H}α)/F(\mathrm{H}β)$; a common proxy for dust attenuation) and the total stellar mass ($M_\star$). Several studies have suggested that the BD-$M_\star$ relation may be redshift invariant; however, the compared surveys often have different $f_c$ due to their differing fibre or slit sizes that can cause systematic offsets. Our results indicate that $f_c$ has a significant impact on this relationship, due to galaxies having negative BD radial gradients, which are more negative for more massive galaxies at $z\lesssim0.4$. Comparing spectroscopic surveys with $\left<f_c\right> \gtrsim 0.5$, we find that the BD-$M_\star$ relation shows a preference for redshift evolution and is roughly consistent with the behaviour of UV stellar continuum attenuation redshift evolution ($A_\mathrm{FUV}$-$z$), with the average dust attenuation in galaxies peaking at $z\sim1.2$ and decreasing at lower and higher redshifts.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 16 figures, 9 tables. These data products are being hosted on Data Central (https://docs.datacentral.org.au/magpi/). They are also available as .zip files for download here (https://cloud.datacentral.org.au/teamdata/MAGPI/public/). Accepted for publication in MNRAS

analysis.title_zh: MAGPI 巡天：发射线产品数据发布以及光谱孔径覆盖比例在 Balmer Decrement-恒星质量关系中的作用
analysis.summary_zh: 本文发布 MAGPI 巡天的发射线数据产品，并利用这些数据研究光谱孔径覆盖比例 f_c 对 Balmer decrement 与总恒星质量关系的影响。摘要报告 f_c 对该关系有显著影响，原因与星系中负的 BD 径向梯度有关；在覆盖比例较高的巡天比较中，BD-M_star 关系更倾向存在红移演化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于星系演化和观测系统学，对 CMB 本身没有直接影响。它与宇宙学的联系在于星系尘埃衰减、发射线测量和巡天选择效应会影响星系样本的物理解释；对 CMB 研究者而言，相关性更多体现在多波段巡天交叉分析和前景/星系系统学背景知识。
key_points: 发布 MAGPI 发射线产品，包括发射线图和孔径发射线测量。
研究光谱孔径覆盖比例对 Balmer decrement-恒星质量关系的系统影响。
结果指向孔径覆盖比例会影响尘埃衰减关系，并可能影响不同红移巡天之间的比较。

ESO VLT/MUSE 积分场光谱
GIST 软件
836 个星系的发射线图，0.05≤z_spec≤0.424
2607 个星系的孔径发射线测量，0.05≤z_spec≤1.50
Balmer decrement F(Hα)/F(Hβ)

BD-M_star 关系比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对：孔径覆盖比例 f_c 的定义和测量方式、径向 BD 梯度如何进入系统偏差修正，以及不同巡天样本选择是否足以支持红移演化判断。

papers.title: PowerFull: fast and accurate computation of the relativistic angular galaxy power spectrum including local primordial non-Gaussianity
papers.abstract: Current and forthcoming wide-field galaxy surveys, such as SPHEREx and Euclid, provide a unique opportunity to probe the ultra-large scales of structure formation, where primordial non-Gaussianity, often parameterized by $f_\text{NL}$, is expected to leave its most detectable imprint. At the same time, these surveys inevitably enter regimes where relativistic and wide-angle effects become significant, requiring careful modeling to extract unbiased cosmological information. We address these challenges by applying the total-angular-momentum (TAM) formalism to describe redshift-space clustering beyond the flat-sky approximation. The standard Fourier-mode description, which characterizes distortions by the angle between a mode and a line of sight, becomes ill-defined over wide fields, whereas the TAM basis naturally separates radial and angular contributions and incorporates the relevant relativistic effects. Within this framework, we provide a new parameterization of wide-angle predictions that can be compared directly with survey data. We then introduce PowerFull, a modification of the Julia-based 2-FAST package, which enables efficient computation of the full relativistic angular power spectrum. Finally, using Fisher information matrix-based analyses, we show that a survey like SPHEREx reaches $σ(f_\text{NL}) \sim 1$, but that neglecting the relativistic and wide-angle contributions shifts the recovered $f_\text{NL}$ by an amount of order its own uncertainty: at this precision the inferred value is biased unless the clustering is modeled consistently.

analysis.title_zh: PowerFull：包含局域型原初非高斯性的相对论性星系角功率谱的快速精确计算
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对宽场星系巡天在超大尺度上测量局域型原初非高斯性 f_NL 时必须处理相对论和宽角效应的问题，采用总角动量形式并实现 PowerFull 来快速计算全相对论角功率谱。摘要称，SPHEREx 类巡天可达到 σ(f_NL) 约为 1，但若忽略相对论和宽角项，恢复的 f_NL 会产生约为自身不确定度量级的偏差。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 局域型 f_NL 是检验暴胀机制和原初扰动的重要窗口，并与 CMB 的原初非高斯性约束互补；该工具和建模提醒说明，未来大尺度结构与 CMB 联合分析若要达到 σ(f_NL)≈1 的精度，必须一致处理超大尺度相对论投影效应。
key_points: 面向 SPHEREx、Euclid 等宽场星系巡天的超大尺度聚类建模。
使用 TAM 形式超越平直天近似，纳入相对论和宽角效应。
摘要报告若忽略这些效应，f_NL 的恢复值会出现与自身不确定度同量级的偏移。
methods: 总角动量 TAM 形式
红移空间聚类建模
全相对论角功率谱计算
Julia 版 2-FAST 的修改程序 PowerFull
Fisher 信息矩阵分析
SPHEREx 类巡天预测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 TAM 参数化与观测数据向量的对应关系、PowerFull 与既有全相对论计算的精度验证，以及 Fisher 偏差估计对巡天设定和尺度截断的依赖。

papers.title: CosmoPyro: Gradients for Gravitational-Wave Cosmology
papers.abstract: Gravitational-wave (GW) observations of stellar-mass compact binary coalescences directly measure the source luminosity distance. Combined with the source redshift, these measurements constrain the current expansion rate of the Universe, the Hubble constant, $H_0$, or $h=H_0 / [100 \,{\rm km \,s^{-1} \, Mpc^{-1}}]$. For most GW signals no electromagnetic redshift measurement is expected, but the GW signal itself depends on the redshifted (detector-frame) masses. Assuming a source-frame mass distribution therefore enables a redshift estimate for each source. Combining the redshift estimates with the distance measurements provides a weak constraint on $H_0$ for each individual source that tightens with the number of sources in the catalog. However, the shape of the source-frame mass distribution is not known a priori, and previous work has relied on parametric models (piecewise power-laws with Gaussian components), and one-dimensional Gaussian processes. Here, we introduce CosmoPyro, a fully differentiable hierarchical Bayesian inference code that models the mass distribution using either one- or two-dimensional Gaussian processes. With the latest GW transient catalog (GWTC-5) we find $h = 0.66^{+0.17}_{-0.20}$ and $h = 0.57^{+0.20}_{-0.15}$ (median with $1σ$ uncertainty), for the one- and two-dimensional case, respectively. Despite the noticeably different inferred mass distributions, both models yield $H_0$ values consistent with the latest LVK measurements within $1 σ$. While our main results marginalize over the Gaussian-process power-spectrum hyperparameters, the measurement is also robust against fixing these hyperparameters over a range comparable to their measured uncertainty.

analysis.title_zh: CosmoPyro：用于引力波宇宙学的梯度方法
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 CosmoPyro，一个用于引力波宇宙学的全可微分层级贝叶斯推断代码，通过对源质量分布采用一维或二维高斯过程建模，从无电磁红移的致密双星事件中统计约束 H0。摘要报告基于 GWTC-5 得到的 h 约为 0.66 和 0.57，两种质量分布模型的结果均与最新 LVK 测量在 1σ 内一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: H0 是 CMB 推断与低红移测量张力的核心参数；暗标准汽笛提供与 CMB 声学标尺不同的独立低红移约束，因此这类可微分层级推断工具有助于检验宇宙学参数张力是否来自系统误差或模型假设。
key_points: 用恒星质量致密双星引力波的距离和质量红移退化来约束 H0。
CosmoPyro 是全可微分的层级贝叶斯推断代码。
质量分布用一维或二维高斯过程建模，摘要报告结果与最新 LVK 测量在 1σ 内一致。
methods: 全可微分层级贝叶斯推断
一维高斯过程质量分布模型
二维高斯过程质量分布模型
GWTC-5 引力波暂现源目录
对高斯过程功率谱超参数边缘化
固定超参数的稳健性检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对质量分布非参数建模与 H0 的退化如何被处理、GWTC-5 选择效应和探测效率是否完整纳入，以及一维和二维高斯过程给出不同质量分布但 H0 仍一致的原因。

papers.title: Testing MOND-like modifications to gravity using growth-rate measurements and one-loop corrections to the matter power spectrum
papers.abstract: We develop a perturbative framework for structure formation in a broad class of MOND-like theories characterized by a generalized nonlinear Poisson equation. We derive the modified evolution equations governing matter perturbations and obtain the corresponding linear growth equation, extending the analysis into the mildly nonlinear regime through one-loop corrections to the matter power spectrum. Beyond the theoretical framework, we perform a cosmological analysis based on two phenomenological scenarios: one parametrized by a quantity controlling the degree of nonlinearity in the generalized Poisson equation, and another describing the interplay between the MOND acceleration scale and the cosmological acceleration associated with the background expansion. We constrain these scenarios using recent measurements of the growth rate of structure, $fσ_8$, DESI-DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation data, and Type Ia supernova compilations. We find no statistically significant evidence for departures from the standard $Λ$CDM cosmology. The inferred constraints are fully consistent with the GR + $Λ$CDM scenario within the current observational uncertainties. At nonlinear scales, we note that MOND-like modifications can alter $P_{\rm NL}(k)$ and leave signatures that current and future high-precision large-scale-structure observations may probe. Our results establish a systematic connection between MOND-like gravitational dynamics and large-scale structure observations, providing a consistent framework to assess the phenomenological viability of MOND-inspired modifications of gravity in a cosmological context.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 7 figures and 2 table. Comments are welcome!

analysis.title_zh: 利用增长率测量和物质功率谱的一圈修正检验 MOND 类引力修正
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对由广义非线性泊松方程表征的一类 MOND 类引力理论，推导结构形成的线性增长方程，并用一圈修正扩展到弱非线性物质功率谱。作者结合 fσ8、DESI-DR2 BAO 和 Ia 型超新星数据约束两个现象学情景，摘要报告当前没有发现相对标准 GR + ΛCDM 的统计显著偏离。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 本身强约束早期宇宙和初始扰动，但修改引力常通过晚期结构增长和物质功率谱表现出来；这类工作可为将 CMB 与 BAO、超新星、RSD/增长率及未来大尺度结构数据联合检验 ΛCDM 和广义相对论提供模型化接口。
key_points: 建立了广义非线性泊松方程下 MOND 类理论的结构形成微扰框架。
用 fσ8、DESI-DR2 BAO 和 Ia 型超新星数据约束两个现象学情景。
摘要称当前未发现相对 GR + ΛCDM 的统计显著偏离，但非线性物质功率谱可能留下可探测特征。
methods: 广义非线性泊松方程
物质扰动演化方程与线性增长方程推导

papers.title: Mapping the Information Geometry of an Unresolved Dark Matter Population using a Differentiable Strong Lensing Simulator
papers.abstract: Strong gravitational lensing is a unique probe of the matter power spectrum on small scales, where the abundance of dark matter subhalos in galaxies could be used to distinguish the predictions of the concordance cold dark matter model from alternatives such as warm dark matter. Extracting this signal poses major computational challenges, since perturbations of the lensing potential induced by substructure can be degenerate with both the macro-model of the lens and highly flexible models of the background source. Here, we introduce a framework to quantify these degeneracies using a differentiable strong-lensing simulator. Substructure is represented in a spectral basis confined to an annular domain surrounding the lensed image, allowing signals from a population of NFW subhalos to be encoded in a finite vector space. We then use the Fisher matrix to determine how much information about substructure is absorbed by nuisance components of the model. We find that macro-model degeneracies are largely confined to low-order perturbations of the lensing potential, while degeneracies with the source model can strongly suppress sensitivity across a broad range of scales as the expressivity of the source model is increased. Finally, we introduce the Fisher Graph Laplacian prior as a diagnostic tool to study how the internal degeneracies of the source model can be used to regulate the sensitivity of the data to an unresolved population of dark matter subhalos.

analysis.title_zh: 使用可微强透镜模拟器绘制未分辨暗物质群体的信息几何
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用可微强透镜模拟器研究未分辨暗物质子晕群体信号与透镜宏模型、背景源模型之间的退化。作者以环形区域谱基表示子结构扰动，并用 Fisher 矩阵量化信息损失，摘要报告宏模型退化主要集中在低阶透镜势扰动，而更灵活的源模型会在更宽尺度范围内显著抑制对子结构的敏感度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 小尺度物质功率谱和暗物质子结构是区分冷暗物质与温暗物质等模型的重要观测窗口；这与 CMB 对初始功率谱和暗物质总体丰度的约束互补，尤其有助于检验 CMB 一致宇宙学模型在星系尺度以下的延伸。
key_points: 提出用可微强透镜模拟器量化未分辨暗物质子结构的信息几何。
将子结构扰动限制在透镜像附近环形区域的谱基中，并用 Fisher 矩阵分析退化。
摘要指出源模型越灵活，越可能在广泛尺度上压低对子晕信号的敏感度。

环形区域内的谱基表示

papers.title: The Cross-Survey Decade: A Call to Action
papers.abstract: By 2027, three flagship wide-field surveys will be operating simultaneously from ground and space, observing overlapping sky and representing more than $6 billion in US and European public investment. Together they will produce overlapping petabyte-scale datasets across thousands of square degrees. This is a different class of challenge: the observations are no longer the bottleneck; realizing their joint scientific return now depends on shared computational infrastructure and coordination. Decades of community studies show that combining these datasets does more than improve precision. For science ranging from weak lensing to transient discovery and Galactic-plane astronomy, joint processing and analysis can unlock capabilities no single survey provides alone. Yet the required infrastructure -- joint pixel-level processing, cross-calibration and validation, interoperable data access, and the people to build and sustain it -- falls outside any single mission or institution's mandate. We issue a call to action for cross-survey science infrastructure, built around four pillars: (1) joint pixel-level processing and validation; (2) an AI-ready data substrate for scientific foundation models; (3) standardized, interoperable data access across surveys, democratizing participation in astrophysical discovery; and (4) dedicated personnel and career pathways. We outline concrete steps for policymakers, agencies, observatories, universities, the research community, and philanthropy, and argue that the moment to act is now, while foundational technical choices can still be aligned at a fraction of the cost of reconciling them later.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 1 figure. Community perspective on cross-survey science infrastructure

analysis.title_zh: 跨巡天十年：行动呼吁
analysis.summary_zh: 本文不是报告新的宇宙学测量，而是针对 2027 年左右地面与空间旗舰宽场巡天重叠运行提出跨巡天基础设施倡议。摘要主张通过联合像素级处理、AI-ready 数据底座、互操作访问和专门人员机制，释放弱透镜、暂现源与银河面等联合科学收益。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 研究越来越依赖与光学/近红外大尺度结构、弱透镜和星系巡天的交叉相关来约束暗能量、物质分布、系统误差和前景。该倡议若落实，将影响 CMB 透镜、星系交叉相关、簇宇宙学和多信使暂现源关联分析所需的数据互操作与联合定标基础。

papers.title: Towards Quantum-Dot Detectors as Barcodes for Dark Matter Interactions
papers.abstract: Quantum dots are tunable semiconductor nanocrystals that can be produced at industrial scales. We present the first ab initio calculation of the scattering of dark matter on electrons bound in quantum dots. The momentum-dependence of a quantum dot's electronic response depends on its morphology and on the dark matter mass, interaction operator, mediator coupling, and mediator mass. Therefore, the relative rates across an array of distinct quantum dot targets form a ``barcode'' that carries information about the nature of the dark matter interaction. We project the sensitivity of a detector concept in which a collection of independent target subunits, each loaded with silicon quantum dots of a particular morphology, are read out by Skipper CCDs. Given a future signal, this barcode could discriminate between interaction operators and mediator types. We quantify the discrimination power for a benchmark pair of models as a function of readout noise and exposure.

analysis.title_zh: 迈向将量子点探测器用作暗物质相互作用条形码
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出将不同形貌的量子点靶组成阵列，用其电子响应的动量依赖性为暗物质相互作用生成相对率“条形码”。摘要称作者完成了暗物质散射量子点束缚电子的首个从头计算，并投影了由硅量子点与 Skipper CCD 读出构成的探测概念在不同噪声和曝光下的模型判别能力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇更偏粒子暗物质直接探测而非 CMB 分析；其宇宙学关联在于 CMB 主要约束暗物质丰度和部分相互作用性质，而实验室低质量暗物质探测可提供互补的微观相互作用信息。
key_points: 给出暗物质与量子点束缚电子散射的首个从头计算。
不同形貌量子点阵列的相对计数率可形成暗物质相互作用“条形码”。
摘要称未来信号下该方案可能区分相互作用算符和媒介类型，并评估读出噪声与曝光量影响。

papers.title: Imprints of Mass Accretion History on Galaxy Cluster Morphology
papers.abstract: Variations in dynamical states of galaxy clusters can introduce biases and scatter in observable-mass relations. The dynamical state of a cluster is an emergent feature of its mass accretion history (MAH), it is therefore useful to constrain the MAH of the cluster. In this work, we characterize 305 massive clusters from The300 project by connecting features from their projected stellar distributions to their mass accretion histories (MAH). As a baseline, we first correlate host dark matter halo dynamical state indicators at $z=0$ with their MAH via the Spearman rank correlation coefficient $ρ_{\mathrm{sp}}$. Both substructure mass fraction and center-of-mass offset measurements correlate strongly with the MAH measured between $0.1\lesssim z\lesssim 1$. We repeat this exercise with morphological measurements of projected stellar density maps, many of which exhibit moderate correlation strength with different times in the MAH. Broadly, core morphological measurements ($r \leq 30\,\mathrm{kpc}$) correlate better with early-time MAH. Core-excised ($50\,\mathrm{kpc} \leq r \leq 1\,\mathrm{Mpc}$) morphological measurements correlate better with late-time MAH. We further quantify the MAH prediction power of both traditional dynamical state indicators and morphological parameters using Multivariable Conditional Abundance Matching (MultiCAM). MultiCAM employs simple rank-ordering operations, making it straightforward to translate to observed datasets. We find reasonable ($ρ_{\mathrm{sp}} \geq 0.6$) performance for predictions of the mass fraction between $1\lesssim z\lesssim 0.1$, though with notable information loss when using projected quantities. In one example application of our methodology, we use the coefficients of the MultiCAM models to select subsamples of galaxy clusters that have accreted more (or less) of their $z = 0$ mass budget over a given time frame.

analysis.title_zh: 质量吸积历史在星系团形态中的印记
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 The300 项目的 305 个大质量星系团，考察投影恒星分布的形态特征与星系团质量吸积历史之间的联系，并以 Spearman 相关和 MultiCAM 量化预测能力。摘要报告核心形态量更追踪早期吸积，去核心的大尺度形态量更追踪晚期吸积，MultiCAM 对 z≈1 到 z≈0.1 间的质量分数预测达到合理表现但投影量造成信息损失。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团动力学状态会增加可观测量-质量关系的偏差和散布，这是用星系团计数约束宇宙学、并与 CMB 给出的参数进行比较时的重要系统误差。理解形态如何追踪吸积历史，有助于改进星系团质量校准和选择函数，从而降低与 CMB 宇宙学联合分析中的星系团系统误差。
key_points: 用 The300 项目的 305 个大质量星系团连接投影恒星形态与质量吸积历史。
核心形态量更关联早期吸积历史，去核心的大尺度形态量更关联晚期吸积历史。
MultiCAM 对 z≈1 到 z≈0.1 间质量分数预测达到摘要所称的合理相关强度，但投影量会损失信息。
methods: The300 项目模拟星系团样本
305 个大质量星系团

papers.title: A compact analytic formula for the one-loop triangle cosmological correlator
papers.abstract: We derive a compact analytic formula for the one-loop triangle correlator of conformally coupled scalars in de Sitter space. The result is organised as six leading-singularity prefactors multiplying pure weight-two functions of the six energy variables. It contains forty-two dilogarithms, compared with approximately one hundred and twenty in the previously known closed-form representation, and requires no auxiliary regulator. The dilogarithms occur in Galois-conjugate pairs, making each contribution separately real throughout the physical region. We validate the result numerically. Moreover, we show that its symbol can be derived directly from the dressed integral representation or, independently, bootstrapped from Landau singularities and general consistency conditions. Finally, we show that the correlator (in a suitable normalization) is a Stieltjes function of each squared energy separately and is jointly completely monotone in all six squared energies. These structures suggest a route towards higher-point one-loop cosmological correlators.

analysis.title_zh: 一圈三角宇宙学关联函数的紧凑解析公式
analysis.summary_zh: 本文推导了德西特空间中共形耦合标量一圈三角宇宙学关联函数的紧凑解析公式，将结果组织为六个 leading-singularity 前因子乘以六个能量变量的纯权重二函数。摘要报告该表达式不需辅助调节器、二重对数数量少于既有闭式表示，并经过数值验证，同时揭示了符号、Landau 奇点、Stieltjes 性和完全单调性等结构。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文偏理论方法，直接对象不是 CMB 数据分析，而是宇宙学关联函数的解析结构。若这些一圈关联函数技术能推广到更物理的场内容和扰动类型，将有助于理解原初非高斯性、环修正和宇宙学 bootstrap 中与 CMB 高阶相关函数相关的理论模板。
key_points: 给出德西特空间中共形耦合标量一圈三角关联函数的紧凑解析表达。
表达式由六个 leading-singularity prefactors 与六个能量变量的纯权重二函数组成，二重对数数量较既有闭式表示减少。
摘要称其符号可由 dressed integral representation 推导，或由 Landau 奇点和一致性条件 bootstrap 得到。
methods: 德西特空间共形耦合标量的一圈三角关联函数解析推导
dressed integral representation
Landau singularities 与一般一致性条件的 bootstrap
数值验证
Stieltjes 函数与 joint complete monotonicity 分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该紧凑公式的适用归一化、物理区域定义、分支选择与实性证明，以及从该标量 toy model 推广到更接近宇宙学扰动/CMB 可观测相关函数时是否仍保留这些解析结构。

papers.title: eROSITA cosmology with galaxy groups: Hot gas budget out to the virial radius
papers.abstract: Non-gravitational processes that expel hot gas beyond the virial regions of groups and clusters of galaxies, known collectively as baryonic feedback, play a key role in reshaping the matter distribution of the Universe on Mpc scales. We use eROSITA observations of a complete sample of 25 galaxy groups selected from the first public release of the eROSITA-DE data (eRASS1) and identified with the Two Micron Redshift Survey optical group catalogue (2MRS). We extract and fit surface brightness (SBx) profiles and present hot gas mass and hot gas fraction profiles out to $R_{200}$. We perform a Bayesian analysis of $M_{\mathrm{gas}}-M_{\mathrm{tot}}$, $L_{\mathrm{X}}-M_{\mathrm{tot}}$, and $L_{\mathrm{X}}-M_{\mathrm{gas}}$ relations, taking into account the aperture covariance effects. At $R_{500}$, we report uniformly flat SBx profiles with a mean $β$ parameter of $0.38 \pm0.04$, steepening to $β= 0.76\pm0.19$ beyond $R_{500}$. We measure a sub-cosmic hot gas fraction at the median mass of our sample $M_{500} = 2.54\times10^{13}M_{\odot}$ of $ f_{\mathrm{gas,500}} = 4.32\pm0.42\%$. Similarly, at $R_{200}$ and the median mass $M_{\mathrm{ 200}} = 3.69\times10^{13}M_{\odot}$, we obtain $f_{\mathrm{gas,200}}=5.78\pm0.69\%$. Our $f_{\mathrm{gas}}-M_{\mathrm{tot}}$ and $L_{\mathrm{X}}-M_{\mathrm{tot}}$ relations show significant deviations from the predictions of the strong feedback variants of the FLAMINGO simulation ($2.5σ$ to $8.0σ$ tension), while fiducial FLAMINGO and BAHAMAS provide the closest match to our measurements. Using our measured baryon fractions and the SP(k) model, we infer a $10\%-15\%$ reduction in the matter power spectrum at $k = 5\ h\ \mathrm{Mpc}^{-1}$ relative to a dark matter-only universe, in agreement with fiducial FLAMINGO and BAHAMAS, while revealing a growing tension on smaller scales with the strong feedback variants.

analysis.summary_zh: AI 解读尚未启用。摘要首句：Non-gravitational processes that expel hot gas beyond the virial regions of groups and clusters of galaxies, known collectively as baryonic feedback, play a key role in reshaping the matter distribution of the Universe on Mpc scales.

papers.title: Large eROSITA X-ray sources as 2MRS galaxy groups
papers.abstract: We aim to exploit the large area coverage, good sensitivity, and low instrumental background of eROSITA to detect the faint surface brightness emission of galaxy groups from the Two Micron All Sky Survey Redshift Survey (2MRS). Using the data from eROSITA-DE Data Release 1, including images, exposure maps, and local background maps, we performed a wavelet decomposition of image mosaics in the 0.6--2.3 keV band at angular scales of 1/8-16'. We adopted 8-16' scales for source detection and 2-4' scales to improve catalog purity. A novel identification method based on the ranked partial Hausdorff distance fully exploits the X-ray image and group membership information. Random catalogs were used to control match purity, and the identification threshold was chosen to maximize the catalog size at a fixed purity. {We present a catalog of 619 X-ray galaxy groups with 80% purity, and define subsamples with 90% and 97% purity. Bright sources closely match the AXES-2MRS catalog (which is based on ROSAT All Sky Survey data analysis on spatial scales of 12-24'). The X-ray luminosity function of our groups agrees with previous studies down to 5.e41 erg/s. Using dynamical mass estimates, we find that the X-ray counterpart completeness for groups with >=4 members exceeds 60% for masses >2e13 Msun. We modeled the 2MRS group catalog and justify the inclusion of two-member groups in the identification. This study demonstrates that large X-ray sources on spatial scales relevant for cosmological studies of baryonic distributions can be reliably detected and identified using nearby galaxy group catalogs.

analysis.title_zh: 作为 2MRS 星系群的大尺度 eROSITA X 射线源
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 eROSITA-DE DR1 的大天区、低背景 X 射线数据，在 0.6--2.3 keV 波段通过小波分解寻找 2MRS 星系群的低表面亮度辐射，并用 ranked partial Hausdorff distance 结合 X 射线图像和成员星系信息进行识别。摘要报告得到 619 个 X 射线星系群、80% 纯度目录，并给出更高纯度子样本、与既有 AXES-2MRS 的亮源一致性、光度函数一致性以及按动力学质量估计的完备度结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系群和团簇是 CMB 宇宙学中的重要前景和交叉相关对象，尤其关系到热/动 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 效应、重子分布、低红移大尺度结构和弱透镜交叉检验。该目录若选择函数可控，可为 CMB 透镜、SZ 堆叠和局域宇宙重子普查提供外部样本。
key_points: 利用 eROSITA-DE DR1 在 0.6--2.3 keV 波段寻找 2MRS 星系群的低表面亮度 X 射线辐射。
通过小波分解和 ranked partial Hausdorff distance 识别方法构建 X 射线星系群目录。
摘要给出 619 个、80% 纯度的星系群目录，并定义 90% 和 97% 纯度子样本。

0.6--2.3 keV 波段图像拼接的小波分解

papers.title: VERaiPHY -- Validation & Evaluation for Robust AI in PHYsics
papers.abstract: Modern machine learning is leading to substantial gains in precision, flexibility, and computational efficiency in fundamental physics. Statistical validation, uncertainty quantification, and robustness assessment are less systematically addressed. The VERaiPHY initiative (Validation & Evaluation for Robust AI in PHYsics) is a series of articles developed within the PHYSTAT programme, aimed at establishing statistical standards for the development, evaluation, and deployment of ML techniques. Each article focuses on a specific methodological domain from a statistics perspective and clarifies statistical questions, tests, and the interpretation of results. This opening article establishes the probabilistic, statistical, and machine learning foundations that the later contributions assume, together with the notation used throughout.

analysis.title_zh: VERaiPHY：面向物理中鲁棒 AI 的验证与评估
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 VERaiPHY 计划，旨在为基础物理中的机器学习技术建立统计验证、评估和部署标准。摘要称这篇开篇文章给出后续系列文章所依赖的概率、统计与机器学习基础，以及统一记号。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 和宇宙学分析越来越多使用机器学习进行参数推断、模拟加速、前景分离或异常检测；如果缺少系统的统计验证和不确定性评估，可能会影响宇宙学结论的可靠性。该系列若能形成可操作标准，将有助于规范 CMB 相关 AI 方法的误差控制与鲁棒性报告。
key_points: VERaiPHY 是面向物理中机器学习方法验证与评估的系列文章。
本文作为开篇，建立概率、统计和机器学习基础及统一记号。
摘要强调统计验证、不确定性量化和鲁棒性评估需要更系统的标准。
methods: 统计验证框架
不确定性量化
鲁棒性评估
机器学习方法的开发、评估与部署标准化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该开篇文章给出的统计检验、结果解释和记号体系是否足够具体，能否直接指导 CMB/宇宙学中 ML 管线的验证，而不仅是原则性综述。

papers.title: An axion constraint from the diffuse supernova neutrino background indicated by Super-Kamiokande
papers.abstract: Recently, the Super-Kamiokande Collaboration reported an indication of the diffuse supernova neutrino background (DSNB) with a statistical significance of $2.6σ$. Motivated by this possible discovery, we investigate the impact of axion cooling on the DSNB flux on the basis of long-term neutrino-radiation hydrodynamic simulations. We compare the observed flux and our models and obtain a $1σ$ upper limit $|g_{ap}|<1.3\times10^{-9}$ on the axion-proton coupling constant, which is comparable to the conventional limit based on the SN 1987A neutrino burst. In contrast to the SN 1987A bound, the DSNB constraint does not rely on the properties of a single observed supernova, because the DSNB represents the cumulative neutrino emission from a cosmic population of core-collapse events. More generally, this approach can be applied to other feebly interacting particles that modify protoneutron-star cooling.

analysis.title_zh: 由 Super-Kamiokande 指示的弥散超新星中微子背景给出的轴子约束
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文利用 Super-Kamiokande 对弥散超新星中微子背景的可能探测迹象，研究轴子冷却对 DSNB 通量的影响。摘要称，作者基于长期中微子辐射流体模拟并与观测通量比较，得到轴子-质子耦合常数的 1σ 上限 |g_ap|<1.3×10^-9，量级上可与 SN 1987A 中微子暴约束相比。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 轴子或其他弱相互作用粒子会改变原中子星冷却和宇宙中核心坍缩事件的累积中微子背景，从而影响粒子宇宙学中的轻弱耦合新物理约束。该结果与 CMB 的联系是间接的：它约束早期宇宙候选粒子和暗部门模型的参数空间，可与 CMB 对额外辐射成分、暗物质和宇宙学背景演化的限制互补。
key_points: Super-Kamiokande 报告了 DSNB 的 2.6σ 迹象，作者据此研究轴子冷却影响。
基于长期中微子辐射流体模拟，比较观测通量与模型。
摘要给出轴子-质子耦合的 1σ 上限，并强调 DSNB 约束不依赖单个超新星事件。
methods: Super-Kamiokande 的弥散超新星中微子背景迹象
长期中微子辐射流体动力学模拟
比较观测通量与包含轴子冷却的模型
核心坍缩事件宇宙族群的累积中微子发射
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 DSNB 通量模型中核心坍缩率、超新星族群分布、探测选择和轴子冷却实现方式的系统误差；还应区分摘要所称 1σ 上限与更常用置信水平限制的可比性。

papers.title: Infrared Lines from Sterile-Neutrino Transition Magnetic Moments at JWST
papers.abstract: We investigate infrared line signatures from radiatively decaying sterile-neutrino dark matter using publicly available JWST/NIRSpec IFU blank-sky observations. The main signal considered is the sterile-to-sterile transition $N_1\to N_2γ$, induced by the transition magnetic dipole coefficient $d_{NNγ}$, with $m_1>m_2$. In contrast to ordinary two-photon decays of axion-like or Majoron-like particles, the observed photon energy is not fixed by the full dark matter mass, but by the small mass splitting $Δm=m_1-m_2$. Thus, a keV-scale sterile-neutrino dark matter state can generate an eV-scale infrared photon line in the JWST band. We construct a $χ^2$-based line-search analysis using the NIRSpec IFU $\rm F170LP$-$\rm G235M$ blank-sky data toward $\rm GN\text{-}z11$, modelling the smooth continuum with a cubic spline and including the Milky Way halo decay flux. In the absence of a significant excess, we derive projected limits on $d_{NNγ}$ and on the decay width $Γ_{N_1\to N_2γ}$ for $0.1~{\rm eV}\lesssimΔm\lesssim1~{\rm eV}$. For a sterile component saturating the dark matter abundance, the strongest sensitivity reaches $d_{NNγ}\lesssim7\times10^{-14}~{\rm GeV}^{-1}$ and $Γ_{N_1\to N_2γ}\lesssim10^{-25}~{\rm s}^{-1}$. We also include a minimal anomalous-Majoron benchmark, $ω\toγγ$, obtaining JWST sensitivity to $λ_{ωγγ}\sim10^{-11}$-$10^{-9}~{\rm GeV}^{-1}$ for $m_ω\sim0.6$-$1~{\rm eV}$.

analysis.title_zh: JWST 中来自惰性中微子跃迁磁矩的红外谱线
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究惰性中微子暗物质的辐射衰变 N1→N2γ 是否可在 JWST 红外波段产生谱线，并用公开 JWST/NIRSpec IFU GN-z11 方向空白天区数据做 χ^2 谱线搜索。摘要报告未发现显著超额，因此在 0.1 eV 到 1 eV 的质量劈裂范围内给出跃迁磁偶极系数和衰变宽度的预期限制，并讨论一个异常 Majoron 衰变基准。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质粒子性质直接影响早期宇宙组分、结构形成和 CMB 推断中的物质密度解释。虽然该工作使用 JWST 而非 CMB 数据，但它提供了对惰性中微子暗物质衰变通道的独立天体物理约束，可与 CMB 对暗物质丰度、辐射成分和能量注入的限制互补。
key_points: 研究 keV 级惰性中微子暗物质通过小质量劈裂产生 eV 级红外线的可能性。
使用 JWST/NIRSpec IFU 空白天区数据进行基于 χ^2 的谱线搜索。
摘要称未发现显著超额，并给出跃迁磁偶极系数与衰变宽度的预期限制。
methods: JWST/NIRSpec IFU 公开空白天区观测
F170LP-G235M 数据
GN-z11 方向空白天区
χ^2 谱线搜索
三次样条建模平滑连续谱
银河系晕衰变通量建模
惰性中微子 N1→N2γ 衰变模型
异常 Majoron ω→γγ 基准模型
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对空白天区选择、NIRSpec 系统误差和连续谱样条建模对窄线限制的影响，以及银河系晕 J 因子/暗物质丰度假设如何传递到 d_NNγ 与衰变宽度限制。

papers.title: A stochastic forward model for the intergalactic dispersion-measure distribution of Fast Radio Bursts
papers.abstract: Fast Radio Bursts probe ionised baryons through their observed dispersion measures. We present \turbofrb, a semi-analytic stochastic forward model for the intergalactic dispersion-measure distribution, $P({\rm DM}_{\rm IGM}\mid z)$, that resolves the diffuse IGM, halo, and filament contributions as explicit physical channels, with the halo and filament encounter rates coupled by a latent line-of-sight environmental variable. Only four effective parameters are calibrated against hydrodynamical ray-traced IllustrisTNG benchmark. The model matches the benchmark mean DM to the percent level and yields a per-redshift Jensen-Shannon divergence of at most $5\times10^{-3}$ across $z = 0.5$-$2.5$. The per-sightline channel decomposition makes explicit what closed-form parametric descriptions cannot show: the diffuse IGM sets the body of the distribution, while halos and filaments populate the high-DM tail. Applied to representative localised FRBs, the forward likelihood quantifies host-excess events independently of their astrophysical signatures and recovers the injected $H_0$ within $1σ$ in a closed-loop consistency test. The \turbofrb package is available at \href{https://github.com/jefersonfortunato/turbofrb}{github.com/jefersonfortunato/turbofrb}.

analysis.title_zh: 快速射电暴星系际色散量分布的随机前向模型
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 turbofrb，一个用于快速射电暴星系际色散量分布 P(DM_IGM|z) 的半解析随机前向模型，将弥散 IGM、晕和丝状结构贡献分解为显式物理通道。摘要称模型经 IllustrisTNG 射线追踪基准校准后可很好匹配均值和分布差异，并可用于本地化 FRB 的宿主超额识别与 H0 闭环一致性测试。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: FRB 色散量为低红移重子分布和 H0 测量提供了独立探针，可与 CMB 推断的宇宙学参数形成互补。若该前向模型能可靠描述 IGM、晕和丝状结构对 DM 分布的贡献，将有助于把 FRB 用作检验 CMB ΛCDM 外推、重子缺失问题和 H0 张力的观测工具。
key_points: 提出用于 FRB 星系际色散量分布的半解析随机前向模型 turbofrb。
模型将弥散 IGM、晕和丝状结构作为显式物理通道，并用 IllustrisTNG 流体力学射线追踪基准校准。
摘要称该模型可识别高 DM 尾部来源，并在闭环测试中恢复注入的 H0。
methods: 半解析随机前向模型
P(DM_IGM|z) 建模
弥散 IGM、halo、filament 通道分解
潜在线-of-sight 环境变量
IllustrisTNG 流体力学射线追踪基准校准
Jensen-Shannon divergence 比较
本地化 FRB 前向似然
闭环一致性测试
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对四个有效参数的定义和校准范围、IllustrisTNG 基准到真实宇宙的系统误差，以及用于恢复 H0 的闭环测试是否覆盖了宿主星系 DM 和选择效应的不确定性。

papers.title: Revisiting neutrino event epochs for the blazar PKS 0735+178 with TESS
papers.abstract: We present here the results of the optical light curve variability analysis of the blazars PKS 0735+178, in weeks-scale flare state, observed in three sectors with the Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS). The TESS observations in this study coincide with a well-known neutrino emission phase detected with four different neutrino observatories at multiple epochs in a narrow time window. We segmented the rising and decaying parts of the flare and individually analyzed their flux distribution, excess variance, variability timescale, and the power spectral density (PSD). The source displayed an elevated excess variance of ~25%, with a multi-modal flux distribution (coherent in the rising and distorted in the decaying phase). The variability timescale analysis highlights a much faster decay than the rising scale, and the PSDs depict a nominal change in the power spectral slope. We discuss a likely connection in the optical variations and the neutrino events, and briefly explain a possible physical scenario for the observed optical flux behavior in view of previously discovered radio-band results.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ApJ, 13 pages, 6 figures, 1 table

analysis.title_zh: 用 TESS 重新审视耀变体 PKS 0735+178 的中微子事件历元
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 TESS 的三段观测光变，研究类星体 PKS 0735+178 在周尺度耀发中的光学变率，并把该时段与多台中微子观测到的发射阶段对应起来。摘要报告了较高的超额方差、多峰通量分布、衰减快于上升的时间尺度，以及功率谱斜率的名义变化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这类工作属于多信使高能天体物理，但对 CMB 研究也有间接价值：它提供了前景源的时间变率与高能活动关联的案例，有助于评估未来高灵敏巡天中活动星系核对宇宙学射电/毫米波背景和前景建模的影响。
key_points: 基于 TESS 光变分析 PKS 0735+178 在几周尺度耀发期的上升段与衰减段。
摘要报告该源的光变与已知中微子事件窗口重合，并呈现较高的超额方差与多峰通量分布。
作者将光变特征与中微子事件联系起来，并讨论了一个与此前射电结果相容的物理图景。
methods: TESS 三个 sector 的光学光变数据
将耀发分为上升段与衰减段分别分析
通量分布分析
超额方差分析
变率时间尺度分析
功率谱密度（PSD）分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最需要核对的是：光学变率与中微子事件的时间对应是否足够稳健，PSD 斜率变化是否显著，以及作者提出的物理联系是否只是相关而非因果。

papers.title: Dianoga simulations of galaxy clusters and groups: Properties of the baryonic components
papers.abstract: We introduce the Dianoga set of cosmological simulations of galaxy clusters and groups, specifically aimed at studying the impact of the implementation of AGN feedback and star formation. Using the OpenGadget3 code, we carry out simulations of 28 regions centred on massive galaxy clusters, and of a cosmological box. This generates a sample of 293 halos with M_{200}> 1.5 x 10^{13} M_{\odot}. Parameters of AGN feedback in the reference implementation were minimally calibrated exclusively to match the local relation between SMBH masses and stellar masses of host galaxies. Simulations are compared to observed galaxy stellar mass function (GSMF), stellar mass fraction in clusters and groups, BCG masses, scaling relations between ICM/IGM properties and profiles of their thermodynamical properties. In the appendix, we show how results vary as we modify the reference feedback model in six alternative configurations. Our reference model predicts a GSMF in general agreement with observations, albeit overestimated in the high end. BCG stellar masses and mass fractions are higher than observed in massive clusters, while being closer to observations for groups. Predicted properties of the ICM/IGM are in general agreement with observations, with the core regions of simulated clusters having entropy and temperature profiles that are slightly less "cool-cored" than observed. A comparison with other implementations of AGN feedback highlights that models including thermal evaporation of the sub-resolution interstellar medium succeed to bring BCG masses and stellar mass fractions closer to observation, and to increase the cool-coreness of simulated clusters. Our results demonstrate that the details of the interface between AGN energy injection and the sub-resolution interstellar medium model are at least as critical as the total feedback efficiency itself.

analysis.title_zh: 星系团和星系群的 Dianoga 模拟：重子组分的性质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 Dianoga 星系团和星系群宇宙学模拟，使用 OpenGadget3 研究 AGN 反馈和恒星形成实现对重子组分性质的影响。摘要报告参考模型总体能再现 GSMF 和 ICM/IGM 若干观测趋势，但高质量端、BCG 质量和大质量团中的恒星质量分数偏高，且不同 AGN 反馈与亚网格星际介质耦合方式会显著改变结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团气体和恒星的重子物理会影响团质量校准、热 SZ/X 射线可观测量以及小尺度物质功率谱，因此间接关系到 CMB 次级各向异性和 CMB 透镜的宇宙学解释。不过该论文摘要主要是星系团形成与反馈建模，并非直接 CMB 分析。
key_points: 介绍 Dianoga 星系团和星系群宇宙学模拟集，重点考察 AGN 反馈和恒星形成实现方式。
样本包含围绕大质量星系团的 28 个区域和一个宇宙学盒子，共 293 个 M200 超过阈值的晕。
摘要强调 AGN 能量注入与亚网格星际介质模型的接口细节，对 BCG 质量、恒星质量分数和冷核性质至少与总反馈效率同等关键。
methods: OpenGadget3 宇宙学流体模拟
28 个大质量星系团中心区域模拟
一个宇宙学盒子模拟
与 GSMF、团/群恒星质量分数、BCG 质量、ICM/IGM 标度关系和热力学剖面观测比较
六种替代 AGN 反馈配置比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对参考 AGN 反馈模型只按 SMBH-宿主恒星质量关系最小校准是否足以支持后续比较，以及各观测样本、质量定义、选择函数和剖面测量口径是否与模拟一致。

papers.title: From Variability to SED Modeling: A Multiwavelength Study of the Neutrino Blazar TXS 0506+056
papers.abstract: The blazar TXS 0506+056 is the first source that was reported to be associated with high-energy extragalactic neutrino events and is one of the major targets for multi-messenger studies. We carried out multi-wavelength optical monitoring of this object on 24 nights in the period from 2018 to 2023. The overall light curves exhibit a dimming trend superposed by some small-amplitude fluctuations, and intraday variability was detected on four nights. Bluer-when-brighter behaviors were observed on both intraday and long timescales and were more pronounced on long timescales, while a weak redder-when-brighter trend was detected on one night. No significant time lags were found between variations at different optical wavelengths. We also retrieved the multi-broadband data from some monitoring programs. The data reveal complex, asynchronous flaring in different wavebands. A cross-correlation analysis shows that the high-energy emission (optical to gamma-ray) is co-spatial and leads the radio emission by a substantial time of about 800 to 900 days, suggesting that the radio emission originates from a downstream region of the jet. We performed time-dependent lepto-hadronic modeling of the spectral energy distributions for three representative epochs, the 2017 neutrino-associated flare, a post-flare phase, and a deep quiescent state, revealing an evolution in the radiative properties of the emission regions. The modeling results provide a phenomenological framework for interpreting the long-term multiwavelength behavior of TXS 0506+056 in a multi-messenger context.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in The Astrophysical Journal. 20 pages, 12 figures

analysis.title_zh: 从变率到 SED 建模：中微子 blazar TXS 0506+056 的多波段研究
analysis.summary_zh: 本文结合 TXS 0506+056 的长期光学监测与多波段资料，分析其多年尺度的亮度演化、短时标变率和跨波段相关性。摘要给出的结果是：光学到伽马射线的高能辐射与射电存在显著时延，且三个代表历元的时变 lepto-hadronic 模型显示辐射区性质随时间演化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文直接面向中微子 blazar 的多信使解释，对理解喷流中粒子加速和辐射区位置很相关。对 CMB/宇宙学而言，它主要是前景与源物理参考：类似活动源的长期变率会影响射电与毫米波天空中的点源统计和背景分解。
key_points: 研究对象是与高能天体中微子相关的 blazar TXS 0506+056。
作者给出 2018 至 2023 年的长期光学监测，并结合多波段资料研究不同波段的不同步耀发。
摘要报告了光学到伽马射线与射电之间的显著时延，并对三个代表历元做了时变 lepto-hadronic SED 建模。
methods: 24 晚光学监测
多波段监测资料汇总
不同光学波段的相关性/时延分析
跨波段互相关分析
三组代表历元的时变 lepto-hadronic SED 建模
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：800–900 天的射电滞后是否对采样和互相关方法敏感，三种代表历元的 SED 建模是否存在参数退化，以及中微子关联与多波段辐射区解释是否唯一。

papers.title: Seeding baryonic dark matter
papers.abstract: It has been proposed that primordial quark pellets or PQPs --ultra-dense quark-matter mini- stars-- formed at $T\sim 1$ GeV maybe a good candidate accounting for the dark matter of the universe. If correct, dark matter would consist of very compact objects with a maximum mass of $10^{-2} \ M_\odot$ and radii of approximately 100 m, although smaller objects would be much more abundant and encompass the bulk of the dark matter content. Here we describe a viable formation mechanism based on the enhancement of the local baryon density when supra-horizon Peccei-Quinn domain walls formed at an earlier epoch sweep and accumulate quarks and gluons before entering the horizon. Assuming an efficient baryon concentration by contracting Peccei-Quinn domain walls, we derive the resulting primordial quark pellet mass spectrum, minimum mass and cosmological abundance The results confirm that PQPs potentially constitute a conservative, Standard-Model-based, and observationally viable solution to the dark-matter puzzle.

analysis.title_zh: 播种重子暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究原初夸克团块是否可作为宇宙暗物质，并提出一种由早期超视界 Peccei-Quinn 畴壁扫掠、压缩并聚集夸克和胶子的形成机制。摘要称，在假设畴壁能有效集中重子数的条件下，作者推导了团块的质量谱、最小质量和宇宙学丰度，并认为该候选体可能是基于标准模型且观测上可行的暗物质方案。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 若暗物质由极致密的重子性小天体组成，将改变通常非重子冷暗物质的图像，并会影响早期宇宙重子预算、结构形成和致密天体约束。对 CMB 研究而言，关键在于这类对象是否与 BBN/CMB 推断的重子密度、物质功率谱和致密物体观测限制相容。
key_points: 讨论原初夸克团块作为重子暗物质候选体。
形成机制依赖超视界 Peccei-Quinn 畴壁收缩并聚集夸克和胶子。
摘要声称可得到质量谱、最小质量和宇宙学丰度，并认为该方案仍具观测可行性。
methods: 基于 Peccei-Quinn 畴壁扫掠并积累夸克、胶子的形成机制建模
假设收缩畴壁能有效集中重子数
推导原初夸克团块质量谱、最小质量和宇宙学丰度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“高效重子集中”这一关键假设的物理依据、畴壁演化与进入视界前后的处理，以及所得丰度是否同时满足微透镜、动力学、BBN 和 CMB 对致密暗物质/重子组分的限制。

papers.title: The VariableTNG project: how baryonic mechanisms shape galaxy properties
papers.abstract: We use 50 Sobol-sampled VariableTNG simulations, varying eight subgrid parameters at fixed cosmology and initial conditions, to determine which baryonic processes regulate galaxies and black holes at $z=6$ and $z=8$. We compare the simulations with recent high-redshift measurements of the stellar mass function, star-forming main sequence, stellar and gas-phase mass-metallicity relations, stellar mass-size relation, and black-hole host and accretion properties. The simulations reproduce several broad trends in these observables, although differences remain in gas-phase metallicity, galaxy size, and the most extreme black-hole populations. Given the substantial uncertainties in both the physical modelling and the observational inference of high-redshift galaxy properties, we regard these differences as diagnostic tensions rather than definitive model failures. Random-forest analyses reveal a clear hierarchy in parameter sensitivity. The abundance of low-mass galaxies is regulated primarily by stellar feedback, particularly the supernova temperature $T_{\mathrm{SN}}$ and thermal wind fraction $τ_{\mathrm{w}}$, whereas the sensitivity of the scatter in the star-forming main sequence is weaker and redshift dependent. The high-accretion tail of black-hole growth depends on black-hole seeding and feedback parameters, but also on $T_{\mathrm{SN}}$, suggesting that stellar feedback indirectly regulates rapid black-hole growth through its impact on the available gas supply. Although cosmic variance can obscure these intrinsic responses in independent small volumes, our controlled experiment identifies stellar feedback as a common physical link between early low-mass galaxy formation and rapid black-hole growth.

analysis.title_zh: VariableTNG 计划：重子机制如何塑造星系性质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文通过 50 个固定宇宙学条件下的 VariableTNG 模拟，系统考察了高红移星系与黑洞性质对亚网格重子物理参数的响应。摘要报告说，模拟能重现若干总体趋势，但在气相金属丰度、星系尺寸和极端黑洞族群上仍有差异；随机森林分析则指出恒星反馈是最关键的控制因素。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章与 CMB 的关系是间接但重要的：它推进了高红移星系形成与黑洞增长的物理建模，而这些早期结构会影响再电离、宇宙射电背景和小尺度前景建模。对做 CMB 统计分析的人来说，它提供了早期宇宙天体前景与源族群演化的约束背景。
key_points: 用 50 个 Sobol 采样的 VariableTNG 模拟，在固定宇宙学和初始条件下改变 8 个亚网格参数。
重点考察高红移 z=6 和 z=8 时星系、金属丰度和黑洞增长的统计关系。
随机森林分析显示，低质量星系丰度主要受恒星反馈控制，而黑洞高吸积尾也会受恒星反馈间接影响。
methods: 50 个 Sobol-sampled VariableTNG 模拟
固定宇宙学与初始条件
改变 8 个亚网格参数
与高红移观测量比较
随机森林敏感性分析
红移 z=6 和 z=8 的星系与黑洞统计量分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对的是：这些高红移观测对模拟诊断张力的强度有多大、随机森林给出的参数敏感性是否受样本体积和宇宙方差影响，以及哪些差异只是模型退化而非真正失败。

papers.title: AT 2020afjz (TSS2020a): The First Fast Extragalactic Transient Discovered by TESS
papers.abstract: We report the discovery of AT 2020afjz (TSS2020a): the first hour-scale extragalactic transient discovered in optical wavelengths whose complete evolution -- from explosion onset to decay -- is temporally resolved, and the first such transient discovered by TESS. AT 2020afjz was identified as a $>10σ$ detection in the pilot HiLaTS program run within the TESSELLATE Sky Survey, which blindly searches for transient phenomena in TESS data with the TESSELLATE pipeline. Through cross-matching with legacy imaging, we associate it with DES J042144.37$-$383311.3, a member of an interacting galaxy pair at $z_{\rm phot}=0.67^{+0.07}_{-0.10}$. While AT 2020afjz is similar in duration and brightness to GRB afterglows, it exhibits a slow rise time of $\sim1$ hr and lasts for only 2.4 hr above the half-max brightness; modeling the TESS light curve with VegasAfterglow finds that it is best described as either an on-axis "dirty-fireball" or off-axis orphan afterglow. Each of these rare classifications hinge upon a non-detection at gamma-ray energies, but as Fermi-GBM was Earth-occulted at the time of explosion, AT 2020afjz's gamma-quiet nature cannot be definitively confirmed. Regardless, AT 2020afjz demonstrates TESS's power to discover fast extragalactic transients, and heralds a new population awaiting discovery with TESSELLATE.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to AAS journals

analysis.title_zh: AT 2020afjz（TSS2020a）：TESS 发现的首个快速河外暂现源
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报道 AT 2020afjz（TSS2020a），称其为 TESS 发现的首个快速河外暂现源，也是光学波段首个从爆发开始到衰减均被时间分辨的小时尺度河外暂现源。作者用 TESSELLATE/TESS 盲搜发现该事件，并结合历史成像关联宿主，再用 VegasAfterglow 拟合 TESS 光变曲线，摘要称其可由轴上“dirty-fireball”或离轴孤儿余辉解释，但伽马射线未探测无法被最终确认。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接研究 CMB，但属于时域河外天体物理与宇宙学巡天交叉领域。对 CMB 读者而言，其相关性主要在于 TESS/TESSELLATE 展示了大面积、高时间采样巡天发现稀有瞬变源的能力，这类前景或多信使瞬变背景的统计认识会影响宽视场时域天文和宇宙学样本构建。
key_points: 报道 TESS 在光学波段发现首个小时尺度河外暂现源。
光变曲线完整覆盖从爆发开始到衰减的过程。
其物理分类依赖伽马射线未探测，但摘要说明该条件无法最终确认。

TESSELLATE Sky Survey 与 TESSELLATE pipeline 盲搜
pilot HiLaTS program
与历史成像交叉匹配

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对暂现源与宿主星系关联的可靠性、TESS 光变曲线建模中“dirty-fireball”和离轴孤儿余辉之间的可区分性，以及 Fermi-GBM 被地球遮挡对“伽马宁静”判定造成的限制。

papers.title: Investigating The Effects of Early Dark Energy on Large-scale Structure Within the EDENS Suite
papers.abstract: Early Dark Energy (EDE) models have been suggested as a possible solution to the so-called Hubble Tension, a discrepancy of the measurement of the Hubble constant at early and late times. In this paper, we investigate the effects of EDE on large-scale structure probes of cosmology via the EDENS (Early Dark Energy N-body Simulations) suite. The EDENS suite extends the reach of available EDE simulations considerably by adding volume and resolution. We derive several key metrics, such as the halo mass function, the nonlinear power spectrum, and the concentration-mass relation. Furthermore, we implement a halo occupation distribution model to populate the simulations with synthetic galaxies. This allows us to measure the galaxy-galaxy correlation function and galaxy bias. We choose an EDE model that is consistent with observations across several probes and allows for the increase of the present day value of the Hubble constant to resolve the Hubble tension. This model adds three more parameters to the standard $Λ$CDM model. Additionally, it requires small shifts in the best-fit $Λ$CDM cosmological parameters to accommodate existing observational constraints. We find significant differences between the standard $Λ$CDM model and the EDE model, suggesting that some of our chosen metrics may allow us to distinguish EDE from $Λ$CDM, and future observations should help further constrain possible cosmological models. We release outputs from our simulations via the OpenCosmo data portal.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 EDENS 套件研究早期暗能量对大尺度结构的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 EDENS 早期暗能量 N 体模拟套件研究 EDE 对大尺度结构宇宙学探针的影响，计算晕质量函数、非线性功率谱、浓度-质量关系，并通过 HOD 构造合成星系以测量星系相关函数和偏置。摘要报告 EDE 与标准 ΛCDM 在若干指标上存在显著差异，提示未来观测可能进一步约束这类模型，并称模拟输出将通过 OpenCosmo 发布。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 早期暗能量是缓解 CMB 推断的早期宇宙 H0 与晚期测量之间哈勃张力的重要候选方案之一。该工作把 EDE 的影响从 CMB 背景和线性扰动延伸到非线性大尺度结构与星系统计，有助于判断 CMB 允许的 EDE 参数空间是否会被低红移结构观测排除或进一步检验。
key_points: 用 EDENS 早期暗能量 N 体模拟研究大尺度结构可观测量。
比较 EDE 与标准 ΛCDM 在晕和星系统计上的差异。
摘要称若干指标可能区分 EDE 与 ΛCDM，并公开模拟输出。

papers.title: Dark Energy in the $w-c_s^2$ Plane
papers.abstract: We introduce a unified framework for dark energy diagnostics based on the joint phase space of the equation of state $w$ and the sound speed $c_s^2$. The resulting $w-c_s^2$ plane provides a minimal extension beyond background cosmology, capturing both the expansion history and perturbative properties within a single representation. Building on this framework, we define the microphysical flow parameter $F=dc_s^2/dw$, which encodes the dynamical relation between background evolution and perturbative response. We derive a direct connection between the present-day value $F_0$, $H_0$, and $σ_8$, and show that the microphysical flow parameter enables a hierarchy of increasingly stringent consistency tests that substantially reduce the viable dark energy theory space. We further demonstrate how trajectories in the $w-c_s^2$ plane distinguish models that are nearly degenerate at the level of $w(a)$, including canonical quintessence, Chaplygin gas models, and noncanonical scalar field realizations. This framework provides a compact phenomenological bridge between dark energy microphysics and future perturbation-sensitive observations, establishing $F_0$ as a useful discriminator of the kinetic structure underlying cosmic acceleration.
papers.comment: 17 pages with 3 figures, new citations added

analysis.title_zh: w-c_s^2 平面中的暗能量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出在状态方程 w 与声速平方 c_s^2 构成的平面中统一诊断暗能量，同时描述背景膨胀和扰动性质。作者定义微物理流参数 F=dc_s^2/dw，并在摘要中称其当前值 F0 可与 H0、σ8 直接关联，用于区分在 w(a) 层面近似简并的暗能量模型。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 对暗能量的限制主要通过几何距离、晚期综合 Sachs-Wolfe 效应以及与低红移结构数据的联合约束体现；引入 c_s^2 和扰动响应能把暗能量检验从背景层面推进到结构增长层面。该框架若成立，可帮助解释或检验 H0、σ8 相关张力中暗能量微物理的角色。
key_points: 提出以 w 与声速平方 c_s^2 的联合平面诊断暗能量。
定义微物理流参数 F=dc_s^2/dw。
摘要称 F0 与 H0、σ8 存在直接联系，并可用于暗能量一致性检验。

papers.title: Confirmation of the Finch Flatter-Fainter Relation for the Quadruple Images of Lensed Point Sources
papers.abstract: Finch et al (2002) derived relations for the summed absolute magnifications of quadruply lensed images that vary inversely with flattening in two alternative isothermal gravitational potential models. However, they did not elaborate on the selection effects this "flatter-fainter'' relation induces in actual lensed systems. We test the relation against the Luhtaru et al (2021) sample of 39 quadruply lensed quasars (38 of which we model successfully), using predicted rather than observed magnifications to avoid the complication of microlensing. We found that the summed predicted magnification decreases by a factor of ten over the observed range of flattening.
papers.comment: 3 pages. Authors' version, including Figure 1 at intended size and full resolution

analysis.title_zh: 对透镜点源四重像的 Finch“越扁越暗”关系的确认
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检验 Finch 等提出的四重引力透镜点源像总绝对放大率与透镜扁率成反比的“越扁越暗”关系，并将其应用于 Luhtaru 等的四重透镜类星体样本。摘要报告他们用预测放大率规避微透镜影响，在成功建模的 38 个系统中发现总预测放大率随观测扁率范围下降约十倍。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 强引力透镜样本的放大率和选择效应会影响类星体透镜统计、透镜质量模型和宇宙学应用中的系统误差评估；虽然不直接针对 CMB，但与利用透镜系统约束宇宙结构和选择函数有关。
key_points: 检验四重透镜点源像的“越扁越暗”关系。
使用模型预测放大率以避开微透镜带来的观测放大率复杂性。
摘要报告：在观测到的扁率范围内，总预测放大率下降约一个数量级。

papers.title: Intrinsic Alignments in Redshift Space I: Symmetries
papers.abstract: Galaxy shapes are unique tensor tracers of large-scale structure, providing a promising avenue to both enhance current cosmological programs and detect new physics beyond the scalar sector. We develop a general formalism to describe the full 3D structure of galaxy shapes and their statistics, including the breaking of isotropy by the line of sight and redshift space distortions. We constructively show that the redshift-space mapping generates a kinematic basis whose form factors are strictly polynomial in the line-of-sight angle $μ= \hat{k} \cdot \hat{n}$, and that parity selection rules restrict scalar-tensor and tensor-tensor correlators to 3 and 13 independent form factors, respectively, with the latter further reduced to 9 by exchange symmetry. We show that this polynomiality is preserved transforming into a total helicity basis denoted by total angular momentum $M$---sourced to be nonzero by powers of the line-of-sight $\hat{n}$---and that this is equivalent to the form factors having spin weights $(1 - μ^2)^{|M|/2}$ and described by associated Legendre polynomials $P^{|M|}_\ell$. We construct estimators for form factors in the normalized total-helicity basis that provide the optimal angular weighting to extract shape information, and connect the full tensor basis to projected shape statistics. To validate our formalism, we study the above tensor form factors within a toy model, showing that all allowed channels are generated even within simplified assumptions, and apply our estimators to halo shape statistics in N-body simulations wherein all channels up to total angular momentum $|M| \leq 2$ are detected. We anticipate that the methods developed here will have applications ranging from optimal extraction of intrinsic-alignments in hydrodynamical simulations to identifying new physics in tensor channels forbidden by selection rules in the standard model of cosmology.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 9 figures, to be submitted to PRD

analysis.title_zh: 红移空间中的内禀取向 I：对称性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文构建红移空间中星系形状及其统计的三维张量形式体系，系统处理视线方向和红移空间畸变造成的各向同性破缺。摘要报告该映射产生关于视线角 μ 的多项式形状因子，并给出相关函数的独立通道计数、最优角权重估计量，以及在玩具模型和 N 体模拟晕形状统计中的验证。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 内禀取向是弱透镜宇宙学的重要系统误差，也可能作为大尺度结构的张量示踪量补充 CMB 透镜和星系巡天信息；该形式体系有助于在联合宇宙学分析中区分标准标量扰动、红移空间效应和潜在新物理的张量通道。
key_points: 建立红移空间中星系形状三维统计的对称性形式体系。
给出标量-张量和张量-张量相关函数的独立形状因子计数。
在玩具模型和 N 体模拟晕形状统计中验证估计量，并检测到 |M|≤2 的通道。

papers.title: A novel technique for reflection coefficient measurement in precision cosmology
papers.abstract: The detection of the global 21-cm signal from the Cosmic Dawn and Epoch of Reionisation remains a challenge to experiments worldwide. Emitted at a rest-frame frequency of 1420.405~MHz, this signal from the early Universe is redshifted to 40-200~MHz with a maximum brightness temperature of a few 100~mK. Efforts to detect this sky-averaged signal include experiments such as the Shaped Antenna measurement of the background RAdio Spectrum (SARAS) and Probing ReionizATion of the Universe using Signal from Hydrogen (PRATUSH). Detecting this faint signal requires precise calibration of the antenna, which includes a high-precision measurement of its reflection coefficient. This measurement must be performed \textit{in situ} at the observation site, as the antenna characteristics vary significantly with the environment. PRATUSH, a space-based radiometer, faces the additional challenge of structural distortions induced by thermal cycling, necessitating multiple measurements of the reflection coefficient. This work highlights the development of an \textit{in situ} Vector Network Analyser, which utilises a novel noise source-based calibration scheme and a cross-correlation spectrometer to perform magnitude and phase measurements of the complex reflection coefficient of the antenna. Further, we demonstrate the performance of the designed network analyser using independent measurements from a precision network analyser and reflection coefficient modelling of the device under test. We find the level of non-smooth calibration systematics, which need critical control for 21-cm signal detection, to be about $10^{-5}$. Finally, we study the impact of reflection coefficient correction on sky measurements, highlighting its usability for precision 21-cm observations.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 11 figures, Submitted to Experimental Astronomy

analysis.title_zh: 精密宇宙学中反射系数测量的一种新技术
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对宇宙黎明和再电离时期全球 21 cm 信号探测中的天线校准难题，提出一种用于原位测量复反射系数的矢量网络分析仪。摘要报告该系统采用噪声源校准和互相关频谱仪，并通过独立精密网络分析仪测量与建模验证，得到需重点控制的非平滑校准系统误差约为 10^-5。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 全球 21 cm 信号是 CMB 之外探测宇宙黎明和再电离历史的重要手段，其前景与 CMB 光学深度、早期恒星形成和电离史约束互补；天线反射系数的非平滑校准误差会直接限制毫开量级信号的可靠提取。
key_points: 面向全球 21 cm 信号实验的天线反射系数原位高精度测量。
提出基于噪声源校准和互相关频谱仪的原位矢量网络分析仪。
摘要报告非平滑校准系统误差约为 10^-5，并研究反射系数修正对天空测量的影响。

papers.title: Spectral Fingerprints Beyond Degeneracies in Primordial Gravitational-Wave Sources
papers.abstract: Stochastic gravitational-wave backgrounds from different primordial mechanisms can exhibit identical peak frequencies and amplitudes, leaving their origin degenerate. We show that this degeneracy can be broken by the broadband spectral response of the gravitational-wave source. By comparing scalar-induced and gauge-field-induced gravitational waves with the same primordial spectral profile and cosmological evolution, we isolate the imprint of the tensor-source dynamics. Although both mechanisms exhibit the same infrared scaling, they develop distinct spectral shapes near the peak and different ultraviolet asymptotes. The local spectral index $n_{\rm gw}$ and its running $α_{\rm gw}$ further characterize this source-dependent evolution, providing a spectral fingerprint beyond the peak observables. These results show that broadband, multi-frequency observations can probe the production mechanism of a primordial gravitational-wave background even when its peak frequency and amplitude are degenerate.
papers.comment: 5+2 pages,4 figures. This version has been submitted to the journal

analysis.title_zh: 超越简并的原初引力波源频谱指纹
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究峰值频率和振幅简并时，如何区分不同原初机制产生的随机引力波背景。作者在相同原初谱轮廓与宇宙学演化下比较标量诱导和规范场诱导的引力波，报告二者虽有相同红外标度，却在峰值附近谱形、紫外渐近行为以及局域谱指数及其跑动上呈现差异。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初引力波背景能够检验早期宇宙扰动及粒子物理过程；本文强调，单靠峰值观测可能无法确定其来源，需要宽频、多频段频谱信息。对 CMB 研究而言，这提供了与 CMB 原初张量模和标量扰动约束互补的判别途径，但摘要并未直接讨论 CMB B 模或联合分析。
key_points: 峰值频率和振幅相同，不足以判别原初随机引力波背景的产生机制。
两类机制具有相同的红外标度，但峰值附近谱形和紫外渐近行为不同。
局域谱指数及其跑动可作为依赖于源动力学的宽频谱指纹。
methods: 比较标量诱导与规范场诱导的引力波
为两类机制设定相同的原初谱轮廓和宇宙学演化，以分离张量源动力学的影响
分析峰值附近谱形、红外标度和紫外渐近行为
使用局域引力波谱指数 n_gw 及其跑动 α_gw 描述频谱演化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：所谓“相同的原初谱轮廓和宇宙学演化”如何具体构造，结论对谱宽、传播历史及模型参数是否稳健；还应检查 n_gw 与 α_gw 的定义、可观测频段，以及区分两类源所需的频率覆盖和实验精度。摘要没有给出这些可探测性细节。

papers.title: Merging Galaxy Clusters and the Search for New Physics of Dark Matter: A Review
papers.abstract: Merging galaxy clusters represent one of the most powerful macroscopic laboratories in the Universe for searching for new physics within the dark sector. High-velocity cosmic collisions inherently separate the dark matter and stellar components from the highly collisional, X-ray-emitting intracluster gas. These massive systems provide an ideal environment to probe the fundamental nature of dark matter, specifically testing whether it behaves as a strictly collisionless particle or exhibits non-zero self-interactions. While pioneering systems like the Bullet Cluster historically demonstrated the macroscopic decoupling of dark and ordinary matter, the field has evolved into a sophisticated discipline driven by multi-disciplinary methodologies. This review synthesizes recent theoretical and empirical advances in interpreting post-collision dynamics. It examines how the synergy of combined approaches---integrating multi-wavelength observations from gravitational lensing and X-ray mapping with high-fidelity N-body hydrodynamical simulations---allows the translation of macroscopic spatial observables into stringent constraints on microscopic particle properties. Through this synthesis, the work evaluates how leveraging heterogeneous merger ensembles can reliably advance the ongoing search for physics beyond the standard cosmological model.
papers.comment: 38 pages, 7 figures: Review accepted for publication in Universe

analysis.title_zh: 并合星系团与暗物质新物理的搜寻：一篇综述
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于并合星系团作为暗物质新物理实验室的综述，重点讨论高速碰撞中暗物质、恒星与星系团内 X 射线气体的分离。摘要称，文章综合引力透镜、X 射线观测和 N 体流体模拟，用于把并合后的空间观测量解释为暗物质微观性质约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗物质的碰撞性和自相互作用会影响结构形成与星系团尺度动力学，是标准 ΛCDM 中冷暗物质假设的重要检验。虽然该文不直接研究 CMB，但其暗物质性质约束可与 CMB 给出的宇宙学参数和早期宇宙暗物质模型限制互补。
key_points: 并合星系团可通过暗物质、恒星和 X 射线气体的空间分离检验暗物质性质。
综述强调引力透镜、X 射线成图和 N 体流体模拟的联合使用。
目标是把宏观并合观测量转化为暗物质微观性质约束。
methods: 综述近期理论与观测进展
多波段观测：引力透镜与 X 射线成图
高保真 N 体流体动力学模拟
异质并合星系团样本综合分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对综述如何处理不同并合系统的选择效应、投影效应和模拟先验，以及所谓“严格约束”是否依赖特定暗物质自相互作用模型。

papers.title: The linear dilaton in cosmology and particle physics
papers.abstract: A warped extra dimension in a five-dimensional (5D) anti de Sitter (AdS) background was introduced in 1999 by Lisa Randall and Raman Sundrum to solve the gauge hierarchy problem in particle physics. As a bonus, a holographic interpretation in terms of four dimensional (4D) conformal field theories (CFT) was found. Interestingly enough, another 5D background, the linear dilaton (LD), was found to have a holographic interpretation in terms of Little String Theory. In this review we will show how a set of 5D backgrounds, parametrized in terms of a real parameter $ν$, generalizes both theories and gives rise, in particular, to AdS for $ν=0$ and to LD for $ν=1$. Furthermore, working in the 5D theory, we will consider applications of the LD background to: i) Particle Physics, so that the 5D Planck scale can be lowered to sub-Planckian values, ii) Brane World Cosmology (BWC), based on the appearance of an extra vacuum characterized by a 5D black hole. In all cases we find a gapped continuum for bulk propagating fields, which makes connection with unparticles. In the case of BWC we also point out on the existence of a pressureless holographic fluid which could play the role of dark matter (DM), with feeble (gravitational) interactions to the Standard Model (SM), decoupled from the thermal SM bath, and generated by a freeze-in mechanism after inflation. We also point out the additional possibility of identifying DM with a long-lived feebly interacting massive graviton, as an isolated resonance generated by radiative corrections to the continuum graviton propagator self-energy.

analysis.title_zh: 线性膨胀子在宇宙学与粒子物理中的应用
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇综述式文章，介绍了一个用参数 ν 统一描述 AdS 和线性膨胀子背景的五维框架，并讨论其在粒子物理和膜世界宇宙学中的应用。摘要还提到，该框架会产生带能隙的连续谱，并在宇宙学场景下引出可作为暗物质的候选，例如压强为零的全息流体或长寿命的弱相互作用类引力子共振。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 它与 CMB/宇宙学的关联主要来自额外维和膜世界背景对早期宇宙、暗物质与引力传播的影响。虽然摘要没有直接给出 CMB 计算，但这类模型常会改变暴胀后热史、额外自由度或引力波/标量扰动的传播方式，因此对宇宙学约束是相关的。
key_points: 这是一篇综述，讨论五维线性膨胀子背景及其与 AdS、Randall-Sundrum 与 Little String Theory 的关系。
作者强调该类背景在宇宙学中可导出带能隙的连续谱，并与非粒子效应相关。
在膜世界宇宙学语境下，作者提出可能的暗物质候选，包括类引力子共振和弱相互作用的层析流体。
methods: 五维弯曲额外维理论讨论
参数 ν 的统一背景分类
膜世界宇宙学分析
黑洞真空与体场连续谱的理论讨论
通过辐射修正讨论引力子传播子自能与共振结构
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时要区分哪些内容是已有理论综述，哪些是作者对宇宙学应用的具体主张，尤其需要核对暗物质候选是否只是模型层面的可能性，以及是否给出了与 CMB、结构形成或早期宇宙热史直接相关的可检验预言。

papers.title: Halo Mass of ULIRGs at Cosmic Noon
papers.abstract: We present a clustering analysis of $\sim 3000$ ultraluminous infrared galaxies (ULIRGs) at $z\sim 2$, uniformly selected by $24μ{\rm m}$ flux and IRAC colors in the COSMOS and BOOTES fields. We measure the angular correlation functions of ULIRGs in both fields and fit them with galaxy clustering models. Linear theory modeling shows that these ULIRGs reside in dark matter halos with characteristic masses of $\log M_{\rm h} /({h^{-1}\rm M_{\odot}}) = 12.64\pm 0.50$ in COSMOS and $12.72\pm 0.13$ in BOOTES. The halo occupation distribution (HOD) modeling yields occupation-weighted effective halo masses of $\log M_{\rm eff} /({h^{-1}\rm M_{\odot}}) =12.50^{+0.26}_{-0.28}$ for COSMOS and $12.89^{+0.11}_{-0.12}$ for BOOTES. These host halos are expected to evolve into halos with masses of $\sim 10^{13.6-13.9}\ {h^{-1}\rm M_{\odot}}$ at $z=0$. The HOD fits allow for a non-negligible satellite contribution to the clustering of galaxies in the BOOTES field, but the satellite fraction derived in the COSMOS field appears nearly zero.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, accepted for publication in the Astrophysical Journal

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙正午时期超亮红外星系的暗物质晕质量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文对宇宙正午 z≈2 的约 3000 个超亮红外星系进行聚类分析，样本由 COSMOS 和 BOOTES 场中的 24 μm 流量与 IRAC 颜色统一选择。作者测量角相关函数并用线性理论与 HOD 模型拟合，摘要报告这些 ULIRG 位于约 10^12.5-10^12.9 h^-1 M_sun 量级的暗物质晕中，并可能演化为 z=0 的更大质量晕。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文主要服务于星系形成和大尺度结构研究，而非直接 CMB 分析。它与宇宙学的关系在于利用星系聚类追踪暗物质晕和结构增长，可作为理解 CMB 所约束初始扰动如何演化到低红移星系分布的辅助观测。
key_points: 对 z≈2 的约 3000 个 ULIRG 样本做聚类分析。
使用角相关函数、线性理论和 HOD 模型估计宿主暗物质晕质量。
摘要报告 COSMOS 与 BOOTES 的有效晕质量和卫星占比结果存在差异。
