papers.title: Broadband Properties of the Harmonic of Type-C Quasi-periodic Oscillation in MAXI J1348-630
papers.abstract: Harmonics are common features of quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) in black hole X-ray binaries; however, their physical origins remain poorly understood. Using broadband Insight-HXMT data, we investigated the Type-C QPO harmonic in MAXI J1348-630. The harmonic is significantly detected exclusively during the hard intermediate state and displays prominent energy-dependent properties: while it is strong in the soft X-ray band (< 10 keV) with its fractional rms amplitude even exceeding that of the fundamental QPO, it is much weaker in the hard X-ray band (> 10 keV), where its rms amplitude is generally several times lower than that of the fundamental. Furthermore, the harmonic shows no significant phase coupling with the fundamental in the soft X-ray band, whereas strong coupling is present in the hard X-ray band. These features point to a complex, energy-dependent origin for the harmonic. We propose that the hard X-ray harmonic may arise from nonlinear distortion of the fundamental waveform within the corona, while the soft X-ray harmonic is likely produced via a distinct physical process, such as the reflection emission from the inner disk.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, accepted for publication in ApJ

analysis.title_zh: MAXI J1348-630 中 Type-C 准周期振荡谐波的宽带性质
analysis.summary_zh: 作者利用 Insight-HXMT 宽带数据研究了 MAXI J1348-630 中 Type-C QPO 的谐波性质，发现该谐波仅在硬中间态显著出现，并且在软、硬 X 射线能段中的强弱和相位耦合表现明显不同。摘要据此推测，硬 X 射线谐波可能来自康普顿冕中基波波形的非线性畸变，而软 X 射线谐波可能与内盘反射有关。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是直接的 CMB 论文，但它涉及黑洞时域信号的谐波结构、谱形和相位关系分析，属于高能天体物理中的时间序列方法学问题。对宇宙学读者而言，价值主要在于了解可迁移的频域分析与信号分解思路，而不是直接的宇宙学结论。
key_points: 研究黑洞 X 射线双星 MAXI J1348-630 中 Type-C QPO 的谐波。
谐波只在硬中间态显著探测到，并呈现明显能段依赖。
软 X 射线与硬 X 射线中的谐波可能来自不同物理机制。
methods: Insight-HXMT 宽带观测数据
Type-C QPO 谐波的能段分析
相位耦合分析
对比软硬 X 射线段的 rms 振幅
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对的是：作者如何判定软、硬能段中的谐波确实不是同一成因，以及相位耦合结论对数据分段和统计方法是否稳健。

papers.title: A comparative study of emergent dark energy models
papers.abstract: Late (emergent) dark energy models that involve a hyperbolic tangent in their dynamic equations have achieved success due to their simplicity, the possibility of resolving the Hubble tension, and, in some cases their consistency with the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) results. Among the most studied are the Phenomenological and General Emergent Dark Energy Models (PEDE and GEDE, respectively), the variable curvature model, and the graduated dark energy model. Our goal is to include the curvature term in the models and perform a robust comparative study using diverse data samples, in particular, Cosmic Chronometers, Type Ia supernovae, Baryon Acoustic Oscillations from DESI-DR1, and Cosmic Microwave Background Radiation. This study presents the Universe age, the deceleration, the $w_{eff}$ parameter reconstruction, the redshift transition, and the best fit for the free parameters of each model. Our collected evidence from Akaike Information Criterion and Bayesian Information Criterion indicates that the best candidate is the PEDE model. Nevertheless, the variable-curvature model is the only model that exhibits a decelerated phase near $z=0$, consistent with the results from DESI.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 15 figures, accepted for publication in the Physics of the Dark Universe journal

analysis.title_zh: 涌现暗能量模型的比较研究
analysis.summary_zh: 本文比较 PEDE、GEDE、variable-curvature 和 graduated dark energy 等晚期涌现暗能量模型，并在纳入曲率项后用 Cosmic Chronometers、Ia 型超新星、DESI-DR1 BAO 和 CMB 数据进行拟合与模型选择。摘要报告称，AIC 和 BIC 汇总证据显示 PEDE 是最佳候选，但 variable-curvature 模型是唯一在 z≈0 附近呈现减速阶段、并与 DESI 结果相一致的模型。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 晚期暗能量模型直接影响 CMB 推断中的距离尺度、曲率、Hubble 张力和与 BAO/超新星数据的联合一致性。该文显式使用 CMB 数据并讨论 DESI 相关结果，因此对研究 CMB 参数退化、暗能量模型选择和晚期宇宙张力的读者值得精读。
key_points: 比较多种含双曲正切结构的晚期涌现暗能量模型。
联合使用 Cosmic Chronometers、Ia 型超新星、DESI-DR1 BAO 和 CMB 数据。
摘要称 AIC/BIC 证据偏好 PEDE，但 variable-curvature 模型在近零红移出现与 DESI 相关的减速阶段。
methods: 曲率项纳入暗能量模型
Cosmic Chronometers
Type Ia supernovae
DESI-DR1 重子声学振荡
宇宙微波背景辐射数据
Akaike 信息准则与 Bayesian 信息准则
宇宙年龄、减速参数、有效状态方程参数重构、转变红移和最佳拟合参数比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 CMB 数据具体采用的是距离先验还是完整似然、曲率与暗能量参数的退化如何处理，以及 AIC/BIC 对不同模型自由参数数目的惩罚是否公平。

papers.title: Quasi-local Hamiltonian for generalized Kerr-Schild black holes in the Iyer-Wald formalism
papers.abstract: Grounded in the covariant phase space approach of the Iyer-Wald formalism, we propose a quasi-local Hamiltonian for generalized Kerr-Schild (GKS) black holes. Evaluated for spherically symmetric spacetimes over a flat Minkowski background, our formulation recovers the Misner-Sharp mass. Because this framework relies solely on the GKS structure, it provides a straightforward extension of the Misner-Sharp mass to rotating geometries. We further extend our analysis to asymptotically anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes, where a renormalization procedure to subtract the background AdS energy naturally emerges. By employing this technique, we establish a geometric quasi-local formulation of Kerr-AdS thermodynamics.

analysis.title_zh: Iyer-Wald 形式下广义 Kerr-Schild 黑洞的准局域哈密顿量
analysis.summary_zh: 作者在 Iyer-Wald 协变相空间框架中提出了适用于广义 Kerr-Schild 黑洞的准局域哈密顿量。摘要称，该构造在球对称平直背景下可恢复 Misner-Sharp 质量，并可自然推广到旋转与 AdS 黑洞，同时导出 Kerr-AdS 热力学的几何化表述。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作属于引力理论和黑洞热力学的基础方法研究，与 CMB 没有直接观测联系，但与广义相对论中的守恒量、边界项和准局域能量定义相关。对研究早期宇宙和强引力背景的宇宙学读者，它提供的是更通用的几何与变分工具。
key_points: 在 Iyer-Wald 协变相空间框架下构造准局域哈密顿量。
对球对称情形可恢复 Misner-Sharp 质量，并可推广到旋转几何。
在 AdS 黑洞中自然出现背景能量扣除，进而建立 Kerr-AdS 热力学的几何化表述。
methods: Iyer-Wald formalism
协变相空间方法
广义 Kerr-Schild 几何
球对称与旋转黑洞的准局域质量计算
AdS 背景重整化/能量扣除
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对的是：这个准局域哈密顿量对一般 GKS 度规的适用范围，以及它与既有黑洞质量定义在边界项和重整化处理上的差异。

papers.title: Nonlinear velocity power spectrum: modeling the cosmological dependence on the Hubble constant and cold dark matter density
papers.abstract: In this paper we present a semi-analytical model for the velocity power spectrum in $\La$CDM cosmology for wave numbers $k<1/$Mpc. We mainly concentrate on the dominant divergence part but also present some results on the vorticity contribution. We divide cosmological parameters into evolution and shape parameters and model the dependence of the evolution parameter $h$ and of the shape parameter $\om_{\rm cdm}$ with an accuracy better than 2.5\%. A surprising finding of our study is that the velocity power spectrum becomes independent of $\om_{\rm cdm}$ on nonlinear scales. A python implementation of the model is publicly available.

analysis.title_zh: 非线性速度功率谱：哈勃常数与冷暗物质密度的宇宙学依赖建模
analysis.summary_zh: 作者为 $\Lambda$CDM 宇宙学中的速度功率谱建立了一个半解析模型，重点处理纵向散度项，并给出涡度项的部分结果。摘要称该模型对 $h$ 和 $\Omega_{\rm cdm}$ 的依赖可达到优于 2.5% 的精度，而在非线性尺度上速度功率谱对 $\Omega_{\rm cdm}$ 近似不敏感。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 速度场统计量与大尺度结构增长、红移空间畸变和宇宙学参数推断有关。对其非线性功率谱的可控建模，有助于把结构形成理论与观测约束连接起来，也可作为与 CMB 推断的背景宇宙学参数相互校验的工具。
key_points: 给出适用于 $k<1/\mathrm{Mpc}$ 的速度功率谱半解析模型。
将宇宙学参数分为演化参数与形状参数，并单独刻画 $h$ 和 $\Omega_{\rm cdm}$ 的依赖。
摘要称在非线性尺度上速度功率谱对 $\Omega_{\rm cdm}$ 变得近似无关。
methods: 半解析建模
对速度功率谱的纵向（divergence）主导项建模
同时给出涡度（vorticity）贡献的部分结果
以 Python 实现模型并公开发布
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最需要核对的是：模型适用的波数范围、参数分解方式是否可推广到更一般的宇宙学参数集，以及“非线性尺度上对 $\Omega_{\rm cdm}$ 无关”这一结论的精确定义与验证范围。

papers.title: Brightest group and cluster galaxies as indicators of relaxation
papers.abstract: Context. Galaxy groups and clusters are widely used to probe the evolution of the cosmic web and cosmology, while assuming that they are relaxed. Aims. We identify the properties of the brightest halo galaxies (BHGs) that can be used to predict the most likely sample of dynamically relaxed host halos. Our work combines thoroughly studied galaxy clusters with less frequently analysed groups. Methods. Our analysis was based on data from the IllustrisTNG simulations. We considered several observationally motivated parameters, including the offset of the BHG from the potential well of the host system ($d_\text{off}$) and from the r-band luminosity centre ($d_\text{lum}$), the distance between the brightest and second-brightest galaxies ($d_{12}$), and the r-band magnitude gap between them ($Δm_{12}$). The primary analysis was performed at redshift $z=0$, with an additional investigation of the redshift evolution of halo relaxation up to $z=1$. The observable proxies were applied to construct a halo mass function (HMF), which was then compared to the HMF of the relaxed sample defined from 3D information commonly used in theoretical approaches. Results. We find that $d_\text{off}$ and $Δm_{12}$ are effective indicators of group and cluster relaxation, particularly when used in combination. The selection criteria of $d_\text{off}<0.05~R_{200}$ and $Δm_{12}>1.6$ mag allowed us to reproduce an HMF that closely matches that of the relaxed halo population. These criteria can be applied to observations up to $z\sim0.2$ within a mass range $\text M_{200}\geq10^{12.5}\text M_\odot$ ($\text M_\text{*, BHG}\gtrsim10^{10.9}\text M_\odot$), including groups and clusters in the selection. In this mass range, $15-23\%$ of the systems are considered fully relaxed at $z=0$. The fraction of relaxed haloes decreases with redshift up to $z\sim0.4$, after which the decrease is far slower.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 18 figures. Accepted for publication in A&A

analysis.title_zh: 作为弛豫状态指示器的最亮星系群和星系团星系
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 IllustrisTNG 模拟研究最亮群/团星系的可观测性质是否能筛选动力学弛豫的宿主暗物质晕，并比较由这些 proxy 构造的晕质量函数与理论三维弛豫样本的晕质量函数。摘要报告 BHG 相对势阱中心偏移和最亮—次亮星系星等差，尤其联合使用时，是群和星系团弛豫状态的有效指标。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系群和星系团常用于大尺度结构和宇宙学参数约束，弛豫状态会影响质量估计、选择函数和晕质量函数解释；这些也是与 CMB 透镜、SZ 星系团宇宙学和 CMB 约束互补的重要系统误差来源。该文提供的可观测弛豫筛选方法可能有助于构建更可控的群团样本。
key_points: 利用 IllustrisTNG 研究最亮晕星系性质与群、团动力学弛豫的关系。
摘要指出 BHG 相对势阱中心偏移和第一、第二亮星系星等差是有效弛豫指标。
作者用这些可观测 proxy 构造 HMF，并与基于三维信息定义的弛豫样本 HMF 比较。
methods: IllustrisTNG 数值模拟
最亮晕星系 BHG 观测型 proxy
BHG 到势阱中心偏移 d_off
BHG 到 r 波段光度中心偏移 d_lum
最亮与次亮星系距离 d_12
r 波段星等差 Δm_12
红移 z=0 主分析及至 z=1 的演化分析
晕质量函数 HMF 比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“弛豫”三维理论定义与观测 proxy 的对应关系、选择阈值对质量和红移的依赖，以及这些准则在真实星系团巡天中受投影效应、成员星系识别和光度测量误差影响的程度。

papers.title: RIOJA. Environmental Effects on Stellar Populations and Ionized Gas in a Protocluster at $z=7.88$
papers.abstract: Protoclusters in the epoch of reionization provide key laboratories for investigating how environment shapes early galaxy formation and evolution, and may also have contributed to cosmic reionization. We analyze 23 member galaxies of A2744-z7p9OD, a protocluster at $z=7.88$, using JWST/NIRCam and NIRSpec to investigate their stellar population properties, rest-frame UV sizes, and ionized-gas properties. We also quantify the internal structure of A2744-z7p9OD using the projected distance to the most massive galaxy ($D_{\rm YD4}$), and to the nearest neighbor ($D_{\rm nei}$), as global and local environmental indicators, respectively. Stellar mass, SFR on a 100 Myr timescale, dust attenuation, and galaxy size show significant correlations ($p<0.05$) with $D_{\rm YD4}$, but not with $D_{\rm nei}$, suggesting that these properties are primarily linked to the global protocluster structure. The member galaxies also show a large galaxy-to-galaxy variation in R23 ($=\log{(([\mathrm{O}\text{\textsc{iii}}]λ\lambda4960,5008\rmÅ+[\mathrm{O}\text{\textsc{ii}}]λ\lambda3727,3730\rmÅ)/\rm{H}β)}$), implying inhomogeneous chemical enrichment in the protocluster environment. O32 ($=\log{([\mathrm{O}\text{\textsc{iii}}]\lambda5008\rmÅ/[\mathrm{O}\text{\textsc{ii}}]λ\lambda3727,3730\rmÅ)}$) correlates with $D_{\rm YD4}$, indicating that the core region is characterized by low-ionization gas. Together with the non-detection of Ly$α$ emission, the possible neutral-gas reservoir traced by ALMA [C{\sc ii}]~$158μ$m emission, and evidence for high-column-density neutral hydrogen in the core, this suggests a neutral-gas-rich protocluster core where the current escape of ionizing photons may be suppressed, even in a overdense environment during the EoR.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to ApJ. Comments welcome

analysis.title_zh: RIOJA：再电离时代一个原星系团中恒星族群与电离气体的环境效应
analysis.summary_zh: 作者利用 JWST/NIRCam 和 NIRSpec 研究了红移 $z=7.88$ 原星系团 A2744-z7p9OD 中 23 个成员星系的恒星族群、静止系紫外尺寸和电离气体性质，并量化了全局与局部环境指标。摘要报告这些星系的若干性质与原星系团整体结构相关，且核心区域表现出低电离、可能富中性气体的特征。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这类原星系团研究直接关联再电离时期的星系形成、环境驱动的气体物理，以及电离光子逃逸效率。它为理解早期过密区如何贡献于宇宙再电离提供了观测约束，也与 CMB 所约束的再电离历史背景相衔接。
key_points: 研究再电离时期原星系团 A2744-z7p9OD 的成员星系性质与环境关系。
星系质量、100 Myr 时间尺度 SFR、尘埃消光和尺寸与全局环境指标相关，但与局部邻近度指标不显著相关。
摘要指出核心区呈现低电离、可能富中性气体的环境，或抑制电离光子的逃逸。
methods: JWST/NIRCam 观测
JWST/NIRSpec 观测
分析 23 个成员星系
使用投影到最大质量星系的距离 $D_{\rm YD4}$ 作为全局环境指标
使用最近邻距离 $D_{\rm nei}$ 作为局部环境指标
测量/比较 R23 与 O32 指标
结合 ALMA [CII] 158 $\mu$m 结果与 Ly$\alpha$ 非探测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：环境指标与样本选择是否会引入投影偏差，R23/O32 的物理解释在极高红移和低金属丰度条件下是否稳健，以及“中性气体丰富核心”与电离光子逃逸受抑这一判断依赖了哪些间接证据。

papers.title: Coronal gas excitation as a tracer of supermassive black hole mass: on the mid-IR coronal [Ne v] lines
papers.abstract: Coronal lines (CL) may be a reliable proxy of supermassive black hole (SMBH) masses in active galactic nuclei (AGN) because the production of these high ionisation potential (IP) lines is sensitive to the shape of the ionising continuum which, for a thin accretion disc, relies on the black hole mass. In this work we study the connection between the [Ne\,v] coronal lines and the SMBH mass. We analyse the \textit{Spitzer spectra} of a sample of 27 AGN spanning three orders of magnitude in SMBH mass. Fluxes and the electron density in the coronal gas medium were measured after fitting Gaussians to both the $\rm [Ne\,v]14μm$ and $\rm [Ne\,v]24μm$ lines where detected at high signal to noise. Line fluxes were normalised to the Br$γ_{\rm broad}$ emission from the broad line region. We found strong correlations between the $\rm [Ne\,v]14μm/Brγ_{\rm broad}$ and $\rm [Ne\,v]24μm/Brγ_{\rm broad}$ line ratios and the SMBH mass. For this sample of 27 AGN we find scatters of 0.54 and 0.53 dex, respectively. These correlations support the theory that the coronal gas excitation is sensitive to a range of SMBH masses because of the dependence on the shape of the ionising continuum. The electron densities of the coronal medium are of the order 1000$\rm cm^{-3}$ supporting their nuclear origin. A comparison with density values derived from JWST for a subsample of objects confirm this conclusion. These results further demonstrate the ability to use CL as a SMBH mass proxy, allowing for accurate SMBH mass measurements in AGN.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures with another in the appendix, 1 table

analysis.title_zh: 日冕气体激发作为超大质量黑洞质量的示踪：中红外日冕 [Ne v] 线
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论中红外日冕线 [Ne v] 是否可作为超大质量黑洞质量的代理量。作者分析了 27 个 AGN 的 Spitzer 光谱，发现 [Ne v] 14 μm/Brγ_broad 和 [Ne v] 24 μm/Brγ_broad 与黑洞质量存在强相关，并报告了约 0.5 dex 的离散度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作为用核区高电离日冕线估计 AGN 中的黑洞质量提供了经验依据。对 CMB 研究的直接关联不强，但它有助于改进活动星系核性质标定，从而影响前景天体建模与高红移星系样本的物理解释。
key_points: 研究将中红外日冕线 [Ne v] 14 μm 和 24 μm 与超大质量黑洞质量建立关联。
样本为 27 个 AGN，日冕线通量用宽线区的 Brγ_broad 归一化后，得到与 SMBH 质量的强相关。
摘要还指出日冕气体电子密度约为 1000 cm^-3，支持其核区起源。
methods: 使用 Spitzer 光谱
对检测到的 [Ne v] 14 μm 和 [Ne v] 24 μm 线进行高信噪比高斯拟合
测量线通量与电子密度
将线通量归一化到 Brγ_broad
与超大质量黑洞质量做相关性分析
与 JWST 推导的密度值作比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最需要核对的是：相关性是否对样本选择、线未检出对象、以及黑洞质量标定方式敏感；同时要确认这些 [Ne v]/Brγ_broad 标度关系是否能在更广 AGN 样本中稳定复现。

papers.title: A Radio-Bright Local Little Red Dot Analog
papers.abstract: The James Webb Space Telescope revealed the existence in the early Universe ($z >$ 4) of large populations of little red dots (LRDs), compact red luminous sources that host rapidly growing supermassive black holes (SMBHs) surrounded by coeval nuclear starbursts. LRDs have defining properties, one of which is the absence of radio detections. LRDs could be radio-undetected because of their large distances. A way to investigate the radio properties of LRDs is to search for radio emission in their local analogs, the Local Little Red Dot (LLRD) galaxies at $z <$ 1 with analogous properties to LRDs. We report the radio continuum detection of the LLRD analog J204837.26${-}$002437.2 ($z$ = 0.4332, hereinafter J2048). This adds to the previous radio detection of two other LLRDs. However, with a flux density of 3.0$\pm$0.2 mJy at 3.0 GHz, J2048 is two orders of magnitude more radio luminous than the previous detections. The spectral index of $α$ = -0.39$\pm$0.04 is consistent with moderately optically-thick synchrotron emission. The radio luminosity of J2048 is $1.2 \times 10^{41}~ \mathrm{erg ~s^{-1}}$, in the lower end of the range defined by radio-loud giant elliptical galaxies and quasars of $L_R$ = $10^{41-46} ~\mathrm{erg ~s^{-1}}$. The expected radio luminosity of the SMBH associated with J2048 is estimated to be about an order of magnitude larger, suggesting that its radio luminosity could potentially be strongly dimmed. A cosmological ($z >$ 4) LRD with radio luminosity similar to that of J2048 would be detectable using the VLA with moderately long integrations.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures. To appear in The Astrophysical Journal

analysis.title_zh: 一个射电明亮的本地 Little Red Dot 类比体
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告了本地 Little Red Dot 类比体 J2048 的射电连续谱探测，并给出其 3.0 GHz 通量、光谱指数和射电光度。作者指出该源比此前已知的 LLRD 射电探测更亮，但其射电输出可能仍低于基于黑洞的预期值。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: LRD 是 JWST 发现的高红移紧致红色源体，与早期宇宙中快速成长的黑洞有关。该工作通过本地类比体约束其射电性质，有助于理解高红移 LRD 的可探测性及其核区物理，但这主要属于星系/黑洞研究而非直接的 CMB 主题。
key_points: 研究对象是低红移的 Little Red Dot 本地类比体 J2048，并报告了其射电连续谱探测。
该源在 3.0 GHz 的射电光度比此前两个 LLRD 探测高出两个数量级。
光谱指数为负值，摘要将其解释为中等光学厚度的同步辐射；同时作者认为其射电输出可能被显著淬灭。
methods: VLA 射电连续谱观测/探测
测量 3.0 GHz 通量密度
由通量推导射电光度
测量射电光谱指数
将结果与先前 LLRD 探测和射电亮椭圆星系、类星体作比较
估计与该源相关联的 SMBH 预期射电光度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时要重点核对：J2048 与高红移 LRD 的类比依据是否足够稳固，射电亮度与“被强烈淬灭”这一判断依赖了哪些假设，以及与 VLA 可探测性的外推是否受红移和谱形影响。

papers.title: Cosmology without the cosmological principle: A study of the large-scale structure effects in the background universe
papers.abstract: Recent studies strongly suggest that the $Λ$CDM model may no longer serve as the definitive standard model in cosmology, given the increasing tensions between different cosmological observables. Some researchers have described this situation as a "crisis in cosmology." The $Λ$CDM model relies on two fundamental assumptions: the isotropy of the universe (supported by observational evidence) and the Copernican principle (a philosophical postulate). Together, these assumptions lead to the well-known Cosmological Principle, with the homogeneity of the universe emerging as a direct consequence. In this thesis, I review the cosmological consequences of relaxing some of these assumptions, exploring inhomogeneous and anisotropic universe models, as well as tilted cosmologies, which consider observers in motion relative to the Hubble flow. We examine methods to study these effects using existing cosmological data. First, we explore a variety of models that describe inhomogeneous and anisotropic universes, including different metric theories, perturbative analyses, averaging effects, tilted scenarios, and cosmographic approaches. We then apply this theoretical framework to analyze SNIA data and the local peculiar velocity field, aiming to constrain key parameters.
papers.comment: PhD thesis, defended in April 2025 at Universidad de Valparaíso, Chile, for the degree of Doctor in Astrophysics

analysis.title_zh: 不依赖宇宙学原理的宇宙学：背景宇宙中大尺度结构效应的研究
analysis.summary_zh: 本文回顾在放松宇宙学原理后，非均匀、各向异性和 tilted 宇宙模型的宇宙学后果，并讨论如何用现有数据研究这些效应。摘要还说明作者把这套框架应用到 SNIA 数据和本动速度场，以约束关键参数。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这类工作直接对应宇宙学中关于同质各向同性假设、局部偏差和观测张力的讨论。对 CMB 读者来说，它关联到是否存在超出标准 FLRW 假设的背景各向异性，以及这些效应如何与低红移巡天和速度场观测联动约束。
key_points: 这是一个关于放松宇宙学原理、考察非均匀/各向异性宇宙模型的学位论文式综述与应用工作。
重点讨论了 inhomogeneous、anisotropic、tilted cosmologies 及相关的宇宙测度方法。
摘要只明确给出将该框架用于 SNIA 数据和本动速度场约束参数，并未在摘要中展开具体结果。
methods: 回顾不同的非均匀与各向异性宇宙模型
metric theories
perturbative analyses
averaging effects
tilted scenarios
cosmographic approaches
SNIA data 分析
local peculiar velocity field 分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对的是作者究竟放松了哪些假设、各模型之间如何区分，以及 SNIA 与本动速度场分别给出什么定量约束；摘要没有提供这些关键结论。

papers.title: Testing Matter Diffusion with Late-Time Cosmological Observations
papers.abstract: We investigate a class of late-time cosmological models derived from the phenomenological framework of variable matter diffusion. In these scenarios, energy-momentum conservation requires a continuous energy exchange between matter and an effective scalar-field dark-energy component, $φ$. We consider a baseline constant-diffusion scenario alongside four non-linear power-law parametrizations, in which the diffusion coefficient evolves as a function of the scale factor, matter density, scalar-field density, or Hubble expansion rate. To assess their cosmological viability, we implement these models within \texttt{SimpleMC} and constrain them using late-time observations, including cosmic chronometers, baryon acoustic oscillation measurements, Type Ia supernovae with and without the local SH0ES calibration. In the absence of the local calibration, the diffusion models yield only modest improvements in the fit ($Δχ^2 \approx -4$), performing comparably to the CPL parametrization while exhibiting negative Bayesian log-evidence differences relative to $Λ$CDM. In contrast, including SH0ES leads to a dramatic reduction in the minimum $χ^2$ ($Δχ^2 \approx -22$) and decisive Bayesian evidence in favor of the diffusion framework ($Δ\ln\mathcal{Z} \approx 9$). Remarkably, the single-parameter constant-diffusion model accounts for virtually all the statistical improvement, outperforming the CPL parametrization by more than 10 units in $χ^2$ and more than 8 units in $Δ\ln\mathcal{Z}$. The four non-linear extensions provide only negligible additional improvements ($Δχ^2 \approx -1$), indicating that current late-time background observations favor the presence of a non-vanishing matter-diffusion interaction over $Λ$CDM, while providing no statistically significant evidence for a specific time-dependent functional form of the diffusion coefficient.

analysis.title_zh: 用晚期宇宙学观测检验物质扩散
analysis.summary_zh: 本文检验一类晚期宇宙学中的可变物质扩散模型，其中物质与有效标量场暗能量之间存在连续能量交换。作者在 SimpleMC 中用宇宙时钟、BAO、Ia 型超新星以及可选的 SH0ES 本地标定约束常数扩散和四种非线性幂律扩散形式；摘要报告称，不加入 SH0ES 时改进有限且贝叶斯证据不支持相对 ΛCDM，而加入 SH0ES 后 χ² 和贝叶斯证据显著偏向扩散框架，且额外时间依赖形式没有明显必要。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作直接关联晚期宇宙学参数推断和 H0 张力，因为 SH0ES 标定的加入显著改变了模型比较结果。对 CMB 研究者而言，它提供的是一种修改晚期背景演化、可能影响从 CMB 推断到低红移距离梯的模型方案；但摘要中的数据集未包含 CMB，因此需要谨慎看待其与早期宇宙约束的一致性。
key_points: 研究可变物质扩散导致的物质与有效标量场暗能量之间的能量交换。
使用晚期背景观测约束常数扩散模型和四种非线性幂律参数化。
摘要称：不含 SH0ES 时相对 ΛCDM 证据不足；加入 SH0ES 后扩散框架得到显著统计改善，且主要由单参数常数扩散模型贡献。
methods: 在 SimpleMC 中实现模型
宇宙时钟 cosmic chronometers
重子声学振荡 BAO 测量
Ia 型超新星数据
包含或不包含本地 SH0ES 标定
与 CPL 参数化和 ΛCDM 进行 χ² 与贝叶斯证据比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 SH0ES 标定对贝叶斯证据和参数后验的驱动程度：扩散信号是否主要是在缓解 H0 张力，而非由 BAO、超新星或宇宙时钟独立支持；还需检查先验选择、证据计算和与 CPL/ΛCDM 的公平比较。

papers.title: Redshift dependence and dipolar velocity corrections in cosmographic reconstructions through Type Ia supernova samples
papers.abstract: We perform a cosmographic analysis of Type Ia supernovae using the Pantheon+\&SH0ES, DES-SNY5 and Union3 compilations. We consider different redshift intervals, analyzed through a third-order Taylor expansion and a Padé $(1,2)$ approximation of the luminosity distance. First, we first infer the cosmographic parameters directly from the observed supernova redshifts. Afterwards, we extend the analysis by including a dipole correction associated with the local peculiar velocity field, constraining both its amplitude and direction. For Pantheon+\&SH0ES, the Cepheid calibration allows a direct determination of the Hubble constant, whereas for DES-SNY5 and Union3 we fix $H_0$ to set the absolute distance scale. By progressively increasing the maximum redshift of the sample, we study how the inferred cosmographic parameters depend on the adopted redshift interval. We find that the Hubble constant obtained from Pantheon+\&SH0ES remains consistent with previous determinations for both cosmographic parameterizations. Instead, the agreement of the deceleration $q_0$ and jerk $j_0$ parameters with the $Λ$CDM values depends on the adopted compilation and improves mainly for Pantheon+\&SH0ES as the redshift interval is enlarged. Moreover, the reconstructed dipole parameters remain stable across the redshift intervals considered, with velocity amplitudes of order $300\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}}$, for all three supernova samples. Finally, fixing the dipole parameters with the cosmic microwave background values leads to a slight shift from the fiducial $Λ$CDM values of the deceleration $q_0$ and jerk $j_0$ parameters.

analysis.title_zh: 超新星样本宇宙学重建中的红移依赖与偶极速度修正
analysis.summary_zh: 作者使用 Pantheon+&SH0ES、DES-SNY5 和 Union3 超新星样本，对不同红移区间做宇宙学重建，并比较了三阶泰勒展开与 Padé $(1,2)$ 近似。摘要称加入偶极速度修正后，重建的偶极参数在各红移区间内较稳定，而固定为 CMB 对应值会使 $q_0$ 和 $j_0$ 相对 $\Lambda$CDM 的偏移略有变化。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: Ia 型超新星仍是晚期宇宙学参数、尤其是 $H_0$ 与加速膨胀史的重要工具。把本动速度场和 CMB 相关偶极信息纳入重建，有助于评估局域宇宙与全局宇宙学参数之间的系统差异。
key_points: 使用 Ia 型超新星样本做宇宙测距的宇宙学重建。
比较了三阶泰勒展开与 Padé $(1,2)$ 近似，并考察不同红移区间的影响。
加入偶极速度修正后，重建得到的偶极参数在各红移区间内较稳定，量级为几百 km/s。
methods: Pantheon+&SH0ES、DES-SNY5、Union3 超新星编译本
宇宙学测距学分析
三阶泰勒展开
Padé $(1,2)$ 近似
引入与局部本动速度场相关的偶极修正
对不同最大红移区间分别拟合
将偶极参数固定为 CMB 值进行对照
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时要核对：不同编译本的系统误差处理、固定或拟合 $H_0$ 的方式、偶极项与宇宙学参数之间是否存在退化，以及“与 CMB 值一致”的偶极设定具体如何影响 $q_0$ 和 $j_0$ 的重建。

papers.title: Modelling the nonlinear matter power spectrum in Hu-Sawicki $f(R)$ gravity with the Web-Halo Model
papers.abstract: We develop a semi-analytic extension of the Web-Halo Model (WHM) to Hu-Sawicki $f(R)$ gravity, with the aim of linking nonlinear matter clustering to the successive stages of cosmic-web collapse. The cylindrical sheet and filament windows of the original WHM are replaced by axisymmetric ellipsoidal top-hat windows, yielding a modest improvement around the perturbative-to-nonlinear transition without introducing additional fitting parameters. Modified gravity is incorporated through environment-dependent chameleon spherical collapse, from which the collapse threshold and virial overdensity are obtained and propagated through the sheet, filament, and halo contributions. For $|f_{R0}|=10^{-5}$ and $10^{-6}$, the predicted nonlinear enhancement is broadly consistent with the scale-, redshift-, and field-strength dependence seen in the e-MANTIS emulator, with closer agreement for the weaker field and at higher redshift. The component responses show that sheets and filaments contribute substantially around the transition regime, while the halo response becomes increasingly important at smaller scales. As complementary diagnostics, no displacement of the BAO peak is resolved, whereas tomographic weak-lensing spectra retain a percent-level response to the modified matter power spectrum. The extended WHM therefore provides a physically interpretable framework for tracing screened modified-gravity effects across the cosmic-web collapse hierarchy.

analysis.title_zh: 用 Web-Halo Model 模拟 Hu-Sawicki f(R) 引力中的非线性物质功率谱
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出将 Web-Halo Model 扩展到 Hu-Sawicki f(R) 修正引力，用宇宙网从片、丝到晕的坍缩层级来解释非线性物质功率谱。摘要报告该模型在 |f_{R0}|=10^{-5} 和 10^{-6} 下与 e-MANTIS emulator 的尺度、红移和场强依赖大体一致，并指出弱透镜谱仍保留百分比量级响应而未解析出 BAO 峰位移。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 非线性物质功率谱是从 CMB 推断晚期宇宙结构增长、检验修正引力和分析 CMB 透镜的重要环节。若这种半解析框架能可靠描述筛选修正引力下的非线性聚集，它可帮助把 CMB 初始条件、弱透镜和大尺度结构观测连接起来，用于检验广义相对论之外的宇宙学模型。
key_points: 将 Web-Halo Model 半解析推广到 Hu-Sawicki f(R) 引力。
通过环境依赖的变色龙球坍缩把筛选效应传递到片、丝和晕贡献。
摘要称模型对非线性功率谱增强、BAO 与弱透镜响应给出可解释诊断。
methods: Web-Halo Model 半解析建模
轴对称椭球 top-hat 窗函数
Hu-Sawicki f(R) 引力
环境依赖的变色龙球坍缩
与 e-MANTIS emulator 比较
BAO 峰诊断
断层弱引力透镜功率谱
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该 WHM 扩展与 e-MANTIS 的比较范围、误差水平和适用尺度，尤其是无新增拟合参数的说法在不同红移、|f_{R0}| 与非线性尺度上是否成立。

papers.title: Addressing position anomalies in the Strong Gravitational Lensing System HS~0810+2554 through Dark Matter Subhalos
papers.abstract: Self-bounded dark matter (DM) subhalos are predicted to populate galactic halos in great abundance in the Cold Dark Matter (CDM) scenario. These substructures can leave observable imprints in strong gravitational lensing and have shown the ability to account for flux-ratio and position anomalies in multiply imaged systems. In this paper, we utilize the DM subhalos to address the image position anomalies of the two radio quads of HS 0810+2554 observed with the Very Long Baseline Interferometry. We model the lens using an elliptical power-law macro-lens supplemented by a population of CDM subhalos from numerical simulations and perform a dual-source reconstruction to fit all eight radio images simultaneously. We find that subhalos below $10^{6}M_\odot$ induce astrometric shifts smaller than the measurement uncertainties, whereas more massive subhalos naturally generate the required milliarcsecond perturbations without significantly altering the global lens configuration. Including CDM subhalos improves the fit from $χ^2=60.38$ for the pure macro-lens to $χ^2=1.61$. Our results show that the position anomalies of HS~0810+2554 can be explained within the CDM framework and do not by themselves necessarily require non-standard scenarios like fuzzy DM or angular complexity in the macro-lens. Instead, they provide a sharp and testable manifestation of the subhalo population predicted by CDM.

analysis.title_zh: 通过暗物质子晕解释强引力透镜系统 HS 0810+2554 中的位置异常
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用冷暗物质子晕解释强引力透镜系统 HS 0810+2554 中两个射电四像的像位置异常。摘要报告作者采用椭圆幂律宏透镜加数值模拟给出的 CDM 子晕种群进行双源重建，发现较大质量子晕可产生所需毫角秒级位置扰动，并将拟合从纯宏透镜的 χ^2=60.38 改善到 χ^2=1.61。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 小尺度暗物质子结构是冷暗物质模型的重要预言，也与 CMB 所确定的早期宇宙初始条件和暗物质性质相衔接。强透镜子结构探测能在星系尺度检验 CDM 的小尺度结构形成，因而可与 CMB 对暗物质总量和初始扰动的约束互补；但该摘要本身不涉及 CMB 数据分析。
key_points: 研究强透镜系统 HS 0810+2554 的射电四像位置异常。
用椭圆幂律宏透镜加 CDM 子晕种群同时拟合八个射电影像。
摘要称质量高于 10^6 M_⊙ 的子晕可产生毫角秒级扰动，并显著改善拟合。
methods: 强引力透镜建模
椭圆幂律宏透镜模型
来自数值模拟的 CDM 子晕种群
双源重建
VLBI 射电四像观测拟合
χ^2 拟合比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对子晕质量函数、空间分布和数值模拟先验如何进入透镜拟合，以及 χ^2 大幅改善是否可能受宏透镜复杂性、视线结构或模型自由度影响。

papers.title: Observational Manifestations of Primordial Objects in the Early Universe Through the Hydrogen Subordinate Lines
papers.abstract: A new mechanism for the formation of spectral--spatial distortions in cosmic microwave background radiation near primordial massive compact objects (such as primordial black holes) at redshifts from $z \sim 1000$ to $\sim$100 is proposed. After hydrogen recombination, the radiation from these objects leads to a significant increase in the population of hydrogen subordinate levels in their surrounding environment. Consequently, this allows for the observation of a Fraunhofer-like absorption spectrum in the cosmic microwave background. Such a distortion is formed due to the temperature difference between matter and relic radiation at the corresponding epoch. Ultimately, we should observe circular absorption or emission features around the objects with small angular sizes. These subordinate hydrogen lines currently lie in the radio wavelength range. Estimates indicate that the effect under consideration is accessible for the observations with planned large radiotelescopes. The possibility of the proposed mechanism lies in the ability of an object (e.g., accretion disk around black hole) to emit few-eV photons that populate the $n=2,3,4$ and higher levels of hydrogen, enabling the required excitation.

analysis.title_zh: 通过氢原子次级谱线观测早期宇宙中原初天体的观测表现
analysis.summary_zh: 作者提出一种新机制：在再复合之后、红移约 1000 到 100 的时期，原初大质量致密天体周围的辐射会增强氢原子次级能级的粒子数，从而在 CMB 中形成类似弗劳恩霍夫线的吸收畸变。摘要声称这类畸变会表现为围绕天体的微小角尺度圆形吸收或发射特征，而且其相关谱线现位于射电波段，未来大型射电望远镜可能有机会观测。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作把原初黑洞等早期致密天体与 CMB 的局域谱线畸变联系起来，提供了一种不同于引力透镜或整体功率谱分析的潜在探测通道。对 CMB/宇宙学研究而言，它更接近“寻找早期小尺度结构的局部电磁指纹”，可作为原初黑洞和相关早期能量注入机制的观测补充。
key_points: 提出一种与原初致密天体附近氢次级谱线有关的 CMB 光谱-空间畸变机制。
效应依赖再复合后天体辐射对周围氢原子 n=2,3,4 及更高能级的激发。
作者指出该畸变可能在射电波段表现为围绕天体的圆形吸收或发射特征，并认为未来大型射电望远镜有机会观测。
methods: 提出新的物理机制模型
讨论红移范围 z ~ 1000 到 ~100
基于氢原子次级能级布居与 CMB/物质温度差的定性估算
面向计划中的大型射电望远镜做可探测性评估
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最需要核对的是：该机制对原初黑洞或类似致密天体的参数依赖有多强，作者的可探测性估算是否建立在稳健的辐射转移与线发射建模之上，以及是否会被常规天体物理前景淹没。

papers.title: Prospects for Direct Detection of Ultralight Dark Matter candidates in deci-Hz Band with IndIGO-D
papers.abstract: We investigate the sensitivity of IndIGO-D, a proposed space-based decihertz gravitational-wave interferometer, to different classes of ultralight dark matter. IndIGO-D will probe the $\sim0.01$--$10~\mathrm{Hz}$ frequency band between those accessible to current ground- and future space-based gravitational-wave interferometers, providing access to ultralight dark-matter masses beyond the reach of existing instruments. We consider two complementary signatures: interferometric displacements induced by coherently oscillating scalar (dilaton), vector (dark-photon, $U(1)_B$ and $U(1)_{B-L}$ gauge groups), and tensor fields with masses $m_{\rm DM}\sim10^{-17}$--$10^{-14}~\mathrm{eV}$; and changes in laser polarization induced by pseudoscalar axion dark matter at higher masses, around $m_a\sim10^{-12}~\mathrm{eV}$. For the dilatons, dark photons and tensors, we compute the expected sensitivities using two pipelines -- cross-correlation and BSD excess-power -- assuming L-shaped and triangular interferometer layouts and three representative noise power spectral densities (S1, S2, S3), each for two years of continuous observation. We find that the projected sensitivities agree to within a factor of order unity across the search pipelines and interferometer geometries. In particular, we show that IndIGO-D could open previously unconstrained coupling parameter space for vector and tensor dark matter across $m_{\rm DM}\sim10^{-16}$--$10^{-14}~\mathrm{eV}$, bridging the sensitivity of space- and ground-based experiments. For axion dark matter, we demonstrate that a complementary detection for laser light polarization shifts, limited primarily by photon shot noise, could probe the axion-photon coupling $g_{aγ}$ at masses around $m_a\sim10^{-12}~\mathrm{eV}$ at a level potentially better than that of other future experiments without degrading sensitivity to gravitational waves.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 IndIGO-D 在分赫兹频段直接探测超轻暗物质候选的前景
analysis.summary_zh: 作者评估了拟议中的空间十赫兹引力波干涉仪 IndIGO-D 对多类超轻暗物质的探测能力，覆盖标量、矢量、张量场以及轴子暗物质。摘要称，在所设定的搜索流程和噪声假设下，该实验可在若干质量区间打开此前未约束的参数空间，并且轴子偏振信号具有互补探测潜力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作和 CMB 没有直接观测量对应，但与宇宙学中的暗物质候选及其超轻场性质密切相关。若此类场存在，它们会影响早期宇宙演化、结构形成和部分原初物理模型，也常与 CMB 约束的暗物质参数空间相互联系。
key_points: 研究了未来十赫兹以下引力波干涉仪对超轻暗物质的直接探测前景。
同时考虑了位移型信号和偏振旋转型信号两类探测机制。
摘要强调该方案可连接空间与地基实验的灵敏度空白。
methods: 以 IndIGO-D 这一拟议中的空间十赫兹引力波干涉仪为目标实验。
对标量、矢量、张量超轻暗物质计算干涉位移信号灵敏度。
采用 cross-correlation 与 BSD excess-power 两种搜索流程。
假设 L 型与三角形干涉仪布局，并使用三种代表性噪声功率谱密度和两年连续观测。
对轴子暗物质的激光偏振变化信号进行灵敏度估计。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对：灵敏度曲线对噪声模型、干涉仪构型和两年观测假设有多强依赖，以及不同暗物质候选的信号建模是否完全可比。

papers.title: Testing a Sign-Switch Cosmological Model with Curvature through Latest Planck 2018, DESI DR2 and PantheonPlus\&SH0ES Observational Data
papers.abstract: We investigate the spatial geometry of the Universe within the framework of a sign-switch dark energy scenario by extending the recently proposed $Λ_{\rm s}$CDM model to include a free curvature parameter $Ω_k$.In this framework, the effective cosmological constant undergoes a transition from a negative to a positive value at a characteristic redshift $z_{\dagger}$. Using the latest Planck 2018 cosmic microwave background (CMB) data, DESI DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation (BAO) measurements, and the PantheonPlus\&SH0ES Type Ia supernova sample, we derive joint constraints on the spatial curvature parameter $Ω_k$ and other cosmological parameters. We find that Planck data itself slightly favors a closed universe within both the $Λ_{\rm s}$CDM$+Ω_k$ and $Λ$CDM$+Ω_k$ frameworks, although spatial flatness remains well within the allowed uncertainties. When low-redshift probes were included, the curvature constraints were significantly tightened. In particular, the full Pk18+DR2+PP\&SH0ES dataset yields $Ω_k = 0.0001 \pm 0.0014$ for the $Λ_{\rm s}$CDM model, indicating a universe that is remarkably consistent with spatial flatness. We further analyzed the correlations between $Ω_k$, $H_0$, and $S_8$, finding that the inclusion of curvature and a sign-switch dark energy component helps stabilize cosmological parameter estimates while remaining compatible with current observational constraints. Model comparison using AIC and Bayesian evidence shows that the $Λ_{\rm s}$CDM model receives inconclusive/weak observational support relative to $Λ$CDM.
papers.journal_ref: Phys. Dark Univ. Volume 53, Issue September (2026), Article No. 102423

analysis.title_zh: 使用最新的 Planck 2018、DESI DR2 和 PantheonPlus&SH0ES 观测数据检验带曲率的符号切换宇宙学模型
analysis.summary_zh: 作者在带有符号切换暗能量的 Λ_sCDM 框架中加入曲率自由度，利用 Planck 2018 CMB、DESI DR2 BAO 和 PantheonPlus&SH0ES 超新星数据联合约束宇宙曲率及相关参数。摘要报告说，Planck 单独略偏好闭宇宙，但加入低红移探针后曲率约束明显收紧，联合数据与空间平直高度一致，而模型选择上 Λ_sCDM 相对 ΛCDM 仅得到不明确或较弱支持。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接使用 CMB 与低红移数据联合检验宇宙曲率和暗能量演化，是当前标准宇宙学参数估计与模型选择的典型问题。对 CMB 研究者而言，它涉及 Planck 数据对 Ω_k、H_0、S_8 的退化关系，以及新增巡天数据如何改变对平直性和暗能量模型的判断。
key_points: 在带有符号切换暗能量的模型中引入空间曲率参数 Ω_k，并用多组最新观测数据联合约束。
Planck 2018 CMB 数据单独使用时略偏好闭宇宙，但平直宇宙仍在允许范围内。
加入低红移数据后，曲率约束显著收紧；模型比较显示该扩展模型相对 ΛCDM 只获得不明确/较弱支持。
methods: Planck 2018 CMB 数据
DESI DR2 BAO 测量
PantheonPlus 与 SH0ES Ia 型超新星样本
联合参数拟合
AIC 与 Bayesian evidence 模型比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：符号切换红移 z_† 的设定是否与数据真正可辨识，曲率与 H_0、S_8 的相关性是否会被先验和数据组合强烈影响，以及 AIC/证据比较对基准模型的敏感性。

papers.title: Improved Cosmological Constraints from Morphology-Based Marked Correlation Functions
papers.abstract: The cosmic web contains morphology-dependent information that is not fully captured by standard two-point statistics. We construct morphology-based marked correlation functions (MCFs) by assigning marks to halos according to the cosmic-web morphology identified with the \textsc{Nexus} algorithm. Using the \textsc{Kun} simulation suite, which spans 129 $w_0w_a$CDM cosmologies, we build Gaussian-process emulators for the MCFs as functions of cosmological parameters and tracer bias. We then apply the emulators to mock halo catalogues from the independent \textsc{Jiutian} simulation and perform a joint likelihood analysis to quantify the resulting cosmological constraints. We consider two marker choices: a discrete morphology marker and a continuous morphology strength marker. The continuous marker improves the Figure of Merit (FoM) by a factor of $\sim 8.6$ relative to the standard 2PCF and reduces the $1σ$ uncertainty on $σ_8$ by a factor of $\sim 5$. The discrete marker gives a more modest FoM improvement of $\sim 17\%$. We further test the impact of tracer selection by varying the halo mass threshold by a factor of $\sim 4.5$. Even for the lowest mass threshold, the continuous marker remains unbiased and achieves a FoM about $\sim 3.4$ times higher than that of the 2PCF alone. These results show that morphology-based MCFs, combined with simulation-based emulation, provide a useful framework for extracting additional cosmological information from large-scale structure surveys.

analysis.title_zh: 来自基于形态的标记相关函数的改进宇宙学约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对标准二点统计未充分利用宇宙网形态信息的问题，构造基于形态赋权的 marked correlation functions，并用模拟训练的高斯过程 emulator 做宇宙学参数约束。摘要报告连续形态强度 marker 相比标准 2PCF 大幅提高 Figure of Merit 并收紧 \(\sigma_8\) 约束，且在改变 halo 质量阈值时仍保持较强表现。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 的联系在于晚期大尺度结构对 \(\sigma_8\)、暗能量参数和结构增长的独立约束，可用于和 CMB 初始条件外推结果交叉检验。若形态标记相关函数在真实巡天中稳健，它们可能增强 CMB 透镜、星系聚类和弱透镜联合分析对晚期宇宙张力的诊断能力。
key_points: 提出按宇宙网形态给 halo 赋权的 marked correlation functions。
使用 Nexus 识别形态，Kun 模拟训练高斯过程 emulator，并用独立 Jiutian mock halo catalogues 做似然约束测试。
摘要报告连续形态强度 marker 相比标准 2PCF 显著提高 FoM，并明显收紧 \(\sigma_8\) 约束；离散 marker 改进较小。
methods: Nexus 宇宙网形态识别算法
morphology-based marked correlation functions
Kun 模拟套件，129 个 \(w_0w_a\)CDM 宇宙学
高斯过程 emulator
独立 Jiutian 模拟 mock halo catalogues
联合似然分析
改变 halo 质量阈值的 tracer selection 测试
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 emulator 的训练覆盖范围、协方差与似然假设、mock 与训练模拟的独立性和系统差异，以及形态 marker 在真实巡天选择函数、红移空间畸变和重子效应下是否仍保持无偏。

papers.title: Catastrophic Inflation in the Axiverse
papers.abstract: In the landscape of compactifications of type IIB string theory on O3/O7 orientifolds of Calabi--Yau threefolds, we identify regions of the axion potential in specific geometries that support small-field inflation, under the assumption that the overall Calabi--Yau volume can be stabilized at certain tuned values. At the tuned volume multiple critical points of the axion potential merge in a ``catastrophe'', creating a region with small gradient and small Hessian determinant --- necessary conditions for slow-roll inflation. We describe an algorithm that identifies several explicit examples of these catastrophes that have small field range $f / M_{\rm Pl} \ll 1 $ yet inflate for thousands of efolds. Some examples correctly reproduce the observed spectral tilt but not the amplitude of scalar perturbations, while others reproduce the observed amplitude but with a tilt that is slightly too red. All our examples have negligible tensor perturbations and no significant non-Gaussianity generated during the slow-roll phase. Our results demonstrate that string theory axions can be the source of cosmic inflation without alignment or large field ranges, provided that the Kähler moduli can be stabilized at special values of the volume.

analysis.title_zh: 轴域中的灾变暴胀
analysis.summary_zh: 作者在类型 IIB 弦论紧化的轴子势中寻找可支持小场暴胀的“灾变”区域：当 Calabi--Yau 体积被调谐到特定值时，多个临界点并合，产生满足慢滚条件的小梯度、小 Hessian 行列式区域。摘要报告了一组显式例子，它们都具有很小的场程但可暴胀数千个 e-folds，不过有的只能复现谱倾斜而不能同时匹配标量扰动幅度，另一些则幅度合适但倾斜偏红。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作直接关系到弦论暴胀模型是否能在不依赖大场程或对齐机制的情况下产生可观测宇宙学信号。对 CMB 研究而言，它讨论了谱倾斜、标量幅度、张量模和非高斯性的理论来源与约束，属于将高能理论与观测可检验量连接起来的典型案例。
key_points: 在弦论轴子景观中寻找可支持小场暴胀的灾变点。
在调谐后的 Calabi--Yau 体积下，多个临界点并合，形成小梯度和小 Hessian 行列式区域。
给出若干显式例子，具有很小的场程但可持续数千个 e-folds。
methods: IIB 弦论紧化到 O3/O7 Calabi--Yau 三折叠
对轴子势的特定几何区域做搜索
构造识别灾变点的算法
在调谐体积下评估慢 रोल 暴胀条件
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最该核对的是：这些“灾变点”对体积调谐有多敏感、可控性如何，以及摘要中提到的谱指数与扰动幅度不能同时满意时，具体失配来自哪里。

papers.title: Blazar Boosted Dark Matter in IceCube
papers.abstract: We study the sensitivity of IceCube to blazar-boosted dark matter in a fermionic dark matter model with a massive vector mediator coupling to quarks. To this aim, we compute the diffuse flux arising from a sample of 324 blazars with proton spectra inferred from multiwavelength observations, adopting conservative dark matter spike profiles around the central supermassive black holes and consistently accounting for attenuation effects during propagation through the Earth. The dark matter-nucleon scattering cross section is evaluated by including elastic, resonant single pion production, and deep inelastic contributions, with particular emphasis on resonant single-pion production channels in order to smoothly cover the transition between the elastic and deep inelastic regimes. Using IceCube neutrino data, we derive constraints on the parameter space of the model and show that this detection strategy can surpass the sensitivity of conventional direct-detection experiments for dark matter masses below $\sim 1$ GeV. We find that the signal is dominated by deep inelastic scattering and is therefore more sensitive to comparatively heavy mediators, while resonance processes provide a reduction of the event rate, reaching up to about $9\%$ near the experimental threshold. Our results demonstrate that IceCube constitutes a powerful probe of sub-GeV dark matter scenarios through the observation of blazar-boosted dark matter.

analysis.title_zh: IceCube 中的耀变体加速暗物质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 IceCube 对耀变体加速暗物质的灵敏度，考虑一个通过大质量矢量媒介与夸克耦合的费米子暗物质模型。摘要报告称，利用324个耀变体样本和 IceCube 中微子数据可约束模型参数，并在约 1 GeV 以下暗物质质量范围可能超过传统直接探测实验的灵敏度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于高能天体物理和粒子暗物质探测，与 CMB 的联系在于暗物质性质是宇宙学核心参数和早期宇宙模型的重要组成部分。不过其观测通道是 IceCube 高能事件而非 CMB，各类约束与 CMB 暗物质湮灭、散射或有效自由度约束属于互补关系。
key_points: 研究 IceCube 对耀变体加速暗物质的探测灵敏度。
采用含夸克耦合的大质量矢量媒介费米子暗物质模型。
摘要称该策略在亚 GeV 暗物质质量区间可优于传统直接探测灵敏度。
methods: 324个耀变体样本的弥散通量计算
由多波段观测推断的质子谱
中心超大质量黑洞周围保守暗物质尖峰剖面
穿越地球传播衰减效应
IceCube中微子数据约束
弹性散射、共振单 pion 产生和深度非弹性散射截面计算
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对耀变体质子谱和暗物质尖峰剖面的天体物理假设、地球衰减处理、IceCube 事件选择，以及共振单 pion 与深度非弹性散射在阈值附近如何影响约束。

papers.title: Cosmic Ray Diffusion and the Origin of Very High Energy Gamma-Ray Emission in Young Massive Stellar Clusters
authors: Elisabete M. de Gouveia Dal Pino
papers.abstract: The search for Galactic sources capable of accelerating cosmic rays (CRs) to PeV energies has advanced significantly in recent years. High-energy observatories such as LHAASO have detected extended gamma-ray halos around several sources, suggesting that CRs escape their acceleration sites through anomalously slow diffusion. Theoretical studies propose that magnetic mirror diffusion combined with pitch-angle scattering in turbulent flow can naturally suppress CR transport. Here, we first show how mirror diffusion combined with scattering suppresses cosmic-ray transport, leading to an energy-dependent diffusion coefficient $D(E)\propto E^{1/3}$. We then combine a 3D magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) simulation of a young massive stellar cluster (YMSC) with Monte Carlo CR propagation calculations (CRPropa). The model includes the background gas density, magnetic field, stellar blackbody and dust emission, the cosmic microwave background, and the Galactic interstellar radiation field. Using the YMSC W43 as a benchmark, we compare two CR injection geometries: a central source and a spherical shell representing the cluster's collective wind shock. We show that mirror+scattering diffusion $D(E)\propto E^{1/3}$, combined with a CR injection spectrum $E^{-2}$, reproduces the gamma-ray spectrum observed by Fermi and LHAASO. In contrast, stronger energy-dependent diffusion requires a harder CR injection spectrum, $\sim E^{-1.6}$, to match the data. The relative contributions of leptonic inverse-Compton and hadronic emission depend sensitively on the diffusion regime. Finally, the resulting spectra show little dependence on the CR injection location, aside from a lower injection luminosity in the central-source case. Overall, our results indicate that the observed gamma-ray emission is shaped primarily by the diffusive propagation regime rather than by the precise location of the CR source.

analysis.title_zh: 年轻大质量星团中宇宙线扩散与甚高能伽马射线发射的起源
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究年轻大质量星团是否能通过受抑制的宇宙线扩散解释甚高能伽马射线发射。作者将磁镜扩散加散射模型、3D MHD星团模拟和CRPropa传播计算结合，并据摘要称在W43上用 D(E)∝E^{1/3} 与 E^{-2} 注入谱可再现Fermi和LHAASO观测，且谱形主要由扩散机制而非注入位置决定。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与CMB的联系主要在于把CMB作为宇宙线电子逆康普顿散射的背景光子场之一，用于建模高能伽马射线谱。对CMB研究者而言，它不是原初宇宙或CMB各向异性论文，但涉及高能前景、银河源建模和辐射场组成，可能影响多波段前景理解。
key_points: 讨论年轻大质量星团中宇宙线慢扩散如何塑造甚高能伽马射线晕。
结合3D MHD模拟与CRPropa蒙特卡洛传播，应用于W43基准模型。
摘要称CMB被纳入辐射场背景，但核心问题是高能伽马射线源而非CMB各向异性。
methods: 磁镜扩散与俯仰角散射模型
3D磁流体力学模拟
CRPropa蒙特卡洛宇宙线传播计算
Fermi与LHAASO伽马射线观测比较
包含CMB、银河星际辐射场、恒星黑体与尘埃辐射场
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对镜像+散射扩散导致 D(E)∝E^{1/3} 的物理假设、MHD环境与W43参数是否唯一地约束了谱形，以及CMB作为逆康普顿靶光子在总辐射中的实际权重。

papers.title: Vector-Like Fermions at FCC-ee: NLO Higgs-Strahlung Signatures and Constraints
papers.abstract: We compute the one-loop effects of vector-like fermions (VLFs) on the Higgs-strahlung cross-section, the flagship precision observable of future $e^+e^-$ Higgs factories such as FCC-ee. We consider four benchmark extensions of the Standard Model (SM): two in which a VL quark (VLQ) or VL lepton (VLL) doublet, together with its singlet partners, couples to the Higgs boson through purely internal Yukawa interactions, and two in which a single VL singlet mixes directly with the third-generation charged lepton or neutrino. Working throughout in the on-shell renormalization scheme and imposing perturbativity bounds on the relevant couplings under renormalization-group (RG) running, we compute both the universal self-energy and the non-universal vertex contributions to the Higgs-strahlung amplitude at one loop, together with the oblique parameters $S$ and $T$ and the $H\toγγ$ rate as complementary cross-checks. In the two Yukawa-driven scenarios, we find that a sizable fraction of the parameter space still allowed by current LHC searches produces shifts in $σ(ZH)$ at or above the per-mille sensitivity envisioned for FCC-ee, offering a radiative probe of these couplings. In the two mixing-driven scenarios, existing electroweak-precision bounds on the relevant mixing angles already preclude an observable effect, although we characterize the underlying loop dynamics in full generality for future reference. These results identify the VL Yukawa couplings, rather than any residual mixing with the SM fermions, as the more promising target for Higgs-strahlung precision measurements at a future $e^+e^-$ collider.

analysis.title_zh: FCC-ee上的矢量样费米子：NLO Higgs-strahlung 信号与约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文计算矢量样费米子对未来 e+e- Higgs工厂核心过程 Higgs-strahlung 截面的单圈影响。摘要报告，在Yukawa驱动的两类模型中，当前LHC仍允许的部分参数空间可产生FCC-ee千分量级灵敏度可探测的 σ(ZH) 偏移，而混合驱动情形已受电弱精密限制压低到不可观测。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要面向超出标准模型的粒子物理精密检验，与CMB数据分析或宇宙学参数推断没有直接关系。它的间接宇宙学意义在于约束可能出现在早期宇宙模型中的新费米子自由度，但摘要未讨论暗物质、有效相对论自由度或CMB可观测量。
key_points: 研究矢量样费米子对未来 e+e- Higgs-strahlung 截面的单圈修正。
摘要称Yukawa驱动情形可能产生FCC-ee可达的千分量级偏移。
与CMB没有直接观测联系，属于粒子物理精密检验。
methods: 单圈效应计算
壳层重整化方案
重整化群运行下的微扰性约束
自能与顶角修正计算
斜参数S、T与H→γγ率交叉检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其矢量样费米子基准模型、RG微扰性边界和电弱精密约束的处理是否与已有LHC限制一致，并区分哪些结论只适用于FCC-ee精度设定。

papers.title: ATLAS. IV. A JWST+MUSE Demographic Study of Ly$α$ Profiles in Little Red Dots
papers.abstract: We present an initial demographic study of Ly$α$ profiles in little red dots (LRDs) at $z=3$--9 using $R\sim1000$--4000 spectroscopy. Our sample consists of 8 LRDs observed in the VLT/MUSE Deep and Wide surveys and 23 LRDs observed with JWST/NIRSpec grating spectroscopy from JADES, CANUCS, and GO programs including SPURS. We identify Ly$α$ emission in 5 MUSE LRDs and 9 JWST LRDs. Only two of them exhibit broad Ly$α$ emission (FWHM $>1000\ \mathrm{km\ s^{-1}}$), both reported previously. The other Ly$α$-emitting LRDs show narrow Ly$α$ emission (FWHM $<1000\ \mathrm{km\ s^{-1}}$), with FWHMs mostly in the range 300--600 $\mathrm{km\ s^{-1}}$, comparable to or slightly larger than those of high-redshift star-forming galaxies (100--500 $\mathrm{km\ s^{-1}}$). We measure the fraction of broad Ly$α$ emitters above a broad Ly$α$ luminosity threshold of $L_{\mathrm{Ly}α,\mathrm{broad}}=10^{42}\ \mathrm{erg\ s^{-1}}$, obtaining $0.10^{+0.12}_{-0.07}$ for LRDs, about five times higher than the $2σ$ upper limit of $<0.02$ for high-redshift star-forming galaxies. Although we reproduce the broad Ly$α$ component reported in a previous stacking analysis of eight LRDs, albeit with a large uncertainty, we find no evidence for broad Ly$α$ emission in either the larger JWST stack, after excluding the two individually detected broad Ly$α$ emitters, or the higher-resolution MUSE stack. These results suggest that broad Ly$α$ emission is not ubiquitous among LRDs. Instead, LRDs with broad Ly$α$ emission appear to represent a rare population that may correspond to a particular evolutionary stage, potentially associated with unusually strong outflows or other distinctive physical conditions.

analysis.title_zh: ATLAS IV：基于JWST+MUSE的小红点星系Lyα轮廓人口统计研究
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用JWST/NIRSpec和VLT/MUSE中等分辨率光谱，对 z=3–9 小红点星系的 Lyα 线型进行初步统计研究。摘要报告，在31个LRD中识别到14个Lyα发射体，只有两个显示宽Lyα发射，堆叠结果也不支持宽Lyα在LRD中普遍存在。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 高红移LRD及其Lyα性质有助于理解早期星系、可能的AGN活动、外流以及电离氢介质环境，这些都与再电离时期的天体源建模相关。对CMB研究而言，联系主要体现在再电离历史和光学深度的天体物理先验，而摘要本身不涉及CMB数据或宇宙学参数拟合。
key_points: 统计 z=3–9 小红点星系的 Lyα 线型，样本来自JWST/NIRSpec与VLT/MUSE。
摘要称宽Lyα并非LRD普遍特征，可能只对应稀有演化阶段或特殊物理条件。
对CMB研究的关联主要是高红移星系与再电离时代背景，而非直接CMB测量。
methods: JWST/NIRSpec grating光谱
VLT/MUSE Deep与Wide巡天光谱
Lyα发射线识别与FWHM测量
宽Lyα发射体比例估计
堆叠光谱分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对LRD选择函数、MUSE与JWST光谱分辨率和灵敏度差异、宽线阈值设定及堆叠样本剔除策略，因为这些会直接影响“宽Lyα不普遍”的判断。

papers.title: The deepest color-magnitude diagrams for the benchmark open cluster NGC 2437 from Gaia and VVVX
papers.abstract: Deep photometry of Galactic star clusters provides one of the most powerful tools for determining their physical properties. In particular, in low Galactic latitude regions that suffer from heavy extinction and crowding. NGC2437 is the most extended star cluster in the near-IR footprint of the VVV Extended Survey (VVVX), covering more than one degree on the sky. We aim to characterize its physical properties using Gaia DR3 in the optical and the VVVX in the near-IR. We use Gaia DR3 proper motions to select NGC2437 members in order to make optical and near-IR color-magnitude and color-color diagrams. We further exploited the newly constructed VVVX deep stack images to obtain the deepest near-IR color-magnitude diagram currently available for this cluster. We estimate the main physical parameters for NGC2437, including the mean parallax of 0.608 mas and PMs (-3.85, 0.41) mas/yr. The mean reddening E(J-Ks) = 0.059 mag and extinction of A_k = 0.034 mag for the cluster field, with no significant differential reddening spread. A distance modulus of 11.08 mag is estimated, equivalent to a distance of 1644 pc. This places NGC2437 at z=115 pc above the Galactic plane and at a galactocentric distance of 9.24 kpc. We measure the cluster structural parameters, obtaining a core radius of 10.79 arcmin. The estimated total absolute magnitudes are Mk = -4.91 mag and Mv = -3.70 mag. The cluster mean age is 350 Myr, using PARSEC-COLIBRI isochrones for solar metallicity. We measure a binary fraction of 28.6%. We also discuss the implications of the revised cluster parameters for the nearby open cluster NGC2425, the planetary nebula NGC2438, and the evolved OH/IR source OH231.8+04.2. The VVVX deep stacks increase the Ks photometric depth by 1.6 mag, nearly doubling the detected point sources and enabling significantly improved studies of stellar populations throughout the southern Galactic plane.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 12 figures, 1 tables. Accepted for Publication in A&A

analysis.title_zh: 基于 Gaia 和 VVVX 的基准疏散星团 NGC 2437 最深颜色-星等图
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 Gaia DR3 光学数据和 VVVX 近红外深叠加图像研究低银纬疏散星团 NGC 2437，通过自行筛选成员星并构建颜色-星等图来估计其距离、消光、年龄、结构参数和双星比例。摘要报告称，VVVX 深叠加获得了该星团目前最深的近红外颜色-星等图，并使 Ks 波段深度增加 1.6 星等、点源数接近翻倍。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于银河系星团和恒星族研究，与 CMB 本身关系较弱；但精确刻画低银纬恒星场、消光和源拥挤对于银河前景建模有间接价值。对 CMB 读者而言，它可作为了解 Gaia/VVVX 如何约束银河恒星分布和尘埃消光的背景材料。
key_points: 利用 Gaia DR3 自行筛选成员星，并结合 VVVX 近红外深叠加图像。
给出 NGC 2437 的距离、消光、年龄、结构参数和双星比例等星团参数。
VVVX 深叠加使 Ks 测光深度增加 1.6 星等，并显著增加探测点源数。
methods: Gaia DR3 光学数据与自行成员星筛选
VVVX 近红外数据与深叠加图像
光学和近红外颜色-星等图、颜色-颜色图
PARSEC-COLIBRI 太阳金属丰度等龄线
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对成员星选择、VVVX 深叠加测光误差与完备性、以及等龄线拟合中年龄、距离和消光之间的退化如何处理。

papers.title: How X-rays heat the IGM in different 21-cm simulation codes: a comparison between Licorice and Beorn
papers.abstract: Any interpretation of the 21-cm signal of neutral hydrogen using Bayesian inference methods can only be as accurate as the underlying simulation code used to model the state of the intergalactic medium (IGM). 3D radiative transfer (RT) simulation codes may capture complex physics, but are computationally expensive and, therefore, faster, more approximate codes have been developed. To improve our understanding of the convergence of simulation codes in the 21-cm science community, we present a comparison of the X-ray heating of the IGM modelled in Licorice, a 3D RT simulation code, and Beorn, a 1D RT code. We use Beorn to process sources extracted from Licorice simulations, using the same physics of the sources, in order to obtain two versions of the temperature of the IGM heated by X-rays. We observe a good agreement between the luminosity fields, mean temperatures, and global 21-cm signal of the two setups, but discrepancies in the distribution of temperature and 21-cm signal, which result in a $\sim 30\%$ difference in the 21-cm power spectrum. We attempt to isolate the approximations that lead to these differences and find that common approximations used in 1D RT codes produce effects of that magnitude. Using an emulator of the Licorice power spectra in an MCMC pipeline, we translate these differences between power spectra into differences between posterior distributions over the astrophysical parameters. We observe a typical bias between 1D posteriors of $\gtrsim 1 σ$ (with a noise level corresponding to 100h of SKA observations).

analysis.title_zh: 不同 21-cm 模拟代码中 X 射线如何加热星系际介质：Licorice 与 Beorn 的比较
analysis.summary_zh: 本文比较 21-cm 模拟中 X 射线对星系际介质加热的处理，具体将 3D 辐射转移代码 Licorice 与 1D 辐射转移代码 Beorn 在相同源物理下进行对照。摘要报告两者在亮度场、平均温度和全球 21-cm 信号上符合较好，但在温度和 21-cm 信号分布上有差异，导致约 30% 的功率谱差别，并可能在天体物理参数后验中引入约大于 1σ 的典型偏差。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 21-cm 宇宙学依赖对再电离前后 IGM 热史的精确建模，而未来 SKA 等实验的参数推断会直接受模拟近似影响。该工作提示，即使全球信号或平均量一致，辐射转移近似仍可能在 21-cm 功率谱和贝叶斯后验中形成不可忽略的系统偏差，对用 21-cm 数据约束早期星系和宇宙热史尤为重要。
key_points: 比较 Licorice 的 3D 辐射转移与 Beorn 的 1D 辐射转移对 IGM X 射线加热的建模。
平均温度、亮度场和全球 21-cm 信号一致性较好，但温度和 21-cm 信号分布存在差异。
这些差异可导致约 30% 的 21-cm 功率谱差别，并在 MCMC 参数推断中造成约大于 1σ 的典型偏差。

Beorn 1D radiative transfer code
从 Licorice 模拟中提取源并用 Beorn 处理
21-cm 功率谱比较
Licorice 功率谱 emulator
MCMC pipeline
100h SKA 观测噪声水平
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Beorn 与 Licorice 之间保持一致的源物理具体包括哪些，以及作者如何逐项隔离 1D RT 近似对温度分布和功率谱偏差的贡献。

papers.title: Nonstandard Solution for Anomaly Cancellation as Seesaw Neutrino Origin in the SM
papers.abstract: For fixed Standard Model (SM) non-Abelian representations of 15 chiral fermions with arbitrary hypercharges, anomaly cancellation admits the usual assignment and a distinct nonstandard solution. In the latter, the colored exotic quark and exotic lepton weak doublets and exotic lepton singlet have zero hypercharge, whereas the two colored exotic quark singlets carry opposite hypercharges $-q$ and $q$. The exotic neutral lepton singlets naturally play the role of the heavy neutrinos. The minimal model with two exotic lepton copies gives a rank-two seesaw, the minimal seesaw model, with one massless active neutrino and predicts $m_{ββ} = 1.2 \text{-} 4.1 \, \mathrm{meV}$ for normal ordering or $15.9\text{-}48.9 \,\mathrm{meV}$ for inverted ordering. In a direct SM realization, generating exotic quark masses through the SM Higgs mechanism forces the exotic quarks to carry electric charges $\pm 1/2$. A separate $\mathrm{SU}(2)_{L'}$ realization of the nonstandard solution can allow exotic quarks from several TeV to $10\,\mathrm{TeV}$ with order-one Yukawa couplings. In this model, the charged exotic quarks and leptons carry electric charges $\pm q$. In both cases, the lightest exotic quark and lepton are stable, but suitable choices of their charges and masses can satisfy experimental constraints.

analysis.title_zh: 标准模型中作为跷跷板中微子起源的反常抵消非标准解
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究标准模型手征费米子在固定非阿贝尔表示、任意超荷下的反常抵消条件，指出除通常超荷赋值外还有一个非标准解。摘要称该解中的奇异中性轻子单态可作为跷跷板机制的重中微子，最小模型产生秩二跷跷板并给出一个无质量活跃中微子及相应的 $m_{ββ}$ 范围。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作属于粒子唯象学，与 CMB 的联系主要通过中微子质量、有效中微子数、稳定奇异粒子和可能的暗物质/热史约束间接相关。CMB 研究者若关注宇宙学对中微子质量层级、额外稳定带电或弱相互作用粒子的限制，可将其作为模型输入背景。
key_points: 在固定 SM 非阿贝尔表示且任意超荷的设定下，反常抵消除通常解外还存在非标准解。
非标准解中的奇异中性轻子单态可自然充当跷跷板机制的重中微子。
最小两份奇异轻子模型给出秩二跷跷板，并在摘要中给出无中微子双β衰变有效质量范围。
methods: 标准模型手征费米子超荷的反常抵消条件分析
跷跷板中微子质量模型
直接 SM 实现与独立 SU(2)_{L'} 实现的模型构造
实验约束的参数选择讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对非标准反常抵消解的推导是否唯一、奇异粒子的稳定性是否导致宇宙学遗迹丰度问题，以及给出的电荷和质量选择如何满足现有实验约束。

papers.title: Cosmicflows-4 and the Cosmological Consistency of Large-Scale Motions
papers.abstract: We study coherent flows in Cosmicflows-4 (CF4) and its constituent catalogs. We fit monopole and dipole moments in nonoverlapping radial bins using a log-distance radial-velocity estimator. For each sample, the Planck 2018 $Λ$CDM prediction accounts for the actual positions, statistical weights, velocity covariance, and measurement covariance. Across six bins extending to $300,h^{-1},\mathrm{Mpc}$, the All Individual sample is broadly consistent with $Λ$CDM, with dipole and joint deviations of $2.29σ$ and $2.36σ$. The strongest localized feature occurs at $120$--$160,h^{-1},\mathrm{Mpc}$, where $|V_{\rm dip}|=628\pm82,\mathrm{km,s^{-1}}$ and the dipole deviation reaches $3.40σ$. The excess is concentrated toward negative supergalactic X and depends strongly on the survey window. TFR and 6dFGS favor larger dipoles, while SDSS and SN favor smaller ones. Removing 6dFGS reduces the upper-bin dipole deviation to $1.56σ$, while removing SN raises it to $3.77σ$. Nevertheless, the SN and 6dFGS dipoles remain mutually consistent when their covariance is included. SDSS is consistent with $Λ$CDM through $160,h^{-1},\mathrm{Mpc}$ but shows a separate rise at larger radii whose significance depends on the treatment of the monopole and shared distance-scale covariance. Overall, CF4 does not show uniformly anomalous motion across its full radial range. Instead, it contains localized and window-dependent features that should be tested with selection-matched mock catalogs and correlated calibration uncertainties.

analysis.title_zh: Cosmicflows-4与大尺度运动的宇宙学一致性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用Cosmicflows-4及其子星表研究大尺度相干速度流，在非重叠径向壳层中拟合单极和偶极，并与包含实际位置、权重和协方差的Planck 2018 ΛCDM预期比较。摘要报告CF4整体与ΛCDM大体一致，但在120--160 h^{-1} Mpc处存在局域且依赖巡天窗口的较强偶极特征，不同子样本对该特征的贡献并不相同。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 大尺度本动速度检验的是低红移宇宙的结构增长和引力势分布，可与CMB给出的ΛCDM初始条件和参数预言相互比较。若速度流存在稳健异常，可能指向局域结构、选择效应、距离标定系统误差，或更广义的宇宙学张力；但摘要强调目前特征是局域和窗口依赖的。
key_points: CF4整体到300 h^{-1} Mpc范围内未呈现一致的异常大尺度运动。
最显著的局域偶极特征出现在120--160 h^{-1} Mpc径向壳层，并且强烈依赖巡天窗口。
不同子样本如TFR、6dFGS、SDSS和SN给出的偶极趋势不同，需用匹配选择函数的模拟检验。
methods: Cosmicflows-4及其组成星表
非重叠径向分箱中的单极和偶极矩拟合
log-distance径向速度估计量
Planck 2018 ΛCDM预测
速度协方差、测量协方差、统计权重和实际天体位置建模
子样本移除检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对作者如何构造各子样本的窗口函数、协方差矩阵和距离标定误差；尤其要看120--160 h^{-1} Mpc偶极异常在选择函数匹配的mock中是否仍然罕见。

papers.title: Cosmographic Reconstruction of the Quintessence Potential in Scalar-Tensor Gravity
papers.abstract: We generalise the cosmographic reconstruction programme of Chakraborty, Dunsby & Scherrer to scalar-tensor gravity. Working in the Jordan frame with a general non-minimal coupling $F(Φ)$, we derive exact closed-form expressions for the potential slope $λ_U$, the coupling slope $λ_F$, and their curvature parameters $Γ_U$ and $Γ_F$ in terms of the cosmographic parameters $(q,j,s)$, the Planck-mass running $α_M = d\ln F/d\ln a$ and its derivatives. We express $α_M$ and its derivatives in terms of a set of coefficients $g_n$ describing the time variation of the gravitational constant $G\propto F^{-1}$, casting all four quantities in fully observable form. We then evaluate the reconstruction against current data, including DESI~DR2 baryon acoustic oscillation measurements and Lunar Laser Ranging constraints on $\dot G/G$, propagating the cosmographic uncertainties through to the reconstructed potential. All expressions reduce analytically to those of Chakraborty, Dunsby & Scherrer in the minimally-coupled limit, which we verify symbolically. We find that the potential slope $λ_U$ is recovered at the few-tenths level while the curvature $Γ_U$ is essentially unconstrained. We further show that the positivity of the scalar kinetic term is equivalent to $w_{\rm eff,0}\ge-1$, so that the region of cosmographic parameter space closed to minimally-coupled quintessence is exactly the phantom region, and that the non-minimal coupling reopens it through a single coefficient $g_2$ of the gravitational tower. Because Lunar Laser Ranging forces $|g_1|\lesssim2\times10^{-4}$ while the reconstruction is sensitive to $g_2\sim O(0.1)$, the framework presupposes that $α_M$ is passing through zero at the present epoch, as expected on the Damour--Nordtvedt least-coupling attractor.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 5 figures. The numerical analysis files used for the reproduction of the figures can be found at: https://github.com/leandros11/st-reconstruction

analysis.title_zh: 标量-张量引力中精质势的宇宙志重构
analysis.summary_zh: 本文把Chakraborty、Dunsby与Scherrer的宇宙志重构方案推广到Jordan frame中的标量-张量引力，推导势函数和耦合函数相关斜率、曲率参数的闭式表达，并用DESI DR2 BAO和月球激光测距约束评估。摘要报告势斜率可在有限精度下恢复，而势曲率基本不受约束；非最小耦合可通过引力常数时间变化塔中的系数改变最小耦合quintessence对phantom区域的限制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗能量和修正引力是解释晚期宇宙加速、检验ΛCDM的重要方向，而CMB给出的距离尺度、结构增长和早期宇宙参数通常为此类模型提供基准约束。该文结合BAO和本地G变化率约束，讨论与动态暗能量和有效引力强度演化相关的可观测重构，因此与CMB联合宇宙学参数推断和暗能量模型判别相关。
key_points: 将宇宙志重构从最小耦合quintessence推广到标量-张量引力。
给出势斜率、耦合斜率及曲率参数关于宇宙志参数和Planck质量运行的闭式表达。
摘要称当前数据下势斜率可恢复到十分之几量级，而势曲率基本不受约束。
methods: Jordan frame标量-张量引力
非最小耦合函数F(Φ)

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对闭式重构公式的假设条件、宇宙志展开的红移适用范围，以及DESI DR2和月球激光测距约束如何传递到g_n和α_M；还需确认“phantom区域由非最小耦合重新打开”的物理条件是否依赖特定参数化。

papers.title: Constraining Primordial Power Asymmetry from Galaxy Clustering and Peculiar Velocity Information
papers.abstract: Primordial power asymmetry would probe departures from statistical isotropy, offering a clue to the physics of the primordial Universe. We investigate how such asymmetries can be tested with galaxy surveys and quantify how peculiar-velocity information can improve these tests. We develop a unified bipolar spherical harmonic (BipoSH) analysis of the auto- and cross-power spectra of galaxy density and line-of-sight peculiar velocity, and perform Fisher forecasts combining a Euclid-like spectroscopic galaxy survey with peculiar velocities reconstructed from Simons Observatory-like CMB maps through the kinetic Sunyaev-Zel'dovich effect. For dipolar asymmetry, we consider both scale-independent and scale-dependent modulations proportional to $k^{-0.5}$. Galaxy clustering provides most of the constraining power in both cases, while peculiar velocities add only modest information. For quadrupolar asymmetry, we account for the recently identified anisotropic galaxy-bias response and marginalize over its amplitude. We find that galaxy clustering alone suffers from a degeneracy between the primordial quadrupolar modulation and anisotropic galaxy bias. This degeneracy can be substantially broken by adding peculiar-velocity information: the density-velocity cross-spectrum provides complementary information to the galaxy auto-spectrum, while the velocity auto-spectrum constrains the primordial modulation independently of anisotropic galaxy bias. The velocity information becomes increasingly effective for more negative scale dependence, yielding constraints tighter than those from BOSS for scale dependences proportional to $k^{-1}$ and $k^{-2}$. Our results demonstrate that peculiar-velocity information provides a complementary avenue for testing primordial power asymmetry with large-scale structure, particularly for quadrupolar asymmetry in the presence of anisotropic galaxy bias.

analysis.title_zh: 利用星系成团和奇异速度信息约束原初功率不对称
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究星系巡天和奇异速度信息如何约束原初功率不对称，使用统一的 BipoSH 框架分析星系密度与视向奇异速度的自谱和互谱，并做 Euclid-like 与 Simons Observatory-like kSZ 速度重建组合的 Fisher 预报。摘要报告称，偶极情形主要由星系成团提供约束、速度信息增益较小；四极情形中，加入速度信息可显著缓解原初四极调制与各向异性星系偏置之间的简并。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接关联 CMB 与大尺度结构的交叉宇宙学：奇异速度由 CMB 图中的运动学 Sunyaev-Zel'dovich 效应重建，而目标是检验原初宇宙的统计各向同性。它说明 CMB 次级各向异性信息不仅可用于速度场重建，也可与星系巡天互补地约束原初扰动的方向依赖性，尤其是在星系偏置系统学存在时。
key_points: 原初功率不对称可检验统计各向同性偏离。
星系成团通常提供主要约束；速度信息对偶极情形增益有限。
对四极不对称，奇异速度信息可帮助打破与各向异性星系偏置的简并。
methods: 双极球谐函数（BipoSH）分析
星系密度与视向奇异速度的自功率谱和互功率谱
Fisher 预报
Euclid-like 光谱星系巡天
由 Simons Observatory-like CMB 图通过 kSZ 效应重建的奇异速度
偶极尺度无关调制与正比于 k^{-0.5} 的尺度相关调制
四极情形中边缘化各向异性星系偏置响应振幅
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 BipoSH 形式中密度、速度及其互谱对原初调制和各向异性星系偏置的响应如何区分，以及 kSZ 速度重建噪声、巡天规格和偏置边缘化假设对四极约束改善的稳健性。

papers.title: Investigation of the black-hole quantum atmosphere from the effective proper temperature
papers.abstract: Hawking radiation may be regarded as originating at the event horizon; however, its spatial origin can instead be distributed over a finite region outside the horizon. In this paper, using an effective proper temperature, we investigate the quantum atmosphere within a tractable model based on the two-dimensional radial sector of $D$-dimensional Schwarzschild black holes. In the Hartle--Hawking state, the proper temperature is derived from the first law of thermodynamics in the presence of the conformal anomaly associated with Hawking radiation. In the Unruh state, we decompose the proper temperature into two chiral temperatures, $T_{\rm L}$ and $T_{\rm R}$, associated with the ingoing and outgoing fluxes, respectively. Demonstrating $T_{\rm R}$ as the effective proper temperature characterizing the outgoing Hawking flux with the proper temperature in the Hartle-Hawking state, we define the atmospheric radius effectively as the radial position at which the effective proper temperature attains its maximum. We then numerically compute the atmospheric radius of the quantum atmosphere for various spacetime dimensions and show that it decreases monotonically as the number of spacetime dimensions increases. In the large-dimensional limit, we find that the atmospheric radius remains separated from the horizon by a finite radial factor, indicating that the quantum atmosphere can persist as an extended exterior region in any dimension.

analysis.title_zh: 从有效固有温度研究黑洞量子大气
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用有效固有温度研究 D 维 Schwarzschild 黑洞二维径向扇区模型中的量子大气，即霍金辐射可能起源于视界外有限区域的问题。摘要报告称，作者通过 Hartle-Hawking 态和 Unruh 态中的温度构造定义大气半径，并数值发现该半径随时空维数增加而单调减小，但在大维数极限仍保持为视界外延展区域。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于黑洞量子场论和引力理论，对 CMB 数据分析没有直接应用。其宇宙学相关性在于霍金辐射、量子场在曲率背景中的反常和热性质是早期宇宙量子场论与半经典引力的概念基础；对 CMB 读者而言更偏理论背景而非观测相关论文。
key_points: 用有效固有温度研究黑洞霍金辐射的有限外部起源区域。
在 Hartle-Hawking 态中结合热力学第一定律和共形反常，在 Unruh 态中分解左右手温度。
数值结果显示量子大气半径随时空维数增加而单调减小，但大维数极限中仍与视界保持有限径向分离。
methods: D 维 Schwarzschild 黑洞二维径向扇区模型
有效固有温度
Hartle-Hawking 态与 Unruh 态分析
共形反常
不同维数下量子大气半径的数值计算
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“有效固有温度最大值”定义大气半径的物理合理性、二维径向约化对高维黑洞的适用范围，以及大维数极限中的有限分离是否依赖坐标或温度定义。

papers.title: Gravitational Waves from Dimension-6 Assisted Peccei - Quinn Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: We consider a simple model-independent extension of the minimal KSVZ axion model, augmenting the Peccei - Quinn effective potential with a dimension-6 operator invariant under the Peccei - Quinn symmetry. We show that this operator can trigger a first-order phase transition and study its cosmological consequences. We map out the parameter space, consistent with present observational constraints, in which the phase transition produces a gravitational wave signal observable at current and future interferometers, and we investigate the resulting dark matter phenomenology. Finally, we present specific ultraviolet completions that generate the dimension-6 operator, each leading to distinct phenomenological signatures, which motivates our model-independent approach.

analysis.title_zh: 由六维算符辅助的 Peccei–Quinn 相变产生的引力波
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究在最小 KSVZ 轴子模型的 Peccei–Quinn 有效势中加入 PQ 对称六维算符后，是否可诱发一阶相变及其宇宙学后果。摘要报告作者在满足现有观测约束的参数空间中寻找可被当前和未来干涉仪观测的引力波信号，并讨论相应暗物质现象学与若干紫外完备实现。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 的联系主要是间接的：PQ 相变、轴子暗物质和早期宇宙一阶相变都会影响宇宙学模型空间，而随机引力波背景可与 CMB 对早期宇宙、暗物质组成和新物理能标的约束互补。对 CMB 研究者而言，重点在于该模型是否引入额外辐射、等曲率或相变遗迹，从而与 CMB 约束共同限定轴子参数空间。
key_points: 在最小 KSVZ 轴子模型的 Peccei–Quinn 有效势中加入 PQ 对称的六维算符。
该算符可触发一阶相变，并可能产生当前或未来干涉仪可探测的引力波信号。
摘要还讨论了暗物质现象学和可生成该六维算符的紫外完备模型。
methods: 模型无关的最小 KSVZ 轴子模型扩展
