analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对六维算符触发一阶相变的条件、有效场论适用范围、观测约束如何施加，以及引力波可探测区域是否与轴子暗物质要求和紫外完备模型一致。

papers.title: Abundant Heavy Black Hole Seeds from Moderate Lyman-Werner Radiation
papers.abstract: The existence of high-redshift quasars may indicate that massive black hole seeds formed via supermassive Population III stars in atomic-cooling halos with large gas inflow rates; however, the dependence of this process on halo assembly rate and radiative background remains poorly constrained. We present a large suite of 65 high-resolution cosmological zoom-in simulations of 15 pristine halos spanning a wide range of Lyman-Werner radiation backgrounds and halo assembly histories. We introduce a novel method to estimate the final Population III stellar mass from radial gas infall profiles at the onset of runaway collapse and validate it against simulations from the literature that explicitly follow protostellar accretion with sink particles, reproducing protostellar masses to within a factor of $\sim2$. We find a clear transition in gas inflow rates between halos exposed to $J_{\rm 21} \lesssim 1$ and $J_{\rm 21} \gtrsim 10$, with the latter frequently sustaining inflow rates above the adopted threshold for supermassive star formation and producing estimated stellar masses up to $10^{5} \, M_{\odot}$. In contrast, the halo assembly timescale, $M_{\rm Halo}$/$\dot{M}_{\rm Halo}$, shows no statistically significant correlation with predicted stellar mass, despite halo assembly rates spanning $0.01$-$7 \, M_{\rm \odot} \, {\rm yr}^{-1}$. The Lyman-Werner radiation field therefore is a stronger predictor of sustained high accretion within our parameter space. Finally, a semi-analytic model applied to cosmological volumes shows that halos exposed to intermediate Lyman-Werner backgrounds ($1 \lesssim J_{\rm 21} < 10$) are orders of magnitude more common than those in the high-$J_{\rm 21}$ tail. If sustained high accretion extends into this intermediate regime, heavy black hole seeds may form in substantially more common environments than required by classical direct-collapse scenarios.

analysis.title_zh: 中等 Lyman–Werner 辐射产生丰富的重黑洞种子
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对高红移类星体所需的大质量黑洞种子形成问题，利用一大组高分辨率宇宙学 zoom-in 模拟和半解析模型考察 Lyman–Werner 辐射背景与晕装配史的作用。摘要报告在其参数空间内，Lyman–Werner 背景比晕装配时间尺度更能预测持续高吸积，并指出若中等背景也能维持高吸积，重黑洞种子可能在比经典直接坍缩情景更常见的环境中形成。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文不直接研究 CMB，但与早期结构形成和再电离前后的天体源族有关。高红移重黑洞种子的丰度会影响早期类星体形成、辐射背景和潜在再电离历史，因此可作为 CMB 再电离光学深度、二级各向异性以及未来 21 cm/星系巡天约束的背景模型输入。
key_points: 使用 65 个高分辨率宇宙学 zoom-in 模拟研究 15 个原初晕。
较强 Lyman–Werner 背景比晕装配时间尺度更能预测持续高吸积率。
半解析模型显示中等 Lyman–Werner 背景环境远比高背景尾部常见，可能放宽重黑洞种子的形成环境要求。
methods: 65 个高分辨率宇宙学 zoom-in 模拟
15 个原初原子冷却晕样本
不同 Lyman–Werner 辐射背景与晕装配历史
基于径向气体内流剖面的最终 Pop III 恒星质量估计方法
与含 sink particles 的原恒星吸积模拟文献结果对比验证
半解析模型应用于宇宙学体积
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对从径向内流剖面推断最终 Pop III 恒星质量的方法、超大质量恒星形成阈值的选择、Lyman–Werner 背景的建模，以及中等背景下高吸积能否持续这一关键外推是否被模拟直接支持。

papers.title: Axion Isocurvature Perturbations Survive the Scaling Evolution of Axion Domain Walls
papers.abstract: We revisit the evolution of axion domain walls seeded by inflationary fluctuations. In our previous work, we showed that such domain-wall networks retain superhorizon correlations even after entering the scaling regime. We extend our previous analysis to the case with large initial fluctuations, where many minima of the axion potential are already populated when the axion starts to oscillate. Although the conventional misalignment contribution can have suppressed long-wavelength isocurvature perturbations when many vacua are averaged over, axions produced by domain-wall collapse provide an additional contribution that can dominate when the walls enter the scaling regime before annihilation. In particular, the biased vacuum energy released during wall annihilation inherits the superhorizon correlations of the inflationary fluctuations and transfers them to the axion energy density. We find that sizable isocurvature perturbations can therefore survive even after the walls annihilate. We also discuss generic isocurvature constraints on dark matter produced by domain-wall collapse.

analysis.title_zh: 轴子等曲率扰动在轴子畴壁的标度演化后仍可存活
analysis.summary_zh: 本文重新研究由暴胀涨落播种的轴子畴壁网络，特别扩展到初始涨落较大、多个势能极小值在轴子开始振荡时已被占据的情形。摘要报告即便常规 misalignment 轴子的长波等曲率可因多真空平均而受抑，畴壁坍缩和湮灭释放的能量仍可继承超视界相关，并在最终轴子能量密度中留下可观等曲率扰动。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 关系直接而重要，因为轴子暗物质等曲率扰动是 CMB 温度和偏振各向异性强约束的对象。若畴壁坍缩产生的轴子能在湮灭后保留超视界等曲率，那么一些以多真空平均抑制 misalignment 等曲率的轴子情景仍可能受到 CMB 等曲率限制，需要重新评估可行参数空间。
key_points: 研究由暴胀涨落播种的轴子畴壁在 scaling 演化中的等曲率扰动。
即使常规 misalignment 贡献的长波等曲率因多真空平均被抑制，畴壁坍缩产生的轴子仍可保留超视界相关。
摘要认为畴壁湮灭释放的偏置真空能可把暴胀涨落相关性转移到轴子能量密度，使显著等曲率在湮灭后仍存活。
methods: 轴子畴壁演化再分析
大初始涨落情形扩展
多真空占据情形的 misalignment 贡献讨论
畴壁进入 scaling regime 与湮灭过程分析
畴壁坍缩产生暗物质的等曲率约束讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者如何定义和追踪超视界相关、畴壁进入 scaling regime 与湮灭时序的参数条件、畴壁坍缩轴子相对常规 misalignment 的能量占比，以及其等曲率约束是否可直接与 Planck/CMB 限制比较。

papers.title: A binary black hole merger rate comparison within the same metallicity - star formation rate framework
papers.abstract: Recent studies have suggested that binary population synthesis models, when coupled with observationally based, metallicity-dependent star formation rate density, overpredict the observed local binary black hole (BBH) merger rate density. The significance of this tension might vary depending on the specific code and parameters adopted. Thus, a more extensive exploration of the parameter space is required. In this work, we perform such an extended analysis by considering BBH merger efficiencies coming from multiple population synthesis codes across a wide range of physical assumptions and parameter's choices. We adopt an observationally motivated metallicity distribution, exploring several variations to encompass observational uncertainties. We find that the tension persists: in almost all our metallicity variations, 14 out of 18, none of the models considered predicts a local BBH merger rate within or below the observed $90\%$ credible interval. Even in the four most favorable metallicity variations, only $\lesssim 10\%$ of the models are consistent with the observational constraints. We show that such a discrepancy originates from the low-metallicity tail contributed by low-mass galaxies and starbursts, as well as from the use of iron abundance rather than oxygen abundance in deriving the metallicity distribution. Even literature models that predict moderate BBH merger rates shift toward higher merger rates when combined with observationally motivated metallicity distributions. Although not comprehensive of all the literature models, our analysis suggests that models featuring stronger natal kicks and/or non-standard treatments of mass-transfer and common-envelope physics provide the most promising avenue for alleviating the tension with the observed local BBH merger rate.

analysis.title_zh: 同一金属丰度—恒星形成率框架下的双黑洞并合率比较
analysis.summary_zh: 本文比较了多个双星族群合成代码在同一金属丰度依赖恒星形成率密度框架下对本地双黑洞并合率的预测。摘要报告称，在大多数金属丰度变化中，所考察模型仍高于观测约束，张力主要来自低质量星系和星暴贡献的低金属丰度尾部，以及金属丰度指标选择。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接研究 CMB，但属于宇宙学与多信使天体物理交叉问题：双黑洞并合率依赖宇宙恒星形成史、星系金属丰度演化和低金属丰度星族。对 CMB 研究者而言，它提示用引力波事件约束宇宙结构形成和星族演化时，天体物理系统误差可能主导解释。
key_points: 在同一金属丰度—恒星形成率框架下比较多个双星族群合成模型。
多数金属丰度变化下，模型仍倾向高估本地双黑洞并合率。
低金属丰度尾部、元素丰度口径以及双星物理处理是摘要指出的关键来源。
methods: 多个双星族群合成代码的双黑洞并合效率
观测动机的金属丰度分布及多种不确定性变化
与观测本地双黑洞并合率的90%可信区间比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对金属丰度分布如何由观测构造，铁丰度与氧丰度转换的假设，以及不同族群合成代码和强 natal kick、质量转移、公共包层处理对并合率张力的贡献是否可分离。

papers.title: Vector Perturbations in Ghost-Free Quasidilaton Massive Gravity
papers.abstract: We study transverse vector perturbations in ghost-free extended quasidilaton massive gravity without a quasidilaton kinetic term, in the presence of minimal matter. In vacuum, we recover the known result that the kinetic coefficient $K_V$ of the gravitational vector modes vanishes on the self-accelerating branch $J=0$, so those modes are infinitely strongly coupled at linear order. We then add a canonical scalar field and a single Abelian vector (Maxwell or Proca). After integrating out the auxiliary shift, we find the same $K_V$ as in vacuum. The scalar matter has no transverse perturbation; it enters the unsimplified shift constraint, but those terms cancel once the Friedmann equation is used. A Maxwell or Proca field with vanishing isotropic background does not mix with the gravitational vectors at quadratic order. Minimal matter therefore leaves $K_V=0$ on Branch II. We do not claim that the modes are absent from the nonlinear theory. We do conclude that ordinary minimal matter is not enough to make the vector sector perturbatively healthy on this branch. If we need healthy gravitational vector modes at the linear level, Branch I is the branch to use.
papers.comment: 9 pages. Mathematica notebook supplement is enclosed in the source file

analysis.title_zh: 无鬼 quasidilaton 大质量引力中的矢量扰动
analysis.summary_zh: 本文分析 ghost-free 扩展 quasidilaton massive gravity 中的横向矢量扰动，考察加入正则标量场以及 Maxwell/Proca 场后能否改善自加速分支上的矢量部门。摘要报告，普通最小耦合物质不会改变该分支上引力矢量模的动能系数 K_V=0，因此不足以使线性扰动健康。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 大质量引力和修正引力模型常被用于解释宇宙加速，其扰动稳定性直接决定模型能否作为暗能量替代理论参与宇宙学拟合。虽然摘要未涉及 CMB 数据分析，但引力扰动的健康性会影响大尺度结构、透镜和 CMB 各向异性中的理论可行性。
key_points: 研究无 quasidilaton 动能项的 ghost-free extended quasidilaton massive gravity 中横向矢量扰动。
在自加速分支 J=0 上，加入普通最小耦合物质后矢量动能系数仍为零。
作者认为若要求线性层面的健康引力矢量模，应使用 Branch I。
methods: 线性横向矢量扰动分析
二次阶作用量/动能系数 K_V 计算
积分掉辅助 shift 变量
加入正则标量场与单个 Abelian 矢量场（Maxwell 或 Proca）
利用 Friedmann 方程化简约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 K_V=0 的结论是否依赖“无 quasidilaton 动能项”、各向同性背景取零、最小耦合物质和自加速分支 J=0 等假设，并确认非线性强耦合问题与线性有效理论适用性的界限。

papers.title: Higher-Order Analytical Expansion of Thawing Dark Energy with an Exponential Potential
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent DESI results suggesting dynamical dark energy, we investigate the thawing scenario in quintessence with an exponential potential, $V=V_0e^{-λφ/m_{\mathrm{pl}}}$, by analytically expanding the deviation of the equation of state parameter $w_φ$ from $-1$ in powers of $λ$. In addition to the previously known leading-order result at $O(λ^2)$, we derive the $O(λ^4)$ correction as a function of the density parameter $Ω_φ$. We show that a consistent determination of the redshift dependence of $w_φ$ through $O(λ^4)$ requires corrections to the background expansion. We obtain the required correction by expanding $Ω_φ$ in powers of $λ$ around its $Λ\mathrm{CDM}$ value. Comparison with numerical solutions demonstrates that the $O(λ^4)$ expansion provides a more accurate approximation than the leading-order result. Our analytical approximation, which consistently incorporates the $O(λ^4)$ correction, will provide a potentially useful tool for distinguishing the exponential quintessence model from other dark energy models in future observations.

analysis.title_zh: 指数势解冻型暗能量的高阶解析展开
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究指数势 thawing quintessence 暗能量模型，将状态方程参数 w_φ 对 -1 的偏离按 λ 展开，并在已知 O(λ²) 基础上推导 O(λ⁴) 修正。摘要称，一致得到 O(λ⁴) 的红移演化还需修正背景膨胀，且该解析近似比 leading-order 结果更接近数值解。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗能量状态方程的红移演化会影响 CMB 距离标尺、晚期 ISW 效应以及与 BAO/超新星数据的联合约束。该解析展开可为比较 ΛCDM、指数 quintessence 和其他动力学暗能量模型提供快速理论模板，尤其与 DESI 等大型巡天及 CMB 联合分析相关。
key_points: 受 DESI 动力学暗能量迹象启发，研究指数势 thawing quintessence。
在已知 O(λ²) 结果之外推导 w_φ 偏离 -1 的 O(λ⁴) 修正。
一致的 O(λ⁴) 红移演化需要同时修正背景膨胀 Ω_φ。
methods: 指数势 V=V0 exp(-λφ/m_pl) 的 thawing quintessence 模型
按 λ 展开 w_φ+1
推导 O(λ^4) 解析修正
围绕 ΛCDM 值展开 Ω_φ
与数值解比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 O(λ^4) 近似在 λ、红移和 Ω_φ 范围内的有效性，以及与数值解比较的误差如何随参数变化；还需看其是否足以服务 DESI、CMB 联合约束中的实际模型区分。

papers.title: The Most Probable Outer Density Profile from Excursion Set Theory
papers.abstract: Measurements of the turnaround radius around galaxy clusters can be used to break the degeneracy between measurements of the present day energy density of matter and dark energy. Korkidis & Pavlidou showed that the turnaround radius coincides with the first point of deviation between outer density profiles in N-body simulations and the analytic profile predicted by excursion set theory. However, their analytic profile relied on a number of simplifying assumptions, which may each introduce systematic error. We evaluate the effect of these assumptions on the shape of the analytic profile and its correspondence with simulated outer density profiles. We relax the key simplifying assumptions and re-derive the mode of the outer density profile from excursion set theory. We then numerically resolve the double distribution (DD) across a range of masses and clustering parameters, and compare the numerical mode estimate to the re-derived analytic profile. We find excellent agreement between our analytic profile and the numerically-realized DD. However, our analytic profiles diverge from N-body profiles, and this divergence grows as we relax successive assumptions. We relate this mismatch to the differing window functions used in the analytic and simulation-based approaches, which respectively yield Markovian and correlated density trajectories. We conclude that the analytic profile proposed by Korkidis & Pavlidou should only be used as a few-parameter effective description of the most-probable outer density profile, with parameters fitted to results of cosmological simulations.

analysis.title_zh: 来自 Excursion Set Theory 的最可能外部密度剖面
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究用星系团 turnaround radius 打破当今物质与暗能量密度测量简并时，excursion set theory 对外部密度剖面的预测是否可靠。作者放松既有解析模型的简化假设、重推导最可能剖面并数值求解 double distribution，发现解析结果与数值 DD 很一致，但与 N-body 剖面偏离且偏离随假设放松而增大。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团 turnaround radius 可作为晚期宇宙学探针，帮助约束物质密度和暗能量密度，从而与 CMB 给出的早期宇宙约束互补；但摘要显示其理论模板与 N-body 模拟存在系统差异，关系到这类低红移探针能否稳健用于联合宇宙学分析。
key_points: 研究星系团周围 turnaround radius 与外部密度剖面的理论描述。
从 excursion set theory 重新推导最可能外部密度剖面的众数，并数值求解 double distribution。
摘要称解析剖面与数值 DD 符合良好，但与 N-body 剖面的偏离在放松假设后增大。
methods: excursion set theory
outer density profile 的解析重推导
double distribution 的数值求解
与 N-body simulations 的外部密度剖面比较
不同质量和 clustering parameters 的扫描
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对被放松的简化假设分别是什么、窗口函数差异如何导致 Markovian 与 correlated density trajectories 的不匹配，以及将解析剖面作为有效参数化时如何拟合模拟结果。

papers.title: Automatic detection of fast oscillations of dark matter scalar field and updated cosmological constraints on QCDM
papers.abstract: It is well known that a scalar field dark matter with a quadratic potential undergoes fast oscillations when the time period represented by the mass scale in the Klein-Gordon equation becomes much smaller than that set by the Hubble parameter. This makes a solution to the equation numerically intractable. Many works in the literature have addressed the problem by either switching between solving the Klein-Gordon equation in the well-behaved regime to solving the fluid equations at the onset of oscillations, or by introducing a new set of variables that can absorb these oscillations. Despite being successful, these techniques rely on an estimate of when the oscillations start. For large scale scans of a model's parameter space, this can become cumbersome. Furthermore, the techniques have been used mainly for non-interacting dark matter models. In this work, we introduce an averaging technique with an automatic detection of the onset of oscillations, capable of capturing the non-interacting as well as the interacting dark matter scenarios. The technique, implemented in \texttt{CLASS}, is tested on the QCDM model and shows excellent detection and averaging abilities. We also update the cosmological constraints on the model using the most recent public data.

analysis.title_zh: 暗物质标量场快速振荡的自动探测及 QCDM 的更新宇宙学约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对二次势标量场暗物质进入快速振荡后 Klein-Gordon 方程难以数值求解的问题，提出一种可自动探测振荡起点的平均化技术。该方法实现于 CLASS，并在 QCDM 模型中测试，摘要称其具有良好的探测和平均化能力，同时用最新公开数据更新了该模型的宇宙学约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 标量场暗物质模型会影响背景演化和扰动演化，进而进入 CMB 各向异性与大尺度结构的联合约束；将该算法实现于 CLASS 直接关系到 CMB 参数推断中这类模型的数值稳定性和大规模参数扫描效率。
key_points: 面向二次势标量场暗物质快速振荡导致 Klein-Gordon 方程数值求解困难的问题。
提出带自动振荡起点探测的平均化技术，并实现于 CLASS。
在 QCDM 模型上测试该技术，并用最新公开数据更新宇宙学约束。
methods: Klein-Gordon 方程
fluid equations
自动探测振荡起点的 averaging technique
CLASS 实现
QCDM 模型测试
最新公开数据的宇宙学约束更新
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对自动探测振荡起点的判据、平均化后与直接 Klein-Gordon 求解或流体近似的误差控制，以及更新约束所用的具体公开数据集和 CMB likelihood 处理方式。

papers.title: Unknown Unknowns: Model Misspecification in Machine Learning for Physics
papers.abstract: Machine learning is now a central tool for solving inverse problems in particle physics and astronomy. Models are trained on simulation and deployed on real data, raising the question not just of whether they fit, but of whether they are wrong in ways we did not anticipate: the unknown unknowns. This challenge of model misspecification is not unique to machine learning. In physics, misspecification is sometimes exactly what we want to find: new discoveries appear as failures of existing models. At other times, we want such effects absorbed into the analysis without biasing the measurement. A robust analysis is one that absorbs the misspecifications we are not interested in, while preserving sensitivity to the ones we are. Machine learning can both amplify misspecification and provide new tools to address it. We discuss the challenges of model misspecification, diagnostics for detecting it, and strategies for mitigation. No single diagnostic can confirm that a model is correctly specified: detection and mitigation are two halves of an iterative loop, in which a battery of complementary diagnostics is applied, the model is updated, and the process repeated. Robustness against unknown unknowns is ultimately less about any single technique than about a disposition: a willingness to suspect one's own model, and to design analyses that can survive being wrong in ways one did not anticipate.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 2 figures, part of the VERaiPHY initiative

analysis.title_zh: 未知的未知：物理机器学习中的模型错设
analysis.summary_zh: 本文讨论机器学习用于粒子物理和天文学反问题时的模型错设问题，特别是训练模拟与真实数据之间未预期的不一致。摘要强调没有单一诊断能证明模型正确，稳健性依赖多种互补诊断、模型更新和反复迭代的分析流程。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章与 CMB 数据分析高度相关，尤其是机器学习用于前景分离、去噪、透镜重建、模拟基推断和异常探测时。CMB 分析常依赖精细模拟和强模型假设，模型错设可能把前景、仪器效应或仿真偏差误解释为宇宙学信号，也可能掩盖真正的新物理。
key_points: 讨论机器学习在物理反问题中面对训练模拟与真实数据不一致的风险。
强调模型错设既可能带来偏差，也可能是新物理发现信号。
主张用互补诊断、缓解和迭代更新构建稳健分析。
methods: 模型错设诊断
错设缓解策略
训练于模拟并应用于真实数据的机器学习反问题框架
迭代式诊断—更新流程
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者给出的诊断工具是否能区分 nuisance 型错设与潜在新物理信号，以及这些策略是否适用于 CMB 似然、前景清除、参数推断和仿真到观测的 domain shift。

papers.title: JWST Detects a Dusty AGB-like Source Before the Type Ia-CSM Supernova 2026sqf
papers.abstract: Supernova (SN) 2026sqf recently appeared in the nearby face-on spiral galaxy NGC 3310 and has shown signs of strong interaction with a circumstellar medium (CSM). Such intense interaction, rare among nearby SNe, offers a valuable opportunity to reveal details on the origin and nature of its progenitor system. We analyzed the early-phase spectra and light curves (LCs) of SN 2026sqf. The general shapes of the observed spectra, the strengths of the emission lines, and the LC evolution all suggest that SN 2026sqf belongs to the rare SN Ia-CSM subclass. If confirmed, this would be the closest known member of this class, at D~19 Mpc. We also report the first candidate progenitor system for a thermonuclear supernova identified in JWST pre-explosion imaging, and the first evidence for a (probable) carbon-rich AGB donor to the exploding white dwarf (WD). Our results are consistent with the expectation that SNe Ia-CSM emerge from a system consisting of a WD and an AGB star undergoing a common-envelope phase. The CSM mass and dust content are consistent with expectations for an AGB environment, but the narrow-line width exceeds superwind expansion velocities, favoring an episodic ejection. Binary interaction shortly before the explosion is a natural explanation, though the channel and timescale remain uncertain. Late-time follow-up, especially with JWST, will test the identification and the conclusions of our early-phase analysis.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables; submitted to A&A (as a Letter)

analysis.title_zh: JWST 在 Ia-CSM 型超新星 2026sqf 爆发前探测到一个类似含尘 AGB 星的源
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究近邻星系 NGC 3310 中出现的 SN 2026sqf，利用早期光谱、光变曲线和 JWST 爆发前成像来判断其性质。摘要称其观测特征支持罕见的 SN Ia-CSM 分类，并报告了一个热核超新星候选前身系统及可能的富碳 AGB 供体，但仍需晚期 JWST 等随访检验。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是 CMB 论文，但与宇宙学中的 Ia 型超新星系统误差有关：Ia-CSM 这类有强星周介质相互作用的热核超新星会影响 Ia 型超新星族群、前身星通道和光变曲线解释。对用超新星作距离探针的宇宙学研究而言，理解这类少见通道有助于界定样本污染和物理多样性。
key_points: SN 2026sqf 的早期光谱、发射线强度和光变曲线演化被认为符合罕见的 SN Ia-CSM 子类。
摘要报告了 JWST 爆发前成像中的候选热核超新星前身系统，并提出可能存在富碳 AGB 供体。
作者认为 CSM 质量和尘埃含量与 AGB 环境相符，但窄线宽度更支持爆发前的 episodic ejection。
methods: JWST 爆发前成像
早期光谱分析
光变曲线分析
CSM 质量和尘埃含量的解释
晚期随访，尤其 JWST，被提出为检验手段
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 SN Ia-CSM 分类依据是否充分、JWST 源与真实前身系统的 astrometric/photometric 关联有多稳健，以及 AGB 供体和 episodic ejection 解释是否存在退化方案。

papers.title: Radio Properties of Narrow-Line and Broad-Line Seyfert 1 Galaxies
papers.abstract: Narrow-line Seyfert 1 (NLS1) galaxies host active galactic nuclei (AGN) with narrow optical emission lines of the broad-line region. This is often explained with a relatively lower mass of the central supermassive black hole and super-Eddington accretion. We compared the radio properties of large samples of NLS1 and broad-line Seyfert 1 (BLS1) galaxies compiled from the Sloan Digital Sky Survey. We cross-matched the NLS1 and BLS1 samples with the Faint Images of the Radio Sky at Twenty-Centimeters (FIRST) sky survey at 1.4 GHz and the first and second epoch data of the Very Large Array Sky Survey (VLASS) at 3 GHz. We calculated the radio spectral indices, the 1.4-GHz radio power, and the radio loudness. We found lower 1.4-GHz radio detection rates for the NLS1 galaxies. The median radio loudness values, the fraction of radio-loud AGN, and the median 1.4-GHz radio power are also lower for the NLS1 sample. The median spectral indices imply a slightly steeper radio spectrum for the NLS1 sample than for the BLS1 sample. Comparison of the star formation rates estimated from the radio data and the infrared measurements of the Wide-field Infrared Survey Explorer satellite indicated that more than half of the FIRST- and VLASS-detected NLS1 and BLS1 galaxies contain radio-emitting AGN.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables. Published in Galaxies

analysis.title_zh: 窄线与宽线 Seyfert 1 星系的射电性质
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文比较 SDSS 编目的窄线 Seyfert 1 与宽线 Seyfert 1 星系的射电性质，并与 FIRST、VLASS 及 WISE 数据结合分析。摘要报告 NLS1 在探测率、射电响度、射电响 AGN 比例和 1.4 GHz 射电功率上总体低于 BLS1，且射电探测样本中超过一半含有射电发射 AGN。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇工作主要属于星系与 AGN 物理，对 CMB 的关联是前景和源污染层面：射电 AGN 是 CMB 温度、透镜和二级各向异性分析中的点源前景。不同 AGN 子类的射电功率、谱指数和探测率统计可帮助改进源族群建模与多频掩膜策略。
key_points: 研究比较了 SDSS 中 NLS1 与 BLS1 星系的大样本射电性质。
NLS1 的 1.4 GHz 射电探测率、射电响度、射电响 AGN 比例和中位射电功率较低。
FIRST 和 VLASS 探测到的两类源中，超过一半包含射电发射 AGN。
methods: SDSS 窄线 Seyfert 1 与宽线 Seyfert 1 样本
FIRST 1.4 GHz 巡天交叉匹配
VLASS 3 GHz 第一、第二历元数据交叉匹配
射电谱指数、1.4 GHz 射电功率和射电响度计算
基于射电数据与 WISE 红外测量的恒星形成率比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 NLS1/BLS1 样本选择、交叉匹配半径与非探测处理，以及射电发射中 AGN 与恒星形成贡献分离的方法是否会系统性影响两类源的比较。

papers.title: X-ray Flaring and Variability in NGC 1275, the Heart of the Perseus Cluster
papers.abstract: NGC 1275 is the central galaxy in the Perseus Cluster. The active galactic nucleus (AGN) within NGC 1275 is notable for its strong and variable radio activity, tied to the production of radio jets that inflate large bubbles in the hot intracluster medium (ICM). High spatial resolution X-ray imaging can separate the AGN from the bright ICM, but monitoring the mass accretion rate onto the black hole and establishing disk-jet connections in NGC 1275 requires a high cadence. Here, we report on X-ray monitoring of NGC 1275 using data taken over 20 years with the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory. Modeling the temporally constant ICM in each observation allows X-ray emission from accretion onto the black hole to be traced reliably, with typical flux errors of $\sim 3\%$. X-ray flaring by a factor of $\sim2$ over mere days is detected starting on MJD 59956 (2023 Feb. 21). The flares imply an emission region consistent with $r \leq 870~(10^{8}~M_{\odot}/M_{BH})~ GM/c^{2}$. The profile of the flaring is inconsistent with simple predictions for tidal disruption events. A flare appears roughly 300 days later in radio monitoring data at 43 GHz. Overall, our results indicate that coordinated, moderate-resolution X-ray imaging and radio monitoring could potentially trace disk-jet connections in the AGN that most vividly impact large-scale structure, and be extended to other sources that impact their hosts.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in ApJ Letters

analysis.title_zh: Perseus 星系团核心 NGC 1275 中的 X 射线耀发与变异性
analysis.summary_zh: 这篇论文利用 Swift 对 Perseus 星系团中心星系 NGC 1275 的约 20 年 X 射线监测，试图在明亮 ICM 背景中可靠追踪 AGN 吸积相关发射。摘要报告探测到数天尺度、约 2 倍的 X 射线耀发，且约 300 天后在 43 GHz 射电监测中出现对应耀发，提示可用联合 X 射线与射电监测研究盘-喷流联系。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: NGC 1275 位于 Perseus 这类重要星系团环境中，AGN 喷流对 ICM 加热和大尺度结构气体热史有直接影响。对 CMB 研究而言，星系团气体状态关系到 SZ 效应建模、星系团宇宙学质量校准以及 AGN 反馈对重子分布的系统影响，因此这类个例监测具有间接但明确的宇宙学相关性。
key_points: 作者用 Swift 约 20 年监测数据追踪 NGC 1275 核区 X 射线变化。
通过在每次观测中建模近似恒定的 ICM，分离黑洞吸积相关 X 射线发射。
摘要报告 2023 年 2 月起出现数天内约 2 倍的 X 射线耀发，并在约 300 天后见到 43 GHz 射电耀发。
methods: Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory 20 年 X 射线监测数据
逐次观测中对时间上恒定的星系团内介质 ICM 建模
X 射线光变监测
43 GHz 射电监测数据比较
耀发轮廓与简单潮汐瓦解事件预测比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 ICM 背景建模如何影响核区 X 射线光变、耀发时间延迟与盘-喷流联系的统计稳健性，以及排除简单 TDE 解释所用的具体假设。

papers.title: Optical concept model of the future cosmology project BISOU
papers.abstract: We present an optical analysis of BISOU (Balloon Interferometer for Spectral Observations of the primordial Universe), an astronomical balloon-borne pathfinder spectrometer developed as part of a preparatory study for a future space mission aiming at measuring spectral distortions of the cosmic microwave background (CMB). The BISOU optical system is based on a differential polarizing Fourier Transform Spectrometer (FTS) that receives inputs from both a sky-facing telescope and an internal calibration source. The FTS focal planes are equipped with bolometric detectors coupled to multimode feed horns, with distinct focal planes dedicated to the low (90 - 300GHz) and high (0.3 - 1.5THz) frequency bands. The optical analysis first relies on ray-tracing simulations to establish the overall configuration of the system, before proceeding to more advanced Gaussian beam and physical optics analyses.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. SPIE 14106, Optical Design and Engineering X, 141060M (26 May 2026)

analysis.title_zh: 未来宇宙学项目 BISOU 的光学概念模型
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 BISOU 气球载荷先导光谱仪的光学概念模型，目标是为未来测量 CMB 频谱畸变的空间任务做准备。摘要称其基于差分偏振傅里叶变换光谱仪，并用光线追迹、高斯光束和物理光学分析建立和评估 90 GHz 至 1.5 THz 的光学配置。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 频谱畸变测量要求极高的光学稳定性、定标能力和系统误差控制；BISOU 作为气球先导实验，其光学设计可为未来空间级 CMB 频谱任务验证关键仪器方案。
key_points: BISOU 是面向未来 CMB 频谱畸变空间任务的气球载荷先导光谱仪。
光学方案采用差分偏振傅里叶变换光谱仪，同时接收天空望远镜和内部定标源输入。
摘要明确区分 90–300 GHz 与 0.3–1.5 THz 两个焦平面频段。
methods: 光线追迹模拟
高斯光束分析
物理光学分析

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对光线追迹、高斯光束和物理光学三类分析之间的假设是否一致，尤其是多模馈源、双频段焦平面和内部定标源如何影响杂散光、波束匹配与系统误差控制。

papers.title: Optical development of the BISOU breadboard
papers.abstract: BISOU (Balloon Interferometer for Spectral Observations of the primordial Universe) is an astronomical balloon-borne pathfinder developed as part of a preparatory study for a future space mission aimed at measuring spectral distortions of the cosmic microwave background (CMB). A laboratory breadboard of the instrument is being developed at the Institut d'Astrophysique Spatiale (IAS), enabling the characterization of subsystems and instrument systematic effects, particularly in the optical system. The optical system is based on a differential polarizing Fourier Transform Spectrometer (FTS) that receives inputs from both a sky-facing telescope and an internal calibration source. The FTS focal planes include sub-K detectors coupled to multimode feed horns. The full spectral band, spanning between 90 and 1500 GHz, is sub-divided into two frequency sub-bands, thanks to the use of a dichroic. The optical analysis first relies on ray-tracing simulations to establish the overall configuration of the system, before proceeding to more advanced Gaussian beam and physical optics analyses.

analysis.title_zh: BISOU 实验室样机的光学开发
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 BISOU 仪器实验室 breadboard 的光学开发，用于表征子系统和光学系统误差。摘要说明该系统采用差分偏振傅里叶变换光谱仪、内部定标源和天空输入，并通过二向色元件将 90–1500 GHz 全频段分为两个子频段，再结合光线追迹、高斯光束和物理光学分析。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 对 CMB 频谱畸变实验而言，许多限制来自仪器系统误差而非单纯灵敏度；实验室 breadboard 能在飞行前检验光学链路、分频方案和定标路径，对未来 CMB 频谱畸变任务具有方法学意义。
key_points: 论文聚焦 BISOU 实验室 breadboard 的光学开发，而非完整飞行载荷结果。
breadboard 用于表征子系统和仪器系统误差，尤其是光学系统。
全频段 90–1500 GHz 通过二向色元件分成两个子频段。

差分偏振傅里叶变换光谱仪

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 breadboard 与预期飞行/空间任务光学系统之间的可比性：二向色分频、内部定标源、亚开尔文探测器耦合和多模馈源是否足以代表真实系统误差。

papers.title: Long-term 3+1 simulations of primordial black hole formation during radiation domination
papers.abstract: We develop an efficient three-dimensional numerical-relativity framework for primordial black-hole (PBH) formation from superhorizon curvature perturbations in a radiation-dominated Universe. We implement flux-conservative relativistic hydrodynamics in the adaptive-mesh-refinement code \textsc{GRChombo} and introduce a cosmologically scaled Gamma-driver that allows the cosmic-time step to grow in proportion to the scale factor. For a representative long-term simulation, the scaled driver preserves the apparent-horizon mass evolution and constraint behavior while reducing the number of coarse-level advances by a factor of approximately $94$ relative to the standard driver. We also construct a conformal-time version of the moving-puncture gauge as an independent check. Applying the framework to a spherical Gaussian curvature profile, we find a collapse threshold $0.79578 < μ_c < 0.79580$ and a critical exponent $γ\simeq 0.3559$, consistent with previous spherically symmetric results. We further fit the late-time PBH mass growth to the Zel'dovich--Novikov accretion law, demonstrating that the code can follow both near-critical collapse and long-term post-formation evolution in three dimensions. The framework provides a foundation for future studies of PBH formation beyond spherical symmetry.
papers.comment: Two columns, 17 pages, 6 figures; v2: references added

analysis.title_zh: 辐射主导时期原初黑洞形成的长期 3+1 维模拟
analysis.summary_zh: 本文开发了一个三维数值相对论框架，用于模拟辐射主导宇宙中由超视界曲率扰动形成原初黑洞。摘要报告该框架在球形高斯剖面测试中复现了既有球对称临界塌缩结果，并能跟踪形成后的长期质量增长。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 原初黑洞丰度取决于早期宇宙小尺度曲率扰动的塌缩阈值和质量映射，而这些小尺度扰动常与暴胀模型及 CMB 约束的外推相联系。更可靠的三维 PBH 形成模拟有助于把 CMB 可观测的早期宇宙物理与暗物质候选、引力波背景等宇宙学信号连接起来。
key_points: 构建了用于辐射主导时期 PBH 形成的三维数值相对论框架。
在 GRChombo 中实现通量守恒相对论流体，并引入随尺度因子增长时间步的宇宙学缩放 Gamma-driver。
球对称高斯曲率扰动测试给出的塌缩阈值和临界指数与既有球对称结果一致，并可追踪后期吸积演化。
methods: 三维数值相对论模拟

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对规范条件和时间步缩放是否影响临界行为、视界质量定义及长期吸积拟合，并确认三维框架在非球对称扰动中的数值稳定性与收敛性。

papers.title: FOSSIL's preliminary thermal architecture
papers.abstract: FOSSIL (FTS fOr CMB Spectral diStortIon expLoration) is a proposed ESA M8 mission tailored to measure the spectral distortions monopole of the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) with a sensitivity three orders of magnitude beyond the COBE/FIRAS legacy measurement. Achieving this sensitivity demands an extraordinarily challenging cryogenic architecture: the scientific instrument must be maintained at 4.5 K, while the detector focal plane assembly operates at 50 mK. This paper presents an overview of the preliminary thermal architecture of the FOSSIL payload, from the spacecraft service module at 293~K down to the sub-kelvin detector stage. The design draws on heritage from the Planck and ARIEL missions and relies on a staged passive cooling chain comprising a multi-layer insulation blanket, three V-groove radiators (operating at approximately 130 K, 90 K, and 50 K), and a 25 K actively cooled shield fed by an ESA-provided 4 K mechanical cryocooler. Sub-kelvin temperatures are achieved via a multi-stage adiabatic demagnetisation refrigerator (ADR) developed for NewAthena/X-IFU, providing continuous cooling at 1.8 K and 350 mK, and 50 mK with an 80% duty cycle. The Focal Plane Assembly (FPA), housing four Kinetic Inductance Detector (KID) arrays at 50 mK, is thermally isolated from the 4.5 K bench via a carbon-fibre reinforced polymer (CFRP) hexapod with staged heat interception. We outline the staged cooling concept and show that the architecture closes with positive thermal margins at every stage; the detailed steady-state thermal budget will be presented in a forthcoming dedicated paper.
papers.journal_ref: Millimeter, Submillimeter, and Far-Infrared Detectors and Instrumentation for Astronomy XIII 2026

analysis.title_zh: FOSSIL 的初步热架构
analysis.summary_zh: 本文概述拟议 ESA M8 任务 FOSSIL 的初步热架构，该任务面向 CMB 频谱畸变单极测量。摘要称设计采用从被动 V 型槽辐射器到 4 K 机械制冷、再到多级 ADR 的分级冷却方案，使科学仪器保持在 4.5 K、探测器焦平面达到 50 mK，并报告各级具有正热裕度。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 频谱畸变的绝对光谱测量对低温背景、探测器噪声和热稳定性极其敏感；FOSSIL 的热架构直接关系到能否把仪器自发辐射和热漂移控制到支持高灵敏度频谱测量的水平。
key_points: FOSSIL 是拟议 ESA M8 CMB 频谱畸变任务，目标是测量 CMB 频谱畸变单极。
摘要给出从 293 K 服务舱到 50 mK 探测器级的分级热架构。
作者称该初步架构在每一级都有正热裕度，但详细稳态热预算将另文给出。

多层绝热毯

analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对“每一级均有正热裕度”的依据：热载荷来源、接口温度、ADR 连续/占空比工作模式、4.5 K 台面到 50 mK 焦平面的热隔离，以及尚未在本文给出的稳态热预算对结论的影响。

papers.title: Cosmography with DESI-DR1 Cosmic Chronometers: Direct H(z) measurements from Luminous Red Galaxy ages
papers.abstract: Providing robust redshift estimates for almost 3 million luminous red galaxies (LRGs), the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) offers a unique opportunity to test the expansion rate of the Universe with independent approaches. We apply the cosmic chronometer method to derive new, independent constraints on the Hubble parameter at 0.3<z<1.2 from the differential age evolution of DESI LRGs. We select spectra applying spectroscopic cuts to ensure sample purity and remove contamination by star-forming objects, then build a robust sample of cosmic chronometers (CCs) by stacking to obtain stable, high signal-to-noise (S/N) spectra, which also serves as a democratic binning choice for the $t-z$ plane. Ages are estimated by measuring Lick indices on the stacked spectra and fitting them with a theoretical stellar population model. We obtain $t-z$ relations from which we derive $H(z)$ constraints via two independent approaches: a fit with a pivotal-redshift cosmography, and a direct estimate from the original CC method. The cosmographic fit yields posteriors for the kinematic parameters $\{H_{z_0}, q_{z_0}, j_{z_0}\}$ compatible with currently considered cosmologies, giving a precision-level estimate of $H(z)$. We provide the maximum-a-posteriori (MAP) $H(z)$ estimate, an array of the median confidence region in the $H-z$ plane, and its covariance matrix. We also leverage the redshift distributions of the $t-z$ relation for different velocity dispersion groups to obtain two independent local measurements using the discrete approximation $H(z) \approx -Δz/[Δt (1+z)]$; the one from the reddest envelope of CCs gives $H(z \approx 0.61) = 88.5^{+6.7}_{-12.6}$ (stat.) $\pm 8.1$ (syst.) km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$. Systematic uncertainties for both the cosmographic and discrete $H(z)$ measurements come from a comprehensive analysis of all methodological choices in the data treatment.
papers.comment: 14 main text pages (7 figures), 4 appendix pages (6 figures). Supplementary material will be provided in the journal version of the article, currently under correction

analysis.title_zh: 利用 DESI-DR1 宇宙计时器开展宇宙志研究：来自亮红星系年龄的直接 H(z) 测量
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 DESI-DR1 亮红星系年龄，通过宇宙 chronometer 方法从差分年龄演化直接约束 0.3<z<1.2 的哈勃参数 H(z)。摘要报告其通过宇宙志拟合和原始 CC 离散估计给出独立 H(z) 约束，并提供 MAP 估计、H-z 置信区域及协方差矩阵。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 直接 H(z) 测量是检验 CMB 推断的 ΛCDM 膨胀史、H0 张力和暗能量模型的重要低红移补充。DESI LRG 的宇宙计时器结果若系统误差受控，可与 CMB、BAO 和超新星形成互补约束，帮助区分几何膨胀史与早期宇宙参数退化。
key_points: 利用 DESI 近 300 万个亮红星系的红移和光谱，应用宇宙 chronometer 方法约束 0.3<z<1.2 的 H(z)。
通过光谱筛选、堆叠高信噪比谱、Lick 指数测龄和恒星族模型拟合获得 t-z 关系。
摘要给出宇宙志拟合结果、H-z 置信区间及协方差矩阵，并报告一个 z≈0.61 的离散 H(z) 测量。

papers.title: Forecast for the detectability of patchy hydrogen reionization in WEAVE-QSO measurements of the Lyman-$α$ forest power spectrum at redshift $z \geq 4$
papers.abstract: We present the first detailed forecasts for the detectability of patchy hydrogen reionization in the one-dimensional Ly$α$ forest power spectrum to be measured by the WEAVE-QSO survey. Using the Sherwood-relics reionization simulations and a WEAVE-QSO survey configuration, we generate mock spectra in four redshift bins, $z=4.0,4.2,4.4,$ and $4.6$, in which relic ionization and temperature fluctuations from patchy hydrogen reionization enhance the Ly$α$ forest power spectrum on large scales (i.e., at wavenumber $k\sim 10^{-3},\mathrm{s\,km^{-1}}$). Our Ly$α$ forest pipeline forecasts the power spectrum covariance by considering sample size, spectral resolution, noise subtraction, continuum placement, metal contamination, and damping wings from high-column density absorbers. Applying our covariance forecast within a Bayesian parameter inference framework, we find that the signature of patchy hydrogen reionization should be detectable at a significance of $\simeq 4.5σ$. The forthcoming WEAVE-QSO 1D power spectrum measurements should therefore be able to directly detect and characterize the large-scale relic imprint of patchy hydrogen reionization in the Ly$α$ forest power spectrum at $z\geq 4$.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 13 figures, 1 table, submitted to MNRAS

analysis.title_zh: 用 WEAVE-QSO 在红移 z≥4 的 Lyα 森林功率谱测量预测斑块状氢再电离的可探测性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文预测 WEAVE-QSO 测得的一维 Lyα 森林功率谱能否探测斑块状氢再电离在 z≥4 的遗迹信号。作者用 Sherwood-relics 再电离模拟和 WEAVE-QSO 巡天配置生成模拟光谱，纳入多项观测协方差来源，并在贝叶斯推断中报告该信号应可约 4.5σ 探测。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离历史是 CMB 光学深度和大尺度极化解释中的关键宇宙学输入；Lyα 森林在 z≥4 对再电离后的温度和电离遗迹敏感，可为 CMB 对再电离积分约束提供更具红移和尺度分辨的信息。
key_points: WEAVE-QSO 的一维 Lyα 森林功率谱被用于预测斑块状氢再电离遗迹的可探测性。
模拟显示再电离遗留的电离与温度涨落会增强 z=4.0–4.6 的大尺度 Lyα 森林功率谱。
摘要报告在其协方差与贝叶斯推断设定下，斑块状再电离信号约可达到 4.5σ 探测。
methods: Sherwood-relics 再电离模拟
WEAVE-QSO 巡天配置
模拟 Lyα 森林光谱与一维功率谱管线
协方差预测：样本量、光谱分辨率、噪声扣除、连续谱放置、金属污染、高柱密度吸收体阻尼翼
贝叶斯参数推断框架
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对协方差模型中连续谱误差、金属污染和高柱密度吸收体阻尼翼的处理是否足以支撑约 4.5σ 的可探测性预测，以及模拟中的再电离历史和温度遗迹是否覆盖了合理的不确定性。

papers.title: Cosmic Structures in CDM and SIDM
papers.abstract: The standard $Λ$ Cold Dark Matter ($Λ$CDM) model has achieved remarkable success in explaining the formation and evolution of cosmic structures on large scales, supported by a wide range of observations, including the cosmic microwave background, large-scale structure surveys, and galaxy clusters. However, discrepancies between theoretical predictions and observations on small scales, have motivated the exploration of alternative dark matter models, including the self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) scenario. This review provides an overview of the theoretical foundations of CDM structure formation, the small-scale challenges, and the solutions proposed within the SIDM framework. We summarize recent theoretical developments in the SIDM framework and discuss current observational constraints on the dark matter self-interaction cross-section with particular emphasis on galaxy clusters.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 5 figures. Invited review for "One Hundred and Ten Years of General Relativity: Reviews and Perspectives". Accepted for publication in IJMPD

analysis.title_zh: CDM 与 SIDM 中的宇宙结构
analysis.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于 CDM 与自相互作用暗物质 SIDM 中宇宙结构形成的综述，概述 ΛCDM 在大尺度结构、CMB、星系团等观测支持下的成功，以及小尺度上理论预言与观测之间的张力。摘要称文章总结了 SIDM 的理论进展，并重点讨论星系团对暗物质自相互作用截面的当前观测约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: CMB 是 ΛCDM 大尺度成功的重要支柱，但暗物质微物理通常需要结合小尺度结构和星系团观测来检验。该综述有助于 CMB 研究者理解：在保持早期宇宙与大尺度观测一致的同时，SIDM 如何试图解释小尺度结构问题，并受到星系团约束限制。
key_points: 综述 ΛCDM 下结构形成的理论基础与小尺度问题。
介绍 SIDM 对小尺度张力的可能解释。
特别讨论星系团尺度上对自相互作用截面的观测约束。
methods: 理论综述
ΛCDM 结构形成框架
SIDM 框架
观测约束汇总
星系团观测
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对作者如何界定“小尺度挑战”，以及星系团约束中采用的观测样本、系统误差和对自相互作用截面的模型依赖。

papers.title: Complex Energy-Dependent Behaviour of Quasi-Periodic Oscillation Observed in GRS 1915+105
papers.abstract: We present complex energy-resolved properties of quasi-periodic oscillations (QPOs) in the black hole X-ray binary GRS 1915+105 using an observation from the LAXPC instrument onboard AstroSat. Power density spectra (PDSs) are constructed in multiple energy bands and modeled with multi-Lorentzian components to investigate the energy dependence of QPO properties. The QPO frequency shows a modest increase with energy. Dynamic PDS analysis does not reveal clear evidence for time-dependent evolution of the QPO frequency, suggesting that the observed frequency shift is not primarily driven by temporal variability. We perform simultaneous fitting of energy-resolved PDSs and find that a model in which the QPO feature is described by two Lorentzian components provides a better fit. The two components exhibit different evolution in fractional root mean square amplitude as a function of energy. We further examine the phase-lag properties by simultaneously modeling the PDS and the real and imaginary parts of the cross-spectrum and find distinct phase-lag behavior for the two components. Overall, these results indicate that the apparent energy-dependent evolution of the QPO feature may be a result of the presence of more than one variability component.
papers.comment: 13 pages, 10 figures, accepted for publication in the Astrophysical Journal

analysis.title_zh: GRS 1915+105 中观测到的准周期振荡的复杂能量依赖行为
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 AstroSat/LAXPC 对黑洞 X 射线双星 GRS 1915+105 的观测，构建多能段功率密度谱并用多洛伦兹成分研究 QPO 的能量依赖。摘要报告 QPO 频率随能量温和增加，但动态 PDS 未显示清晰时间演化；双洛伦兹描述更优，两个成分在 fractional rms 和相位滞后上表现不同。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于高能时域和黑洞吸积物理，对 CMB 本身没有直接关联；但其在频域建模、交叉谱和相位滞后分析上的处理，与 CMB 实验中处理时间序列、噪声谱和系统效应的频域方法有方法论上的相通之处。
key_points: 研究对象是黑洞 X 射线双星 GRS 1915+105 的 QPO 能量依赖行为。
多能段 PDS 显示 QPO 频率随能量有温和增加，但动态 PDS 未给出清晰的时间演化证据。
摘要认为 apparent 的能量依赖演化可能来自多个变率成分。
methods: AstroSat 搭载的 LAXPC 观测
多能段功率密度谱 PDS
多洛伦兹成分建模
动态 PDS 分析
能量分辨 PDS 同时拟合
PDS 与交叉谱实部、虚部的同时建模
相位滞后分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对双洛伦兹模型相对单一 QPO 模型的拟合改进是否稳健，以及能量相关频移、rms 和相位滞后是否可能受能段选择、背景处理或模型退化影响。

papers.title: AT 2024qfm: a luminous fast blue optical transient at a redshift of z = 0.2267 identified by Lasair-ZTF
papers.abstract: Luminous fast blue optical transients (LFBOTs) emit from x-ray to radio wavelengths, epitomised by the discovery of AT 2018cow in a host galaxy at 65 Mpc. In the following eight years eleven more have been found, at redshifts $0.075 \lesssim z \lesssim0.34$, plus one identified retrospectively from 2016. Here we present the discovery of AT 2024qfm, classified as an LFBOT in a host galaxy at $z = 0.2267 \pm 0.0002$. Its ultraviolet-to-optical luminosity and rapid 13 day fade closely match AT 2018cow. We describe how the transient was identified in the Zwicky Transient Facility alert stream using a custom filter in the Lasair broker that flags flux gradients over time. Another LFBOT candidate was identified with the same methodology (AT 2024kth). The physical origin of LFBOTs remains debated with no firm consensus, and further progress requires more discoveries, host-galaxy characterisation, and multi-wavelength analysis to constrain theory. We discuss this discovery in the context of Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), whose sensitivity will increase the effective LFBOT survey volume tenfold relative to ZTF, out to $z \lesssim 0.6$, and show that our FastFinder filter could recover such events. We highlight the challenge of detecting their fast evolution with sufficiently low latency to trigger multi-wavelength follow-up that can constrain theoretical models.
papers.comment: Submitted to MNRAS. 11 pages with 5 figures and 3 tables (incl., Appendices)

analysis.title_zh: AT 2024qfm：由 Lasair-ZTF 识别的红移 z = 0.2267 的明亮快速蓝光学暂现源
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 Lasair-ZTF 在 ZTF 警报流中通过基于通量梯度的自定义筛选发现 AT 2024qfm，并将其分类为宿主星系红移 z=0.2267 的明亮快速蓝光学暂现源。摘要称其紫外到光学光度和 13 天快速衰减与 AT 2018cow 接近，并讨论 LSST 将扩大 LFBOT 搜索体积及低延迟多波段后随的挑战。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作与 CMB 科学关联较弱，主要服务于高能暂现源和时域巡天；对宇宙学读者的间接意义在于 LSST 等大巡天的暂现源发现、宿主星系表征和多波段跟进会影响未来宽场数据流处理与天体前景/变源目录建设。
key_points: 报告 AT 2024qfm，被分类为红移 z=0.2267 的 LFBOT。
其紫外到光学光度和 13 天快速衰减与 AT 2018cow 接近。
论文强调低延迟发现与多波段后随对约束 LFBOT 理论的重要性。
methods: Zwicky Transient Facility 警报流
Lasair broker 自定义筛选器
基于随时间通量梯度的 FastFinder 筛选
宿主星系红移测定
与 AT 2018cow 的紫外到光学光度和衰减行为比较
Rubin Observatory LSST 探测能力情景讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 LFBOT 分类依据、宿主红移和光变时间尺度的测定方式，以及 FastFinder 对快速暂现源的完备性、误报率和低延迟触发能力。

papers.title: X-ray signals converted from high-frequency gravitational waves emitted by spinning light primordial black hole dark matter
papers.abstract: We investigate the detectability of high-frequency gravitational waves from the superradiance of light primordial black hole dark matter through photons converted in the Galactic magnetic field. We find that the signal is significantly enhanced in the X-ray frequency range around $10^{18}$Hz. For clustered initial conditions, future X-ray observations may detect the converted photons from primordial black holes in the mass range $10^{-15}M_{\odot} \sim 10^{-13}M_{\odot}$. Our results indicate that future X-ray observations could provide a new probe of light primordial black hole dark matter through high-frequency gravitational waves.

analysis.title_zh: 自旋轻原初黑洞暗物质发射的高频引力波转换产生的 X 射线信号
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究轻原初黑洞暗物质通过超辐射产生的高频引力波，是否能在银河磁场中转换为光子并被 X 射线观测探测。摘要报告称信号在约 10^18 Hz 的 X 射线频段显著增强；在成团初始条件下，未来 X 射线观测可能探测质量约 10^-15 至 10^-13 太阳质量的原初黑洞。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作与 CMB 的联系主要通过暗物质候选体和原初黑洞宇宙学约束，而不是直接通过 CMB 各向异性测量。若高频引力波到 X 射线的转换可作为轻 PBH 暗物质探针，它将与 CMB 对早期宇宙、暗物质丰度和原初黑洞的限制形成互补。
key_points: 研究轻原初黑洞暗物质自旋超辐射产生的高频引力波。
高频引力波可在银河磁场中转换为光子。
摘要称 X 射线频段约 10^18 Hz 信号显著增强，未来观测可能探测特定质量范围的 PBH。
methods: 高频引力波信号建模
原初黑洞超辐射
银河磁场中的引力波-光子转换
未来 X 射线观测可探测性评估
成团初始条件
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对引力波到光子的转换概率如何计算、银河磁场模型与成团初始条件的假设，以及 X 射线背景和仪器灵敏度是否足以支撑可探测性判断。

papers.title: Waterfall-modulated $α$-attractors
papers.abstract: Hybrid $α$-attractor models \cite{Kallosh:2022ggf} can have significantly greater values of $n_{s}$ and smaller $r$, while preserving the relation $r\cong 3α(1-n_s)^2$, which is valid for exponential T- and E-models at large values of the inflaton field. Here we study single-field $α$-attractors with features inspired by hybrid models: one can uplift the potential, and one can also have a waterfall regime that leads to a premature termination of inflation near the critical point $\varphi_c$. This allows one to increase the effective number of e-foldings $N_c$ in formulas like $n_s\simeq 1-{2\over N_c}$, $r\simeq {12 α\over N_c^2}$. By changing the waterfall's steepness and location, one can continuously move the predictions along the curves with $r\cong 3α(1-n_s)^2$ as $n_s$ increases and $r$ decreases. We also study the effect of waterfall insertions and uplift on $n_s$ in quintessential $α$-attractors that describe inflation and dynamical dark energy.

analysis.title_zh: Waterfall 调制的 α-attractor 模型
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究受混合 α-attractor 启发的单场 α-attractor 暴胀模型，通过势能 uplift 和接近临界点 φc 的 waterfall 提前结束暴胀来改变有效 e-fold 数。摘要称，调节 waterfall 的陡峭度和位置可沿 r≈3α(1−ns)^2 曲线连续提高 ns 并降低 r，并进一步考察了这些插入对 quintessential α-attractors 中 ns 的影响。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: ns 和 r 是 CMB 温度/偏振各向异性约束早期宇宙暴胀模型的核心参数；这类模型试图在保持 α-attractor 标志性关系的同时改变 CMB 可观测预测，因此与 CMB 对暴胀势形状和张量模的检验直接相关。
key_points: 研究混合 α-attractor 启发的单场暴胀势特征。
waterfall 的位置和陡峭度可改变有效 e-fold 数，从而移动 ns 与 r 预测。
还讨论了同时描述暴胀和动力学暗能量的 quintessential α-attractors。
methods: 单场 α-attractor 模型构造
势能 uplift
waterfall regime / waterfall insertions
使用摘要给出的近似关系 ns≈1−2/Nc、r≈12α/Nc^2 与 r≈3α(1−ns)^2
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 waterfall 机制是否在单场有效描述中自洽，尤其是提前结束暴胀的临界点 φc、有效 e-fold 数 Nc 的定义，以及 uplift/waterfall 对 ns、r 关系的适用范围。

papers.title: Scalar induced gravitational waves as probes of dark QCD
papers.abstract: We investigate scalar induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) as probes of a dark QCD crossover. Motivated by twin Higgs and asymmetric twin baryon dark matter scenarios, we consider a dark QCD sector with a confinement scale approximately 5.5 times the Standard Model (SM) QCD scale. We construct the effective energy and entropy degrees of freedom for the SM supplemented by dark QCD sectors containing either three light dark quark flavors or all six dark quark flavors. The resulting equation of state parameter and sound speed are then used to solve the first-order scalar perturbations and the second-order SIGWs through the SM and dark QCD crossover epochs. For a monochromatic primordial curvature power spectrum, we first demonstrate that the realistic SM thermal history modifies the SIGW spectrum relative to the idealized radiation-dominated case. We then show that a dark QCD crossover generates an additional frequency-shifted distortion when the enhanced scalar mode reenters the horizon near the dark confinement scale. This distinctive feature can therefore serve as a characteristic signature of the dark QCD sector. Our results demonstrate that SIGWs provide a complementary cosmological probe of hidden confining sectors, with characteristic spectral features shifted to higher frequencies relative to the SM QCD imprint. The analysis developed in this work can also be extended to other well-motivated theories containing different dark confining sectors.

analysis.title_zh: 作为暗 QCD 探针的标量诱导引力波
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究标量诱导引力波能否作为暗 QCD confinement/crossover 的宇宙学探针，考虑受 twin Higgs 和非对称 twin baryon 暗物质启发的暗 QCD 扇区。摘要报告称，现实 SM 热史会相对理想辐射主导情形改变 SIGW 频谱，而暗 QCD crossover 会在增强标量模于暗 confinement 标度附近入视界时产生额外的频移谱畸变。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然主题不是直接 CMB 各向异性，但原初曲率扰动、早期宇宙热史和隐藏扇区都会影响宇宙学可观测量；SIGW 可与 CMB 对原初扰动和暗辐射/隐扇区的约束形成互补，尤其是在 CMB 难以直接探测的小尺度曲率扰动上。
key_points: 把标量诱导引力波用于探测暗 QCD crossover。
显式构造含暗 QCD 的有效能量和熵自由度，并通过 crossover 计算扰动演化。
暗 QCD 可在 SIGW 频谱中产生相对 SM QCD 印记移至更高频率的特征畸变。
methods: 有效能量自由度和熵自由度构造
状态方程参数与声速计算
一阶标量扰动求解
二阶标量诱导引力波计算
单色原初曲率功率谱
SM 与暗 QCD crossover 热史
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对暗 QCD 热力学自由度和声速建模、单色原初曲率谱假设对频谱特征的依赖，以及所谓额外频移畸变能否与标准热史或其他隐扇区效应区分。

papers.title: Gaia parallax bias via spherical harmonics: A Python tool and discussion of possible causes
papers.abstract: Parallaxes in Gaia DR3 are known to suffer from a complex set of sky-correlated and magnitude-dependent offsets or biases at the level of a few tens of $μ$as. Estimated from a sample of one million distant quasars and AGNs from the CRF catalog, the average offset is negative, but the actual distribution of this important parameter shows significant variations on the sky. We propose a practical method to evaluate the parallax correction as a function of sky position and, optionally, of $G$ magnitude using a spherical harmonic series, and supply a tested Python tool {\tt varpi3.py} available on Zenodo\footnote{ https://zenodo.org/records/21708614}. We find that only the constant $Y_{00}$ term is significantly dependent on magnitude, while the other 80 harmonic terms are either close to zero or flat with magnitude. The directions of the smallest and largest parallax offsets are $(l,b)\simeq(220\degr,+43\degr)$ and $(l,b)\simeq(45\degr,-45\degr)$, which are close to the orientation of the quasar density dipole reported in recent publications. Motivated by this curious coincidence, we review possible physical effects resulting in a negative bias of measured parallaxes, including an anisotropic universe with a positive curvature and an orbital aberration component. The proposed method of parallax correction is tested using independent asteroseismology data for four different areas on the sphere. Finally, we show that the parallax zero-point propagates into the CRF proper-motion field through the parallax--proper-motion covariance, biasing the vector spherical harmonic determination of the secular-aberration glide, and hence the Galactocentric acceleration, at the microarcsecond-per-year level.
papers.comment: Submitted. The parallax-correcting code in Python and graphical presentation is available at https://zenodo.org/records/21708614

analysis.title_zh: 通过球谐函数刻画 Gaia 视差偏差：一个 Python 工具及可能成因讨论
analysis.summary_zh: 本文针对 Gaia DR3 视差存在天空相关和星等相关零点偏差的问题，提出用球谐级数按天区并可选按 G 星等进行校正的方法，并发布 Python 工具。摘要称，除常数 Y00 项外其他 80 个球谐项对星等依赖弱，并用独立星震学数据进行了检验，同时讨论该偏差对 CRF 自行场和银河心加速度测定的传播影响。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要服务于天体测量系统误差而非 CMB；其宇宙学相关性在于 Gaia 类星体参考系、宇宙学各向异性讨论和银河心加速度等大尺度参考系问题，但对 CMB 分析的直接影响有限。
key_points: 提出用球谐级数校正 Gaia DR3 视差零点偏差的实用方法和 Python 工具。
基于远距离类星体和 AGN 样本估计天空相关、星等相关的视差偏差。
讨论视差零点如何通过协方差影响 CRF 自行场和银河心加速度估计。
methods: Gaia DR3 视差数据
CRF catalog 中一百万个远距离类星体和 AGN 样本
球谐级数建模
Python 工具 varpi3.py
独立星震学数据检验
矢量球谐分析 secular-aberration glide
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对球谐展开阶数和星等依赖的处理是否足以描述 Gaia DR3 系统误差，以及将视差偏差方向性与类星体密度偶极或宇宙学解释联系起来时证据是否充分。

papers.title: Laser-micromachined silicon-platelet feedhorns for large-scale submillimeter and millimeter-wave focal planes
papers.abstract: We present the fabrication and characterization of the first silicon-platelet feedhorn arrays produced using laser micromachining. First, we present a demonstration of the technology for the millimeter-wave band of 80~GHz to 170~GHz, i.e. covering the 90/150~GHz bands typical of CMB experiments. Next, we expand the technology to large-scale production on 150~mm wafers and demonstrate operation at submillimeter wavelengths. This feedhorn array is optimized for operation in a band centered at 350~GHz (330~GHz to 370~GHz) and is being deployed as one of the focal plane elements of the CCAT 350~GHz module of Prime-Cam. We present the design and fabrication processes for these feedhorn arrays and compare the optical performance directly to simulation and to feedhorns of identical design but produced using traditional deep reactive-ion etching (DRIE). We conclude with a discussion of future expansions of this technology, including the potential of sidewall control and using thicker (and thus fewer) wafers, which could significantly reduce production costs and labor.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, SPIE Astronomical Telescopes + Instrumentation 2026, Copenhagen

analysis.title_zh: 用于大规模亚毫米和毫米波焦平面的激光微加工硅片层馈源喇叭
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍首批通过激光微加工制备的硅片层 feedhorn 阵列，并给出设计、加工和光学表征。摘要报告该技术先在 80-170 GHz 毫米波段演示，覆盖 CMB 常用 90/150 GHz 频段，随后扩展到 150 mm 晶圆规模和 330-370 GHz 亚毫米波应用，并与仿真及传统 DRIE 制作的同设计 feedhorn 进行比较。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文与 CMB 仪器直接相关：90/150 GHz feedhorn 阵列是许多 CMB 偏振实验的核心焦平面技术之一，而大规模、低成本、可重复的加工路线会影响探测器阵列扩展、波束控制和系统误差预算。350 GHz 应用也与亚毫米巡天和前景天体物理观测有关。
key_points: 展示了用激光微加工制备硅片层 feedhorn 阵列。
技术覆盖 80-170 GHz，包含 CMB 实验常用的 90/150 GHz 频段。
进一步扩展到 150 mm 晶圆规模生产，并用于 Prime-Cam 的 CCAT 350 GHz 模块焦平面元件。
methods: 激光微加工 silicon-platelet feedhorn 阵列制备
80-170 GHz 毫米波频段技术演示
150 mm 晶圆大规模生产
330-370 GHz 亚毫米波段器件表征
与仿真结果直接比较
与传统深反应离子刻蚀 DRIE 制作的同设计 feedhorn 比较
光学性能表征
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对激光微加工阵列相对于 DRIE 阵列的光学性能差异、加工公差和可重复性，以及这些差异在 90/150 GHz CMB 焦平面和 350 GHz Prime-Cam 模块中的系统误差影响。

papers.title: CosmoFit: A Graphical User Interface for Bayesian Cosmological Parameter Estimation with User-Defined H(z) Models
papers.abstract: We present CosmoFit, a desktop graphical interface for Bayesian parameter inference in background cosmology. The application is designed to simplify cosmological analyses by reducing the need to manually program each step, while maintaining the transparency and reproducibility of the results. Users can define an expansion history H(z), specify fixed and sampled parameters, assign prior ranges and proposal scales, select the available observational likelihoods, and run Markov chain Monte Carlo analyses from a unified graphical interface. CosmoFit uses Cobaya for Bayesian sampling and GetDist for posterior analysis and visualization. The current version supports cosmic-chronometer data and the official Pantheon+, Pantheon+SH0ES, and Union3 supernova likelihoods available through Cobaya. For each run, the application stores the configuration files, metadata, execution logs, chains, and numerical summaries required to inspect and reproduce the analysis. The performance of CosmoFit was evaluated through unit tests, a parameter-recovery test using synthetic data, and an independent comparison with an analysis performed directly in Cobaya. The posterior mean values obtained with both procedures agree to within less than one percent. In addition, the synthetic-data test recovers the fiducial parameters within the expected credible regions. As an illustrative example, we perform a spatially flat wCDM analysis using Pantheon+SH0ES and obtain marginalized constraints and triangle plots directly from the interface. Within its current scope, CosmoFit provides an accessible, transparent, and reproducible tool for research and academic applications involving explicit models of the background cosmological expansion.

analysis.title_zh: CosmoFit：用于用户自定义 H(z) 模型的贝叶斯宇宙学参数估计图形用户界面
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 CosmoFit，一个用于背景宇宙学贝叶斯参数估计的桌面图形界面，允许用户自定义膨胀历史 H(z)、设置参数与先验、选择观测似然并运行 MCMC。摘要称该工具通过单元测试、合成数据参数恢复和与直接 Cobaya 分析比较进行验证，二者后验均值在百分之一以内一致，并给出平直 wCDM 的示例分析。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要关系到低红移背景宇宙学推断工具链，而非直接的 CMB 各向异性分析；但 H(z)、超新星和宇宙计时器约束常与 CMB 共同用于检验暗能量、曲率和 H0 张力相关模型。对 CMB 研究者而言，它的价值在于是否能透明复现非 CMB 数据集对扩张史模型的约束，并方便与 CMB 约束联合或对照。
key_points: CosmoFit 提供用于背景宇宙学贝叶斯参数推断的桌面图形界面。
用户可自定义 H(z)、先验、采样参数并调用若干观测似然。
摘要报告其与直接 Cobaya 分析的后验均值在百分之一以内一致。
methods: Cobaya 贝叶斯采样
GetDist 后验分析与可视化
Markov chain Monte Carlo 分析
宇宙计时器数据
Pantheon+、Pantheon+SH0ES、Union3 超新星似然
单元测试、合成数据参数恢复测试、与直接 Cobaya 分析的独立比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对自定义 H(z) 的表达能力、似然接口与 Cobaya 配置是否完全透明，以及“百分之一以内一致”对应的参数、模型和测试范围。

papers.title: Spontaneous Scoto-leptogenesis
papers.abstract: We propose a low-scale spontaneous leptogenesis scenario within the dynamical minimal scotogenic model for accommodating neutrino masses and inert scalar dark matter simultaneously. Thus, we dub the mechanism Spontaneous Scoto-leptogenesis. In this setup, a rolling Majoron arising from the global $U(1)_{B-L}$ symmetry breaking induces an effective chemical potential for the $B-L$ charge in the presence of $B-L$ violating interactions that allow for the efficient decays and inverse decays of right handed neutrinos (RHN), so it gives rise to the observed baryon asymmetry of the Universe through the electroweak sphaleron conversion. The mechanism becomes effective in the strong washout regime and successfully lowers the viable mass scale of the lightest RHN to the range of TeV scales, thereby making the thermal scotogenic leptogenesis with two hierarchical RHNs accessible to direct tests. We identify the roles of the $λ_5$ coupling for spontaneous leptogenesis and inert scalar dark matter through the efficient erasure of the inert scalar asymmetry. We also explore the regime for Majoron dark matter from the kinetic misalignment, showing that a multicomponent dark sector comprising the inert scalar and the Majoron can be realized in the model. The resulting framework provides a unified origin for low-scale baryogenesis, neutrino masses, and multicomponent dark sector, so it can be tested by complementary experimental probes through direct detection experiments, collider searches for inert scalars, and future detection of Majoron dark matter or dark radiation.

analysis.title_zh: 自发 Scoto-轻子生成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在动态最小 scotogenic 模型中提出“自发 Scoto-轻子生成”，用全局 U(1)_{B-L} 破缺产生的滚动 Majoron 为 B-L 荷提供有效化学势，并借助右手中微子的衰变/逆衰变与电弱 sphaleron 转换生成宇宙重子不对称。摘要报告该机制在强 washout 区域有效，可把最轻右手中微子的可行质量尺度降至 TeV，并可同时容纳中微子质量、惰性标量暗物质和 Majoron 暗物质/暗辐射。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于粒子宇宙学而非直接 CMB 分析，但它涉及重子不对称、暗物质组分和可能的暗辐射，这些都会影响宇宙学背景参数和早期宇宙历史。对 CMB 研究者而言，关键关联在于模型是否预言可观测的额外辐射自由度、暗物质丰度或早期宇宙能量组分变化。
key_points: 在动态最小 scotogenic 模型中提出低能标自发轻子生成机制。
滚动 Majoron 通过有效化学势和右手中微子衰变/逆衰变产生 B-L 不对称，并经电弱 sphaleron 转换为重子不对称。
摘要称最轻右手中微子可降至 TeV 能标，并允许惰性标量与 Majoron 组成多组分暗物质。
methods: 动态最小 scotogenic 模型
全局 U(1)_{B-L} 对称性破缺产生的滚动 Majoron
B-L 破坏相互作用中的右手中微子衰变和逆衰变
强 washout 区域分析
动能失配产生 Majoron 暗物质
直接探测、对撞机惰性标量搜索、Majoron 暗物质或暗辐射探测作为互补检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Boltzmann/输运方程中滚动 Majoron 化学势、强 washout 条件与 λ_5 耦合对惰性标量不对称擦除的处理是否一致，并确认 TeV 右手中微子可行区是否同时满足中微子质量、暗物质和实验约束。

papers.title: Singlet-Doublet fermion origin of dark matter, neutrino mass and inverse first-order electroweak phase transition
papers.abstract: We study the possibility of an inverse first-order electroweak phase transition (IFOEWPT) and observable gravitational waves (GW) in a radiative neutrino mass model of scotogenic type where singlet-doublet (SD) fermions, the lightest of whom is the dark matter (DM) candidate, generate the necessary seesaw at one-loop level. Considering the possibility of light neutrinos being Dirac for simplicity and additional detection prospects, we extend the standard model (SM) with two generations of $SU(2)_L$ singlet and doublet fermions, one singlet scalar, and three right-handed neutrinos (RHNs). While RHNs provide the right chiral parts of light Dirac neutrinos, the SD fermions and the scalar singlet facilitate the one-loop neutrino mass diagram. The neutral component of the lighter SD fermion, stabilized under a residual $Z_2$ symmetry plays the role of DM while the heavier SD fermions strongly couple to the Higgs leading to an IFOEWPT where the Universe undergoes two different first-order phase transition as it goes from the symmetric to the final broken Higgs phase. We constrain the parameter space from the requirements of generating the correct neutrino mass, DM relic as well as IFOEWPT while incorporating the existing constraints from different experiments. The final allowed parameter space of the model can be probed at collider, direct-detection, GW and cosmic microwave background (CMB) experiments in near future.

analysis.title_zh: 暗物质、中微子质量与反向一阶电弱相变的 singlet-doublet 费米子起源
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在 scotogenic 型辐射中微子质量模型中研究 singlet-doublet 费米子是否可同时解释暗物质、中微子质量，并产生可观测引力波的反向一阶电弱相变。摘要称作者在满足正确中微子质量、暗物质遗迹丰度、反向一阶电弱相变及现有实验约束后，得到的允许参数空间可由未来对撞机、直接探测、引力波和 CMB 实验检验。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 强一阶电弱相变可产生随机引力波背景，也可能通过能量注入、相变历史或相关新物理与 CMB 可观测量发生间接联系。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类模型的重要性在于它把暗物质、轻中微子质量和早期宇宙相变放在同一参数空间中，并声称未来 CMB 实验可参与检验。
key_points: 提出 singlet-doublet 费米子框架同时关联暗物质、辐射中微子质量和电弱相变。
较轻中性 singlet-doublet 费米子在残余 Z2 对称性下作为暗物质候选体。
摘要称允许参数空间未来可由对撞机、直接探测、引力波和 CMB 实验检验。
methods: scotogenic 型辐射中微子质量模型
一圈中微子质量生成机制
singlet-doublet 费米子扩展
反向一阶电弱相变分析
暗物质遗迹丰度约束
现有实验约束
未来对撞机、直接探测、GW 与 CMB 探测前景
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对反向一阶电弱相变的有限温有效势处理、两次一阶相变的热历史是否自洽，以及同时满足中微子质量、暗物质遗迹丰度和现有实验约束时参数空间是否稳定。

papers.title: Thermal false vacuum decay near black holes is aspherical
papers.abstract: We study decay of a scalar field false vacuum near a (3+1)-dimensional Schwarzschild black hole equilibrated at Hawking temperature with the environment. Our scalar field model has negative quartic self-coupling and thereby resembles Higgs sector of the Standard Model in the large-field limit. We demonstrate that if the black hole is not too small, the false vacuum in this model decays aspherically with regard to the black hole center: via formation of expanding true vacuum bubbles emerging on the outer side of the event horizon. More specifically, we identify three regimes of the decay. For the largest and coldest black holes, the main mechanism is quantum tunneling described by an infinitesimally thin bounce sitting at some point of the horizon. In the intermediate-mass regime, the vacuum is destroyed by thermal fluctuations creating aspherical critical bubbles in the horizon vicinity. Finally, near the smallest black holes thermal fluctuations still guide the decay but the dominant critical bubble is spherically symmetric and covers the entire horizon.

analysis.title_zh: 黑洞附近的热假真空衰变是非球对称的
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究处于 Hawking 温度热平衡环境中的 3+1 维 Schwarzschild 黑洞附近，带负四次自耦合的标量场假真空如何衰变。摘要报告，当黑洞不太小时主导衰变通常是相对黑洞中心非球对称的，并进一步识别出大质量冷黑洞的量子隧穿、中等质量黑洞的非球对称热临界泡、小质量黑洞附近球对称热临界泡三类区域。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 真空稳定性和相变历史会影响早期宇宙的背景演化、引力波产生以及可能的遗迹种群；若原初黑洞能催化或改变假真空衰变，其结果会约束包含 Higgs 类势能的早期宇宙情景。与 CMB 的联系较间接，主要通过相变历史、原初黑洞丰度及其对宇宙学模型一致性的影响体现。
key_points: 研究与环境处于 Hawking 温度平衡的 Schwarzschild 黑洞附近标量场假真空衰变。
摘要称黑洞不太小时，衰变相对于黑洞中心呈非球对称，真空泡从事件视界外侧出现并膨胀。
按黑洞质量区分三种机制：量子隧穿、非球对称热临界泡、球对称覆盖视界的热临界泡。
methods: 3+1 维 Schwarzschild 黑洞背景
与 Hawking 温度环境平衡的热假真空衰变分析
负四次自耦合标量场模型
薄壁 bounce 描述的量子隧穿
热涨落产生临界泡
按黑洞质量区分衰变机制
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对边界条件、热平衡假设、黑洞质量分区标准以及非球对称 bounce/临界泡解的稳定性和作用量比较，特别是这些结论对类 Higgs 负四次势近似的依赖。

papers.title: Evidence for the First Globular Cluster Stellar Stream beyond the Milky Way
papers.abstract: The dark matter content of ultra-diffuse galaxies is the subject of considerable debate. Stellar streams, which form when a host galaxy tidally strips stars from an orbiting stellar system, provide a powerful technique to constrain the dark matter content of external galaxies. The stripped stars form long, thin leading and trailing tidal arms that persist for billions of years. Stellar streams from globular clusters are particularly sensitive probes of dark matter halos and substructure. Globular cluster streams are expected to exist in a variety of host galaxy types, but so far, they have only been observed in the Milky Way. We present evidence for the first extragalactic globular cluster stellar stream, identified in deep Hubble Space Telescope imaging of the ultra-diffuse galaxy, UGC9050-Dw1. The stream's morphology, colour, and apparent association with a compact source support the globular cluster progenitor interpretation observationally, and we reproduce the observed surface brightness with simulated globular cluster stellar populations. We use generative stream modelling, which fits dynamical models directly to the stream morphology, to constrain the mass of the progenitor and present the first stream-based halo constraint for an ultra-diffuse galaxy. The stream models point to a globular cluster origin and suggest a massive dark matter host halo. By extending the reach of globular cluster stream analysis to external galaxies, this work opens a new chapter in dark matter science.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. This version of the article has been accepted for publication in Nature, after peer review, but does not reflect post-acceptance improvements. The Version of Record is available online at: http://dx.doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10878-w

analysis.title_zh: 银河系之外首个球状星团恒星流的证据
analysis.summary_zh: 该文针对超弥散星系暗物质含量争议，报告在 UGC9050-Dw1 的深 HST 图像中发现首个银河系外球状星团恒星流的证据。作者用形态、颜色、与致密源的关联、恒星族群模拟和生成式恒星流动力学建模支持球状星团起源，并给出基于恒星流的超弥散星系暗晕约束，摘要称结果暗示宿主暗物质晕较大。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接处理 CMB，但与宇宙学中的小尺度暗物质结构和星系暗晕问题相关。若银河系外球状星团流可用于约束超弥散星系暗晕，它将为 CMB 所约束的暗物质宇宙学模型提供低红移、小尺度的互补检验。
key_points: 在超弥散星系 UGC9050-Dw1 的深 HST 成像中识别到疑似球状星团恒星流。
形态、颜色及与致密源的表观关联支持球状星团前身解释。
生成式恒星流建模指向球状星团起源，并暗示宿主具有较大质量的暗物质晕。
methods: 深度哈勃空间望远镜成像
模拟球状星团恒星族群以复现表面亮度
直接拟合恒星流形态的生成式恒星流动力学建模
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对球状星团前身判据是否足以排除其他潮汐结构来源，以及流形态到暗物质晕质量约束之间对轨道、距离、投影和恒星族群假设的敏感性。

papers.title: LIGO Detector Characterization in the Second and Third Parts of the Fourth Observing Run
papers.abstract: LIGO detector characterization efforts enabled the confident detection of gravitational waves from hundreds of compact binary coalescences during the fourth observing run. Reliable production of high quality detector data and rapid noise mitigation efforts allow the extraction of the most in-depth knowledge of gravitational wave sources and their progenitors. In this paper we describe LIGO detector characterization activities during the second and third parts of O4-O4b and O4c. We summarize changes in detector configuration and performance at the LIGO Hanford and LIGO Livingston Observatories between the end of the first part of O4a and the end of O4c, including upgrades made during the commissioning break preceding O4b and during repairs performed in O4c. We describe instrumental investigations carried out at both sites designed to understand and subsequently mitigate the effect on detector sensitivity of transient glitches, narrowband spectral lines, and vibration-driven noise, among other data quality concerns. We then review the tools and procedures used to validate gravitational wave candidates and the data quality products thus supplied to searches for gravitational waves from compact binary coalescences and unmodeled transients, continuous gravitational waves, and the stochastic gravitational wave background. The efforts of the detector characterization group are essential for maintaining and improving the sensitivity and reliability of the LIGO detectors especially as observing runs lengthen and more events are detected. We conclude with prospects for LIGO detector characterization activities in future observing runs.

analysis.title_zh: 第四观测轮第二和第三阶段的 LIGO 探测器表征
analysis.summary_zh: 本文总结 LIGO 第四观测轮第二、三阶段 O4b/O4c 的探测器表征工作，包括 Hanford 与 Livingston 的配置和性能变化、噪声源调查与缓解、以及候选引力波事件的数据质量验证工具和流程。摘要报告这些工作支撑了数百个紧致双星并合事件的可靠探测，并提升了长观测轮中的探测器灵敏度与可靠性。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文主要属于引力波仪器与数据质量领域，与 CMB 的直接联系较弱；但随机引力波背景是宇宙学探针之一，其探测或上限依赖长时间稳定数据和严谨噪声表征。对关注早期宇宙随机背景或多信使宇宙学的 CMB 研究者而言，它提供了理解 LIGO 数据质量系统误差的背景。
key_points: 总结 LIGO 第四观测轮 O4b 与 O4c 的探测器表征工作。
覆盖 Hanford 与 Livingston 的配置、性能变化、噪声源排查和数据质量验证。
服务于紧致双星并合、未建模暂现源、连续波和随机引力波背景搜索。
methods: LIGO Hanford 和 LIGO Livingston 观测站数据与配置记录
O4b 和 O4c 探测器表征活动总结
瞬态 glitches、窄带谱线、振动驱动噪声的仪器调查
引力波候选体与数据质量产品验证流程
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对这些探测器表征与数据质量标记如何进入各类引力波搜索的选择函数、灵敏度估计和候选体验证流程，尤其是与随机背景搜索相关的数据质量处理是否会影响宇宙学解释。

papers.title: Robustness of the primordial power spectrum in hybrid loop quantum cosmology to approximations near the bounce
papers.abstract: We prove the robustness of the analytic approximation used in (hybrid) loop quantum cosmology to compute the primordial power spectrum of the cosmological perturbations for a recently proposed vacuum state (the non-oscillatory state with asymptotic Hamiltonian diagonalization). To investigate this, we study different approximations to the effective mass of these perturbations near the bounce, showing that the Pöschl-Teller potential employed in previous works leads to indistinguishable power spectra compared to other estimations of the mass, provided that they successfully capture the characteristic scale of the bounce, which translates into a scale of power suppression.

analysis.title_zh: 混合圈量子宇宙学中原初功率谱对反弹附近近似的稳健性
analysis.summary_zh: 该文检验混合圈量子宇宙学中用于计算宇宙学扰动原初功率谱的解析近似是否稳健，重点是最近提出的非振荡态与渐近哈密顿量对角化真空。作者比较反弹附近有效质量的不同近似，摘要称只要这些近似捕捉反弹的特征尺度，先前使用的 Pöschl-Teller 势与其他估计给出的功率谱不可区分。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接关联 CMB 初始条件问题：原初功率谱的低 $k$ 抑制或其他特征可能反映早期宇宙反弹动力学。若反弹附近近似确实稳健，相关模型与 CMB 大角尺度功率谱比较时的理论系统误差会更清晰。
key_points: 研究混合圈量子宇宙学中反弹附近有效质量近似对原初功率谱的影响。
比较了 Pöschl-Teller 势与其他有效质量估计。
摘要称只要近似捕捉反弹的特征尺度，所得功率谱不可区分，并对应功率抑制尺度。
methods: 混合圈量子宇宙学中的解析近似检验
反弹附近宇宙学扰动有效质量的不同近似比较
Pöschl-Teller 势近似
非振荡态与渐近哈密顿量对角化真空态
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对“不可区分”的判据、比较的有效质量近似范围，以及反弹特征尺度如何映射到 CMB 可观测的原初功率谱功率抑制尺度。

papers.title: CIBER $\times$ galaxy cross-correlations reveal a bright, low-redshift NIR background
papers.abstract: We perform the first tomographic analysis of near-IR extragalactic background light (EBL) anisotropies, cross-correlating CIBER 1.1 and 1.8 $μ$m imager data with photometric galaxy catalogs from DESI Legacy Survey DR8 and Hyper-Suprime-Cam Ultra-Deep Survey. We measure significantly higher cross-power than expectations from an integrated galaxy light (IGL) model on scales $\ell < 2000$, concentrated at low redshift ($z\lesssim 0.6$). Cluster member galaxies and associated structure account for 15-20\% of the large-angle cross-power, indicating that group- and galaxy-scale halos contribute the bulk of the signal. Through a parametric halo model decomposition, we detect two-halo and one-halo clustering in cross-power at high significance, with amplitudes that decline smoothly across $z=0{-}1$. The inferred one-halo cross-power is of similar amplitude between DESI-LS and the deeper HSC catalog, implying a scenario in which low-redshift EBL fluctuations are amplified by contributions from lower-mass halos with satellites and/or diffuse intra-halo light (IHL). Converting our two-halo fits into estimates of $b_I \times dI/dz$, we find that standard IGL predictions underestimate our measurements, even when assuming an intensity bias as high as 3, similar to that of large SZ clusters, suggesting that a higher $dI/dz$ is required to reconcile observed discrepancies. Lastly, we find that correlated large-scale structure (LSS) at $z<1$ accounts for a substantial fraction of the CIBER auto-power reported in earlier work. These results identify low-redshift LSS as a significant and previously unappreciated contributor to near-IR EBL fluctuation measurements, setting the stage for cross-correlation science with CIBER-2, SPHEREx and a variety of LSS tracers.
papers.comment: 29+12 pages, 12+10 figures, 3 tables. To be submitted to JCAP

analysis.title_zh: CIBER × 星系交叉相关揭示明亮的低红移近红外背景
analysis.summary_zh: 本文将 CIBER 1.1/1.8 μm 近红外成像与 DESI-LS DR8 和 HSC Ultra-Deep 光度星系目录做断层交叉相关，研究河外背景光各向异性的红移来源。摘要报告在 ℓ<2000、z≲0.6 处测得高于积分星系光模型预期的交叉功率，并通过 halo model 指出低红移大尺度结构、群和星系尺度 halo、卫星或弥散晕内光可能显著贡献近红外背景涨落。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 近红外河外背景光及其各向异性是理解低红移大尺度结构、星系形成和弥散光成分的重要探针；对 CMB 研究者而言，这类交叉相关和 halo model 分解与 CMB lensing、SZ、LSS 交叉相关分析共享系统误差与建模问题，也会影响多波段背景各向异性和前景理解。
key_points: 首次对近红外河外背景光各向异性进行断层交叉相关分析。
CIBER 与 DESI-LS、HSC 星系目录的交叉功率在低红移和大角尺度上高于 IGL 预期。
摘要认为 z<1 的相关大尺度结构解释了早期 CIBER 自功率的重要部分。
methods: CIBER 1.1 和 1.8 μm 成像数据
DESI Legacy Survey DR8 光度星系目录
Hyper-Suprime-Cam Ultra-Deep Survey 光度星系目录
近红外 EBL 各向异性断层分析
与星系目录的交叉相关功率谱
参数化 halo model 分解
two-halo 和 one-halo 聚类拟合
b_I × dI/dz 估计
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 CIBER 前景扣除、星系样本红移分箱、掩膜与系统误差控制，以及 halo model 分解中 IHL、卫星星系和低质量 halo 贡献之间的退化。

papers.title: MeerKAT Reveals Evidence of a Radio Megahalo at GHz Frequency
papers.abstract: Radio megahalos are recently discovered large-scale diffuse synchrotron sources identified through LOFAR observations. We present MeerKAT L-band observations of the massive galaxy cluster RXC~J0528.9$-$3927, that reveals faint emission surrounding its central radio halo. At 1.28 GHz, the known $\sim1.14$ Mpc halo is embedded within previously unreported low-surface-brightness emission extending to $\sim2$ Mpc. The surface-brightness profile of the emission shows a distinct flattening beyond $\sim0.55R_{500}$, suggesting that the outer emission forms an additional component. These properties make the cluster a candidate megahalo system and potentially the first detected at GHz frequencies, although deeper multi-frequency observations are required for confirmation.
papers.comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, accepted for publication in URSI Radio Science Letters

analysis.title_zh: MeerKAT 在 GHz 频率揭示射电巨晕的证据
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 MeerKAT L 波段对大质量星系团 RXC J0528.9−3927 的观测，在已知约 1.14 Mpc 中心射电晕之外发现延展至约 2 Mpc 的低表面亮度弥散辐射。摘要称其表面亮度剖面在约 0.55R500 外出现明显变平，使该系统成为 GHz 频率下 megahalo 的候选，但仍需更深的多频观测确认。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系团弥散同步辐射追踪宇宙大尺度结构中的磁场、相对论电子和湍流再加速过程，是星系团形成和重子物理的重要探针。对 CMB 研究者而言，这类 GHz 低表面亮度射电组分也关系到星系团前景、SZ/射电联合分析以及未来高灵敏度巡天中的源建模。
key_points: MeerKAT L 波段在 RXC J0528.9−3927 中看到中心射电晕外的低表面亮度弥散辐射。
1.28 GHz 下，已知约 1.14 Mpc 射电晕嵌在延展至约 2 Mpc 的此前未报告辐射中。
作者将其列为候选 megahalo，并强调需要更深的多频观测确认。
methods: MeerKAT L-band observations
1.28 GHz radio continuum analysis
surface-brightness profile of diffuse emission
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对外层低表面亮度辐射的成像、去源和背景处理是否稳健，以及表面亮度剖面变平是否足以支持独立 megahalo 组分而非普通射电晕外延或系统误差。

papers.title: LIGO A$^\sharp$: Detector Design and Science Prospects Beyond A+
papers.abstract: We present the LIGO A$^\sharp$ detector concept, an upgrade for the LIGO observatories based on room-temperature interferometers beyond the fifth observing run (O5). Building on the A+ sensitivity, A$^\sharp$ targets broadband sensitivity improvements through heavier test masses, improved suspensions and seismic isolation, increased arm-cavity power, enhanced frequency-dependent squeezing, reduced coating thermal noise considering two scenarios, and improved control of mechanical motion and optical modes. We describe the principal design choices, projected noise performance, and corresponding astrophysical prospects. LIGO A$^\sharp$ substantially increases compact-binary detection rates, strengthens population inference, and improves both early-warning times and localization for binary neutron star mergers. The improved sensitivity enables more detailed studies of compact-binary coalescences, including higher-order multipoles, intermediate-mass black holes, remnant black hole ringdown, and the neutron star equation of state. It also broadens the discovery potential for new gravitational-wave sources such as continuous waves and bursts, should enable detection of the stochastic background from compact binary mergers if it remains undetected after O5, and strengthens the role of gravitational-wave detectors as probes of fundamental physics. We discuss key technical challenges and the role of A$^\sharp$ as both a major scientific upgrade for the 2030s and a technology pathfinder for next-generation gravitational-wave observatories, such as Cosmic Explorer.

analysis.title_zh: LIGO A^sharp：超越 A+ 的探测器设计与科学前景
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出 LIGO A^sharp 探测器概念，作为 O5 之后基于室温干涉仪的 LIGO 升级方案，并概述主要设计选择、预期噪声表现和天体物理前景。摘要称该升级将显著提高紧致双星探测率、族群推断能力、双中子星预警和定位，并扩展对连续波、爆发源和紧致双星随机背景的发现潜力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文与 CMB 的直接交集不大，但与宇宙学中的引力波背景和基础物理探针相关。若 A^sharp 能提升随机引力波背景灵敏度，它将与 CMB 对早期宇宙、相变、暴胀或紧致源背景的约束形成互补，不过摘要中强调的是紧致双星并合随机背景而非原初背景。
key_points: 提出 O5 之后面向 LIGO 台站的 A^sharp 室温干涉仪升级概念。
设计目标包括更重测试质量、改进悬挂与隔震、更高臂腔功率、频率相关压缩和降低镀膜热噪声等。
预期提升紧致双星探测率、定位和预警能力，并增强随机背景、连续波和爆发现象的发现潜力。
methods: LIGO A^sharp 探测器概念设计
投影噪声性能评估
基于设计灵敏度的天体物理前景评估
两种降低镀膜热噪声情景
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对投影噪声曲线、各升级项对灵敏度的边际贡献、随机背景可探测性所依赖的背景模型，以及 A^sharp 与 Cosmic Explorer 等下一代设施之间的技术承接关系。

papers.title: Constraints on ultralight bosons from merging binary and remnant black holes observed during the second and third parts of the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run
authors: J. F. J. van den Brand
papers.abstract: We present constraints on ultralight bosons using binary black hole mergers observed in the second and third parts of the fourth LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing run. Directed searches are conducted for long-transient gravitational waves from ultralight vector boson clouds around merger remnants, using a hidden-Markov-model (HMM) tracking scheme. We target the remnant black holes formed in the binary coalescences that produced GW250114 and GW250207. We find no evidence for such signals from either target. Estimating our search sensitivity at a threshold corresponding to a 1% false alarm probability, we thus disfavor vector boson masses in the range of $[2.80, 3.95]\times 10^{-13}$ eV with greater than 90% confidence. In addition, we derive constraints on ultralight scalar and vector bosons from the inferred high spins of the constituent black holes in three binaries, using events GW240515, GW241113, and GW241225_08. The excluded mass ranges in this approach depend on the assumed black-hole ages. At $10^5$ years, corresponding to typical dynamically formed binaries, we exclude scalar and vector bosons in the ranges $[1.39, 6.94]\times 10^{-13}$ eV and $[0.32, 14.4]\times 10^{-13}$ eV at 90% confidence, respectively.
papers.comment: 27 pages (12 pages author list, 15 pages main paper), 5 figures

analysis.title_zh: 利用 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第四观测轮第二和第三部分观测到的并合双黑洞及遗迹黑洞约束超轻玻色子
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第四观测轮后续双黑洞并合事件检验超轻玻色子，既对并合遗迹黑洞周围矢量玻色子云的长暂态引力波进行 HMM 定向搜索，也利用部分双星组分黑洞的高自旋推导约束。摘要报告未在 GW250114 和 GW250207 遗迹中发现相应信号，并给出若干矢量与标量超轻玻色子质量区间的 90% 置信排除，后者依赖黑洞年龄假设。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章主要属于引力波和粒子天体物理，但与宇宙学中的暗物质候选体相关：超轻玻色子是波状暗物质/类轴子暗物质的重要模型族。对 CMB 研究者而言，它提供了与早期宇宙和大尺度结构约束互补的强场黑洞检验，不过摘要内容并未直接涉及 CMB 数据或参数推断。
key_points: 利用 O4 第二、三部分的双黑洞并合事件约束超轻玻色子。
对 GW250114 和 GW250207 的并合遗迹黑洞进行长暂态引力波定向搜索，未发现信号。
还利用若干双黑洞组分的高自旋推导标量与矢量超轻玻色子的质量排除范围。
methods: LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 第四观测轮第二、三部分的双黑洞并合事件
针对遗迹黑洞的长暂态引力波定向搜索
隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）跟踪方案
基于 1% 误警概率阈值的搜索灵敏度估计
利用 GW240515、GW241113、GW241225_08 中组分黑洞高自旋进行约束
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 HMM 搜索的信号模型、灵敏度注入/恢复流程、1% 误警概率阈值如何转化为大于 90% 置信排除，以及基于黑洞高自旋的约束对黑洞年龄和形成通道假设的依赖。

papers.title: Testing Covarying Coupling Constants (CCC) against the full SPARC rotation-curve sample: a like-for-like comparison with MOND and NFW
