papers.title: Astrophysical viability of extremal black holes
papers.abstract: We take a fresh look at the viability of physically realistic extremal black holes within our (non-supersymmetric) low energy physics. By incorporating prefactors and volume effects, we show that Schwinger discharge in charge neutral environments is far more efficient than commonly assumed. Using ionisation estimates for neutral hydrogen, we obtain a new and robust lower bound on the mass of an extremal electrically charged black hole, exceeding $10^{14} M_\odot$. For magnetic black holes, we compute the Lee-Nair-Weinberg instability and revisit early universe pair creation rates, including singular instantons that substantially enhance production, to demonstrate that the extreme charges required for stability are cosmologically implausible. Finally, we speculate that an extremal Kerr black hole could shed angular momentum via superradiant scattering from the stochastic gravitational wave background. Taken together, our results provide a unified picture that extremal black holes are unlikely to persist in our universe.

analysis.title_zh: 极端黑洞的天体物理可行性
analysis.summary_zh: 本文重新评估了现实宇宙中极端黑洞的可行性，分别从电荷黑洞的 Schwinger 放电、磁黑洞的不稳定性与早期宇宙成对产生、以及极端 Kerr 黑洞的角动量损失机制展开讨论。摘要声称，在更完整地计入前因子与体积效应后，这些极端构型都难以长期存活。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 虽然主题偏广义相对论和高能理论，但它触及早期宇宙中黑洞种子、原初黑洞与极端紧致天体的形成与演化。对宇宙学读者而言，它提供了对早期宇宙可允许黑洞态空间的边界判断，也可能影响相关引力波源与初始条件模型。
key_points: 重新评估极端黑洞在现实宇宙中的可存活性。
摘要强调考虑前因子和体积效应后，电荷黑洞的 Schwinger 放电比通常估计更有效。
对磁黑洞与极端 Kerr 黑洞也分别讨论了失稳或失去角动量的机制，结论偏向其难以长期存在。
methods: 电荷中性环境下的 Schwinger 放电估算
基于中性氢的电离估计
Lee-Nair-Weinberg 不稳定性计算
早期宇宙中的成对产生率分析
考虑奇异 instanton 增强的磁黑洞产生过程
利用随机引力波背景研究极端 Kerr 黑洞的超辐射散射
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时要核对的是各类极端黑洞的稳定性判据是否来自统一的低能有效物理框架，以及结论对早期宇宙初始条件和环境电荷/磁荷分布有多强依赖。

papers.title: Wavelet-Scattering Signatures of Fuzzy Dark Matter in Simulated 21 cm Brightness-Temperature Maps
papers.abstract: We study the effect of fuzzy dark matter (FDM) on the multiscale morphology of simulated redshifted 21\,cm maps during Cosmic Dawn and the Epoch of Reionization. Using FDM-modified \texttt{21cmFAST} light cones, we apply the two-dimensional wavelet scattering transform (WST) to matched 2\,MHz map products. The first-order coefficients $S_1(j)$ summarize wavelet-band amplitudes, while the normalized second-order ratio $R=S_2/S_1(j_1)$ measures ordered cross-scale modulation. FDM shifts and reshapes both summaries through delayed halo and source formation. We compare a two-dimensional power spectrum (PS), WST, and their combination on the same transferred and noisy maps. In this controlled local Fisher analysis, PS+WST reduces the marginalized errors on the FDM mass, effective X-ray emissivity normalization, and ionizing efficiency by approximately a factor of 1.8 relative to the matched two-dimensional PS baseline, although the dominant mass-heating degeneracy remains. An idealized three-wedge test shows that $R$ is less reshaped at the coefficient level than $S_1$. The covariance includes thermal noise conditional on one fiducial light cone but not cosmic variance or foreground residuals; the results are therefore relative information comparisons, not survey forecasts or a demonstration of superiority over a full three-dimensional PS analysis.

analysis.title_zh: 模拟 21 cm 亮温图中模糊暗物质的小波散射特征
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究模糊暗物质如何改变宇宙黎明和再电离期模拟红移 21 cm 亮温图的多尺度形态，使用 FDM 修改的 21cmFAST 光锥并对 2 MHz 匹配图像应用二维小波散射变换。摘要报告，在受控局域 Fisher 分析中，二维功率谱与 WST 联合相对匹配二维功率谱基线可将 FDM 质量、有效 X 射线发射率归一化和电离效率的边缘误差约降低 1.8 倍，但主要的质量-加热简并仍存在，且结论不是完整巡天预报。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 21 cm 宇宙学是连接暗物质微物理、早期结构形成和再电离历史的重要探针；若小波散射等非高斯形态统计能补充功率谱信息，将有助于从未来低频观测中区分 FDM、加热与电离参数。不过摘要明确限制了协方差和前景处理，因此对 CMB 读者而言，它更像是与早期宇宙结构和再电离建模相关的方法学信息量研究，而非已可直接用于观测约束的结果。
key_points: 用 FDM 修改的 21cmFAST 光锥研究宇宙黎明和再电离期 21 cm 形态。
二维小波散射变换提取一阶幅度和二阶跨尺度调制信息。
摘要强调结果是相对信息量比较，不是完整巡天预报。
methods: FDM-modified 21cmFAST light cones
matched 2 MHz 21 cm map products
two-dimensional wavelet scattering transform
two-dimensional power spectrum comparison
controlled local Fisher analysis
thermal-noise covariance conditional on one fiducial light cone
idealized three-wedge test
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 Fisher 分析的参数化、噪声转移函数和协方差设定，特别是未纳入宇宙方差与前景残差时，PS+WST 的误差缩小因子能否在更完整的 3D PS 或实际观测条件下保持。

papers.title: A measurement of $H_0$ from DESI DR1 using energy densities
papers.abstract: We present a new measurement of the Hubble constant, independent of standard rulers and robust to pre-recombination modifications such as Early Dark Energy (EDE), obtained by calibrating the total energy density of the Universe. We start using the present-day photon density as an anchor, and use the baryon-to-photon ratio from Big Bang Nucleosynthesis based measurements and the baryon-to-matter ratio from the baryons' imprint on galaxy clustering to translate to a physical matter density at present day. We then compare this to measurements of the ratio of the matter density to the critical density ($Ω_{\mathrm{m}}$), calculated using the relative positions of the baryon acoustic oscillations, to measure the critical density of the universe and hence $H_0$. The important measurements of the evolution of the energy density all happen at low redshift, so we consider this a low-redshift measurement. We validate our method both on a suite of $N$-body mocks and on noiseless theory vectors generated across a wide range of Hubble parameters in both $Λ$CDM and EDE cosmologies. Using DESI DR1 data combined with the angular CMB acoustic scale and the latest BBN constraints, we find $H_0 = 69.0 \pm 2.5$ km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$, consistent with existing early and late-time determinations of the Hubble constant. We consider the impact of non-standard dark energy evolution on our measurement. Future data, including that from further iterations of DESI and from Euclid, will add to these results providing a powerful test of the Hubble tension.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, 9 tables. Chains and data to reproduce the figures available at https://zenodo.org/records/17686137. Updated to match accepted version

analysis.title_zh: 利用能量密度从 DESI DR1 测量 $H_0$
analysis.summary_zh: 该文提出通过校准宇宙总能量密度来测量哈勃常数：以现今光子密度为锚，结合 BBN 的重子-光子比、星系成团中重子印记给出的重子-物质比，以及由 BAO 相对位置得到的 $\Omega_{\mathrm{m}}$ 推得临界密度和 $H_0$。摘要报告用 DESI DR1、角向 CMB 声学尺度和最新 BBN 约束得到 $H_0=69.0\pm2.5$ km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$，并称结果与早期和晚期测量一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文直接面向哈勃张力，并试图构造一种对复合前新物理如早期暗能量更稳健的低红移 $H_0$ 测量。它仍使用角向 CMB 声学尺度作为输入，因此对 CMB 读者的关键价值在于理解哪些 CMB 信息被保留、哪些标准尺假设被规避，以及该方法能否作为 CMB 推断 $H_0$ 的独立交叉检验。
key_points: 提出一种不依赖标准尺的 $H_0$ 测量思路。
用现今光子密度、BBN 重子-光子比和星系成团中的重子印记校准物质能量密度。
摘要报告 DESI DR1 结合 CMB 声学角尺度和 BBN 得到 $H_0=69.0\pm2.5$ km s$^{-1}$ Mpc$^{-1}$。
methods: DESI DR1 数据
现今光子密度锚定
Big Bang Nucleosynthesis 基于测量的重子-光子比
星系成团中重子印记给出的重子-物质比
BAO 相对位置推得的 $\Omega_{\mathrm{m}}$
角向 CMB 声学尺度
$N$-body mocks 验证
$\Lambda$CDM 与 EDE 宇宙学中的无噪声理论向量
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对该方法声称“不依赖标准尺”的具体实现，尤其是 CMB 声学角尺度、BAO 相对位置和 BBN 先验在推断链中的角色，以及这些输入对 EDE 或非标准暗能量演化是否真的稳健。

papers.title: Gravitational potential drives the concentration dependence of the stellar mass-halo mass relation
papers.abstract: We investigate the origin of the scatter in the stellar mass-halo mass (SMHM) relation using the \colibre cosmological hydrodynamical simulations. At fixed halo mass, we find a clear positive correlation between stellar mass and halo concentration, particularly in low-mass haloes between $10^{11}$ and $10^{12}\,\rm M_\odot$, where all halo properties are computed from the corresponding dark-matter-only simulation. Two scenarios have been proposed to explain this trend: the earlier formation of higher-concentration haloes allows more time for star formation, or the deeper gravitational potential wells of higher-concentration haloes enhance baryon retention. To distinguish between them, we examine correlations between halo concentration, stellar mass, stellar age, and stellar metallicity. While, at fixed halo mass, halo concentration correlates with stellar age, stellar age itself shows only a weak correlation with stellar mass, indicating that early formation alone cannot account for the concentration-dependence in the scatter of the SMHM relation. In contrast, both stellar metallicity and halo concentration exhibit correlations with stellar mass. The connection between halo concentration and stellar metallicity persists even when simultaneously controlling for both halo mass and stellar mass. These results support the scenario in which the deeper gravitational potentials in higher-concentration haloes suppress feedback-driven outflows, thereby enhancing both baryon and metal retention.
papers.journal_ref: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society, Volume 546, Issue 2, February 2026, stag110

analysis.title_zh: 引力势驱动恒星质量-晕质量关系对浓度的依赖
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用 COLIBRE 宇宙学流体动力学模拟研究恒星质量-晕质量关系散布为何依赖晕浓度。摘要报告，在固定晕质量下，恒星年龄不足以解释该依赖，而晕浓度、恒星质量和金属丰度的相关性支持更深引力势阱抑制反馈外流、增强重子与金属保持的图景。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作主要属于星系形成与暗物质晕-星系连接建模；对 CMB 研究的关联较间接，体现在星系-晕关系和反馈物理会影响大尺度结构示踪体、CMB 透镜交叉相关及小尺度物质分布的解释。
key_points: 研究对象是恒星质量-晕质量关系散布与晕浓度的相关性。
在固定晕质量下，低质量晕中恒星质量与晕浓度呈清楚正相关。
摘要认为更深引力势阱增强重子和金属保持，比单纯较早形成更能解释该趋势。
methods: COLIBRE 宇宙学流体动力学模拟
对应的暗物质-only 模拟中计算晕性质
固定晕质量下的相关性分析
控制晕质量和恒星质量后的相关性检验
比较晕浓度、恒星质量、恒星年龄和恒星金属丰度
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对晕浓度来自暗物质-only 对应模拟的定义和匹配方式，以及在固定晕质量、恒星质量后相关性是否对样本选择、反馈模型和低质量晕分辨率稳健。

papers.title: Search for planetary-mass ultra-compact binaries using data from the first part of the LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA fourth observing run
authors: J. F. J. van den Brand
papers.abstract: We present a search for gravitational waves from inspiraling, planetary-mass ultra-compact binaries using data from the first part of the fourth observing run of LIGO, Virgo and KAGRA. Finding no evidence of such systems, we determine the maximum distance reach for such objects and their merger rate densities, independently of how they could have formed. Then, we identify classes of primordial black-hole mass distributions for which these rate limits can be translated into relevant constraints on the mass distribution of primordial black holes, assuming that they compose all of dark matter, in the mass range $[10^{-6},10^{-3}]M_\odot$. Our constraints are consistent with existing microlensing results in the planetary-mass range, and provide a complementary probe to sub-solar mass objects.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA 第四次观测运行第一阶段数据搜索行星质量超致密双星
analysis.summary_zh: 论文利用 LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA 第四次观测运行第一阶段数据搜索行星质量超致密双星的旋近引力波信号。摘要报告未发现证据，并给出这类天体的探测距离可达范围和并合率密度限制，进而在原初黑洞构成全部暗物质且质量位于 10^{-6}--10^{-3} M_\odot 的假设下，对若干质量分布类别给出约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作主要服务于暗物质和原初黑洞宇宙学，而非直接 CMB 数据分析。若行星质量原初黑洞可构成暗物质，其丰度约束会影响暗物质模型空间，并与 CMB 所依赖的标准宇宙学成分假设相联系；同时它提供了与微透镜互补的非电磁探针。
key_points: 使用 LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA 第四次观测运行第一阶段数据搜索行星质量超致密双星并合引力波。
未发现这类系统的证据，给出了距离可达范围和并合率密度限制。
在特定原初黑洞质量分布假设下，将并合率限制转化为对行星质量范围原初黑洞暗物质的约束。
methods: LIGO、Virgo、KAGRA 第四次观测运行第一阶段数据
引力波并合搜索
最大距离可达范围估计
并合率密度限制
原初黑洞质量分布约束解释
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对搜索模板或信号模型如何覆盖行星质量超致密双星、选择效应如何进入距离可达范围和率限制，以及将率限制映射到原初黑洞质量分布时对形成通道和暗物质占比的假设边界。

papers.title: New constraints on axion with gamma-ray observations of the Crab Nebula
papers.abstract: In this paper, we derive the upper bounds on the coupling of axion-like particles (ALPs) with photon as a function of the mass by considering axion-photon conversion in the Crab Nebula. Previous studies have not considered the influence of the magnetic field within the Crab Nebula. The magnetic field plays a crucial role through the Synchrotron Self-Compton (SSC) process, in which high-energy electrons produce synchrotron radiation that is subsequently up-scattered by the same electrons via inverse Compton scattering to generate gamma rays. Therefore, neglecting the magnetic field in modeling leads to theoretical inconsistencies. In this work, we investigate the significance of the magnetic field effect and demonstrate that even differences in magnetic field modeling can substantially alter the conversion probability. We thus, for the first time, point out that proper consideration of the magnetic field is essential in ALP searches using gamma rays from the Crab Nebula. The resulting constraints reach up to a coupling of $g_{aγγ} \lesssim 1 \times 10^{-11} {\rm GeV}^{-1}$ for ALP masses in the range $10^{-10} {\rm eV} \lesssim m_a \lesssim 10^{-6} {\rm eV}$.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 5 figures, published in Phys. Rev. D

analysis.title_zh: 利用蟹状星云伽马射线观测给出轴子的新约束
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用蟹状星云伽马射线观测，通过轴子-光子转换来约束类轴子粒子与光子的耦合。摘要强调以往忽略星云内部磁场会造成建模不一致，且不同磁场模型可显著改变转换概率；作者据此给出 ALP 质量与耦合的上限约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 类轴子粒子是暗物质和早期宇宙新物理的重要候选，其光子耦合会影响天体高能辐射传播和多信使约束。对 CMB 研究而言，ALP 参数空间也与宇宙辐射传播、暗物质性质和早期宇宙粒子内容相关，但这篇工作主要是高能天体观测约束而非 CMB 直接分析。
key_points: 利用蟹状星云伽马射线观测约束 ALP-光子耦合。
强调星云内磁场建模会显著影响轴子-光子转换概率。
摘要给出在特定 ALP 质量范围内耦合上限可达约 1 × 10^-11 GeV^-1。
methods: 蟹状星云伽马射线观测
轴子-光子转换计算
考虑蟹状星云内部磁场建模
同步自康普顿 SSC 过程的物理一致性讨论
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对伽马射线数据与源模型的选取、磁场模型的不确定性如何传播到转换概率和耦合上限，以及约束是否依赖 SSC 模型或背景系统误差。

papers.title: How Primordial Black Holes Change BBN
papers.abstract: Primordial Black Holes (PBHs) provide a powerful probe of the early universe physics, linking inflationary fluctuations to observable cosmological phenomena. In this work, we use a bottom-up approach to study how PBHs with masses in the range $10^{8} \leq M \leq 10^{13}\,\mathrm{g}$ modify Big Bang Nucleosynthesis (BBN) through Hawking radiation. We incorporate PBH evaporation into the BURST reaction network code to evaluate its impact on light-element abundances. Our analysis illustrates that PBH evaporation acts as an entropy injection mechanism, increasing the comoving entropy density. To reproduce the observed comoving entropy density per baryon $(s/n_{\mathrm{b}})$ from the CMB, BBN simulations must therefore begin with a smaller initial entropy than in the standard scenario without PBHs. The results also reveal a threshold near $M \approx 10^{10}\,\mathrm{g}$ that separates two distinct regimes of BBN behavior. As an example, for $M\geq10^{10}\,\mathrm{g}$, the final $^4{\mathrm{He}}$ mass fraction $Y_{\mathrm{P}}$ obtained from calculation increases monotonically with the initial PBH mass fraction $β_{30}$ specified at the starting temperature $T=30\,\mathrm{MeV}$. This trend is driven by the enhanced Hubble expansion caused by the PBH energy density. In contrast, for $M \leq 10^{10}\,\mathrm{g}$, $Y_{\mathrm{P}}$ exhibits non-monotonic behavior shaped by the timing of PBH evaporation and its influence on nuclear reaction rates. These findings highlight the sensitivity of BBN to PBH evaporation and establish a framework for understanding how PBH populations influence the thermal history of the early universe.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 11 figures, Prepared for submission to PRD

analysis.title_zh: 原初黑洞如何改变大爆炸核合成
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用底层自洽的 BBN 数值模拟研究质量在 10^8–10^13 g 的原初黑洞通过 Hawking 辐射如何改变轻元素丰度。摘要报告称，PBH 蒸发会注入熵并改变初始熵设定，且在约 10^10 g 附近出现两种不同的 BBN 行为区间：较重 PBH 时 ^4He 丰度随初始 PBH 质量分数单调变化，而较轻 PBH 时则呈非单调行为。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作把 PBH 作为早期宇宙热历史的扰动源，与 BBN 和 CMB 共同联系起来，因此直接关系到用轻元素丰度和 CMB 约束早期宇宙非标准成分。对 CMB 研究者而言，它提示 PBH 可能通过改变熵和扩张史，影响我们对重子密度与早期宇宙演化的联合推断。
key_points: 用 BURST 核反应网络把 PBH 蒸发加入 BBN 计算。
研究的 PBH 质量范围为 10^8–10^13 g，并讨论了 Hawking 辐射带来的熵注入。
结果显示约在 10^10 g 附近出现两种不同的 BBN 行为区间；^4He 丰度对初始 PBH 质量分数的响应在不同质量区间中不同。
methods: 将 PBH 蒸发并入 BURST reaction network code
BBN 数值模拟
以 CMB 给出的每重子共动熵密度 s/n_b 作为约束参照
考察不同 PBH 质量与初始质量分数 β_30 下的轻元素丰度演化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：PBH 蒸发在网络代码中的实现方式、初始条件如何由 CMB 的 s/n_b 反推、以及 10^10 g 附近行为转变的物理原因是否稳健；还要区分摘要中明确给出的示例结论与更一般的参数空间结论。

papers.title: On the bin sensitivity of the transverse BAO
papers.abstract: We investigate the transverse BAO projection effect caused by redshift binning uncertainty ($z_c$). For SKA HI and DESI LRG surveys, we compare Gaussian, top-hat, and semi-Gaussian bins over widths $0.01<σ_z<0.1$, and propose a statistical correction using adjacent redshifts. The semi-Gaussian bin best recovers the BAO signal for $σ_z<0.04$, despite higher shot noise. Constraints are survey-dependent: Gaussian binning is weakest for SKA, while for DESI semi-Gaussian is tightest for $σ_z<0.04$ (otherwise comparable). The semi-Gaussian scheme offers the optimal balance between cosmological parameter constraints and BAO fidelity, making it robust for multi-probe analyses.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication by JCAP. 35 pages, 27 figures

papers.title: Cosmic Shear constraints from HSC Year 3 with clustering calibration of the tomographic redshift distributions from DESI
papers.abstract: We reanalyze cosmological constraints from Hyper Suprime-Cam (HSC) Y3 shear-shear correlation function using new calibration of the tomographic redshift distribution via the clustering redshifts method with DESI spectroscopy presented in Choppin de Janvry et al. (2025a). We present both importance sampling of the original MCMC chains by HSC, applying the weights of our newly calibrated $Δz$ priors, as well as full MCMC analysis with new photometric redshift distributions, finding consistent results between the two. We obtain the growth of structure parameter $S_8\equivσ_8\sqrt{Ω_m/0.3}=0.804^{0.019}_{-0.018}$, compared to previous HSC Y3 result of $S_8=0.769^{+0.031}_{-0.034}$, which is a 1.8 reduction of error due to the improved clustering redshift calibrations, with the central value shifting considerably higher towards Planck cosmology. With the new photometric redshift calibration, HSC Y3 has comparable constraining power to the recent KIDS Legacy and DES Y6 results.

analysis.title_zh: 采用 DESI 对层析红移分布进行聚类校准的 HSC 第三年宇宙剪切约束
analysis.summary_zh: 论文利用 DESI 光谱数据的聚类红移校准，重新分析 HSC Y3 宇宙剪切两点相关函数，并比较原 MCMC 链的重要性采样与采用新光度红移分布的完整 MCMC。摘要报告两种分析一致，得到 S8=0.804（约 ±0.019），误差较此前 HSC Y3 结果减小，中心值向 Planck 宇宙学结果上移。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 宇宙剪切通过晚期物质分布约束结构增长参数 S8，是与 CMB 推断的早期宇宙参数进行一致性检验的重要低红移探针。该工作表明，层析红移分布校准能够显著影响 HSC 的 S8 精度和中心值，因此直接关系到弱透镜结果与 Planck 等 CMB 宇宙学结果之间张力的判断。
key_points: DESI 聚类红移校准提高了 HSC Y3 层析红移分布的精度。
重要性采样与采用新红移分布的完整 MCMC 分析结果一致。
摘要报告的 S8 中心值高于此前 HSC Y3 结果，并更接近 Planck 宇宙学。
methods: HSC Y3 宇宙剪切两点相关函数
基于 DESI 光谱样本的聚类红移方法
对原始 HSC MCMC 链进行重要性采样并施加新校准的 Δz 先验权重
采用新光度红移分布开展完整 MCMC 分析
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对 DESI 聚类红移校准对样本选择、星系偏置和尺度选择的依赖，以及重要性采样是否充分覆盖新先验偏好的参数区域；还需确认摘要所称误差缩小“1.8”具体指缩小至原来的比例还是提升倍数，并区分 S8 上移由红移分布中心变化还是不确定性收缩所驱动。

papers.title: Full calibration of the tomographic redshift distribution from the HSC PDR3 Shape Catalog with DESI
papers.abstract: The calibration of tomographic redshift distributions is essential for cosmological analysis of weak lensing data. In this work, we calibrate all four tomographic bins of the Hyper Suprime Camera (HSC) weak lensing catalog with the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Data Release 1 and 2 using the clustering redshifts technique. We include z > 1.2 redshift sources such as emission line galaxies (ELG) and quasars (QSO) sources in our calibration, which were not available in the previous HSC calibration (Rau et al. 2022), allowing a complete calibration of all the redshift bins. We find the first tomographic bin exhibits a small shift towards low redshifts. The second bin is in good agreement with the photometric calibration, while third and fourth bin exhibit a shift towards higher redshifts. However, these shifts are considerably smaller than the shifts obtained in the HSC Year 3 cosmic shear analyses. We evaluate the impact of galaxy bias and magnification effects from all the samples on the measurements, finding them to be small, and we propose corrections to reduce them further. Specifically, we relax the assumption of linear bias and only assume no redshift evolution of the cross-correlation coefficient, allowing us to leverage smaller clustering scales. We model the redshift distributions with splines and compare our results to previous analyses as well as to other parameterizations found in literature. For the two high-redshift tomographic bins, we find the shifts to higher redshifts with respect to the measurements performed in Rau+2022 to be $Δz_3=-0.043^{+0.022}_{-0.020}$ and $Δz_4=-0.050^{+0.012}_{-0.012}$.

analysis.title_zh: 利用DESI对HSC PDR3形状星表的tomographic红移分布进行完整校准
analysis.summary_zh: 本文用DESI DR1/DR2光谱样本和聚类红移技术，对HSC PDR3弱透镜形状星表的四个tomographic红移bin进行完整校准。摘要称第一bin略向低红移偏移，第二bin与光度红移校准一致，第三和第四bin向高红移偏移，但这些偏移小于HSC Year 3 cosmic shear分析中的偏移。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 弱引力透镜的红移分布校准是S8、Ωm和暗能量约束的核心系统误差之一，也直接影响与CMB透镜和Planck主CMB结果的张力评估。该文若校准可靠，可改进HSC cosmic shear与CMB联合宇宙学分析中的红移系统误差控制。
key_points: 使用DESI DR1和DR2通过聚类红移校准HSC PDR3弱透镜四个tomographic bins。
纳入z>1.2的ELG和QSO，使所有红移bin得到完整校准。
摘要报告高红移bin相对既有测量有向高红移的偏移，并评估了星系偏置和放大效应的影响。
methods: HSC PDR3 Shape Catalog弱透镜样本
DESI Data Release 1和2光谱样本
聚类红移技术
ELG和QSO高红移源
样条函数红移分布建模
星系偏置与放大效应评估和修正
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对聚类红移中交叉相关系数无红移演化的假设、非线性/小尺度信息的使用方式，以及红移分布偏移如何传播到HSC cosmic shear宇宙学参数。

papers.title: Angular clustering and bias of photometric quasars in the Kilo-Degree Survey Data Release 4
papers.abstract: We investigate the angular clustering and effective bias of photometrically selected quasars in the Kilo-Degree Survey Data Release 4 (KiDS DR4). We update the previous photometric redshifts (photo-$z$s) of the KiDS quasars using Hybrid-z, a deep learning framework combining four-band KiDS images and nine-band KiDS+VIKING magnitudes. Hybrid-z is trained on the latest Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) DR1 and Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) DR17 quasars matching with KiDS, and achieves average bias $\langle δz \rangle < 0.01$ and scatter $\sim 0.04(1 + z)$ on a test sample. The updated catalog of $\sim 157k$ quasars over $777~\mathrm{deg}^2$ is divided into four tomographic bins spanning $0.1 \leq z_{\mathrm{phot}} \leq 2.7$. In each bin, we measure the angular two-point correlation function and compare it with theoretical predictions for dark matter clustering. We estimate the best-fit scale-independent quasar bias, which increases from $b \approx 1.6$ at $z \approx 0.6$ to $b \approx 4.0$ at $z \approx 2.2$, and is well matched by a quadratic relation in redshift. Our clustering analysis indicates that KiDS quasars reside in dark matter halos of mass $\log_{10}(M_{\mathrm{eff}}/h^{-1}M_\odot)$ in the range $\sim 12.7$--$12.9$ and effective peak heights $ν_{\mathrm{eff}}$ rising from $\sim 1.5$ to $2.9$ over our redshift span. We study two systematics that could affect the bias derivation: stellar contamination and the redshift distribution assumed in the theoretical modeling. The former has a negligible effect, whereas the latter significantly impacts the derived $b(z)$, emphasizing the importance of redshift calibration. Our work is the first cosmological application of quasars selected from KiDS and paves the way for future extensions in the final KiDS DR5, the Legacy Survey of Space and Time, or the 4-metre Multi-Object Spectroscopic Telescope.

analysis.title_zh: Kilo-Degree Survey 第四次数据发布中光度类星体的角聚类与偏置
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 KiDS DR4 光度选择类星体研究角聚类和有效偏置，并用 Hybrid-z 结合 KiDS 图像、KiDS+VIKING 星等及 DESI/SDSS 光谱样本更新光度红移。摘要报告约 777 平方度、约 15.7 万个类星体的四个红移层析 bin 中，类星体偏置随红移从约 1.6 增至约 4.0，且红移分布假设是偏置推断的重要系统误差。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 类星体是大尺度结构和高红移物质分布的示踪体，其偏置与红移分布校准会影响与 CMB 透镜、ISW 效应及多探针宇宙学交叉相关分析的解释。该工作对未来 KiDS、LSST 等巡天与 CMB 数据联合分析中的示踪体建模有直接参考价值。
key_points: 使用 Hybrid-z 更新 KiDS 类星体光度红移，并构建约 15.7 万个源的样本。
测量四个 tomographic 红移 bin 中的角两点相关函数和尺度无关类星体偏置。
摘要称恒星污染影响可忽略，但理论建模采用的红移分布会显著影响 b(z)。
methods: KiDS DR4 四波段图像
KiDS+VIKING 九波段星等
Hybrid-z 深度学习光度红移框架
DESI DR1 与 SDSS DR17 类星体训练/匹配样本
角两点相关函数测量
暗物质聚类理论预测比较
尺度无关类星体偏置拟合
恒星污染与红移分布系统误差检验
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对光度红移训练集与 KiDS 样本的选择函数是否一致，以及 n(z) 校准如何进入角相关函数模型并传播到偏置和晕质量估计。

papers.title: Deep Investigation of Neutral Gas Origins (DINGO): Options for robust Deep Spectral Line Imaging in the SKA-Era
papers.abstract: The data storage requirements for deep spectral line observations with next-generation radio interferometers like the Australian Square Kilometre Array Pathfinder (ASKAP) and the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) are challenging. The default strategy is to reduce data after each daily observation and stack the resulting images. Although computationally efficient, this approach risks propagating systematic errors (e.g. RFI, continuum and deconvolution residuals) and degrades data quality. Imaging the entire deep dataset jointly, the traditional approach, is prohibitively expensive in storage and compute. We present an alternative \textit{uv}-grid stacking method and compare its outcomes with both the traditional approach, our benchmark, and the default image-stacking method, using 200~h of the Deep Investigation of Neutral Gas Origins (DINGO) pilot and main survey data. Our method pauses the standard imaging pipeline after forming the daily residual visibility grids, which are then stacked and jointly deconvolved to combine many epochs of data. Relative to the traditional method, image-stacking recovers a median of 0.92$_{-0.02}^{+0.05}$ of the reference {\HI} flux across our source sample, and \textit{uv}-grid stacking recovers 0.99$_{-0.04}^{+0.01}$. For the brightest source, both methods show a similar, negligible flux offset of $\sim$3 per~cent from the traditional flux. {\HI} velocity widths ($W_{50}$, $W_{20}$) are recovered to within a few per~cent by both methods, with image-stacking showing somewhat larger deviations and scatter. Image-stacking further introduces non-physical artefacts, such as negative bowls around strong sources, indicating poor deconvolution and loss of physical information. Based on these findings, we intend to apply \textit{uv}-grid stacking to the DINGO survey on ASKAP.
papers.comment: accepted by MNRAS. A companion paper submitted to PASA, "Deep Investigation of Neutral Gas Origins (DINGO): Options for the Processing and Storage of Radio Astronomy Data for robust Deep Spectral Line Imaging in the SKA-Era using uv-Grids", which is on arxiv as https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2410.02285

analysis.title_zh: 中性气体起源深度研究（DINGO）：SKA时代稳健深场谱线成像的方案
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究ASKAP/SKA时代深场谱线观测中，如何在存储和计算受限下稳健合并多历元数据。作者用200小时DINGO数据比较传统联合成像、图像叠加和uv-grid叠加，摘要报告uv-grid叠加在HI通量恢复上更接近传统基准，并计划用于DINGO巡天。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文主要面向射电干涉谱线成像和HI巡天数据处理，对CMB本身不是直接科学结果；但其关于多历元数据合并、系统误差传播、去卷积残差和大数据处理策略的讨论，对未来大规模射电宇宙学实验的数据管线设计有参考价值。
key_points: 比较深场谱线成像的传统联合成像、默认图像叠加和uv-grid叠加。
uv-grid叠加在DINGO数据中更接近传统联合成像的HI通量基准。
图像叠加可能引入负碗等非物理伪影。
methods: uv-grid stacking方法
每日残差可见度网格叠加后联合去卷积
传统全数据联合成像作为基准
默认图像叠加方法
200小时DINGO pilot和主巡天数据
HI通量与速度宽度W50、W20比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对传统联合成像基准的可行性与设置、源样本选择、RFI和连续谱残差处理，以及uv-grid叠加在更大数据量和不同动态范围下是否仍能维持摘要中报告的通量与线宽表现。

papers.title: Absorption effects in the expanding Universe: spectral transmittance functions of the intergalactic medium for distant sources
papers.abstract: We construct two self-consistent analytic approximations to the neutral hydrogen fraction, $x_{\rm HI}(z)$, and the helium ionization fractions, $x_{\rm HeI}(z)$, $x_{\rm HeII}(z)$, and $x_{\rm HeIII}(z)$, that are consistent with current constraints inferred from quasar spectra, galaxy surveys, and CMB polarization measurements. These approximations describe observationally motivated early- and late-reionization scenarios. Using these histories, we analyse the formation of broad absorption troughs in the continuum spectra of high-redshift sources over $1\leq z_{\rm s}\leq15$. We assume that neutral hydrogen and helium in a homogeneous diffuse intergalactic medium reside predominantly in their ground states and absorb radiation through the Lyman-series lines and continua of HI, HeI, and HeII. We compute the wavelength-dependent optical depths for the first 39 Lyman-series lines of HI and HeII, the first 10 lines of HeI, and the corresponding continua, and use them to derive spectral transmittance functions, $T(λ;z_{\rm s})$. As illustrative applications, we calculate the spectra of starless virialized Cloud9-type haloes and dwarf galaxies and demonstrate how intergalactic absorption modifies their intrinsic emission. Spectral features in sources at $5\lesssim z_{\rm s}\lesssim7$ are found to be particularly sensitive to the adopted hydrogen and helium ionization histories

analysis.title_zh: 膨胀宇宙中的吸收效应：远距离源的星系际介质光谱透过率函数
analysis.summary_zh: 本文构造两套与类星体光谱、星系巡天和 CMB 偏振约束相容的氢、氦电离历史解析近似，并据此计算 z_s=1–15 高红移源连续谱受到星系际介质吸收后的波长相关透过率。摘要报告，HI、HeI、HeII 的 Lyman 线和连续吸收会形成宽吸收槽，且 z_s约5–7 的谱特征对所采用的氢、氦电离历史特别敏感。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离历史是 CMB 大尺度偏振光学深度解释中的关键输入之一；该工作把 CMB 偏振约束与高红移源光谱吸收联系起来，有助于比较 CMB 推断的电离历史与类星体、星系观测对 IGM 透明度的约束。
key_points: 构造与现有类星体、星系巡天和 CMB 偏振约束相容的氢、氦电离历史解析近似。
计算高红移源光谱中 HI、HeI、HeII 的 Lyman 系列线和连续吸收导致的透过率函数。
摘要指出 z_s≈5–7 的谱特征对所采用的氢、氦电离历史尤其敏感。
methods: 中性氢分数与氦电离分数的自洽解析近似
早再电离与晚再电离情景
均匀弥散星际介质假设
HI 和 HeII 前 39 条 Lyman 系列线、HeI 前 10 条线及相应连续吸收的波长相关光学深度计算
高红移源光谱透过率函数 T(λ; z_s)
Cloud9 型无星位力化晕和矮星系的示例光谱计算
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对其电离历史参数化如何同时满足类星体、星系巡天与 CMB 偏振约束，以及均匀 IGM、基态占据和截断 Lyman 线数对透过率函数的适用范围有多大影响。

papers.title: Creation of Viscous Dark Energy by the Hubble Flow: Comparison with SNe Ia Master Sample Binned Data
papers.abstract: We study a family of cosmological models featuring dynamical dark energy (DE), based on the idea that the creation of its constituents arises from the gravitational field of the expanding universe, whose non-equilibrium physics is described by a non-zero bulk viscosity coefficient. We consider the complete scenario, in which both matter creation and bulk viscosity are present, together with its two limiting cases, in which only one of the two effects is retained. Once each model is constrained by requiring its present-day deceleration parameter $q_0$ to match specific values, the complete scenario introduces up to two additional free parameters with respect to the $Λ$CDM model, one of which is the equation of state parameter $w$ of the created dark energy. \textcolor{blue}{We consider two choices for $q_0$: the value predicted by the $Λ$CDM model, and one obtained from a background analysis of Fazzari et. al. (2025). To perform the analysis, we construct the effective running Hubble constant, i.e. a theoretical function corresponding to the ratio between the Hubble parameter of our models and the $Λ$CDM expansion rate. The theoretical predictions for the effective running Hubble constant of the three models are tested against the Master binned sample of Type Ia Supernovae (SNe Ia), through a Markov Chain Monte Carlo procedure with up to four free parameters. The most important result emerging from this analysis is that, when using the cosmographic $q_0$, all three models exhibit a quintessence-to-phantom transition in the effective equation of state parameter of the dark energy; on the contrary, when using the $q_0$ coming from the $Λ$CDM limit, the transition cannot happen, and the effective equation of state parameter is entirely of phantom nature across the considered redshift range.

analysis.title_zh: 由哈勃流产生的粘滞暗能量：与 Ia 型超新星 Master 样本分箱数据的比较
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究一类由哈勃流相关引力场产生暗能量组分、并用非零体粘滞系数描述非平衡效应的动力学暗能量模型。作者构造相对于 ΛCDM 膨胀率的有效运行哈勃常数，并用 Ia 型超新星 Master 分箱样本进行 MCMC；摘要报告当采用宇宙志学 q0 时三类模型出现暗能量有效状态方程从 quintessence 到 phantom 的转变，而采用 ΛCDM 极限给出的 q0 时则不出现该转变且全程为 phantom 性质。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗能量动力学直接影响晚期宇宙膨胀史，并与 CMB 推断的背景参数、距离标尺和低红移探针之间的一致性检验相关。虽然该摘要主要使用 Ia 型超新星而非 CMB 数据，但它探索了偏离 ΛCDM 的有效状态方程演化，对理解晚期宇宙学参数张力和与 CMB 锚定模型的兼容性有参考价值。
key_points: 研究由宇宙膨胀引力场产生暗能量组分、并以体粘滞描述非平衡物理的模型族。
比较完整模型及仅保留物质产生或仅保留体粘滞的两个极限情形。
使用 SNe Ia Master 分箱样本和 MCMC 检验有效运行哈勃常数，结果依赖所选的当前减速参数 q0。
methods: 动力学暗能量模型
物质产生与体粘滞
有效运行哈勃常数
Type Ia Supernovae Master binned sample
Markov Chain Monte Carlo
两种 q0 选择：ΛCDM 预测值与 Fazzari et al. (2025) 背景分析值
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对 q0 先验或约束方式是否主导了 quintessence-to-phantom 转变结论，以及与 ΛCDM 相比增加参数后是否进行了模型选择或信息准则检验。

papers.title: How light can ALP dark matter be?
papers.abstract: We assume axion-like particles (ALPs) to provide the full dark matter abundance and derive various lower bounds on the ALP mass. We contrast the post- and pre-inflationary symmetry breaking cases and present allowed regions in the plane of ALP mass and energy scale of inflation. For the post-inflationary case, we revisit bounds from isocurvature perturbations taking into account that, as suggested by simulations, axion radiation by cosmic strings during the scaling regime provides the dominant production mechanism of dark matter, obtaining significantly weaker limits than previously. Combining isocurvature, with constraints from black hole superradiance and free streaming, we find that the bound $m_a \gtrsim 10^{-17}$ eV applies for most cases considered here. It can be potentially relaxed to $\sim 6\times 10^{-19}$ eV only in the post-inflationary case with a strongly temperature-dependent axion mass, subject to uncertainties on the axion emission spectrum. Significantly stronger bounds are obtained in the post-inflationary scenario from the non-observation of CMB tensor modes, which can be as strong as $m_a > 5\times 10^{-7}$ eV for small reheating efficiencies, $ε\lesssim 5\times 10^{-4}$.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 12 figures. Version published in JCAP

analysis.title_zh: ALP 暗物质可以有多轻？
analysis.summary_zh: 本文假设轴子样粒子构成全部暗物质，比较暴胀前和暴胀后对称性破缺情形，并结合等曲率扰动、黑洞超辐射、自由流和 CMB 张量模未观测等约束推导 ALP 质量下限。摘要报告称多数情形下得到约 ma ≳ 10^-17 eV 的下限，特殊暴胀后且质量强温度依赖情形可放宽到约 6×10^-19 eV，而 CMB 张量模未观测在小再加热效率时可给出强得多的下限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章直接关联 CMB 宇宙学：ALP 暗物质的产生历史会影响等曲率扰动，而 CMB 对等曲率和张量模的限制可强烈约束 ALP 质量与暴胀能标。对研究 CMB 的读者，它展示了如何用 CMB 未探测到的信号反向限制暗物质候选体和早期宇宙相变情景。
key_points: 假设 ALP 构成全部暗物质，推导其质量下限。
区分暴胀前与暴胀后对称性破缺情形，并讨论等曲率扰动、黑洞超辐射和自由流限制。
摘要强调 CMB 张量模未观测在某些暴胀后情形中给出更强下限。
methods: ALP 暗物质丰度假设
暴胀前/暴胀后对称性破缺情形对比
等曲率扰动约束

papers.title: The SRG/eROSITA all-sky survey: X-ray scaling relations of galaxy groups and clusters in the western Galactic hemisphere
papers.abstract: The soft X-ray telescope on board the SRG mission, eROSITA, has produced the largest sample to date of galaxy groups and clusters detected via their intracluster and intragroup medium emission. Scaling relations between the intrinsic properties of these systems provide valuable insight into their formation and evolution. In this work, we investigated the scaling relations between key physical properties, such as soft band X-ray luminosity, temperature, gas mass, and the low-scatter mass proxy $Y_{\rm X}$, for the galaxy groups and clusters detected in the first eROSITA All-Sky Survey (eRASS1). Our analysis fully accounts for selection effects and the redshift evolution of the observable distributions. We constructed a high-purity sample of $3061$ galaxy groups and clusters spanning the redshift range of $0.05<z<1.07$ and the mass range of $1.1\times10^{13}<M_{500}/$M$_{\odot}<1.6\times10^{15}$. This represents the largest sample to date used in scaling-relation analysis. The selection function, derived from state-of-the-art simulations of the eROSITA sky, is rigorously incorporated into our modeling. We report best-fit parameters -- normalization, slope, redshift evolution, and intrinsic scatter -- for a set of scaling relations: $L_{\mathrm{X}}-T$, $L_{\mathrm{X}}-M_{\rm gas}$, $L_{\mathrm{X}}-Y_{\rm X}$, as well as the $M_{\rm gas}-T$ relation. Our best-fit models indicate that the slopes of the scaling relations significantly deviate from self-similar expectations, while the redshift evolution remains consistent with the self-similar model. The fits exhibit small statistical uncertainties, likely owing to the large sample size. Our results are in good agreement with previous observational studies that account for selection effects. For clusters with $kT>3$~keV, our inferred $L_{\rm X}-T$ relation is consistent with simulation models that include strong or stronger AGN feedback.

analysis.title_zh: SRG/eROSITA 全天巡天：银河系西半球星系群和星系团的 X 射线标度关系
analysis.summary_zh: 本文利用 eROSITA 首次全天巡天数据，研究星系群和星系团的软 X 射线光度、温度、气体质量及 $Y_{\rm X}$ 之间的标度关系，并通过将巡天选择函数和红移演化纳入模型，对 3061 个系统进行拟合。摘要报告称，各关系的斜率显著偏离自相似预期，但红移演化与自相似模型一致；在 $kT>3$ keV 的星系团中，$L_{\rm X}-T$ 关系与包含强或更强 AGN 反馈的模拟结果一致。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 星系群和星系团的 X 射线标度关系连接了热气体观测量与暗物质晕质量，是团样本质量校准、选择效应控制以及利用星系团开展宇宙学研究的重要基础。该工作的大样本和显式选择函数建模有助于判断标度关系偏离自相似模型的程度，并为 AGN 反馈等重子物理过程对团际介质的影响提供观测约束；这些结果也可影响基于星系团丰度和质量代理量的宇宙学参数分析。
key_points: 基于 eROSITA 首次全天巡天构建了 3061 个星系群和星系团的高纯度样本。
模型严格纳入选择函数和可观测量分布的红移演化。
多个标度关系的斜率显著偏离自相似预期，而红移演化与自相似模型一致。

papers.title: Implicit inference of the reionization history with higher-order statistics of the 21-cm signal
papers.abstract: The Epoch of Reionization (EoR), when the first luminous sources ionised the intergalactic medium, represents a new frontier in cosmology. The Square Kilometre Array Observatory (SKAO) will offer unprecedented insights into this era through observations of the redshifted 21-cm signal, enabling constraints on the Universe's reionization history. We investigate the information content of the average neutral hydrogen fraction ($\bar{x}_{\rm HI}$) in several Gaussian (spherical and cylindrical power spectra) and non-Gaussian (Betti numbers and bispectrum) summary statistics of the 21-cm signal. Mock 21-cm observations are generated using the AA* configuration of SKAO's low-frequency telescope, incorporating noise levels for 100 and 1000 hours. We employ a state-of-the-art implicit inference framework to learn posterior distributions of $\bar{x}_{\rm HI}$ in redshift bins centred at $z=8.0,7.2$ and $6.5$, for each statistic and noise scenario, validating the posteriors through calibration tests. Using the figure of merit to assess constraining power, we find that Betti numbers alone are on average more informative than the power spectra, while the bispectrum provides limited constraints. However, combining higher-order statistics with the cylindrical power spectrum improves the mean figure of merit by $\sim$0.25 dex ($\sim33\%$ reduction in $σ(\bar{x}_{\rm HI})$). The relative contribution of each statistic varies with the stage of reionization. With SKAO observations approaching, our results show that combining power spectra with higher-order statistics can significantly increase the information retrieved from the EoR, maximising the scientific return of future 21-cm observations.

analysis.title_zh: 利用 21 cm 信号高阶统计量对再电离历史进行隐式推断
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 21 cm 信号的高阶统计量对再电离历史中平均中性氢比例 \bar{x}_{\rm HI} 的信息量，比较功率谱、Betti 数和双谱，并用隐式推断在 z=8.0、7.2、6.5 的红移 bin 中学习后验。摘要报告 Betti 数平均上比功率谱更有信息，双谱约束有限，而高阶统计量与柱状功率谱结合可使 figure of merit 平均提高约 0.25 dex，对应 σ(\bar{x}_{\rm HI}) 约 33% 降低。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 再电离历史是 CMB 大尺度偏振光学深度解释的重要物理背景，21 cm 观测可在红移上分辨 CMB 只能积分约束的电离过程。该工作评估 SKAO 时代如何从非高斯 21 cm 统计中提取更多再电离信息，对连接 CMB τ 约束和再电离模型很有价值。
key_points: 比较 21 cm 信号中功率谱、Betti 数和双谱对平均中性氢比例的约束信息。
采用 SKAO-Low AA* 构型模拟观测，并考虑 100 与 1000 小时噪声。
摘要称 Betti 数单独优于功率谱，且与柱状功率谱组合可进一步提高约束力。
methods: SKAO-Low AA* 构型模拟 21 cm 观测

papers.title: Constraints on the canonical single-field slow-roll inflation model from observations
papers.abstract: In this work, we employ two complementary approaches to constrain the canonical single-field slow-roll inflation scenario. The first method makes explicit use of the analytic dependence of the primordial perturbations on the slow-roll parameters, whereas the second adopts a phenomenological parameterization of the primordial scalar and tensor spectra. Using the latest observational datasets, including Planck satellite data, BICEP/Keck measurements, baryon acoustic oscillation data, and the recent DESI Data Release 2, we derive direct constraints on the slow-roll parameters. A key advantage of this strategy is that it allows us to compute the predictions of single-field slow-roll inflation directly from the constrained parameter values. We illustrate the resulting predictions for the parameters that characterize the scalar power spectrum and place constraints on several representative inflationary models. Our analysis shows that monomial-potential inflation is disfavored, while models with concave potentials, such as the Starobinsky model and brane inflation, are preferred. From the constraints on the slow-roll parameters, we obtain a tensor spectral index in the single-field slow-roll framework that is very small, $|n_t|\lesssim 4.9\times 10^{-3}$, a value that will be challenging to measure with CMB data alone in the foreseeable future. Moreover, the absolute value of the derived running of the tensor spectral index does not exceed $1.91\times 10^{-4}$ at $95\%$ confidence level, based on the combination of CMB+BAO+DESI datasets.

analysis.title_zh: 观测对正则单场慢滚暴胀模型的约束
analysis.summary_zh: 论文采用两种互补方法：一是显式利用原初扰动对慢滚参数的解析依赖，二是对原初标量与张量功率谱进行唯象参数化，并结合 Planck、BICEP/Keck、BAO 和 DESI DR2 数据约束慢滚暴胀。摘要报告称，单项式势暴胀不受青睐，Starobinsky 模型和膜暴胀等凹势模型更受偏好；同时得到很小的张量谱指数及其跑动上限。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把 CMB 对标量扰动和原初引力波的限制与 BAO、DESI 大尺度结构数据结合起来，直接检验单场慢滚暴胀及其代表性势模型。其结果也说明，仅依靠可预见未来的 CMB 数据测量如此小的张量谱指数可能十分困难，对未来实验目标和多探针联合分析具有参考意义。
key_points: 以两种互补参数化方式直接约束慢滚参数。
摘要称单项式势模型不受青睐，而 Starobinsky 模型和膜暴胀等凹势模型更受偏好。
在单场慢滚框架下得到 |n_t|≲4.9×10^-3；CMB+BAO+DESI 组合给出的张量谱指数跑动绝对值在 95% 置信水平下不超过 1.91×10^-4。
methods: 利用原初扰动对慢滚参数的解析依赖进行约束。
采用原初标量与张量功率谱的唯象参数化作为互补分析。
联合使用 Planck、BICEP/Keck、重子声学振荡数据和 DESI Data Release 2。
由受约束的慢滚参数计算单场慢滚暴胀预言，并检验若干代表性暴胀模型。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对两种参数化所用的慢滚阶数、枢轴尺度、先验和一致性关系，以及“偏好”或“不受青睐”具体对应的模型比较指标；还需确认 DESI DR2 与 CMB、BAO 数据组合的独立性处理，以及张量谱指数及其跑动界限对数据组合和模型假设的敏感性。

papers.title: Proposal to construct the dark-matter-only counterpart of the observed universe combining weak lensing and baryon censuses
papers.abstract: Baryonic effects such as AGN feedback can significantly impact the matter clustering, are harder to model from first principles, and emerge as a severe limiting factor in weak lensing cosmology. To tackle this issue, we propose a generic relation of mapping the observed matter clustering to its counterpart in a dark-matter-only universe. We verify this relation to be accurate at better than $1\%$ level at $k<1\,h/$Mpc and $z\in [0,3]$ in both TNG and Illustris simulations, demonstrating its model-independence to the underlying baryonic physics. Implementing this relation in observations will be made possible by the specifically designed cross-correlation statistics and baryon census (ionized diffuse gas through localized fast radio bursts, stellar mass through galaxy surveys, and neutral hydrogen through 21cm mapping). It is capable of correcting the baryonic effect not only in the matter power spectrum, but also at the field level, as demonstrated by tests on the scattering transform statistics. This approach paves the way for constructing the dark-matter-only counterpart of the observed Universe, establishing an ideal cosmological laboratory for probing the dark universe.

papers.title: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: A demonstration of CMB lensing measurement from daytime data
papers.abstract: We present a cosmic microwave background (CMB) lensing power spectrum analysis using daytime data (11am-11pm UTC) gathered by the Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) over the period 2017-2022 (ACT Data Release 6). This dataset is challenging to analyze because the Sun heats and deforms the telescope mirror, complicating the characterization of the telescope. We perform more than one hundred null and consistency checks to ensure the robustness of our measurement and its compatibility with nighttime observations. We detect the CMB lensing power spectrum at 18$σ$ significance, with an amplitude $A_\textrm{lens} = 1.071 \pm 0.060$ with respect to the prediction from the best-fit Planck-ACT CMB power spectrum $Λ$CDM cosmology. In combination with the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Baryon Acoustic Oscillation (BAO) data, this corresponds to a constraint on the amplitude of matter fluctuations $σ_8 = 0.842 \pm 0.026$. The analysis presented here is especially relevant for ground-based millimeter-wave CMB experiments at the Atacama site, paving the way for future analyses making use of both nighttime and daytime data to place tight constraints on cosmological parameters.

analysis.title_zh: 阿塔卡马宇宙学望远镜：用白天数据测量 CMB 透镜的演示
analysis.summary_zh: 本文使用 ACT 2017-2022 年 DR6 的白天观测数据进行 CMB 透镜功率谱分析，处理太阳加热导致望远镜表征更困难的问题，并用大量 null 与一致性检验验证结果。摘要报告白天数据给出 18σ 的 CMB 透镜功率谱探测，透镜振幅与 Planck-ACT ΛCDM 预言一致范围内，并与 DESI BAO 联合得到 \(\sigma_8\) 约束。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇论文对 CMB 观测策略很重要，因为地基毫米波实验通常因太阳相关系统误差而更依赖夜间数据。若白天 ACT 数据也能稳健用于 CMB 透镜，将扩大可用观测时间，提高透镜功率谱和由其导出的物质涨落、暗能量及结构增长约束能力。
key_points: 使用 ACT DR6 白天观测数据测量 CMB 透镜功率谱。
通过超过一百项 null 与一致性检验评估白天数据的可靠性。
摘要报告 18σ 探测，并与 DESI BAO 联合给出 \(\sigma_8\) 约束。

papers.title: Dark Photons in the Radio Sky: II. Resonant Conversions in the Intergalactic Medium
papers.abstract: This is the second in a pair of papers forecasting the sensitivity of the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) to dark photons, a highly motivated, simple extension of the Standard Model. Through a kinetic mixing term, visible photons from the cosmic microwave background can resonantly convert into dark photons, generating new temperature anisotropies in the sky. In this work, we detail the entire analysis pipeline that we use to compute SKA's sensitivity, focusing on resonant conversions that occur in the intergalactic medium. We also discuss the sensitivity of 21-cm experiments to dark photons. Our results show that both SKA in combination with galaxy surveys and 21-cm experiments could discover dark photons with masses between $5\times 10^{-15}$ and $5\times 10^{-12}$ eV, and kinetic mixing parameter $ε$ as low as $10^{-8}$.

analysis.title_zh: 射电天空中的暗光子：II. 星系际介质中的共振转换
analysis.summary_zh: 本文是预测 SKA 对暗光子灵敏度的两篇系列论文中的第二篇；通过动能混合，CMB 可见光子可在星系际介质中共振转换为暗光子，从而在天空产生新的温度各向异性。摘要称本文详述计算 SKA 灵敏度的完整分析管线，并讨论 21-cm 实验的灵敏度，结果显示 SKA 结合星系巡天以及 21-cm 实验可发现质量介于 5×10^-15 与 5×10^-12 eV、动能混合参数 ε 低至 10^-8 的暗光子。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 若暗光子通过动能混合与可见光子耦合，CMB 光子会在传播中发生共振转换，直接改变射电波段的温度各向异性，因此 SKA 与 21-cm 实验可把 CMB 作为探测超出标准模型粒子的宇宙学探针。
key_points: 这是 SKA 暗光子灵敏度系列的第二篇，重点研究星系际介质中的共振转换。
摘要报告 SKA 与星系巡天联合、以及 21-cm 实验，可覆盖约 5×10^-15–5×10^-12 eV 的暗光子质量并探至 ε≈10^-8。
论文强调给出了完整的灵敏度计算分析管线，但具体建模与系统误差处理需核对全文。
methods: 通过动能混合项使 CMB 可见光子共振转换为暗光子。
计算 SKA 对暗光子灵敏度的完整分析管线。
讨论 21-cm 实验灵敏度，并考虑 SKA 与星系巡天联合。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时最应核对：星系际介质中的共振转换条件与背景模型如何设定；SKA 和 21-cm 的前景、系统误差与统计方法如何处理；摘要中的质量范围和 ε 灵敏度是否依赖特定的星系巡天联合方式及参数空间假设。

papers.title: Dark Photons in the Radio Sky: I. Resonant Conversions in Halos
papers.abstract: Mixing between dark photons and visible photons leads to substantial anisotropies in the cosmic microwave background due to resonant conversions of visible photons into dark photons in baryonic matter found in dark matter halos. In this work, we forecast the sensitivity of the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) to this signal. We find that SKA could be the first experiment to discover dark photons with a mass between $10^{-13}$ and $5\times 10^{-12}$ eV and kinetic mixing parameter $ε$ as small as $\sim 10^{-8}$ by cross-correlating their data with a low-redshift galaxy survey, potentially improving on the sensitivity from a similar analysis using Planck data by a factor of 4 in $ε$. This improvement is largely due to an enhancement of the signal at low frequencies and the unique experimental advantages of radio telescopes such as small beam sizes.

analysis.title_zh: 射电天空中的暗光子：I. 暗物质晕中的共振转换
analysis.summary_zh: 论文研究暗光子与可见光子混合后，在暗物质晕内重子物质中发生共振转换，从而在宇宙微波背景中产生显著各向异性。作者对平方千米阵（SKA）探测该信号的灵敏度进行预报，发现通过与低红移星系巡天互相关，SKA可探测质量在10^-13至5×10^-12 eV、动能混合参数ε小至约10^-8的暗光子，并可能比使用Planck数据的类似分析在ε上提升约4倍。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作把暗光子参数空间与CMB各向异性及射电低频观测直接联系起来，说明SKA与星系巡天互相关有望成为探测暗光子的重要手段，对CMB宇宙学和粒子宇宙学都具有交叉检验意义。
key_points: 机制是暗物质晕重子介质中可见光子共振转换为暗光子，并在CMB中留下各向异性。
摘要报告SKA通过低红移星系巡天互相关，可覆盖约10^-13–5×10^-12 eV质量范围和ε小至约10^-8的灵敏度。
相比使用Planck数据的类似分析，灵敏度在ε上可能提升约4倍，主要来自低频信号增强和射电望远镜小波束等实验优势。
methods: 对SKA探测暗光子共振转换信号的灵敏度进行预报
将SKA数据与低红移星系巡天进行互相关分析
与使用Planck数据的类似分析进行灵敏度比较
考虑暗物质晕内重子物质中的共振转换过程
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对：晕内重子分布、等离子体频率等模型如何决定共振转换信号；SKA频段、波束与前景去除对互相关信噪比的影响；所报质量范围、ε灵敏度和相对Planck提升4倍是否基于相同似然与前景假设。

papers.title: Cosmological Limits on Strong Dark Forces
papers.abstract: We showcase cosmology's ability to constrain long-range forces between dark matter particles. Specifically, we consider a fermionic dark matter interacting via a Yukawa-coupled light scalar, focusing on regimes where the dark forces are stronger than gravitational and yet unconstrained. We show that the dark sector dynamics, both at the background and perturbation levels, is far richer than what can be captured with just the static interparticle Yukawa potential. The background dynamics includes an attractor that funnels a wide range of initial conditions onto an evolution unique to each parameter space. In a large swath of parameter space beyond existing limits, the dark sector deviates drastically from cold dark matter in observable epochs. We rule out this parameter space using existing constraints on dark-sector equation of state and small-scale cosmic perturbations, thus setting the strongest constraints yet on dark matter self-interactions at length scales shorter than 100 kpc. In addition, we briefly discuss repulsive dark forces and place cosmological limits that are stricter than in the attractive case.

analysis.title_zh: 强暗力的宇宙学限制
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究费米子暗物质通过与轻标量场的 Yukawa 耦合产生长程暗力时，其背景演化与扰动演化如何偏离冷暗物质，并强调静态粒子间 Yukawa 势不足以描述完整动力学。摘要称，作者利用现有的暗部门状态方程和小尺度宇宙扰动约束，排除了大片此前未受限的参数空间，并对短于 100 kpc 尺度的暗物质自相互作用给出其所称迄今最强的限制；排斥性暗力受到的宇宙学限制更严格。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 暗部门的状态方程和扰动演化会影响宇宙膨胀、结构增长以及与 CMB 各向异性相关的引力势演化，因此该工作有助于检验标准冷暗物质假设并约束非标准暗物质微观作用。不过摘要未明确说明使用了哪些 CMB 数据集，也未单独量化 CMB 对最终限制的贡献。
key_points: 强于引力的长程暗力仍可受到宇宙学观测约束。
暗部门背景动力学存在吸引子，可使广泛初始条件趋向由参数决定的演化轨迹。
摘要报告吸引性与排斥性暗力均受限，且排斥情形的限制更严格。
methods: 建立费米子暗物质与轻标量场 Yukawa 耦合的暗部门模型。
分析暗部门的背景演化和宇宙学扰动演化，而非仅采用静态粒子间 Yukawa 势。
利用现有暗部门状态方程约束与小尺度宇宙扰动约束排除参数空间。
分别讨论吸引性和排斥性暗力。
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对背景吸引子的成立条件及其对初始条件的依赖，并确认状态方程和小尺度扰动约束具体来自哪些观测与尺度、是否包含 CMB 信息，以及“最强限制”的比较范围和模型依赖性。

papers.title: Exploring the Impact of Systematic Bias in Type Ia Supernova Cosmology Across Diverse Dark Energy Parametrizations
papers.abstract: We investigate the impact of instrumental and astrophysical systematics on dark energy (DE) constraints from Type Ia supernova (SN-Ia) observations. Using simulated datasets consistent with current SN-Ia measurements, we examine how photometric calibration, intergalactic dust, progenitor evolution in luminosity and light-curve stretch, intrinsic color scatter, and matter density mismatch affect the inferred DE equation of state (EoS) parameters $(w_0,w_a)$. We test the Generalised Scale Factor (GEN) parametrization against three time-evolving DE models: Chevallier-Polarski-Linder (CPL), Jassal-Bagla-Padmanabhan (JBP), and Logarithmic (LOG). Calibration and progenitor-related effects emerge as the dominant sources of bias. {In particular, a calibration offset of $ΔM_B=0.02$ can shift the inferred parameters by up to $Δw_0 \simeq -0.12$ and $Δw_a \simeq +0.60$ in JBP, while the corresponding shift in GEN is much smaller, with $Δw_0 \simeq -0.02$ and $Δw_a \simeq -0.04$. Progenitor-stretch evolution also induces substantial shifts, whereas intergalactic dust and color-scatter systematics produce only minor deviations for the fiducial amplitudes adopted here. Overall, JBP is the most sensitive to injected systematics, CPL and LOG show intermediate sensitivity, and GEN remains the most stable. We also quantify the deviation from the fiducial $Λ$CDM ($w_0=-1,\, w_a=0$) for the injected-systematic cases, and find that the second set of systematic injections supports the same qualitative hierarchy. These results highlight the need for sub-percent calibration precision and improved astrophysical modelling for robust DE inference from present and future SN-Ia cosmology experiments. More broadly, our results motivate model-independent tests of late-time physics, with phenomenological $(w_0,w_a)$ parametrizations used as summary statistics.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for publication in Physical Review D

analysis.title_zh: 在多种暗能量参数化下探索 Ia 型超新星宇宙学中系统偏差的影响
analysis.summary_zh: 本文研究 Ia 型超新星宇宙学中仪器与天体物理系统误差对暗能量状态方程参数 \((w_0,w_a)\) 的影响，使用与当前 SN-Ia 测量一致的模拟数据并比较 GEN、CPL、JBP、LOG 参数化。摘要报告定标偏移和前身星相关演化是主要偏差来源，JBP 对系统误差最敏感，GEN 在所测试注入下最稳定。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇文章不直接使用 CMB 数据，但关系到晚期宇宙暗能量约束与 CMB 早期宇宙基准模型的联合解释。若 SN-Ia 系统误差在不同 \((w_0,w_a)\) 参数化中诱发不同偏差，它会影响 SN 与 CMB、BAO 联合约束中对 ΛCDM 或动态暗能量的判断。
key_points: 研究 SN-Ia 系统误差如何偏置暗能量状态方程参数。
比较 GEN 与 CPL、JBP、LOG 等暗能量参数化。
摘要报告定标与前身星相关效应是主要偏差来源，GEN 最稳定。
methods: 与当前 SN-Ia 测量一致的模拟数据集
注入光度定标、星际/星系际尘埃、前身星光度与光变曲线 stretch 演化、本征颜色散布、物质密度不匹配等系统误差
暗能量参数化比较：GEN、CPL、JBP、LOG
相对于 fiducial ΛCDM 的偏离量化
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应核对模拟 SN-Ia 数据与系统误差注入幅度是否覆盖真实巡天误差预算，以及 GEN 参数化“更稳定”是源于物理鲁棒性、参数退化结构，还是所选 fiducial 与先验设置。

papers.title: A JWST/NIRSpec Integral Field Unit Survey of Luminous Quasars at z ~ 5-6 (Q-IFU): Rest-frame Optical Nuclear Properties and Extended Nebulae
papers.abstract: It remains debatable how billion-solar-mass supermassive black holes (SMBHs) form and evolve within the first billion years. We report results from a James Webb Space Telescope (JWST)/NIRSpec integral field unit (IFU) survey of 27 luminous quasars at $z \sim 5$-$6$, enabling a systematic investigation of their key physical properties and the associated, extended line emission. Our sample hosts SMBHs with $\log(M_{\mathrm{BH}}/M_\odot) \sim 8.6$-$9.7$ and Eddington ratios of $\sim 0.1$-$2.6$ based on H$β$, and the H$β$-based and H$α$-based BH mass are broadly consistent with each other. Our sample may have a slightly smaller median BH mass and larger median Eddington ratio than lower-redshift quasars within the same luminosity range, although the difference could still be explained by statistical uncertainties. They generally follow the empirical correlations between [O III] $λ$5007 equivalent width and bolometric luminosities or Eddington ratios formed by lower-redshift quasars. The majority of them fall within the Eigenvector~1 planes formed by lower-redshift quasars. Nevertheless, a subset of the sample shows enhanced, blueshifted [O III] emission associated with fast outflows. Spatially extended [O III] line emission is detected in 6 objects and shows morphologies and kinematics consistent with merging activities and/or turbulent and clumpy interstellar media (ISM). Tentative evidence of quasar radiative feedback shaping the ISM of a merging companion galaxy is seen in the object with the most extended [O III] emission. Our results provide crucial insight into the rapid growth of SMBHs and the gaseous environments they reside in at z$\sim$5-6.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, resubmitted to ApJ after addressing the referee's comments

analysis.title_zh: z≈5–6 明亮类星体的 JWST/NIRSpec 积分视场单元巡天（Q-IFU）：静止系光学核区性质与延展星云
analysis.summary_zh: 本文报告 JWST/NIRSpec IFU 对 27 个 z≈5–6 明亮类星体的巡天结果，研究早期宇宙十亿太阳质量级超大质量黑洞的核区光学性质和延展线发射。摘要称样本的 Hβ 与 Hα 黑洞质量大体一致，多数性质延续低红移类星体经验关系，但有部分目标显示增强且蓝移的 [O III] 外流，6 个目标检测到延展 [O III] 发射。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这篇主要属于高红移类星体和星系演化研究，与 CMB 的联系较间接：它约束再电离后期附近的超大质量黑洞快速增长、反馈和气体环境，可为早期结构形成与高红移辐射源族群提供背景信息。对以 CMB 为主的读者，它更像是宇宙早期天体形成的旁支参考，而非 CMB 数据分析论文。
key_points: JWST/NIRSpec IFU 观测 27 个 z≈5–6 明亮类星体。
基于 Hβ 和 Hα 估计黑洞质量，并研究 Eddington 比、[O III] 性质和外流。
6 个目标中检测到空间延展 [O III] 发射，形态和运动学与并合或湍动团块状 ISM 相符。
methods: JWST/NIRSpec 积分视场单元（IFU）巡天
27 个 z≈5–6 明亮类星体样本
Hβ 与 Hα 黑洞质量估计

Eigenvector 1 平面对比

papers.title: Chaotic Inflation RIDES Again
papers.abstract: Following the recent Atacama Cosmology Telescope (ACT) results, we revisit chaotic inflation based on a single complex scalar field with mass term $M^2 |Φ|^2$, which usually predicts a spectra index $n_s\approx 0.96$ but a too-large tensor to scalar ratio $r\approx 0.16$. With radiative corrections, the potential $M^2 |Φ|^2 \ln \left( |Φ|^2/Λ^2 \right)$ induces spontaneous symmetry breaking near the scale $Λ$, yielding a Pseudo Nambu-Goldstone boson which can play the role of a quintessence field, hence radiative inflation and dark energy (RIDE). Including a non-minimal coupling to gravity $ξ|Φ|^2 R^2$ reduces $r$, allowing a good fit of the RIDE model to Planck data. Allowing a small additional quartic coupling correction $λ|Φ|^4$ increases both $n_s$ and $r$, with a good fit to ACT data sets achieved for $ξ\approx 1$.

analysis.title_zh: 混沌暴胀 RIDE 再现
analysis.summary_zh: 本文在近期 ACT 结果后重新考察基于单个复标量场质量项的 chaotic inflation，并加入辐射修正、非最小引力耦合和小的四次耦合修正。摘要报告，辐射修正可产生与暗能量相关的赝 Nambu-Goldstone 模式，非最小耦合降低张量标量比使模型可拟合 Planck，而小四次项可提高谱指数和张量标量比并在 ξ≈1 时拟合 ACT 数据集。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该文直接涉及 CMB 可观测量中的标量谱指数 ns 和张量标量比 r，并讨论 ACT 与 Planck 数据对暴胀模型的偏好；对关注 CMB 初始扰动、原初引力波和暴胀-暗能量统一模型的读者具有直接相关性。
key_points: 在 ACT 结果背景下重新讨论带辐射修正的 chaotic inflation/RIDE 模型。
辐射修正诱导自发对称性破缺，并产生可作为 quintessence 的赝 Nambu-Goldstone 玻色子。
摘要称非最小引力耦合可降低 r，额外小四次项可提高 ns 和 r，并使模型可拟合 ACT 数据集。
methods: 单复标量场 chaotic inflation 模型
辐射修正势能
非最小引力耦合
额外四次耦合修正
与 Planck 和 ACT 数据集拟合比较
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对非最小耦合项的具体形式和维度一致性、ACT 与 Planck 数据组合的选择、ns-r 约束的处理，以及 RIDE 同时解释暴胀与暗能量时是否满足稳定性和晚期宇宙约束。

papers.title: Study the nature of dynamical dark energy by measuring the CMB polarization rotation angle
papers.abstract: Recent results from the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) support the dynamical dark energy. Intriguingly, the data favor a transition of the dark energy equation of state across $w=-1$, a hallmark of the Quintom scenario. In this paper, we consider a different approach to the dynamical nature of dark energy by investigating its interaction with ordinary matters, specifically the Chern-Simons (CS) interaction with photons. In cosmology, this interaction rotates the polarized plane of the cosmic microwave background (CMB) photons, which induces non-zero polarized TB and EB power spectra. We forecast this measurement with the Ali CMB Polarization Telescope (AliCPT) experiment. We take the best-fit value of the isotropic rotation angle from Planck data as our fiducial input. We project that 11 module-year (modyr) of observations will yield an improved detection sensitivity with a significance $\sim 5σ$, given a calibration precision of $0.1^\circ$ in the polarization angle. We also forecast AliCPT's sensitivity to the amplitude of a scale invariant spectrum of the anisotropic polarization rotation field. With $50$~modyr of observations, the large-aperture configuration is expected to reach $σ_{A_{\mathrm{CB}}}\sim10^{-2}$, offering a sixfold improvement over the small-aperture design and enabling competitive tests of spatial fluctuations in the dark energy field.

analysis.title_zh: 通过测量 CMB 偏振旋转角研究动态暗能量的性质
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出通过测量 CMB 偏振旋转角来检验动态暗能量与普通物质、特别是光子的 Chern-Simons 相互作用，并用 AliCPT 进行观测预报。摘要报告在采用 Planck 各向同性旋转角最佳拟合值为 fiducial 时，AliCPT 可提高探测灵敏度，并进一步预报其对尺度不变各向异性旋转场振幅的约束能力。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把暗能量动力学、宇宙双折射和 CMB 偏振系统测量直接联系起来；若 TB/EB 中的偏振旋转信号可靠存在，它可为 DESI 所提示的动态暗能量或 Quintom 类情景提供与距离测量互补的检验。
key_points: 以动态暗能量与光子的 Chern-Simons 相互作用为物理动机。
CMB 偏振旋转会诱导非零 TB 和 EB 功率谱。
摘要给出 AliCPT 对各向同性和各向异性偏振旋转的预报灵敏度。
methods: AliCPT 实验预报
采用 Planck 数据给出的各向同性旋转角最佳拟合值作为 fiducial 输入
TB 和 EB 偏振功率谱测量
尺度不变各向异性偏振旋转场振幅的灵敏度预报
比较小口径与大口径配置
analysis.reading_note_zh: 精读时应重点核对预报中的仪器噪声、天空覆盖、前景处理、透镜化、TB/EB 系统误差和偏振角定标先验，特别是 0.1° 定标精度如何进入显著性评估。

papers.title: Neural Network identification of Dark Star Candidates. I. Photometry
papers.abstract: The formation of the first stars in the universe could be significantly impacted by the effects of Dark Matter (DM). Namely, if DM is in the form of Weakly Interacting Massive Particles (WIMPs), it could lead to the formation (at $z\sim 25-10$) of stars that are powered by DM annihilations alone, i.e. Dark Stars (DSs). Those objects can grow to become supermassive ($M\sim 10^6 M_\odot$) and shine as bright as a galaxy ($L\sim 10^8 L_\odot)$. Using a simple $χ^2$ minimization, the first three DSs photometric candidates (i.e. JADES-GS-z11, JADES-GS-z12, and JADES-GS-z13) were identified by Ilie et al. (2023). Our goal is to develop tools to streamline the identification of such candidates within the rather large publicly available high redshift JWST data sets. We present here the key first step in achieving this goal: the development and implementation of a feed-forward neural network (FFNN) search for Dark Star candidates, using data from the JWST Advanced Deep Extragalactic Survey (JADES) photometric catalog. Our method reconfirms JADES-GS-z13 and JADES-GS-z11 as dark star candidates, based on the chi-squared goodness of fit test, yet they are $\sim10^4$ times faster than the Neadler-Mead $χ^2$ minimization method used in Ilie et al. (2023). We further identify six {\it new photometric} Dark Star candidates across redshifts $z \sim 9$ to $z \sim 14$. These findings underscore the power of neural networks in modeling non-linear relationships and efficiently analyzing large-scale photometric surveys, advancing the search for Dark Stars.

papers.title: Euler-Heisenberg actions for gauge-axial background vectors: Hessian diagonalization, sector classification, and applications
papers.abstract: We derive the closed-form one-loop Euler-Heisenberg effective actions for Dirac fermions coupled simultaneously to classical electromagnetic vector and massive pseudo-vector backgrounds within a controlled quasi-static approximation. Through complete diagonalization of the functional Hessian, we systematically delineate the parameter space into distinct sectors characterized by stability properties and spectral structure. We identify subspaces that encompass and extend results from previous studies into a broader class, admitting propagating axial fields as physically viable regimes; strikingly, we note sectors presenting chirality-asymmetric instability. This addresses long-standing questions regarding the well-defined nature, diagonalizability, and stability of these models. From the effective actions, we derive novel nonperturbative pair-production rates for simultaneously propagating electromagnetic and axial vector backgrounds; remarkably, we find pronounced vacuum stabilization compared to previous results. Furthermore, we derive the non-perturbative contributions to the chiral current divergence, which enables dynamical chiral symmetry breaking and show that the electromagnetic coupling induces instanton-like configurations for the axial field, even when it is not a fundamental gauge field. As a proof-of-concept, we analyze a cosmological toy model of baryogenesis driven by an axial vector, providing numerical estimates that support the viability of this hypothesis. Additionally, we outline qualitative predictions for Weyl/Dirac semi-metals and briefly discuss potential applications in related phenomena, such as Quark-Gluon plasma, Electroweak scenarios and the Strong-CP problem.
papers.comment: 33 pages, 2 figures, based on the author's M.Sc. Dissertation available at https://repositorio.ufjf.br/jspui/handle/ufjf/19665?mode=full

analysis.title_zh: 规范-轴向背景矢量的 Euler-Heisenberg 作用：Hessian 对角化、扇区分类与应用

通过 Hessian 对角化划分稳定性和谱结构不同的参数扇区。

papers.title: CMB observables and reheat temperature as a window to models of inflation and freeze-in dark matter production
papers.abstract: A systematic approach is presented for using CMB observables and reheating temperature for discriminating between various models of inflation and certain freeze-in dark matter scenarios. It is applied to several classes of $α$-attractor models as an illustrative example. In the first step, all independent parameters of the inflationary potential are expressed in terms of the CMB observables (the three parameters - by the scalar spectral index $n_s$, scalar amplitude $A_s$ and the tensor-to-scalar amplitude ratio $r$). For a standard reheating mechanism characterized by the inflaton equation of state parameter $w$ and its effective dissipation rate $Γ$ the reheating temperature is uniquely fixed in terms of the CMB observables measured for some pivot scale $k_*$. There are striking consequences of this fact. The model independent bounds on the reheating temperature, the BBN lower bound and the upper bound of the order of the GUT/Planck scale, translate themselves for each class of models into very narrow ranges of the allowed values of the spectral index $n_s(k_*)$, providing their strong tests by the present and future CMB data. The recent tension between Planck and DESI-ACT results has strong impact on our conclusions. Furthermore, given a class of inflaton models satisfying those tests, the reheating temperature is an interesting portal to link the CMB observables to the particle physics scenarios that are sensitive to it. As an example, non-thermal dark matter (DM) production mechanisms are discussed. One obtains then a consistency check between theories of inflation and DM production. If the future precision of the CMB data will constrain the reheating temperature beyond the model independent bounds, further constraints on the DM production will follow.
papers.comment: 29 pages; 8 figures; version accepted for publication in JCAP. Used approximations and accuracy of obtained results discussed in more detail; some figures modified to improve their readability; discussion of some points extended

papers.title: Symmetry-Protected $α$-Attractor Hybrid Inflation in Supergravity and Constraints from ACT DR6 and DESI DR2
papers.abstract: We present a symmetry-protected supergravity effective realization of hybrid $α$-attractor inflation with a sequestered Stückelberg uplift. The model contains four chiral multiplets, an inflaton modulus $T$, a stabilizer field $S$, and a pair of oppositely charged waterfall multiplets $(Ψ,\barΨ)$, together with a hidden Stückelberg $U(1)_D$ sector that generates an approximately constant positive contribution to the scalar potential. Along the real inflationary trajectory, the F-term potential realizes the E-model plateau \[ U(φ)=V_0\left(1-e^{-\sqrt{2/(3α)}\,φ}\right)^2 , \] while the sequestered uplift shifts the total energy density without directly modifying the tree-level inflaton slope. We derive the background evolution, the analytic $N$--$φ$ relation, the waterfall stability condition, and the leading predictions for the scalar spectral index and tensor-to-scalar ratio. The model retains the characteristic red-tilted $α$-attractor behavior, with $n_s\simeq1-2/N_*$ and tensor amplitudes controlled primarily by the curvature parameter $α$, while the uplift and the hybrid end point generate only subleading corrections at fixed $N_*$. We also discuss the assumptions required for an effectively single-field trajectory, including the treatment of the light angular component of $T$, and examine the sensitivity of the sequestered uplift to Planck-suppressed cross-couplings. The resulting construction provides a controlled supergravity embedding of hybrid $α$-attractor inflation compatible with current CMB constraints, including Planck, ACT DR6, and DESI DR2, while remaining testable by future $B$-mode searches such as LiteBIRD and CMB-S4.

papers.title: Conditional variational autoencoders for cosmological model discrimination and anomaly detection in cosmic microwave background power spectra
papers.abstract: The cosmic microwave background power spectra are a primary window into the early universe. However, achieving interpretable compression and fast inference diagnostics under weak model assumptions remains challenging. We propose a parameter-conditioned variational autoencoder (CVAE) that aligns a data-driven latent representation with cosmological parameters while retaining an interface to likelihood-style diagnostic tests. The model achieves high directional reconstruction fidelity for the $D_\ell^{TT}$, $D_\ell^{EE}$, and $D_\ell^{TE}$ spectra in just 5 latent dimensions. It reconstructs spectra for several beyond-$Λ$CDM test cases, including controlled parameter extrapolations, and enables an amortized surrogate diagnostic that reduces one representative post-training MCMC run from $\sim$40 hours on CPU cores to $\sim$2 minutes on a GPU in this demonstration. The learned latent space shows a distributed, partially structured organization that mirrors known cosmological parameters and their degeneracies. It also provides representation-space discrimination diagnostics for distinguishing tested cosmological spectra from a fiducial reference. Overall, this physics-informed CVAE supports interpretable compression, rapid diagnostic exploration, and anomaly-sensitive representation learning beyond $Λ$CDM.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 18 figures; accepted for publication in Physical Review D

analysis.title_zh: 用于宇宙微波背景功率谱中宇宙学模型判别与反常探测的条件变分自编码器
analysis.summary_zh: 本文面向 CMB TT、EE、TE 功率谱，提出以宇宙学参数为条件的变分自编码器，将数据驱动潜变量与参数空间对应起来，用于可解释压缩、快速诊断和模型区分。摘要报告该方法在 5 维潜空间中实现较高方向重建保真度，可重建若干 beyond-ΛCDM 测试谱，并在一个演示中把代表性的后训练 MCMC 诊断从 CPU 上约 40 小时降到 GPU 上约 2 分钟。

papers.title: Cosmic Overture Echoed in a Stellar Final Act: Implications of Nanohertz Gravitational Waves for Core Collapse Supernova Neutrinos
papers.abstract: The growing evidence for nanohertz gravitational waves, from NANOGrav and other observations, may be pointing to a cosmological first-order phase transition at temperatures of $\mathcal{O}(10-100)\;\mathrm{MeV}$. Such an interpretation requires beyond the Standard Model dynamics in this energy range. If so, it may well be the case that galactic core-collapse supernova explosions would produce the key components related to the first-order phase transition, leaving detectable imprints on the spectrum of neutrinos emitted in the initial few seconds of the collapse. This might provide further evidence in support of the early universe interpretation of the nanohertz gravitational wave signal. The scenario proposed here is also suggestive of a low-mass seesaw mechanism to explain neutrino masses. We outline the prospects for future observations of Galactic supernovae to uncover the signals of this scenario, with further confirmation from future pulsar timing array measurements of primordial nanohertz gravitational waves.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Matches the version accepted in PLB

analysis.title_zh: 宇宙序曲回响于恒星终幕：纳赫兹引力波对核心坍缩超新星中微子的启示
analysis.summary_zh: 论文探讨将脉冲星计时阵列所提示的纳赫兹引力波解释为温度约为10–100 MeV的宇宙学一级相变，并讨论相关超越标准模型成分能否在银河系核心坍缩超新星中改变坍缩最初数秒的中微子能谱。摘要称，未来超新星中微子观测与脉冲星计时阵列测量可对这一情景进行互补检验，同时该情景可能指向低质量跷跷板中微子质量机制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作并非直接研究CMB，而是尝试用纳赫兹引力波和超新星中微子探测早期宇宙在MeV能标附近可能发生的相变，为CMB之外的早期宇宙与粒子物理约束提供互补渠道。若该联系成立，还可能把原初引力波背景、恒星坍缩和中微子质量起源纳入同一套超越标准模型框架。

papers.title: Superhorizon Isocurvature as a Window into Dark Matter Production
papers.abstract: In the presence of primordial isocurvature perturbations, for example in a separate dark radiation sector, the superhorizon evolution of curvature perturbations becomes nontrivial. If the dark sector is radiation-like and constitutes a significant fraction of the energy density, its isocurvature can imply isocurvature in the inflaton sector even without direct interactions between the sectors. In this article, we revisit superhorizon curvature and isocurvature evolution in the long-wavelength limit systematically, drawing a simple picture of how to understand the nature of these fluctuations from first principles and without brute-force cosmic perturbation theory. We show how the described setup is able to source isocurvature in simple models of dark matter such as freeze-in and freeze-out and demonstrate that future measurements of matter and neutrino isocurvature can potentially discriminate between these two mechanisms.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 9 figures. v2: Minor revisions: corrected typo, added limit to analytic calculation, expanded discussion. Results and conclusions unchanged

analysis.title_zh: 超视界等熵扰动：窥探暗物质产生机制的窗口
analysis.summary_zh: 本文系统讨论存在原初等熵扰动时，尤其是暗辐射扇区占据显著能量密度时，超视界曲率扰动的演化，并用长波长极限和基本原理建立直观描述。摘要称该机制可在无直接扇区相互作用时诱导暴胀子扇区等熵扰动，并应用于 freeze-in 和 freeze-out 暗物质模型；未来物质和中微子等熵扰动测量或可区分两种产生机制。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 超视界曲率与等熵扰动会影响原初扰动从早期宇宙向后续结构形成和辐射观测的传递，因此与 CMB 的温度、偏振及等熵扰动约束具有直接的宇宙学关联。该工作进一步把暗物质产生机制映射到物质和中微子等熵扰动，为利用 CMB 及其他宇宙学观测区分 freeze-in 与 freeze-out 提供了概念框架；不过摘要未报告具体 CMB 约束或预测数值。
key_points: 暗辐射扇区的等熵扰动可在超视界尺度上影响曲率扰动演化。
即使暗扇区与暴胀子扇区没有直接相互作用，显著的暗辐射能量分数也可能诱导暴胀子扇区等熵扰动。
未来对物质和中微子等熵扰动的测量可能区分暗物质 freeze-in 与 freeze-out 产生机制。
methods: 长波长极限下系统研究超视界曲率扰动和等熵扰动演化
从基本原理分析扰动性质，避免直接依赖繁复的宇宙学微扰理论计算
将该框架应用于暗物质 freeze-in 和 freeze-out 模型

papers.title: Electroweak Baryogenesis with BARYONET: a self-contained review of the WKB approach
papers.abstract: We present a comprehensive, self-contained pedagogical computation of the baryon asymmetry of the Universe within electroweak baryogenesis (EWBG), from the derivation of the semiclassical, CP-dependent force to the formulation and solution of the transport equations obtained from the Boltzmann equations$-$all implemented in the open-source code BARYONET. Our analysis follows the semiclassical WKB approach, where spatially varying complex masses across expanding bubble walls feel CP-violating forces that bias plasma transport. Starting from the stationary Boltzmann equation in the wall frame and projecting onto a hierarchy of velocity moments, we derive a compact, fluid-like system of coupled differential equations for chemical potentials and velocity perturbations. After obtaining the solutions, one can define the left-handed baryon chemical potential, which acts as the source term for the weak sphalerons. These processes generate the baryon asymmetry in front of the wall, which is subsequently frozen once it passes through it. We validate the framework against established formalisms and provide benchmarks in representative scenarios, including singlet extensions of the Standard Model, two-Higgs-doublet models, and Higgs$-φ^6$ constructions. The resulting BARYONET implementation delivers an automated, reproducible pipeline for WKB-based baryogenesis studies, connecting formal derivations with phenomenological applications. In parallel, we revisit standard EWBG ingredients$-$diffusion constants, Yukawa/helicity-flip rates, and strong/weak sphaleron rates$-$to clarify conventions, update numerical inputs, and present a pedagogical derivation, ensuring transparent reproducibility.

papers.title: Testing a cosmological teleparallel modified f(T) model with parametric H(z)
papers.abstract: We study the late-time cosmological expansion of a modified teleparallel gravity model. This modified gravitational lagrangian yields a cosmological constant term along with power-law corrections to the Teleparallel Equivalent of General Relativity (TEGR) for small $λ$. By combining observational data from cosmic chronometers, Type Ia supernovae from the Pantheon+ dataset, and Baryon Acoustic Oscillations (BAO) from DESI RD1, we constrain the parameters of the modified gravitational dynamics assuming a quadratically parameterized Hubble rate $H(z)$. The joint observational fit indicates a late-time accelerated expansion with a deceleration parameter of $q_0 = -0.417_{-0.022}^{+0.021}$. Furthermore, we analyze the effective energy density, pressure, and equation-of-state parameter $ω$, showing that this modified gravity theory naturally accommodates quintessence like and phantom like behavior. Finally, a linear scalar perturbation analysis confirms that the cosmological background is dynamically stable against homogeneous fluctuations.

analysis.title_zh: 用参数化 H(z) 检验一个宇宙学遥平行修正 f(T) 模型

papers.title: WimPyC: an extension module of WimPyDD for the calculation of WIMP capture in celestial bodies
papers.abstract: We introduce WimPyC, a Python code for the calculation of the capture rate of Weakly Interacting Massive Particles (WIMPs) by celestial bodies through nuclear scattering in the optically thin regime. WimPyC is an extension of the WimPyDD code, that calculates WIMP-nucleus scattering signals in direct detection (DD) experiments, and allows to combine DD and capture in celestial bodies in virtually any scenario within the framework of Galilean-invariant non-relativistic effective theory (NREFT), including inelastic scattering, an arbitrary WIMP spin and a generic WIMP velocity distribution in the Galactic halo. WimPyDD and WimPyC are suitable for both top-down approaches, where the interaction operators of a high-energy physics model are matched to those of the NREFT, and to bottom-up studies, where the Wilson coefficients of the NREFT are explored in a model-independent way and/or where the velocity distribution is written in terms of a superposition of streams taken as free parameters. As in the case of WimPyDD WimPyC exploits the factorization of the three main components that enter in the calculation of the capture rate: i) the Wilson coefficients that encode the dependence of the signals on the ultraviolet completion of the effective theory; ii) a response function that depends on the nuclear physics; iii) the halo function that depends on the WIMP velocity distribution. In WimPyC these three components are calculated and stored separately for later interpolation and combined together only as the last step of the signal evaluation procedure. This makes the phenomenological study of the capture rate with WimPyC transparent and improves computational speed.
papers.comment: 54 pages, 10 figures, 1 table. Updated to published version. WimPyC can be downloaded from https://wimpydd.hepforge.org/

analysis.title_zh: WimPyC：用于计算天体中 WIMP 捕获的 WimPyDD 扩展模块
analysis.summary_zh: 本文介绍 WimPyC，一个用于计算弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）通过核散射被天体捕获的 Python 扩展模块。摘要称它继承 WimPyDD 的直接探测框架，可在 NREFT 中处理非弹性散射、任意 WIMP 自旋和一般银河晕速度分布，并通过将 Wilson 系数、核响应与晕函数分开计算和插值来加速现象学研究。

papers.title: The Lensing Counter Narrative: An Effective Description of Small-Scale Clustering in Weak Lensing Power Spectra
papers.abstract: We present a new formalism to separate large- and small-scale contributions to cosmic shear through \textit{lensing counterterms} (LCT) inspired by effective field theory (EFT). Marginalizing over these LCTs isolates the large-scale cosmological signal in weak lensing power spectra while simultaneously constraining the impact of baryonic feedback or new physics (e.g. axion dark matter) at small scales. Our formalism removes the need for hard scale cuts in standard analyses, even when theoretical predictions are limited to below a physical cutoff $Λ$, resulting in significant improvements in constraining power, more than $5\times$ smaller in the case of an LSST-Y10-like analysis without marginalizing over baryons when the analysis cutoff is set to $Λ= 1.0h$ Mpc$^{-1}$. We conduct a proof-of-principle analysis on the publicly available DES Y3 data, finding $S_8= 0.783\pm 0.029$ and $S_8 = 0.798\pm 0.026$ for analyses with cutoffs of $Λ= 0.5h$ Mpc$^{-1}$ and $1.0 h$ Mpc$^{-1}$, respectively, with no detection of modifications to small-scale clustering at $k > Λ$ beyond the predictions of collisionless dark matter in a $Λ$CDM universe. We make our \texttt{JAX}-based pipeline, \texttt{gholax}, integrated with intrinsic alignment predictions from the EFT of large-scale structure at 1-loop, publicly available.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 16 figures, likelihood code released at https://github.com/j-dr/gholax. Version accepted in PRD

analysis.title_zh: 透镜反叙事：弱透镜功率谱中小尺度聚团的有效描述
analysis.summary_zh: 本文提出一种受有效场论启发的 lensing counterterms 框架，用于在弱引力透镜功率谱中分离大尺度宇宙学信号与小尺度聚团、重子反馈或新物理影响。摘要称，该方法可减少对硬尺度切割的依赖，在 LSST-Y10-like 分析中提升约束能力，并在 DES Y3 数据上得到与 ΛCDM 冷暗物质小尺度预测相容的结果。
analysis.why_it_matters_zh: 弱透镜的 S8 张力、重子反馈和小尺度非线性建模是当前宇宙学参数推断的关键系统误差来源，也与 CMB 推断的物质涨落幅度比较密切相关。若该框架稳健，它可改进低红移大尺度结构与 CMB 之间的一致性检验，并为 LSST 等未来巡天提供更灵活的小尺度建模策略。
key_points: 提出用 lensing counterterms 分离弱透镜功率谱中的大尺度与小尺度贡献。

摘要报告了 DES Y3 的概念验证分析，并公开 JAX 管线 gholax。
